papers.title: DepthMaster: Unified Monocular Depth Estimation for Perspective and Panoramic Images
papers.abstract_en: While monocular depth estimation has achieved significant progress, achieving generalized metric depth estimation for both narrow field-of-view (FoV) perspectives and $360^\circ$ panoramas remains an unsolved challenge. Existing methods are often tailored to specific camera types and struggle to produce accurate metric depth that generalizes across diverse settings. This limitation stems from two key challenges: the inherent geometric discrepancy between perspective and panoramic cameras, and the scarcity of panoramic training data with metric annotations. In this work, we introduce DepthMaster, a unified metric depth estimation framework. Rather than employing specialized networks to learn spherical distortions, we reformulate the problem by decomposing panoramic images into overlapping perspective patches. Crucially, distinct from prior projection-based methods that rely on ad-hoc architectural modifications to handle boundaries, we introduce a novel Correspondence Consistency Loss (CCL) and inject virtual projection cameras as geometric priors, allowing us to seamlessly stitch the patches while avoiding specialized operators and keeping the backbone largely compatible with standard Transformer designs. This strategy also resolves the geometric differences by unifying all inputs into a canonical perspective representation, and effectively circumvents data scarcity by directly unlocking powerful metric priors from vast perspective datasets. Trained on a mixed dataset that contains only one panorama dataset, DepthMaster achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on 13 diverse datasets, outperforming not only universal methods but also leading specialist models in both perspective and panoramic domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DepthMaster，一个统一的度量深度估计框架，同时适用于窄视场透视图像和360°全景图像。通过将全景图像分解为重叠的透视补丁，并引入对应一致性损失（CCL）和虚拟投影相机作为几何先验，该方法无需专门网络学习球面畸变，即可无缝拼接补丁。仅使用一个全景数据集训练，在13个多样数据集上实现了最先进的零样本性能，超越通用方法和专用模型。
Motivation: 现有单目深度估计方法通常针对特定相机类型设计，难以在透视和全景图像上同时实现准确的度量深度泛化，主要因为两种相机的几何差异和全景训练数据的匮乏。
Method: 将全景图像分解为重叠的透视补丁，引入对应一致性损失（CCL）和虚拟投影相机几何先验，以统一输入为规范透视表示，避免专门算子，保持与标准Transformer兼容。
Result: 仅使用一个全景数据集训练，在13个多样数据集上达到零样本最先进性能，优于通用方法和透视/全景领域的专门模型。
Conclusion: DepthMaster通过统一输入表示和利用透视数据集中的度量先验，有效解决了全景深度估计的数据稀缺和几何差异问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VOID: Defeating Unauthorized Mimicry in Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: While Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have revolutionized visual synthesis, they are increasingly exploited for unauthorized mimicry of individuals. Existing defenses inject deceptive perturbations to steer the generated images toward irrelevant targets. However, this approach hinges on an ungrounded assumption: subtle perturbations can maintain their deceptive efficacy throughout an LDM's extensive generation process. In reality, the model's innate restoration mechanism will remove such perturbations and cause individual identities to re-emerge in the images generated. We propose VOID, a defense framework that overcomes this conundrum by manipulating an LDM's intrinsic stochasticity. VOID perturbs the diffusion pipeline in two novel ways: 1) amplifying the latent encoding errors to shatter an image's semantic structure, and 2) counteracting the target guidance signals to suppress the model's restoration capabilities. This results in a semantic corruption that thwarts any unauthorized mimicry. Notably, the security gain does not come at the price of visual utility, as VOID simultaneously manages to confine perturbations to human-imperceptible regions of protected images. Our comprehensive evaluation of 24 state-of-the-art defenses against 10 mimicry attacks on 5 datasets demonstrates VOID's unprecedented protection power: it increases the average Frechet Inception Distance (FID) from 113 to 365, a 223% improvement over the strongest defense to date.
papers.comment: Extended full version with more comprehensive experimental results. To appear in the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜在扩散模型（LDM）被用于未经授权模仿的问题，提出VOID防御框架。VOID通过放大潜在编码误差以破坏语义结构，并抑制目标引导信号以削弱模型修复能力，从而在人类不可感知的扰动范围内实现语义破坏。实验表明，在5个数据集上对10种模仿攻击的评估中，VOID将平均FID从113提升至365，相比现有最强防御提升223%。
Motivation: 现有防御依赖注入欺骗性扰动以将生成图像导向无关目标，但该假设不成立：LDM的固有能力会移除这些扰动并还原个体身份。
Method: VOID通过两种方式操纵LDM的内在随机性：1) 放大潜在编码误差以破坏图像的语义结构；2) 抵消目标引导信号以抑制模型的修复能力，从而在保持视觉效用的情况下实现语义破坏。
Result: 在24种现有防御和10种模仿攻击的全面评估中，VOID将平均FID从113提升至365，比最强现有防御提高223%。
Conclusion: VOID通过扰动LDM内在随机性有效防御未经授权模仿，且安全增益不牺牲视觉效用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DrivingAgent，一个面向自动驾驶系统设计与实时调度的智能体框架。该框架在系统设计阶段自动解读架构、生成代码并通过超网络训练验证模块；在调度阶段使用经强化学习训练的轻量级大语言模型动态编排模块，并借助结合长期存储与时戳短期记忆的结构化记忆支持持续运行。实验在nuScenes和Bench2Drive上展示了优越的速度-准确率权衡。
Motivation: 当前自动驾驶系统集成基础模型时面临手动设计集成新模型和缺乏智能动态调度两大挑战，现有基于LLM的智能体无法区分系统设计与实时调度的不同要求，且不适用于持续运行。
Method: 设计阶段自动化模块开发：通过解释系统架构生成代码并利用超网络训练验证；调度阶段采用经强化学习的轻量级LLM实时动态编排系统模块，并配备融合长期存储与带时间戳短期记忆的结构化记忆。
Result: 在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准上取得更优的速度-准确率权衡。
Conclusion: DrivingAgent通过统一设计自动化与智能调度，有效应对自动驾驶系统面临的动态实时约束与模块集成挑战。

papers.title: A Lightweight Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Concrete Barrier Design
papers.abstract_en: The design of reinforced concrete highway barriers is a safety-critical process that requires strict compliance with regulatory provisions such as the AASHTO-LRFD bridge design guidelines. Current engineering practice relies heavily on manual, iterative, and heuristic calculations to satisfy complex nonlinear material and mechanics constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generative capabilities, their direct application to structural engineering remains limited by hallucination risks and insufficient physical grounding. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel "generation-evaluation-optimization" closed-loop framework for automated concrete barrier design using the multi-agent orchestration capabilities of AutoGen. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed agentic framework achieves over 98% design accuracy, significantly outperforming standalone general-purpose LLMs. More importantly, the study reveals that design performance is not necessarily correlated with model scale, where an 8B-parameter lightweight model could outperform unconstrained 631B-parameter flagship models. This finding highlights the potential to substantially reduce computational costs while improving the accessibility of AI-assisted engineering tools for industry applications. The source code for the proposed multi-agent design framework is available at the project GitHub repository: https://github.com/MXY820/barrier-design. Keywords: Structural Engineering; Multi-Agent Systems; Large Language Models; Concrete Barrier Design; AutoGen; Design Automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于多智能体（AutoGen）的轻量级框架，用于自动化钢筋混凝土护栏设计，将“生成-评估-优化”闭环集成，以符合AASHTO-LRFD规范。实验表明该框架设计准确率超过98%，且8B参数模型性能优于631B参数通用大模型，显著降低了计算成本。
Motivation: 当前混凝土护栏设计依赖人工迭代和启发式计算，效率低且易出错；大语言模型直接应用存在幻觉和物理约束不足的问题。
Method: 提出“生成-评估-优化”闭环框架，利用AutoGen的多智能体编排能力，将设计任务分解为多个智能体协作，分别负责生成、校验和优化。
Result: 设计准确率超过98%，显著优于通用大语言模型；8B参数轻量模型表现优于631B参数旗舰模型，表明模型规模与设计性能并非正相关。
Conclusion: 该多智能体框架能有效结合LLM生成能力与工程约束校验，实现低成本、高准确率的自动化护栏设计，并开源代码。

papers.title: Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling (HELM): Agent-Based Finite Element Modeling of Concrete Bridge Barriers
papers.abstract_en: Finite element (FE) modeling of safety-critical infrastructure such as bridge barriers requires high-fidelity nonlinear dynamic analysis, yet the current FE modeling process remains labor-intensive and lacks automation. This paper presents the Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling (HELM) framework, a collaborative human-agent protocol that decomposes long-sequence finite element modeling into discrete, visually verifiable checkpoints across geometry generation, boundary condition definition, and material assignment. The framework is demonstrated through a 20-case matrix of reinforced concrete bridge barriers under MASH TL-4 and TL-5 lateral loading conditions, interfacing specialized agents with two widely used commercial FE softwares, i.e., ANSYS and LS-PrePost. Experimental results show that HELM improves the baseline autonomous modeling success rate from 20% to 75%, with agent-level pass rates for geometry and boundary condition tasks approximately doubling. Error analysis reveals that spatial reasoning and algebraic logic limitations constitute the primary failure modes, underscoring the value of structured human-in-the-loop intervention for modeling automation. The complete agent design code and prompts are open-sourced and can be accessed at: https://github.com/SimAgentDev/Ansys-LSPP-AgentKit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了人类增强循环建模 (HELM) 框架，这是一种人机协作协议，将有限元建模分解为几何生成、边界条件定义和材料分配等可验证的步骤，用于混凝土桥梁护栏的建模。在20个案例的钢筋混凝土桥梁护栏测试中，HELM将自主建模成功率从20%提升到75%，并开源了代码。
Motivation: 当前桥梁护栏等安全关键基础设施的有限元建模过程劳动密集且缺乏自动化，现有自主建模方法成功率低。
Method: HELM框架通过人类代理协作，将长序列有限元建模分解为离散、视觉可验证的检查点，涉及几何生成、边界条件定义和材料分配，并使用ANSYS和LS-PrePost两种商用软件。
Result: 在20个案例的MASH TL-4和TL-5横向加载条件下，HELM将自主建模成功率从20%提高到75%，几何和边界条件任务的代理级通过率近乎翻倍。错误分析表明空间推理和代数逻辑限制是主要失败模式。
Conclusion: 结构化的人机协作干预对于建模自动化有价值，HELM框架在安全关键基础设施建模中展现了显著改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frozen Multimodal Embeddings for Personality and Cognitive Ability Assessment in Asynchronous Video Interviews
papers.abstract_en: Predicting psychological traits from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) is a challenging problem in AI-assisted interview assessment because labeled datasets are limited while each response contains high-dimensional visual, acoustic, and verbal signals. This paper presents our solution for the ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026, which evaluates two tasks: Track~1 predicts self-reported HEXACO personality traits from personality-related interview responses, and Track~2 classifies cognitive ability levels from structured AVI responses. We treat the problem as a small-sample representation learning task. Instead of fine-tuning large pretrained models, we use frozen multimodal encoders, including CLIP for visual features, Whisper for acoustic features and transcripts, and RoBERTa, E5, and DeBERTaV3 for textual representations, followed by low-capacity downstream models. For Track~1, our trait-specific regression and late-fusion system achieves an average validation MSE of 0.2696, improving over the official baseline of 0.3334. Ablation results show a three-step improvement from a global model (0.3189), to per-trait modeling (0.2871), to per-trait late fusion (0.2696), corresponding to a 19.1% relative MSE reduction over the official baseline. For Track~2, a compact subject-attribute baseline reaches 0.5781 accuracy, while our multimodal ensemble reaches 0.5313, both above the official baseline of 0.4062. We interpret this result as evidence of possible subject-attribute shortcuts in the validation split rather than robust cognitive inference from AVI content. Overall, our findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用冻结多模态嵌入（CLIP, Whisper, RoBERTa等）处理异步视频面试中的心理特质预测问题，在ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026上参与两个任务：人格特质回归和认知能力分类。人格特质任务通过逐特质建模和晚融合将验证集MSE从基线0.3334降至0.2696；认知能力任务表现不佳，可能由于数据集中的捷径。
Motivation: 异步视频面试中标签数据有限，而每个回答包含高维视觉、声学和语言信号，传统微调大模型的方法不适合小样本场景。
Method: 使用冻结的多模态编码器（CLIP、Whisper、RoBERTa、E5、DeBERTaV3）提取特征，后接低容量下游模型。人格特质任务采用逐特质回归和晚融合；认知能力任务则使用多模态集成。
Result: 人格特质回归任务验证集MSE从基线0.3334降至0.2696，相对降低19.1%；认知能力分类任务准确率0.5313，高于基线0.4062但作者认为可能存在捷径。
Conclusion: 基于异步视频面试的心理评估得益于逐特质多模态建模，但认知能力预测需要谨慎控制数据集中的捷径。

papers.title: GraspLLM: Towards Zero-Shot Generalization on Text-Attributed Graphs with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraspLLM 框架，将图结构理解与 LLM 的语义能力结合，以增强文本属性图 (TAG) 的跨数据集和跨任务零样本泛化能力。通过统一语义空间中的冻结嵌入模型和 motif 感知对比学习提取数据集无关的结构信息，并利用最优上下文子图对齐到 LLM 的 token 空间。实验表明其在多个 TAG 基准上优于先前基于 LLM 的方法，尤其在零样本场景中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有集成 LLM 到 TAG 的方法在跨不同图和任务的泛化能力上仍有限，难以捕获可迁移的图结构模式。
Method: 使用冻结的通用嵌入模型将不同图的节点文本映射到统一语义空间；在此基础上，通过多个 motif 诱导的邻接矩阵进行对比学习以提取数据集无关的结构信息；然后提取每个目标节点的最优上下文子图，并通过对齐投影器将其映射到 LLM 的 token 空间。
Result: 在覆盖多个领域的 TAG 基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GraspLLM 在零样本场景中持续优于先前基于 LLM 的方法，展现强大的跨数据集和跨任务泛化能力。
Conclusion: GraspLLM 框架有效结合图结构与语义理解，显著提升了 TAG 的零样本泛化性能。

papers.title: Wild3R: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Sparse Photo Collection
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) removes the need for time-consuming per-scene optimization required by traditional 3DGS. However, existing feed-forward approaches struggle with real-world photo collections that include diverse lighting conditions and transient objects. In this paper, we present Wild3R, a feed-forward approach for unconstrained sparse photo collections. The main bottleneck is the lack of training data that provides multiple viewpoints, a variety of illuminations, and transient variations necessary for learning robust scene representations. To address this, we introduce the WildCity dataset, which comprises 200 scenes, 170 lighting conditions, and transient objects, resulting in 337,500 images in total. By leveraging the dataset, our model learns appearance consistency across viewpoints conditioned on reference views, while removing transient content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing feed-forward approaches and achieves results competitive with prior per-scene optimization-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wild3R，一种前馈式 3D 高斯溅射 (3DGS) 方法，用于无约束的稀疏照片集。现有前馈方法难以处理真实世界照片中的多样光照和瞬态物体，主要瓶颈是缺乏多视角、多样光照和瞬态变化的训练数据。为此，作者构建了 WildCity 数据集（200 场景、170 种光照条件、瞬态物体，共 337,500 张图像），模型学习基于参考视图的外观一致性并移除瞬态内容。实验表明，该方法优于现有前馈方法，与基于逐场景优化的方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法在处理真实世界照片集合（包含多样光照和瞬态物体）时表现不佳，且缺乏可用于学习的多视角且包含光照和瞬态变化的大规模训练数据。
Method: 提出 Wild3R 模型，利用新构建的 WildCity 数据集（包含 200 场景、170 种光照条件和瞬态物体）进行训练，学习跨视角的外观一致性，并以参考视图为条件去除瞬态内容。
Result: 在无约束稀疏照片集上，Wild3R 优于现有前馈方法，且与基于逐场景优化的方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 大规模包含光照和瞬态变化的数据集对于提升前馈 3DGS 在无约束场景下的鲁棒性至关重要。

papers.title: AI4Land: Scalable Deep Learning for Global High-Resolution Land Use Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty in the terrestrial carbon cycle remains a major constraint in climate projections, partly driven by the uncertainties affecting the land surface representation and variability in Earth system models. To address this limitation, we present a data-driven framework AI4Land, for generating high-resolution historical reconstructions and future projections of key land surface variables. The framework follows a two-phase approach using a U-Net architecture. In the first phase, which is the focus of this work, it reconstructs annual land use and land cover by integrating coarse-resolution scenario data with static geophysical features. In a planned second phase, the resulting high-resolution maps will be used to predict dynamic biophysical variables, particularly leaf area index, at finer temporal scales. Trained on Earth observation data, the models learn to reproduce spatially explicit and physically consistent land surface patterns, extending temporal coverage to periods lacking direct observations. AI4Land was developed and trained on MareNostrum5, demonstrating how GPU-accelerated HPC infrastructure enables global-scale climate AI pipelines. The final product is a suite of open-source emulators designed for real-time coupling with digital twin platforms, such as those developed under the Destination Earth initiative. By delivering realistic and evolving land surface conditions on demand, this work aims to reduce critical uncertainties and improve the predictive power of next-generation climate simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI4Land框架，利用U-Net架构的两阶段方法，从粗分辨率情景数据和静态地理特征重建高分辨率年度土地利用与土地覆盖历史重建及未来预测。第一阶段关注土地利用重建，第二阶段计划预测动态生物物理变量（如叶面积指数）。模型在地球观测数据上训练，在MareNostrum5超级计算机上开发，旨在为数字孪生平台提供实时地表条件，减少气候模拟中的陆地碳循环不确定性。
Motivation: 陆地碳循环的不确定性限制了气候预测，部分源于地球系统模型中地表表示和变率的误差。需要高分辨率的历史重建和未来投影来改进模型。
Method: 采用两阶段方法，第一阶段使用U-Net架构，集成粗分辨率情景数据与静态地理特征，重建年度土地利用/覆盖；第二阶段计划利用高分辨率地图预测动态生物物理变量（如叶面积指数）。训练基于地球观测数据，并在GPU加速的HPC基础设施上执行。
Result: 模型能够生成空间显式、物理一致的地表模式，并扩展至缺乏直接观测的时间段。最终产出为开源模拟器，支持与数字孪生平台（如Destination Earth）实时耦合。
Conclusion: 该工作旨在通过提供按需的、演化的地表条件，减少关键不确定性，提高下一代气候模拟的预测能力。

papers.title: MultiToP: Learning to Patch Visual Tokens to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出MultiToP，一种多模态上下文感知的视觉令牌补丁框架，通过在语言生成前替换不可靠的视觉令牌来减轻视频大语言模型中的幻觉。该框架引入轻量级Visual Token Patcher预测令牌替换分布，并使用信息引导的排名校准进行训练。实验表明，MultiToP在Vript-HAL上将Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的F1分数提升50.60%，在ActivityNet-QA上将Video-LLaVA-7B的相对准确率提升18.58%，且推理开销极小。
Motivation: 视频大语言模型在视频理解中易产生幻觉，即生成内容与输入视频不一致，亟需一种无需修改原始模型即可在语言生成前修正不可靠视觉令牌的方法。
Method: 提出MultiToP框架，包含：1) Visual Token Patcher，预测令牌级替换分布并用动态全局补丁令牌选择性替换不可靠令牌；2) 信息引导排名校准，利用答案条件化的帧级信息线索指导替换；3) 结合真实答案监督和稀疏正则化进行训练。
Result: 在Vript-HAL数据集上，Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的F1分数提升50.60%；在ActivityNet-QA数据集上，Video-LLaVA-7B相对准确率提升18.58%。推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: MultiToP能有效减少幻觉，同时保持通用视频理解能力，且不修改原始模型，是一种轻量级的视觉证据修正方法。

papers.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对灵巧手仅依赖触觉进行盲抓取（blind grasping）中的 sim-to-real 差距和稀疏触觉信号表达力不足问题，提出一个包含三个关键组件的框架：Real2Sim 触觉标定管道、布局感知触觉编码器（layout-aware tactile encoder）以及触觉条件扩散策略（tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy）。在真实 LEAP Hand 上对 10 个见过和 10 个未见物体进行测试，达到 27% 的抓取成功率，无需视觉输入或真实抓取演示。仿真消融实验表明，布局感知预训练和 Real2Sim 标定分别提升了抓取性能和触觉接触事件的一致性。
Motivation: 真实灵巧手仅依赖触觉信号进行盲抓取极具挑战性，原因是触觉模拟与现实之间的差距（sim-to-real gap）以及稀疏触觉信号表达力不足，限制了策略在真实机器人上的部署。
Method: 提出一种三部分框架：1) Real2Sim 触觉标定管道，构建接触标定的数字孪生模拟器以复现真实触觉信号；2) 布局感知触觉编码器，通过自监督预训练利用传感器几何先验增强稀疏触觉观测的表达力；3) 在标定模拟器中训练物体专用的强化学习专家，并将成功抓取轨迹聚合成触觉条件扩散策略。
Result: 在配备分布式触觉传感的 LEAP Hand 上，针对 10 个已见和 10 个未见物体，部署的策略实现了 27% 的真实抓取成功率。仿真消融实验显示，布局感知触觉预训练提升了抓取性能；传感级评估表明，Real2Sim 标定增强了模拟与硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。
Conclusion: 接触事件标定、几何感知触觉表示学习以及基于扩散的策略聚合为在真实灵巧手上实现纯触觉盲抓取提供了一条有效路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对灵巧手仅依赖触觉进行盲抓取（blind grasping）中的 sim-to-real 差距和稀疏触觉信号表达力不足问题，提出一个包含三个关键组件的框架：Real2Sim 触觉标定管道、布局感知触觉编码器（layout-aware tactile encoder）以及触觉条件扩散策略（tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy）。在真实 LEAP Hand 上对 10 个见过和 10 个未见物体进行测试，达到 27% 的抓取成功率，无需视觉输入或真实抓取演示。仿真消融实验表明，布局感知预训练和 Real2Sim 标定分别提升了抓取性能和触觉接触事件的一致性。
summary_sections.motivation: 真实灵巧手仅依赖触觉信号进行盲抓取极具挑战性，原因是触觉模拟与现实之间的差距（sim-to-real gap）以及稀疏触觉信号表达力不足，限制了策略在真实机器人上的部署。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种三部分框架：1) Real2Sim 触觉标定管道，构建接触标定的数字孪生模拟器以复现真实触觉信号；2) 布局感知触觉编码器，通过自监督预训练利用传感器几何先验增强稀疏触觉观测的表达力；3) 在标定模拟器中训练物体专用的强化学习专家，并将成功抓取轨迹聚合成触觉条件扩散策略。
summary_sections.result: 在配备分布式触觉传感的 LEAP Hand 上，针对 10 个已见和 10 个未见物体，部署的策略实现了 27% 的真实抓取成功率。仿真消融实验显示，布局感知触觉预训练提升了抓取性能；传感级评估表明，Real2Sim 标定增强了模拟与硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 接触事件标定、几何感知触觉表示学习以及基于扩散的策略聚合为在真实灵巧手上实现纯触觉盲抓取提供了一条有效路径。

papers.title: Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process Modelling for Expensive Quantum Systems with Heteroskedastic Noise
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modeling of quantum many-body systems often requires computationally expensive simulations such as Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) or Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) calculations. These methods, while precise, impose significant time and resource constraints, limiting their use in exhaustive parameter exploration. Moreover, these expensive simulations can contain variable errors over the large unknown parameter space, which needs to be quantified and propagated. Thus, predictive modelling is required to estimate the functional space accurately over scarcely sampled data with heteroskedastic noise, while preserving the physical relevance of the estimation. Therefore, we present a Physically Constrained Ensemble Gaussian Process (pc-EGP) framework designed to efficiently model complex and noisy quantum systems under physical consistency constraints. The proposed method first enforces physical constraints as a user controlled weighted penalty to the data-driven loss function of the Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates. Then an ensemble of such GP models is trained with variable noisy simulations via numerical quadrature method where these multiple GP(s) at different nodes is integrated as a quadrature weighted average. We first demonstrate the framework on synthetically generated data before applying to quantum systems. In the first case study, we leverage DMRG simulations of the Bose-Hubbard Model to predict the critical interaction parameter Uc governing the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition. In the second case study, we demonstrate our method on QMC simulations, of a quantum liquid confined inside a nanoporous silicate with the goal of optimizing a chemical environment to realize a one-dimensional superfluid. Compared to conventional GP, pc-EGP achieves a better balance of accuracy and physically meaningful predictions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理约束集成高斯过程（pc-EGP）框架，用于高效建模具有异方差噪声的昂贵量子系统。该框架首先将物理约束作为加权惩罚项加入高斯过程代理模型的损失函数，然后通过数值求积法集成多个高斯过程模型。在Bose-Hubbard模型的DMRG模拟和纳米多孔硅酸盐中量子液体的QMC模拟两个案例中，pc-EGP相比传统GP在准确性和物理合理性之间取得了更好平衡。
Motivation: 量子多体系统的精确模拟（如DMRG、QMC）计算成本高，且在大参数空间中存在可变误差，需要一种能够处理稀疏采样数据和异方差噪声、同时保持物理一致性的预测建模方法。
Method: 提出pc-EGP框架：首先在GP损失函数中加入用户控制的加权物理约束惩罚项，然后通过数值求积法对多个不同节点上的GP模型进行加权平均集成。
Result: 在Bose-Hubbard模型的超流-莫特绝缘体转变临界参数Uc预测和纳米多孔硅酸盐中一维超流体优化两个案例中，pc-EGP相比传统GP在准确性与物理合理性之间取得了更好的平衡。
Conclusion: pc-EGP能够有效对复杂、有噪声的量子系统进行物理一致的高效建模，适用于计算昂贵的仿真场景。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Ship Finance: Applications, Opportunities, and a Case Study in AI-Augmented Loan Origination
papers.abstract_en: Ship finance is a data-intensive and document-heavy segment of asset-based lending, requiring the integration of financial, technical, contractual, and regulatory information from heterogeneous and largely unstructured sources. Increasing environmental regulation and ESG reporting requirements are adding further complexity to underwriting and loan-origination processes. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), create new opportunities for processing and analysing such information. This paper reviews potential applications of AI in ship finance, with a particular focus on LLM-based systems for document comprehension, information extraction, and workflow automation. We present ShipFinance.ai, a modular agentic architecture to support loan application workflows in ship finance. The proposed system combines an LLM-based extraction module, financial analysis components, external maritime data services, and a controlled document-generation module with a chatbot interface to support the preparation of standardized financing applications. The paper discusses the key challenges for using such models in production. We argue that AI-assisted systems can support maritime finance professionals in managing increasingly complex information and reporting requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了人工智能在船舶金融中的应用，特别是基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统，并提出了ShipFinance.ai模块化智能体架构，用于处理异构非结构化数据、自动化贷款申请工作流。文档强调AI可帮助应对日益复杂的监管和ESG报告要求，但未提供定量实验结果。
Motivation: 船舶金融涉及财务、技术、合同和监管等多源异构非结构化数据，环境监管和ESG报告增加了承销和贷款发起的复杂性，亟需AI辅助处理。
Method: 提出ShipFinance.ai架构，包含LLM提取模块、财务分析组件、外部海事数据服务和受控文档生成模块，通过聊天界面支持标准化融资申请准备。
Conclusion: AI辅助系统有望帮助海事金融专业人员管理复杂信息与报告要求，但需解决生产部署中的关键挑战。

papers.title: Point-Identification of a Robust Predictor Under Latent Shift with Imperfect Proxies
papers.abstract_en: Addressing the domain adaptation problem becomes more challenging when distribution shifts across domains stem from latent confounders that affect both covariates and outcomes. Existing proxy-based approaches that address latent shift rely on a strong completeness assumption to uniquely determine (point-identify) a robust predictor. Completeness requires that proxies have sufficient information about variations in latent confounders. For imperfect proxies the mapping from confounders to the space of proxy distributions is non-injective, and multiple latent confounder values can generate the same proxy distribution. This breaks the completeness assumption and observed data are consistent with multiple potential predictors (set-identified). To address this, we introduce latent equivalent classes (LECs). LECs are defined as groups of latent confounders that induce the same conditional proxy distribution. We show that point-identification for the robust predictor remains achievable as long as multiple domains differ sufficiently in how they mix proxy-induced LECs to form the robust predictor. This domain diversity condition is formalized as a cross-domain rank condition on the mixture weights, which is substantially weaker assumption than completeness. We introduce the Proximal Quasi-Bayesian Active learning (PQAL) framework, which actively queries a small, targeted set of diverse domains that satisfy this rank condition. PQAL can recover the point-identified predictor, demonstrates robustness to varying degrees of shift and outperforms previous methods on synthetic data and semi-synthetic dSprites, IHDP, ACS Folktables datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜在混淆变量导致的领域适应问题，提出潜在等价类（LECs）概念，并证明在跨域混合权重满足秩条件时，无需强完整性假设即可点识别鲁棒预测器。提出近端准贝叶斯主动学习（PQAL）框架，主动查询满足条件的多样化领域，在合成数据和半合成数据集上表现优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有代理方法依赖强完整性假设，但实际中代理往往不完美，导致多个预测器与数据一致（集识别）。需要更弱的假设实现鲁棒预测器的点识别。
Method: 引入潜在等价类（LECs）作为诱导相同条件代理分布的潜在混淆变量组。提出跨域秩条件作为领域多样性条件，比完整性假设弱。在此基础上提出近端准贝叶斯主动学习（PQAL）框架，主动查询少量满足秩条件的多样化领域以恢复点识别预测器。
Result: 在合成数据和半合成数据集（dSprites, IHDP, ACS Folktables）上，PQAL展现了鲁棒性并优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 证明在不完美代理下，通过领域多样性条件可实现鲁棒预测器的点识别，为领域适应提供新方法。

papers.title: DecompSR: A dataset for decomposed analyses of compositional multihop spatial reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DecompSR, decomposed spatial reasoning, a large benchmark dataset (over 5m datapoints) and generation framework designed to analyse compositional spatial reasoning ability. The generation of DecompSR allows users to independently vary several aspects of compositionality, namely: productivity (reasoning depth), substitutivity (entity and linguistic variability), overgeneralisation (input order, distractors) and systematicity (novel linguistic elements). DecompSR is built procedurally in a manner which makes it is correct by construction, which is independently verified using a symbolic solver to guarantee the correctness of the dataset. DecompSR is comprehensively benchmarked across a host of Large Language Models (LLMs) where we show that LLMs struggle with productive and systematic generalisation in spatial reasoning tasks whereas they are more robust to linguistic variation. DecompSR provides a provably correct and rigorous benchmarking dataset with a novel ability to independently vary the degrees of several key aspects of compositionality, allowing for robust and fine-grained probing of the compositional reasoning abilities of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 介绍了DecompSR，一个大型组合空间推理基准数据集（超过500万数据点）和生成框架，允许独立变化组合性的多个方面（生产力、替代性、过度泛化、系统性）。通过符号求解器保证正确性，在多个LLM上评测显示LLM在空间推理中难以进行生产性和系统性泛化，但对语言变化更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有数据集难以独立控制组合性的不同方面，无法精细探测LLM的组合推理能力。
Method: 通过程序化生成DecompSR数据集，结合符号求解器验证正确性，并设计生成框架以独立改变组合性的多个维度。
Result: 在多个LLM上的基准测试显示，LLM在空间推理任务中在生产性和系统性泛化方面表现困难，但对语言变化更为鲁棒。
Conclusion: DecompSR提供了可证明正确且严格的基准数据集，能够独立改变组合性关键方面的程度，从而实现对LLM组合推理能力的鲁棒和细粒度探测。

papers.title: Periodic-MAE: Periodic Video Masked Autoencoder for rPPG Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Periodic-MAE, a self-supervised framework for learning generalizable spatio-temporal representations of periodic physiological signals from unlabeled facial videos. The proposed method leverages a masked autoencoder (MAE), which learns high-dimensional facial representations by reconstructing masked video tokens without relying on remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) specific supervision. To explicitly align representation learning with the characteristics of rPPG, we introduce a periodicity-aware frame masking strategy based on video resampling, enabling the encoder to learn representations that capture quasi-periodic temporal patterns relevant to pulse signal estimation. In addition, physiological bandlimit constraints are integrated into the MAE pre-training framework, exploiting the sparsity of pulse signals in the frequency domain to guide the learned representations toward physiologically meaningful patterns. After pre-training, the learned representations are transferred to downstream rPPG estimation, where the encoder serves as a generic feature extractor for recovering pulse-related signals from facial videos. We conduct extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets, including PURE, UBFC-rPPG, MMPD, and V4V. Moreover, we evaluate the proposed approach on a real-world rPPG dataset collected under unconstrained lighting conditions and subject motion. Experimental results demonstrate that Periodic-MAE consistently improves rPPG estimation performance, particularly in challenging cross-dataset and real-world evaluation settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/ziiho08/Periodic-MAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Periodic-MAE，一种自监督框架，从无标签面部视频中学习周期性生理信号（rPPG）的通用时空表征。通过周期感知的帧掩码策略和生理带限约束，改进掩码自编码器预训练，在下游rPPG估计任务上取得跨数据集和真实场景下的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有rPPG方法依赖标签数据且泛化性差，缺乏利用生理信号周期性的自监督学习框架。
Method: 提出Periodic-MAE，使用视频重采样实现周期感知的帧掩码，并引入频域生理带限约束到MAE预训练中，迫使编码器学习与脉搏信号相关的准周期模式。
Result: 在PURE、UBFC-rPPG、MMPD和V4V四个公开数据集以及一个真实场景数据集上，Periodic-MAE一致提升rPPG估计性能，尤其在跨数据集和真实评估场景中。
Conclusion: 自监督周期感知预训练能有效学习生理信号表征，提升rPPG估计的泛化能力。

papers.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relevant in later layers, especially for grounding-sensitive queries. We propose Reroute, a training-free plug-in that replaces removal with recoverable routing. At each routing stage, selected vision tokens pass through decoder blocks, while deferred tokens bypass the stage and re-enter the candidate pool at the next routing decision. Reroute reuses existing attention-score ranking rules and stage-wise schedules, preserving the theoretical TFLOPs and KV-cache budget class of the pruning method it augments. Across FastV, PDrop, and Nüwa variants on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen backbones, reroute improves grounding under aggressive token reduction while maintaining general VQA performance. These results suggest that VLM token reduction should not be viewed only as irreversible pruning, but also as recoverable routing. The code can be found here: https://github.com/elmma/mllm-reroute/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Reroute，一种无需训练的可恢复视觉token路由方法，替代传统永久丢弃token的范式。方法在路由阶段将选中token通过解码器，延迟token跳过当前阶段并在下一路由决策时重新进入候选池，复用现有注意力评分规则。在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen骨干上增强FastV、PDrop、Nüwa变体，在激进token缩减下提升grounding能力，同时保持VQA性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉token减少方法在解码器不同层中重要性发生变化，永久丢弃会丢失后续层可能需要的token，尤其对细粒度查询不利。
Method: 提出可恢复路由机制：每个路由阶段，选中token通过解码器块，延迟token跳过当前阶段并在下一路由决策时重新进入候选池，复用现有注意力评分规则和阶段调度。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen骨干上增强FastV、PDrop、Nüwa变体，在激进token缩减下提升grounding性能，同时保持一般VQA性能。
Conclusion: 视觉token减少应视为可恢复路由而非不可逆剪枝，Reroute在不增加理论计算量和KV缓存预算下实现改进。

papers.title: Context-Driven Incremental Compression for Multi-Turn Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern conversational agents condition on an ever-growing dialogue history at each turn, incurring redundant attention and encoding costs that grow with conversation length. Naive truncation or summarization degrades fidelity, while existing context compressors lack cross-turn memory sharing or revision, causing information loss and compounding errors in long dialogues. We revisit the context compression under conversational dynamics and empirically present its fragility. To improve both efficiency and robustness, we introduce Context-Driven Incremental Compression (C-DIC), which treats a conversation as interleaved contextual threads and stores revisable per-thread compression states in a single, compact dialogue memory. At each turn, a lightweight retrieve, revise, and write-back loop shares information across turns and updates stale memories, stabilizing long-horizon behavior. In addition, we adapt truncated backpropagation-through-time (TBPTT) to our multi-turn setting, learning cross-turn dependencies without full-history backpropagation. Extensive experiments on long-form dialogue benchmarks demonstrate superior performance and efficiency of C-DIC; notably, C-DIC shows stable inference latency and perplexity over hundreds of dialogue turns, supporting a scalable path to high-quality dialogue modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出上下文驱动的增量压缩（C-DIC）方法，用于多轮对话生成，通过可修订的每线程压缩状态和轻量级检索-修订-写回循环，实现跨轮次信息共享，稳定长对话行为，并在长对话基准上展示优越性能和效率。
Motivation: 现有对话系统随着轮次增加，对话历史不断增长导致冗余注意力和编码成本；简单截断或摘要会损失保真度；现有上下文压缩方法缺乏跨轮次记忆共享或修订，导致信息丢失和错误累积。需要提升效率和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出上下文驱动的增量压缩（C-DIC），将对话视为交织的上下文线程，在单个紧凑对话记忆中存储可修订的每线程压缩状态。每轮使用轻量级检索-修订-写回循环分享跨轮次信息并更新陈旧记忆。此外，将截断回溯时间（TBPTT）适配到多轮设置，学习跨轮次依赖而不需要全历史反向传播。
Result: 在长对话基准上，C-DIC展现出优越性能和效率；在数百轮对话中保持稳定的推理延迟和困惑度，支持高质量对话建模的可扩展路径。
Conclusion: C-DIC通过增量压缩和可修订记忆实现了长对话的高效稳健建模，是一种可扩展的方案。

papers.title: How Seemingly Inconsequential Design Choices Dictate Performance of LLMs in Pathology
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are routinely used as baselines when evaluating specialized pathology models on whole-slide images (WSIs). Because WSIs exceed contemporary model context limits, LLM baselines routinely use small, high-magnification patches processed independently via majority voting, without systematic evaluation of seemingly inconsequential design choices such as patch size, patch count, and magnification. Generalist LLMs have consistently underperformed specialized systems, reinforcing the perception that domain-specific training or architectural adaptation is necessary for pathology tasks involving WSIs. Here, we conduct a systematic factorial analysis of four input design factors: inference mode, patch size, magnification, and patch count. We demonstrate that prior studies have overstated the gap between specialized models and general-purpose LLMs by choosing non-optimized input configurations. On the MultiPathQA benchmark, switching to a single balanced configuration (large patches at lower magnification, processed jointly) raises GPT-5 from 15.1% to 39.5% on cancer-type classification (TCGA) and from 38.1% to 62.9% on organ classification (GTEx). Per-task optimization yields further gains up to 43.9% (TCGA) and 71.6% (GTEx). The same configuration generalizes to two other models and to a fully held-out CPTAC cohort, where it improves Gemini 3 Flash by 23.4 percentage points without any task-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对四个输入设计因素（推理模式、图块大小、放大倍数和图块数量）进行系统析因分析，表明在病理学全切片图像任务中，通用大型语言模型通过优化输入配置可以大幅缩小与专用模型之间的性能差距。在MultiPathQA基准上，单一平衡配置将GPT-5的癌症类型分类准确率从15.1%提升至39.5%，器官分类从38.1%提升至62.9%。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型常被用作病理学全切片图像任务的基线，但以往研究未系统评估图块大小、数量等设计选择的影响，导致通用模型表现不佳，强化了需要领域特定训练的认知。
Method: 对四个输入因素（推理模式、图块大小、放大倍数、图块数量）进行析因分析，通过优化配置（大图块、低放大倍数、联合处理）提升通用LLM性能。
Result: 在MultiPathQA基准上，优化配置使GPT-5在TCGA癌症分类上从15.1%提升至39.5%，在GTEx器官分类上从38.1%提升至62.9%；任务特异优化进一步提升至43.9%和71.6%。配置泛化到其他模型和CPTAC队列，使Gemini 3 Flash提升23.4个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过简单调整输入设计，通用LLM可以在病理学WSI任务上接近或达到专用模型性能，挑战了领域特定训练必要性的观点。

papers.title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT)，一种无需专用力传感器的数据驱动方法，可在1分钟内从10分钟自由运动数据中训练，估计外部关节扭矩，精度堪比专用传感器。结合 Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST)，在五个长时程任务中，策略学习任务进度超过先前力感知策略17%以上。
Motivation: 多数机器人手臂因成本问题缺乏专用力传感器，而接触丰富的操作任务需要力敏感性，现有方法依赖额外硬件或复杂标定。
Method: 提出 NEXT 方法，利用自由运动数据训练神经网络估计外部扭矩；结合 FIRST 方法，在行为克隆中对预接触和接触段进行上采样，增强力信息。
Result: NEXT 训练仅需1分钟与10分钟数据，估计精度媲美专用扭矩传感器；FIRST 在五个长时程任务中任务进度优于先前力感知策略17%以上。
Conclusion: NEXT 与 FIRST 使得低成本机器人无需额外传感硬件即可实现力感知遥操作与策略学习，推动力感知操作普及。

papers.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for embodied agents, with an emerging strategy of scaling test-time compute to improve capability. However, we observe that doing so increases latency, token usage, and FLOPs while yielding uneven, often diminishing gains in downstream success, limiting where embodied agents can be deployed. We argue that choosing when and where to spend test-time compute is central to bringing frontier performance to the real world. We introduce DIRECT, a routing framework that uses multimodal scene context to allocate compute per prompt, improving the success--cost Pareto frontier over fixed model selection. Across three dominant scaling axes, namely chain-of-thought depth, model size, and memory history, our experiments on VLABench and RoboMME show that test-time compute is not a uniform lever: different axes yield qualitatively distinct capability gains. We validate these insights on a physical Franka arm in a DROID setup spanning zero-shot manipulation and long-horizon chaining, where our router matches or exceeds a stronger model's success rate at up to 65% lower average latency. Ultimately, our results show that naively scaling test-time compute is wasteful, and that DIRECT can provide frontier-level embodied planning in robotic systems at a fraction of the cost. Project page can be found at jadee-dao.github.io/direct/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DIRECT框架，通过多模态场景上下文为具身规划器中的视觉-语言模型（VLM）动态分配测试时计算资源，以优化成功-成本帕累托前沿。实验表明，不同缩放维度（链式思维深度、模型大小、记忆历史）对能力提升的贡献存在质性差异，直接扩展测试时计算会导致资源浪费。DIRECT在物理Franka机械臂上以高达65%的延迟降低匹配或超过更强模型。
Motivation: 现有方法无差别扩展测试时计算，导致延迟、token消耗和FLOPs增加，而下游任务成功率提升有限且不均，限制了具身代理的实际部署。
Method: 提出路由框架DIRECT，利用多模态场景上下文为每个提示选择最优的计算分配策略，覆盖链式思维深度、模型大小和记忆历史三个缩放轴。
Result: 在VLABench和RoboMME上，DIRECT在不同缩放轴下实现成功-成本帕累托改进；物理实验中以65%平均延迟降低匹配或超越强基线的成功率。
Conclusion: 测试时计算并非均匀杠杆，盲目扩展效率低下；DIRECT能以低成本提供前沿级别的具身规划能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Redesign Mixture-of-Experts Routers with Manifold Power Iteration
papers.abstract_en: Router is the cornerstone component to the Mixture-of-Experts models. Serving as expert proxies, the rows of the router matrix compute their similarity to the MoE inputs to determine which subset of experts is activated. Ideally, each router row is designed to encode the expert matrix into this representative vector, such that its dot-product with token can better reflect token-expert affinity. However, there exists no design principles to enforce this condensation. In this paper, we propose to align each router row with the principal singular direction of the associated expert, as this direction provides the most expressive mathematical description of a matrix. Based on this principle, we propose a router redesign with Manifold Power Iteration (MPI). Specifically, it introduces a "Power-then-Retract" paradigm, where a power iteration step is performed on the router weights, followed by a retraction to impose a norm constraint to ensure both efficiency and stability. Theoretically, we show that MPI drives router rows to converge toward the principal singular directions of associated experts. Empirically, we pretrain MoE model across scales from 1B to 11B parameters to confirm that this alignment facilitates more effective MoE models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流形幂迭代（Manifold Power Iteration, MPI）的混合专家模型路由器重设计方法，将路由器行向量与对应专家矩阵的主奇异方向对齐，从而更准确反映标记与专家之间的亲和力。方法采用“幂迭代后收缩”范式，在路由器权重上执行幂迭代后再施加范数约束以保证效率与稳定性。理论证明了MPI使路由器行收敛到专家矩阵的主奇异方向，实验在1B至11B参数的MoE模型上验证了该对齐的有效性。
Motivation: 现有混合专家模型的路由器行向量缺乏明确的设计原则来编码专家矩阵的主信息，导致标记-专家亲和度计算不够准确，影响模型性能。
Method: 提出MPI方法，包括两个步骤：对路由器权重执行幂迭代（Power Iteration），使其逼近专家矩阵的主奇异方向；然后通过收缩操作施加范数约束，确保更新后的路由器行向量在流形上保持稳定。
Result: 在1B到11B参数规模的MoE预训练模型上，MPI方法使路由器行与专家矩阵主奇异方向对齐，提升了模型的有效性。
Conclusion: 将路由器行与专家矩阵主奇异方向对齐是一种有效的设计原则，MPI为实现该对齐提供了理论保证和实用算法，有助于构建更高效的MoE模型。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出MPI方法，包括两个步骤：对路由器权重执行幂迭代（Power Iteration），使其逼近专家矩阵的主奇异方向；然后通过收缩操作施加范数约束，确保更新后的路由器行向量在流形上保持稳定。
summary_sections.result: 在1B到11B参数规模的MoE预训练模型上，MPI方法使路由器行与专家矩阵主奇异方向对齐，提升了模型的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 将路由器行与专家矩阵主奇异方向对齐是一种有效的设计原则，MPI为实现该对齐提供了理论保证和实用算法，有助于构建更高效的MoE模型。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can describe scenes and reason about them in language, yet still struggle to ground their actions in the dense 3D world around them. Existing approaches either inject features from a frozen 3D foundation model without an objective that ensures the policy uses them, or constrain geometry with sparse box and map losses that provide no dense spatial signal. We introduce VLGA, the first vision-language-action model supervised to reconstruct the dense 3D world it drives through. VLGA introduces geometry as a fourth modality alongside vision, language, and action through a dedicated expert supervised by a per-pixel pointmap regression loss against LiDAR. Extensive experiments conducted on challenging nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets for open-loop and closed-loop evaluations, respectively, show the superiority of VLGA over counterpart VLA methods. In particular, on open-loop nuScenes, VLGA sets a new state of the art among VLA methods without ego status, with the lowest L2 (0.50\,m average) and 3-second collision rate (0.18\%). On closed-loop Bench2Drive, VLGA attains the state-of-the-art driving score of 79.08, +0.71 over the strongest prior VLA, at comparable efficiency and comfort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLGA，首个将几何作为第四模态的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过逐像素点图回归损失监督其重建密集3D世界。在 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 数据集上，VLGA 在开环和闭环评估中均达到最先进水平，优于现有 VLA 方法。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型难以将动作锚定在密集3D世界中，要么注入3D特征但无确保策略使用的目标，要么仅用稀疏框和地图损失约束几何，缺乏密集空间信号。
Method: VLGA 引入几何作为第四模态，通过专用专家和逐像素点图回归损失（与 LiDAR 对齐）监督模型重建密集3D世界。
Result: 在开环 nuScenes 上，VLGA 达到 VLA 方法新 SOTA，L2 误差平均 0.50m，3秒碰撞率 0.18%；在闭环 Bench2Drive 上，驾驶得分 79.08，比最强先前的 VLA 高 0.71，效率与舒适度相当。
Conclusion: VLGA 证明了密集几何监督对于提升 VLA 模型在自动驾驶中行动定位的有效性。

papers.title: System Report for CCL25-Eval Task 5: New Dataset and LoRA-Fine-Tuned Qwen2.5
papers.abstract_en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising progress in the fields of classical Chinese translation and the generation of classical poetry. However, domain-specific research on precise translation and affective-semantic understanding of classical poetry remains limited. The main challenge is that most studies treat the poetic appreciation task as a general-domain problem, neglecting the distinctive features of poetic appreciation, while high-quality and domain-specific datasets are extremely limited. To address this limitation, we decompose the task into three subtasks: term interpretation, semantic interpretation, and emotional inference. Based on multiple open-source datasets, we perform data cleansing and alignment to construct the Classical Chinese Poetry Instruction Pair Dataset (CCPoetry-49K), which comprises 49,404 high-quality instruction-response pairs explicitly optimized for this domain. We then propose a domain-specialized LLM, called PoetryQwen, by applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the Qwen2.5-14B model. Experimental results on the CCL25-Eval Task 5 benchmark demonstrate that PoetryQwen achieves a score of 0.757, representing a 9.7% improvement over the Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct baseline (0.690). These findings clearly indicate that PoetryQwen significantly enhances performance in precise translation and emotional understanding of classical poetry. We present new dataset and methodological considerations intended to support the domain-specific optimization of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对古典诗歌翻译与情感理解任务，构建了CCPoetry-49K高质量指令数据集，并使用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-14B得到PoetryQwen模型，在CCL25-Eval Task 5基准上取得0.757分，相比基线提升9.7%。
Motivation: 现有研究将诗歌鉴赏视为通用领域任务，忽视了其独特特征，且高质量领域数据集匮乏。
Method: 将任务分解为术语解释、语义解释和情感推断三个子任务，基于多个开源数据集构建CCPoetry-49K数据集，并利用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-14B模型。
Result: PoetryQwen在CCL25-Eval Task 5基准上获得0.757分，比Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct基线（0.690）提升9.7%。
Conclusion: PoetryQwen在古典诗歌的精确翻译和情感理解上表现显著提升，数据集和方法可作为领域优化LLM的参考。

papers.title: TAHOE: Text-to-SQL with Automated Hint Optimization from Experience
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have democratized database access through Text-to-SQL, but moving from prototypes to production remains difficult. Real deployments must handle strict SQL dialects, massive schemas, and evolving user preferences, while supervised fine-tuning is costly and rigid and agentic test-time scaling is expensive. We present Tahoe, a system that treats prompt optimization as a dynamic data management problem. Tahoe uses an error-driven hint learning pipeline across Development and Deployment to consolidate debugging traces into a structured Hint Bank. Compiler feedback is distilled into reusable Syntax Hints for dialect-specific rules, while execution and user feedback are converted into Semantic Hints for schema- and user-specific logic. Tahoe further introduces a Strategy Layer that models conflicting user intents as competing strategies under shared natural-language triggers, with recency signals and post-learning attribution statistics that summarize empirical success, harm, inertness, and support. At inference time, Tahoe retrieves relevant hints and guides the LLM through Logic Planning followed by SQL Synthesis. We implement and evaluate the development-phase workflow, leaving deployment-time human-feedback updates for future work. On Spider 2.0-Snow, Tahoe substantially improves Text-to-SQL without updating model parameters. On 113 supervised Spider 2.0-Snow-0212 examples using GPT-5.5, Tahoe raises pass rate from 61.95 percent to 79.42 percent and pass-at-4 from 72.57 percent to 87.61 percent, achieves 100 percent Snowflake syntax pass rate, and reduces average compiler-feedback critic rounds from 2.79 to 0.12 per sampled candidate. The same Hint Bank also transfers to weaker backbones, including a 19.7 percentage-point pass-rate gain on Doubao-2.0-lite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAHOE系统，将提示优化视为动态数据管理问题。通过错误驱动的提示学习流水线，将调试痕迹转化为结构化的Hint Bank（包含语法提示和语义提示），并引入策略层处理冲突用户意图。在Spider 2.0-Snow上，使用GPT-5.5将pass rate从61.95%提升至79.42%，且无需更新模型参数。同一Hint Bank可迁移至弱骨干网络，在Doubao-2.0-lite上带来19.7个百分点的pass rate提升。
Motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统从原型到生产部署面临SQL方言、大规模模式和用户偏好演变的挑战，监督微调成本高且僵化，而agentic test-time scaling计算昂贵。
Method: 提出TAHOE，采用开发与部署两阶段的错误驱动提示学习流水线，将编译器反馈蒸馏为语法提示，执行与用户反馈转换为语义提示，并构建策略层建模冲突用户意图，利用最近信号和后学习归因统计。推理时检索相关提示，先进行逻辑规划再生成SQL。
Result: 在Spider 2.0-Snow的113个示例上，使用GPT-5.5，pass rate从61.95%提升至79.42%，pass@4从72.57%提升至87.61%，Snowflake语法pass率达到100%，平均编译器反馈批评轮次从2.79降至0.12。同一Hint Bank迁移至Doubao-2.0-lite，pass rate提升19.7个百分点。
Conclusion: TAHOE通过错误驱动的提示优化，在不更新模型参数的情况下显著提升Text-to-SQL性能，并展示了Hint Bank的可迁移性。但仅实现了开发阶段流程，部署时的人类反馈更新留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ATLAS: Active Theory Learning for Automated Science
papers.abstract_en: Advancing scientific understanding through mechanistic modeling requires posing the right experimental questions to yield maximally informative data. To automate this pursuit within cognitive science, we introduce ATLAS (Active Theory Learning for Automated Science), an active learning framework for the data-driven discovery of interpretable behavioral models. ATLAS iterates between generating mechanistic hypotheses--instantiated as a diverse ensemble of sparse neural networks (Disentangled RNNs)--and designing experiments that optimally distinguish between them. We test this approach on the problem of recovering reinforcement learning agents from their behavior in bandit tasks. ATLAS designs varied sequences of qualitatively novel experiments with temporal structure tailored to underlying agent characteristics. The models trained on these experiments are evaluated against a comprehensive set of metrics for mechanistic modeling that capture behavioral, structural, and computational similarity. ATLAS achieves a 5-10x improvement in sample efficiency across all metrics compared to random experimentation, and its performance is further validated against expert-designed experiments derived from literature. These in silico results showcase ATLAS's potential to accelerate human-interpretable insights in cognitive science and other domains where scientific inquiry relies on discovering mechanistic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS框架，通过主动学习在认知科学中自动发现可解释的行为模型。ATLAS迭代生成机械假设（用Disentangled RNNs的稀疏集成表示）并设计最优区分这些假设的实验。在bandit任务中恢复强化学习智能体的测试表明，ATLAS相比随机实验在样本效率上提升5-10倍，且性能与专家设计实验相当。
Motivation: 科学发现需要提出最信息量的实验问题，但手动设计实验耗时且依赖领域知识。认知科学中，从行为数据中恢复机械模型（如强化学习）需要高效自动化的实验设计。
Method: ATLAS是一个主动学习框架，使用稀疏神经网络集成（Disentangled RNNs）生成机械假设，然后通过设计具有时间结构的实验来最大化区分这些假设。
Result: 在bandit任务中，ATLAS相比随机实验在所有机械建模指标（行为、结构、计算相似性）上实现5-10倍样本效率提升，并达到与专家设计实验相当的性能。
Conclusion: ATLAS展示了在认知科学及其他依赖机械模型发现的领域中加速可解释洞察的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the multi-turn tool-use capabilities of large language model agents. However, most existing methods assign credit over coarse heuristic units, such as tool-call boundaries or fixed workflows, making it difficult to identify which intermediate decisions influence downstream outcomes. In this work, we study agentic RL from two perspectives: \textit{where to branch and how to assign credit after branching}. Our pilot analysis shows that influential decision points are broadly distributed throughout the generated sequence rather than concentrated at tool calls, while token entropy alone does not reliably reflect their impact on final outcomes. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization (APPO)}, which shifts branching and credit assignment from coarse interaction units to fine-grained decision points in the sequence. APPO selects branching locations using a Branching Score that combines token uncertainty with policy-induced likelihood gains of subsequent continuations, enabling more targeted exploration while filtering out spurious high-entropy positions. It further introduces procedure-level advantage scaling to better distribute credit across branched rollouts. Experiments on 13 benchmarks show that APPO consistently improves strong agentic RL baselines by nearly 4 points, while keeping efficient tool-calls and maintaining behavior interpretability.
papers.comment: 25 pages, including 14 pages of main text and 11 pages of appendix; work in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APPO（Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization），一种改进大型语言模型代理多轮工具使用能力的新型强化学习方法。该方法通过细粒度的决策点分支和信用分配，替代了传统的粗粒度启发式单元，在13个基准上平均提升近4个百分点，同时保持高效工具调用和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有代理强化学习方法通常基于工具调用边界或固定工作流等粗粒度单元分配信用，难以识别影响下游结果的中间决策。
Method: APPO 提出分支分数（Branching Score）结合 token 不确定性和策略诱导的后续生成似然增益来选择分支位置，并引入过程级优势缩放（procedure-level advantage scaling）以更好地分布在分支轨迹上的信用。
Result: 在13个基准上，APPO 持续改进强代理强化学习基线，平均提升近4个百分点，同时保持高效工具调用和可解释性。
Conclusion: APPO 通过在序列中细粒度的决策点进行分支和信用分配，比粗粒度方法更能有效识别关键中间决策，从而提升多轮工具使用性能。

papers.title: SPEA2$^+$: Improved Density Estimation in SPEA2 with Provable Runtime Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: The Strength Pareto Evolutionary Algorithm 2 (SPEA2) is a popular and prominent evolutionary algorithm for solving multi-objective optimisation problems. Despite its popularity, theoretical analyses of SPEA2 have only appeared recently. Moreover, these analyses focus exclusively on how SPEA2 handles non-dominated solutions and disregard the algorithmic components responsible for handling dominated solutions. We conduct a first runtime analysis of SPEA2 for which these components are analysed. We prove that, unlike other prominent algorithms, including NSGA-II, NSGA-III and SMS-EMOA under the same setting of constant population size and duplicate elimination, SPEA2 is unable to cover the Pareto front of the OneTrapZeroTrap benchmark efficiently. Our results indicate that using k-th nearest-neighbour distance in the fitness assignment provides an insufficient signal to maintain diversity among dominated individuals. To address this issue, we propose an improved variant, SPEA2$^+$, that considers all pairwise distances. The new algorithm achieves the same performance guarantees as the other prominent algorithms on OneTrapZeroTrap, while matching the performance of the original SPEA2 on simpler problems. Experimental results complement our theoretical findings.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of PPSN 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多目标进化算法SPEA2进行了首次包含支配解处理组件的运行时分析，发现其使用k近邻距离的适应度分配不足以维持多样性，导致在OneTrapZeroTrap基准上无法有效覆盖Pareto前沿。为此提出改进版本SPEA2$^+$，改用所有成对距离，在理论上达到与NSGA-II等算法相同的性能保证，实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有SPEA2的理论分析仅关注非支配解，忽略了支配解处理组件的影响，亟需填补这一空白以理解算法在一般情况下的行为。
Method: 对原始SPEA2进行运行时分析，指出k近邻距离在适应度分配中提供的多样性信号不足；提出SPEA2$^+$，用所有成对距离替代k近邻距离来改进密度估计。

papers.title: Illumination-Robust Camera-Based Heart-Rate Estimation for Physiological Sensing in Robots
papers.abstract_en: Physiological awareness is important for service, social, and assistive robots that interact with humans in everyday environments. Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart-rate (HR) estimation from an RGB camera, making it a promising sensing modality for robot-mounted vision systems. However, illumination variation remains a major barrier to robust deployment. This paper presents an end-to-end spatial-temporal transformer framework for remote HR estimation on a new dataset with varied illumination. Our estimator integrates PRNet-based 3D face alignment, clip-level illumination augmentation, the Residual Temporal Standardization Module, and controlled hybrid temporal-frequency supervision. The training objective combines a Soft-Shifted Pearson waveform loss with a spectral Kullback-Leibler divergence loss, where a tuned weight ($\mathbfβ$) controls the contribution of frequency-domain heart-rate guidance. Experiments on a static all-level mix protocol covering three illumination levels show that $\mathbfβ=5$ provides the strongest result among the tested beta settings, achieving a best-run HR mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.79 bpm and an HR correlation of 0.982. Compared with the PhysFormer baseline evaluated on our dataset, our estimator reduces HR MAE by 93.6 %, while increasing HR correlation from 0.088 to 0.982, making it usable when illumination varies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人视觉系统中光照变化对远程光电容积描记术（rPPG）的干扰，提出了一个端到端的时空变换器框架。该框架整合了PRNet三维人脸对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块以及混合时频监督，并引入带权重的频谱KL散度损失。在包含三个光照级别的静态混合协议数据集上，实验表明最优权重β=5时心率均绝对误差（MAE）为0.79 bpm，相关系数达0.982，相比PhysFormer基线MAE降低93.6%，相关系数从0.088提升至0.982。
Motivation: 光照变化是远程光电容积描记术（rPPG）在机器人平台上稳健部署的主要障碍，亟需一种光照鲁棒的心率估计方法。
Method: 提出一种端到端时空变换器框架，包含PRNet三维人脸对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块，以及结合Soft-Shifted Pearson波形损失和频谱KL散度损失的混合时频监督，其中通过权重β调节频域心率引导的贡献。
Result: 在三个光照级别的静态混合协议实验中，β=5取得最佳结果：心率MAE为0.79 bpm，相关系数0.982；与PhysFormer基线相比，MAE降低93.6%，相关系数从0.088提升至0.982。
Conclusion: 本文方法在光照变化条件下实现了高精度、高鲁棒性的远程心率估计，可有效应用于机器人视觉系统的生理感知。

papers.title: Semantically-Aware Diver Activity Recognition Framework for Effective Underwater Multi-Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Effective multi-human-robot collaboration is essential for expanding human-led operations in the challenging and high-risk underwater environment. For autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) to become true teammates, they must be able to comprehend their surroundings and recognize a diver's activities to offer assistance and ensure safety. Towards this goal, we introduce DAR-Net, a novel transformer-based framework that analyzes complex underwater scenes to classify diver activities. Our contribution lies in a semantically guided learning formulation that couples transformer-based temporal reasoning with pixel-level scene supervision. This multi-loss training strategy explicitly aligns global activity recognition with local human-robot interaction semantics, which is particularly critical in low-visibility underwater conditions. To address the significant challenge of data scarcity in this domain, we present the first-ever Underwater Diver Activity (UDA) dataset, a foundational resource containing over 2,600 annotated images with pixel-level masks. Through rigorous experimental evaluations in a controlled environment, we demonstrate that DAR-Net achieves promising accuracy in recognizing six distinct diver activities, outperforming state-of-the-art models. While this dataset provides a crucial baseline, our work serves as a pioneering step, laying the groundwork for future research and facilitating the development of more intelligent, collaborative underwater robotic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对水下多人机器人协作中潜水员活动识别问题，提出了 DAR-Net，一个基于 transformer 的框架，通过语义引导的联合学习实现全局活动识别与局部交互语义的对齐。同时发布了首个水下潜水员活动（UDA）数据集，包含 2600 多张带像素级标注的图像。实验表明 DAR-Net 在识别六种潜水员活动上优于现有模型，为智能水下机器人协作奠定了基础。
Motivation: 水下环境高风险、低可见性，自主水下机器人（AUV）需要理解环境并识别潜水员活动以提供协助和保障安全，现有方法因数据稀缺和语义理解不足而受限。
Method: 提出 DAR-Net，基于 transformer 的框架，采用语义引导学习公式，将时间推理与像素级场景监督耦合，通过多损失训练策略对齐全局活动识别和局部人机交互语义。
Result: 在受控环境中，DAR-Net 在识别六种不同潜水员活动上达到有希望的准确率，优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 该工作为水下人机协作中的活动识别提供了基础数据和方法，是迈向更智能协作系统的关键一步，但摘要未提局限性。

papers.title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HiL-RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, enabling online policy improvement with human guidance. However, current HiL-RL frameworks remain intervention-intensive, relying on frequent human corrections to redirect the policy out of unproductive exploration, which incurs high labor cost and limits real-world scalability. To address this, we propose UniIntervene, an agentic intervention model that detects unproductive exploration and autonomously recovers the policy toward high-value states, taking over the bulk of interventions from human operators. Specifically, UniIntervene first performs future-conditioned action-value estimation, predicting the latent consequence of the current action and evaluating its induced value, which provides a more stable progress signal. Building on this, a temporal value-risk critic aggregates recent value dynamics and triggers intervention when the estimated value exhibits sustained stagnation or degradation. When intervention is required, UniIntervene retrieves a high-value recovery target from a memory of past intervention episodes and produces executable corrective actions through a goal-conditioned recovery policy. In this way, UniIntervene turns intervention from passive human correction into a value-aware recovery process for efficient real-world RL. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UniIntervene improves the average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniIntervene 是一种用于真实世界强化学习的代理干预模型，旨在减少人机循环强化学习 (HiL-RL) 中的人力干预。它通过未来条件动作值估计检测无效率探索，并在价值持续停滞时触发自主恢复，利用记忆中的高价值目标产生纠正动作。在多种真实操作任务上，UniIntervene 将平均成功率提升 8.6%，同时减少 57% 的人类干预。
Motivation: 当前人机循环强化学习依赖频繁的人工纠正来引导策略脱离无效率探索，导致人力成本高昂，限制真实世界的可扩展性。
Method: 提出 UniIntervene 代理干预模型：首先进行未来条件动作值估计以预测动作的潜在后果和诱导价值；然后通过时间值风险评论家聚合近期价值动态，在价值停滞或下降时触发干预；最后从记忆中检索高价值恢复目标，通过目标条件恢复策略生成可执行纠正动作。
Result: 在多样化真实操作任务上，UniIntervene 相比最先进的 HiL-RL 基线，平均成功率提升 8.6%，人类干预次数减少 57%。
Conclusion: 该工作将干预从被动的人类纠正转变为一种价值感知的恢复过程，从而实现更高效的真实世界强化学习。

papers.title: A Turbo-Inference Strategy for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Object detection and instance segmentation tasks are closely related. Existing top-down instance segmentation methods usually follow a detect-then-segment paradigm, where an initial detector is used to recognize and localize objects with bounding boxes, followed by the segmentation of an instance mask within each bounding box. In such methods, the detection accuracy directly influences the subsequent segmentation performance. However, previous research has seldom explored the impact of the instance segmentation task on object detection. In this paper, we present a turbo-inference strategy for the top-down methods that leverages the complementary information between detection and segmentation tasks iteratively. Specifically we design two modules: turbo-detection head and turbo-segmentation head, which facilitate communication between the tasks. The two modules form a closed loop that interlaces the detection and segmentation results without retraining the model. Comprehensive experiments on the COCO, iFLYTEK, and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate that our method substantially enhances both detection and segmentation accuracies with a certain increase in computational cost. The proposed method represents a tradeoff between prediction accuracy and inference speed. Codes are available at https://github.com/zhaozhen2333/Turbo-Learning.git.
papers.comment: Preprint version of an article published in Computer Vision and Image Understanding
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision and Image Understanding, Volume 270, Article 104827, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对自上而下（detect-then-segment）实例分割方法的涡轮推理策略，通过设计涡轮检测头和涡轮分割头形成闭环，迭代利用检测与分割之间的互补信息，无需重新训练模型即可同时提升检测和分割精度，但增加了一定计算开销。在COCO、iFLYTEK和Cityscapes数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有自上而下实例分割方法中，检测误差直接影响后续分割性能，但很少有研究利用分割任务反馈改进检测。本文旨在利用检测与分割任务的互补信息，在不重新训练的情况下迭代提升两者精度。
Method: 提出涡轮推理策略，包含两个模块：涡轮检测头（turbo-detection head）和涡轮分割头（turbo-segmentation head），两者形成闭环，迭代交换检测和分割结果，实现任务间的信息互补。
Result: 在COCO、iFLYTEK和Cityscapes数据集上，该方法在增加一定计算成本的前提下，显著提升了检测和分割的准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法代表了预测精度与推理速度之间的权衡，适用于需要同时提升检测和分割性能的场景。

papers.title: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component in modern large language models, yet the rollout stage remains the key bottleneck in RL training pipelines. Although Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) offers a natural solution to accelerate rollouts through speculative decoding, many studies have observed that MTP acceptance rates degrade significantly during RL training, leading to limited speedup performance. To address this bottleneck, we present Bebop, a systematic study of MTP in LLM post-training, and offer practical recipes to integrate MTP into large-scale RL pipelines. First, we reveal that the MTP acceptance rate is fundamentally bounded by the fluctuation of model entropy, which demonstrates a clear negative linear relationship with the rise of entropy in the RL stage. Second, we show that probabilistic rejection sampling largely alleviates the disturbance introduced by entropy in RL compared to greedy draft sampling. We further identify that the conventional MTP training objectives (cross-entropy or KL) are suboptimal in such settings, and therefore we propose a novel end-to-end TV loss that directly optimizes multi-step rejection sampling acceptance rate, yielding ~10% acceptance rate improvements, achieving up to 95% acceptance rates and up to 25% extra inference throughput gains across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks. Third, we test various online MTP training strategies during RL and show that pre-RL MTP training with e2e TV loss and rejection sampling achieves a consistent acceptance rate and speedup throughout the entire RL, eliminating the need for costly online MTP updating. We provide extensive experiments and analysis that validate our findings. Experimental results show our method achieves up to 1.8x end-to-end acceleration in async RL training of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.7 models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了多标记预测（MTP）在大型语言模型强化学习后训练中的应用，揭示了MTP接受率受熵波动限制，提出Bebop框架，包括概率拒绝采样、端到端TV损失和预RL MTP训练策略，在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上实现高达95%接受率和1.8倍异步RL训练加速。
Motivation: RL训练中rollout阶段是瓶颈，MTP可加速，但RL训练中MTP接受率显著下降，限制了加速效果。
Method: 提出Bebop框架：1）揭示MTP接受率与模型熵的负线性关系；2）使用概率拒绝采样替代贪婪draft采样以减轻熵干扰；3）提出端到端TV损失直接优化多步拒绝采样接受率；4）测试在线MTP训练策略，发现预RL MTP训练配合TV损失和拒绝采样可保持稳定接受率，无需在线更新。
Result: 所提方法在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上接受率达到95%，额外推理吞吐量提升25%；在Qwen3.5/3.6/3.7模型的异步RL训练中实现最高1.8倍端到端加速。

papers.title: Ambient Diffusion Policy: Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Data in Robotics
papers.abstract_en: We propose Ambient Diffusion Policy, a simple and principled method for imitation learning from suboptimal data in robotics. High-quality, task-specific robot data is expensive and time-consuming to collect, while suboptimal datasets with lower-quality or out-of-distribution demonstrations are abundant. Existing methods that co-train on both data sources in robotics often fail to separate the meaningful and the harmful features in the suboptimal samples. In contrast, our method extracts only the useful features by introducing a new axis to co-training in robotics: noise-dependent data usage. Ambient Diffusion Policy restricts the contribution of suboptimal data during training to only the high and low diffusion times. To rigorously justify our approach, we first observe that robot action data exhibits a spectral power law. This induces two important properties on the optimal Diffusion Policy that we exploit: a global-to-local hierarchy and locality. We theoretically formalize this discussion using a simplified model. Our experiments validate Ambient Diffusion Policy on four types of suboptimal action data (noisy trajectories, sim-to-real gap, task mismatch, and large-scale data mixtures) across six tasks. The results show that it effectively learns from arbitrary sources of suboptimal data. Notably, it outperforms existing co-training baselines by up to 33% when scaled to Open X-Embodiment - a large dataset with heterogeneous data quality and unstructured distribution shifts. Overall, Ambient Diffusion Policy increases the utility of suboptimal demonstrations and expands the set of usable data sources in robotics.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ambient Diffusion Policy，一种利用次优数据进行机器人模仿学习的简单且原则性方法。该方法通过噪声依赖的数据使用，限制次优数据仅在高和低扩散时间贡献，从而提取有用特征。实验在六种次优数据任务上验证，在 Open X-Embodiment 上超越现有基线达 33%。

papers.title: On Subquadratic Architectures: From Applications to Principles
papers.abstract_en: Transformers dominate modern sequence modeling, but their quadratic attention incurs substantial computational cost. Subquadratic architectures offer a scalable alternative. However, it remains unclear which designs yield the most effective sequence models. We compare three leading approaches: xLSTM, Mamba-2, and Gated DeltaNet. We evaluate these models on tasks with complex dependencies: (1) code-model pre-training, (2) distillation of code models from large language models, and (3) pre-training of time-series foundation models. Across these settings, xLSTM delivers the strongest overall performance. To explain xLSTM's advantage, we present a unified formulation and analyze the underlying architectural mechanisms, focusing on state tracking and memory dynamics. Our results show that xLSTM enables more flexible and stable memory correction via its gating scheme. We corroborate these findings on controlled synthetic length-generalization tasks. Overall, our findings indicate that xLSTM's gains on complex tasks stem from robust state tracking and accumulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种亚二次架构（xLSTM、Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet）在代码模型预训练、LLM代码蒸馏和时间序列基础模型预训练等复杂任务上的表现，发现xLSTM整体最优。通过统一公式和机制分析，作者将优势归因于其门控机制带来的更灵活稳定的状态跟踪与记忆校正。

Method: 对xLSTM、Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet进行多任务实证比较，并构建统一理论框架分析状态跟踪与记忆动态。
Result: xLSTM在所有复杂任务上表现最好；在受控的合成长度泛化任务上也验证了其优势。
Conclusion: 亚二次架构中，xLSTM因其鲁棒的状态跟踪与累积机制在复杂序列建模中优于其他方法。

papers.title: Latent World Recovery for Multimodal Learning with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: We study multimodal learning under missing modalities, with particular motivation from bioscience applications in which heterogeneous modalities are often only partially available when decisions need to be made. We propose Latent World Recovery (LWR), a framework built on two key ideas: (i) modality-specific embeddings from different modalities are aligned in a shared latent space, and (ii) a unified representation is constructed by fusing only the embeddings of the modalities that are actually available at both training and inference time. Rather than imputing missing modalities or requiring a fixed modality set, LWR treats each modality as a partial perception of an underlying latent state and performs availability-aware representation learning directly from the observed modalities. This combination of neighbor-based latent alignment and availability-aware modality fusion enables robust multimodal prediction under partial observation, while avoiding error propagation from explicit reconstruction of missing modalities. We evaluate the proposed framework on real-world incomplete multi-omics benchmarks and demonstrate that it provides an effective approach to downstream tasks such as cancer phenotype classification and survival prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent World Recovery (LWR) 框架，用于处理多模态学习中部分模态缺失的问题。LWR 通过邻居对齐和可用性感知融合，直接从观测到的模态学习统一表示，无需显式重构缺失模态。在真实不完整多组学基准上，该方法在癌症表型分类和生存预测等下游任务中表现有效。
Motivation: 生物科学应用中，多模态数据往往部分缺失，传统方法需要固定模态集合或进行模态补全，容易引入误差。
Method: LWR 框架包含两个关键：模态特定嵌入在共享潜空间中对齐，以及仅使用训练和推理时实际可用的模态嵌入进行融合，实现可用性感知表示学习。
Result: 在真实不完整多组学基准上，LWR 在癌症表型分类和生存预测等下游任务中展现出鲁棒的多模态预测能力。
Conclusion: LWR 通过避免显式重构缺失模态，有效降低了误差传播，为缺失模态下的多模态学习提供了新思路。

papers.title: Anatomy of Post-Training: Using Interpretability to Characterize Data and Shape the Learning Signal
papers.abstract_en: Language-model post-training is the main stage at which model behavior is shaped, yet it still largely involves optimization of scalar rewards that summarize diverse desiderata. This abstraction gives practitioners little visibility into what their data actually teaches models, allowing spurious correlations to be learned by a model and inducing undesirable behaviors such as over-stylization and sycophancy. To address this problem, we ask: can we inspect a preference dataset before optimization and decide, at the level of concepts, which behaviors a model should be allowed to learn? Motivated by this, we introduce a data-centric post-training pipeline that uses interpretability protocols to develop statistical hypotheses for the latent concepts separating preferred from dispreferred generations, making them explicit for fine-grained user feedback. Building on this view, we unify several interpretability-based training protocols as ways of shaping rewards via feature or data interventions. Empirically, we show that our pipeline diagnoses undesirable signals in existing preference data, mitigates off-target learning, and can also help amplify or shape desired properties such as safeguards and model personality. More broadly, our results suggest that interpretability can turn post-training from optimizing opaque proxy rewards into a process of auditing and sculpting the learning signal itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型后训练中优化标量奖励导致模型学习虚假相关的问题，提出一个基于可解释性的数据驱动后训练流程。该流程通过开发统计假设来识别偏好数据中的潜在概念，并允许用户进行细粒度反馈。实验表明该方法能够诊断不良信号、减轻脱靶学习，并增强安全性和模型个性等期望属性。
Motivation: 语言模型后训练主要依赖优化标量奖励，这使从业者难以了解数据实际教会了模型什么，导致模型学习虚假相关并产生不良行为（如过度风格化和谄媚）。需要一种方法在优化前检查偏好数据集，并在概念层面上决定模型应学习哪些行为。
Method: 引入数据驱动的后训练流程，使用可解释性协议来开发统计假设，识别偏好与非偏好生成之间的潜在概念，并将其显式化以获取细粒度用户反馈。统一了多种基于可解释性的训练协议，通过特征或数据干预来塑造奖励。
Result: 实证表明该流程能诊断现有偏好数据中的不良信号，减轻脱靶学习，并有助于放大或塑造安全性和模型个性等期望属性。
Conclusion: 可解释性可以将后训练从优化不透明的代理奖励转变为审计和塑造学习信号本身的过程。
