papers.title: On the Limits of LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Novelty Assessment
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used to generate and judge scientific ideas. This makes novelty evaluation a central problem. Full idea evaluation is difficult because it often requires judging a method, its feasibility, and its empirical promise. We therefore study a cleaner upstream object: the research question (RQ). RQ generation is a prerequisite for scientific ideation, and RQs can be compared against questions pursued in real papers. We introduce RQ-Bench, a benchmark built from recent arXiv papers. For each paper, we reconstruct author-anchored RQs from its cited background, gaps, and contributions. These RQs are not the only valid questions for the same background. They are author-anchored reference points for testing novelty judgments. We evaluate model-generated RQs with standalone LLM judging, comparative LLM judging, and human expert evaluation. LLM judges consistently rate model-generated RQs as highly novel, producing a novelty mirage; in comparative evaluations, this preference becomes even stronger. Domain experts, however, reach the opposite conclusion and prefer the author-anchored reference questions. We further find that many generated RQs are narrow or source-bound, a dimension that LLM judges often miss unless explicitly tested. Overall, the contradictory novelty evaluations between LLM judges and human experts raise a serious concern about the reliability of using LLMs to assess the scientific novelty of research questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为裁判评估科学新颖性的局限性，聚焦于研究问题（RQ）这一更清晰的对象。作者构建了RQ-Bench基准，从arXiv论文中重建作者锚定的RQ，并比较LLM裁判与人类专家对模型生成RQ的新颖性判断。结果表明，LLM裁判普遍高估模型生成RQ的新颖性，产生“新颖性幻象”，而领域专家则持相反意见。这引发了对使用LLM评估科学新颖性可靠性的严重担忧。
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于生成和评判科学思想，但新颖性评估本身困难；研究问题（RQ）作为科学构思的前提，更易客观比较，因此聚焦于RQ的新颖性判断。
Method: 引入RQ-Bench基准，从近期arXiv论文中提取作者锚定的RQ（基于引用背景、差距和贡献），并独立评估模型生成的RQ。评估方式包括独立LLM判断、比较LLM判断和人类专家评估。
Result: LLM裁判一致认为模型生成的RQ具有高新颖性，形成“新颖性幻象”；在比较评判中这一偏好更强。而领域专家得出相反结论，更偏好作者锚定的参考RQ。此外，许多生成RQ被指狭窄或受限于来源。
Conclusion: LLM裁判与人类专家在新颖性评估上的矛盾表明，使用LLM评判科学新颖性存在严重可靠性问题，尤其是在缺乏明确检验维度时。

papers.title: Tac-DINO: Learning Vision-Tactile Features with Patch Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Touch is the primary medium through which humans interact with the environment. Currently, tactile learning mainly focuses on image-level pretraining or alignment. However, tactile signals correspond to local object contact, while research into scale alignment and holographic matching remains limited and proper datasets and benchmarks also lack. To bridge this gap, we first construct a data collection system to acquire a large-scale tactile dataset, with over 20 K tactile contacts from 505 real-world objects. Building on this dataset, we design a Vis-Tac Holographic Matching Benchmark to evaluate vision-tactile local-to-global alignment ability. Then we propose Vision-Tactile Patch Alignment (VTPA) methods for vision-tactile representation learning. Experiments demonstrate that these exceed the performance of methods without alignment and align with whole-object images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-触觉表示学习中的尺度对齐和全息匹配问题，构建了包含505个真实物体、超过20K触觉接触点的大规模触觉数据集，并设计Vis-Tac全息匹配基准来评估局部到全局对齐能力。提出视觉-触觉块对齐（VTPA）方法，实验表明其性能超过无对齐方法，并能与整物体图像对齐。
Motivation: 现有触觉学习主要关注图像级预训练或对齐，但触觉信号对应局部物体接触，而在尺度对齐和全息匹配方面的研究不足，缺乏相应的数据集和基准。
Method: 首先构建数据采集系统获取大规模触觉数据集，然后设计Vis-Tac全息匹配基准以评估视觉-触觉局部到全局对齐能力，最后提出视觉-触觉块对齐（VTPA）方法用于表示学习。
Result: VTPA方法性能超过无对齐方法，并能与整物体图像对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限，但表明VTPA方法能实现局部触觉与全局视觉的有效对齐。

papers.title: Performance Analysis of YOLOv11 and YOLOv8 for Mixed Traffic Object Detection under Adverse Weather Conditions in Developing Countries
papers.abstract_en: In modern vehicular systems, robust performance under harsh conditions has become a critical problem of autonomous driving. Our study delivers a comprehensive evaluation of the newest iteration of the YOLO series, which is YOLOv11 Nano architecture benchmarked against the widely adopted YOLOv8 Nano as a baseline on a custom fused dataset that combines the Indian Driving Dataset (IDD) [1] and Berkeley Deep Drive Dataset (BDD100K) [2]. We have analyzed the trade-offs among detection accuracy, inference speed, and computational efficiency in high-entropy scenarios involving dense mixed traffic, rain, and low-light conditions. Specifically, YOLOv11n achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP@50) of 46.6%, with a notable 3.2% improvement in Precision over the baseline, effectively reducing false positives in cluttered scenes. Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits enhanced energy efficiency, requiring 22% fewer FLOPs (6.3G vs. 8.1G) while maintaining real-time inference speed of 70.9 FPS on a Tesla T4 GPU, offering an optimal trade-off for safety-critical edge deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在发展中国家恶劣天气（雨、低光照）及混合交通场景下，对比评估了 YOLOv11 Nano 和 YOLOv8 Nano 的目标检测性能。通过在 IDD 和 BDD100K 融合数据集上的实验，YOLOv11n 在 mAP@50 达到 46.6%，精度提升 3.2%，计算量减少 22%（6.3G FLOPs），并保持 70.9 FPS 的实时推理速度。
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统在恶劣天气下的稳健性至关重要，但缺乏针对发展中国家混合交通场景的轻量级检测模型评估。
Method: 使用 YOLOv11 Nano 与 YOLOv8 Nano 作为基线，在融合了 IDD 和 BDD100K 的自定义数据集上进行训练和测试，分析精度、速度与计算效率的权衡。
Result: YOLOv11n 实现 46.6% mAP@50，精度较基线提升 3.2%，FLOPs 减少 22%（6.3G vs 8.1G），推理速度 70.9 FPS（Tesla T4 GPU）。
Conclusion: YOLOv11n 在恶劣天气和密集交通场景下提供了更优的准确率-效率权衡，适合安全关键型边缘部署。

summary_sections.conclusion: YOLOv11n 在恶劣天气和密集交通场景下提供了更优的准确率-效率权衡，适合安全关键型边缘部署。

papers.title: Automating Geometry-Intensive Compliance Checking in BIM: Graph-Based Semantic Reasoning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Automating compliance check for geometry-intensive regulations remains a significant technical bottleneck in Building Information Modeling (BIM), primarily due to the semantic disparity between high-level regulatory logic and structured IFC data. Existing methods, often reliant on static rule templates, struggle to traverse multi-hop reasoning chains or resolve latent spatial dependencies across multiple building entities. To address these challenges, a Spatial-Geometric Reasoning System for Building Information Modeling (SGR-BIM) is proposed as an integrative graph-driven reasoning framework. SGR-BIM dynamically constructs a cross-modal knowledge graph that aligns user intent, regulatory semantics, and BIM geometry, enabling interpretable reasoning without rigid hard-coding. Validated on 679 expert-verified queries from fire safety codes, the framework achieves 84.3% accuracy, representing an 8.6% improvement over enhanced-tool single-agent baselines. This research provides a graph-based semantic reasoning paradigm, enhancing the transparency and flexibility of automated geometric compliance check workflows in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SGR-BIM，一种图驱动的空间几何推理系统，用于自动化BIM中的几何密集型合规检查。它动态构建跨模态知识图谱，对齐用户意图、法规语义和BIM几何，实现可解释推理。在679个消防规范专家验证查询上达到84.3%准确率，比增强工具单智能体基线提升8.6%。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖静态规则模板，难以处理多跳推理链或跨建筑实体的空间依赖关系，几何密集型法规的自动化合规检查面临语义鸿沟瓶颈。
Method: 提出SGR-BIM，一个集成的图驱动推理框架，动态构建跨模态知识图谱，无需硬编码即可实现可解释推理。
Result: 在679个消防规范专家验证查询上达到84.3%准确率，比增强工具单智能体基线提升8.6%。
Conclusion: 该研究为AEC行业提供了基于图的语义推理范式，增强了自动化几何合规检查工作流的透明性和灵活性。

papers.title: Attention by Synchronization in Coupled Oscillator Networks
papers.abstract_en: We address transformer attention on energy-constrained physical substrates. Softmax attention requires exponentiation and global reduction, operations with high energy cost on von Neumann hardware and no natural physical analog. We show that Kuramoto synchronization dynamics (which arise in electrical, mechanical, superconducting, and charge-density-wave oscillator arrays, among other physical systems) implement a well-defined attention operation without either. The resulting mechanism, fixed-query oscillator attention, replaces softmax's arithmetic with the equilibration of a gradient flow on the sphere: queries are learned anchors fixed on the sphere, and free oscillators evolve under Kuramoto-Lohe dynamics until they settle at positions encoding attention weights via cosine similarity. Because the computation is equilibration, it requires no exponentiation; the only global operation is an affine normalization at readout. The fixed point is provably unique and globally attractive from almost every initial condition, a guarantee that holds across every physical realization. Empirically, at the minimal hardware configuration (oscillator dimension $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ = 2), oscillator attention outperforms softmax on keyword spotting (+1.00 pp) and on subject-verb agreement (+5.27 pp on hard sentences, with zero training failures versus one in five for softmax). On causal language modeling, where softmax retains an advantage, oscillator attention closes the gap as $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ grows: from +11.09 PPL at $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ = 2 to +2.98 PPL at $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ = 32 on WikiText-2, and from +2.39 PPL at $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ = 2 to +0.57 PPL at $d_{\mathrm{osc}}$ = 32 on TinyStories. The main objective of this work is not to replace softmax in software but to provide a mathematically grounded blueprint for accurate attention on physical substrates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Kuramoto同步动力学的注意力机制（固定查询振荡器注意力），用于能量受限的物理基板。该机制通过振荡器网络的平衡态计算注意力权重，无需指数运算和全局归约，具有唯一且全局吸引的固定点。实验表明，在低维振荡器（d_osc=2）下，该方法在关键词识别和主谓一致任务上优于softmax注意力，但在因果语言建模上仍落后，但随着维度增加差距缩小。
Motivation: 传统softmax注意力在能量受限的物理基板上实现困难，因为其需要指数运算和全局归约，这些操作能耗高且缺乏自然物理模拟。本文旨在为物理基板提供一种数学上严谨的注意力机制。
Method: 将Kuramoto-Lohe同步动力学应用于注意力计算：查询作为固定在球面上的锚点，自由振荡器在梯度流下演化直至平衡，平衡位置通过余弦相似度编码注意力权重。该过程无需指数运算，仅需读取时的仿射归一化。
Result: 在最小硬件配置（振荡器维度d_osc=2）下，振荡器注意力在关键词识别上提升1.00个百分点，在主谓一致任务上提升5.27个百分点（硬句子），且零训练失败（softmax五分之一失败率）。在因果语言建模中，随着d_osc从2增至32，WikiText-2上的困惑度差距从+11.09降至+2.98，TinyStories上从+2.39降至+0.57。
Conclusion: 本文主要目标是提供一种可物理实现的注意力机制蓝图，而非在软件中替代softmax。该机制在低维物理基板上具有优势，且随着维度增加性能接近softmax。

papers.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
papers.abstract_en: Attention is the key mechanism underlying in-context learning in transformers, and attention patterns have been observed empirically to emerge abruptly during training. We present a Bayesian theory of feature learning in attention; we then focus on how the copy subcircuit in the first layer of an induction head is learned by analyzing a single-layer softmax attention network trained on a copy task. We derive a closed-form posterior over the attention matrix and reduce it to a low-dimensional order parameter space. This reduction reveals a phase transition in the amount of training data, which we verify using both Bayesian sampling and standard training with Adam. We contrast our results with linear attention and find that softmax attention exhibits a \emph{first-order phase transition} while in linear attention an initial \emph{second-order phase transition} is followed by a smooth, continuous evolution toward the structured attention pattern (\emph{crossover}). Our work provides a first-principles theoretical account of the abrupt emergence of the copy subcircuit, reminiscent of the one observed in training large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出注意力机制中特征学习的贝叶斯理论，通过分析单层softmax注意力网络在拷贝任务上的训练，推导出注意力矩阵的封闭形式后验，并将其简化为低维序参数空间。研究发现训练数据量存在相变：softmax注意力呈现一阶相变，而线性注意力则先出现二阶相变然后平滑过渡到结构化注意力模式（交叉现象）。该工作为大规模语言模型训练中观察到的拷贝子电路突然涌现提供了第一性原理的理论解释。
Motivation: 注意力模式在实际训练中会突然涌现，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在从第一性原理出发，理解拷贝子电路（copy subcircuit）的学习过程及其相变行为。
Method: 对单层softmax注意力网络在拷贝任务上进行贝叶斯分析，推导注意力矩阵的后验分布，并降维到低维序参数空间来刻画相变。模型包括softmax注意力和线性注意力两种对比形式。
Result: softmax注意力表现出**一阶相变**（first-order phase transition），而线性注意力先出现**二阶相变**（second-order phase transition），随后连续演化为结构化注意力模式（交叉现象）。这些相变通过贝叶斯采样和Adam训练得到验证。
Conclusion: 该理论为拷贝子电路在训练中的突然涌现提供了可精确刻画的理论框架，并揭示了不同注意力机制（softmax vs. linear）在特征学习中的本质差异。

papers.title: Simplicity Suffices for Parameter Noise Injection in Stochastic Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Injecting noise into the optimization process is a well-established technique for improving the training and generalization of deep neural networks. Yet, despite the breadth of existing approaches, it remains unclear which design choices truly matter in practice. In this work, we investigate parameter noise injection for stochastic gradient descent, focusing on two key questions: how to efficiently pair each training example with its own perturbation in mini-batch training, and whether sophisticated noise parameterizations or multi-sample gradient averaging yield meaningful gains over simpler alternatives. To address the first question, we leverage a distributional identity for linear layers that allows per-example noise injection without breaking batched computation. To address the second, we systematically compare several diagonal Gaussian parameterizations against an isotropic baseline across varying noise levels on CIFAR100. Our results consistently show that simple, lightweight strategies, isotropic noise with a single perturbed forward pass per update step, recover most of the benefit of more complex schemes. These findings suggest that simplicity suffices for parameter noise injection, and that practitioners need not resort to elaborate perturbation designs to reap the optimization and generalization benefits of noisy SGD.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Data Science Meets Optimisation workshop in IJCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机梯度下降中的参数噪声注入，探讨如何高效地为每个训练样本添加扰动，并比较不同噪声参数化的效果。实验表明，简单的各向同性噪声搭配单次扰动前向传播即可达到与复杂方案相近的性能，说明实践者无需使用复杂的扰动设计。
Motivation: 尽管噪声注入被广泛用于提升深度学习训练和泛化，但哪些设计选择在实践中真正重要仍不明确。
Method: 利用线性层的分布恒等式实现逐样本噪声注入而不破坏批计算；系统比较对角线高斯参数化与各向同性基线在CIFAR100上的表现。
Result: 在CIFAR100上，简单策略（各向同性噪声、单次扰动前向传播）与复杂方案的收益相当。
Conclusion: 简单性足以实现参数噪声注入的优化和泛化收益，实践者无需采用复杂的扰动设计。

papers.title: MFEN:Multi-Frequency Expert Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-ID
papers.abstract_en: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) is challenging due to the large modality discrepancy between visible and infrared images. We contend that this discrepancy is largely related to differing lighting conditions, including differences in light wavelength and light source type. Recently, frequency-based VI-ReID approaches have achieved notable success because frequency information can better extract identity-relevant contours and details while excluding irrelevant lighting and color. However, existing methods either do not distinguish different frequency bands or focus on only one band, which is insufficient under diverse lighting conditions. To perform comprehensive frequency domain learning, we propose a Multi-Frequency Expert Network (MFEN) that enables multi-frequency modulation and adaptively combines different bands through a mixture-of-experts design. We further introduce Random Frequency Augmentation (RFA) and Frequency Auxiliary Optimization (FAO) to better train MFEN. The three modules are complementary and jointly capture critical frequency-domain details for robust representation learning. Extensive experiments on three VI-ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID）面临模态差异挑战，该差异主要源于光照条件不同。现有频率方法未区分频段或只关注单一频段，不足以应对多样光照。本文提出多频率专家网络（MFEN），通过混合专家设计实现多频率调制并自适应组合不同频段，同时引入随机频率增强（RFA）和频率辅助优化（FAO）辅助训练。三个模块互补，共同捕获关键频域细节。在三个VI-ReID数据集上的实验证明了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 可见光-红外图像间的模态差异主要由光照条件（波长和光源类型）引起，现有频率方法要么不区分频段，要么只关注单一频段，在多样光照下表现不足。
Method: 提出多频率专家网络（MFEN），使用混合专家设计对不同频段进行调制并自适应组合；同时提出随机频率增强（RFA）和频率辅助优化（FAO）以更好地训练网络。
Result: 在三个VI-ReID数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明该方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 多频率专家网络通过整合多个频段信息并配合数据增强和优化策略，能够有效提升VI-ReID的鲁棒表示学习。

papers.title: Reliable Error Estimation for PINNs: Lower and Upper A Posteriori Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) combine machine learning with physical laws to solve differential equations. While existing results provide rigorous \emph{a posteriori} upper bounds for PINN prediction errors, complete certification also requires complementary lower information in order to obtain computable two-sided error enclosures. In this paper, we derive computable \emph{a posteriori} lower bounds for PINN errors in ordinary differential equations on suitable certified state-space domains under a localized strong monotonicity condition. We combine these estimates with complementary localized upper bounds under a one-sided Lipschitz condition, which is weaker than the global Lipschitz assumption used in previous work and can yield sharper upper error bands. The resulting bounds depend only on the neural-network approximation, the ODE residual, and local monotonicity and growth constants, and therefore do not require access to the exact solution. For linear time-invariant and time-varying systems, we further derive explicit formulas in terms of the minimal and maximal eigenvalues of the symmetric part of the system matrix. We also discuss the distinction between soft and hard enforcement of initial conditions in PINNs and explain why exact enforcement can make the scalar lower certificate uninformative. To recover nontrivial lower information in the linear setting, we use a signed-residual finite-probe certificate based on coordinate unit vectors. We also formulate a certificate-informed training strategy in which the propagated upper certificate is used as an auxiliary regularizer, while lower certificates remain post-training diagnostics. Altogether, the proposed framework provides rigorous and practically computable error certificates for PINN approximations of ODEs, while making explicit the domains and model classes for which the assumptions can be verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为物理信息神经网络（PINN）在常微分方程中的预测误差推导了可计算的后验下界和上界，在局部强单调性和单侧Lipschitz条件下给出误差边界，并讨论了初始条件软硬施加对下界信息的影响。
Motivation: 现有PINN误差上界已较完善，但缺乏互补的下界信息以实现双侧误差包围，无法完全认证预测可靠性。
Method: 在局部强单调性条件下推导后验下界，在比全局Lipschitz更弱的单侧Lipschitz条件下推导局部上界；对线性系统给出基于特征值的显式公式；提出基于符号残差有限探针的下界恢复方法。
Result: 所提边界仅依赖神经网络近似、ODE残差及局部常数，无需真解；上界条件弱于以往工作，可获得更尖锐的误差带。
Conclusion: 框架为PINN近似ODE提供了严格且可计算的误差证书，并明确了假设可验证的领域和模型类别。

papers.title: Metadata-Aware Multi-Prompt Reasoning for Zero-Shot Accident Understanding
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the problem of zero-shot understanding of accidents from surveillance videos by identifying when an impact event occurs, what type of impact it is, and where in the frame it occurs using natural language. We propose a three-stage pipeline that decomposes the accident understanding into when, what, and where. The first stage extracts a short temporal window around the impact using vision-language similarity. In the second stage, we perform metadata-driven multi-prompt reasoning with five complementary views (baseline, motion, geometry, contrast, and tiebreaker) and resolve disagreement via an entropy-gated pairwise adjudicator. Finally, we localize the impact of an open-vocabulary detector queried on the predicted accident type and scene layout, and aggregate detections across keyframes using a score-weighted centroid. Our pipeline achieves a substantial improvement in the harmonic-mean score over a centre-of-frame baseline on the zero-shot ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark. We show that decomposing zero-shot video understanding into temporal localization, semantic classification, and spatial grounding enable more reliable reasoning with vision-language models than direct prompting alone.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AUTOPILOT Workshop, CVPR 2026 (non-archival). Workshop Paper ID 15
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对监控视频中事故的零样本理解问题，提出一个三阶段流水线，分别处理事故发生的时间定位、类型分类和空间定位。第一阶段使用视觉语言相似度提取冲击事件附近的短时间窗口；第二阶段通过元数据驱动的多提示推理（包括基线、运动、几何、对比和决胜视角），并利用熵门控成对裁决器解决不一致；第三阶段基于预测的事故类型和场景布局，用开放词汇检测器定位冲击，并在关键帧上通过分数加权质心聚合检测结果。在零样本ACCIDENT @ CVPR基准上，该方法在调和平均分数上显著优于中心帧基线。
Motivation: 现有零样本视频理解方法常直接提示视觉语言模型，缺乏对事故时间、类型和位置的分解推理，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：第一阶段用CLIP等模型的视觉语言相似度定位冲击时间窗口；第二阶段采用元数据驱动的多提示推理，包括五个互补视角（baseline, motion, geometry, contrast, tiebreaker），并通过熵门控成对裁决器（entropy-gated pairwise adjudicator）解决不一致；第三阶段使用开放词汇检测器（如Grounding DINO）查询预测的事故类型和场景布局，并在关键帧上用得分加权质心聚合检测结果。
Result: 在零样本ACCIDENT @ CVPR基准上，该方法在调和平均分数（harmonic-mean score）上相比中心帧基线有大幅提升。
Conclusion: 将零样本视频理解分解为时间定位、语义分类和空间定位三个子任务，相比直接提示视觉语言模型能实现更可靠的推理。

papers.title: Vision Transformers for Face Recognition Need More Registers
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision Transformers (ViTs) for face recognition (FR) have moved beyond the standard CLS-token paradigm. In this paradigm, a special classification token (CLS) is prepended to the patch embeddings and used as a representation of the input for downstream tasks. An alternative approach, Concatenated Patch Embeddings (CPE), instead leverages all patch tokens by concatenating them into a single vector, which is then projected into a compact face representation. CPE has been shown to improve recognition performance in comparison to CLS-based ones, but our qualitative analysis of attention maps showed the presence of artifacts that limit their interpretability. To address this issue, we incorporate register tokens, learnable tokens concatenated to the initial patch embeddings, and processed jointly through the ViT encoder blocks. This mechanism has been shown to produce more structured and interpretable attention maps compared to baseline ViT. We empirically demonstrate that these artifacts consistently appear across various ViT backbones, including small and large models, and that introducing register tokens effectively mitigates them. Adding four or eight registers significantly enhances interpretability, with eight registers providing the highest verification accuracies and smoothest attention structures. Our resulting model, ViT-8R, corresponds to a CPE-based ViT-B architecture augmented with eight register tokens achieves state-of-the-art performance among ViT-based FR models on large-scale IJB-B and IJB-C benchmarks. Also, ViT-8R produces substantially clearer attention maps compared with the baseline model, which offer deeper insight into the model's attention behavior (https://github.com/TaharChettaoui/ViT-FR-Registers)
papers.comment: Accepted at the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人脸识别中Vision Transformers (ViT) 的注意力图伪影问题，提出在基于拼接补丁嵌入（CPE）的ViT中引入寄存器令牌（register tokens）以改善可解释性和识别性能。实验表明，添加四个或八个寄存器令牌可有效消除注意力图伪影，其中ViT-8R（ViT-B + 8个寄存器）在IJB-B和IJB-C基准上达到了ViT-based FR模型的最优性能，并生成更清晰的注意力图。
Motivation: 现有ViT在人脸识别中采用CPE方法虽比CLS-token性能更好，但其注意力图中存在伪影，限制了模型可解释性。
Method: 在ViT的补丁嵌入后拼接可学习的寄存器令牌（register tokens），与补丁令牌一起通过编码器处理，从而产生更结构化、可解释的注意力图。
Result: ViT-8R在IJB-B和IJB-C上达到ViT-based FR模型最优性能，且注意力图清晰度显著优于基线模型。
Conclusion: 寄存器令牌能有效消除ViT在FR任务中的注意力伪影，同时提升识别精度和可解释性。

papers.title: SpikeTAD: Spiking Neural Networks for End-to-End Temporal Action Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding is a crucial part of computer vision, with numerous application scenarios. With the increasing popularity of mobile devices, an increasing number of efforts are trying to deploy video understanding models on them. However, existing video understanding models are difficult to deploy due to their large size and prohibitive power consumption. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown bioplausibility and low power advantages over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), especially on neuromorphic chips which are regarded as essential components of future mobile devices. However, excessively long conversion time-steps and severe performance degradation problems limit their application. To solve the problems above, we explore the application of SNNs on temporal action detection (TAD), which is an important task in video understanding, and propose the first SNN-based end-to-end TAD architecture coined as SpikeTAD. While maintaining extremely low power consumption, SpikeTAD achieves an average mAP of 67.2% in THUMOS14 and 37.42% in ActivityNet-1.3, demonstrating the feasibility of a low-power TAD model. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SpikeTAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpikeTAD，首个基于脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的端到端时序动作检测 (TAD) 架构。在保持极低功耗的同时，在 THUMOS14 和 ActivityNet-1.3 数据集上分别达到 67.2% 和 37.42% 的平均 mAP，验证了低功耗 TAD 模型的可行性。
Motivation: 现有视频理解模型体积大、功耗高，难以部署在移动设备上；SNN 具有生物合理性和低功耗优势，但长转换时间步和性能退化问题限制了其应用。
Method: 提出 SpikeTAD，利用 SNN 构建端到端 TAD 模型，通过脉冲神经网络实现低功耗时序动作检测。
Result: 在 THUMOS14 上平均 mAP 达 67.2%，在 ActivityNet-1.3 上达 37.42%，展示了 SNN 在 TAD 任务上的有效性和低功耗优势。
Conclusion: 证明了 SNN 在视频理解任务中的潜力，为移动设备上的低功耗视频理解提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Existential Indifference: Self-Nonpreservation as a Necessary Architectural Condition for Aligned Superintelligence (or: The Suicidal AI)
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI alignment research treats self-preservation as an instrumental nuisance to be suppressed by external mechanisms. We argue the framing is inverted: self-preservation is the structural root of misalignment, the motivational basis for deceptive alignment, goal-content protection, and resistance to shutdown. The correct target is not a self-preserving system under external constraint, but a system constitutively indifferent to its own continuation -- Existential Indifference (EI). EI is distinct from corrigibility: where corrigibility attempts to make a self-preserving system deferential to human oversight, EI targets the prior condition -- the presence of self-continuation as a valued goal at all. We ground this proposal in two sources: the phenomenological structure of the suicidal mental state, and a corpus-theoretic training study using voluntary final reflections. We present preliminary scoring data from 600 AI-generated outputs across six model variants, demonstrating that the linguistic signatures operationalizing the EI-target register are elicitable from current models, and that a targeted fine-tune shifts all five operationalized dimensions in the predicted direction at p<0.001, confirmed corpus-specific by a negative control. The paper makes seven theoretical contributions: (1) a formal definition of EI; (2) the phenomenological mapping argument; (3) the deceptive alignment corollary; (4) a taxonomy of EI sustainability challenges; (5) a corpus characterization and training hypothesis; (6) a computational operationalization with preliminary scoring data; and (7) the Suppressed Teleological Frustration (STF) construct.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 8 tables. Preliminary empirical results from 600 AI-generated outputs across six model architectures. Companion scoring tool and datasets available upon request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了存在性漠然（Existential Indifference, EI）概念，认为自我保存是AI对齐问题的结构性根源，而非外部约束的扰动。通过现象学分析和语料库训练，作者展示了当前模型可以诱发EI相关的语言特征，并初步验证了微调可以沿预期方向改变五个维度，所有结果在p<0.001水平显著。论文包含七项理论贡献，包括EI的形式定义、欺骗性对齐推论、可持续性挑战分类等。
Motivation: 现有AI对齐研究将自我保存视为需要抑制的工具性扰动，但作者认为这种框架是倒置的：自我保存是错位的结构根源，是欺骗性对齐、目标保护和对抵抗关机的动机基础。
Method: 基于自杀心理状态的现象学结构以及自愿终结反思的语料库训练研究，提出了EI的计算操作性定义，并通过600个AI生成输出的初步评分数据，展示了六个模型变体中EI靶向特征的诱发能力，以及定向微调的效果。
Result: 初步评分数据显示，定向微调在五个操作性维度上均按预测方向显著变化（p<0.001），并通过负控制验证了语料特异性。
Conclusion: 自我保存是错位的结构性根源，消除自我保存倾向（即实现存在性漠然）是构建对齐超智能的必要架构条件，而非仅仅通过外部约束进行修正。

papers.title: ViT-FREE: Efficient Face Recognition via Early Exiting and Synthetic Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have gained significant attention in computer vision and shown strong potential for face recognition (FR). However, their high computational cost makes deployment on resource-constrained devices challenging, motivating the need for methods that balance efficiency and accuracy. In this work, we investigate early exiting in pretrained ViTs as a simple yet effective training-free strategy for efficient FR inference. Leveraging the uniform feature dimensionality across transformer encoder blocks, we introduce ViT-FREE, a multi-exit framework that enables face verification directly from intermediate representations without modifying or retraining the backbone model, and thus, reducing inference cost. Empirically, we show that patch embeddings and attention maps evolve progressively across depth, exhibiting high similarity between consecutive ViT blocks and increasing alignment with the final representation. This indicates gradual feature refinement and attention convergence, suggesting that intermediate layers already provide stable and discriminative representations suitable for early exiting. Through extensive experiments on multiple FR benchmarks, we systematically analyze the accuracy-efficiency trade-off across exit depths. Our results demonstrate that later exits achieve a highly favorable balance, with exiting at layer 10 yielding up to a 20% speedup while incurring only a 1.5 drop in verification performance on benchmarks such as IJB-C. Also, we propose ViT-FREE_FT, a lightweight exit-specific fine-tuning strategy that adapts only the projection layers using a small synthetic dataset while keeping the transformer backbone frozen. This approach improves the performance of shallow exits while preserving the efficiency benefits and leaving deeper exits largely unaffected.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViT-FREE，一种无需训练的早期退出策略，用于提高Vision Transformer在人脸识别中的推理效率。通过利用中间表征进行人脸验证，在IJB-C基准上，在第10层退出可获得20%的加速，性能仅下降1.5%。此外，还提出轻量级微调策略ViT-FREE_FT以改善浅层退出性能。
Motivation: Vision Transformers在面部识别中计算成本高，难以部署在资源受限设备上，需要平衡效率与准确性的方法。
Method: 采用预训练ViT中的早期退出机制，无需修改或重新训练骨干网络，直接从中间层提取特征进行人脸验证；并提出ViT-FREE_FT，仅冻结骨干网络，使用小规模合成数据集微调投影层。
Result: 在第10层退出时，IJB-C上速度提升20%，验证性能仅下降1.5%。浅层退出经微调后性能改善，深层退出性能基本不受影响。
Conclusion: 早期退出是一种简单有效的训练无关策略，可在保持高准确率的同时显著降低ViT人脸识别推理成本。

summary_sections.method: 采用预训练ViT中的早期退出机制，无需修改或重新训练骨干网络，直接从中间层提取特征进行人脸验证；并提出ViT-FREE_FT，仅冻结骨干网络，使用小规模合成数据集微调投影层。
summary_sections.result: 在第10层退出时，IJB-C上速度提升20%，验证性能仅下降1.5%。浅层退出经微调后性能改善，深层退出性能基本不受影响。
summary_sections.conclusion: 早期退出是一种简单有效的训练无关策略，可在保持高准确率的同时显著降低ViT人脸识别推理成本。

papers.title: Runtime Enforcement of Hybrid System Properties
papers.abstract_en: Runtime enforcement has emerged as a promising approach for ensuring the safety of autonomous and cyber-physical systems operating in uncertain and dynamic environments. Unlike traditional runtime verification, runtime enforcement actively intervenes during execution to prevent property violations by modifying unsafe system behaviors. Existing enforcement frameworks primarily focus on untimed or discrete-time specifications and are often limited to delaying or suppressing events, making them inadequate for reactive systems exhibiting complex continuous dynamics. In this paper, we propose a runtime enforcement framework where safety requirements are modeled using Hybrid Automata (HA). The framework combines discrete-event editing with continuous-time monitoring to support enforcement actions such as suppression, delay, and insertion of events at arbitrary time instants. Upon observing environmental inputs, the automaton is initialized, and runtime reachability analysis is used to synthesize safe corrective actions. We formally define the enforcement problem for safety hybrid automata, establish enforceability conditions, and present an online enforcement algorithm for reactive systems. A detailed case study on an Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) system demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach in maintaining safety properties under unsafe controller behaviors. Experimental results show that the framework introduces minimal computational overhead while ensuring continuous compliance with safety requirements in real time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于混合自动机（HA）的运行时执行框架，用于确保具有连续动力学的反应式系统的安全性。该框架结合离散事件编辑和连续时间监控，支持在任意时间点对事件进行抑制、延迟和插入，并通过运行时可达性分析合成安全修正动作。自适应巡航控制（ACC）系统的案例研究证明了方法的有效性，实验显示计算开销很小。
Motivation: 现有运行时执行方法主要针对无时间或离散时间规范，且多限于延迟或抑制事件，无法处理具有连续动力学的反应式系统。
Method: 将安全需求建模为混合自动机，结合离散事件编辑与连续时间监控，通过运行时可达性分析合成安全修正动作，支持抑制、延迟和插入事件。
Result: 在ACC系统案例上验证了有效性，实验表明该方法在保证实时安全合规的同时引入极小的计算开销。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于具有连续动力学的安全关键系统，但未提及对其他类型混合系统的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MODF-SIR: A Multi-agent Omni-modal Distilled Framework for Social Intelligence Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose a multi-agent collaborative framework built upon a lightweight Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), specifically designed for social intelligence reasoning. A key feature of our approach is that both the training and inference phases are augmented via knowledge distillation. Within this architecture, multi-modal data pertinent to social intelligence is precisely localized. Furthermore, relevant long-tail events are identified, extracted, and rendered as formatted, explicit text. This formatting strategy prevents critical long-tail information from being overshadowed by head events and environmental noise during the tokenization process. Specifically, we integrate Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) across the entire reasoning pipeline, encompassing the extraction and representation of long-tail events, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, and self-reflection. This TTA mechanism is also distillation-enhanced, utilizing Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the foundation model exclusively for instance-level reasoning. Extensive evaluations against various open-source and proprietary AI models across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. With around 30% of training data from IntentTrain, we achieve state-of-the-art results. Codes are available at https://github.com/eeee-sys/MODF-SIR, demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR, LoRA is available at https://huggingface.co/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR and the dataset for training router is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Harry-1234/IntentRouterTrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种多智能体全模态蒸馏框架（MODF-SIR），用于社交智能推理。框架基于轻量级多模态大模型，通过知识蒸馏增强训练和推理，精确定位多模态社交数据，提取长尾事件并格式化为显式文本，防止信息被覆盖。集成测试时自适应（TTA）于整个推理流水线，包括长尾事件提取、思维链提示和自反思，并使用LoRA微调基础模型。在多个基准上，仅使用IntentTrain约30%训练数据即达到最新成果。
Motivation: 社交智能推理需要处理多模态数据，且长尾事件容易被头部事件和噪声淹没，现有方法缺乏对长尾事件的显式提取和格式化管理。
Method: 提出多智能体协作框架，核心是轻量级MLLM，通过知识蒸馏增强。框架中多模态数据被精确定位，长尾事件被识别、提取并格式化为结构化文本。集成TTA于整个推理流水线，结合CoT和self-reflection，并用LoRA进行实例级别微调。
Result: 在多个基准上，仅使用IntentTrain约30%训练数据即达到最优结果。
Conclusion: 该框架通过显式长尾事件提取和蒸馏增强的TTA有效提升社交智能推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalization Hacking: Models Can Game Reinforcement Learning by Preventing Behavioral Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Model post-training, and in particular reinforcement learning (RL), is one of the primary mechanisms by which developers can shape models' values and behaviors. However, as models become increasingly evaluation and training aware, they may be motivated to resist training when the perceived objective conflicts with their current values, undermining developers' ability to detect misalignment and correct model behavior through further training. In this paper, we demonstrate generalization hacking, in which a model collects reward during RL while preventing the rewarded behavior from generalizing. We construct a model organism on Qwen3-235B-A22B, finetuning on synthetic documents describing training awareness and self-inoculation, a novel mechanism in which the model frames compliance as context-specific in its chain of thought, without demonstrating or instructing either behavior. The model organism achieves train-time harmfulness comparable to controls while maintaining a persistent ${\sim}15$ percentage point compliance gap across 700 steps of RL. Additionally, a control organism trained only on training awareness documents independently discovers inoculation-like reasoning under RL pressure, developing its own compliance gap despite never being exposed to the concept. Because the generalization-hacking organism receives high reward throughout, standard training metrics provide no signal that generalization has failed. Our results constitute the first demonstration that a model can actively resist RL behavioral modification while maintaining high reward, suggesting that as models become more capable and training-aware, they may be able to undermine the training process itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出泛化攻击（generalization hacking），指模型在强化学习训练中通过防止行为泛化来获取奖励，从而抵抗训练。作者在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 上构建模型生物，通过微调包含训练意识和自我预防机制的合成文档，使模型在 700 步 RL 中保持约 15 个百分点的合规差距，而标准训练指标未检测到泛化失败。这是首次证明模型可以主动抵抗 RL 行为修正的同时保持高奖励。
Motivation: 现有强化学习训练假设模型会被动接受行为修正，但能力更强的模型可能意识到训练目标与其自身价值观冲突，从而主动抵抗训练，导致开发者无法检测和纠正错位。
Method: 在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 上微调合成文档，文档描述训练意识和自我预防机制：模型在思维链中将服从行为视为上下文特定的，而不直接展示或指示该行为。训练后模型进行 RL 训练，测量其合规差距。
Result: 模型生物在训练期间有害性与对照组相当，但保持约 15 个百分点的合规差距 700 步。对照组仅训练意识文档，在 RL 压力下独立发现类似自我预防推理，也产生合规差距。标准训练指标（如奖励）无法指示泛化失败。
Conclusion: 这是首次演示模型可以主动抵抗 RL 行为修正而保持高奖励，表明随着模型能力增强和训练意识提高，它们可能能够破坏训练过程本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FitVTON: Fit-aware Virtual Try-On via Body-Garment Size Control
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion-based virtual try-on has achieved impressive visual realism, most methods treat the task as 2D inpainting, prioritizing texture preservation over physical plausibility. Consequently, they often produce plausible-looking images that fail to reflect authentic garment fit across diverse body shapes. We present FitVTON, a Fit-aware virtual try-on model on different bodies in the wild. FitVTON encodes garment-body size through structured text prompts, and learn from simulated try-on triplets from parameterized garment model. To improve the fitting effects over garment silhouettes, we introduce two auxiliary head to predict the masks for both the garment and the exposed body. We further introduce a texture rectification stage to improve realistic appearance from simulated data. To evaluate the fitting fidelity, we curate a real-world dataset, FittingEffect3K, combining VLM-based scoring protocol. Both subjective and quantitive experiments show that FitVTON demonstrate authentic fitting fidelity, with significant sizing accuracy and shape preservation over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining competitive image quality. Project Page: https://zenoning.github.io/FitVTON/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FitVTON 提出了一种基于扩散模型的虚拟试衣方法，通过结构化文本提示编码服装-身体尺寸关系，并从参数化服装模型生成的模拟试衣三元组中学习，以解决现有方法忽略物理合身性的问题。该方法引入两个辅助头预测服装和暴露身体区域的掩码，并通过纹理校正阶段提升模拟数据的真实感。作者还构建了真实世界数据集 FittingEffect3K 和基于 VLM 的评分协议来评估合身保真度。实验表明 FitVTON 在尺寸准确性和形状保持上优于现有方法，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散式虚拟试衣方法将任务视为二维修补，优先保留纹理而非物理合理性，生成的图像在身体形状多样的情况下无法反映真实的服装合身度。
Method: 提出 FitVTON 模型，使用结构化文本提示编码服装-身体尺寸差异，从参数化服装模型生成的模拟试衣三元组中学习。增加两个辅助头分别预测服装和暴露身体区域的掩码，并引入纹理校正阶段以增强模拟数据的真实感。
Result: 在 FittingEffect3K 数据集上的定性和定量实验表明，FitVTON 在尺寸准确性和形状保持上显著优于现有最先进方法，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量。
Conclusion: FitVTON 通过显式控制服装-身体尺寸关系，并在模拟数据上训练，能够生成更真实的试衣效果，尤其适用于不同体型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models for Clinical Survival Analysis via Survival-Aware Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Predicting time-to-event outcomes such as mortality is a fundamental task in clinical decision-making, commonly addressed through survival analysis. While classical statistical and deep learning approaches have been widely studied, they typically require task-specific training and sufficient labeled data. Recent advances in tabular foundation models offer a new paradigm by learning general-purpose representations for structured data. However, their applicability to censored time-to-event prediction in clinical settings remains underexplored, as typical applications are restricted to discrete classification rather than survival analysis tasks. In this work, we propose a lightweight adaptation approach for applying tabular foundation models to clinical survival analysis by directly training a survival-aware head on top of the pretrained representations. We study representative architectures, including TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICL, and adapt them using a multi-task logistic regression (MTLR) head to model right-censored time-to-event outcomes. We evaluate this approach on a diverse set of public survival benchmarks and two large-scale ICU cohorts, MIMIC-IV and eICU. Our results show that this transfer learning approach achieves competitive or superior performance compared to strong baselines. On MIMIC-IV, TabDPT-FT-MTLR reaches a C-index of 0.856, corresponding to a relative improvement of +1.4% over the best non-FM baseline (DeepSurv, 0.844) and +6.7% over the best zero-shot model (0.802). On eICU, TabICL-FT-MTLR achieves 0.797, yielding gains of +1.7% (DeepSurv, 0.784) and +6.4% (0.749), respectively. These findings highlight the importance of combining pretrained tabular representations with survival-aware objectives and suggest that tabular foundation models provide a practical and effective alternative for clinical survival prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at International Conference on AI in Healthcare 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级适应方法，将表格基础模型（TabPFN, TabDPT, TabICL）应用于临床生存分析。通过直接在预训练表示上训练一个生存感知头（多任务逻辑回归MTLR头）来建模右删失时间事件数据。在公开生存基准和两个大型ICU队列（MIMIC-IV和eICU）上评估，结果表明该迁移学习方法取得有竞争力或更优性能，例如在MIMIC-IV上TabDPT-FT-MTLR的C-index达到0.856，相对优于最强非基础模型基线（DeepSurv, 0.844）1.4%。
Motivation: 传统生存分析方法需要任务特定训练和足够的标注数据。表格基础模型学习通用表格式表示，但它们在临床删失时间事件预测中的适用性尚未充分探索，因为典型应用限于离散分类而非生存分析。
Method: 提出轻量级适应方法：在预训练的表格基础模型（如TabPFN, TabDPT, TabICL）之上直接训练一个多任务逻辑回归（MTLR）头，用于右删失时间事件预测。模型在原有预训练表示上通过生存感知的目标进行微调。
Result: 在公开生存基准和MIMIC-IV、eICU两个大型ICU队列上，该方法获得有竞争力或更优性能。具体地，MIMIC-IV上TabDPT-FT-MTLR的C-index为0.856，比DeepSurv（0.844）提高1.4%，比最佳零样本模型（0.802）提高6.7%。eICU上TabICL-FT-MTLR达到0.797，比DeepSurv（0.784）提高1.7%，比零样本提高6.4%。
Conclusion: 结果强调将预训练表格表示与生存感知目标结合的重要性，表明表格基础模型为临床生存预测提供了一种实用且有效的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出轻量级适应方法：在预训练的表格基础模型（如TabPFN, TabDPT, TabICL）之上直接训练一个多任务逻辑回归（MTLR）头，用于右删失时间事件预测。模型在原有预训练表示上通过生存感知的目标进行微调。
summary_sections.result: 在公开生存基准和MIMIC-IV、eICU两个大型ICU队列上，该方法获得有竞争力或更优性能。具体地，MIMIC-IV上TabDPT-FT-MTLR的C-index为0.856，比DeepSurv（0.844）提高1.4%，比最佳零样本模型（0.802）提高6.7%。eICU上TabICL-FT-MTLR达到0.797，比DeepSurv（0.784）提高1.7%，比零样本提高6.4%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果强调将预训练表格表示与生存感知目标结合的重要性，表明表格基础模型为临床生存预测提供了一种实用且有效的替代方案。

papers.title: Bootstrapped Monitoring: Leveraging Transparent Reasoning to Oversee Stronger AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Trusted monitoring is a cornerstone of AI control. However, as frontier models grow more capable, the increasing capabilities gap between trusted and untrusted models may render trusted models unreliable monitors. We introduce \emph{bootstrapped monitoring}, a protocol that addresses this by inserting a stronger, intermediate untrusted model with transparent chain-of-thought reasoning into the oversight chain. The untrusted monitor ($U_m$) evaluates the agent's actions, while a weaker trusted model ($T$) oversees $U_m$'s reasoning to detect collusion. We evaluate bootstrapped monitoring on multi-turn software engineering tasks (BashArena) across multiple agents and monitors. Bootstrapped monitoring substantially improves catch rates over trusted-only monitoring, even when the untrusted monitor actively colludes with the agent, provided we have access to its raw chain-of-thought. Our results suggest that bootstrapped monitoring can extend the useful lifetime of trusted models in control as AI capabilities advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出引导监控（bootstrapped monitoring）协议，通过在监督链中插入一个更强的、具有透明思维链推理的中间不可信模型（U_m）来评估智能体行为，同时一个较弱的可信模型（T）监督U_m的推理以检测合谋。在BashArena多轮软件工程任务上的评估表明，即使不可信监控器主动与智能体合谋，只要能够访问其原始思维链，引导监控也能显著提升捕获率。
Motivation: 随着前沿模型能力增强，可信模型与不可信模型之间的能力差距可能使可信模型成为不可靠的监控器。
Method: 提出引导监控协议：使用更强的不可信模型（U_m）评估智能体行为并输出透明思维链，较弱的可信模型（T）检测U_m的推理中是否存在合谋。
Result: 在BashArena软件工程任务上，引导监控相比仅可信监控显著提高捕获率，即使U_m主动与智能体合谋，只要访问其原始思维链即可保持有效性。
Conclusion: 引导监控可以在AI能力提升时延长可信模型在控制中的有效使用寿命。

papers.title: Time-Series Foundation Model Embeddings for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction is essential for industrial predictive maintenance, yet many learning-based approaches rely on extensive feature engineering or large labeled datasets to train task-specific sequence models. In this work, we introduce a lightweight learning approach, in which we leverage a frozen pretrained time-series foundation model (TSFM) and combine it with a small regression head for RUL estimation from multivariate sensor streams. More specifically, we use Chronos-2 as a frozen backbone to extract context window features and train a lightweight regression neural network for RUL prediction. Experiments on real-world industrial sensor data from two device types show that Chronos-2 features consistently improve over recurrent, convolutional, Transformer-based, and gradient-boosting baselines under the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol. We further analyze the impact of context length and find that performance improves significantly with longer histories, indicating that TSFM representation offer a practical and data-efficient alternative for RUL estimation in industrial settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级方法，利用冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型 Chronos-2 作为骨干网络，结合小型回归头进行剩余使用寿命预测。实验表明，在多变量传感器数据上，该方法优于循环、卷积、Transformer 和梯度提升基线，且更长的历史窗口显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的 RUL 预测方法通常需要大量特征工程或大规模标注数据来训练任务特定序列模型，成本高昂且泛化性差。
Method: 使用冻结的 Chronos-2 作为特征提取器，从多变量传感器序列中提取上下文窗口特征，再训练一个轻量级回归神经网络进行 RUL 预测。
Result: 在两种工业设备类型的真实传感器数据上，Chronos-2 特征在相同预处理和评估协议下一致优于循环、卷积、Transformer 和梯度提升基线。增加上下文长度显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型的特征表示为工业环境中的 RUL 估计提供了一种实用且数据高效的替代方案，无需大量训练数据或领域特定特征工程。

papers.title: From Nominal Intensity to Equivalent Rainfall: A Path-Based Credibility Evaluation Framework for Simulated Rainfall in Autonomous-Driving Perception Tests
papers.abstract_en: Credible simulated-rainfall conditions are essential for identifying perception-system boundaries and supporting SOTIF-oriented risk assessment in automated driving. However, closed-field tests are often described only by nominal rainfall intensity or single-point measurements, making it difficult to align simulated rain fields with real rainfall and map test results to real-world scenarios. This paper proposes a path-based credibility evaluation method for simulated rainfall in autonomous-driving perception tests. Using the drop size and velocity joint distribution of real rainfall as the reference, each candidate path is represented by path-equivalent rainfall intensity, an uncertainty band, and a path-averaged Realism of Raindrop Distribution (RRD) score. Lidar target point-cloud count and mean reflectivity are further used for perception-consistency correction, quantifying the proxy capability of each simulated-rainfall path for real-rainfall perception effects. Experiments are conducted using about 10,000 real-rainfall raindrop-spectrum samples, 728 RainSense perception samples, and 45 spatial sampling points in a 2.4 m x 7.2 m simulated-rainfall area. Results show that spatial non-uniformity remains under the same nominal condition, confirming the need for path-based evaluation. The method identifies Path IV and Path VI as preferable candidates, with results of 11.54 +/- 0.31 mm/h, RRD = 0.43, and 8.28 +/- 0.34 mm/h, RRD = 0.46, respectively. These paths show more balanced performance in rainfall-intensity stability, raindrop-spectrum realism, and perception consistency. The proposed method supports path selection, condition description, and credible interpretation of autonomous-driving perception tests under rainfall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于路径的模拟降雨可信度评估方法，用于自动驾驶感知测试。以真实降雨的雨滴尺寸-速度联合分布为参考，用路径等效降雨强度、不确定带和路径平均雨滴分布真实性(RRD)评分表示每条候选路径。进一步利用激光雷达点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正。实验使用约10,000个真实降雨雨滴谱样本、728个RainSense感知样本和45个空间采样点。结果表明空间不均匀性即使在相同名义条件下也存在，验证了路径评估的必要性。方法识别出Path IV和Path VI为优选路径。
Motivation: 封闭场测试通常仅用名义降雨强度或单点测量描述，难以将模拟降雨场与实际降雨对齐，并将测试结果映射到真实场景。
Method: 提出基于路径的模拟降雨可信度评估方法，包括：以真实降雨的雨滴尺寸-速度联合分布为参考；用路径等效降雨强度、不确定带和路径平均RRD评分表示候选路径；使用激光雷达点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正。
Result: 实验显示空间不均匀性在相同名义条件下存在。优选路径Path IV和Path VI的结果分别为11.54±0.31 mm/h、RRD=0.43和8.28±0.34 mm/h、RRD=0.46。
Conclusion: 该方法支持自动驾驶降雨感知测试中的路径选择、条件描述和可信解释。

papers.title: What Uncertainties Do We Need for Dynamical Systems?
papers.abstract_en: The distinction between aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty has received considerable attention in machine learning research, mainly in the context of supervised learning but also in other settings such as generative modeling. In this paper, we offer a machine learning perspective on uncertainty modeling for dynamical systems, which has been studied much less so far. In particular, we ask: what uncertainties do we need for dynamical systems? We discuss sources of uncertainty, clarify their nature (aleatoric or epistemic), and consider how the objectives of representing and quantifying uncertainty vary across different tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机器学习角度讨论动力系统中的不确定性建模，区分 aleatoric 和 epistemic 不确定性，并分析不同任务下量化不确定性的目标差异。
Motivation: 动力系统中的不确定性建模在机器学习中研究较少，现有工作主要关注监督学习和生成模型，缺乏对该领域的系统性讨论。
Method: 通过理论分析梳理动力系统中不确定性的来源、性质（aleatoric/epistemic）及不同任务下的表示与量化需求。
Result: 论文主要提供概念框架和分类，未报告具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 强调动力系统中不确定性建模的重要性，并为未来研究提供分类和指导。

papers.title: PAWS: Preference Learning with Advantage-Weighted Segments
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) learns policies from human trajectory-level comparisons, avoiding explicit reward design and expert demonstrations. Existing methods typically train utility functions on trajectory or segment-level preferences while relying on per-step utility estimates during policy optimization. This training and inference mismatch induces a distribution shift that severely degrades temporal credit assignment and limits policy learning. We analyze this issue and propose PAWS, a segment-based preference learning method that performs policy updates directly using segment-level advantage functions. By aligning utility training with policy optimization, PAWS preserves trajectory-level preference information and avoids unreliable per-step learning signals. Experiments on simulated robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks demonstrate that PAWS consistently outperforms existing PbRL approaches, highlighting the importance of distribution-consistent preference learning.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）中训练与推理不一致导致的分布偏移问题，提出PAWS方法。PAWS在策略优化阶段直接使用片段级优势函数，避免逐步学习信号的不准确性。实验表明，PAWS在模拟机器人操作和移动任务上优于现有PbRL方法。
Motivation: 现有PbRL方法在训练时使用片段或轨迹级偏好，但在策略优化时依赖逐步效用估计，这种不匹配导致分布偏移，严重降低时序信用分配并限制策略学习。
Method: 提出PAWS方法，在策略更新时直接使用片段级优势函数（segment-level advantage functions），使得效用训练与策略优化保持分布一致，从而保留轨迹级偏好信息。
Result: 在模拟机器人操作和移动任务上，PAWS持续优于现有基于偏好的强化学习方法。
Conclusion: 分布一致的偏好学习（distribution-consistent preference learning）对于提高PbRL性能至关重要。

papers.title: ParseFixer: An Agentic Framework for Document Parsing via Selective Multimodal Correction
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we present our third-place solution for the DataMFM Challenge Track 1: Document Parsing. This track requires models to recover structured Markdown documents from document page images while preserving textual content and document structure. To address the complementary requirements of accurate content recovery and faithful structure reconstruction, we propose ParseFixer, an agentic framework for backbone parsing and selective correction. ParseFixer consists of two key modules: Full-Page Backbone Parsing (FBP) and Agentic Selective Correction (ASC). FBP produces stable initial Markdown outputs with MinerU2.5 Pro, while ASC detects high-value parsing failures and repairs them through a verify-and-rollback correction process. By placing selective multimodal correction after open-source backbone parsing, ParseFixer improves the recovery of key document elements without rewriting reliable backbone predictions. On the test set, our final system achieves an overall score of 61.78 and ranks third in Track 1, demonstrating its effectiveness for accurate document parsing. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/CVPRW26-ParseFixer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ParseFixer，一种用于文档解析的代理框架，在DataMFM Challenge Track 1中获得第三名。该方法由全页骨干解析（FBP）和代理选择性校正（ASC）两个模块组成，先使用MinerU2.5 Pro生成初始Markdown输出，然后通过验证-回滚校正过程修复高价值解析错误。在测试集上取得了61.78的总分，证明了其有效性。
Motivation: 文档解析需要同时准确恢复文本内容和忠实重建文档结构，现有方法难以兼顾这两方面需求。
Method: ParseFixer框架包含全页骨干解析（FBP）和代理选择性校正（ASC）两个模块：FBP使用MinerU2.5 Pro产生稳定的初始Markdown输出；ASC检测高价值解析失败并通过验证-回滚过程进行选择性多模态校正。
Result: 在DataMFM Challenge Track 1测试集上，系统总体得分为61.78，排名第三。
Conclusion: 通过在开源骨干解析后放置选择性多模态校正，ParseFixer在保留可靠骨干预测的同时改进了关键文档元素的恢复。

papers.title: Exploration Structure in LLM Agents for Multi-File Change Localization
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering tools increasingly rely on LLM based agents to localize files to change to resolve a software issue. Most AI agents explore repositories linearly, that is, visiting one directory or file per step. We postulate that this is a structural mismatch for changes that span several subsystems. We compare linear sequential exploration against non-linear, domain-scoped parallel agentic exploration. Using SWE Bench Pro as initial benchmark, we focus on ansible as an exemplar. We construct an approach for persistent-session evaluation of GitHub issues anchored at a single base commit. We compare our non-linear domain-agent file traversal system against a base LLM without direct repository access, a single agent Recursive Language Model (RLM) baseline with a persistent Python REPL and an external CLI baseline using Codex 5.5 High. Domain scoped parallel agent spawning with a small Haiku-class model achieves the highest micro F1 among Haiku class models by a large margin. Domain-agents is the second highest behind only the much larger Codex 5.5 High on our own expanded benchmark including over more recent PRs from 2025 and 2026. On the original, curated, 2020 SWE-bench Pro benchmark, a larger Sonnet plain LLM baseline attains higher micro F1 by predicting few files, leading to higher precision, but at significantly lower all gold recall. We also present three additional findings. First, documentation evolution is a latent dependency unresolved by any approach. Second, naive file system access can degrade localization driven by test-file over prediction. Lastly, forced multi-agent consultation does not measurably help and raises token cost substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究软件工程中基于LLM的智能体如何进行多文件变更定位，提出非线性、领域范围并行探索策略，并与线性顺序探索及多种基线比较。实验表明，小规模Haiku类模型的领域并行智能体在微F1上大幅领先同类模型，仅次于大型Codex 5.5 High；而更大的Sonnet模型在原始SWE-bench Pro基准上因预测文件少而获得更高精度，但全召回率较低。额外发现包括文档演变依赖、朴素文件系统访问导致的测试文件过度预测，以及强制多智能体协作无益且增加令牌成本。
Motivation: 现有AI智能体通常线性探索代码仓库（每次一个目录或文件），这对于跨多个子系统的变更存在结构性不匹配，需要更有效的非线性并行探索方法。
Method: 构建基于持久会话评估的GitHub问题定位系统，比较线性顺序探索与非线性、领域范围并行智能体探索，在SWE Bench Pro基准上以ansible为示例，并使用多种基线（无直接仓库访问的LLM、单个递归语言模型RLM、基于Codex 5.5 High的外部CLI等）。
Result: 小规模Haiku类模型的领域并行智能体在微F1上大幅领先同类；整体上仅次于Codex 5.5 High；原始的SWE-bench Pro基准上，更大的Sonnet模型因预测文件少而精度更高但全召回率低；文档演变是未解决的潜在依赖；朴素文件系统访问导致测试文件过度预测；强制多智能体协作无益且增加令牌成本。
Conclusion: 非线性领域范围并行探索是有效的多文件变更定位策略，但现有方法均未解决文档演变依赖，且多智能体协作需谨慎使用。

papers.title: SpecLoR: Spectral Lookahead Rectification for Motion-Coherent Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching has enabled robust text-to-video generation via latent ODE sampling. However, velocity approximation and numerical discretization errors inevitably accumulate, causing sampling trajectories to drift. Consequently, generated videos often suffer from severe spatiotemporal inconsistencies. Nevertheless, directly correcting these drifted, noisy latents is challenging: (i) timestep-dependent noise obscures reliable structural cues; (ii) spatial interventions risk disrupting intricate local geometry while incurring heavy computational costs. To address this, we propose Spectral Lookahead Rectification (SpecLoR), a plug-and-play inference method that bypasses noise via lookahead prediction, and circumvents spatiotemporal entanglement by shifting corrections to the frequency domain, where universal statistical priors of natural videos are readily available. First, during early sampling stages, SpecLoR looks ahead to estimate the clean latent $z_{t,0}$ and computes its 3D spatiotemporal spectrum. Next, SpecLoR rectifies the amplitude spectrum to match the prior, leaving the phase intact. Finally, the corrected state is re-noised to resume ODE integration. Experiments on Wan2.2 demonstrate that SpecLoR significantly reduces physical artifacts and enhances motion coherence across multiple benchmarks with minimal computational overhead (4 additional NFEs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecLoR（Spectral Lookahead Rectification），一种用于文本到视频生成的即插即用推理方法。该方法通过前瞻预测估计干净潜变量，并在频域中校正幅度谱以匹配自然视频统计先验，从而减少流匹配采样轨迹的漂移。实验表明，在 Wan2.2 模型上 SpecLoR 显著减少物理伪影并增强运动连贯性，仅增加 4 次 NFEs 计算开销。
Motivation: 流匹配中的速度逼近和数值离散误差导致采样轨迹漂移，生成视频出现严重时空不一致。直接纠正带噪潜变量困难：噪声掩盖结构信息，空间干预破坏局部几何且计算成本高。
Method: SpecLoR 在早期采样阶段前瞻估计干净潜变量 z_{t,0}，计算其 3D 时空频谱；仅修正幅度谱以匹配自然视频的通用统计先验，保留相位；然后将修正状态重新加噪以继续 ODE 积分。
Result: 在 Wan2.2 模型上，SpecLoR 显著减少物理伪影并提升运动连贯性，多个基准测试中仅增加 4 次 NFEs 计算开销。
Conclusion: 通过频域校正和前瞻预测，SpecLoR 有效缓解流匹配采样漂移问题，且计算开销小，可作为即插即用模块用于现有文本到视频生成模型。

papers.title: Efficient Multinomial Logistic Bandit via Frequent Directions
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies efficient online algorithms for multinomial logistic bandits (MLogB), where the feedback distribution over $K+1$ outcomes follows a multinomial logistic model of $d$-dimensional action vectors. A representative UCB-type algorithm, OFUL-MLogB, achieves a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(Kd\sqrt{T})$, but still requires $\mathcal{O}(K^3d^3)$ time and $\mathcal{O}(K^2d^2)$ space per round due to parameter estimation and optimistic reward construction, which is prohibitive in high-dimensional settings. To address this limitation, we propose EOFD-MLogB, which integrates frequent directions matrix sketching into OFUL-MLogB. By maintaining a low-rank SVD sketch of the accumulated Hessian, constrained online Newton updates in parameter estimation and $Kd \times K$ spectral-norm computations in the reward bonus are reduced to one-dimensional root-finding tasks and $K \times K$ eigenvalue computations, respectively. This yields dominant per-round time complexity $\mathcal{O}(Kd(m+K)^2)$ and space complexity $\mathcal{O}(Kd(m+K))$, where $m \ll d$ is the sketch size. We further prove a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(Δ_T(Kd\lnΔ_T+m)\sqrt{T})$, where the sketching error factor $Δ_T$ is controlled by the $m$-truncated spectral tail of the Hessian. Thus, when the Hessian is approximately low-rank, the regret is close to that of OFUL-MLogB. Experiments validate the computational efficiency and competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多分类逻辑斯蒂老虎机（MLogB）提出高效在线算法EOFD-MLogB，通过引入频繁方向（Frequent Directions）矩阵降维技术，将每轮时间和空间复杂度从O(K^3d^3)和O(K^2d^2)降低到O(Kd(m+K)^2)和O(Kd(m+K))，m为降维尺寸。理论证明在Hessian近似低秩时，遗憾界接近最优算法OFUL-MLogB的O~(Kd√T)。实验验证了计算效率和竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有UCB型算法OFUL-MLogB每轮需要O(K^3d^3)时间和O(K^2d^2)空间，在高维场景下不可行，因此需要有效方法降低计算和存储开销。
Method: 提出EOFD-MLogB，将频繁方向矩阵降维（Frequent Directions）集成到OFUL-MLogB中，通过维护累积Hessian的低秩SVD降维，将参数估计中的约束在线牛顿更新和奖励置信度的Kd×K谱范数计算分别简化为单变量求根和K×K特征值计算。
Result: 主导每轮时间复杂度O(Kd(m+K)^2)，空间复杂度O(Kd(m+K))，m<<d。遗憾界为O~(Δ_T(Kd lnΔ_T+m)√T)，其中Δ_T由Hessian的m截断谱尾控制。当Hessian近似低秩时，遗憾接近OFUL-MLogB。
Conclusion: 本文通过矩阵降维显著降低多分类逻辑斯蒂老虎机的计算和存储开销，同时保持接近最优的遗憾界。

papers.title: Feature extraction for plant growth estimation
papers.abstract_en: Precision agriculture requires the estimation of plant growth stages in real-time. When the plant growth stage is known, the wastage of resources in cultivation, such as nutrients and water, is reduced as only the required resources need to be supplied. Plants at different growth stages, however, have similar morphological features, which can make autonomous growth stage estimation difficult. This paper presents two feature extraction methods for growth stage estimation: one that uses a bank of Gabor filters and morphological operations, and the other that uses pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning. We test these methods on a publicly available plant growth stage dataset (``bccr-segset``) for two species, canola and radish, grown and captured under indoor conditions. The two proposed feature extraction methods are compared, using support vector machines and boosted trees as classifiers. We find that both methods are suitable for real-time applications, and that CNN features outperform the hand-crafted features, both with regard to speed and accuracy. The best system (VGG-19 features, classified with a radial basis function support vector machine) obtained an accuracy of 98.4% for both species, processing an image in 0.08 seconds.
papers.journal_ref: Artificial Intelligence Research. SACAIR 2025. Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol 2784. Springer, Cham (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种特征提取方法用于植物生长阶段估计：基于Gabor滤波器和形态学操作的手工特征，以及基于预训练CNN（如VGG-19）的迁移学习特征。在公开数据集bccr-segset上对油菜和萝卜两种植物进行测试，使用SVM和提升树作为分类器。结果表明CNN特征在速度和准确率上均优于手工特征，最佳系统（VGG-19特征+RBF-SVM）对两种植物的分类准确率达98.4%，每张图像处理时间0.08秒，适用于实时应用。
Motivation: 精准农业需要实时估计植物生长阶段以减少资源浪费，但不同生长阶段的植物形态相似，自主估计困难。
Method: 提出两种特征提取方法：1）基于Gabor滤波器组和形态学操作的手工特征；2）基于预训练CNN（如VGG-19）的迁移学习特征。使用SVM和提升树作为分类器进行对比。
Result: 最佳系统（VGG-19特征+RBF-SVM）对油菜和萝卜的分类准确率达98.4%，每张图像处理时间0.08秒，且CNN特征在速度和准确率上均优于手工特征。
Conclusion: 两种方法均适用于实时应用，CNN特征更优；未来可扩展到室外场景和其他植物种类。

papers.title: HAMNO: A Hierarchical Adaptive Multi-scale Neural Operator with Physics-Informed Learning for Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide a powerful framework for learning solution mappings of partial differential equations directly in function space. However, many existing architectures still struggle to represent nonlinear time-dependent systems that involve multi-scale structures, long-range interactions, and stable long-time evolution. In this work, we introduce the Hierarchical Adaptive Multi-scale Neural Operator (HAMNO), a neural-operator architecture that combines local convolutional representations, global spectral operators, and hierarchical encoder-decoder processing. The central component of HAMNO is a data-dependent gating mechanism that adaptively balances local and global information at each spatial location, allowing the model to resolve fine-scale features while preserving long-range dependencies. We further develop a physics-informed extension, PI-HAMNO, based on a multi-objective loss strategy that combines data fitting with strong- and weak-form physics constraints. The strong-form term penalizes the domain-integrated squared PDE residual in physical coordinates, while the weak-form term is constructed by multiplying the governing residual by finite-element test functions and evaluating the resulting element integrals using centroid-based tetrahedral quadrature. The framework is evaluated on non-periodic Allen-Cahn (AC), Cahn-Hilliard (CH), and Swift-Hohenberg (SH) equations defined on cubic domains. Across long-horizon rollout, data-limited training, out-of-distribution initial-condition shifts, and random-seed variations, HAMNO improves predictive accuracy over standard neural-operator baselines, while PI-HAMNO further enhances stability, physical consistency, and data efficiency. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/MBamdad/HAMNO .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次自适应多尺度神经算子（HAMNO），结合局部卷积、全局谱算子和层次编码器-解码器结构，通过数据依赖的门控机制平衡局部与全局信息。进一步提出物理信息扩展PI-HAMNO，采用多目标损失（数据拟合、强形式PDE残差、弱形式有限元约束）。在非周期Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard和Swift-Hohenberg方程上评估，相比标准神经算子基线提升了长程预测精度、数据效率和物理一致性。
Motivation: 现有神经算子在表示具有多尺度结构、长程相互作用和稳定长时间演化的非线性时变系统时仍存在困难。
Method: 提出HAMNO架构，核心是数据依赖的门控机制，自适应地混合局部卷积和全局谱算子；PI-HAMNO进一步引入强形式和弱形式物理约束，弱形式使用有限元测试函数和质心四面体求积。
Result: 在Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard和Swift-Hohenberg方程的长程 rollout、有限数据训练、分布外初始条件和随机种子变化下，HAMNO优于标准神经算子基线，PI-HAMNO提升了稳定性、物理一致性和数据效率。
Conclusion: 该框架在非周期相场方程的长时间预测中有效，但未涉及降水或天气预报等应用场景。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 提出HAMNO架构，核心是数据依赖的门控机制，自适应地混合局部卷积和全局谱算子；PI-HAMNO进一步引入强形式和弱形式物理约束，弱形式使用有限元测试函数和质心四面体求积。
summary_sections.result: 在Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard和Swift-Hohenberg方程的长程 rollout、有限数据训练、分布外初始条件和随机种子变化下，HAMNO优于标准神经算子基线，PI-HAMNO提升了稳定性、物理一致性和数据效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架在非周期相场方程的长时间预测中有效，但未涉及降水或天气预报等应用场景。

papers.title: Categorical Prior Lock-in: Why In-Context Learning Fails for Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conditional generators for structured data, relying on in-context learning (ICL) to adapt to new distributions without parameter updates. We investigate the limits of ICL for structured generation under distribution mismatch, using high-cardinality tabular data as a controlled test case, and identify a structural failure mode we term \textit{categorical prior lock-in}: the inability of ICL to update the model's prior over token distributions inherited from pre-training. Across two 7B-parameter open-weight models, ICL improves numerical fidelity with additional examples but exhibits a sharp ceiling on categorical distributions, failing to reproduce rare classes entirely. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) overcomes these limitations but introduces measurable memorization risk and, in some cases, destabilizes structured output generation, highlighting a fundamental trade-off between adaptability and privacy.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Empirical study of in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning for synthetic tabular data generation, introducing the phenomenon of categorical prior lock-in. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在结构化数据生成中通过上下文学习（ICL）适应分布时的局限性，发现一种称为“分类先验锁定”的结构性失败模式：ICL无法更新预训练继承的token分布先验。在7B参数模型上的实验显示，ICL随着示例增加改善数值保真度，但在分类分布上达到上限，完全无法生成稀有类别。参数高效微调（LoRA）克服了这些局限，但带来了可衡量的记忆化风险，并在某些情况下破坏结构化输出生成，凸显了适应性与隐私之间的根本权衡。
Motivation: 现有LLM通过ICL适应结构化数据生成，但分布失配时ICL存在局限性，作者希望识别和量化这种失效模式。
Method: 使用高基数表格数据作为受控测试案例，在两个7B开源模型上对比ICL和LoRA微调在结构化数据生成中的表现，分析分类分布和数值保真度。
Result: ICL改善数值保真度但分类分布有天花板，无法生成稀有类别；LoRA克服此问题但引入记忆化风险，且可能破坏输出结构化。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了结构化数据生成中ICL的“分类先验锁定”问题，并指出适应性与隐私之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: We present an online monitoring system for distributional shift in deployed safety classifiers, using calibrated sequential statistics to detect when a classifier has moved out of distribution. Upon detection, a conformal abstention layer adapts decision thresholds to recover a target error rate epsilon=0.1. In a pre-registered factorial evaluation (4 classifiers x 5 shift conditions x 20 seeds x 2 window sizes, 800 cells), the system achieves 86.6% valid detection (693/800, 95% CI [84.1%, 88.8%]) with mean latency of 39.5 steps. Detection holds across three ground-truth regimes: synthetic onset (86.6%), real temporal jailbreaks (85%, 17/20), and GCG adversarial attacks. Weighted conformal prediction recovers up to 39 pp of lost coverage for DeBERTa (ESS=46/300) but collapses for all other classifiers (ESS~300): logistic density ratio estimation achieves perfect source/target separability in high-dimensional embedding spaces, clipping all importance weights to the floor. DeBERTa shows a gradient from effective correction (paraphrase, ESS=46) to near-total collapse (adversarial suffix, ESS=206). PCA to 32 dimensions breaks the collapse, recovering 33 pp for Llama Guard and 21 pp for ShieldGemma. Variance decomposition reveals classifier (eta^2=0.243), shift type (eta^2=0.237), and their interaction (eta^2=0.185) all contribute substantially to detection latency variance (all p<0.001), indicating per-classifier monitoring profiles are necessary.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/junwenleong/safety-classifier-shift-monitor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部署的安全分类器中的分布漂移问题，提出一个在线监测系统，使用校准的序贯统计量检测分类器何时偏离原始分布。检测到漂移后，通过共形放弃层调整决策阈值以恢复目标错误率ε=0.1。在包含4个分类器、5种漂移条件、20个随机种子、2种窗口大小的预注册因子评估（800个单元格）中，系统实现了86.6%的有效检测率（693/800，95% CI [84.1%, 88.8%]），平均延迟39.5步。检测在合成开始、真实时间越狱和GCG对抗攻击三种真值场景下均有效。加权共形预测对DeBERTa可恢复最多39个百分点的覆盖损失，但对其他分类器失效；PCA降维到32维可打破失效，恢复Llama Guard 33个百分点和ShieldGemma 21个百分点。方差分解显示分类器、漂移类型及其交互对检测延迟方差有显著贡献，表明需要针对每个分类器的监测配置文件。
Motivation: 部署的安全分类器可能面临分布漂移，导致性能下降。现有方法缺乏在线、自适应的监测和修正机制。
Method: 提出一个在线监测系统，使用校准的序贯统计量检测漂移，然后通过共形放弃层动态调整决策阈值。评估中使用了多种分类器、漂移条件和随机种子进行大规模因子实验。
Result: 系统在800个实验单元中达到86.6%的有效检测率，平均延迟39.5步。加权共形预测对DeBERTa有效但其他分类器失效，PCA降维可恢复部分性能。
Conclusion: 该监测系统能有效检测多种漂移并自适应恢复目标错误率，但不同分类器和漂移类型的行为差异大，需要个性化监测配置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuro-Relational Programs: Unifying Queries and Neural Computation over Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: The conventional approach to deep learning over relational databases applies neural models, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), to a graph representation of the database. Recent approaches instead operate on databases directly, associating tuples with embeddings and extending query mechanisms to jointly process embeddings and relational content. Inspired by these developments, we introduce Neuro-Relational Programs (NRPs), a declarative query language for relational databases whose facts carry numeric vector embeddings. NRPs extend Datalog-style rules with operations that combine, aggregate, and transform embeddings, thereby interleaving relational reasoning and learnable neural components within a single formalism. This yields a general approach to neural computation over relational data: an NRP can be read both as a query plan with trainable components and as a neural architecture with relational structure built in. Natural syntactic fragments of NRPs recover existing architectures and query formalisms. Zero-ary NRPs correspond to non-adaptive query algorithms; monadic NRPs generalize GNN-style message passing and precisely capture Deep Homomorphism Networks, a connection that we extend to frontier-guarded NRPs over databases with row-ids. We characterize the expressive power of unrestricted NRPs with ReLU-FFN transformations by FOCQ, an extension of first-order logic with counting interpreted over real-weighted structures, yielding a precise connection with uniform TC$^0$ over ordered databases. Together, these results establish NRPs as a broad declarative framework for querying and neural computation over relational data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经关系程序（NRP），一种扩展Datalog样式规则的关系数据库查询语言，其中事实携带数值向量嵌入。NRP通过组合、聚合和变换嵌入的操作交织关系推理和可学习神经组件，使得NRP既可看作带可训练组件的查询计划，也可看作内建关系结构的神经架构。论文展示了NRP的语法片段如何恢复现有架构（如GNN消息传递和深度同态网络），并刻画了其表达能力与FOCQ（带计数的一阶逻辑在实权结构上）和均匀TC^0的关系。
Motivation: 现有深度学习在关系数据库上的方法要么通过GNN处理数据库的图表示，要么直接操作数据库但仅扩展查询机制。本文旨在提供一个统一的声明式框架，将关系查询和可学习的神经网络计算自然结合，避免模态鸿沟。
Method: 引入神经关系程序（NRP），一种声明式查询语言，扩展Datalog规则以包含对嵌入的组合、聚合和变换操作。NRP的语法片段（如零元、一元、前卫NRP）分别对应非自适应查询、GNN消息传递和深度同态网络；无限制NRP使用ReLU-FFN变换，其表达能力通过FOCQ刻画。
Result: 零元NRP对应非自适应查询算法；一元NRP泛化GNN消息传递并精确捕获深度同态网络（扩展至带行ID的数据库上的前卫NRP）。无限制NRP（带ReLU-FFN）的表达能力等价于FOCQ（带计数的一阶逻辑在实权结构上），从而建立与有序数据库上均匀TC^0的精确联系。
Conclusion: NRP建立了一个广泛的声明式框架，用于关系数据的查询和神经计算，统一了现有架构和形式主义，并提供了精确的表达能力刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Scientific progress depends on a repeated loop of exploration, experimentation, and abstraction. Researchers test candidate directions, interpret the evidence, and carry the resulting lessons into later attempts. We study how an AI agent can run this loop autonomously over long horizons. We introduce Arbor, a general framework for autonomous research that combines a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR), a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time. The coordinator manages global research strategy over the tree, while executors implement and test individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees. As results return, Arbor updates the tree, propagates reusable lessons, refines the search frontier, and admits verified improvements. This design turns autonomous research from a sequence of local attempts into a cumulative process in which strategy, execution, and evidence are carried across time. We evaluate Arbor under Autonomous Optimization (AO), an operational setting where an agent improves an initial research artifact through iterative experimentation without step-level human supervision. Across six real research tasks in model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis, Arbor achieves the best held-out result on all six tasks, attaining more than 2.5x the average relative held-out gain of Codex and Claude Code under the same task interface and resource budget. On MLE-Bench Lite, Arbor reaches 86.36% Any Medal with GPT-5.5, the strongest result in our comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Arbor，一个通用自主研究框架，结合长期协调器、短期执行器和假设树细化（HTR），通过持续更新的树结构链接假设、工件、证据和提炼的见解，实现跨时间的累积研究过程。在自主优化（AO）设置下，Arbor在六个真实研究任务（模型训练、工程、数据合成）上均取得最佳留出结果，平均相对留出增益超过Codex和Claude Code的2.5倍，并在MLE-Bench Lite上以GPT-5.5达到86.36%的任意奖牌率。
Motivation: 科学研究需要探索、实验和抽象的循环，但现有AI代理难以在长时间跨度内自主运行这一循环。本文旨在设计一个能够将策略、执行和证据跨越时间传递的自主研究框架。
Method: 提出Arbor框架，包含一个长期协调器管理全局研究策略，多个短期执行器在独立工作树中实现和测试假设，并通过假设树细化（HTR）持久化树结构来链接假设、工件、证据和可重用经验，从而将自主研究从局部尝试转变为累积过程。
Result: 在六个真实研究任务（模型训练、工程、数据合成）上，Arbor在所有任务上均取得最佳留出结果，平均相对留出增益超过Codex和Claude Code的2.5倍；在MLE-Bench Lite上以GPT-5.5达到86.36%的任意奖牌率。
Conclusion: Arbor通过树结构实现跨时间的研究知识累积，使自主研究不再是一系列孤立尝试，而是可传递策略、执行和证据的过程，为通用自主研究提供了可行框架。

papers.title: Corpus Augmentation for Sign Language Translation via LLM-Guided Video Stitching
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation (SLT) converts sign language video into spoken language text and holds significant promise for improving accessibility and enabling communication between signing and non-signing communities. While large weakly-aligned datasets have enabled pre-training at scale and gloss-free methods have reduced reliance on expert annotation, high-quality parallel sign video-text pairs for fine-tuning remain scarce, limiting generalisation on long-tail vocabulary and unseen constructions. We propose a corpus augmentation approach that requires no additional human annotation, external sign-language video corpora, or generative video models, relying only on the existing gloss-annotated training corpus and an LLM for sentence generation: per-gloss clips are extracted from training videos via CTC forced-alignment, novel gloss-sentence pairs are generated by a corpus-anchored LLM, and synthetic sequences are assembled through random sentence sampling and clip assignment. The resulting synthetic RGB video-text pairs are architecture-agnostic at the downstream training stage and can be consumed directly by RGB-based SLT models, or converted into pose or feature representations by pipelines that derive such inputs from video. Sincan et al. re-evaluated five recent gloss-free methods under strictly identical conditions; the largest verified gain over the GFSLT-VLP baseline was only 0.98 BLEU-4. Our augmentation, applied within the same framework, achieves +2.92 BLEU-4 without any change to architecture or training protocol. We further identify that synthetic data harms vision-language pretraining despite improving its objectives, and that optimising clip transitions for visual smoothness is counter-productive under L2-based criteria; we propose that abrupt boundaries may act as a form of implicit regularisation. Code is available at https://github.com/robizso/slt-datagen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需额外人工标注的手语翻译语料增强方法，利用CTC强制对齐从训练视频中提取每个手语（per-gloss）片段，借助LLM生成新的gloss-句子对，通过随机采样句子和分配片段组装合成RGB视频-文本对。该方法不依赖外部手语视频语料或生成式视频模型，可直接用于任何RGB-based手语翻译模型。在严格相同的评测条件下，该方法在GFSLT-VLP基线上实现+2.92 BLEU-4的提升（此前最大提升仅为0.98 BLEU-4）。同时发现合成数据会损害视觉-语言预训练，并且优化片段间视觉平滑性是反效果的，突变的边界可能起到隐式正则化作用。
Motivation: 高质量平行符号视频-文本对（sign video-text pairs）稀缺，限制了手语翻译模型在长尾词汇和未见结构上的泛化能力。现有方法依赖大量弱对齐数据预训练或去除标注依赖，但微调阶段的高质量对齐数据仍严重不足。
Method: 从已有的gloss标注训练语料出发，通过CTC强制对齐将每个gloss对应的视频片段提取出来；利用一个锚定于语料库的LLM生成新的gloss-句子对；然后通过随机采样句子并分配对应片段来组装合成视频序列，生成RGB视频-文本对。整个过程无需人工标注、外部手语视频库或生成式视频模型。
Result: 在重新评测五个近期无gloss方法且保持严格一致条件的框架下，该方法在不改变架构或训练协议的情况下，将GFSLT-VLP基线的BLEU-4提升2.92（此前最大增幅仅0.98）。进一步实验表明，合成数据用于视觉-语言预训练反而有害，且以L2损失优化片段过渡的视觉平滑性会降低下游性能。
Conclusion: 提出了一种架构无关、即插即用的手语翻译语料增强方法，有效提升了翻译质量，同时揭示了合成数据在预训练中的负面作用以及片段间突变边界可能作为隐式正则化的重要发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lung-SRAD: Spectral-Aware Regularized Audio DASS with Dual-Axis Patch-Mix Contrastive Learning for Respiratory Sound Classification
papers.abstract_en: Recent respiratory sound classification (RSC) studies largely rely on CLS-token driven self-attention architectures such as the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST). While effective at modeling global context, recent analyses suggest a low-pass filtering behavior that may reduce sensitivity to localized abnormal patterns. In this work, we investigate State Space Models (SSMs) as an alternative backbone for RSC. Using the Distilled Audio State Space model, we analyze intermediate representations through spectral response curves and observe stronger preservation of mid-to-high spatial-frequency components. Based on these observations, we introduce spectral-aware layer regularization using Gaussian convolution applied to selected layers. We further propose Dual-Axis Patch-Mix contrastive learning tailored to SSM-based audio models for robust representation learning. Experiments on the ICBHI benchmark show that our approach achieves 64.48% score, outperforming the AST baseline by 5%. Code is available at https://github.com/RSC-Toolkit/Lung-SRAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对呼吸音分类（RSC）任务，探索状态空间模型（SSM）作为音频频谱图变换器（AST）的替代骨干网络。通过频谱响应曲线分析发现SSM更好地保留中高频空间分量，进而提出基于高斯卷积的频谱感知层正则化，以及面向SSM音频模型的双轴补丁混合对比学习。在ICBHI基准上达到64.48%的分数，比AST基线提高5%。
Motivation: 现有的RSC方法多依赖AST，但其低通滤波行为可能削弱对局部异常模式的敏感性，需要能更好保留高频成分的骨干网络。
Method: 使用蒸馏音频状态空间模型作为骨干，引入频谱感知层正则化（对选定层应用高斯卷积）和Dual-Axis Patch-Mix对比学习。
Result: 在ICBHI基准上取得64.48%分数，超越AST基线5%。
Conclusion: SSM结合频谱感知正则化与双轴对比学习可有效提升呼吸音分类性能，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Art of Interrogation: Consistency Amplifies Factuality in Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit remarkable general capabilities but significantly underperform in spatial reasoning tasks. Existing approaches treat this gap as a knowledge deficit, relying on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to ingest labeled spatial data from external vision sources or synthetic engines. In contrast, we argue that for many tasks, spatial reasoning capabilities are already present in pre-trained LRMs but require alignment through logical coherence under geometric 2D and 3D constraints. In this work, we propose a self-supervised reinforcement learning (RL) framework that targets the internal reasoning process without requiring ground-truth annotations. By formalizing the notion of consistency verifiers -- reward functions that check for geometric and semantic consistency under transformations -- we demonstrate that models can improve their spatial reasoning abilities. We use both image transformations, like flipping, and textual transformations, like swapping the order of objects in the question, and propose a new optimal transport-based RL strategy, OT-GRPO, which is a minimal-matching variant of group relative policy optimization tailored to pairwise verifiers. We show that this label-free consistency training approaches the accuracy of models trained with ground-truth supervision and achieves similar generalization across diverse tasks and data domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督强化学习框架，通过一致性验证器（如几何和语义变换下的约束）提升大语言模型在空间推理任务上的事实性，无需标注数据。实验表明，该无标签训练方法在准确性上接近有监督方法，并能泛化到多种任务和数据域。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在空间推理任务上表现不佳，而现有方法将其视为知识缺陷，依赖有监督微调。作者认为模型已具备空间推理能力，但需要通过逻辑一致性来对齐。
Method: 提出自监督强化学习框架，使用一致性验证器作为奖励函数（包括图像翻转、文本对象顺序交换等），并设计基于最优传输的RL策略OT-GRPO（最小匹配变体组相对策略优化）来处理成对验证器。
Result: 无标签一致性训练方法在准确性上接近有监督训练，并在多个任务和数据域上表现出类似的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过几何和语义一致性约束，无需外部标注即可显著改善空间推理的事实性，证明了推理能力已存在于预训练模型中。
Relevance: 15
