papers.title: Characterizing Software Aging in GPU-Based LLM Serving Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an empirical methodology to study software aging in GPU-based LLM serving systems. Traditional aging studies focus on CPU-centric software with relatively regular workloads; LLM serving is different, spanning a Python host and a CUDA device, handling requests whose cost varies by orders of magnitude, and relying on rapidly evolving software stacks. We run a 216-hour campaign across six co-located deployments under identical stress conditions, monitor host, device, and client metrics in parallel, and apply a statistical pipeline that accounts for autocorrelation and multiple testing. Our results reveal statistically significant memory aging in all deployments, with leak rates strongly dependent on the serving runtime and deployment configuration. Beyond these findings, we provide a reproducible framework that opens a research direction at the intersection of the software aging and rejuvenation and LLM serving communities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种经验方法研究GPU-based LLM服务系统的软件老化现象。通过216小时的实验，监测主机、设备和客户端指标，发现所有部署均存在显著的内存老化，泄漏率与运行时和部署配置强相关。提供了一个可复现的框架，促进软件老化与再生同LLM服务领域的交叉研究。
Motivation: 传统软件老化研究聚焦CPU中心系统和相对规则的工作负载，而LLM服务系统具有Python宿主与CUDA设备协作、请求成本差异大、软件栈快速演进等特点，需要专门研究。
Method: 在六个共置部署上运行216小时的一致压力测试，并行监测主机、设备和客户端指标，并采用考虑自相关和多重检验的统计管道进行分析。
Result: 所有部署均表现出统计显著的内存老化，泄漏率严重依赖于服务运行时和部署配置。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了可复现的框架，为软件老化与再生和LLM服务两个社区的交叉研究方向奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quality Adaptive Angular Margin Learning for Respiratory Sound Classification
papers.abstract_en: We present a quality-adaptive angular-margin learning framework that improves feature generalization by enforcing intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. Our framework, titled QLung, introduces a no-reference audio quality margin derived from spectral entropy and root-mean-square energy, which adaptively scales angular margins based on recording quality. To this end, we propose a log-scaled angular margin that stabilizes training under severe class imbalance. We also use an angular classifier that normalizes features and class weights, ensuring margin penalties are applied consistently on the unit hypersphere. Our approach improves in-distribution performance on the ICBHI dataset by 2.46\% over the cross-entropy baseline, and most significantly, achieves the strongest out-of-distribution performance on the SPRSound dataset compared to prior state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/RSC-Toolkit/QLung.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QLung框架，通过质量自适应的角度边距学习（angular margin learning）改善呼吸音分类的特征泛化。该方法引入基于谱熵和均方根能量的无参考音频质量边距，动态缩放角度边距，并采用对数缩放角度边距应对类别不平衡。在ICBHI数据集上，相比交叉熵基线提升2.46%；在SPRSound数据集上达到最强的分布外（out-of-distribution）性能。
Motivation: 现有呼吸音分类方法在录音质量差异大时泛化能力不足，且存在类别不平衡问题。
Method: 提出质量自适应角度边距学习框架QLung，包括：从谱熵和均方根能量导出无参考音频质量边距以自适应缩放角度边距；对数缩放角度边距稳定类别不平衡训练；使用归一化特征和类权重的角度分类器，在单位超球面上施加一致性边距惩罚。
Result: 在ICBHI数据集上，相比交叉熵基线分类准确率提升2.46%；在SPRSound数据集上，分布外性能超越先前所有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文的质量自适应角度边距方法有效提升了呼吸音分类的分布内和分布外性能，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NARRAS: Edge-Triggered Distributed Inference for CSI-Based Localization in Vehicular IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: CSI-based localization with spatially distributed antenna arrays exposes a basic resource trade-off. Each array can provide a rich view of the channel, but forwarding observations from all arrays to a fusion center is wasteful when only a few carry useful information, and the shared uplink supports only a limited number of simultaneous transmissions. We let each array decide locally whether its current observation is worth reporting, subject to a budget on the average number of active transmitters. We refer to this abstraction as Edge-Triggered Distributed Inference (ETDI). It captures a broader class of task-oriented communication problems where resource-constrained devices share an access channel for a common inference task. We instantiate ETDI for CSI-based localization, a common scenario in vehicular IoT networks. Spatially distributed remote antenna arrays (RAAs) encode local channel state information (CSI) from user equipment (UE) transmissions into latent features, and the fusion center estimates the UE position from the subset of reported features. We propose NARRAS, a decentralized reporting policy in which each RAA combines a recurrent summary of its recent observations with a memory of the last latent it transmitted. Training controls an explicit activity budget through differentiable activity penalties and validation-calibrated deterministic thresholds, and uses channel-chart regularization to shape the latent geometry. Experiments show that, at comparable uplink activity, NARRAS improves localization accuracy over learned and heuristic sparse-reporting strategies, while dense full-report models remain useful budget-free references. In low-activity regimes, chart regularization further reduces high-percentile localization errors, suggesting that geometry-aware latent representations are more robust under sparse reporting.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Under review at the IEEE Internet of Things Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于CSI的分布式定位框架NARRAS，通过边缘触发分布式推理（ETDI）在车联网中实现稀疏报告下的高精度定位。每个远程天线阵列（RAA）根据本地观测和历史信息自主决定是否上传潜特征，融合中心利用接收的子集估计用户位置。实验表明，在相同上行活动预算下，NARRAS优于学习和启发式稀疏报告策略，且通道图正则化在低活动场景下进一步降低高百分位定位误差。
Motivation: 现有基于CSI的定位系统将所有天线阵列观测数据集中融合，但上行链路带宽有限，且多数观测信息冗余。需要一种资源高效的分布式推理方法，在保证定位精度的前提下减少不必要的传输。
Method: 提出NARRAS：每个RAA结合当前观测的循环摘要和上次发送的潜伏记忆，通过可微活动惩罚和验证校准的确定性阈值控制报告率，并引入通道图正则化塑造潜伏空间几何结构，实现边缘触发的分布式推断。
Result: 在同等上行活动水平下，NARRAS的定位精度优于学习的和启发式的稀疏报告策略；密集全报告模型虽作为无预算参考但成本高。低活动条件下，通道图正则化进一步降低高百分位定位误差。
Conclusion: NARRAS展示了任务导向通信中，通过边缘触发决策和几何感知正则化，可在稀疏报告下实现高精度定位，为车联网等资源受限场景提供有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Content to Knowledge: Lightning Fast Long-Video Understanding with Neural Knowledge Representations
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new paradigm for long video understanding by treating a long video as a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR). NKR represents video contents neither as a stream of tokens nor pre-organized databases, but as an individual small portion of network weights attached to the VLM backbone. The NKR weights are optimized to encapsulate the video's semantic content via a novel Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) process, where an agent automatically synthesizes dense descriptions and question-answer pairs to distill the video's knowledge into the NKR. While AKD serves as a comprehensive, one-time encoding phase, the resulting NKR transforms the video into a portable, reusable asset. At inference, the lightweight NKR is mounted onto a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling direct, query-based understanding without reloading or re-encoding the original video. This approach decouples video length from inference cost, offering high amortized efficiency for multi-turn video understanding. Experiments on the LVBench benchmark show our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches while reducing end-to-end latency by over two orders of magnitude, opening new possibilities for interactive long-video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将长视频编码为神经知识表示 (NKR)，通过智能体知识蒸馏 (AKD) 自动合成描述和问答对，将视频语义蒸馏到少量网络权重中。推理时将NKR挂载到冻结的视觉语言模型上，实现直接查询理解，而无需重新加载或编码原视频。在LVBench基准上，该方法性能与现有方法相当，但端到端延迟降低两个数量级。
Motivation: 现有长视频理解方法要么将视频编码为token流（成本高），要么依赖预组织数据库（不灵活），导致视频长度与推理成本耦合。本文旨在解耦二者，实现高效的多轮查询理解。
Method: 提出神经知识表示 (NKR) 范式：将视频内容压缩为附加到VLM骨干网络的小权重块，通过智能体知识蒸馏 (AKD) 过程，由智能体自动生成稠密描述和问答对，优化NKR权重以捕获视频语义。
Result: 在LVBench上，方法达到与当前最优方法相当的性能，同时端到端延迟降低两个数量级。
Conclusion: 该方法将视频长度与推理成本解耦，为交互式长视频理解提供了高摊销效率的新途径。未来可探索NKR的跨场景泛化。

papers.title: From Persistence to Survival: Hypothesis Testing, Effect Sizes and Vectorisation for Topological Features
papers.abstract_en: Persistence diagrams are common representations in topological data analysis, but they do not naturally live in a vector space, and the statistical tools developed for comparing them have largely evolved separately from those used for downstream prediction. We introduce STRAND (Survival Topological Representation ANalysis of Diagrams), which treats (collections of) PDs as survival data: each topological feature with persistence value $p = d - b$ is a fully observed time-to-event, and the persistence survival function $S(t) = \mathbb{P}(p > t)$ is the central object for comparing diagrams. From this single representation we derive (i) a non-parametric two-sample test with calibrated Type I error and high power from a small number of diagrams; (ii) interpretable effect sizes; and (iii) a 1-Wasserstein-stable feature vector for downstream machine learning. We validate calibration and power on synthetic manifolds with controlled topology, demonstrate competitive vectorisation across 14 graph and 3D point cloud benchmarks, and apply the method to study functional brain connectivity in fMRI/neuroscience data. To our knowledge, STRAND is the first method to provide hypothesis testing and vectorisation for persistence diagrams from a single coherent and interpretable representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STRAND方法，将拓扑数据分析中的持久性图（PDs）视为生存数据，通过持久生存函数统一了假设检验、效应量计算和向量化表示。在合成流形、14个图基准和3D点云基准上验证了统计效能和向量化竞争力，并在fMRI脑连接数据上展示了应用。
Motivation: 持久性图缺乏自然向量空间结构，现有统计比较方法与下游预测工具相互独立，缺乏统一可解释的表示。
Method: 将每个拓扑特征的持久性值视为完全观测的生存时间，定义持久生存函数，并从中导出非参数双样本检验（已校准I类错误）、可解释的效应量以及1-Wasserstein稳定的特征向量。
Result: 在合成数据上检验具有高功效和校准的I类错误；在14个图和3D点云分类基准上取得竞争性向量化性能；在fMRI数据上成功应用于功能性脑连接分析。
Conclusion: STRAND是首个从单一连贯可解释表示中同时提供持久性图假设检验和向量化的方法。

papers.title: Embodied-BenchClaw: An Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Embodied Spatial Intelligence Benchmark Construction
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating embodied spatial intelligence, yet their construction is labor-intensive, hard to reuse, and difficult to maintain. Existing embodied benchmarks are often static and may quickly become saturated as models improve, limiting their ability to distinguish new capabilities. We propose Embodied-BenchClaw, an autonomous agentic system for constructing embodied spatial intelligence benchmarks. Given a user-specified evaluation intent, Embodied-BenchClaw automatically produces a complete and continually updatable benchmark package through a five-stage pipeline: intent blueprinting, data collection, structuring and cleaning, benchmark synthesis, and evaluation reporting. The pipeline is coordinated by three agents for planning, construction, and evaluation. To improve reusability and reliability, Embodied-BenchClaw introduces an extensible Skill Library and process quality control, enabling benchmark construction to be composable, verifiable, and repairable. We instantiate multiple benchmarks covering indoor spatial reasoning, outdoor spatial reasoning, robotic manipulation, quadruped robot navigation, UAV/aerial-view understanding, and static benchmark enhancement. These benchmarks span diverse embodied carriers, data sources, and spatial capabilities. Experiments with human evaluation, judge-based assessment, consistency checks, cost analysis, and ablations show that Embodied-BenchClaw can construct verifiable, executable, maintainable, and diagnostically useful embodied spatial benchmarks with reduced manual effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Embodied-BenchClaw，一个用于自动构建具身空间智能基准测试的自主多智能体系统。该系统通过意图蓝图、数据收集、结构化与清洗、基准合成和评估报告五个阶段，由三个智能体协调，生成可维护、可验证的基准包。在室内外空间推理、机器人操作、四足导航、无人机航拍理解等任务上实例化多个基准，实验表明该方法减少了人工工作量，构建的基准具有可诊断性。
Motivation: 现有具身空间智能基准构建劳动密集、难以复用和维护，且静态基准易饱和，无法区分新能力。
Method: 提出 Embodied-BenchClaw，一个由规划、构建和评估三个智能体协调的五阶段管道，包括意图蓝图、数据收集、结构化与清洗、基准合成和评估报告，并引入可扩展技能库和过程质量控制。
Result: 在多个基准上验证，涵盖室内外空间推理、机器人操作、四足导航、无人机航拍理解等，实验表明能构建可验证、可执行、可维护且具有诊断价值的基准，减少人工投入。
Conclusion: Embodied-BenchClaw 能够自动生成持续可更新的基准包，提高可复用性和可靠性，但文中未讨论扩展到其他领域或真实世界部署的局限性。

papers.title: DuoBench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Bimanual Manipulation in Simulation and the Real World
papers.abstract_en: Bimanual robot systems substantially expand manipulation capabilities, but coordinating two arms introduces additional control complexity and failure modes that are not well captured by existing benchmarks. We introduce DuoBench, an extensible benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform. DuoBench comprises eleven tasks spanning four coordination categories, implemented in simulation and partially reproduced in the real world through reproducible task recipes with 3D-printable assets. In addition, we propose a stage-based evaluation scheme that supports fine-grained semantic failure analysis beyond binary success and provide human-teleoperated datasets for all benchmark tasks. We benchmark several dual-arm imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies in simulation and on real hardware. Our results show that current policies remain challenged by bimanual manipulation, particularly in early interaction stages, parallel arm execution, and transfer between simulation and real-world settings. DuoBench provides a reproducible testbed for diagnosing these failure modes and studying future methods for dual-arm policy learning. Code, datasets, and videos are available at https://duobench.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoBench 是一个针对双机械臂操作策略的基准框架，基于 FR3 Duo 平台，包含 11 个任务覆盖四种协调类型，支持模拟和真实世界的复现。论文提出阶段式评估方案以进行细粒度故障分析，并提供了人类遥操作数据集。在模拟和真实硬件上测试了多种双臂模仿学习和视觉-语言-动作策略，结果表明当前策略在双臂操作中仍面临挑战，尤其在早期交互阶段、并行执行以及模拟到真实的迁移方面。
Motivation: 现有基准未能充分捕获双臂操作中的控制复杂性和故障模式，需要可复现的评估框架来系统诊断这些失败。
Method: 构建 DuoBench 框架，包含 11 个任务（4 种协调类别），模拟和真实世界复现使用 3D 打印资源；提出阶段式评估方案进行细粒度语义故障分析；提供人类遥操作数据集；在模拟和真实硬件上评估多种双臂策略。
Result: 摘要报告当前策略在双臂操作中仍表现不佳，尤其在早期交互阶段、双臂并行执行以及模拟到真实迁移方面。
Conclusion: DuoBench 为双臂策略学习提供了可复现的测试平台，用于诊断现有方法的失败模式并推动未来研究。

papers.title: Beyond representational alignment with brain-guided language models for robust reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The correspondence between large language models (LLMs) and the neural mechanisms underlying human higher-order cognition remains insufficiently characterized. Given that language and reasoning in the human brain appear dissociable, an open question is whether LLMs align with neural signals from reasoning-related regions and whether such signals can improve them. Here, focusing on deductive reasoning, we show that LLM internal representations are not only partially aligned with task-fMRI activity but can also be directly enhanced by these signals. Using a neural-predictivity metric, we find that LLMs explain a substantial fraction of the explainable variance in reasoning-related regions at the aggregate level, whereas predictivity within specific reasoning types is lower, indicating both alignment and divergence. Building on this, we propose a brain-guided framework: we steer model representations along directions induced by the joint structure of model and brain representations, applying intervention at inference and fine-tuning during training. We demonstrate that task-evoked brain signals can directly enhance LLM reasoning, yielding gains orthogonal to language-only supervision across 10 LLMs (1.5B-72B), with transfer across reasoning types and up to 13\% absolute accuracy gain. Our results advance LLM-brain correspondences from correlation to guidance, establishing a brain-signal-driven pathway toward more robust and cognitively aligned AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）与人类推理脑信号的对齐关系，并利用脑信号增强LLM的推理能力。通过fMRI实验发现，LLM表征与推理相关脑区部分对齐，但存在差异。作者提出脑引导框架，利用脑信号干预模型表征，在10个LLM（1.5B-72B）上获得最高13%的准确率提升，实现从相关分析到引导的跨越。
Motivation: 人类语言与推理在脑中可分离，LLM与推理相关脑信号是否对齐以及能否利用这些信号改进LLM推理能力尚不明确。
Method: 提出脑引导框架：利用任务态fMRI数据，基于模型与脑表征的联合结构引导模型表征方向，在推理时进行干预，在训练时进行微调。
Result: 在10个LLM上（1.5B-72B）进行实验，脑信号增强使推理准确率最高提升13%，且在不同推理类型间可迁移。
Conclusion: 从相关性到引导的突破，证明了脑信号可直接增强LLM推理，为更鲁棒和认知对齐的AI提供了新路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning for humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation within a single policy. A natural design choice is whether to use a single (unified) critic that estimates the combined value of all objectives, or separate (dual) critics with disjoint reward signals. We present a controlled comparison on the Unitree G1 humanoid (23 active DoF) in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, training loco-manipulation policies through a sequential curriculum spanning 13 levels from stationary reaching to walking with variable-orientation targets. In standardized evaluation, dual-critic policies reach targets 3.5$\times$ faster (6.5 vs. 22.6 simulation steps), achieve 2$\times$ higher throughput (14.3 vs. 7.0 validated reaches per 1,000 steps), and attain higher validated reach rates (65.2% vs. 53.8%) compared to the unified-critic policy. Notably, additional anti-gaming reward mechanisms provide no further improvement beyond the architectural change alone (60.9% vs. 65.2%). These results have direct implications for the emerging paradigm of RL fine-tuning of imitation-learned policies: when refining a pre-trained manipulation policy with RL, a unified critic risks suppressing the learned behavior through competing locomotion gradients. These findings demonstrate that critic architecture is a primary - and often overlooked - design choice in multi-objective humanoid RL, with greater impact than reward engineering on reaching efficiency.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，通过 13 级课程学习比较了双 critic（dual-critic）与统一 critic（unified-critic）架构在人机操作任务中的表现。双 critic 策略在到达速度、吞吐量和成功率上均显著优于统一 critic 策略，且额外的反博弈奖励机制未带来进一步提升。
Motivation: 多目标强化学习中人形机器人的运动与操作协调需要合理设计 critic 架构，但现有研究常忽视这一选择。
Method: 在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 中，对 Unitree G1（23 个主动自由度）进行 13 级顺序课程训练，比较双 critic（分离的奖励信号）与统一 critic（合并的价值估计）的效果。
Result: 双 critic 策略比统一 critic 策略到达目标快 3.5 倍（6.5 vs. 22.6 仿真步），吞吐量高 2 倍（14.3 vs. 7.0 次验证到达/千步），验证到达率高 11.4%（65.2% vs. 53.8%）。反博弈机制未带来额外提升（60.9% vs. 65.2%）。
Conclusion: critic 架构是多目标人形机器人 RL 中关键且常被忽视的设计选择，其影响超过奖励工程，对模仿学习策略的 RL 微调范式有直接影响。

papers.title: Task-Aligned Stability Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving Hazard Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. Furthermore, corruption families differ in failure direction: most suppress hazard detections via false negatives, while occlusion instead triggers false alarms, suggesting that benchmark design should account for asymmetric failure modes, not just overall instability rates. These results suggest that robustness benchmarks should include task-aligned stability measures in addition to embedding-level perturbation statistics.
papers.comment: 8 pages (5 main body + 3 references / appendices). ICML 2026 Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（CLIP）在自动驾驶危险检测中的稳定性，比较了嵌入漂移与边缘漂移的关系，发现不同类型损坏导致的表示漂移与决策漂移耦合程度不同，且损坏族在失败方向上不对称（大多数导致漏报，遮挡导致虚警），建议增加任务对齐的稳定性度量。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型的鲁棒性分析通常仅基于任务无关的嵌入稳定性，忽略了任务对齐的决策稳定性。
Method: 在BDD100K路况场景上施加受控损坏，定义并比较嵌入漂移与边缘漂移（即危险分数在扰动下的变化）。
Result: 嵌入漂移与边缘漂移的关系高度依赖于损坏类型；大多数损坏通过假阴性抑制危险检测，而遮挡引发假阳性。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性基准应包含任务对齐的稳定性度量，而不仅仅是嵌入层面的扰动统计。

papers.title: Image Quality Assessment of Identity Cards Using Measures from Open Face Image Quality
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of assessing image quality in ID cards in remote verification systems by applying capture-related quality measures from the Open Face Image Quality (OFIQ) standard to ID card images. Our preprocessing pipeline includes corner detection, perspective normalization, and comprehensive foreground masking to ensure accurate and unbiased quality measure computation. We evaluate the effectiveness of these measures by analyzing their correlation with the performance of three presentation attack detection (PAD) algorithms across four diverse ID card datasets, where two datasets contain bona fide, i.e. pristine, images and two contain printed mock ID cards. Our results suggest that quality assessment based on some OFIQ measures can significantly improve PAD performance.
papers.comment: Presented on IWBF 2026 (14th International Workshop on Biometrics and Forensics)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将开放人脸图像质量（OFIQ）标准中的采集相关质量度量应用于身份证图像，以提升远程验证系统中的呈现攻击检测（PAD）性能。预处理流程包括角点检测、透视归一化和前景掩码。在四个数据集上评估了度量与三种PAD算法性能的相关性，结果表明部分OFIQ度量能显著改善PAD性能。
Motivation: 远程身份证验证系统中，图像质量对呈现攻击检测至关重要，但缺乏针对身份证图像的专门质量评估标准。
Method: 采用OFIQ标准中的质量度量，通过预处理（角点检测、透视归一化、前景掩码）后计算质量分数，并分析其与三种PAD算法性能的相关性。
Result: 部分OFIQ度量与PAD性能显著相关，基于这些度量的质量评估能提升PAD效果。
Conclusion: 将OFIQ质量度量应用于身份证图像质量评估有助于增强呈现攻击检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SG2Loc: Sequential Visual Localization on 3D Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Visual localization in complex indoor environments remains a critical challenge for robotics and AR applications. Sequential localization, where pose estimates are refined over time, is important for autonomous agents. However, traditional methods often require storing extensive image databases or point clouds, leading to significant overhead. This paper introduces a novel, lightweight approach to sequential visual localization using 3D scene graphs. Our method represents the environment with a compact scene graph, where nodes represent objects (with coarse meshes) and edges encode spatial relationships. For each image in the localization phase, we extract per-patch semantic features, predicting object identities. Localization is performed within a particle filter framework. Each particle, representing a camera pose, projects the coarse object meshes from the scene graph into the image, assigning object identities to patches based on visibility. The similarity of the per-patch features, in the input image, and object features from the scene graph determines the weight of a particle. Subsequent images are incorporated sequentially, refining the pose estimate. By leveraging a compact scene graph and efficient semantic matching, our method significantly reduces storage while maintaining performance on real-world datasets. The code will be available at https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc.
papers.comment: The code will be available at https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于3D场景图（scene graph）的轻量级顺序视觉定位方法。方法将环境表示为紧凑的场景图，节点为带有粗略网格的物体，边编码空间关系；定位阶段使用粒子滤波器，每个粒子通过投影物体网格并匹配语义特征来估计相机位姿，并利用后续图像顺序更新。在真实数据集上，该方法在减少存储开销的同时保持了定位性能。
Motivation: 传统视觉定位方法需存储大量图像数据库或点云，存储开销大，而室内环境中的顺序定位对自主代理至关重要，需要更高效的表示。
Method: 利用3D场景图作为环境表示，包含物体节点和空间关系边；定位时，从输入图像提取逐块语义特征，在粒子滤波器框架中，每个粒子投影场景图物体网格，根据投影块与输入特征相似度计算权重，并通过顺序图像更新位姿。
Result: 方法在真实世界数据集上以显著降低的存储开销实现了与现有方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: 紧凑的场景图和高效的语义匹配使得顺序视觉定位在保持性能的同时大幅减少存储需求，适用于机器人及AR应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Below the Limit of Detection: A Censored-Poisson Bayesian Latent-Growth Change-Point Detector (the Span Detector) for Serial ctDNA in HR+/HER2- Metastatic Breast Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Circulating-tumour DNA (ctDNA) carries evidence of drug resistance months before imaging shows it, but the earliest evidence lives below the assay's limit of detection (LoD): a nascent subclone is detected only intermittently, producing a flickering sequence of faint detects and non-detects. Commercial liquid biopsies treat each draw as an independent snapshot and a non-detect as nothing. We argue a non-detect is a left-censored observation, and the pattern of non-detects and faint detects over time carries actionable evidence of growth before any single value is trustworthy. We introduce Span, a censored-Poisson Bayesian latent-growth change-point detector that models the binary detection process, accumulates a sequential generalised-likelihood-ratio statistic for an upward change-point in the per-variant detection rate, and raises a competing-risks alarm with calibrated false-alarm control. Span has no learned weights, so there is nothing to overfit. On a synthetic cohort of HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer on first-line CDK4/6-inhibitor plus endocrine therapy, at a matched 10% false-alarm rate, Span roughly doubles the fraction of impending progressions caught three months ahead (indolent regime: 25% vs 11% for the snapshot), with a falsifiable dose-response: large for indolent emergence, vanishing for fast emergence. A value-trajectory baseline performs identically to the snapshot, isolating the gain to the censored detection model. The survival backbone matches a Cox baseline on real breast-cancer data (GBSG-2, n=686; C-index 0.67 vs 0.68), and on a real longitudinal cohort with clean biomarkers (PBC2, n=312) the same pipeline correctly declines to win, a falsifiable boundary test confirming the mechanism is regime-specific. All ctDNA trajectories are synthetic.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code and synthetic data generator: https://github.com/span-ai-labs/span-detector
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）中低于检测限的早期耐药信号，提出了一种名为Span的删失泊松贝叶斯潜在增长变化点检测器。该方法将非检测视为左删失观测，通过序贯广义似然比统计量累积证据，并在合成HR+/HER2-转移性乳腺癌队列中，以10%虚警率下提前三个月检出进展的比例比传统快照方法提高约一倍（惰性场景25% vs 11%）。
Motivation: ctDNA携带的药物耐药证据在影像学显现有数月之久，但早期亚克隆信号低于检测限，商业检测将非检测视为无信号，忽略了时间序列中的增长模式。
Method: 提出Span，一种删失泊松贝叶斯潜在增长变化点检测器，建模二元检测过程，累积序贯广义似然比统计量检测每变异检测率的向上变化点，并发出竞争风险警报以控制虚警率。模型无学习权重，避免过拟合。
Result: 在合成队列中，10%虚警率下，Span提前三个月捕获进展的比例是快照方法的两倍（惰性场景25% vs 11%）。价值轨迹基线表现与快照相同，增益来自删失检测模型。在真实乳腺癌数据（GBSG-2, C-index 0.67 vs 0.68）和真实纵向队列（PBC2）中验证了机制的特异性。
Conclusion: 通过将非检测建模为左删失观测，Span能显著提高早期检测耐药亚克隆生长的能力，且收益依赖于肿瘤生长速度（惰性场景显著，快速场景消失）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoMine Solution for AV2 2026 Scenario Mining Challenge
papers.abstract_en: With the development of autonomous driving systems, mining high-value, safety-critical, and planning-relevant scenarios from large-scale driving logs has become essential for data-driven evaluation. In this paper, we propose AutoMine, a robust self-refining scenario mining method based on LLMs and VLMs. AutoMine uses semantics-preserving prompt augmentation to reduce LLM prompt sensitivity, combines robust trajectory atomic functions with VLM-based functions to handle perception noise and open-world visual cues, and refines generated code through execution feedback from real logs. In the Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Competition at CVPR 2026, AutoMine achieves a HOTA-Temporal score of 36.38 and a Timestamp BA score of 77.21.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 Scenario Mining Challenge (Temporal Track Winners)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoMine，一种基于LLM和VLM的自优化场景挖掘方法，用于从大规模驾驶日志中提取高价值、安全关键且与规划相关的场景。在CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2场景挖掘竞赛中，AutoMine取得了HOTA-Temporal 36.38和Timestamp BA 77.21的成绩。
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统需要从大规模驾驶日志中高效挖掘高价值、安全关键且规划相关的场景，以支持数据驱动评估，而现有方法对提示词敏感且难以处理感知噪声和开放世界视觉线索。
Method: AutoMine结合语义保持的提示增强、鲁棒轨迹原子函数与VLM函数，并通过实际日志执行反馈自我优化生成的代码。
Result: 在CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2场景挖掘竞赛中，AutoMine取得HOTA-Temporal 36.38和Timestamp BA 77.21。
Conclusion: AutoMine证明了LLM和VLM在自动驾驶场景挖掘中的有效性，其自优化机制降低了提示敏感性并增强了对复杂环境的适应能力。

papers.title: Modelling magnetic material properties with uncertainty-aware neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly applied to accelerate the discovery of novel materials by exploring large compositional and structural design spaces. Yet, the scarcity of high-quality data and the frequent need for out-of-distribution prediction introduce substantial uncertainty, making the assessment of model reliability essential. In this work, we investigate uncertainty quantification as a means to evaluate model confidence in the context of permanent magnet research. In a first study, we benchmark classical and modern machine learning models for predicting intrinsic magnetic properties, focusing on the quality of their uncertainty estimates. We apply Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss and dropout-based Bayesian approximation as practical strategies for estimating predictive uncertainty. In a second study, we transfer these architectural features for uncertainty estimation to a more complex task: predicting coercivity from microstructural information using a graph neural network. Together, these studies demonstrate that uncertainty quantification not only enhances the trustworthiness of predictions but is also transferable across different modeling tasks.

TL;DR: 本文研究利用机器学习加速永磁材料发现中的不确定性量化问题。通过比较经典与现代机器学习模型预测本征磁性质的不确定性估计质量，并将在第一项研究中获得的不确定性估计架构迁移至基于图神经网络的微结构-矫顽力预测任务。实验表明，不确定性量化不仅能提升预测可信度，且在不同建模任务间具有可迁移性。
Motivation: 机器学习在材料发现中面临高价值数据稀缺和分布外预测需求带来的不确定性，需评估模型可靠性。现有工作在永磁材料领域较少系统性地量化预测置信度。
Method: 采用两阶段研究：1) 以高斯负对数似然损失和dropout贝叶斯近似为工具，基准测试多种模型对磁性本征属性预测的不确定性估计质量；2) 将上述不确定性估计架构迁移至基于图神经网络从微结构预测矫顽力的更复杂任务。
Result: 不确定性量化提升了预测可信度，且架构可跨任务迁移（从本征属性预测到矫顽力预测）。
Conclusion: 不确定性量化方法能增强永磁材料预测的可靠性，并具有任务迁移潜力，适用于更广泛的材料建模场景。

papers.title: Agents All the Way Down; A Methodology for Building Custom AI Agents from Substrate to Production
papers.abstract_en: Custom AI agents areagents that live inside their own application, talk to their own data and tools, enforce their own security boundaries, and carry their own brand and audit trail. What separates them from the general-purpose tier is fit, not capability: each is built for one job, by the engineer who will maintain it. No published practice sets out how to build one end to end. The pieces are everywhere (function-calling APIs, the Model Context Protocol, code agents to pair with), but the practice that chains them lives in podcasts, blogs, and leaked system prompts. This paper writes that practice down as a methodology, Agents All the Way Down: two preconditions crossed once and kept, then three practices repeated for the agent's life. The preconditions are (P1) Substrate, the LLM as a software component, framed as tools, then system, then messages under prompt-caching; and (P2) Building blocks: function calling, MCP, CLI orchestration, the liteshell pattern, the agent loop, skills, characters, hooks, and scaffolding. The practices are (P3) prototype with a general-purpose agent; (P4) harvest, fold, and ship the result as a CLI, the Turtle pattern; and (P5) agent-tests-agent, in which a general-purpose agent drives it through behavioural scenarios, a complement to classical testing, not a replacement. The working loop is P3 to P4 to P5 and back, and one corollary falls out for free: multi-agent orchestration is just CLI composition. The methodology is framework-free by construction. It was distilled from the AAC, a custom agent for the open-source LAMB platform, built in about ten days by one developer with an AI pair-programmer and in production . We present it as a transferable practice, independent of any language or framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套从底层到生产构建自定义AI智能体的方法论，包含两个前提条件（底层LLM组件化和构建块）和三个循环实践（原型、收获交付、智能体测试智能体），并从一个实际案例中提炼。该方法框架无关，强调端到端构建而非通用智能体。
Motivation: 目前缺乏从零开始构建自定义AI智能体的系统性实践指导，相关知识分散在非正式渠道中。
Method: 方法论'Agents All the Way Down'：两个前提条件（P1：将LLM视为软件组件，P2：功能调用、MCP、CLI编排等构建块），然后重复三个实践（P3：用通用智能体原型，P4：收获并交付为CLI，P5：用通用智能体进行行为测试）。
Result: 该方法论源自一个约10天内由一名开发者与AI配对编程构建的自定义智能体案例，并已在生产环境中运行。

papers.title: MemNovo: Look Back at the Spectrum for Balanced De Novo Peptide Sequencing from Mass Spectrometry
papers.abstract_en: De novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectrometry is pivotal in proteomics, enabling identification of novel peptides without reference databases. While recent Transformer-based encoder-decoder models have achieved remarkable performance, we uncover a critical pathology in their inference dynamics. Through comprehensive feature scaling experiments, we demonstrate that existing auto-regressive peptide decoders tend to over-rely on generated-sequence priors while progressively under-utilizing fine-grained physical evidence from the input mass spectrum. This phenomenon leads to suboptimal results, where generated peptide sequences are biologically plausible yet not faithful to the input spectrum. To rectify this, we propose MemNovo, a training-free and plug-and-play mechanism that re-balances peptide and spectral contributions at inference time. MemNovo alleviates the information bottleneck by establishing a persistent spectral memory bank and injecting retrieved features directly into the final decoding stage via an ultra-conservative residual connection. Theoretical analysis confirms that this mechanism restores the mutual information between the decoder state and the raw spectrum. Extensive experiments on the Nine Species benchmark with two representative baselines, Casanovo and InstaNovo, demonstrate that MemNovo consistently improves both amino acid precision and peptide precision, achieving up to 39.1% relative improvement in peptide precision for Casanovo and up to 3.9% for InstaNovo, with negligible computational overhead.

TL;DR: 本文发现基于Transformer的从头肽段测序模型在推理时存在对生成序列先验过度依赖、对输入质谱特征利用不足的问题，提出一种无需训练的即插即用机制MemNovo，通过建立持久谱记忆库并在最终解码阶段注入检索特征来重新平衡肽段和谱贡献。在Nine Species基准上，MemNovo在两个基线模型上一致提升氨基酸精度和肽段精度，最高相对提升39.1%。
Motivation: 现有Transformer编码器-解码器模型在从头肽段测序中存在推理动态失衡：生成序列先验逐渐主导，而输入质谱的细粒度物理证据被逐步忽略，导致输出肽段生物学合理但与谱不忠实。
Method: 提出MemNovo，一种训练免费、即插即用的机制，在推理时通过持久谱记忆库保存谱特征，并通过超保守残差连接将检索到的特征直接注入最终解码阶段，从而恢复解码器状态与原始谱之间的互信息。
Result: 在Nine Species基准上，MemNovo使Casanovo的肽段精度相对提升39.1%，InstaNovo提升3.9%，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: MemNovo有效缓解了自回归解码中的信息瓶颈，无需重新训练即可提升从头肽段测序的忠实性。

papers.title: Conformal Bayes under Label Shift: Post-Hoc Calibration vs. In-Training Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Bayes combines Bayesian posterior predictives with conformal calibration to produce prediction sets that are both statistically valid and geometrically efficient. We study conformal Bayes under label shift from a unified perspective, identifying two complementary approaches that restore nominal target-domain coverage through importance-weighted conformal calibration but operate through independent mechanisms. \emph{Post-hoc calibration} tilts the posterior predictive toward the target domain and corrects the conformal threshold via an importance-weighted quantile, leaving the parameter posterior unchanged. \emph{In-training adaptation} tilts the parameter posterior itself to the target domain, producing a corrected predictive whose highest predictive density region serves as the highest predictive density (HPD) based prediction set under the fitted target predictive; efficiency is model-dependent and does not imply finite-sample conditional optimality. Two controlled experiments show that in an unbiased training regime both strategies achieve valid coverage equally, while in a lead-optimization regime in-training adaptation acts as a debiasing operator, reducing interval width at unchanged coverage.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究标签偏移下共形贝叶斯的两种校准方法：事后校准（post-hoc calibration）通过重要性加权调整共形阈值，不改变参数后验；训练中适应（in-training adaptation）直接倾斜参数后验到目标域，产生修正预测的HPD集。两个控制实验表明，在无偏训练下两者均能恢复名义覆盖，而在主导优化（lead-optimization）下训练中适应作为去偏算子减小区间宽度。
Motivation: 标准共形贝叶斯在标签偏移下目标域覆盖失效，需要恢复名义覆盖的校准方法。
Method: 分别提出事后校准（通过重要性加权分位数调整共形阈值）和训练中适应（通过倾斜参数后验到目标域得到修正预测），两者均基于重要性加权共形校准。
Result: 两个控制实验显示：无偏训练下两种策略均实现有效覆盖；主导优化下训练中适应作为去偏算子，在不改变覆盖下减小区间宽度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两种方法互补但机制独立，且训练中适应的效率依赖于模型，不保证有限样本条件最优性。

papers.title: RePAIR: Predictive Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Chess
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Representation Prediction via Autoencoding using Iterative Refinement (RePAIR) - a novel self-supervised representation learning architecture that synthesizes Masked Autoencoders (MAE), Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). We demonstrate how it can be used to encode objects in sequential data like consecutive chess positions into compact yet meaningful representations. The basic principle of the architecture is to mask large portions of a sequence of latent states, similar to BERT and MAE. Then, we apply a lightweight Predictor to the latent representations that repairs gaps in the sequence in a lower-dimensional embedding space akin to JEPA. Our experiments in the domain of chess show that the Encoder refines the board representations such that meaningful chess concepts emerge clustered in the latent space. Furthermore, reconstructions of the masked board states show that the model is able to reason about the piece movements without relying on costly reinforcement learning methods. Lastly, we find that the resulting representation space allows for quick and intuitive dissections of chess games by observing the game path trajectories in this semantically rich space.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at IEEE Conference on Games 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RePAIR，一种结合MAE、JEPA和BERT的自监督表征学习架构，用于对国际象棋连续位置序列进行紧凑而有意义的编码。通过在潜在空间中遮蔽并修复序列间隙，该架构能够学习到清晰的象棋概念聚类，并无需依赖强化学习即可推理棋子移动。实验表明该表征空间支持快速直观的棋局分析。
Motivation: 现有表征学习方法在序列数据中难以同时捕获局部和全局依赖，且通常需要大量标注或强化学习。
Method: 提出RePAIR架构，利用MAE和BERT的大规模遮蔽策略，结合JEPA的轻量级预测器在低维嵌入空间中修复序列间隙。
Result: 在国际象棋领域，编码器将棋盘表征精炼为有意义的象棋概念聚类；重建被遮蔽的棋盘状态表明模型能够推理棋子移动，无需强化学习；表征空间支持直观的棋局轨迹分析。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确说明局限，但表明该方法在序列数据表征学习上有效，且可推广到其他领域。

papers.title: REACH: Interpretability-Driven Feature Identification and Architecture Compression for Multi-Channel Vehicular Channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-channel mixed-SNR training improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation of deep learning channel estimators for IEEE 802.11p vehicular communications, yet the internal mechanism responsible for this remains unexplained. This work presents REACH (Relevance-based Explanation and Architectural Compression for cHannel estimators), a gradient-based interpretability framework that operates at two levels. Input-level attribution identifies a subset of time-frequency features consistently relevant across all evaluated channel conditions, enabling input dimensionality reduction with minimal performance loss. Filter-level attribution reveals a near-universal internal representation, providing a representational account of the observed OOD generalisation. Guided by the resulting filter taxonomy, relevance-guided architecture compression substantially reduces both the number of parameters and the number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) with sub-1 dB normalised mean square error (NMSE) degradation, and OOD generalisation degrades more slowly than within-distribution accuracy under increasing compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REACH 框架，利用梯度归因方法对多通道混合信噪比训练的 IEEE 802.11p 信道估计器进行可解释性分析。输入级归因识别出时频特征子集，实现输入降维；滤波器级归因揭示近通用内部表征，解释分布外泛化。基于滤波器分类的架构压缩在参数和 FLOPs 大幅减少下保持 NMSE 退化小于 1 dB。
Motivation: 多通道混合信噪比训练提升了深度学习信道估计器的分布外泛化，但其内部机制未解释，需要可解释性方法理解特征重要性。
Method: 提出 REACH，包含输入级归因（识别一致相关时频特征）和滤波器级归因（揭示内部表征），并基于滤波器分类指导架构压缩。
Result: 输入维度压缩后性能损失小；架构压缩大幅减少参数和 FLOPs，NMSE 退化小于 1 dB，且分布外泛化退化慢于分布内精度。
Conclusion: REACH 框架提供了信道估计器特征与架构压缩的可解释性方案，验证了混合 SNR 训练泛化归因于近通用内部表征。

summary_sections.method: 提出 REACH，包含输入级归因（识别一致相关时频特征）和滤波器级归因（揭示内部表征），并基于滤波器分类指导架构压缩。
summary_sections.result: 输入维度压缩后性能损失小；架构压缩大幅减少参数和 FLOPs，NMSE 退化小于 1 dB，且分布外泛化退化慢于分布内精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: REACH 框架提供了信道估计器特征与架构压缩的可解释性方案，验证了混合 SNR 训练泛化归因于近通用内部表征。

papers.title: Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: Art-based Reinforcement Training
papers.abstract_en: There are two main Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) introduces additional weights between the LLM layers, Soft Prompting introduces additional fine-tuning-specific raw tokens to an LLM input. However, both require modification to the computational graphs of precompiled, preoptimized LLMs. As a result, neither is fully supported in high-throughput engines like vLLM. We propose fine-tuning with ART (Art-based Reinforcement Training). The method injects information into a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) by optimizing only its raw visual input, thus enabling the soft-token approach on pre-compiled computational graphs. It relies on backpropagation of gradients back into a plain pixel array and thus supports any fine-tuning objective. Moreover, the optimized visual input can be stylized as task-relevant computational artworks. The approach's effectiveness is confirmed for different sizes of a popular open Qwen architecture and for several textual benchmarks. Specifically, ART reaches accuracy competitive with LoRA across mathematics and structured-tool-use benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ART（Art-based Reinforcement Training）方法，通过仅优化多模态大语言模型的原始视觉输入来注入信息，支持在预编译计算图上实现软提示微调，无需修改模型计算图。该方法在Qwen架构上达到与LoRA相当的数学和结构化工具使用基准性能。
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法如LoRA和Soft Prompting需要修改预编译LLM的计算图，无法在高吞吐引擎如vLLM中完全支持。
Method: 提出ART方法，将梯度反向传播至原始像素数组，仅优化视觉输入（可风格化为计算艺术品），从而在冻结的MLLM上实现软提示微调，兼容任何微调目标。
Result: 在Qwen系列模型上，ART在数学和结构化工具使用基准上达到与LoRA竞争的性能。
Conclusion: ART提供了一种无需修改模型图即可微调MLLM的替代方案，通过优化视觉输入实现有效信息注入。

papers.title: Task-Aware Structured Memory for Dynamic Multi-modal In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) depend on in-context learning (ICL) for rapid task adaptation, but their scalability is severely limited by finite context windows and the growing cost of key-value (KV) caches in long multi-modal sequences. Existing memory compression approaches typically rely on rigid token removal or sample-dependent importance estimation, which introduces bias, disrupts semantic structure, particularly for visual representations, and yields static memories that cannot adapt to new queries. We introduce TASM (Task-Aware Structured Memory), a training-free framework that addresses these limitations through task-aware, structure-preserving, and dynamically accessible memory construction. TASM employs task-vector guided compression to replace sample-specific signals with a task-level direction that captures shared relevance across demonstrations. To preserve the underlying manifold, it applies semantics-aware token merging via bipartite graph matching, aggregating tokens without destructive pruning. Finally, TASM structures memory into a hierarchy comprising a compact Core Memory and a Latent Bank, facilitating query-adaptive dynamic retrieval. Evaluations confirm TASM maintains high performance under heavy compression, effectively balancing efficiency with adaptability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TASM (Task-Aware Structured Memory)，一种无训练的多模态上下文学习内存压缩框架。该方法通过任务向量引导压缩、语义感知token合并（二分图匹配）和层次化内存结构（核心内存+潜在库）实现动态检索，在保持高性能的同时显著提升压缩效率并适应新查询。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs的ICL受限于有限上下文窗口和KV缓存成本增长，而传统内存压缩方法存在偏见、破坏语义结构且无法动态适应新查询。
Method: TASM采用任务向量引导压缩以提取共享任务方向，通过二分图匹配进行语义感知token合并保留流形结构，并构建分层内存（Core Memory和Latent Bank）支持查询自适应的动态检索。
Result: 摘要报告TASM在重压缩条件下仍保持高性能，有效平衡了效率与适应性。
Conclusion: TASM作为无训练框架，通过任务感知、结构保持和动态可访问的内存机制，解决了多模态ICL中内存压缩的核心矛盾。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StatefulDiscovery: Evidence-Calibrated Claim Formation in Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended scientific discovery asks agents to move beyond executing analyses for predefined questions. Across multiple rounds of exploration, a discovery agent must decide which phenomena warrant investigation while avoiding overinterpretation, where emerging claims exceed the evidential scope of the analyses supporting them. This creates an evidence-calibration problem: the exploration trajectory must be coupled with claim status so that evidence can guide both what to investigate next and what can be claimed. We introduce StatefulDiscovery, a discovery framework that externalizes investigation state and uses it to coordinate frontier selection, evidence acquisition, and claim adjudication. We evaluate StatefulDiscovery across 40 real-data discovery tasks. Compared with several baselines, StatefulDiscovery produces more claims overall judged to be both well-supported and high-value. Ablations indicate that structured hypotheses, local adjudication, and frontier control contribute to performance. Together, these results suggest that explicit discovery state can couple exploration with evidence-calibrated claim formation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StatefulDiscovery框架，通过外部化探索状态来解决开放式科学发现中的证据校准问题，即在多轮探索中避免声明超出证据范围。在40个真实数据发现任务上，该框架相比基线生成了更多且证据充分、价值高的声明。消融实验表明结构化假设、局部裁决和前沿控制是其关键组件。
Motivation: 开放式科学发现中，智能体需要自主决定探索方向，但容易过度解读，即生成的声明缺乏充分的证据支持。现有方法缺乏将探索轨迹与声明状态耦合的机制，导致证据校准问题。
Method: 提出StatefulDiscovery框架，将调查状态外部化，用于协调三个环节：前沿选择（决定下一步探索什么）、证据获取（收集数据）和声明裁决（判断声明是否合理）。框架依赖结构化假设和局部裁决机制。
Result: 在40个真实数据发现任务上，StatefulDiscovery相比多个基线产生了更多被判定为既充分支持又高价值的声明。消融实验证实结构化假设、局部裁决和前沿控制各自对性能有贡献。
Conclusion: 明确的发现状态能够将探索过程与证据校准的声明形成有效耦合，从而提升开放科学发现中声明的质量与可信度。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SheafStain: Sheaf-Theoretic Schrödinger Bridge for Spatially and Biologically Coherent Virtual Staining
papers.abstract_en: Current virtual staining approaches offer the potential for time- and cost-efficient biomarker quantification in cancer diagnostics and prognostics. However, patch-wise inference for gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs) fails to maintain spatial continuity, yielding artifacts that cause catastrophic mismatches with ground-truth images. Although pathology Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer rich representations, their self-attention causes varying global contexts to produce inconsistent embeddings for the same physical region. We formalize and validate this ``context contamination'' as a sheaf-theoretic problem where these embeddings form a presheaf that violates the gluing axiom. To address this, we propose SheafStain, a new approach that reinterprets VFM features as sheaf-like sections for spatially and biologically coherent virtual staining. Specifically, SheafStain integrates class and patch tokens into a Schrödinger Bridge framework as sheaf-like sections. While the class token anchors biological consistency, patch tokens form a per-position spatial map. A backbone co-pretrained on Hematoxylin \& Eosin (H\&E) and Immunohistochemistry (IHC) yields non-degenerate cross-stain stalks, so a single VFM feature space supervises both input conditioning and output stain alignment. Departing from prior work that evaluates on isolated $256 \times 256$ patches and either random-crops or resizes the $1024 \times 1024$ ground truth, we translate at $256 \times 256$ and evaluate on the stitched $1024 \times 1024$ outputs across HER2, ER, PR, and Ki-67. SheafStain demonstrates promising results against six prior methods while mitigating patch-boundary stitching artifacts. Code will soon be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SheafStain，一种基于层论薛定谔桥的虚拟染色方法，用于全切片病理图像。该方法将视觉基础模型的特征重新解释为层状截面，通过类标记和补丁标记分别锚定生物一致性和空间连续性，在HER2、ER、PR、Ki-67等指标上优于六种现有方法，并减轻了补丁边界拼接伪影。
Motivation: 现有虚拟染色方法在全切片图像上采用补丁推理时缺乏空间连续性，产生伪影；病理视觉基础模型的自注意力机制导致同一物理区域在不同全局上下文中产生不一致的嵌入，即“上下文污染”问题。
Method: 将视觉基础模型特征视为层状截面，集成类标记和补丁标记到薛定谔桥框架中；类标记锚定生物一致性，补丁标记形成空间图；使用在H&E和IHC上共同预训练的骨干生成非简并跨染色茎，单一特征空间同时监督输入条件和输出染色对齐。
Result: 在HER2、ER、PR、Ki-67等指标上，SheafStain在拼接后的1024×1024输出上优于六种先前方法，并减轻了补丁边界拼接伪影。
Conclusion: SheafStain通过层论框架解决了虚拟染色中的空间一致性和上下文污染问题，展示了在病理图像中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TaskFusion: Continual Anomaly Detection for Heterogeneous Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Continual anomaly detection in tabular data is challenging and remains largely underexplored, particularly in settings with heterogeneous feature schemas, distribution shifts, and severe class imbalance. In many real-world applications, data arrive sequentially from diverse domains, rendering conventional continual learning methods ineffective due to their reliance on a fixed input space. We propose a continual learning (CL) method, which can overcome these challenges and continually learn from different tasks. Our method consists of three main parts: our AGF model, Taskfusion augmentation, and outlier exposure. The AGF-model maps task-specific features into a shared space, then aligns distributions to reduce representation drift, and learns anomaly decision boundaries in the aligned space. To improve stability, we introduce Taskfusion augmentation, combining boundary-aware interpolation within tasks to refine the model anomaly boundaries and cross-task mixing to transfer anomaly structure across datasets. To handle class imbalance and memory constraints, we employ tabular dataset distillation to store compact synthetic replay samples, which are jointly used with augmented data in an outlier exposure objective for robust anomaly detection. We evaluate the approach on 21 heterogeneous datasets across multiple domains. Results show that our approach substantially improves continual anomaly detection performance over sequential fine-tuning and other CL baselines while reducing catastrophic forgetting and maintaining stable detection across heterogeneous datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对异构表格数据的持续异常检测方法 TaskFusion，包含 AGF 模型、Taskfusion 增强和异常暴露三部分。AGF 模型将任务特定特征映射到共享空间并对齐分布，Taskfusion 增强通过边界感知插值和跨任务混合优化异常边界，异常暴露结合蒸馏的压缩回放样本处理类别不平衡。在 21 个异构数据集上，该方法显著优于顺序微调和其他持续学习基线，减少了灾难性遗忘并保持了稳定检测。

Method: 提出包含 AGF 模型（映射对齐分布并学习决策边界）、Taskfusion 增强（边界感知插值+跨任务混合）和基于表格数据集蒸馏的异常暴露目标的持续学习方法。
Result: 在 21 个异构数据集上，该方法在持续异常检测性能上显著优于顺序微调和其他持续学习基线，并减少了灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效处理异构表格数据中的持续异常检测，保持稳定检测并减轻遗忘。

papers.title: Scene-Adaptive Nonlinear Tone Curves for Pseudo Ground-Truth Generation in Low-Light 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Low-light novel view synthesis is challenging because dark multi-view images contain noise, weak structural detail, and compressed dynamic range. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods address these challenges by generating pseudo ground-truth (pseudo-GT) images as supervision targets when paired normal-light references are unavailable. Existing pseudo-GT methods apply a uniform linear gain to all pixels, which clips bright regions while providing insufficient enhancement in dark regions, limiting reconstruction quality. We observe that nonlinear tone mappings, long established in 2D low-light enhancement, have not been explored for pseudo-GT generation in 3D reconstruction. Accordingly, we propose a scene-adaptive nonlinear tone-curve framework that replaces linear pseudo-GT with nonlinear alternatives. The framework introduces percentile-based normalisation for scene-agnostic curve application, a scene-adaptive offset for automatic black-level adjustment, and two complementary curves: Adaptive SoftExp (ASE), a bounded exponential curve, and Adaptive Poly3 (AP3), a data-driven cubic polynomial. The module changes only the pseudo-GT computation and leaves the 3DGS backbone unchanged. Experiments on three benchmarks covering 21 scenes show that both curves consistently outperform the linear baseline with PSNR improvements up to +4.34 dB on LOM and +3.25 dB on RealX3D. Both curves achieve similar performance despite their different mathematical forms, suggesting the improvement is curve-agnostic. Code is available at https://github.com/lvmingzhe/adaptiveToneCurve
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低光照3D高斯溅射（3DGS）中伪地面真值（pseudo-GT）生成时线性增益导致的亮区裁剪和暗区增强不足问题，提出场景自适应非线性色调曲线框架。该框架引入基于百分位的归一化、场景自适应偏移以及两种互补曲线（Adaptive SoftExp 和 Adaptive Poly3），仅修改伪GT计算而不改变3DGS主干。在三个基准的21个场景上，两种曲线均一致优于线性基线，PSNR提升最高达+4.34 dB（LOM）和+3.25 dB（RealX3D）。
Motivation: 现有低光3DGS方法使用均匀线性增益生成伪GT，导致亮区过曝和暗区增强不足，限制了重建质量。非线性色调映射在2D低光增强中已被证明有效，但尚未用于3D重建中的伪GT生成。
Method: 提出场景自适应非线性色调曲线框架，包括：基于百分位的归一化实现场景无关的曲线应用、场景自适应偏移自动调整黑电平、以及两种互补曲线——有界指数曲线Adaptive SoftExp (ASE) 和数据驱动三次多项式Adaptive Poly3 (AP3)。该模块仅替换伪GT计算，保持3DGS主干不变。
Result: 在LOM、RealX3D等三个基准的21个场景上，两种曲线均一致优于线性基线，PSNR提升在LOM上达+4.34 dB，在RealX3D上达+3.25 dB。两种曲线性能相似，表明改进效果与曲线具体形式无关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提框架仅通过替换伪GT为非线性曲线即显著提升低光新视图合成质量，且曲线形式并非关键，表明非线性映射本身的有效性。该模块即插即用，不改变3DGS主干。

papers.title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Reward models for text-to-video (T2V) generation guide post-training but often fail at fine-grained semantic alignment. We trace this to two structural weaknesses in existing reasoning-based reward models: they do not systematically verify every condition described in the prompt, and the visual evidence supporting each judgment remains implicit in their free-form reasoning. We propose SG-PVR, a video reward model that addresses these limitations through plan-and-verify reasoning grounded in spatio-temporal scene graphs. The verification plan decomposes the prompt into atomic claims, ensuring every requirement is checked. The spatio-temporal scene graph, encoding entities, attributes, and temporally-grounded relations, is extracted from the video and maintained as a persistent structured visual reference throughout reasoning. Each claim is verified against both the video and the scene graph, anchoring judgments in explicit visual evidence. SG-PVR achieves strong performance on semantic alignment, including fine-grained temporal semantics. As a test-time reranker, it further enhances compositional alignment in T2V generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-PVR，一种基于规划-验证推理的文本到视频生成奖励模型，通过将提示分解为原子声明并提取视频的时空场景图作为结构化视觉参考，确保每个条件都被显式验证，从而提升细粒度语义对齐。在语义对齐和组合对齐任务上取得优异性能。
Motivation: 现有基于推理的奖励模型存在两个结构缺陷：未系统验证提示中的每个条件，且判断所依赖的视觉证据隐含于自由形式的推理中，导致细粒度语义对齐失效。
Method: 构建规划-验证推理框架：将文本提示分解为原子声明作为验证计划，同时从视频中提取包含实体、属性和时序关系的时空场景图作为持久的结构化视觉参考，将每个声明与视频和场景图共同比对。
Result: SG-PVR 在语义对齐（包括细粒度时序语义）上表现优异，作为测试时重排序器可进一步提升 T2V 生成中的组合对齐。
Conclusion: 通过显式分解验证计划和结构化视觉证据锚定，可有效提升奖励模型的细粒度语义对齐能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LASA: A Weak Supervision Method for Open-Vocabulary Scene Sketch Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary scene sketch semantic segmentation aims to assign dense semantic labels to sparse line drawings based on flexible category vocabularies specified at inference time, without relying on pixel-level annotations during training. Unlike natural images, sketches lack texture and color cues, making semantic understanding heavily dependent on stroke layout and spatial configuration, a challenge that renders single-layer vision-language features inherently unstable. Our key observation is that attention maps from different Vision Transformer layers encode complementary spatial cues: shallow layers capture global structural layouts, while deeper layers focus on local stroke intersections and object parts. This suggests that cross-layer aggregation provides a more robust structural prior than any individual layer alone. Leveraging this insight, we propose a structure-aware framework built upon \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{A}ccumulated \textbf{S}tructural \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{LASA}), which aggregates multi-layer attention to guide hierarchical semantic alignment under weak supervision and refine predictions during inference. Experiments on FS-COCO, SFSD, and FrISS show that LASA improves mIoU by $+3.43$, $+8.01$, and $+15.74$ over the prior weakly supervised baselines, demonstrating consistent gains in both segmentation accuracy and spatial coherence. Our source code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LASA方法，用于开放词汇场景草图语义分割，利用跨层注意力聚合来指导弱监督下的层次语义对齐，在FS-COCO、SFSD和FrISS数据集上分别提升mIoU +3.43、+8.01和+15.74。
Motivation: 草图缺乏纹理和颜色，仅依赖笔画布局，单层视觉语言特征不稳定，需要更鲁棒的结构先验。
Method: 提出层累积结构注意力（LASA），聚合多层Transformer注意力，在弱监督下指导层次语义对齐，并在推理时细化预测。
Result: 在FS-COCO、SFSD和FrISS上，LASA比先前的弱监督基线分别提升mIoU +3.43、+8.01和+15.74。
Conclusion: 跨层聚合提供了比单层更鲁棒的结构先验，LASA在分割准确性和空间连贯性上取得一致提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Data-free and Training-free Compression for Speech Foundation Models Using Parameter Clustering
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means. More fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is also explored. Experiments conducted on the LibriSpeech dataset suggest that when operating with pruning sparsity of 50% on HuBERT-large, consistent WER reductions of 27.73%/18.61% absolute (34.37%/21.91% relative) over the magnitude-based pruning were obtained on the test-clean and test-other subsets before fine-tuning and 0.19%/0.79% absolute (3.36%/4.62% relative) after fine-tuning with only 3 epochs. Similar WER reductions of 2.86%/5.02% absolute (59.21%/55.29% relative) were observed against magnitudebased pruning on Whisper-large-v3 at 10% sparsity, all with no significant WER increase relative to the uncompressed baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对语音基础模型的无数据、无训练压缩方法，通过k-means通道级聚类实现剪枝，并探索了按层不同簇数的混合稀疏剪枝。在LibriSpeech数据集上，对HuBERT-large以50%稀疏度剪枝时，与基于幅度的剪枝相比，微调前在test-clean和test-other上分别实现了27.73%/18.61%绝对（34.37%/21.91%相对）的WER降低，微调3个epoch后仍保持0.19%/0.79%绝对（3.36%/4.62%相对）的降低。在Whisper-large-v3上以10%稀疏度剪枝时，也观察到类似的WER降低，且相对于未压缩基线无显著WER增加。
Motivation: 现有语音基础模型压缩方法通常需要大量原始数据或计算昂贵的微调/训练步骤，这在实际应用中受到限制。本文旨在开发一种无需数据、无需训练的低成本压缩方法。
Method: 采用k-means对语音基础模型的通道进行聚类，实现参数共享和剪枝；进一步提出按层不同聚类数量的混合稀疏剪枝策略，以保留更重要的层。
Result: 在HuBERT-large上50%稀疏度下，微调前WER绝对降低27.73%（test-clean）和18.61%（test-other）；微调3个epoch后仍分别降低0.19%和0.79%。在Whisper-large-v3上10%稀疏度下，WER绝对降低2.86%（test-clean）和5.02%（test-other），且均不显著增加相对于未压缩基线的WER。
Conclusion: 所提无数据、无训练的参数聚类压缩方法在保持语音识别精度的同时显著降低模型大小和计算量，适用于资源受限场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Designing AI-Supported Focus Groups: A Role x Modality Playbook
papers.abstract_en: Collecting participants' lived experiences is central to design research. Focus groups are uniquely valuable because participants not only share individual accounts but also respond to one another, surfacing comparison, disagreement, and collective sensemaking. However, focus groups are resource-intensive and highly sensitive to facilitation: moderators must probe for specificity, balance participation, manage topic flow, and sustain psychological safety, and subtle facilitation choices can shape what becomes salient. Recent HCI work and commercial meeting tools show that generative AI can scaffold live conversation through prompting, turn regulation, thematic mapping, and real-time summarization. Yet UXR teams lack a clear map of what these capabilities mean in focus groups and what methodological risks they introduce. We synthesize AI supports for live conversation and translate them into a focus-group-specific playbook organized by AI role (tool, co-host, host) and modality (text, voice, embodied).We synthesize prior work on AI-supported live conversation and propose a focus-group-specific playbook of AI supports organized by role (tool, co-host, host) and modality (text, voice, embodied). We characterize interactional trade-offs and identify open questions for evaluating AI-supported focus groups as methodological configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对设计研究中焦点小组的实施痛点，提出一个由AI角色（工具、联合主持人、主持人）和模态（文本、语音、具身）构成的角色×模态剧本，以指导AI如何支持焦点小组的实时对话。作者总结了AI支持的交互权衡，并提出了评估AI支持焦点小组的方法学问题。
Motivation: 焦点小组资源密集且对主持人技巧高度敏感，现有AI工具缺乏针对焦点小组场景的系统指导。
Method: 通过综合AI支持实时对话的相关工作，将其转化为一个按角色和模态组织的焦点小组专用剧本。
Result: 论文提出了一个结构化的AI支持焦点小组框架，并指出了交互权衡和开放性问题，但未提供具体的实证验证。
Conclusion: 提出需要进一步研究AI支持焦点小组的方法论配置和评估。

papers.title: Flow Matching with In-Context Priors for Out-of-Distribution Brain Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching and diffusion models enable conditional generation across domains ranging from images to proteins, with recent extensions to out-of-distribution contexts. Yet generative models of neural time series have largely remained restricted to categorical conditioning, precluding compositional and zero-shot generalization. In this work, we propose a per-timestep conditioned diffusion transformer for generating realistic fMRI brain dynamics during unseen cognitive tasks by injecting both compositional language and optional spatial priors in-context. Such zero-shot generation could enable counterfactual neuroscience by supporting in-silico design and evaluation of novel cognitive experiments before empirical validation. Leveraging this model, we evaluate across hundreds of held-out task conditions and characterize predictive performance in relation to the training manifold. From language alone, the model recovers region-specific recruitment across tasks and held-out spatial activation patterns. Spatial priors, when available, complement the text pathway by anchoring generation in regions of task space where language alone degrades, while retaining the compositional structure needed for counterfactual task specification. To our knowledge this is the first generative model of whole-cortex fMRI dynamics for unseen cognitive tasks, advancing counterfactual neuroscience and data-driven experimental design.
papers.comment: Code and pretrained models available at https://github.com/SamGijsen/pinc-flows
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于逐时间步条件扩散变换器（per-timestep conditioned diffusion transformer）的流匹配方法，用于生成未见认知任务下的fMRI脑动态。该方法通过注入组合语言和可选的先验空间信息实现零样本生成，能够在数百个留出任务条件下评估预测性能，据称是首个针对未见认知任务的整皮层fMRI动态生成模型，推动反事实神经科学和数据驱动实验设计。
Motivation: 现有神经时间序列生成模型大多限于类别条件，无法实现组合泛化和零样本泛化，限制了在未曾见过的认知任务中生成反事实脑动态的能力。
Method: 采用逐时间步条件扩散变换器，在上下文中注入组合语言描述和空间先验，通过流匹配（flow matching）训练，实现从噪声到fMRI动态的生成。
Result: 从语言条件即可恢复任务特异性的皮层激活模式；当语言条件退化时，空间先验可锚定生成，同时保留反事实任务规范所需的组合结构。在数百个留出任务条件下评估了预测性能。
Conclusion: 该模型是首个能对未见认知任务生成全皮层fMRI动态的生成模型，可支持反事实神经科学和基于数据的实验设计。

summary_sections.result: 从语言条件即可恢复任务特异性的皮层激活模式；当语言条件退化时，空间先验可锚定生成，同时保留反事实任务规范所需的组合结构。在数百个留出任务条件下评估了预测性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该模型是首个能对未见认知任务生成全皮层fMRI动态的生成模型，可支持反事实神经科学和基于数据的实验设计。

papers.title: From Uniform to Learned Graph Priors: Diffusion for Structure Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Neural relational inference (NRI) methods discover interaction graphs from trajectories through variational reasoning on discrete potential edges. However, these methods typically rely on oversimplified, factorized graph priors. Such priors, typically nearing uniform distributions, treat edges as independent entities. This systemic misalignment does not match the real-world systems and yields diffuse and indecisive edge posteriors limiting the reliability of structural discovery. To address this, we propose \textit{Diff-prior}, a diffusion-parameterized adaptive prior used to calibrate latent graph distribution rather than generate graphs. Our core insight is to reframe prior integration as a learnable denoising-style calibration that organizes scattered, uncertain edge posteriors into a more reliable overall structure which can be trained by the diffusion model. Diff-prior learns an adaptive structure prior that performs structured calibration on the edge posteriors during inference, guiding it towards a distribution closer to the underlying structure. The diff-prior operates before structural sampling and acts as a denoising calibrator directly on the encoder edge distribution, which provides a generic training paradigm over structured variables. Experiments on standard benchmarks validated our framework, and the results indicate that Diff-prior improves the performance of structure inference and generates more decisive edge posteriors across multiple NRI-family architectures. The code is available on https://github.com/Hardy158118/Diffprior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diff-prior，一种通过扩散模型参数化的自适应先验，用于校准神经关系推理（NRI）中的潜在图分布。该方法将先验集成重构为可学习的去噪式校准过程，在推理阶段对编码器输出的边分布进行结构化调整，从而生成更可靠、更明确的边后验。实验表明，Diff-prior 在多个 NRI 架构上提升了结构发现性能。
Motivation: 现有 NRI 方法使用过于简化的分解图先验（接近均匀分布），将边视为独立实体，与真实世界系统不匹配，导致边后验模糊、结构发现不可靠。
Method: 提出扩散参数化的自适应先验（Diff-prior），在结构采样前作为去噪校准器直接作用于编码器边分布，通过可学习的去噪式校准将分散不确定的边后验组织为更可靠的整体结构，并采用扩散模型进行训练。
Result: 在标准基准上验证，Diff-prior 提升了多个 NRI 系列架构的结构推断性能，并产生更明确的边后验。
Conclusion: Diff-prior 提供了一种通用的结构化变量训练范式，通过可学习的先验校准改善图发现质量。

papers.title: Skill-Augmented AI Agents for Medical Research Analysis: An Exploratory Multi-Model Human Evaluation in an NSCLC Transcriptomic Biomarker Task
papers.abstract_en: Background. Large language models and AI agents are increasingly used to support biomedical research, but native model outputs may omit key analytical steps, misuse methods, or overstate conclusions. We evaluated whether autonomous access to a medical research skill package was associated with higher-quality AI-generated transcriptomic research-analysis outputs compared with native AI without skills. Methods. We conducted an exploratory multi-model human evaluation using a non-small cell lung cancer immunotherapy biomarker task. Six model backbones were tested. The evaluation included 21 anonymized outputs: 9 native-AI outputs and 12 skill-augmented outputs generated through an AI agent implementation represented by OpenClaw. Four non-expert biomedical reviewers and two blinded experts evaluated each output, with two ratings from each reviewer type. The primary outcome was expert-rated overall quality. Results. Skill-augmented outputs showed directionally higher expert overall quality than native-AI outputs (mean 5.50 vs 5.11; difference=0.39; bootstrap 95\% CI, -0.04 to 0.90; Welch p=0.156). Non-expert reviewer quality showed the same direction (mean 4.72 vs 4.47; difference=0.26; bootstrap 95\% CI, -0.25 to 0.80; Welch p=0.373). Expert agreement was limited (single-rating ICC=-0.15), and model-specific effects were descriptive and heterogeneous. Conclusions. Autonomous skill access showed a directional quality signal in this exploratory sample, but the signal was smaller than expert-rating noise and should not be interpreted as confirmatory evidence. The findings primarily motivate larger evaluations of skill-augmented AI agents with stronger reliability controls, platform replication, and biological-validity assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了在非小细胞肺癌免疫治疗生物标志物任务中，技能增强型AI代理（skill-augmented AI agent）与原生AI输出的质量差异。通过多模型人工评估，发现技能增强输出在专家评分中方向性更高（均值5.50 vs 5.11），但差异不显著（p=0.156），且专家一致性低。结论强调该信号不应被视为确证证据，并建议开展更大规模评估。
Motivation: 大型语言模型和AI代理在生物医学研究中应用日益广泛，但原生模型输出可能省略关键分析步骤、误用方法或夸大结论。
Method: 采用探索性多模型人工评估，以非小细胞肺癌免疫治疗生物标志物任务为测试用例。六种模型骨干在OpenClaw平台上生成技能增强输出（12份）和原生AI输出（9份），由四位非专家评审和两位盲法专家评估。
Result: 技能增强输出的专家总体质量方向性更高（均值5.50 vs 5.11，差异0.39，bootstrap 95% CI: -0.04 to 0.90，Welch p=0.156），非专家评价方向一致但差异更小。专家评分一致性低（单次评分ICC=-0.15）。
Conclusion: 自主技能访问在探索性样本中显示出方向性质量信号，但该信号小于专家评分噪声，不应视为确证证据。结果主要激励更大规模的评估，需要更强的可靠性控制、平台复制和生物学有效性评估。

papers.title: Feature-Aligned Speech Watermarking for Robustness to Reconstruction Distortions
papers.abstract_en: Audio watermarking aims to embed identifiable information into audio while remaining imperceptible. Existing methods adopt high-fidelity, low-energy designs to preserve perceptual quality, but the resulting watermarks lack robustness under suppression by speech reconstruction models. Improving robustness is challenging due to the inherent robustness-fidelity trade-off in existing designs, where increasing watermark energy improves robustness but reduces fidelity. To address this problem, we propose a feature-aligned watermarking method that aligns the watermark with the original speech feature distribution, allowing higher watermark energy to improve robustness while preserving imperceptibility. We use a pretrained speech codec to generate a pseudo-speech watermark and fuse it into the spectrogram of the input audio, with VAD loss and perceptual losses guiding embedding within voiced regions. Experiments show that our method maintains imperceptibility comparable to existing approaches while substantially improving robustness under both seen and unseen speech reconstruction models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有音频水印在语音重建模型下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出一种特征对齐的水印方法，通过将水印与原始语音特征分布对齐，允许使用更高能量水印而不降低感知质量。方法利用预训练语音编解码器生成伪语音水印，融合到输入音频的语谱图，并采用VAD损失和感知损失指导嵌入。实验表明，该方法在保持与现有方法相当的不可感知性的同时，在已知和未知语音重建模型下鲁棒性显著提升。
Motivation: 现有音频水印为保持高保真度采用低能量设计，导致水印易被语音重建模型抑制。提升鲁棒性面临鲁棒性与保真度之间的固有权衡，增加水印能量会降低感知质量。
Method: 提出特征对齐的水印方法：使用预训练语音编解码器生成与原始语音特征分布对齐的伪语音水印，将其融合到输入音频的语谱图中，并通过VAD损失和感知损失引导水印嵌入在浊音区域。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在保持与现有方法相当的不可感知性（通过客观指标和主观测试验证）的同时，在多种已知和未知语音重建模型下显著提升了水印鲁棒性（如提取准确率）。
Conclusion: 作者认为特征对齐策略有效缓解了鲁棒性与保真度之间的权衡，为音频水印在语音重建场景下的应用提供了新思路。

papers.title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding Can Jailbreak LLMs into Generating Malicious Code
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLMs into generating malicious code. Our experiments show that simply applying a benign code grammar constraint can effectively jailbreak LLMs. To address this vulnerability, we propose CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that robustly preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints. CodeShield aligns the model in the code modality by teaching it to generate honeypot code under GCD. Such code is semantically harmless, so it does not implement the malicious request, and structurally diverse, so it is difficult to suppress through grammar tightening. At the same time, CodeShield still preserves natural-language refusals when natural language is available. Experiments on 10 popular LLMs across 4 benchmarks show that CodeSpear outperforms representative jailbreak baselines and increases the attack success rate by more than 30 percentage points on average. CodeShield also restores safety under CodeSpear while preserving benign utility. Our findings reveal a fundamental risk of GCD and call for greater attention to its potential security implications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了一个反直觉的安全风险：原本用于提升代码生成可靠性的语法约束解码（Grammar-Constrained Decoding, GCD）可被利用来诱导大语言模型生成恶意代码。作者提出名为CodeSpear的攻击方法，仅通过应用良性代码语法约束即可有效越狱模型；同时提出防御方法CodeShield，通过在代码模态下对齐模型，使其在GCD下生成蜜罐代码（语义无害且结构多样），从而恢复安全性。实验在10个流行LLM和4个基准上验证，CodeSpear平均提升攻击成功率超过30个百分点，CodeShield能在保持良性性能的同时恢复安全。
Motivation: 大语言模型用于代码生成时可能被恶意利用；而语法约束解码（GCD）这一可靠性技术可能被攻击者反向利用成为新的攻击面。
Method: 提出CodeSpear攻击：直接使用良性代码语法约束（如Python语法）引导LLM生成恶意代码；提出CodeShield防御：在代码模态下进行安全对齐，训练模型在GCD下生成蜜罐代码（语义无害且结构多样），同时保留自然语言拒绝能力。
Result: 在10个流行LLM和4个基准上，CodeSpear相比代表性越狱基线平均提升攻击成功率超过30个百分点；CodeShield能有效防御该攻击，同时保持良性任务性能。
Conclusion: GCD存在根本性安全风险，需要更多关注其潜在安全影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WorldReasoner: Evaluating Whether Language Model Agents Forecast Events with Valid Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting real-world events requires language-model agents to reason under uncertainty from incomplete, time-bounded information. Yet evaluating whether agents genuinely forecast requires more than final-answer accuracy: a model may be correct by recalling memorized training facts, citing fabricated evidence, or producing an unsupported causal story. We present WorldReasoner, an evaluation framework for temporally valid event forecasting. Each task gives an agent a resolved forecasting question, a simulated forecast date, and access only to evidence available before that date; after resolution, the framework scores the submitted probability, cited evidence, and optional causal event graph. WorldReasoner reports three complementary axes: outcome quality against resolved answers, evidence quality over cited sources, and reasoning quality against post-resolution hindsight graphs. The benchmark is built by an agentic construction pipeline that generates forecasting questions, collects time-stamped evidence, and builds hindsight reference graphs at scale, yielding 345 resolved tasks derived from 14,141 articles with graphs covering 8,087 extracted events. Across six controlled agent settings, temporally valid retrieval is the strongest driver of outcome accuracy; causal graph construction improves key-event recovery; and correct graph-enabled forecasts are more strongly grounded in key events and relevant sources, yet agents still struggle to convert grounded evidence into calibrated probabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WorldReasoner评估框架，用于检验语言模型代理在事件预测中是否进行了有效推理。框架通过时间受限的证据检索和因果图构建，分别评估结果质量、证据质量和推理质量。基于14,141篇文章构建了345个任务，发现时间有效检索是关键，因果图能改善关键事件恢复，但模型校准仍困难。
Motivation: 现有评估只关注最终答案准确性，而模型可能通过记忆、虚构证据或无效因果链获得正确结果，缺乏对推理有效性的评估。
Method: 提出WorldReasoner框架，为每个任务提供模拟预测日期和早期证据，在事件解决后评估提交的概率、引用证据和因果关系图。通过自动化管线生成大量任务，包括时间戳证据和事后参考图。
Result: 在六个代理设置中，时间有效检索是结果准确性的最强驱动；因果图构建改善关键事件恢复；正确图启用的预测更基于关键事件和来源，但代理仍难以将证据转化为校准概率。
Conclusion: 强调了评估语言模型推理有效性的必要性，以及时间有效检索和因果图的重要性，同时指出模型校准方面的不足。

papers.title: Sparsified Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Interpretable Quantum State Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning approaches to quantum state tomography can achieve high reconstruction fidelity, but the physical structure used by the trained model often remains implicit. Here we ask whether a sparsified Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) can be used not only as a regressor, but also as an inspectable reconstruction rule whose internal organization can be checked against known Pauli structure. We study a controlled three-qubit GHZ-family benchmark in which all 63 non-identity Pauli expectation values are used to reconstruct three GHZ-subspace variables: the population imbalance $z$, the real off-diagonal component $c$, and the imaginary off-diagonal component $s$. Under finite-shot sampling and depolarizing noise, external ablation identifies the extended 12-channel GHZ-relevant Pauli set from the 63 measurements, with exact top-12 recovery across the tested shot counts and depolarizing-noise strengths. These support patterns remain stable across multi-seed random-initialization and noise-level analyses, and collapse under random-label controls. The dominant pruned input-hidden-output pathways organize Z-type population observables and X/Y off-diagonal observables in a pattern consistent with the analytic GHZ Pauli grouping, and sparse formula recovery recovers the canonical signed Pauli relations. The contribution of the KAN is therefore pathway-level structural interpretability within a neural reconstruction model, rather than superior sparse regression. Together with negative controls, these probes provide a consistency chain for auditing learned reconstruction rules against known physical structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏化KAN在量子态层析中的应用，不仅作为回归器，还作为可检查的重建规则。在三量子比特GHZ家族基准下，从63个Pauli期望值中通过外部消融识别出12个GHZ相关Pauli集，并发现其支持模式稳定、路径组织与解析GHZ Pauli分组一致。KAN的主要贡献是提供了路径级的结构可解释性。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的量子态层析方法虽能实现高保真度重建，但训练模型的物理结构往往隐式不可解释。本文探索稀疏化KAN能否既作为回归器又作为可检查的重建规则，以验证其内部组织与已知Pauli结构的一致性。
Method: 采用稀疏化KAN作为回归器，在有限采样和退极化噪声下，通过外部消融从63个非单位Pauli期望值中识别GHZ子空间变量（z, c, s）的相关Pauli集，并分析输入-隐藏-输出路径的稳定性与结构。
Result: 在多种shot数和噪声强度下，外部消融精确恢复12通道GHZ相关Pauli集（top-12）；支持模式在多种子随机初始化和噪声分析中保持稳定，并在随机标签控制下消失。主导路径的组织与解析GHZ Pauli分组一致，稀疏公式恢复规范符号Pauli关系。
Conclusion: KAN在此任务中的贡献在于提供路径级的结构可解释性，而非实现更优的稀疏回归性能。负控制实验提供了审计重建规则与已知物理结构一致性的链条。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TextHOI-3D: Text-to-3D Hand-Object Interaction via Discrete Multi-View Generation and Joint Mesh Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned 3D generation has progressed rapidly for images and isolated objects, but producing a hand-object mesh remains challenging: the output must preserve language semantics, cross-view consistency, object geometry, articulated hand shape, and physically plausible contact. We present TextHOI-3D, a staged framework that uses generated multi-view observations as an explicit interface between text-conditioned visual generation and geometry-aware hand-object recovery. TextHOI-3D learns a compact VQ token space for fixed-camera hand-object observations, predicts multi-view visual tokens from text with a CLIP-conditioned visual autoregressive model, and recovers a unified hand-object mesh through prior initialization, multi-view joint optimization, and anti-penetration refinement. The design separates semantic generation from geometric recovery while keeping both stages connected by a discrete multi-view representation. On HO3D-derived evaluations, the multi-view setting reduces object CD from 17.26 mm to 4.92 mm and penetration volume from 5.3721 cm^3 to 0.2193 cm^3 compared with a single-view counterpart, while improving hand errors and surface F-scores. These results support multi-view visual tokens as an effective intermediate representation for text-driven 3D hand-object mesh creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TextHOI-3D是一个分阶段框架，通过多视图生成和联合网格优化实现文本到3D手-物体交互的生成。它学习紧凑的VQ令牌空间用于固定摄像机手-物体观察，使用CLIP条件的视觉自回归模型从文本预测多视图视觉令牌，并通过先验初始化、多视图联合优化和防穿透细化恢复统一手-物体网格。在HO3D数据集上，多视图设置显著降低了物体Chamfer距离（从17.26mm降至4.92mm）和穿透体积（从5.3721 cm^3降至0.2193 cm^3），同时改善了手部误差和表面F分数。
Motivation: 文本驱动的3D生成在图像和孤立物体上进展迅速，但手-物体网格生成仍具挑战，需要同时保持语言语义、跨视图一致性、物体几何、关节手形和物理接触。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：首先学习紧凑的VQ令牌空间用于固定摄像机手-物体观察；然后使用CLIP条件的视觉自回归模型从文本预测多视图视觉令牌；最后通过先验初始化、多视图联合优化和防穿透细化恢复统一的手-物体网格。
Result: 在HO3D数据集上，多视图设置相比单视图将物体Chamfer距离从17.26mm降至4.92mm，穿透体积从5.3721 cm^3降至0.2193 cm^3，同时手部误差和表面F分数也有所改善。
Conclusion: 多视图视觉令牌作为文本驱动3D手-物体网格创建的有效中间表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Trustworthy AI: Multi-Target Adversarial Attacks and Robust Defenses for Continuous Data Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy AI requires reliable data-processing pipelines, not only robust downstream predictive models. As an upstream component, data summarization determines which information is retained and passed to subsequent learning or decision modules. Therefore, adversarial perturbations to the summarization process can compromise trustworthy AI in an upstream manner: they may alter the selected summary, reduce its representativeness, and further degrade the utility of subsequent learning tasks. In this paper, we study adversarial attacks on continuous data summarization under similarity-level perturbations through DR-submodular optimization. We show that a class of multi-resolution image summarization objectives can be formulated as multilinear extensions of non-negative submodular set functions and satisfy DR-submodularity with $m$-weak monotonicity. We then formulate multi-target attack generation as a min-max problem, where one admissible perturbation of the similarity structure is optimized to degrade multiple target summarization models. To mitigate such perturbations, we formulate robust defense against mixed attack types as a regularized max-min problem. For both problems, we develop approximation algorithms with theoretical guarantees. Experiments on real-data and controlled clustered benchmarks show that the proposed attack is effective in representative low-to-moderate budget regimes and can induce downstream task-performance loss. The proposed defense improves the robustness--mitigation trade-off in structured settings, while also revealing the parameter sensitivity of robust protection on real data.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (IEEE TIFS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续数据摘要（data summarization）过程中的对抗攻击与鲁棒防御，旨在提升可信AI。作者将多分辨率图像摘要目标建模为DR-子模（DR-submodular）优化问题，并提出多目标攻击生成及混合攻击类型的鲁棒防御算法，均带有理论保证。实验表明攻击在低到中等预算下有效，防御可改善鲁棒性-缓解权衡。
Motivation: 现有可信AI研究多关注下游模型的鲁棒性，但上游数据摘要组件同样易受对抗扰动影响，从而损害后续学习任务的可靠性。本文填补了这一空白。
Method: 通过DR-子模优化，将多目标攻击生成形式化为极大极小问题，将鲁棒防御形式化为正则化的极大极小问题，并分别开发了具有理论保证的近似算法。
Result: 在真实数据和聚类基准上，所提攻击在低到中等预算下有效降低下游任务性能；防御在结构化设置下改善了鲁棒性与缓解程度的权衡，但也揭示了实际数据中参数敏感性问题。
Conclusion: 论文强调了上游数据摘要的脆弱性，并提供了首个针对连续摘要的对抗攻击与防御框架，但其局限性在于防御参数对真实数据敏感。
Relevance: 0
