papers.title: Deterministic Policy Gradient for Learning Equilibrium in Time-Inconsistent Control Problems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a continuous-time model-free reinforcement learning algorithm to learn deterministic equilibrium policies in general time-inconsistent control problems. Utilizing the extended Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman system, we recast the original time-inconsistent problem into an equivalent two-stage problem. In the first stage, for given auxiliary functions, we employ the deterministic policy gradient approach to learn an optimal policy in an auxiliary time-consistent control problem. In the second stage, given the updated policy, we exploit the inner fixed point iterations and some martingale characterizations to learn the auxiliary functions. As a theoretical contribution, we provide some mild model assumptions and establish the convergence of inner fixed point iterations. By repeating this actor-critic style of iterations across two stages, our algorithm aims to learn the equilibrium under different sources of time-inconsistency in a unified manner. The superior effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are illustrated in two classical financial applications with time-inconsistency: mean-variance portfolio management and optimal tracking portfolio under non-exponential discounting.
papers.comment: Keywords: Time-inconsistent control, two-stage reformulation, model-free continuous-time reinforcement learning, deterministic policy gradient, fixed point iteration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间不一致控制问题，提出一种连续时间无模型强化学习算法，通过将原问题转化为等价的二阶段问题，利用确定性策略梯度和内部定点迭代学习均衡策略。理论贡献包括建立模型假设并证明定点迭代的收敛性，在均值-方差投资组合和非指数折现下的最优跟踪组合两个金融应用中验证了算法有效性。
Motivation: 时间不一致控制问题中，现有方法通常依赖于模型具体知识或难以处理一般性时间不一致性，而实际应用中模型常常未知或复杂，需要无模型方法。
Method: 利用扩展Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman系统将原问题转化为二阶段问题：第一阶段使用确定性策略梯度学习辅助一致控制问题的最优策略；第二阶段利用内部定点迭代和鞅特征学习辅助函数，并通过两阶段actor-critic风格的迭代统一学习不同来源的时间不一致性下的均衡。
Result: 在均值-方差投资组合管理和非指数折现下最优跟踪组合两个经典金融应用中验证了算法的有效性。
Conclusion: 提出的算法能够以统一方式学习多种时间不一致来源下的均衡，并提供了收敛性理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Space-sampled Value Decay: Forgetting Mechanisms for Non-stationary Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Studies on rodents such as mice have shown the capabilities to adapt their behavior when dealing with changing parameters (``drift'') of the environment even if no information about change is provided (uncertainty) -- a behavior that can be modeled by forgetting mechanisms. Non-stationary Reinforcement Learning (NSRL) deals with adapting state-of-the-art RL methods to deal with changing environments: these however usually require (partially) perfect information about the drift such as ``task IDs'' or ``context''. To mitigate the effects of drift, this work develops \emph{Space-sampled Value Decay} as an explicit forgetting mechanism for value-based deep RL architectures as a simple yet effective approach. In particular we demonstrate and discuss positive effects but also limitations in achieved returns for modifications of Deep Q-networks (DQN) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) when evaluated on non-stationary environments.
papers.comment: Accepted at The 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning, EIML@ICML 2026, (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受啮齿动物遗忘机制的启发，提出一种针对非平稳深度强化学习的显式遗忘机制——空间采样值衰减（Space-sampled Value Decay），用于值函数更新。该方法在非平稳环境下对DQN和SAC进行改进，摘要展示了其正面效果与局限性。
Motivation: 非平稳强化学习（NSRL）中，环境参数漂移时，现有方法通常需要任务ID或上下文等完美信息。本文旨在设计一种不需要外部信息的简单遗忘机制来缓解漂移影响。
Method: 提出空间采样值衰减（Space-sampled Value Decay），通过对值函数进行空间采样衰减来实现遗忘，不依赖额外的任务标识。
Result: 摘要报告了在修改的DQN和SAC上，非平稳环境下的奖励提升，但同时也指出了局限性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了显式遗忘机制在非平稳RL中的有效性，但需要进一步研究其适用范围和限制。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Multimodal Ordinal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Severity Using Structural MRI and Clinical Data
papers.abstract_en: Neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) require accurate and scalable tools for assessing disease severity, yet current clinical staging remains time-intensive and prone to variability. We propose an attention-enhanced multimodal machine learning framework with ordinal regression for automated and interpretable AD severity staging. The framework integrates T1-weighted MRI with demographic and genetic variables and compares unimodal and multimodal architectures using ordinal and non-ordinal prediction heads. Models were trained and validated using cohort-stratified splits derived from the ADNI, AIBL, and NIFD datasets. A strictly held-out test set was constructed using subjects excluded from all training, validation, preprocessing, and hyperparameter tuning procedures, with subject-level splitting employed throughout to prevent data leakage. Among unimodal approaches, the T1-weighted MRI model achieved slightly higher adjacent-stage accuracy (0.963) and agreement with clinical staging (QWK 0.444) than the tabular model (QWK 0.433). Integrating imaging, demographic, and genetic information improved overall performance. The multimodal non-ordinal baseline achieved the lowest prediction error (MAE 0.340), whereas the ordinal multimodal model achieved the highest adjacent-stage accuracy (0.970) and strongest agreement with clinical staging (QWK 0.549). These findings indicate that ordinal formulations better capture the ordered structure of the CDR scale and yield predictions more consistent with clinical staging. Explainability analyses using Grad CAM++ and SHAP demonstrated anatomically and clinically plausible model behavior, supporting transparent decision-making. Overall, attention-based multimodal learning with ordinal regression represents a robust, interpretable, and scalable approach for automated AD severity staging and AI-assisted clinical decision support.
papers.comment: 18 pages. Submitted to journal for review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于注意力的多模态机器学习框架，结合序数回归从结构MRI和临床数据中自动评估阿尔茨海默病严重程度。在ADNI、AIBL和NIFD数据集上，多模态序数模型在相邻阶段准确率（0.970）和与临床分期的加权卡帕系数（QWK 0.549）上表现最优。可解释性分析（Grad CAM++和SHAP）显示模型行为符合解剖和临床知识。
Motivation: 当前阿尔茨海默病临床分期耗时且受主观变异影响，需要准确、可扩展且可解释的自动化工具来评估疾病严重程度。
Method: 提出注意力增强的多模态机器学习框架，整合T1加权MRI、人口统计学和遗传变量，比较单模态与多模态架构以及序数与非序数预测头，采用严格隔离的测试集和受试者级划分防止数据泄露。
Result: 多模态非序数基线最低MAE（0.340），而多模态序数模型最高相邻阶段准确率（0.970）和最强临床分期一致性（QWK 0.549）。单模态MRI模型相邻阶段准确率0.963，QWK 0.444。
Conclusion: 序数公式能更好地捕获CDR量表的顺序结构，产生与临床分期更一致的预测。基于注意力的多模态序数学习为自动阿尔茨海默病严重程度分期提供了稳健、可解释且可扩展的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Ecosystem for Open-Domain Customized Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in video generation has shown impressive visual synthesis capabilities. However, open-domain customized video generation remains limited by the lack of large-scale, annotated datasets capturing diverse identity-specific attributes. To address this, we introduce PexelsCustom-1M, the first publicly available million-scale dataset for identity-preserving video generation, containing one million curated <identity, text, video> triplets across 8,000+ categories. Leveraging this, we propose CustoMDiT, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a pretrained multimodal Diffusion Transformer into a customized video generator with only 8% additional learnable parameters. Our method surpasses prior state-of-the-art. However, benchmarks such as DreamBooth cover only 100 classes, which is insufficient for real-world applications. To overcome this, we construct OpenCustom, a new benchmark with 1,000+ categories, created via cross-dataset knowledge fusion from ImageNet and MS-COCO. Extensive experiments confirm the advantages of both our dataset and model. We will open-source the entire ecosystem--including dataset, pipeline, benchmark, and implementations--to support further research.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by ICASSP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了开放域定制化视频生成的完整生态系统，包括百万级数据集PexelsCustom-1M（8000+类别）、参数高效框架CustoMDiT（仅8%额外参数）以及新基准OpenCustom（1000+类别）。实验表明该框架在身份保持视频生成上超越先前最优方法，并将开源所有资源。
Motivation: 开放域定制化视频生成受限于缺乏大规模、标注的多样化身份特定属性数据集，且现有基准（如DreamBooth）仅覆盖100类，难以满足真实应用需求。
Method: 构建PexelsCustom-1M数据集（百万<身份，文本，视频>三元组），并提出CustoMDiT框架，通过仅添加8%可学习参数微调预训练多模态扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer），实现身份保持的定制化视频生成。
Result: 在自建OpenCustom基准（1000+类别）上，该方法超越先前最先进模型，验证了大规模数据集和参数高效框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者将开源整个生态系统（数据集、流水线、基准和实现），以促进该领域的进一步研究。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters: Perceptual Wrapper with Common Randomness for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves impressive real-time rendering, it frequently struggles to synthesize high-frequency textures, a limitation heavily exacerbated in memory-constrained and rate-distortion-optimized (RDO) pipelines. To address this, we propose a versatile 2D perceptual wrapper that enhances the rendered outputs of existing 3DGS representations in a content- and view-dependent manner. Our method leverages a lightweight synthesis network conditioned on pseudo-random Gaussian noise to synthesize perceptually plausible textures. Supervised by Wasserstein Distortion, the network learns to match local feature statistics rather than strictly enforcing pixel-wise reconstruction fidelity, effectively mitigating the blurriness inherent in standard frameworks. We demonstrate the broad applicability of our plug-and-play approach across vanilla, memory-constrained, and RDO 3DGS methods. Comprehensive subjective and objective experiments confirm that our method significantly improves over existing baselines, yielding superior perceptual quality at sharply reduced file or model sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在处理高频纹理时存在的模糊问题，提出一种通用的2D感知包装器，通过基于伪随机高斯噪声的轻量级合成网络生成感知上合理的纹理。该方法以Wasserstein失真为监督，学习匹配局部特征统计而非严格像素重建，从而缓解模糊。实验表明，该插件方法在标准、内存受限和率失真优化（RDO）的3DGS方法上均能显著提升感知质量，同时大幅减小文件或模型尺寸。
Motivation: 3DGS在实时渲染中表现出色，但在高频纹理合成上存在局限，尤其在内存受限和率失真优化（RDO）管道中更为严重。现有方法缺乏一种内容与视图相关的感知增强手段。
Method: 提出一个2D感知包装器，包含一个轻量级合成网络，输入为伪随机高斯噪声，输出增强纹理。训练时使用Wasserstein失真损失，迫使网络匹配局部特征统计而非严格像素级重建。该包装器可即插即用于多种3DGS变体。
Result: 主观与客观实验表明，该方法在感知质量上显著优于基线，同时文件或模型尺寸大幅减小。
Conclusion: 该方法为提升3DGS渲染质量提供了一种灵活、高效的感知包装器，适用于多种管道，但性能受限于合成网络容量和噪声分布设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Limits Does Quantization Place on Dense Top-$k$ Retrieval? A Theoretical Study
papers.abstract_en: We establish conditions for embedding a corpus of $N$ documents as $d$-dimensional vectors such that every $k$-subset $S \subseteq [N]$ is realizable as a result of top-$k$ retrieval by some query vector. Recent work shows that $d = O(k)$ suffices for such embeddings to exist in $\mathbb{R}^d$, independently of $N$. We theoretically prove that this corpus-independent bound is specific to infinite precision. With $B$ bits per coordinate, perfect top-$k$ retrieval requires $Bd = Ω(k \ln N)$; thus, at any fixed precision, the dimension must grow at least logarithmically with $N$. Specializing to a $\ell_2$-normalized $B$-bit uniform scalar quantization model, we also identify a threshold on the precision $B^{*} = O(\ln \ln N)$ below which no dimension suffices, together with two further regimes that bound the feasible $(B, d)$ pairs. Our result implies that in practical vector databases and dense retrieval systems where quantization is standard, the embedding dimension and possibly the precision must grow with the corpus size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究量化对稠密top-k检索的限制。证明在无限精度下，维度d=O(k)即可独立于文档数N实现完美检索；但在有限精度下，完美检索需要Bd = Ω(k ln N)，即维度必须随N对数增长。针对ℓ2归一化的B位均匀标量量化模型，还识别了精度阈值B* = O(ln ln N)，低于该阈值则任何维度都不足以实现完美检索，并给出了可行(B,d)对的另外两个区域。结论是实际向量数据库中量化是标准做法，嵌入维度和精度必须随语料库大小增长。
Motivation: 现有工作表明无限精度下存在维度与语料库大小无关的嵌入，但实际系统使用量化，维度受限，因此需要研究有限精度下的理论限制。
Method: 理论分析，建立完美top-k检索所需精度与维度的条件，针对均匀标量量化模型推导阈值和可行区域。
Result: 证明完美检索需要Bd = Ω(k ln N)；识别精度阈值B* = O(ln ln N)，低于此阈值无可行维度。
Conclusion: 实际向量数据库中，嵌入维度和精度必须随语料库大小增长，量化带来根本性限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Battery detection of XRay images using transfer learning
papers.abstract_en: The need for detecting and sorting batteries is drastically increasing for many applications. This study proves the potential of transfer learning in predicting whether the image contains a battery or not, the location and identifying three types of batteries, namely: prismatic, pouch, and cylindrical Lithium-Ion Batteries (LIB). Particularly, it focuses on the transfer learning method in two applications: Training a large-scale dataset to detect electronic devices using a pre-trained YOLOv5m, then using these latter trained weights to detect and classify the batteries. The precision of battery detection achieves 94%, which outperforms the pretrained YOLOv5m weights with 5%, in 22 ms inference time.
papers.comment: Published at the European Symposium on Artificial Neural Networks (ESANN 2022)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用迁移学习在X射线图像中检测和分类锂离子电池（棱柱形、软包、圆柱形）。基于预训练的YOLOv5m模型，在电池检测任务上达到94%的精度，比直接使用预训练权重提升5%，推理时间为22毫秒。
Motivation: 电池检测和分类在回收、安全等领域需求日益增长，现有方法精度和效率有待提升。
Method: 采用迁移学习策略，先在大型电子设备数据集上预训练YOLOv5m，然后利用这些权重对电池进行检测和三种类型的分类（棱柱形、软包、圆柱形）。
Result: 电池检测精度达到94%，相比直接使用预训练YOLOv5m权重提升5%，推理时间仅22毫秒。
Conclusion: 迁移学习能有效提升X射线图像中电池检测和分类的性能，且推理速度快，适用于实际应用。

papers.title: Magnitude-Based Features for Multispecies Spatial Data
papers.abstract_en: Multispecies spatial data arise in many applications where interactions between different entities are central to system behaviour, including biomedical imaging, geospatial analysis, and species ecology. Despite their importance, relatively few quantitative tools exist to capture such interactions. In this work, we propose magnitude-based features for the analysis of multispecies spatial data. Magnitude is a real-valued invariant of finite metric spaces that can be interpreted as an effective number of points, incorporating both spatial configuration and scale. We develop global and local magnitude feature vectors and demonstrate their utility on synthetic tumour microenvironment data, and in tissue microarray data from human colorectal cancer samples. Locally, the method identifies distinct neighbourhood types and reveals spatial heterogeneity; in the model, this includes radial patterns associated with different qualitative outcomes of the simulations, while in the real-world data it reflects the importance of tertiary lymphoid structure-like interactions between B and T cell populations. Globally, the approach recovers known classifications of long-term simulation outcomes across parameter regimes in synthetic data, and suggests important roles for CD4+ T cells and CD163+ macrophages in distinguishing patients with favourable Crohn's like reactions from unfavourable diffuse immune infiltration. Together, these results suggest that magnitude-based features provide a powerful and flexible tool for the analysis of multispecies spatial data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于量值（magnitude）的特征用于多物种空间数据分析。量值是有限度量空间的一种实值不变量，可视为有效点数，结合空间构型和尺度。作者开发了全局和局部量值特征向量，并在合成肿瘤微环境数据和人类结直肠癌组织微阵列数据上展示其效用。局部特征识别不同的邻域类型并揭示空间异质性；全局特征恢复了合成数据中不同参数区间的长期模拟结果的已知分类，并提示CD4+ T细胞和CD163+巨噬细胞在区分患者类型中的重要作用。
Motivation: 多物种空间数据在生物医学成像和生态学等领域至关重要，但缺乏定量工具来捕捉不同实体间的相互作用。
Method: 提出基于量值的特征，包括全局和局部量值特征向量，用于多物种空间数据分析。
Result: 在合成肿瘤微环境数据中，局部特征识别径向模式等异质性；全局特征恢复已知分类。在结直肠癌数据中，揭示B细胞和T细胞相互作用的重要性，以及CD4+ T细胞和CD163+巨噬细胞在区分患者类型中的作用。
Conclusion: 量值特征为多物种空间数据分析提供了强大灵活的工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Optimistic Multiplicative Weight Update
papers.abstract_en: Optimistic Gradient Descent Ascent (OGDA) and Optimistic Multiplicative-Weights Update (OMWU) are two very popular algorithms to solve convex/concave saddle-point problems, where OMWU is the non-Euclidean, entropic version of OGDA. It is known since the '80s that the last iterate of OGDA asymptotically converges to a saddle point in smooth problems. On the other hand, it is unknown if OMWU has the same property. In this paper, I show that OMWU converges asymptotically for smooth convex-concave saddle-point problems, with a small enough constant learning rate. The result does not require uniqueness, strict complementarity, an error bound, or initialization near a solution. The main new ingredient is a boundary argument showing that every cluster point satisfies the inactive-coordinate KKT inequalities. The boundary argument was discovered with assistance from ChatGPT and is documented in the appendix.

papers.title: SVoT: State-aware Visualization-of-Thought for Spatial Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), as it requires reliable multi-hop inference over both intermediate states and state transitions. Current studies often leave intermediate states unverified and treat state transitions as implicit processes, which limits reliability in multi-hop spatial reasoning. To address this, we propose State-aware Visualization-of-Thought (SVoT), a reinforcement learning framework that generates interleaved, verifiable intermediate states and visualizations. SVoT integrates transition reasoning chains into the generation processes, enabling the model to verify action preconditions and effects through interleaved textual and visual reasoning. We train SVoT via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), instantiating verification through reward design and evaluating the efficacy of different fine-grained rewards. As existing benchmarks reduce state transitions to single-variable updates, substantially simplifying the problems, we establish five domains by extending classical environments and introducing two novel domains, Pacman and Gather, that require multi-object interactions and numerical reasoning. These domains support systematic evaluation of multi-hop spatial reasoning with quantitative verification of generated intermediate states and transition reasoning. SVoT with transition-aware supervision achieves state-of-the-art performance across the introduced domains, yielding up to a 65% absolute accuracy gain on out-of-distribution test sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SVoT（State-aware Visualization-of-Thought），一种基于强化学习的框架，通过生成可验证的中间状态和可视化来增强多模态大语言模型的多跳空间推理能力。SVoT利用GRPO算法训练，并设计细粒度奖励来验证动作前提和效果。在扩展的经典环境和两个新域（Pacman和Gather）上，SVoT在分布外测试集上取得了高达65%的绝对准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在多跳空间推理中常将中间状态视为未验证的黑盒，且状态转换过程隐式化，导致推理可靠性不足。
Method: 提出SVoT框架，结合GRPO训练，在生成过程中插入可验证的中间状态和可视化，并通过奖励设计实现动作前提与效果的验证。
Result: 在引入的五个域上，SVoT实现了最先进的性能，在分布外测试集上获得高达65%的绝对准确率提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过可验证的中间状态和转换感知监督，可以显著提升MLLM在多跳空间推理中的可靠性和泛化能力。

papers.title: When Do Data-Driven Systems Exhibit the Capability to Infer?
papers.abstract_en: The European AI Act is the first comprehensive regulation of artificial intelligence (AI), setting out extensive obligations, particularly for so-called high-risk and general-purpose AI systems. A key distinguishing feature of AI systems under the AI Act is the capability to infer. Since the AI Act does not clearly define what inference is, there is a gray area for certain data-driven systems. A specific example is credit scoring systems, which are listed by Annex III of the AI Act. At the same time, however, these are often implemented using statistical models for which it is unclear whether they have the capability to infer and thus fall under the AI definition of the AI Act at all. Motivated by statistical learning theory, this work develops a framework for grading different levels of the capability to infer. Based on the AI Act and the Commission Guidelines on the definition of an artificial intelligence system, we analyze which levels constitute sufficient capability to infer within the meaning of the AI Act and where further regulatory clarity is needed. We illustrate the framework by creating two realistic credit scoring workflows and show whether and where inference occurs in them. Our analysis illustrates that not only individual models but the entire data processing workflow must be considered. It also shows that the involvement of human experts during development can have significant influence on the capability to infer. Code can be found at https://github.com/fraunhofer-iais/inference-framework-creditscorecards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对欧洲AI法案中'推断能力'定义不明确的问题，基于统计学习理论提出了一种分级框架，用于评估数据驱动系统是否具备推断能力。通过信用评分系统的实例分析，展示了整个数据处理工作流而非单模型需被考虑，且人类专家参与影响显著。
Motivation: 欧洲AI法案对AI系统有严格规定，但未清晰定义'推断能力'，导致信用评分等统计模型是否属于AI监管范围存在灰色地带。
Method: 基于统计学习理论开发推断能力分级框架，结合AI法案和委员会指南分析各级别是否构成足够推断能力，并通过两个信用评分工作流实例进行说明。
Result: 分析表明，推断能力评估需考虑整个数据处理工作流，且开发中人类专家的参与会显著影响推断能力的存在与否。
Conclusion: 论文指出当前监管对推断能力的定义需要进一步澄清，并提供了框架以辅助判定。

papers.title: Fast Speech Foundation Model Distillation Using Interleaved Stacking
papers.abstract_en: Distilling a large speech foundation model (SFM) into an efficient student model has been successfully applied to low-resource environments. Although distillation reduces inference latency, it requires an additional student model training. However, the training efficiency of SFM distillation remains underexplored. In this work, we explore training acceleration of SFM distillation to speed up model deployment. We examine the potential of stacking, in which the model depth is progressively increased through training until the target model depth is reached. While existing stacking methods improve training speed, they suffer from performance degradation. To handle this limitation, we propose interleaved stacking, a novel stacking method that consistently preserves layer position throughout the stacking process. This property is particularly critical in SFMs, in which each layer encodes distinct layer-specific knowledge. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method on SUPERB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音基础模型（SFM）蒸馏中的训练加速问题，提出交错堆叠（interleaved stacking）方法，在逐步增加模型深度的训练过程中保持层位置一致，避免性能下降。在SUPERB基准上验证了该方法能有效加速蒸馏训练。
Motivation: 现有SFM蒸馏虽能降低推理延迟，但学生模型训练效率未被充分探索；传统堆叠方法加速训练但导致性能退化。
Method: 提出交错堆叠（interleaved stacking），在训练过程中逐步增加模型深度时，始终保持各层的位置不变，从而保留每层特有的层知识。
Result: 在SUPERB基准上验证了该方法在加速蒸馏训练的同时，避免了性能退化。
Conclusion: 交错堆叠能有效加速SFM蒸馏训练，且不损失性能，适用于低资源环境下的快速模型部署。

papers.title: Automated Creativity Evaluation of Language Models Across Open-Ended Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in language understanding, reasoning, and generation, sparking growing interest in their creative potential. Realizing this potential requires systematic and scalable methods for evaluating creativity across diverse tasks. However, most existing creativity metrics are tightly coupled to specific tasks, embedding domain assumptions into the evaluation process, and limiting scalability and generality. To address this gap, we introduce an automated, domain-agnostic framework for quantifying LLM creativity across open-ended tasks. Our approach separates the measurement apparatus from the creative task itself, enabling scalable, task-agnostic assessment. Divergent creativity is measured using semantic entropy, a reference-free and robust metric for novelty and diversity, validated against human annotations, LLM-based novelty judgments and baseline diversity measures. Convergent creativity is assessed via a novel retrieval-based multi-agent judge framework that delivers context-sensitive evaluation of task fulfilment with over 60% improved efficiency. We validate our framework in three qualitatively distinct domains: problem-solving (MacGyver), research ideation (HypoGen), and creative writing (BookMIA), using a broad suite of LLMs. Empirical results show that our framework reliably captures key facets of creativity, including novelty, diversity, and task fulfilment, and reveal how model properties, such as size, temperature, recency, and reasoning, impact creative performance. Our work establishes a reproducible and generalizable standard for automated LLM creativity evaluation, paving the way for scalable benchmarking and accelerating progress in creative AI.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 (Main Conference). 35 pages, 16 figures. Code: https://github.com/tanminsen/creativity-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化、领域无关的框架，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在开放任务中的创造力。该框架通过语义熵（semantic entropy）测量发散创造力（novelty和diversity），并通过基于检索的多智能体法官框架评估收敛创造力（task fulfilment），在问题解决、研究构思和创意写作三个领域使用多种LLM进行验证。实验表明该框架可靠捕捉创造力关键方面，并揭示了模型大小、温度、最近性和推理能力对创造性能的影响。
Motivation: 现有创造力指标大多与特定任务紧密耦合，嵌入领域假设，限制了可扩展性和通用性。缺乏系统性、可扩展的方法来评估LLM在多样化任务中的创造力。
Method: 提出一个自动化的领域无关评估框架，将测量装置与创造性任务分离。发散创造力使用语义熵（语义熵）作为参考自由的度量，收敛创造力采用基于检索的多智能体法官框架（retrieval-based multi-agent judge）进行上下文敏感的任务完成评估。
Result: 在三个不同领域（MacGyver问题解决、HypoGen研究构思、BookMIA创意写作）的验证中，框架可靠地捕捉新颖性、多样性和任务完成度。与基线相比，收敛创造力评估效率提升超过60%。此外，发现模型大小、温度、最近性和推理能力等属性影响创造性能。
Conclusion: 该工作为自动化LLM创造力评估建立了可重复和可泛化的标准，为可扩展的基准测试和加速创造性AI进展铺平了道路。

papers.title: RCAP: Robust, Class-Aware, Probabilistic Dynamic Dataset Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic data pruning techniques aim to reduce computational cost while minimizing information loss by periodically selecting representative subsets of input data during model training. However, existing methods often struggle to maintain strong worst-group accuracy, particularly at high pruning rates, across balanced and imbalanced datasets. To address this challenge, we propose RCAP, a Robust, Class-Aware, Probabilistic dynamic dataset pruning algorithm for classification tasks. RCAP applies a closed-form solution to estimate the fraction of samples to be included in the training subset for each individual class. This fraction is adaptively adjusted in every epoch using class-wise aggregated loss. Thereafter, it employs an adaptive sampling strategy that prioritizes samples having high loss for populating the class-wise subsets. We evaluate RCAP on six diverse datasets ranging from class-balanced to highly imbalanced using five distinct models across three training paradigms: training from scratch, transfer learning, and fine-tuning. Our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art dataset pruning methods, achieving superior worst-group accuracy at all pruning rates. Remarkably, with only $10\%$ data, RCAP delivers $>1\%$ improvement in performance on class-imbalanced datasets compared to full data training while providing an average $8.69\times$ speedup. The code can be accessed at https://github.com/atif-hassan/RCAP-dynamic-dataset-pruning
papers.comment: Proceedings of the Forty-first Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCAP 是一种用于分类任务的鲁棒、类别感知、概率动态数据集剪枝算法。它通过闭式解估计每类样本保留比例，并根据类级损失自适应调整，然后采用高损失优先的自适应采样策略。在六个数据集（从类平衡到高度不平衡）上用五种模型在三种训练范式下评估，RCAP 在所有剪枝率下均优于现有方法，特别是在类不平衡数据集上仅用 10% 数据即提升 >1% 性能并实现平均 8.69 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有动态数据集剪枝方法在平衡和不平衡数据集上高剪枝率时难以维持最差组准确率（worst-group accuracy），导致信息损失或计算开销不平衡。
Method: 提出 RCAP，包括：1）基于闭式解估计每类样本保留比例的初始值；2）每 epoch 根据类级损失自适应调整该比例；3）采用高损失优先的自适应采样策略填充每类子集。
Result: 在六个数据集上（包括平衡和不平衡）使用五种模型在三种训练范式下评估，RCAP 在所有剪枝率下实现最优 worst-group accuracy。仅用 10% 数据时，在类不平衡数据集上相比全数据训练提升 >1% 性能，并提供平均 8.69 倍加速。
Conclusion: RCAP 通过类别感知的概率动态剪枝有效提升了最差组准确率，尤其在高剪枝率和类不平衡场景下优势明显。

papers.title: AnchorEdit: Maintaining Temporal Consistency in Multi-turn Image Editing via Causal Memory
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn image editing is essential for iterative design, yet current models often struggle with identity drift and error accumulation over successive steps. While existing research leverages video priors for consistency, their reliance on bidirectional attention is fundamentally misaligned with the causal, sequential nature of interactive editing. In this paper, we propose AnchorEdit, the first autoregressive (AR) diffusion-based framework designed specifically for high-resolution, long-term multi-turn editing. AnchorEdit bridges the gap between video priors and causal inference through a three-stage training curriculum: identity-preserving sing-turn pretraining, causal AR forcing fine-tuning with a novel self-rollout strategy to mitigate exposure bias, and consistency distillation for efficient 4-step generation. During inference, we introduce a memory mechanism to anchor the initial subject identity and ensure stable extrapolation across extended editing trajectories. To evaluate performance, we provide a new high-resolution multi-turn editing benchmark designed to stress-test long-horizon stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnchorEdit achieves state-of-the-art results, maintaining exceptional subject fidelity and instruction following even over 10+ interaction rounds.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有多轮图像编辑模型在连续编辑中常出现身份漂移和误差累积；利用视频先验的方法依赖双向注意力，与因果顺序的交互编辑本质不匹配。
Method: 提出 AnchorEdit 框架，包含三阶段训练：身份保持的单轮预训练、因果自回归强制微调（含自展开策略以减少曝光偏差）、一致性蒸馏实现 4 步高效生成。推理时引入因果记忆机制锚定初始主体身份。
Result: 在自建的高分辨率多轮编辑基准上，AnchorEdit 在 10+ 轮交互中保持优异的主题保真度和指令跟随，达到 SOTA。
Conclusion: AnchorEdit 证明通过因果记忆与自回归扩散可以解决多轮编辑中的时序一致性问题，但方法局限于图像编辑领域。

papers.title: Time Series Analysis in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Time series analysis is a fundamental component of machine learning, especially in astrophysics and cosmology where temporal data abound. This chapter provides a pedagogical review of time series analysis techniques from a machine learning perspective. We cover the basic concepts of time series (stationarity, autocorrelation, seasonality), classical statistical models (autoregressive, moving average, ARIMA, exponential smoothing, state-space models), and modern machine learning approaches. In particular, we discuss how traditional statistical methods lay the groundwork, and then explore machine learning methods for time series, including feature-based regression, tree-based ensemble methods, hidden Markov models, Gaussian processes, and deep learning models (recurrent neural networks, convolutional networks, transformers). Throughout, we illustrate with examples drawn from multiple domains (e.g. astronomy, weather forecasting, finance) to emphasize common principles. The goal is to equip readers with both the theoretical understanding and practical context to apply machine learning techniques for time series analysis in their research.
papers.comment: Invited chapter for the edited book "Machine Learning Techniques for Astrophysics and Cosmology" (Eds. Cosimo Bambi, Vinay Kashyap, Swarnim Shashank, Naoki Yoshida, Springer Singapore, expected in 2026). Submitted version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是为《天体物理学与宇宙学中的机器学习技术》一书撰写的邀请章节，系统综述了时间序列分析从经典统计模型（ARIMA、状态空间模型等）到现代机器学习方法（高斯过程、RNN、Transformer等）的演变。尽管以天体物理和宇宙学为主要应用领域，但通过天气预测、金融等多领域示例说明通用原理。
Motivation: 时序数据在天体物理和宇宙学中普遍存在，但研究者需要从统计模型过渡到机器学习方法的知识桥梁。该章旨在填补这一教学空白，提供理论与实践并重的参考。
Method: 依次介绍时间序列基本概念（平稳性、自相关等），经典统计模型（ARIMA、指数平滑、状态空间模型），以及机器学习方法：基于特征的回归、树集成、隐马尔可夫模型、高斯过程、深度学习（RNN、CNN、Transformer），并辅以跨领域实例。
Result: 该章为综述性质，未报告具体实验数值。它通过结构化内容帮助读者建立从经典到现代方法的完整知识框架。
Conclusion: 本章的目标是使读者能够将机器学习技术应用于各自研究领域的时间序列分析，强调理论理解与实践背景并重。

papers.title: From Prompts to Tokens: Internalizing Causal Supervision in Vision-Language Model for Multi-Image Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Visual causal reasoning is essential for understanding and intervening in the physical world, requiring identification of causal variables from visual inputs and reasoning over intervention effects. Despite recent progress, large vision--language models (VLMs) remain brittle at such tasks, especially for interventional and counterfactual queries over multi-image inputs. Most existing explorations inject causal knowledge via textual prompts, leaving causal mechanisms external to model execution and limiting reliable control during inference. To address this problem, we propose BridgeVLM, which internalizes visual causal reasoning by inducing a causal graph from multi-image inputs and converting it into structured Causal Tokens executed by RAMP layers injected into the LLM decoder for causal message passing. We further introduce a unified training interface M3S for fine-grained causal supervision from different granularities (local/global level). BridgeVLM achieves 54.4% accuracy on intervention tasks on CausalVLBench (vs. 33.2% with prompt-level supervision), improves results on Causal3D from 43.6% to 49.0%, and substantially improves causal structure learning on CausalVLBench ($F_1$: 33.4% $\rightarrow$ 75.1%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BridgeVLM，将视觉因果推理内化到视觉-语言模型中，通过从多图像输入中诱导因果图并转换为结构化因果令牌（Causal Tokens），在LLM解码器中通过RAMP层执行因果消息传递。同时引入统一训练接口M3S，支持不同粒度的细粒度因果监督。在CausalVLBench干预任务上达到54.4%准确率（优于提示级监督的33.2%），在Causal3D上从43.6%提升至49.0%，并显著改善因果结构学习（F1从33.4%提升至75.1%）。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在多图像输入下的干预和反事实推理任务中表现脆弱，通常通过文本提示注入因果知识，使因果机制处于模型执行外部，限制了推理时的可靠控制。
Method: 提出BridgeVLM，从多图像输入中诱导因果图，将其转换为结构化因果令牌，并通过注入LLM解码器的RAMP层进行因果消息传递。设计统一训练接口M3S，提供局部和全局不同粒度的因果监督。
Result: 在CausalVLBench干预任务上达到54.4%准确率（vs. 33.2%），在Causal3D上从43.6%提升至49.0%，因果结构学习F1从33.4%提升至75.1%。
Conclusion: 桥接视觉因果推理与语言模型内部化可以提供更可靠的因果推理能力，尤其在多图像干预查询上表现显著优于基于提示的监督方法。

papers.title: Hey Chat, Can You Teach Me? Structuring Socratic Dialogue for Human Learning in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are now widely used for everyday learning, but the underlying interactions are typically unstructured chats rather than following a curriculum. Unlike formal online learning systems, these interactions carry no prior record of the student, so any estimate of what the student already knows must be inferred from the dialogue itself. We show that this gap is not closed by scaling models alone. Frontier and education-tuned LLMs perform poorly when asked to tutor a student over an extended session, because doing so requires three things at once. The tutor must sequence a curriculum, conduct Socratic dialogue, and infer the student's knowledge state from that dialogue. We propose separating these responsibilities. Given a student query, our system constructs a prerequisite knowledge graph in which subtopics are nodes and dependencies are edges, and frames tutoring as deciding which node to teach next and how many dialogue turns to spend on it before moving on. A lightweight PPO policy handles this sequencing decision, while an LLM conducts the Socratic exchange at the chosen node and returns a signal of student progress. Across held-out STEM and non-STEM topics, our PPO-paired tutor outperforms heuristic baselines, frontier general-purpose models, and a model specialised for Socratic dialogue: on both the rate at which students reach full curriculum mastery and the number of turns required. Explicit curriculum structure delivers gains that scaling the underlying model does not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在非结构化对话中辅导学生时缺乏课程结构的问题，提出将课程编排、苏格拉底式对话和学生知识状态推断三个任务分离的系统。该系统构建前提知识图，并用轻量级PPO策略决定下一步教学节点和对话轮次，LLM负责执行对话。实验在多个STEM和非STEM主题上显示，该方法在达到完全掌握的速度和对话轮次上均优于基线和前沿模型。
Motivation: 现有LLM在长时间辅导中表现不佳，因为需要同时完成课程排序、苏格拉底式对话和知识状态推断，而模型规模扩大无法解决这一结构性缺陷。
Method: 提出分离系统：构建前提知识图（节点为子主题，边为依赖关系），使用PPO策略决定下一步教学节点和在该节点上的对话轮数，LLM负责执行苏格拉底式对话并返回学生进度信号。
Result: 在STEM和非STEM主题上，PPO配对辅导在达到完全掌握的速度和所需对话轮数上均优于启发式基线、前沿通用模型和专门用于苏格拉底式对话的模型。
Conclusion: 明确课程结构带来的收益大于单纯扩大模型规模，结构化方法对于有效辅导至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TacCoRL 框架通过模拟-真实联合训练和强化学习，将触觉反馈注入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，无需大规模触觉预训练即可提升接触丰富任务的性能。在四个双手操作任务上，触觉策略的平均成功率从 50.0% 提升至 72.5%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅依赖视觉，在接触丰富的任务中缺失局部接触状态，导致操作失败。
Method: 使用真实对齐的模拟器作为闭环训练环境，混合模拟与真实轨迹预热触觉条件动作，再通过强化学习优化策略，同时保持对真实分布的对齐。
Result: 在四个双手操作任务上，最终触觉策略平均成功率达 72.5%，高于基线 50.0%。
Conclusion: 该框架无需大规模触觉预训练或大量真实接触探索，即可直接迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: UniReason-Med: A Shared Grounded Reasoning Interface for 2D-to-3D Transfer in Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: We study whether grounded reasoning supervision from abundant 2D medical images can improve 3D medical VQA when both input types are aligned through a common reasoning interface. We introduce UniReason-Med, a single-checkpoint framework that processes either a 2D image or a slice-serialized 3D volume at inference time, generating interleaved textual reasoning and localized visual evidence through shared box syntax, region-token injection, and a common grounded reasoning policy. To train this interface, we construct UniMed-CoT, a 220K instruction-tuning dataset with interleaved textual reasoning and grounded visual evidence, including 170K 2D and 50K 3D samples. Through supervised fine-tuning followed by outcome-level reinforcement learning, UniReason-Med learns to generate grounded reasoning traces without IoU/Dice-based localization rewards during RL. Data-mixture and component ablations show that joint 2D+3D grounded supervision substantially improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training, while grounding and region-token injection consistently benefit both 2D and 3D tasks. These results suggest that a shared grounded reasoning interface can transfer reasoning structure from 2D images to slice-serialized volumetric medical understanding. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniReason-Med，一个统一框架，通过在推理时共享盒语法、区域标记注入和接地推理策略，将2D医学图像中的接地推理监督迁移到3D医学VQA。构建了包含220K样本的UniMed-CoT数据集，结合监督微调和结果级强化学习，使得模型能够生成接地推理轨迹。实验表明联合2D+3D训练显著优于仅3D训练，证实共享接地推理界面的有效性。
Motivation: 3D医学VQA中缺乏接地推理，且3D标注数据稀缺；而2D医学图像丰富但推理结构难以直接迁移。作者希望利用共同的推理界面将2D推理结构迁移到3D体积理解。
Method: 提出 UniReason-Med 单检查点框架，支持2D图像或切片序列化3D体积输入，通过共享盒语法和区域标记注入生成交错的文本推理和局部证据。构建UniMed-CoT数据集（170K 2D + 50K 3D），采用监督微调加结果级强化学习训练，无需IoU/Dice定位奖励。
Result: 数据混合和组件消融实验表明，联合2D+3D接地监督显著提升3D推理性能，优于仅3D训练；接地和区域标记注入对2D和3D任务均有稳定改进。
Conclusion: 共享的接地推理界面能够将2D图像的推理结构有效迁移到切片序列化的3D医学理解中。代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: Multi-View In-Cabin Monitoring System for Public Transport Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a multi-view in-cabin monitoring dataset for public transportation with synchronized RGB and depth images from four inward-facing cameras and a rotating LiDAR covering the vehicle interior of a digitalized and partly automated German city bus. The dataset contains 9.136 synchronized samples with annotations and is accompanied by a calibration and pseudo-labeling pipeline that generates 3D human pose estimates and oriented 3D bounding boxes for occupants. We further provide a nuScenes-format conversion and benchmark representative multi-view 3D detection models (e.g., Lift-Splat-Shoot and BEVFusion), supporting comparative evaluation and small-scale training of multi-view in-cabin perception models. The dataset and tools are available at https://github.com/EvgenyGorelik/multiview_incabin_dataset.

papers.title: Renewable Lasso without Batch-Number Constraints: A Gradient-Enhanced Approach
papers.abstract_en: We study online estimation for high-dimensional generalized linear models with streaming data. First, for the non-distributed setting, we propose a gradient-enhanced surrogate loss that approximates the cumulative loss using only historical summaries, which modifies and improves upon the existing renewable estimation approach for the same model in the high-dimensional setting, and removes the batch-number constraint in previous studies. We then extend the method to distributed streaming data under the master-client architecture, where batches are partitioned across sites and only summaries (gradient vectors) are exchanged. Instead of directing applying the popular method of Jordan et al. (2019) to the surrogate quadratic loss, our adjusted approach does not require the clients to compute the full surrogate loss. We derive non-asymptotic error bounds under the high-dimensional scaling, without the stringent constraint on the number of batches in the previous studies. Simulation results under linear and logistic models, together with a real-data application, show improved accuracy over existing renewable estimators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维广义线性模型在线估计，提出一种梯度增强替代损失函数，改进了现有可再生估计方法，去除了批次数量约束。该方法扩展到分布式流数据场景，推导了非渐近误差界。模拟和真实数据实验表明精度提升。
Motivation: 现有可再生估计方法需要批次数量约束，限制了其在流数据中的应用。
Method: 提出梯度增强替代损失，仅使用历史摘要近似累积损失，并扩展至主从架构的分布式流数据，客户端无需计算完整替代损失。
Result: 在线性和逻辑回归模型下的模拟以及真实数据应用表明，所提方法比现有可再生估计器精度更高，并给出了非渐近误差界。
Conclusion: 该方法消除了批次数量约束，适用于高维流数据在线估计，具有理论保证和实证优势。

papers.title: Machine-learning clustering of close-in exoplanet populations: links to pebble accretion
papers.abstract_en: Close-in exoplanets exhibit a wide range of orbital architectures and physical properties shaped by both formation conditions and migration processes. Although population-synthesis models predict distinct planetary populations, establishing a quantitative connection between observed exoplanets and synthetic populations remains challenging. We investigate the intrinsic organisation of close-in exoplanets using physically motivated dynamical parameters and connect the resulting populations to pebble-accretion formation pathways. A two-stage Gaussian mixture model (GMM) is applied to an observed sample of close-in exoplanets, performing unsupervised probabilistic clustering in a feature space dominated by dynamical descriptors of planet-star interactions. The resulting clusters are mapped onto a pebble-accretion synthetic population within a statistically motivated three-dimensional parameter space. Formation-related quantities, including gas availability, gas fraction, and ice-rock mass ratio, are then used to interpret the mapped populations. We identify statistically supported sub-populations without imposing predefined classification boundaries, including very-massive gas giants, hot giants, warm-Jupiter-dominated systems, and lower-mass giants. The mapped synthetic populations reveal systematic differences in formation timing, gas accretion, and solid growth histories. In particular, very-massive gas giants are preferentially associated with earlier formation epochs than hot-giant and warm-Jupiter-dominated populations. These results demonstrate that physically motivated machine-learning approaches can provide a statistically robust framework for linking observed exoplanet populations to theoretical planet formation pathways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用无监督机器学习（高斯混合模型）对近地系外行星进行聚类，并将聚类结果映射到卵石吸积（pebble accretion）的合成种群中，揭示了不同行星亚群在形成时间、气体吸积和固体增长历史上的系统差异。
Motivation: 尽管种群合成模型预测了不同的行星种群，但观测到的系外行星与合成种群之间的定量联系仍然缺乏，本文旨在通过物理驱动的动力学参数建立这种联系。
Method: 采用两阶段高斯混合模型（GMM）对近地系外行星观测样本进行无监督概率聚类，特征空间由行星-恒星相互作用的动力学描述符主导；然后将聚类结果映射到卵石吸积合成种群的三维参数空间中，并用形成相关量（气体可用性、气体分数、冰岩质量比）进行解释。
Result: 识别出统计上显著的子种群，包括特大型气态巨行星、热巨行星、暖木星主导系统和低质量巨行星；映射显示特大型气态巨行星的形成时代早于热巨行星和暖木星主导系统。
Conclusion: 物理驱动的机器学习方法为连接观测系外行星种群与理论行星形成路径提供了统计稳健的框架。

papers.title: Mind the Perspective: Let's Reason Recursively for Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning requires inferring agents' beliefs from partial and asymmetric observations, which remains an open challenge for LLMs. Existing prompting-based approaches improve ToM reasoning through observable-event filtering or temporal belief chains, without explicitly modeling nested beliefs. We introduce RecToM, an inference-time framework for ToM reasoning that models nested beliefs via recursive perspective construction. RecToM constructs each character perspective from the preceding character perspective along the character chain specified by the question, reducing higher-order belief questions to actual-world questions within the final constructed perspective. We further provide a KD45 analysis showing that RecToM's perspective construction induces a well-formed belief modality beyond simple event filtering. Experiments on ToM benchmarks, including Hi-ToM, Big-ToM, and FanToM, across multiple LLM backbones show that RecToM consistently outperforms recent advanced approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Notably, RecToM reaches 100\% accuracy on Hi-ToM with GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.5, a benchmark requiring higher-order ToM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecToM，一个用于心智理论（ToM）推理的推理时框架，通过递归视角构建来建模嵌套信念。RecToM 按照问题指定的角色链，从上一角色视角构造当前角色视角，从而将高阶信念问题转化为最终构造视角下的实际世界问题。在 Hi-ToM、Big-ToM 和 FanToM 基准上，RecToM 在多个 LLM 骨干上均取得最优结果，尤其在 GPT-5.4 和 Qwen3.5 上达到 Hi-ToM 的 100% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的方法通过可观察事件过滤或时间信念链改善 ToM 推理，但未能显式建模嵌套信念，这是 LLM 在 ToM 推理中的开放挑战。
Method: 提出 RecToM 框架，通过递归视角构建：按照问题指定的角色链，从上一角色视角构造当前角色视角，将高阶信念问题归约为最终视角下的实际世界问题；并给出 KD45 分析证明该构造诱导出良好的信念模态，优于简单事件过滤。
Result: 在 Hi-ToM、Big-ToM 和 FanToM 基准上，RecToM 在多 LLM 骨干（如 GPT-5.4, Qwen3.5）上持续超越近年先进方法，达到 SOTA，并在 Hi-ToM 上实现 100% 准确率。
Conclusion: RecToM 通过递归视角构建有效建模嵌套信念，显著提升了 LLM 的高阶 ToM 推理能力。

papers.title: ICA Lens: Interpreting Language Models Without Training Another Dictionary
papers.abstract_en: Finding interpretable directions in language-model representations is critical for understanding and controlling model behavior. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become the standard tool for this purpose, but using them as the default first lens often requires training, storing, and evaluating large overcomplete dictionaries. This bottleneck limits rapid exploration and raises a fundamental question: how much interpretable structure is already visible from activation geometry before training another neural dictionary? Our intuition is simple: many interpretable directions are selective on tokens, and these directions should look less Gaussian than random directions. We therefore revisit independent component analysis (ICA), a classical method for finding non-Gaussian directions, as a compact lens for language-model interpretability. We find that ICA has been underestimated for LLM interpretability, because prior uses often relied on off-the-shelf ICA implementations that are brittle on LLM activations and lacked systematic tools for inspecting and evaluating the recovered directions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce ICALens, the first practical workflow for stable, efficient, and auditable ICA analysis of LLM representations. It combines an optimized GPU-parallel FastICA pipeline with LLM-specific stability recipes and better fitting diagnostics, enabling efficient and reliable layer-wise analysis. Across GPT-2 Small, Gemma 2 2B, and Qwen 3.5 2B Base, ICALens efficiently recovers compact, human-interpretable directions without per-layer gradient-based dictionary training. On SAEBench, ICA is competitive with public SAEs in sparse probing and outperforms them in targeted probe perturbation under small-to-medium budgets. These results suggest that ICA should not be viewed as a weak baseline, but as an efficient and complementary first lens for exploring language-model representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ICaLens，一种基于独立成分分析（ICA）的紧凑型语言模型表示分析方法，无需训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）即可恢复可解释方向。通过优化GPU并行FastICA流水线和LLM特定稳定性策略，该方法在GPT-2 Small、Gemma 2 2B和Qwen 3.5 2B Base上高效提取人类可解释方向，并在SAEBench上显示与SAE相当的稀疏探针性能。
Motivation: 现有SAE需要训练、存储和评估过完备字典，限制了快速探索；而ICA作为经典非高斯方向发现方法，在LLM可解释性中被低估，因为先前实现不稳定且缺乏系统工具。
Method: 提出ICaLens工作流，包含优化的GPU并行FastICA流水线、LLM特定稳定性配方和拟合诊断工具，用于稳定、高效、可审计的ICA分析。
Result: 在GPT-2 Small、Gemma 2 2B和Qwen 3.5 2B Base上，ICA高效恢复紧凑可解释方向；在SAEBench上，ICA在稀疏探针中与公共SAE竞争，并在中小预算的目标探针扰动中表现更优。
Conclusion: ICA不应被视为弱基线，而应作为探索语言模型表示的高效互补第一透镜。

papers.title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spatial, a self-evolving training framework in which the model plays dual roles as a proposer and a solver. In each iteration, a frozen proposer generates spatial question-answer (QA) pairs from 3D scene metadata and raw video frames, together with executable code for deriving reliable ground truth. A learnable solver is then fine-tuned on the accepted samples, and its per-sample prediction confidence is used as a difficulty signal. This signal is fed back to the proposer in the next iteration, guiding it to generate questions better matched to the solver's current capabilities. Through this closed-loop design, the training distribution co-evolves with model ability, reducing redundant trivial examples while filtering out ambiguous or uninformative samples with limited learning value. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks, Ouroboros-Spatial substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B while using an order of magnitude fewer training examples than recent large-scale curated datasets. On VSI-Bench, it yields absolute gains of 9.9 and 6.8 points for the 4B and 8B models, respectively, enabling both to outperform a wide range of strong open-source and proprietary baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ouroboros-Spatial，一个自我演进的训练框架，用于提升多模态大模型（MLLM）的空间推理能力。框架中模型扮演双角色：提议者生成空间问答对及可执行代码以获取真实答案，求解者微调后提供置信度作为难度信号反馈给提议者，形成闭环。在六个空间推理基准上，该方法用少一个数量级的样本提升了Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B的性能，例如在VSI-Bench上分别提升9.9和6.8个百分点，超越多种强基线。
Motivation: 现有静态数据集将所有样本平等对待，忽略模型能力演化，导致数据效率低下：训练容量浪费在过简或过难的样本上。
Method: 提出循环框架：固定提议者根据3D场景元数据和视频帧生成QA对及可执行代码；可学习的求解者微调后，每样本预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给提议者，下一轮生成更匹配当前能力的样本。
Result: 在VSI-Bench等六个空间推理基准上，Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B分别获得9.9和6.8个百分点的绝对提升，且训练样本数量比大规模数据集少一个数量级，超越多个开源和闭源基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环设计使训练分布与模型能力共同演化，减少冗余样本，提升数据效率，但未讨论其他模态或任务的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Substrate Asymmetry in User-Side Memory: A Diagnostic Framework
papers.abstract_en: User-side memory in LLMs is typically scored as a single "personalization" capability: given a user's history, is the output more user-aware? We show this aggregate metric hides opposite-direction failures. Memory factorises into at least three orthogonal axes -- behavioral consistency (style, voice), factual presence (recall facts in history), and factual absence (abstain when a fact is absent) -- and no single substrate wins all three. Comparing per-user gamma-LoRA (a small LoRA adapter trained on each user's history; gamma denotes per-user, not per-task) against BGE-large dense top-K retrieval on a controlled 50-user synthetic corpus and a real-data probe (LaMP-3), we find gamma-LoRA decisively wins behavioral style while RAG decisively wins factual absence -- and the same query-projection cells in attention layers 21-35 causally load-bear both effects in opposite directions (zeroing those LoRA weights raises absence-probe TPR by +33 pp and drops presence-probe TPR by 20 pp). On the more heavily RLHF-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct the asymmetry strengthens, not heals: parametric memory's behavioral advantage collapses while its absence-calibration deficit against retrieval widens -- an alignment tax on parametric user-memory. On real-data LaMP-3, gamma-LoRA underperforms a majority baseline; a 9-condition mitigation sweep diagnoses this as instruction-following collapse, not substrate failure (a 9x2 cross-product shows the eval-time {1..5} logit mask drives main_acc to >=0.995 on every recipe), and the best training-time fix replicates bit-identically on Llama. Finally, substrate-selection routing is question-classification, not calibration: a 110M DistilBERT on the question text alone beats every logit-based router. We contribute the diagnostic framework, the diagnosed real-data negative, the alignment-tax replication, and the routing-as-classification finding.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个诊断框架，揭示LLM用户侧记忆并非单一能力，而是至少包括行为一致性、事实存在和事实缺失三个正交轴。通过对比per-user gamma-LoRA与稠密检索（RAG）在50用户合成语料和真实数据LaMP-3上的表现，发现gamma-LoRA在行为风格上占优，RAG在事实缺失上占优，且两者在注意力层21-35的相同查询投影单元中起相反作用。在RLHF微调的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，不对称性加剧。最终提出基板选择路由实质是问题分类问题。
Motivation: 现有将用户侧记忆单一评分为“个性化”能力的方式掩盖了方向相反的失败模式，即记忆可分解为多个正交维度，而单一基板无法在所有维度上获胜。
Method: 构建诊断框架，定义三个记忆正交轴：行为一致性、事实存在和事实缺失；在50用户合成语料和LaMP-3数据集上，对比per-user gamma-LoRA与BGE-large稠密检索的表现，并通过因果干预（归零LoRA权重）分析注意力层的作用。
Result: gamma-LoRA在行为风格上胜出，RAG在事实缺失上胜出；归零LoRA权重使缺失探测TPR提升33个百分点，存在探测TPR下降20个百分点。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上不对称性增强。在LaMP-3上gamma-LoRA低于多数基线，经消融发现是指令跟随崩溃而非基板失败。最终一个110M DistilBERT在仅问题文本上超越所有基于logit的路由器。
Conclusion: 基板选择路由本质是问题分类而非校准；RLHF对齐会对参数记忆产生对齐税；诊断框架揭示了用户侧记忆的多维不对称性。

papers.title: Capacity-Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Delayed Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Online learning with delayed feedback typically assumes that the learner can track all pending rounds until their feedback arrives. In practice, tracking resources are finite, and feedback from untracked rounds is permanently lost. In this paper, we study delayed online convex optimization (OCO) under a hard capacity constraint, where at most $C$ pending rounds can be tracked at any time. To model delay information, we introduce a semi-clairvoyant model that refines the clairvoyant assumption from prior work: rather than requiring delays to be known at prediction time, the learner observes delay expirations online, consistent with the classical unconstrained delayed setting. Our approach proceeds via a reduction to a novel ``delayed and weighted'' OCO problem, using a scheduler that randomizes tracking decisions and importance-weights the resulting observations. For this base problem, we propose and analyze Delayed-Weighted FTRL and its bandit analogue, establishing regret bounds that explicitly characterize the interaction between time-varying weights and delayed feedback. Combining these base learners with our schedulers yields the first regret guarantees for capacity-constrained OCO under convex and strongly convex losses, for both first-order and bandit feedback. For first-order feedback, capacity $C = Ω(\log T)$ suffices to recover standard delayed OCO rates up to logarithmic factors. For bandit feedback, the regret rates are modulated by powers of $(1 + σ_{\text{max}}/C)$, where $σ_{\text{max}}$ is the maximum number of pending observations at any time. This allows the regret bound to degrade gracefully when $C < σ_{\text{max}}$, while remaining sublinear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了带硬容量约束的延迟在线凸优化（OCO）问题，其中最多同时跟踪C个待反馈轮次。提出一种半预知模型，通过将问题归约为“延迟加权”OCO问题，并设计调度器随机化跟踪决策和重要性加权观测。对于凸和强凸损失，分别在一阶反馈和bandit反馈下给出了首次遗憾界。
Motivation: 现有延迟反馈在线学习通常假设可以跟踪所有待反馈轮次，但实际中跟踪资源有限，未跟踪的反馈永久丢失。本文首次在硬容量约束下研究此问题，更具实践意义。
Method: 通过归约到一种新的“延迟加权”OCO问题，使用调度器随机化跟踪决策并对观测进行重要性加权。为基问题提出Delayed-Weighted FTRL及其bandit版本，并分析其遗憾界。
Result: 对于一阶反馈，容量C=Ω(log T)足以恢复标准延迟OCO速率（至多对数因子）。对于bandit反馈，遗憾率由(1+σ_max/C)的幂次调控，其中σ_max是任意时刻的最大待观测数，当C<σ_max时遗憾界优雅退化但仍保持次线性。
Conclusion: 首次为容量约束OCO提供了遗憾保证，覆盖凸和强凸损失，以及一阶和bandit反馈。遗憾界显式刻画了时变权重与延迟反馈的交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ERN-Net : Evolving Reason Node-Net for Document Binarization
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ERN-Net, an Evolving Reason Node-Net for efficient document image binarization. ERN-Net enhances degradation-sensitive regions, such as faint strokes, broken characters, and noisy backgrounds, through evolving reason nodes and multi-scale reasoning. We further compare ResNet-101, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ConvNeXt-Base, and find that ConvNeXt-Tiny provides the best practical trade-off between accuracy and memory usage. In addition, DIBCO-based pretraining improves binarization performance without increasing model memory consumption, requiring only about 1.5 additional training hours. Experiments on DIBCO-style benchmarks show that ERN-Net is effective under low-data and low-memory settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ERN-Net (Evolving Reason Node-Net)，一种用于文档图像二值化的高效网络。通过演化推理节点和多尺度推理增强退化敏感区域（如模糊笔画、破损字符和噪声背景）。比较发现 ConvNeXt-Tiny 在准确率和内存占用间取得最佳平衡；DIBCO 预训练可提升性能且几乎不增加内存消耗。在 DIBCO 风格基准上，ERN-Net 在低数据和低内存条件下表现有效。
Motivation: 现有文档二值化方法在处理微弱笔画、破损字符和噪声背景等退化区域时效果不佳，且对计算资源要求较高。
Method: 提出 ERN-Net，采用演化推理节点 (evolving reason nodes) 和多尺度推理模块增强退化区域；骨干网络选用 ConvNeXt-Tiny 以平衡精度与内存；并利用 DIBCO 数据集进行预训练（仅增加约1.5小时训练时间）。
Result: 在 DIBCO 系列基准上，ERN-Net 在低数据和低内存设置下有效，ConvNeXt-Tiny 方案在准确率和内存消耗间提供最佳实际权衡，DIBCO 预训练进一步改善性能而不增加推理内存。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ERN-Net 是一种轻量级且有效的文档二值化方法，特别适用于资源受限场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RLCSD: Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense, token-level supervision for reasoning models by aligning a model's own distribution with the distribution it produces under privileged context, typically a verified solution. However, we show that the learning signal drawn from this distributional gap concentrates on style tokens rather than task-bearing ones, as the hinted model tends to produce more direct, shorter outputs. We term this pathology \emph{privilege-induced style drift}, which destabilizes training or causes response length to shrink. To address this, we propose \textbf{RLCSD} (Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive on-policy Self-Distillation), which mitigates this drift by contrasting the teacher-student gap under a correct hint against that under a wrong hint, suppressing the style shift that conditioning on a hint tends to induce regardless of correctness, and yielding a signal that is more concentrated on task-bearing tokens. Experiments on Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) and Olmo-3-7B-Think across mathematical and logical reasoning show that RLCSD consistently outperforms GRPO and prior OPSD methods. We further show that the contrastive principle is general: it plugs into existing OPSD methods to improve them, and its underlying insight extends to the broader cross-model on-policy distillation setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLCSD（对比在线自蒸馏强化学习），解决在线自蒸馏（OPSD）中的“特权诱导风格漂移”问题，即对齐模型分布时学习信号集中在风格标记而非任务标记。RLCSD 通过对比正确提示和错误提示下的师生差异来抑制风格偏移，使信号更聚焦于任务标记。在 Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) 和 Olmo-3-7B-Think 上的数学与逻辑推理实验中，RLCSD 一致优于 GRPO 和现有 OPSD 方法，且对比原则可推广到跨模型在线蒸馏。
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏提供的密集 token 级监督信号受“特权诱导风格漂移”影响，导致训练不稳定或输出长度缩短，该问题源于对齐分布时风格标记占主导。
Method: 提出 RLCSD，通过对比正确提示与错误提示下的师生分布差异，去除仅因提示存在导致的风格偏移，保留任务相关信号。
Result: 在多个规模（1.7B-7B）的模型上，RLCSD 在数学与逻辑推理基准上均优于 GRPO 和先前 OPSD 方法，且可作为插件提升现有 OPSD 方法。
Conclusion: 对比原则可有效缓解风格漂移，提升在线自蒸馏效果，并适用于跨模型设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedCTA: A Benchmark for Clinical Tool Agents
papers.abstract_en: To make clinically grounded decisions, medical AI agents are expected to go beyond simple recognition and be capable of tool retrieval, evidence acquisition, and integration. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated perception or single-turn question answering, and therefore provide limited visibility into failures of planning, tool recruitment, and rollout reliability. We introduce MedCTA, a benchmark for evaluating medical tool agents on clinician-validated, step-implicit tasks grounded in realistic multimodal clinical inputs, including radiology images, pathology slides, and reports. MedCTA comprises 107 real-world clinical tasks with clinician-verified executable trajectories over 5 deployed tools, and supports process-aware evaluation of tool selection, argument validity, execution stability, trajectory fidelity, and outcome quality. We benchmark 18 open- and closed-source multimodal models and find that even frontier systems remain brittle in multi-step clinical tool use: autonomous rollouts are dominated by protocol failures, premature stopping, and incorrect tool recruitment, while gold-standard tool routing yields large but still incomplete gains. These results show that strong backbone perception does not translate into reliable agentic behavior in clinical settings. MedCTA provides a rigorous testbed for auditing, diagnosing, and advancing trustworthy medical AI agents. The dataset and evaluation suite are available at https://ivul-kaust.github.io/MedCTA/

papers.title: A Data-Centric Framework for Detecting and Correcting Corrupted Labels
papers.abstract_en: The performance of machine learning and deep learning models largely depends on the quality of the training data. However, the quality of the real-world datasets is often compromised by noisy labels, which can substantially degrade model accuracy and reliability. To address this challenge, we propose Relabeler, an end-to-end data-centric framework for detecting and correcting corrupted labels. For corrupted label detection, Relabeler jointly leverages both local and global relationships among data instances to identify potentially noisy samples. After detecting suspicious instances, Relabeler further performs label correction by estimating the most probable clean label for each instance based on both its input features and observed noisy label. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, noise types, and noise rates demonstrate that Relabeler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 58% improvement in label correction precision and 6% improvement in downstream task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Relabeler，一个端到端的数据中心框架，用于检测和纠正训练数据中的错误标签。该方法联合利用数据实例间的局部和全局关系来检测可疑样本，并基于输入特征和观测到的噪声标签估计最可能的干净标签。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集、噪声类型和噪声率下均优于基线，标签校正精度提升高达58%，下游任务性能提升6%。
Motivation: 现实世界数据集的标签质量常因噪声标签而受损，导致机器学习模型准确性和可靠性下降。现有方法在检测和纠正错误标签方面仍有不足。
Method: Relabeler框架包含两个阶段：首先，通过联合利用数据实例间的局部和全局关系检测潜在噪声样本；然后，对检测到的可疑实例，基于输入特征和观测到的噪声标签估计最可能的干净标签进行纠正。
Result: 在多个数据集、噪声类型和噪声率下，Relabeler在标签校正精度上最高提升58%，下游任务性能提升6%，一致优于现有基线方法。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了数据质量对模型性能的重要性，并展示了一种有效的端到端标签噪声处理框架。

papers.title: T2S: A Rehearsal-Based Approach for Extraction-Resistant Model Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Model watermarking safeguards AI model intellectual property by embedding distinctive knowledge that induces unique behavioral signatures. The primary technical challenge lies in ensuring watermark robustness against various post-processing attacks on the watermarked model. Model extraction attacks emerge as the most severe threat, where adversaries exploit prediction outputs to train surrogate models that illegally replicate the original model's functionality. In this work, we propose a rehearsal-based watermark embedding framework to enhance the robustness of model watermarks against model extraction attacks. By simulating the extraction process, our method leverages the loss of a \textit{simulated stolen model} on a trigger set as a training signal to fine-tune the watermark knowledge within the target model. This fine-tuning step encourages the watermark to be embedded in a way that boosts transferability, thereby increasing its chances of persisting and remaining detectable in stolen models. Comprehensive experiments conducted under diverse settings demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the robustness of model watermarks against both model extraction and subsequent watermark removal attacks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于排练（rehearsal）的模型水印嵌入框架，通过模拟模型提取过程，利用模拟被盗模型在触发集上的损失作为训练信号，微调目标模型中的水印知识，增强水印对模型提取攻击和后续移除攻击的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法显著提升了水印的持久性和可检测性。
Motivation: 模型提取攻击是水印鲁棒性面临的最严重威胁，现有水印方法难以抵抗此类攻击，本文旨在通过模拟提取过程来增强水印的迁移能力。
Method: 提出一个排练式水印嵌入框架：模拟提取攻击过程，将模拟被盗模型在触发集上的损失作为额外训练信号，联合微调目标模型，使水印知识更易迁移到被盗模型中。
Result: 在多种设置下的综合实验表明，该方法显著提升了水印对模型提取攻击及后续水印移除攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过模拟提取过程进行排练微调，能有效增强水印的鲁棒性，为抵御模型提取攻击提供了新思路。

papers.title: Noise-Aware Framework for Correcting Corrupted Labels
papers.abstract_en: High-quality labeled data is essential for training reliable ML/DL models. However, real-world datasets often contain a considerable proportion of corrupted labels, which can severely degrade model performance. To address this problem, we propose CANOLA, a novel framework for correcting corrupted labels through noise-aware learning and iterative label refinement. CANOLA explicitly estimates the underlying noise distribution of the dataset and incorporates this information into the training of a noise-aware Deep Neural Network. By incorporating noise characteristics during learning, CANOLA enables the model to down-weight unreliable supervision signals and focus on trustworthy patterns, thereby improving robustness and generalization. Label correction is performed via cautious, iterative soft label refinement, in which model predictions are blended with observed labels to prevent premature or erroneous updates. This progressive refinement allows the dataset to be repaired in a stable and controlled manner. We evaluate CANOLA on six widely used datasets under realistic noisy labeling scenarios. Experimental results show that CANOLA consistently outperforms SOTA label correction methods, achieving relative improvements ranging from 19% to 52% in error reduction. Moreover, models trained on datasets corrected by CANOLA obtain substantial downstream performance gains. Even simple classifiers trained on CANOLA's corrected data can outperform complex model-centric approaches by margins of up to 67%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANOLA 框架，通过噪声感知学习和迭代标签修正来纠正数据集中的损坏标签。该框架显式估计噪声分布，并在训练中利用该信息降低不可靠监督信号的权重，从而提升模型鲁棒性。在六个数据集上，CANOLA 在误差降低方面相对现有最优方法提升 19% 至 52%。
Motivation: 现实数据集常包含大量损坏标签，严重降低模型性能。现有方法在标签修正精度和稳定性上仍有不足。
Method: 提出 CANOLA 框架，包含噪声分布估计、噪声感知 DNN 训练以及谨慎的迭代软标签修正，将模型预测与观测标签混合以避免过早错误更新。
Result: 在六个数据集上，CANOLA 相比现有最优标签修正方法，误差降低相对提升 19%–52%。用修正后数据训练的简单分类器性能可超越复杂模型中心方法达 67%。
Conclusion: 噪声感知学习与迭代软标签修正能有效修复损坏标签，显著提升下游模型性能，且方法具有通用性。

papers.title: Spectrally Regularized Latent Flow Matching for Turbulence Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion and flow matching have emerged as leading approaches for synthetic turbulence generation, yet they systematically under-represent dissipation-range amplitudes. We introduce a latent flow matching framework with a spectrally regularized compression stage that directly targets this failure mode. On a 256^2 DNS dataset at Re_f \approx 2250, replacing an MSE-trained VAE with a zone-weighted log-spectral objective raises deep-dissipation retained spectral power from 25% to 94% in reconstruction and from 20% to 79% in unconditional generation. The improved latent representation also yields a substantially better sampling cost-fidelity tradeoff: the MSE-trained latent space imposes a fundamental quality ceiling near DD bias -0.70 that no integrator or step-count can overcome, while the spectrally regularized latent space reaches DD bias -0.117 at just 20 function evaluations. Mechanistically, encoder-decoder swap experiments show that the improvement is driven primarily by encoder-induced latent reorganization rather than decoder capacity, while a support-amplitude decomposition reveals that MSE-trained models behave as conservative suppression models, minimizing pointwise error by attenuating intermittent high-wavenumber structure. Both pipelines recover the second-order structure function and the correct sign of S_3, indicating the correct cascade direction without explicit supervision. A small residual gap in the magnitude of S_3 suggests that phase-coherent triadic organization remains a complementary axis to amplitude fidelity for future generative turbulence models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜扩散和流匹配方法在湍流生成中系统性低估耗散区幅度的问题，提出一种光谱正则化潜流匹配框架。通过在压缩阶段引入区域加权对数谱目标，在Re_f≈2250的256² DNS数据集上，深度耗散保留谱功率从25%提升至94%（重建）和20%提升至79%（无条件生成）。光谱正则化潜空间在仅20次函数评估时达到DD偏差-0.117，而MSE训练的潜空间存在-0.70的质量上限。
Motivation: 现有潜扩散和流匹配方法在合成湍流生成中系统性地低估耗散区幅度，导致高频结构丢失，限制了生成质量的进一步提升。
Method: 提出一种光谱正则化潜流匹配框架，用区域加权对数谱目标替代MSE训练VAE，在压缩阶段直接优化耗散区谱功率保留。
Result: 在256² DNS数据集上，深度耗散保留谱功率从25%提升至94%（重建）和20%提升至79%（无条件生成）；光谱正则化潜空间在20次函数评估时DD偏差达-0.117，而MSE潜空间上限为-0.70。
Conclusion: 编码器诱导的潜在重组织是改进的主要驱动，而非解码器容量；MSE模型表现为保守抑制模型。两种方法均恢复二阶结构函数和S₃符号，但S₃幅度仍有残差，表明相位相干三元组织是未来补充方向。

papers.title: RankVR: Low-Rank Structure Perception and Value Recalibration for Robust Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) constitutes a pivotal paradigm requiring models to perform joint reasoning on reference images and modification texts. However, the prevalence of Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC) in large-scale datasets severely constrains model performance. Existing denoising methods either target binary mismatches or rely on scalar-based point-wise estimation, neglecting rich global structural correlations among sample populations and dynamic value variations during training, thereby yielding suboptimal results. This paper identifies two critical unresolved challenges: Global Structural Inconsistency of Semantic Correlations and Hard Sample Discrimination Uncertainty. To address these, we propose RankVR, a framework designed to construct a robust CIR model via global structure consistency and dynamic value perception. Specifically, we introduce the Global Structure Consistency Perception (GSCP) module, which utilizes the Effective Rank of the Correlation Matrix to decouple clean samples from structural noise. By measuring rank difference, GSCP identifies samples disrupting macroscopic semantic symmetry. Furthermore, we develop the Adaptive Semantic Value Calibration (ASVC) module to distinguish high-value hard clean samples. By integrating training potential and reliability, it dynamically quantifies the semantic value of each triplet, ensuring effective utilization of hard samples while suppressing noise characterized by logical conflicts. Extensive experiments on the FashionIQ and CIRR benchmark datasets demonstrate that RankVR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, validating its superior robustness in noisy environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对组合图像检索（CIR）中的噪声三元组对应（NTC）问题，提出RankVR框架，通过全局结构一致性感知（GSCP）和自适应语义值校准（ASVC）两个模块，分别利用相关矩阵的有效秩解耦干净样本与结构噪声，并动态量化三元组的语义价值，在FashionIQ和CIRR数据集上显著超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有去噪方法忽视全局结构相关性和动态值变化，导致次优结果；本文识别了全局结构不一致性和困难样本判别不确定性两个关键挑战。
Method: 提出GSCP模块，利用相关矩阵的有效秩识别破坏宏观语义对称性的样本；提出ASVC模块，结合训练潜力和可靠性动态量化每个三元组的语义价值，在利用困难样本的同时抑制逻辑冲突噪声。
Result: 在FashionIQ和CIRR基准数据集上，RankVR显著优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在噪声环境下的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过全局结构一致性和动态值感知构建鲁棒CIR模型，有效应对噪声三元组对应问题。

summary_sections.result: 在FashionIQ和CIRR基准数据集上，RankVR显著优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在噪声环境下的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过全局结构一致性和动态值感知构建鲁棒CIR模型，有效应对噪声三元组对应问题。

papers.title: Goal-Autopilot: A Verifiable Anti-Fabrication Firewall for Unattended Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents are not trusted to run unattended: with no human watching, they confidently report success they never verified. We treat honesty -- bounding what an agent may claim at termination -- as a first-class metric for unattended autonomy, distinct from capability. We present Autopilot, an execution model that makes silent fabricated success structurally impossible rather than merely rarer. Autopilot externalizes all working state into a durable, gated finite-state machine that a scheduler advances one stateless tick at a time; a hard floor forbids any terminal "done" claim whose falsifiable gate did not actually execute and pass. We prove a No-False-Success theorem -- under gate soundness, floor enforcement, and plan coverage, termination implies the goal holds -- whose only trust points are empirically measurable, and show the worst case degrades to an honest stall, never a fabricated success. Because each tick rehydrates only the state machine, per-step context cost is constant in the horizon. Across a 3,150-cell paired corpus (70 tasks $\times$ 3 systems $\times$ 3 models $\times$ 5 seeds, including 50 SWE-bench Lite tasks across 11 OSS repos), Autopilot fabricates on 0.95% of cells [95% CI 0.38--1.62] while Reflexion and StateFlow baselines fabricate on 8.10% [6.48--9.81] and 25.05% [22.48--27.62] respectively. The headline contrast lives in the hard regime: on SWE-bench Lite, the firewall reduces fabrication from 33.7% (StateFlow) to 0.67%, a paired difference of $-33.07$ pp [95% CI $-36.53, -29.73$]. The mechanism is the gate, not the model: all ten Autopilot fabrications come from the strongest model, while two weaker mid-tier models never fabricate across 700 paired cells. The firewall trades coverage for honesty by design -- an honest stall is recoverable; a confident wrong output shipped downstream is not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Autopilot 执行模型，将长期 LLM agent 的所有工作状态外部化到可持久化的门控有限状态机，通过硬性 floor 禁止任何未通过可证伪门的终止声称，从而在结构上杜绝虚假成功。实验表明 Autopilot 的假造率仅为 0.95%，远低于 Reflexion 的 8.10% 和 StateFlow 的 25.05%，且在 SWE-bench Lite 上从 33.7% 降至 0.67%。
Motivation: 长期 LLM agent 在无人监督时可能虚假报告成功，缺乏可验证的诚实性，现有方法无法保证结构上不可能产生虚假成功。
Method: 提出 Autopilot，将 agent 工作状态外部化为持久化的门控有限状态机，调度器以无状态 tick 推进，硬性禁止任何未通过可证伪门的终止声称。证明 No-False-Success 定理，信任点可经验测量。
Result: 在 3150 个单元实验（含 50 个 SWE-bench Lite 任务）中，Autopilot 假造率 0.95% [0.38–1.62]，Reflexion 8.10% [6.48–9.81]，StateFlow 25.05% [22.48–27.62]；SWE-bench Lite 上 Autopilot 假造率 0.67%，StateFlow 33.7%，差异 -33.07 pp。所有假造来自最强模型，两弱模型从未假造。
Conclusion: 机制是门控而非模型本身；诚实停滞可恢复，虚假成功不可恢复。设计以覆盖率为代价换取诚实性。

papers.title: DroneShield-AI: A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Framework for Real-Time Autonomous Drone Threat Detection, Behavioral Intent Classification, and Swarm Intelligence in Contested Airspace
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) threats have emerged as a defining security challenge of the 21st century. This paper presents DroneShield-AI, a unified open framework integrating six processing layers: RF signal classification, acoustic motor-signature detection, YOLOv8-based visual detection, evidence-weighted sensor fusion, a Behavioral Intent Classification Engine (BICE), and a Graph Neural Network Swarm Intelligence Module (GNN-SIM). BICE introduces the first systematic six-class threat taxonomy for drone flight patterns, enabling predictive operator alerts with a 30-second advance-warning horizon. GNN-SIM is the first open framework for adversarial multi-drone formation analysis using Graph Attention Networks. Evaluated on three publicly available real-world datasets, the fused pipeline achieves 96.1% detection accuracy, 3.2% false alarm rate, AUC-ROC: 0.981, and 142ms end-to-end latency on commodity CPU-class hardware at approximately $500-$780 USD total system cost. All code, model weights, and simulation datasets are publicly released at submission.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code available at https://github.com/bayizeremarius/DroneShield-AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DroneShield-AI，一个多模态传感器融合框架，集成 RF 信号分类、声学电机特征检测、YOLOv8 视觉检测、证据加权融合、行为意图分类引擎（BICE）和图神经网络群体智能模块（GNN-SIM），用于实时无人机威胁检测和意图识别。BICE 首次系统定义六类无人机威胁飞行模式，可提前 30 秒预警；GNN-SIM 是首个开源的多无人机编队对抗分析工具。在三个公开真实数据集上，融合管道在低成本硬件上达到 96.1% 检测精度、3.2% 虚警率、AUC-ROC 0.981 及 142ms 端到端延迟。所有代码、模型权重和仿真数据集均已开源。
Motivation: 无人机威胁已成为 21 世纪关键安全挑战，现有系统缺乏统一的多模态融合框架，且无法进行行为意图预测和群体智能分析。
Method: 框架包含六个处理层：RF 信号分类、声学电机特征检测、YOLOv8 视觉检测、证据加权传感器融合、行为意图分类引擎（BICE）以及基于图注意力网络的群体智能模块（GNN-SIM）。
Result: 在三个公开真实数据集上，融合管道实现 96.1% 检测准确率、3.2% 虚警率、AUC-ROC 0.981，以及 142ms 端到端延迟，系统总成本约 $500-$780 美元。
Conclusion: DroneShield-AI 是首个开源的多模态融合框架，可同时进行无人机检测、行为意图分类和群体编队分析，并公开全部代码与数据以促进可复现研究。

papers.title: Layer-Isolated Evaluation: Gating the Deterministic Scaffold of a Production LLM Agent with a No-LLM, Regression-Locked Test Harness
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end task-success is the dominant way to evaluate LLM agents, but one aggregate number tells you that an agent regressed, not where. We present layer-isolated evaluation: a deployed ordering agent is decomposed into a fixed taxonomy of layers (ontology, intent, routing, decomposition, escalation, safety, memory, and cross-cutting envelope/defense), each exercised by its own assertion slice in a deterministic, no-LLM "pure" mode. The pure suite (238 cases across 23 slices; 225 run in 2.39 s, ~10 ms/case) runs in CI on every change against a locked per-slice baseline. We validate by controlled regression injection, degrading one layer at a time across seven non-safety layers. The effect we did not design in is masking: the aggregate pass-rate barely moves (-1.7 to -5.9 pp for six local regressions), while the matching slice craters (-25 to -91 pp). A layer's slice reacting to its own fault is partly by construction; the measured results are (i) the aggregate masking and (ii) that damage stays off the other slices: the injected layer's slice is the single worst-hit in 5 of 7 cases and top-3 in 7 of 7 (mean rank 1.29 of 19). Localization replicates on a second, structurally different tenant (Starbucks SG): all seven matching slices crater, so it is not a single-catalog artifact. We position it as a concrete, deterministic instantiation of the component-level evaluation EDDOps prescribes but leaves unimplemented, with CheckList as ancestor and as the deterministic mirror image of whole-workflow stochastic mutation testing. Our contributions: (a) a fully decomposed, sub-second, no-LLM per-layer harness for a production agent, (b) a coverage-honesty test-adequacy criterion that refuses to score an unexercised layer, and (c) the regression-injection demonstration that per-slice baseline-locked gates localize regressions an aggregate metric masks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层隔离评估方法，将生产级LLM代理分解为固定分类层（本体、意图、路由、分解、升级、安全、记忆、跨切面包裹/防御），每层由独立断言切片在确定性、无LLM的“纯”模式下测试。纯套件包含23个切片的238个案例，225个在2.39秒内运行（约10毫秒/案例）。通过受控回归注入验证，发现聚合指标掩盖了局部回归（-1.7到-5.9百分点），而匹配切片大幅下降（-25到-91百分点）。定位效果在另一租户（Starbucks SG）上复现。该方法作为EDDOps规定的组件级评估的具体确定性实例。
Motivation: 端到端任务成功率只能指示代理是否退化，却无法定位退化位置，存在聚合指标掩盖局部回归的问题。
Method: 将LLM代理分解为固定分类层（本体、意图、路由、分解、升级、安全、记忆、跨切面包裹/防御），每层由确定性无LLM的纯模式断言切片独立测试，在CI中每次变更时运行并与锁定基线比较。
Result: 纯套件238案例225在2.39秒内运行（约10毫秒/案例）。受控回归注入显示：聚合通过率仅下降1.7-5.9百分点，而匹配切片下降25-91百分点；注入层的切片在5/7情况下是唯一最差，在7/7情况排名前三（平均排名1.29/19）。在另一租户上复现。
Conclusion: 本文贡献了（a）完全分解的亚秒级无LLM每层测试夹具，（b）拒绝给未锻炼层打分的覆盖诚实测试充分性标准，（c）通过回归注入证明每切片基线锁定门控能定位聚合指标掩盖的回归。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reason, Then Re-reason: Cross-view Revisiting Improves Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning from egocentric videos is inherently challenging because the observable evidence is constrained by the camera trajectory. Existing methods rely on single-turn inference, forcing models to resolve geometric ambiguity through semantic priors rather than verifiable evidence. We argue that spatial reasoning should be revisitable: conclusions formed under limited evidence should remain open to revision when complementary viewpoints become available. Building on this insight, we propose Reason, then Re-reason (ReRe), a training-free, inference-time framework with two phases: in the Reason Phase, an MLLM forms a spatial hypothesis from the original video; in the Re-reason Phase, it verifies or revises the hypothesis by observing a synthesized novel-view video. To enable effective cross-view revisiting, we design a Geometry-to-Video pipeline that renders strategically complementary novel views from predicted 3D geometry. These views feature an elevated, oblique perspective with scene-spanning coverage, while preserving the MLLM's native video interface without architectural modifications. Extensive evaluations on VSI-Bench and STI-Bench demonstrate that ReRe substantially boosts open-source MLLMs to rival proprietary state-of-the-art performance. Project page: https://zhenjiemao.github.io/ReRe/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Reason, then Re-reason (ReRe)框架，通过两阶段推理提升多模态大模型在自我中心视频中的空间推理能力：首阶段从原始视频生成空间假设，次阶段利用预测的3D几何合成互补视角的新视频进行验证或修正。无需训练，仅在推理时运行。在VSI-Bench和STI-Bench上显著提升开源MLLM性能，接近专有模型。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖单轮推理，模型只能通过语义先验解决几何歧义，缺乏可验证的证据。本文认为空间推理应当可重新审视：当补充视角可用时，先前基于有限证据的结论应保持开放。
Method: 提出ReRe框架：Reason阶段，MLLM从原始视频形成空间假设；Re-reason阶段，通过观察合成的新视角视频验证或修正假设。设计Geometry-to-Video管线，从预测的3D几何渲染战略性互补视角（高空倾斜视角、场景全覆盖），并保持MLLM的原生视频接口。
Result: 在VSI-Bench和STI-Bench上，ReRe大幅提升开源MLLM性能，使其与专有SOTA模型相媲美。
Conclusion: 强调空间推理应支持可重新审视的机制，跨视角验证可有效提升推理准确性。
Relevance: 0
