papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adapter Tuning for Tabular-Image Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular-image multimodal learning aims to improve predictive modeling by jointly using structured tabular attributes and visual data. Although pretrained encoders provide strong modality-specific representations, full fine-tuning can be computationally expensive, while keeping encoders frozen may limit task-specific adaptation. We propose the Tabular-Image Adapter (TI-Adapter), a modality-specific adapter-based fine-tuning framework for efficient multimodal adaptation. TI-Adapter freezes the pretrained tabular encoder and learns an adapter after the extracted tabular embedding, while adapting the image branch with embedding-level and bottleneck-level adapters instead of full fine-tuning. Experiments on 20 tabular-image datasets show that TI-Adapter achieves competitive or better predictive performance than full fine-tuning while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. Ablation studies further demonstrate the importance of adapter placement for balancing performance and practical efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tabular-Image Adapter (TI-Adapter)，一种针对表格-图像多模态学习的参数高效微调框架。TI-Adapter 冻结预训练的表格编码器，在其嵌入后添加适配器，同时对图像分支使用嵌入级和瓶颈级适配器，避免全微调。在20个表格-图像数据集上，TI-Adapter 以远少于全微调的可训练参数实现了相当或更好的预测性能。
Motivation: 全微调多模态预训练编码器计算成本高，而冻结编码器可能限制任务特定适应，需要一种高效的微调方法。
Method: TI-Adapter 冻结表格编码器，仅在其嵌入后学习一个适配器；图像分支则采用嵌入级和瓶颈级适配器，不进行全微调。
Result: 在20个表格-图像数据集上，TI-Adapter 达到与全微调相当或更优的预测性能，且可训练参数显著减少。
Conclusion: 适配器放置位置对平衡性能与效率至关重要，TI-Adapter 提供了一种实用的多模态微调方案。

papers.title: Organize then Retrieve: Hierarchical Memory Navigation for Efficient Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their inherent statelessness, requiring all task-relevant information to be encoded in growing input contexts. The resulting degraded reasoning quality, increased inference cost, and higher latency necessitate efficient working memory mechanisms. However, existing approaches either rely on lossy compression or similarity-based retrieval, which often fail to capture temporal structure and causal dependencies required for multi-step agentic tasks. In this work, we present HORMA, a Hierarchical Organize-and-Retrieve Memory Agent that organizes experience into a file-system-like hierarchical structure, where summarized entities are linked to the corresponding raw trajectories, enabling efficient access without losing detailed information. HORMA decomposes working memory into two stages: structured memory construction and navigation-based retrieval. The construction module iteratively refines how experiences are structured by distinguishing between failures caused by missing information and those caused by misleading or overloaded context. The navigation module retrieves task-relevant context by traversing the hierarchy using a lightweight agent trained with reinforcement learning to select minimal yet sufficient context, thereby reducing latency along the critical execution path. Across ALFWorld, LoCoMo, and LongMemEval, HORMA improves task performance under constrained context budgets while requiring at most 22.17% of the baseline token usage in long conversation tasks. Compared to existing methods, it consistently achieves better efficiency-performance trade-offs and generalizes effectively to unseen tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HORMA，一种层次化组织与检索记忆智能体，将经验组织成类似文件系统的层次结构，支持高效检索而不丢失细节。通过强化学习训练的轻量级导航器选择最小充分上下文，在ALFWorld等基准上提升任务性能，仅用基线22.17%的token量。
Motivation: LLM智能体因无状态性导致长程任务中推理质量下降、推理成本增加，现有方法要么有损压缩，要么基于相似性检索，难以捕捉时间结构和因果依赖。
Method: 将工作记忆分为两阶段：结构化记忆构建（迭代区分失败原因以优化经验结构）和基于导航的检索（用强化学习训练轻量级智能体遍历层次结构，选择最小充分上下文）。
Result: 在ALFWorld、LoCoMo和LongMemEval上，HORMA在有限上下文预算下提升任务性能，长对话任务中仅使用基线22.17%的token，实现更优的效率-性能权衡并泛化到未见任务。
Conclusion: 层次化组织与导航式检索能有效解决LLM智能体的长程任务记忆问题，兼顾效率与性能。

papers.title: Neural-Parameterized Cellular Automata for Wildfire Spread
papers.abstract_en: Traditional wildfire models rely on rigid, low-dimensional parameters and static fuel maps, frequently underpredicting fire spread. To address this weakness, we introduce a hybrid deep-learning parameterized Probabilistic Cellular Automata (CA) framework implemented in JAX. Our approach employs a Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network to dynamically generate spatially varying parameters that govern fire-spread probability, wind alignment, and slope influence. This hybrid design captures complex, nonlinear environmental interactions while preserving the physical interpretability of the underlying three-state CA. The JAX implementation enables hardware acceleration and gradient-based parameter calibration. Evaluated on six large-scale wildfires in the western United States, the model maintains IoU > 0.6 over 72-hour forecast horizons after a 10-day data assimilation window during which the model is fitted incrementally to observed perimeters; the resulting forecast is a conditional projection of fire growth under the suppression regime already ncoded in those observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合深度学习参数化的概率元胞自动机框架，用于模拟野火蔓延。该框架使用多尺度卷积神经网络动态生成空间变化的参数，控制火势蔓延概率、风向和坡度影响，并在JAX中实现以支持硬件加速和梯度校准。在六场美国西部大型野火上的评估显示，模型在10天数据同化窗口后，72小时预报期内IoU>0.6。
Motivation: 传统野火模型依赖刚性低维参数和静态燃料图，经常低估火势蔓延，需要更灵活且物理可解释的模型。
Method: 提出混合深度学习参数化的概率元胞自动机（CA）框架，使用多尺度CNN动态生成空间变化的CA参数，并在JAX中实现。
Result: 在六场美国西部大型野火上，模型在10天数据同化窗口后，72小时预报期内保持IoU>0.6。
Conclusion: 该混合设计在保持物理可解释性的同时捕捉复杂非线性环境交互，JAX实现支持高效校准和预报。

papers.title: Lung-R1: A Knowledge Graph-Guided LLM for Pulmonary Diagnostic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing pulmonary diseases requires integrating heterogeneous evidence amid phenotypic variability and cross-disease overlap. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown progress on pulmonary knowledge question answering (QA) and information-processing tasks, reliable pulmonary diagnosis requires patient-specific, relation-aware reasoning over electronic medical record (EMR) evidence rather than isolated knowledge recall. We define this gap between pulmonary knowledge and case-level diagnostic reasoning as the Pulmonary Knowledge-to-Diagnosis Gap. To address it, we introduce LungKG, the first structured pulmonary knowledge graph for diagnostic knowledge organization and record-grounded reasoning. LungKG contains 59,038 nodes and 164,308 edges across 15 entity types and 112 relation types, serving as both a reusable pulmonary knowledge resource and the foundation for LungKG-guided model adaptation. Built on LungKG, we propose Lung-R1, a LungKG-guided pulmonary LLM trained through KG-constrained reasoning-chain construction and KG-guided reinforcement learning. In a 20-system evaluation, Lung-R1-14B achieves state-of-the-art performance across Choice, Pulmonary-QA, and EMR Diagnosis, reaching an EMR Diagnosis score of 4.3583 and surpassing the strongest non-Lung-R1 baseline by 0.1476 points. These results demonstrate the value of LungKG-guided training for EMR-based pulmonary diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LungKG，第一个用于肺部诊断的结构化知识图谱，包含 59,038 个节点和 164,308 条边，覆盖 15 种实体类型和 112 种关系类型。基于 LungKG，作者训练了 Lung-R1 模型，通过 KG 约束的推理链构建和 KG 引导的强化学习，在电子病历诊断任务上达到 4.3583 分，超越最强基线 0.1476 分。

Method: 构建结构化肺部知识图谱 LungKG，并基于此提出 Lung-R1 模型，采用 KG 约束的推理链构建和 KG 引导的强化学习进行训练。

Conclusion: 结果证明了 LungKG 引导的训练对于基于电子病历的肺部诊断的价值。

papers.title: SpAArSIST: Sparsified AASIST for Efficient and Reliable Anti-Spoofing
papers.abstract_en: We present SpAArSIST, a deployment-oriented refinement of the widely used AASIST graph pooling backend for self-supervised learning (SSL) based anti-spoofing. Motivated by redundant operations in public implementations, we replace learned pooling and stack-node attention with explicit, lightweight choices: separate train and inference graph pooling ratios $(k_{\mathrm{tr}},k_{\mathrm{inf}})$, magnitude-based node scoring, and mean aggregation of graph nodes. The best overall configuration (rank 1) cuts backend compute by 20.7% (195.045M $\rightarrow$ 154.706M MACs) and model size by 4.1% (611.8k $\rightarrow$ 586.4k params), while improving out-of-domain robustness on In-the-Wild to 2.82% EER and 0.078 minDCF (from 4.64% and 0.133) and remaining competitive on ASVspoof5. We further provide a composite selection score that summarizes accuracy, calibration, and compute to support balanced deployment-oriented model choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于自监督学习的反欺骗系统，对AASIST图池化后端进行部署导向的稀疏化改造。通过替代可学习池化和堆叠节点注意力为显式轻量选择（分离训练和推理池化比率、基于幅度的节点评分、均值聚合），最佳配置将后端计算减少20.7%，模型大小减少4.1%，同时将域外数据集In-the-Wild的等错误率从4.64%降至2.82%，并在ASVspoof5上保持竞争力。此外，论文提出一个综合选择分数，用于平衡精度、校准和计算开销的部署模型选择。
Motivation: 公共实现中存在冗余操作，导致AASIST模型在部署时计算和存储成本过高，且域外鲁棒性不足。
Method: 替换learned pooling和stack-node attention为显式轻量选择：使用分离的训练和推理图池化比率(k_tr, k_inf)、基于幅度的节点评分、以及图节点的均值聚合。
Result: 最佳配置（rank 1）后端MACs降低20.7%（195.045M→154.706M），参数量减少4.1%（611.8k→586.4k）；In-the-Wild上EER从4.64%降至2.82%，minDCF从0.133降至0.078；ASVspoof5上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过显式轻量选择可以显著降低计算开销并提升域外鲁棒性，同时提出综合选择分数以支持部署导向的模型权衡。

papers.title: Higher-Order Token Interactions via Quantum Attention
papers.abstract_en: Standard dot-product self-attention computes, in a single layer, only pairwise (order-2) interactions between tokens; representing a generic order-$k$ interaction is known to require either super-quadratic resources in one layer or composition across depth. We introduce \textbf{Quantum Higher-Order Attention (QHA)}, a shallow, hardware-realizable quantum attention head that, via data re-uploading and an all-to-all non-Clifford entangler, synthesizes order-$k$ token interactions inside the circuit and exposes them through a local single-qubit read-out. We prove (i) an expressivity separation: any single standard self-attention layer with embedding dimension $m$, $H$ heads and $p$-bit precision satisfying $mHp=o(N/\log\log N)$ cannot represent the order-$k$ correlation family that one QHA head represents with circuit depth $O(\log k)$ ($O(k)$ two-qubit gates); and (ii) a trainability guarantee for its local-design instantiation: with a local read-out and $O(\log n)$ depth the gradient variance is $Ω(1/\mathrm{poly}(n))$ (no barren plateau), which we confirm empirically -- while being explicit that the more expressive all-to-all instantiation we benchmark is trained empirically and shows exponentially decaying gradients. Empirically, at a $6.5\times$ smaller parameter budget, QHA generalizes hidden-subset parity of every order $k\le6$ from disjoint inputs, whereas the larger classical attention head collapses past order~2; consistent with theory, the size of the advantage tracks the target's Fourier degree - largest for parity and shrinking when low-order structure is present. As an application, QHA serves as a compact high-order interaction detector across three domains - genetic epistasis, learning-parity-with-noise, and graph triangle detection - reaching the noise ceiling at the smallest parameter budget where field-standard linear methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子高阶注意力（QHA），通过数据重上传和非Clifford纠缠器在单层电路中实现token间任意k阶交互，理论证明其在表达能力上优于经典自注意力，并给出可训练性保证。实验表明，QHA在更少参数下能泛化高阶奇偶性任务，并在遗传上位、带噪学习奇偶、三角检测等应用中作为紧凑的高阶交互检测器。
Motivation: 标准自注意力单层只能捕获二阶交互，高阶交互需超二次资源或深层网络，现有方法效率低。量子机器学习有望提供更高效的解决方案。
Method: 提出QHA，使用数据重上传和全连接非Clifford纠缠器，通过浅层量子电路合成k阶交互，并通过局部单量子比特读取输出。理论分析包括表达能力分离和可训练性保证。
Result: 理论证明经典自注意力在特定条件下无法表示QHA单头表示的k阶相关族；实验显示QHA在6.5倍更少参数下泛化隐藏子集奇偶性至k≤6，而经典注意力在k>2时失效；在三个应用中达到噪声下限且参数最少。
Conclusion: QHA是一种高效的量子注意力机制，能紧凑表示高阶交互，但全连接实例化存在指数级梯度衰减问题，局部设计则无贫瘠高原。

papers.title: Can Open-Source LLM Agents Replace Static Application Security Testing Tools? An Empirical Assessment
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the value of agentic AI tools for cybersecurity purposes. We evaluate the efficacy of a general-purpose GenAI Large Language Model- (GenAI-) based agent when powered by three different Ollama-hosted general-purpose open source models. We assess each agent's performance using precision, recall, false positive count, and a calculated composite score based upon the interplay of the captured metrics, against the baseline performance of an existing, vetted Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tool, Bandit. Our findings refute the notion that a modern open-source GenAI LLM-based agent is currently suitable for the specialized task of SAST scanning under realistic conditions.
papers.comment: Keywords: Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Large Language Models, Static Application Security Testing, Model performance evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证评估了基于开源大语言模型（LLM）的agent在静态应用安全测试（SAST）任务中的性能，与现有工具Bandit进行对比。使用三个Ollama托管的通用开源模型，指标包括精确率、召回率、假阳性数和复合分数。结果表明，当前开源GenAI LLM agent在现实条件下不适合替代专用SAST工具。
Motivation: 探索agentic AI工具（尤其是通用开源LLM）在网络安全领域的实际价值，验证其能否替代成熟的SAST工具。
Method: 构建基于三种不同Ollama托管的通用开源LLM的GenAI agent，在SAST扫描任务上评估其性能，并与基线工具Bandit比较。

papers.title: Runtime Skill Audit: Targeted Runtime Probing for Agent Skill Security
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills let LLM agents reuse instructions, resources, tools, and workflows, but they also create a new place for malicious behavior to hide. A skill may look benign in its documentation or code while becoming harmful only when it is invoked with particular user requests, local assets, persistent state, or multi-step tool interactions. This makes purely static vetting brittle. We present Runtime Skill Audit (RSA), a dynamic analysis method that audits skills by asking what the skill-mediated agent actually does under targeted runtime conditions. Instead of testing every skill with the same generic tasks, RSA profiles risk-relevant interfaces, prepares the execution context needed to exercise them, and assigns security labels from the resulting trace evidence. We instantiate RSA on OpenClaw and evaluate it on 100 skills against representative static baselines. RSA achieves 90.0\% accuracy with an 88.0\% true positive rate and an 8.0\% false positive rate, improving accuracy by 13.0 percentage points over the best static baseline. Under self-evolving attacks, static detectors collapse after one or two rounds, while RSA continues to detect 19--20 out of 20 malicious skills across rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理技能中隐藏恶意行为的问题，提出运行时技能审计（RSA）方法，通过动态分析技能在特定运行时条件下的实际行为来检测恶意技能。在OpenClaw平台上对100个技能进行评估，RSA达到90.0%的准确率，比最佳静态基线提高13个百分点，且在自我进化攻击下仍能稳定检测。
Motivation: 现有静态审核无法检测仅在特定用户请求、本地资产、持久状态或多步工具交互时才会触发的恶意行为，导致安全漏洞。
Method: RSA通过分析风险相关接口、准备执行上下文并基于追踪证据分配安全标签，实现针对性的运行时探测，而非对所有技能使用相同的通用测试任务。
Result: 在OpenClaw上对100个技能的评估中，RSA准确率90.0%，真正率88.0%，假正率8.0%，比最佳静态基线准确率高13个百分点；在自我进化攻击下，静态检测器在一两轮后失效，而RSA每轮仍能检测19-20个恶意技能。

papers.title: ARGUS: Stacked Multi-View Identity Mosaic Injection for Subject-Preserving Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Subject-preserving video generation is not solved by frontal-face similarity alone: a generated person must remain recognizable across motion, large viewpoint changes, expression shifts, occlusion, scale variation, and conflicts among text, first-frame, and identity references. We argue that the central bottleneck is the point-reference paradigm, which collapses identity into a single static observation entangled with pose, accessories, lighting, background, and camera statistics. We introduce Argus, a Wan-based framework centered on Stacked Multi-View Identity Mosaic Injection (SMII). SMII converts MLLM-selected image/video identity evidence into a 3*3 stacked mosaic, synchronizes the mosaic with the current diffusion time, and injects it as negative-time read-only memory in Wan's native token space. This turns identity from an external clean adapter or a single reference image into a compact dynamic distribution. Around SMII, an MLLM Identity Director selects informative identity moments and resolves condition conflicts, while no-cross-pair counterfactual training, Temporal Identity Annealing, and Adaptive Self-Likeness Guidance improve robustness without paired subject-video supervision. We further release HardID-Celeb, a public-figure identity-stress benchmark, and introduce YawScore and OccScore to probe large-yaw and first-frame-occlusion robustness. Argus achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenS2V-Eval Human-Domain, reaching 64.38 Total Score, 71.86 FaceSim, 51.62 NexusScore, and 79.14 NaturalScore. On HardID-Celeb, Argus obtains 76.80 FaceSim and improves YawScore and OccScore by 12.60 and 15.10 points over the strongest baselines, demonstrating that dynamic identity memory and large-scale counterfactual self-supervision are highly effective for subject-preserving video generation.

TL;DR: 本文提出Argus框架，针对主体保持视频生成中单视角参考导致的身份信息与姿态、光照等纠缠的问题，引入堆叠多视图身份马赛克注入（SMII）方法，将多视图身份证据转化为3×3马赛克并动态注入Wan模型的隐空间，同时结合反事实训练、时间身份退火和自适应引导，在OpenS2V-Eval Human-Domain和HardID-Celeb基准上达到新SOTA。

Method: 基于Wan模型，核心是SMII：利用MLLM筛选代表性身份帧，将其转化为3×3堆叠马赛克，与扩散时间步同步后作为负时间只读内存注入Wan的原生token空间。辅以MLLM身份导演解决条件冲突、无交叉对反事实训练、时序身份退火和自适应自相似性引导。
Result: 在OpenS2V-Eval Human-Domain上总分64.38、FaceSim 71.86、NexusScore 51.62、NaturalScore 79.14；在HardID-Celeb上FaceSim 76.80，YawScore和OccScore分别超越最强基线12.60和15.10。
Conclusion: 动态身份记忆与大规模反事实自监督能有效提升视频生成中的主体身份保持鲁棒性，尤其应对大角度偏转和遮挡。

papers.title: Probabilistic Salary Prediction with Graph Attention Networks and a Mixture Density Network
papers.abstract_en: Accurate salary prediction is critical for bridging the information gap between employers and job seekers in modern labor markets. Existing approaches predominantly yield a single point estimate and treat job attributes such as location, occupation, and industry as independent categorical features, ignoring both the inherent uncertainty and multi-modality of real-world compensation data and the rich hierarchical and semantic-similarity relationships that govern pay norms. In this paper we propose GAT-MDN, a unified framework that addresses both limitations simultaneously. For each of the three attribute domains we construct a domain-specific graph whose edges encode (i) hierarchical parent-child containment and (ii) weighted similarity links derived from a pre-trained Sentence-Transformer. Parallel Graph Attention Networks (GATs) with edge-feature-aware attention learn rich, context-sensitive node representations from these multi-relational graphs. A priority-based hierarchical selection module then assembles a composite feature vector that gracefully handles missing or coarse attributes, and a Mixture Density Network (MDN) head maps this vector to the parameters of a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), yielding a full conditional salary distribution. Extensive experiments on a real-world Dutch job-posting dataset of over 1 million records demonstrate that GAT-MDN significantly outperforms a non-graph MLP-MDN baseline in both Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) and Mean Squared Error (MSE).

TL;DR: 本文提出GAT-MDN框架，用于概率性薪资预测，通过图注意力网络和混合密度网络同时处理属性层次结构和语义相似性，输出高斯混合模型参数以表示薪资分布。
Motivation: 现有薪资预测方法通常只给出单点估计，并将职位属性视为独立类别，忽略了内在的不确定性和多模态性以及属性间的层次和语义关系。
Method: 为每个属性域构建多关系图，使用图注意力网络学习节点表示，通过优先级层次选择模块组装特征向量，最后用混合密度网络输出高斯混合模型参数。
Result: 在荷兰真实招聘数据集（超过100万条记录）上，GAT-MDN在负对数似然和均方误差上显著优于非图MLP-MDN基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够同时处理属性层次关系和语义相似性，提供概率性薪资预测，效果优于基线。

papers.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
papers.abstract_en: Deep search requires agents to answer complex questions through multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. A central challenge is deciding how to search when several directions look plausible but only some will later lead to reliable evidence. If an agent greedily follows the current best-looking direction, it may keep extending a weak continuation. If it explores without discipline, it may waste budget on disconnected trials. We propose TreeSeeker, an inference-time framework for controlled trial-and-error in deep search. TreeSeeker organizes search as branch-and-return search over tree-structured states, where each branch is a tentative direction for a sub-goal. At each round, TreeSearch reads all sub-goal trees, identifies active goals, and uses textual UCB signals of value, uncertainty, and risk to select among exploiting a promising branch, exploring an uncertain alternative, or pruning an unproductive continuation and returning to an earlier branch point. TreeMem supports this control loop by keeping evidence, uncertainty, conflicts, progress, and failure cues attached to the branches that produced them, so trial outcomes can guide later decisions. Experiments on XBench-DeepSearch, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-ZH show that TreeSeeker consistently outperforms strong open-source baselines, suggesting that explicit branch-and-return control complements stronger reasoning and tool execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TreeSeeker 是一个推理阶段的框架，用于在深度搜索中实现受控的试错与回溯。它将搜索组织为树结构的分支与返回过程，通过文本 UCB 信号在利用、探索和剪枝之间进行选择，并利用 TreeMem 保持各分支的上下文信息。在 XBench-DeepSearch、BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-ZH 基准上，TreeSeeker 持续优于强开源基线。
Motivation: 深度搜索中，智能体在面对多个看似合理的搜索方向时，若贪婪地跟随当前最佳方向可能陷入弱路径，而无纪律地探索则会浪费预算。需要一种机制在探索与利用之间做出有原则的权衡。
Method: 提出 TreeSeeker，将搜索组织为树结构的分支与返回过程。每轮读取所有子目标树，识别活跃目标，并使用基于文本的 UCB 信号（价值、不确定性和风险）来决定是利用有前景的分支、探索不确定的替代，还是剪枝无用的分支并返回早期分支点。TreeMem 将证据、不确定性、冲突、进展和失败线索附加到产生它们的分支上，以指导后续决策。
Result: 在 XBench-DeepSearch、BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-ZH 基准上，TreeSeeker 持续优于强开源基线。
Conclusion: 显式的分支与返回控制可以补充更强大的推理和工具执行能力，提示该框架在深度搜索任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Learning Instance-Adaptive Low-Rank Orthogonal Subspaces for Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Clothes-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) aims to recognize individuals despite drastic appearance changes caused by clothing variation. While existing methods rely on adversarial learning to disentangle clothing features, we propose Ortho-ReID, which explicitly models a low-rank clothing subspace from VLM text descriptions and extracts clothing-invariant representations via direct geometric constraints. A critical component is our transformer-based Basis Maker, which refines a shared, low-dimensional clothing prior into an instance-adaptive low-rank subspace through cross-attention with image patches, enabling robust clothing feature extraction even under varying visibility conditions. This instance-adaptive subspace is supervised via alignment with clothing text embeddings, while identity features are extracted via a learnable projection head and geometrically constrained to be strictly orthogonal to it. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on PRCC (+5.9% top-1), Celeb-reID-light (+3.5%), and LaST (+5.3%), with competitive results on LTCC.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on CoLoRAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ortho-ReID，通过从VLM文本描述中显式建模低秩服装子空间，并利用几何约束提取服装不变特征，用于换衣行人重识别（CC-ReID）。关键组件是基于transformer的Basis Maker，通过交叉注意力将共享低维服装先验调整为实例自适应的低秩子空间，并与服装文本嵌入对齐监督。身份特征通过可学习投影头提取，并与服装子空间严格正交。实验在PRCC、Celeb-reID-light、LaST上达到SOTA，在LTCC上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有换衣行人重识别方法依赖对抗学习分离服装特征，但不够直接高效。本文目的是显式建模服装子空间并通过几何正交约束提取服装不变特征。
Method: 提出Ortho-ReID框架，包括：1）基于VLM文本描述的低秩服装子空间建模；2）transformer Basis Maker通过交叉注意力生成实例自适应低秩子空间；3）服装子空间与文本嵌入对齐监督；4）身份特征通过投影头提取并与服装子空间正交几何约束。

Conclusion: 显式建模低秩服装子空间并施加正交约束可以有效提取服装不变特征，实现换衣行人重识别的SOTA性能。

papers.title: Bergson: An Open Source Library for Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Data attribution is a promising field in interpretability that aims to explain model behavior through the influence of its training data, with applications including debugging undesirable model behavior and training dataset curation. However, significant engineering effort is required to perform it at scale, and many cutting edge techniques lack open-source tooling and support. Bergson is an open source library that aims to enable faster progress in the field by providing a host of techniques that scale to very large language models and pre-training datasets. The library natively supports on-disk gradient stores and multi-node distributed training, and provides quality of life tools for researchers. Finally, we introduce the first open-source implementations of three leading data attribution methods: MAGIC, SOURCE, and TrackStar. The library is available at https://github.com/EleutherAI/bergson .

papers.title: Sparse probes and murky physics: a case study of interpretability challenges in a foundation model for continuum dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI emulators are increasingly used in scientific domains where we already have strong theory, benchmarks, and physical intuition. This raises a central evaluation and interpretability question: when a foundation-style model can reproduce known continuum dynamics, what internal mechanism supports that behavior, is the internal behaviour consistent with known physics, and how does it relate to where the emulator succeeds or fails? We investigate a cross-domain foundation model for continuum dynamics, Walrus by Polymathic, using mechanistic interpretability guided by physical principles. We apply a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to probe a selected layer, and address the practical challenge of triaging a large feature set (over 20,000) using enstrophy as a physically grounded metric. As a deliberately simple testbed, we focus on shear flow and compare feature recruitment across multiple shear-flow setups, i.e. parameter values in the numerical simulation. Across setups we find evidence of piecewise consistency, with subsets of features recurring in similar roles, but this structure is intermittent and does not map cleanly onto standard physical decompositions. In parallel, direct comparisons between numerical simulation and the emulator reveal systematic output-level discrepancies, including regimes where energy/structures become too diffuse or too localized. We connect parts of these discrepancies to changes in specific SAE feature usage. Our work highlights open questions for scientific foundation models: how to robustly prioritize mechanistically meaningful features, how to separate stable structure from analysis artifacts (including single-layer and SAE limitations), and how to use established benchmarks to decide when "different" internal representations are genuinely informative rather than merely effective.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以连续介质动力学基础模型Walrus为例，使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行机械可解释性分析，发现内部特征与标准物理分解存在不一致，且仿真器输出与数值模拟存在系统性偏差。研究揭示了科学基础模型中可解释性方法的局限性。
Motivation: 科学领域中基于AI的仿真器虽能复现已知物理，但其内部机制与物理原理的一致性及失败模式尚不清楚，亟需有效的可解释性方法。
Method: 对Walrus模型选定层应用稀疏自编码器（SAE），以涡度（enstrophy）作为物理指标对超过20000个特征进行筛选，并在多个剪切流设置下比较特征激活模式。
Result: 发现部分特征在类似角色中重复出现，但结构是间歇性的，未清晰对应标准物理分解；仿真器输出在能量/结构分布上出现过度扩散或局部化，且与SAE特征使用变化相关。
Conclusion: 论文强调需要更稳健的方法来优先选择机械上有意义的特征，区分稳定结构与分析伪影，并利用基准判断不同内部表征的信息价值。

papers.title: IAPO: Input Attribution-Aware Policy Optimization for Tool Use in Small Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates reinforcement learning (RL) methods for improving tool-calling capabilities in multimodal small language model (SLM) agents. While existing works have explored various reward designs to improve agentic tool-calling ability, these approaches face inherent limitations for SLM training, especially under multimodal scenarios. First, many existing methods evaluate tool use correctness through exact matching against certain ground-truth or predefined formats. However, this assumption is often unsuitable for multimodal tasks, where multiple tool use paths may be valid and annotated tool trajectories are typically unavailable. Second, such sparse and brittle binary rewards provide little guidance on how to improve the underlying decision process, making them particularly difficult for multimodal SLM to learn from. To address these issues, we propose Input Attribution-Aware Policy Optimization (IAPO), an RL algorithm for improving tool use in multimodal SLM by aligning the model's attribution across input components with that of a stronger teacher. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B show that the proposed method improves visual question answering accuracy by an average of 3% across six test sets compared with existing visual tool use work, by helping the model attend to the most relevant input evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出输入归因感知的策略优化（IAPO）算法，用于提升多模态小语言模型（SLM）的工具调用能力。通过使模型的输入组件归因与更强的教师模型对齐，IAPO在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上平均提升视觉问答准确率3%。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在多模态SLM工具使用中存在两个问题：一是通过精确匹配评估工具使用正确性，不适应多模态任务中多条有效路径的情况；二是稀疏的二值奖励难以指导决策过程改进。
Method: 提出输入归因感知的策略优化（IAPO），通过将模型的输入组件归因与更强教师模型对齐，来改进多模态SLM的工具使用。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上，相比现有视觉工具使用工作，在六个测试集上平均提升视觉问答准确率3%。
Conclusion: IAPO通过对齐输入归因有效提升了多模态SLM的工具使用能力，尤其适用于标注工具轨迹稀缺的多模态场景。

papers.title: DeepRHP: A Hybrid Variational Autoencoder for Designing Random Heteropolymers as Protein Mimics
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic random heteropolymers (RHPs), consisting of a predefined set of monomers, offer an approach toward the design of protein-like materials. These RHPs, if designed appropriately, can mimic protein behavior and function. As such, there is a need for computational tools to efficiently guide RHP design. We bridge this gap by developing DeepRHP, a modified variational autoencoder (VAE) model under a semi-supervised framework. By equipping a classical VAE with an additional feature-based VAE, DeepRHP forces the latent space to capture structures of critical chemical features as well as individual RHP sequence patterns. In this sense, our method is versatile by allowing any relevant features to be incorporated in a hybrid manner. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DeepRHP by suggesting potential monomer compositions that stabilize membrane proteins (e.g. Aquaporin Z) in non-native environments and cross-validating our prediction with published results. The concordance between our model and true RHP function suggests strong potential in utilizing hybrid autoencoder architectures to guide RHP design for proteins and other biological compounds.
papers.comment: Oral presentation at AAAI 2023 Workshop on AI to Accelerate Science and Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepRHP，一种基于半监督混合变分自编码器（VAE）的模型，用于设计随机异聚物（RHP）以模拟蛋白质行为。通过在经典 VAE 上引入特征 VAE，迫使潜在空间同时捕捉关键化学特征和单体序列模式。实验表明，该模型能建议稳定膜蛋白（如 Aquaporin Z）的单体组成，并交叉验证结果与已发表数据一致。
Motivation: 合成随机异聚物（RHP）若设计得当可模拟蛋白质行为，但缺乏高效的计算工具来指导设计。
Method: 提出 DeepRHP：半监督框架下，在经典 VAE 基础上增加一个基于特征的 VAE，实现混合架构，允许任意相关特征灵活融入。
Result: 模型建议的潜在单体组成能稳定非天然环境中的膜蛋白（如 Aquaporin Z），且预测与已发表结果交叉验证一致。
Conclusion: 混合自编码器架构在指导 RHP 设计以模拟蛋白质及其他生物化合物方面具有潜力。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Neural Surrogates with Tractable Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in scientific machine learning provide a means of near-real-time solution to partial differential equations (PDEs), but lack the theoretical underpinnings of conventional simulators that support contemporary verification and validation. In this work, we construct data-driven reduced-order models that serve as structure-preserving, real-time surrogates. Remarkably, the exterior calculus that imposes physical conservation structure also exposes topological structure that we use to build a Gaussian process (GP) representation of uncertainty in state-flux relationships, ultimately yielding a Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for quantities of interest with closed-form expressions for posterior uncertainty. We specifically propose structure-preserving $H(\mathrm{div})$--$L^2$ subspaces of conventional Raviart--Thomas and $dgP_0$ elements prescribed by a lightweight transformer. Reduced-order dynamics consistent with this subspace are learned by posing a conservation law in which a GP describes the fluxes between volumes. This work hinges on a novel interface between mixed FEM spaces and GP regression; when training is posed as the optimal recovery problem (ORP), the resulting GP regression can be written as an optimization problem with equality constraints that impose a conservation structure, amenable to a fast Schur-complement training strategy. The trained model can then be solved in real time with closed-form estimators for boundary fluxes driven by prescribed Dirichlet data. The paper includes RKHS posterior error bounds for linear functionals to support uncertainty quantification, as well as numerical experiments demonstrating the accuracy of the posterior distribution as a surrogate for error estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了结构保持的降阶代理模型，用于实时求解偏微分方程，并利用外微分和拓扑结构构造了状态-通量关系的高斯过程（GP）表示，最终得到具有封闭形式后验不确定性的Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射。通过混合有限元空间与GP回归的新颖结合，将训练问题转化为带等式约束的优化问题，并利用Schur补策略快速求解。数值实验展示了后验分布作为误差估计代理的准确性。
Motivation: 现有科学机器学习求解PDE的方法缺乏传统模拟器的理论支撑，难以进行验证与确认。
Method: 提出结构保持的H(div)-L²子空间（基于Raviart-Thomas和dgP0元），由轻量Transformer定义；将守恒律中的通量假设为高斯过程，通过最优恢复问题（ORP）训练，转化为带约束优化并采用Schur补求解。
Result: 摘要报告了RKHS后验误差界，以及数值实验证明后验分布可作为误差估计的准确代理。
Conclusion: 该方法为实时代理模型提供结构保持和可量化不确定性，但未给出具体数值性能（如精度提升百分比）。

papers.title: Tree-Structured Orthonormal Decomposition of the Aitchison Simplex
papers.abstract_en: Compositional data -- vectors encoding relative proportions -- arise across scientific domains, including ecology, geochemistry, and genomics. The features in these data often come with known hierarchical structure (e.g., taxonomies, phylogenies, ontologies), yet existing methods either ignore this structure, discard the intrinsic Aitchison geometry, are designed for binary trees, or yield incomplete coordinate systems. We describe PolyILR, a canonical orthonormal decomposition of the Aitchison tangent space aligned with any tree topology. Our construction defines a weighted local geometry at each internal node capturing full branching structure, then lifts these to a global orthonormal basis where every coordinate corresponds to a specific tree location. On microbiome and single-cell benchmarks, PolyILR yields stable, interpretable features and enables inference at multiscale tree resolution. We also establish a novel theoretical connection to softmax classifiers, suggesting possible applications to probabilistic modeling.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. To appear in PMLR vol. 306
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有层次结构（如分类学、系统发育树）的组合数据，提出 PolyILR 方法，一种与任意树拓扑对齐的 Aitchison 切空间规范正交分解。该方法在内部节点定义加权局部几何以捕获完整分支结构，并提升为全局正交基，使得每个坐标对应特定的树位置。在微生物组和单细胞基准上，PolyILR 产生了稳定、可解释的特征，并支持多尺度树分辨率推理。此外，论文发现了与 softmax 分类器的新理论联系。
Motivation: 现有组合数据分析方法要么忽略特征间的层次结构，要么丢弃固有的 Aitchison 几何，或者仅适用于二叉树，或者产生不完整的坐标系。
Method: 定义与任意树拓扑对齐的 Aitchison 切空间规范正交分解（PolyILR），在每个内部节点处定义加权局部几何以捕获完整分支结构，并将这些局部几何提升为全局正交基。
Result: 摘要报告在微生物组和单细胞基准上，PolyILR 产生稳定、可解释的特征，并支持多尺度树分辨率推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法建立了与 softmax 分类器的新理论联系，暗示了在概率建模中的潜在应用。

papers.title: Motion Reinforces Appearance: RGB-Skeleton Gated Residual Fusion for Micro-Gesture Online Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Micro-gesture analysis attracts increasing attention for inferring spontaneous emotion from subtle body movements. Micro-gesture online recognition, which localizes and classifies each gesture instance in untrimmed videos, is a core task in the 4th EI-MiGA-IJCAI Challenge. Compared with typical temporal action detection, MGR emphasizes the localization and classification of actions, requiring the model to output the start time, end time, and category of each micro-gesture. Moreover, since micro-gestures are highly spontaneous, relying solely on a single modality makes it difficult to capture the complete and accurate multi-modal cues. In this work, we propose DyFADet+, which extends DyFADet into a dual-stream RGB-skeleton framework. In our model, both modalities are projected into shared multi-scale temporal embeddings and fused through a gated residual module, which adaptively injects skeleton motion into the RGB representation rather than using naive concatenation. Finally, these fused features are decoded by a Dynamic TAD head for online classification and boundary regression. On the SMG dataset, our method achieves an F1 score of 40.88, ranking 2nd in the Micro-gesture Online Recognition track.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微手势在线识别任务，提出了一种双流RGB-骨架框架DyFADet+，通过门控残差融合模块将骨架运动自适应注入RGB表示，并使用动态TAD头进行分类和边界回归。在SMG数据集上，该方法取得了40.88的F1分数，在第四届EI-MiGA-IJCAI挑战赛中排名第二。
Motivation: 微手势具有高度自发性，仅依赖单模态难以捕捉完整准确的多模态线索，因此需要融合RGB和骨架信息。
Method: 提出DyFADet+，将RGB和骨架投影到共享多尺度时间嵌入，通过门控残差模块融合，而非简单拼接，最后用动态TAD头解码。
Result: 在SMG数据集上，该方法达到40.88的F1分数，在微手势在线识别赛道中排名第二。
Conclusion: 门控残差融合能有效结合外观和运动信息，提升微手势在线识别性能。

papers.title: TAROT: Task-Adaptive Refinement of LLM-prior Graphs for Few-shot Tabular Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot tabular learning provides a cost-effective approach for real-world applications where annotation is costly and collecting sufficient samples for new tasks is difficult. Existing Traditional and LLM-based methods have demonstrated effectiveness in few-shot scenarios. However, traditional methods need additional training on unlabeled or generated data, which incur significant computational overhead. In addition, LLM-based methods that directly feed raw tabular data into LLMs raise privacy and compliance concerns. More importantly, both paradigms largely overlook the semantic relationships between features, which provide structural and semantic prior for constructing a semantic graph. Semantic graph is essential for modeling meaningful feature interactions in few-shot scenarios. In this paper, we propose TAROT, a GNN-based framework that encodes the structural and semantic prior by constructing and refining a task-adaptive semantic graph from this prior, thereby improving predictive performance in few-shot tabular learning. TAROT first encodes heterogeneous tabular data into unified node semantic representations via a Unified Semantic Tabular Node Encoder (USTNE). Then, it prompts LLMs to infer the semantic relationship between features based on the task description and feature names to construct a semantic graph. To mitigate structural noise introduced by the hallucination of LLMs, TAROT introduces Task-adaptive Semantic Graph Refinement that prunes spurious or task-unrelated edges and adds missing task-related ones, aligning the graph structure with the downstream objective. Finally, a GNN performs message passing over the refined graph to capture task-related semantic dependencies for prediction. Extensive experiments on various few-shot tabular learning benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of TAROT, establishing it as a state-of-the-art approach in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAROT，一种基于GNN的少样本表格学习框架。它首先通过统一语义表格节点编码器（USTNE）将异构表格数据编码为节点表示，然后利用LLM根据任务描述和特征名推断特征间语义关系，构建初始语义图。为了缓解LLM幻觉引入的结构噪声，TAROT引入任务自适应语义图细化步骤，修剪虚假或任务无关的边，并补充缺失的任务相关边。最后，GNN在细化后的图上进行消息传递，捕捉任务相关的语义依赖关系用于预测。在多个少样本表格学习基准上的实验表明，TAROT取得了最先进的性能。
Motivation: 现有少样本表格学习方法中，传统方法需要额外训练，计算开销大；LLM方法直接处理原始表格数据存在隐私和合规问题。更重要的是，两者都忽略了特征间的语义关系，而语义图对于建模有意义的特征交互至关重要。
Method: 提出TAROT框架，包含三个关键组件：1）统一语义表格节点编码器（USTNE），将异构表格数据编码为统一的节点语义表示；2）利用LLM根据任务描述和特征名推断特征间语义关系，构建初始语义图；3）任务自适应语义图细化，通过修剪虚假边和添加缺失边来对齐图结构与下游目标。最后使用GNN在细化图上进行消息传递预测。
Result: 在多个少样本表格学习基准上的广泛实验表明，TAROT取得了优越性能，成为该领域的最先进方法。
Conclusion: TAROT通过构建和细化任务自适应语义图，有效编码了结构和语义先验，提升了少样本表格学习的预测性能。

papers.title: TouchThinker: Scaling Tactile Commonsense Reasoning to the Open World with Large-scale Data and Action-aware Representation
papers.abstract_en: Touch is a key modality for embodied agents to understand the physical world. Although recent work has incorporated tactile signals into language systems for tactile commonsense reasoning, scaling such systems to realistic open-world settings remains challenging due to two key bottlenecks: (1) current tactile reasoning datasets remain limited in format and scale, providing insufficient supervision for reasoning from tactile observations to physical commonsense and hindering the learning of transferable tactile commonsense; (2) Tactile signals are inherently redundant and action-specific, yet existing methods often overlook these properties, resulting in inefficient representations with limited semantic expressiveness. To address these limitations, we propose TouchThinker, a tactile-language framework that scales tactile commonsense reasoning to the open world from both data and representation perspectives. First, we construct TouchThinker-1M, a million-scale, multi-source tactile reasoning dataset covering \textbf{415} objects, \textbf{8} scenarios, and \textbf{7} sensor types, providing a solid data foundation for open-world generalization. We further introduce TouchThinker-Bench, an open-world benchmark with more realistic and diverse tasks. Then, we propose action-aware modeling mechanism to improve tactile representation efficiency and enable efficient reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TouchThinker achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Our code and dataset will be made available at: https://github.com/lvkailin0118/TouchThinker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TouchThinker 框架，从数据和表示两个维度扩展触觉常识推理到开放世界。构建了百万级多源触觉推理数据集 TouchThinker-1M，包含415个物体、8种场景和7种传感器类型；提出动作感知建模机制以提高触觉表示效率。实验表明在多个数据集上达到有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 当前触觉推理数据集格式和规模有限，无法提供足够监督以学习可迁移的触觉常识；触觉信号冗余且动作相关，现有方法忽略这些特性导致表示低效。
Method: 构建TouchThinker-1M数据集和TouchThinker-Bench基准；提出动作感知建模机制（action-aware modeling mechanism）以提高触觉表示效率。
Result: 在多个数据集上与现有最优模型相比取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 所提框架通过大规模数据和完善的基准以及动作感知表示，将触觉常识推理扩展到开放世界。

papers.title: Are LLMs Bad at Moral Reasoning?
papers.abstract_en: For highly capable AI systems to operate safely in dynamic, open-ended environments, they must be able to identify, understand, and respond to moral reasons for action, and constrain their behaviour accordingly. A growing body of research aims to evaluate this capacity -- moral competence -- in today's most capable AI systems, recently reaching broadly pessimistic conclusions. One of the most ambitious such papers collects gold-standard human-authored rubrics for evaluating moral reasoning in 1,000 cases, and benchmarks frontier AI models against those rubrics, with underwhelming results. In this paper, we argue that the MoReBench dataset can be redeployed to give a much more optimistic picture of LLMs' moral reasoning (an essential part of moral competence). We show that if, instead of scoring LLMs' responses to these cases against these rubrics, we instead give the LLMs the same task given to humans -- to generate scoring rubrics for the moral analysis of particular cases -- the rubrics they generate are both better calibrated to the human rubrics than their open-ended responses, and, where they differ, plausibly reflect nothing more than the vast dimensionality of most moral problems, as well as highlighting some human departures from the "rubric for creating rubrics". Taking these points into consideration, the MoReBench dataset suggests that LLMs are significantly more capable at moral reasoning than was previously believed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视MoReBench数据集，指出如果让LLM像人类一样生成评分标准（scoring rubrics），则LLM生成的rubrics与人类更加一致，且差异反映道德问题的多维性而非缺陷，因此认为LLM的道德推理能力比之前认为的要强。
Motivation: 先前研究使用人类编写的评分标准评估LLM的道德推理，得出悲观结论。本文认为该方法可能低估了LLM的能力。
Method: 将MoReBench数据集的任务重新定义为让LLM生成评分标准，而非直接评分，然后比较LLM生成的rubrics与人类rubrics的一致性。
Result: LLM生成的rubrics与人类rubrics校准更好，差异合理，说明LLM的道德推理能力更强。
Conclusion: LLM在道德推理方面比之前认为的更强大，MoReBench实际提供了乐观证据。

papers.title: Architecture-Aware Reinforcement Learning Makes Sliding-Window Attention Competitive in Math Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs) has increased the demand for long-context inference, but self-attention (SA) scales quadratically with context length. To address this, we study SWARR (Sliding-Window Attention with Reinforced Adaptation for Math Reasoning), a practical recipe for adapting SWA models to mathematical reasoning. SWARR has two stages: (1) efficient conversion from a pretrained SA model to SWA with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which avoids pretraining a new base model, and (2) policy adaptation with reinforcement learning (RL). We find that SWA still underperforms SA after SFT, and we hypothesize that this gap is caused in part by a data-architecture mismatch: most SFT data are prepared for SA models and may contain long-range dependencies that are difficult for SWA to model. Because on-policy RL optimizes self-generated trajectories under the SWA constraint, it can adapt trajectories to better match SWA. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that this recipe substantially narrows the gap between SWA and SA, recovering much of the accuracy lost during SWA conversion while preserving the efficiency benefits of linear-complexity attention. Our central contribution is the empirical finding that RL changes the conclusion one would draw from conversion and SFT alone about SWA's viability for math reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWARR 方法，通过监督微调将预训练的自注意力模型转换为滑动窗口注意力模型，再使用强化学习进行策略适应，以提升数学推理性能。实验表明，强化学习能有效缩小 SWA 与 SA 之间的性能差距，使得线性复杂度的 SWA 在数学推理任务中变得具有竞争力。
Motivation: 自注意力在长上下文推理中计算量随序列长度二次增长，而滑动窗口注意力虽然效率高但在数学推理中性能不足。直接微调转换后的 SWA 模型仍存在性能差距，作者假设这是由于微调数据与 SWA 架构不匹配所致。
Method: SWARR 包含两个阶段：首先将预训练 SA 模型通过监督微调高效转换为 SWA 模型；然后使用策略梯度强化学习对 SWA 模型进行在线策略优化，让模型在自身生成的轨迹上适应 SWA 的约束。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，SWARR 显著缩小了 SWA 与 SA 的精度差距，恢复了大部分因转换损失的准确率，同时保持了线性复杂度的效率优势。
Conclusion: 强化学习可以改变仅依赖转换和微调对 SWA 适用性的结论，使得 SWA 在数学推理中成为可行的选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sovereign Assurance Boundary: Certificate-Bound Admission for Agentic Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Agentic infrastructure introduces a critical control-plane authorization problem: non-deterministic reasoning systems can propose high-stakes mutations to production resources, yet existing security mechanisms -- such as identity and access management (IAM), policy engines, consensus protocols, and audit logs -- either enforce static, context-unaware permissions or merely record actions post-execution. This paper introduces the Sovereign Assurance Boundary (SAB), a certificate-bound runtime admission layer for autonomous execution authority. SAB intercepts agent proposals at an assurance airlock, compiles them into typed execution contracts $C$, and binds these contracts to cryptographic evidence digests $H(E)$ and policy versions. The contracts are then routed through consequence-aware certification paths. Upon successful admission, the system emits a signed Sovereign Assurance Certificate ($Ω$) that is strictly scoped to a specific execution identity, revocation epoch, and validity window. Finally, a sovereign execution broker verifies $Ω$ and performs fresh pre-execution revocation and drift checks before invoking infrastructure APIs. We detail the airlock-broker architecture, formalize its admission and revocation invariants, and report preliminary feasibility measurements from a Go prototype evaluated over 2,500 admission attempts. Ultimately, this broker-enforced model prevents autonomous reasoning from directly mutating state, transforming delegated execution authority into a cryptographically verifiable, evidence-bound, revocable, and replayable runtime artifact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体基础设施中非确定性推理系统提出的控制平面授权问题，引入主权保证边界（SAB），一种基于证书的运行准入层。SAB在保障气闸中拦截智能体提案，编译为类型化执行合约，绑定加密证据摘要和策略版本，通过后果感知认证路径，最终颁发主权保证证书。执行代理验证证书并进行撤销和漂移检查后才调用基础设施API。初步可行性测试来自Go原型，在2500次准入尝试上评估。
Motivation: 现有安全机制（IAM、策略引擎、共识协议、审计日志）要么强制执行静态、无上下文感知的权限，要么只在执行后记录操作，无法应对非确定性推理系统对生产资源提出的高风险变更。
Method: 提出SAB架构，包括保障气闸和代理执行，将代理提案编译为类型化执行合约，绑定加密证据和策略版本，通过后果感知认证路径，颁发有严格作用域的主权保证证书，并在执行前进行撤销和漂移检查。
Result: 摘要报告了来自Go原型的初步可行性测量，在2500次准入尝试上进行了评估，但未给出具体性能数字。
Conclusion: 该模型防止自主推理直接变更状态，将委派执行权限转化为加密可验证、证据约束、可撤销且可重放的运行时工件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Integral Formulation of QENDy for Robust Nonlinear System Identification
papers.abstract_en: This manuscript proposes an integral formulation of the newly defined quadratic embedding method for identifying nonlinear systems (QENDy). In the original algorithm, trajectory data points along with their time derivatives are used. Methods for calculating time derivatives make the algorithm sensitive to noise. Our integral formulation does not use the time derivatives. This results in a more robust method to learn the dynamics.

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUCID，一个从互联网非结构化人类视频学习任务意图的两阶段框架，意图模型预测短时场景变化，可跨实体（灵巧手/平行爪）迁移，并在仿真中学习控制器。在五个真实操作任务上，仅用视频监督即可实现零样本迁移。
Motivation: 现有机器人学习依赖昂贵且与特定实体绑定的示范数据，非结构化人类视频虽丰富但缺乏与机器人动作的直接关联。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段从互联网视频学习闭循环的短时意图模型（预测场景下一步变化）；第二阶段在并行仿真中训练实体特定的传感器运动策略，将意图转换为动作。意图接口作为共享中间表示。
Result: 在搅拌、擦、分拣任务上仅用互联网视频监督，实现零样本迁移到新场景和对象；推-T和电缆布线任务各用1小时自拍视频监督，达到有效操作。
Conclusion: LUCID 展示了从非结构化人类视频学习可跨实体迁移的意图模型可行性，有望降低机器人技能获取的数据成本和实体依赖。

papers.title: When Context Returns: Toward Robust Internalization in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that on-policy distillation can internalize privileged context, such as system prompts or task hints, into a student model so that the context is no longer needed at inference time. Although this approach successfully improves the student's no-context performance, we identify an interesting and previously unstudied phenomenon: in many settings, reintroducing the original privileged context to the distilled student actually degrades its performance, even on instances it already solves correctly without context. We term this context-induced degradation and argue that robust internalization demands not only matching the teacher's context-conditioned behavior, but also remaining stable when the context is reintroduced, a property we call context removability. Motivated by this observation, we propose a lightweight consistency regularizer that first anchors the student's no-context output via stop-gradient, then penalizes the context-conditioned output for deviating from it via forward KL divergence. This simple addition requires only one extra forward pass per training step, yet it effectively mitigates context-induced degradation and, in many cases, even improves no-context performance. Across 12 configurations spanning diverse domains and model families, our method improves context-conditioned accuracy in the majority of settings, reduces context-induced harm in 11 out of 12 settings, and effectively eliminates response-length inflation. A mechanistic case study further confirms that context removability is achieved at the representation level, with hidden states remaining nearly identical regardless of whether the context is present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，在在线蒸馏中，将特权上下文内化到学生模型后，重新引入原始上下文反而会损害学生性能，这种现象称为上下文诱导退化。作者提出一种轻量级一致性正则化器，通过固定无上下文输出并惩罚上下文输出偏离，有效缓解退化并提升性能。
Motivation: 现有在线蒸馏方法成功将特权上下文内化，但重新引入上下文会导致学生性能下降，这一未被研究的问题需要解决。
Method: 提出轻量级一致性正则化器：先通过stop-gradient固定无上下文输出，再使用前向KL散度惩罚上下文输出偏离无上下文输出。
Result: 在12个跨域配置中，该方法在多数设置下提高了上下文条件准确率，在11个设置中减少了上下文危害，并消除了响应长度膨胀。
Conclusion: 上下文可移除性要求模型在上下文重新引入时保持稳定，所提正则化器在表示层面实现了近似的隐藏状态不变性。

papers.title: Adapting Vision-Language Models from Iconic to Inclusive for Multi-Label Recognition Without Labels
papers.abstract_en: Understanding multi-label images remains a challenging task in computer vision. With the rapid progress of vision-language multimodal learning, vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot recognition without labeled data. However, due to their intrinsic design, these models often prioritize the most iconic object and omit other contextual positives. This intrinsic bias conflicts with the nature of multi-label learning, thereby limiting their applicability. In this work, we propose an unsupervised framework that adapts VLMs from iconic recognition toward inclusive understanding, enabling label-free multi-label image recognition. Our approach consists of two key stages, ``cutting'' and ``sewing'': In the cutting stage, we present the multi-sampling response estimator to prevent the model from concentrating only on one single object. In the second sewing stage, the multi-object blend adaptation is introduced to adjust the labels to better conform to the multi-label distribution while preserving the intrinsic characteristics of the original model within only one epoch. Extensive experiments show that our framework significantly outperforms existing unsupervised approaches on four public datasets, even surpassing several representative weakly supervised baselines. These results demonstrate the potential of adapting pre-trained VLMs for more comprehensive visual understanding without manual annotations. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iCVTEAM/TailorCLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无监督框架TailorCLIP，将视觉语言模型从标志性识别适应到包容性理解，实现无标签的多标签图像识别。方法包括“裁剪”阶段的多采样响应估计器和“缝合”阶段的多目标混合适应。在四个公开数据集上显著优于现有无监督方法，甚至超过若干弱监督基线。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型倾向于识别最突出的物体而忽略其他上下文物体，这种内在偏差与多标签学习需求冲突，限制了其在多标签识别中的应用。
Method: 提出无监督框架TailorCLIP，包含两个阶段：裁剪阶段使用多采样响应估计器防止模型只关注单一物体；缝合阶段引入多目标混合适应，仅用一epoch调整标签以符合多标签分布，同时保留原始模型特征。
Result: 在四个公开数据集上显著优于现有无监督方法，甚至超过若干代表性弱监督基线。
Conclusion: 展示了无需人工标注即可适应预训练视觉语言模型实现更全面视觉理解的潜力，代码已公开。

papers.title: TimeRouter: Efficient and Adaptive Routing of Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly explored as predictive experts within emerging agentic time-series systems. However, TSFMs exhibit heterogeneous inductive biases, and no single model consistently dominates across forecasting regimes, making expert selection a critical challenge. Existing systems often delegate this decision to LLM-based controllers, incurring substantial inference overhead. We present TimeRouter, an efficient routing framework that leverages empirical complementarity across a pool of pretrained TSFMs through lightweight discriminative routing, selective gating, and ensemble fallback. Concretely, TimeRouter combines a learned routing head, a selective gate, and an ensemble fallback, enabling adaptive expert selection without invoking an LLM at inference time. TimeRouter achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GIFT-EVAL leaderboard, with an LB MASE of 0.6765. Beyond benchmark performance, our ablation studies provide empirical insights into TSFM routing design, highlighting the importance of pool composition and selective gating. Taken together, these results position TimeRouter as a modular and lightweight routing layer for future agentic time-series systems built upon foundation-model pools. Our code is available at https://github.com/UConn-DSIS/TimeRouter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimeRouter，一个高效路由框架，利用预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）池的互补性，通过轻量判别路由、选择门控和集成回退实现自适应专家选择，无需在推理时调用LLM。在GIFT-EVAL排行榜上达到SOTA，LB MASE为0.6765。
Motivation: 现有TSFM在预测中各有偏差，单一模型无法在所有场景占优，需要专家选择。但现有系统依赖LLM控制器，推理开销大。
Method: 提出TimeRouter，结合学习路由头、选择门控和集成回退，通过轻量级判别路由选择适合的TSFM，避免使用LLM。
Result: 在GIFT-EVAL排行榜上实现LB MASE 0.6765，达到SOTA。消融研究揭示了池组成和选择门控的重要性。
Conclusion: TimeRouter可作为未来基于基础模型池的智能时间序列系统的模块化轻量级路由层。代码开源。

papers.title: Family-Aware Residual Architecture for Predicting Quantum Circuit Simulation Performance
papers.abstract_en: Approximate tensor-network simulators enable classical simulation of quantum circuits beyond the reach of exact methods, but selecting optimal approximation parameters -- such as bond dimension thresholds -- remains a costly trial-and-error process. We present a family-aware neural architecture that predicts both the minimum approximation threshold required to achieve target fidelity and the expected wall-clock runtime for quantum circuit simulation, given only the circuit's OpenQASM description and execution context. Our key insight is that quantum circuits from different algorithmic families (e.g., QFT, Grover, VQE) exhibit fundamentally distinct simulation cost profiles due to their differing entanglement structures. We employ family-conditioned residual corrections -- additive, family-specific adjustments atop a shared backbone, drawing on established conditional computation techniques -- enabling the model to capture both universal circuit properties and algorithmic nuances. The architecture incorporates a pretrained family classifier (97.5% accuracy) and domain-informed algorithm fingerprint features derived from gate-composition heuristics. Evaluated on circuits spanning 7--130 qubits across 10 algorithm families, our system achieves 79.5% exact threshold accuracy (91.2% within one rung) and $R^2 = 0.82$ runtime correlation, with inference completing in approximately 50 ms -- replacing trial-and-error simulation runs that may take minutes to hours. Ablation studies confirm that family-aware modeling provides the single largest performance improvement (+3.2 percentage points), validating the hypothesis that algorithm family is a first-class feature for simulation cost prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper at IEEE ISVLSI 2026 (QC-CSAA Workshop). To appear in IEEE Xplore. 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种家族感知的残差架构，用于预测量子电路模拟所需的最小近似阈值和目标保真度下的运行时间。该方法仅需电路的OpenQASM描述和执行上下文，利用不同算法家族（如QFT、Grover、VQE）的模拟成本差异，通过家族条件残差修正和预训练分类器实现预测。在7-130量子比特、10个算法家族的电路上，阈值预测精确率达79.5%（一阶内91.2%），运行时间R²为0.82，推理仅需约50毫秒，替代了数分钟到数小时的试错模拟。
Motivation: 近似张量网络模拟器在模拟量子电路时，选择最优近似参数（如键维阈值）依赖昂贵的试错过程。现有方法缺乏对电路模拟成本的高效预测，尤其是不同算法家族因纠缠结构差异导致成本特性不同。
Method: 提出家族感知残差架构（family-aware residual architecture），在共享骨干网络上叠加家族特定的可加性残差修正（借用条件计算技术）。输入电路OpenQASM描述，经预训练家族分类器（准确率97.5%）和门组成启发式算法指纹特征提取后，输出最小阈值和运行时间预测。
Result: 在7-130量子比特、10个算法家族的电路上，系统达到79.5%精确阈值准确率（91.2%在一阶误差内），运行时间预测R²=0.82，推理时间约50毫秒。消融实验表明，家族感知建模是性能提升的最大单一因素（+3.2个百分点）。
Conclusion: 算法家族是模拟成本预测的一等特征；家族感知建模显著优于不区分家族的基线，验证了不同算法家族具有不同模拟成本模式的假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Precision-Aware Illumination-Disentangled Vision Transformer for Spacecraft 6D Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Vision sensors provide a lightweight solution for spacecraft proximity operations, but monocular spacecraft 6D pose estimation remains difficult under illumination variation, specular reflection, shadowing, weak texture, and background interference. These factors make local visual evidence spatially unreliable and can destabilize pose regression. This article proposes a Precision-Aware Illumination-Disentangled Vision Transformer (PAID-ViT) for robust spacecraft pose estimation.The proposed model separates pose-relevant structure tokens from illumination-sensitive appearance tokens, estimates patch reliability before pose aggregation, and uses foreground mask supervision to preserve silhouette cues. A parameter-free geometric recovery module converts normalized crop coordinates, log-depth, and a continuous 6D rotation representation into camera-frame rotation and translation. Experiments on SPEED+ V2, the SPEED+ validation/lightbox/sunlamp evaluation configuration used in this study, suggest that PAID-ViT reduces translation error and improves robustness in the challenging sunlamp domain, while ablation studies support the complementary roles of illumination disentanglement, reliability-aware token aggregation, mask supervision, and training-side regularization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种精度感知的光照解耦视觉Transformer（PAID-ViT）用于鲁棒的航天器6D姿态估计。模型分离结构token与光照敏感外观token，估计patch可靠性，并使用前景掩码监督保留轮廓信息。在SPEED+ V2的多个配置上，该方法减少了平移误差并提高了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 单目航天器6D姿态估计在光照变化、镜面反射、阴影、弱纹理和背景干扰下困难，局部视觉证据不可靠，影响姿态回归稳定性。
Method: 提出PAID-ViT，包括光照解耦（分离结构token和外观token）、patch可靠性估计、前景掩码监督，以及参数无关的几何恢复模块（将归一化裁剪坐标、对数深度和连续6D旋转表示转换为相机帧旋转和平移）。
Result: 在SPEED+ V2的验证/光箱/强光配置上，PAID-ViT降低了平移误差，在强光域提高了鲁棒性。消融实验验证了光照解耦、可靠性感知token聚合、掩码监督和训练侧正则化各组件的作用。
Conclusion: 光照解耦、可靠性感知token聚合、掩码监督和训练侧正则化具有互补作用，有助于提升航天器姿态估计的鲁棒性。

papers.title: DeMix: Debugging Training Data with Mixed Data Error Types by Investigating Influence Vectors
papers.abstract_en: High-quality training data is essential for the success of machine learning models. However, real-world datasets often contain mixed types of errors arising from systematic flaws in data preparation pipelines, including label errors, feature errors, and spurious correlations. Effective debugging of training data requires both detecting erroneous samples and identifying their specific error types to enable targeted repair, yet existing data cleaning and attribution methods fail to adequately address this dual requirement. In this paper, we propose DeMix, a novel framework that simultaneously diagnoses erroneous samples and their error types. Our key insight is that different error types produce distinct patterns on model behavior. DeMix captures such error-specific patterns by influence vectors that characterize how each training sample affects model predictions across all validation samples. We formulate training data debugging as a multi-label classification problem where a classifier is developed to predict error types directly from influence vectors. We further introduce an intervention-based learning strategy that guides the classifier to capture invariant rationales specific to each error type, ensuring the learned classifier generalizes effectively. Empirical evaluations on 11 tasks across tabular data prediction, recommendation systems, and LLM alignment demonstrate that DeMix significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a 22.61% improvement in data debugging F1-score and a 9.32% gain in task model performance after data repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/SJTU-DMTai/DeMix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeMix 框架，通过影响向量（influence vectors）捕捉不同错误类型对模型行为的独特模式，将训练数据调试视为多标签分类问题，并采用基于干预的学习策略提升泛化性。在表格数据预测、推荐系统和 LLM 对齐等 11 个任务上，DeMix 在数据调试 F1 上提升 22.61%，修复后模型性能提升 9.32%。
Motivation: 现有数据清理和归因方法无法同时检测错误样本并识别其具体错误类型，导致难以针对性修复。
Method: 利用影响向量表征每个训练样本对所有验证样本预测的影响，将数据调试转化为多标签分类问题，并引入基于干预的学习策略使分类器捕获各错误类型的不变特征。
Result: 在 11 个任务上，数据调试 F1 较 SOTA 提升 22.61%，修复后模型性能提升 9.32%。
Conclusion: DeMix 能有效诊断混合错误类型并指导数据修复，提升模型表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adv-TGD: Adversarial Text-Guided Diffusion for Face Recognition Impersonation Attacks
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of face recognition (FR) technologies raises serious privacy concerns, as facial data can be exploited without consent. To address this challenge, we propose Adv-TGD, a generative adversarial attack framework that synthesizes photorealistic faces capable of impersonating target identities and deceiving face recognition systems. Built upon Stable Diffusion, Adv-TGD performs per-sample LoRA fine-tuning conditioned on concise textual prompts to generate natural yet adversarially manipulated identities. Unlike conventional identity-attack approaches, our method optimizes lightweight cross-attention adapters for each source-target pair within a single-step denoising process. Latent blending is constrained by a face-local heatmap mask to ensure spatially precise identity manipulation while preserving non-sensitive regions. We introduce a composite objective that integrates masked epsilon-MSE reconstruction, thresholded identity divergence in FR embedding space, directional feature alignment, and source-similarity suppression to balance adversarial attack and visual realism. Optionally, LLaVA-generated attribute prompts enhance fine-grained semantic details without reintroducing identity cues. Under the black-box evaluation protocol, Adv-TGD attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 85.90% across IR152, IRSE50, MobileFace, and FaceNet, surpassing the semantic SOTA baseline Adv-CPG by +6.25 points, diffusion-based makeup method DiffAIM by +3 points, and noise-based P3-Mask by +16 points. Despite its strong attack efficacy, Adv-TGD preserves high visual fidelity (PSNR = 27.15 dB, SSIM = 0.981). Furthermore, we demonstrate the flexibility of our framework by successfully extending it to in-the-wild datasets (LADN), general object classification (ImageNet), and transformer-based diffusion models (FLUX.1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Adv-TGD，一种基于Stable Diffusion的生成对抗攻击框架，通过对每个源-目标对进行轻量级LoRA微调和文本条件生成，合成能够欺骗人脸识别系统的逼真人脸图像。在黑盒评估下，在IR152、IRSE50、MobileFace和FaceNet上达到平均85.90%的攻击成功率，优于现有语义基线Adv-CPG、扩散方法DiffAIM和噪声方法P3-Mask，同时保持高视觉保真度（PSNR=27.15 dB, SSIM=0.981）。
Motivation: 人脸识别技术广泛使用引发隐私担忧，面部数据可能被未经同意利用。现有攻击方法在视觉真实性和攻击成功率之间难以平衡。
Method: 基于Stable Diffusion，对每个源-目标身份对进行单步去噪过程中的每样本LoRA微调，使用人脸局部热图掩码约束潜在混合以实现精确身份操纵。复合目标函数包括掩码epsilon-MSE重建、阈值化身份差异损失、方向特征对齐和源相似度抑制，可选LLaVA生成属性提示增强细节。
Result: 在黑盒评估下，Adv-TGD在IR152、IRSE50、MobileFace和FaceNet上平均攻击成功率为85.90%，比Adv-CPG高6.25个百分点，比DiffAIM高3个百分点，比P3-Mask高16个百分点；视觉质量指标PSNR=27.15 dB，SSIM=0.981。
Conclusion: Adv-TGD在攻击成功率和视觉真实性之间取得良好平衡，并展示了扩展到野外数据集（LADN）、通用目标分类（ImageNet）和transformer扩散模型（FLUX.1）的灵活性。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Decomposition for Multimodal Interaction Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning hinges on capturing redundant, unique, and synergistic information across modalities, which collectively constitute multimodal interactions. A critical yet underexplored challenge is that these implicit interactions vary dynamically across samples. In this work, we present the first systematic, information-theoretic analysis highlighting why learning these dynamic, sample-specific interactions is critical for effective multimodal learning. Our analysis further reveals deficits in conventional paradigms at learning these distinct interaction types: modality ensemble approaches struggle to capture synergy, while joint learning paradigms often under-utilize redundant information. This highlights the need for an approach that can adaptively learn from different interaction types on a per-sample basis. To this end, we propose Decomposition-based Multimodal Interaction Learning (DMIL), a novel paradigm that explicitly models and learns from sample-specific interactions. First, we design a variational decomposition architecture to isolate the constituent interaction components. Second, we employ a new learning strategy that leverages these explicit interaction components in a fine-tuning process to achieve comprehensive interaction learning. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks and architectures demonstrate that DMIL consistently achieves superior performance by adapting to holistic sample-specific interactions. Our framework is flexible and broadly applicable, establishing an interaction-centric paradigm for multimodal learning. The code is available at https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/DMIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次从信息论角度系统分析多模态交互中冗余、独特和协同信息的动态变化，指出现有模态集成和联合学习范式在捕获这些样本特定交互上的不足，并提出基于分解的多模态交互学习（DMIL）框架，通过变分分解架构隔离交互成分，并利用微调策略实现全面交互学习。实验表明DMIL在多种任务和架构上表现优越。
Motivation: 多模态学习依赖于跨模态的冗余、独特和协同信息，但这些交互随样本动态变化，现有范式无法有效捕获这种样本特定的交互。
Method: 提出DMIL框架：设计变分分解架构将多模态交互分离为冗余、独特和协同成分；采用微调策略利用这些显式交互成分进行综合学习。
Result: 在多种任务和架构上的实验表明，DMIL通过适应样本特定的交互实现了持续优越的性能。
Conclusion: 该框架灵活且广泛适用，建立了以交互为中心的多模态学习范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frozen Foundation-Model Embeddings Discard Small-Lesion Signal in Chest Radiography: Implications for Pre-Deployment Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Frozen vision-transformer (ViT) foundation-model embeddings increasingly serve as the substrate for downstream chest-radiography (CXR) pipelines, yet where small-scale, low-contrast signal is retained or lost in the frozen forward pass has not been systematically quantified across architectures, pretraining domains, and objectives. We probed five frozen ViTs (RAD-DINO, DINOv2-B/14, DINOv3 ViT-7B, BiomedCLIP, MedSigLIP) and a frozen DINO-pretrained ResNet-50 architectural control across three large CXR cohorts (NIH-CXR14, MIMIC-CXR, Emory-CXR; aggregate pool n=492,724) and ChestX-Det10 (n=3,543; 1,462 small-lesion bounding boxes across Calcification, Nodule, Mass). Each model was evaluated with a small-scale-perturbation panel and a region-aware bounding-box-stratified probe on real lesions, comparing three pooling modes from the same forward pass: classification token (CLS), patch-mean (mean over all final-layer patch tokens), and bounding-box-restricted patch-local. On the perturbation panel, CLS embeddings sat at the chance floor (area under the ROC curve [AUC] 0.500-0.524); patch-mean was indistinguishable from CLS on iso-blur and reticular-fine cells but rose with CLS on larger directional-blur footprints, while disease AUC on globally decided tasks ranged 0.642-0.913. Patch-local probes recovered AUC ~1.0 from the same forward pass (per-model mean improvement +0.412 to +0.488); the ResNet-50 control reproduced the chance floor. On ChestX-Det10, image-level CLS classification showed within-class small-versus-large stratum gaps up to +0.243 AUC; bounding-box-level patch-local pooling on the same forward pass recovered AUC >= 0.899 on every (model x class) cell. Frozen ViT embeddings silently suppress small-scale signal at the global-aggregation step; the signal is recoverable from patch tokens conditional on a region of interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统量化了五种冻结ViT基础模型（RAD-DINO, DINOv2-B/14, DINOv3 ViT-7B, BiomedCLIP, MedSigLIP）及一个冻结ResNet-50在胸部X光片上对小病灶信号的保留能力。实验表明，全局聚合（CLS token或patch-mean）在小尺度扰动和真实病灶检测中表现接近随机（AUC 0.5左右），而基于边界框的patch-local池化能从相同前向传播中恢复接近完美的信号（AUC~1.0），揭示冻结ViT嵌入在全局聚合步骤中会无声抑制小尺度信号。
Motivation: 冻结ViT基础模型被广泛用于下游CXR任务，但小尺度低对比度信号在前向传播中的保留或丢失尚未被系统量化，这一缺陷可能影响模型在部署前的评估可靠性。
Method: 使用小尺度扰动面板（iso-blur, reticular-fine cells等）和基于真实病灶边界框的区域感知探针，对五个冻结ViT和一个ResNet-50进行测试，比较三种池化模式：CLS token、patch-mean和bounding-box-restricted patch-local。数据来自NIH-CXR14、MIMIC-CXR、Emory-CXR（共492,724例）和ChestX-Det10（3,543例，含1,462个小病灶边界框）。
Result: 扰动面板上，CLS和patch-mean的AUC为0.500-0.524（接近随机），而patch-local的AUC恢复到1.0（平均提升0.412-0.488）；在ChestX-Det10上，CLS分类的小病灶与大病灶AUC差距达0.243，而patch-local在所有模型和类别上AUC均≥0.899。
Conclusion: 冻结ViT的全局聚合步骤会丢失小尺度信号，但该信号可从patch token中基于感兴趣区域恢复，提示部署前评估需关注局部特征而非仅全局表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Distilled Neural Network enabled by Large Language Models for Manufacturing Process-Property Predictive Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Predicting process-property relationships in manufacturing is often challenged by high experimental costs and the limited interpretability of complex 'black-box' models. This paper proposes a novel knowledge distillation framework designed to achieve high-accuracy predictions in data-scarce scenarios. The framework integrates analytical physics priors, which are systematically extracted from scientific literature via Large Language Models, into a privileged teacher model. We employ a Graph-Masked Attention layer to capture the complex physical dependencies among input variables showing strict setpoints or a combination of static and high-frequency temporal signatures. This privileged knowledge is distilled into a lightweight student predictor for inference. The feasibility and robustness of the framework are evaluated through a comprehensive experiment across five diverse manufacturing processes. To ensure statistical reliability, given the small dataset sizes, a repeated K-fold cross-validation technique is employed to quantify model stability and generalization. Results indicate that the proposed framework consistently achieves high predictive accuracy across all evaluated domains. Most importantly, the architecture demonstrates significant fault tolerance by maintaining robust predictive performance even in scenarios where LLM-derived analytical priors are suboptimal or incomplete. Furthermore, the student predictor achieves an inference frequency exceeding 6000 Hz, which facilitates real-time edge deployment on standard industrial hardware. This work provides a scalable solution for bridging the gap between theoretical physics and real-time industrial monitoring in data-limited environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对制造过程数据稀缺和模型可解释性差的问题，提出一种基于LLM提取物理先验的知识蒸馏框架。该框架将文献中的分析物理先验整合到特权教师模型中，并通过Graph-Masked Attention层捕获变量间的复杂依赖，再蒸馏给轻量学生模型。在五个不同制造过程上的实验表明，该方法在小样本下保持高预测精度，对不完美先验具有容错性，且学生模型推理频率超过6000Hz，适合实时边缘部署。
Motivation: 制造过程属性预测常面临实验成本高、数据稀缺，以及传统黑盒模型可解释性差的问题。
Method: 提出知识蒸馏框架：利用LLM从科学文献中系统提取分析物理先验，嵌入特权教师模型；教师模型采用Graph-Masked Attention层处理静态与高频时域输入；再将知识蒸馏至轻量学生模型用于推理。
Result: 在五个制造过程数据集上，重复K折交叉验证显示该方法始终达到高预测精度；即使LLM提取的先验不完善或次优，模型仍保持稳健性能；学生模型推理频率超6000Hz。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的方案，在数据受限环境下桥接理论物理与实时工业监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Aligning Hierarchical Standardized Embedding for Audio-visual Generalized Zero-shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual Generalized Zero-shot Learning (AV-GZSL) is a challenging task that aims to classify both seen and unseen objects or scenes by integrating data from audio and visual modalities. Recent studies primarily focus on fusing or aligning audio and visual features to generate more informative audio-visual embeddings. Also, aligning the audio-visual and textual features of most existing methods relies solely on the optimization objectives. However, those methods neglect the inherent distributional and structural differences between audio-visual and textual modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a method termed Aligning Hierarchical Standardized Embedding (AHSE), which enables hierarchical alignment of standardized audio-visual and textual embeddings within a shared embedding space. Specifically, we first apply Z-score standardization to the fused audio-visual and textual embeddings to reduce distributional mismatches. We then introduce a hierarchical alignment strategy that minimizes discrepancies at the semantic, class, and batch levels, thereby constructing a more robust and well-structured embedding space. This strategy not only preserves semantic and inter-class relationships but also maintains spatial consistency within each batch. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets: VGGSound-GZSL, UCF-GZSL, and ActivityNet-GZSL, demonstrate that AHSE achieves competitive performance in zero-shot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音频-视觉广义零样本学习（AV-GZSL）中视听特征与文本特征分布不一致的问题，提出层次化标准化嵌入对齐方法（AHSE）。该方法先对融合后的视听与文本嵌入进行Z-score标准化以缩小分布差异，再通过语义、类别和批次三个层次的层次化对齐策略构建更鲁棒的嵌入空间。在VGGSound-GZSL、UCF-GZSL和ActivityNet-GZSL三个基准数据集上取得了有竞争力的零样本学习性能。
Motivation: 现有AV-GZSL方法仅依赖优化目标来对齐视听与文本特征，忽略了两种模态之间固有的分布和结构差异。
Method: 提出AHSE方法：首先对融合后的视听嵌入和文本嵌入进行Z-score标准化以缓解分布不匹配；然后引入语义级、类别级和批次级三个层次的层次化对齐策略，最小化各层次差异。
Result: 在VGGSound-GZSL、UCF-GZSL和ActivityNet-GZSL三个基准数据集上，AHSE取得了有竞争力的零样本学习性能。
Conclusion: 层次化标准化嵌入对齐能够有效改善视听与文本模态间的分布和结构差异，提升AV-GZSL性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatially Coupled Phase-to-Depth Calibration for Fringe Projection Profilometry
papers.abstract_en: In fringe projection profilometry (FPP), depth is commonly recovered by fitting a phase-to-depth relation independently at each camera pixel. Although such pixel-wise calibration achieves high local accuracy, neighboring pixels can acquire markedly different calibration functions even when they observe the same smooth surface, producing spatially inconsistent geometry and structured surface artifacts. We propose a spatially coupled phase-depth transformation in which all pixels share a single low-dimensional mapping-global phase scalars combined with affine spatial terms on the undistorted reference-camera grid-rather than independent per-pixel fits, optionally augmented by a bounded, spatially smooth correction field. We further introduce a native-grid pairing scheme that constructs phase-depth calibration pairs directly on the reference-camera grid: when depth supervision comes from a rectified active-stereo pipeline, planes are fitted in stereo 3D and sampled back onto the camera grid along native rays, so the phase maps are never rectified. On a dental target with high-resolution scanner ground truth, the proposed model attains point-to-surface RMSE comparable to an active-stereo reference (about 12μm aggregate) while substantially improving spatial coherence over pixel-wise polynomial and rational calibration, and reduces the runtime mapping to a few element-wise operations per pixel with negligible parameter storage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对条纹投影轮廓术中逐像素相位-深度标定导致的空间不一致和伪影问题，提出一种空间耦合的相位-深度变换。该方法让所有像素共享一个低维映射（全局相位标量加仿射空间项以及可选的平滑修正场），而非独立拟合。同时引入原生网格配对方案，在参考相机网格上直接构建标定对。在口腔扫描数据集上，该方法达到与主动立体参考相当的精度（点对面RMSE约12μm），显著改善了空间一致性，且计算量小、参数存储少。
Motivation: 现有逐像素标定方法虽局部精度高，但相邻像素标定函数差异大，导致几何不一致和结构化伪影。
Method: 提出空间耦合相位-深度变换：所有像素共享全局相位标量加仿射空间项（在未畸变的参考相机网格上），可选加有界平滑修正场；配合原生网格配对方案，在参考相机网格上沿原生射线采样构建标定对，避免相位图重畸变。
Result: 在口腔扫描高分辨率基准上，点对面RMSE约12μm，与主动立体参考相当；空间一致性显著优于逐像素多项式/有理函数标定，运行时仅需少量逐元素操作。
Conclusion: 该方法有效消除了空间不一致和伪影，降低了计算和存储开销，适用于对空间一致性要求高的FPP应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When is Your LLM Steerable?
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the generation process, e.g., after generating the first few tokens, and how to leverage such a predictor to improve steering success rate. To this end, we first introduce ASTEER, a testbed including 1.4M steered generations, spanning 150 concepts with each steering success/failure labeled. Leveraging this testbed, we analyze the model's early decoding dynamics by extracting features that compare hidden states before and after steering across layers and initial decoding steps. These features help us understand how steering's effects propagate along layers and token positions, which provide key information for steerability prediction. We then train a Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT) classifier on these features to predict whether an intervention will under-steer, succeed, or over-steer without requiring full rollout. Our predictor achieves around 0.7 macro-F1 score on unseen concepts, demonstrating that early hidden states encode substantial, structured information about eventual steering efficacy. We further leverage this steerability predictor as guidance for steering strength searching, achieving near-optimal performance with a small fraction of decoding cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从语言模型生成初期的内部状态预测激活干预(activation steering)的可操控性(steerability)，并利用该预测改进干预成功率。作者构建了包含140万次干预生成的测试台ASTEER，提取早期解码动态特征，训练梯度提升决策树(GBDT)分类器预测干预是否欠操控、成功或过操控，在未见概念上达到约0.7 macro-F1。进一步利用该预测导向搜索操控强度，以少量解码成本达到接近最优性能。
Motivation: 激活干预的成功与否高度依赖提示、概念、模型和配置，现有方法需昂贵网格搜索和事后评估。本文探索能否从生成过程初期状态预测可操控性，并利用该预测提升干预成功率。
Method: 构建ASTEER测试台，包含140万次干预生成，标注成功失败。提取跨层和初始解码步骤的隐藏状态对比特征，训练GBDT分类器进行三分类预测（欠操控、成功、过操控）。再利用预测导向操控强度搜索，减少解码成本。
Result: 分类器在未见概念上达到约0.7 macro-F1，利用预测导向搜索以少量解码成本达到接近最优性能。
Conclusion: 早期隐藏状态编码了关于干预效果的充足结构化信息，可用于预测和优化操控强度。
Relevance: 0
