papers.title: Model-Based and Data-Driven Hierarchical Control and Topology Co-Design for Robust Networked Systems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider a class of networked systems comprising an interconnected set of linear subsystems, disturbance inputs, and performance outputs. Using dissipativity theory, we first propose a model-based hierarchical control design strategy to ensure the closed-loop networked system is dissipative from its disturbance inputs to performance outputs. This involves designing local controllers for each subsystem to enforce local dissipativity guarantees, which are then exploited to co-design distributed global controllers and the interconnection topology to enforce global dissipativity guarantees while optimizing interconnection topology costs. The overall design process requires only solving a sequence of linear matrix inequality (LMI) problems, thereby retaining compositionality and decentralizability while avoiding non-convex, iterative design processes that are inefficient and centralized. This model-based hierarchical control design strategy assumes the knowledge of the subsystem dynamics, which may not hold in many real-world networked systems. Motivated by this, we also propose a data-driven hierarchical control design strategy that assumes only the availability of rich input-state-output trajectory data from the subsystems. The proposed data-driven design process assumes that the unknown disturbances affecting the subsystem dynamics are bounded by a quadratic matrix inequality (relaxing conventional bounds) and accounts for this by using the matrix S-lemma. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model-based and data-driven hierarchical control designs is illustrated for a networked system representing a DC microgrid, with the aim of enforcing robust (dissipative) voltage regulation and current sharing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对一类由线性子系统、扰动输入和性能输出构成的网络化系统，提出基于耗散性理论的模型驱动分层控制与拓扑协同设计方法，并进一步扩展到数据驱动场景，仅需子系统轨迹数据。在DC微电网案例上验证了该方法在电压调节和电流共享方面的鲁棒性能。
Motivation: 实际网络化系统中子系统动力学通常未知，而传统模型驱动方法依赖精确模型，驱动数据驱动方法的提出以放宽此假设。
Method: 模型驱动方法通过顺序求解线性矩阵不等式（LMI）实现局部与全局耗散性保证及拓扑成本优化；数据驱动方法利用子系统输入-状态-输出轨迹数据，结合矩阵S引理处理未知有界扰动。
Result: 在DC微电网网络实例上，该方法实现了鲁棒（耗散）的电压调节和电流共享。
Conclusion: 所提设计流程保持了组合性和分散性，避免了非凸迭代集中式设计，并适用于模型未知场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kuramoto Attention: Synchronizing Self-Attention on the Torus
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kuramoto attention, a self-attention layer in which each hidden coordinate is an angle. The layer scores tokens by gated cosine similarity, attends over previous phase states, and updates each token by the tangent component of the attention-weighted circular mean. Because the values are the raw phase states, this update is exactly the Kuramoto coupling term $\sum_u A_{t,u}\sin(θ_u-θ_t)$, with the attention matrix acting as an adaptive, content-dependent coupling kernel. Equivalently, the gated score is a learned metric on the torus that selects which tokens couple, and the update pulls each token toward the circular mean of the tokens it selects, tightening their phase agreement. The same two ingredients, an invariant similarity score and an on-manifold mean, define such a layer on any compact group; the torus is the abelian case, where both are closed-form. The softmax weights solve an entropy-regularized phase-retrieval problem, and rotary position enters as a position-dependent phase drift in the score. On enwiki8 character-level language modeling, the layer trains as a functional language model whose bits-per-character stays close to a strong matched RoPE+SwiGLU transformer: within $0.02$ BPC at one million parameters ($1.637\pm0.010$ versus $1.616\pm0.004$) and level on the median at five million ($1.448$ versus $1.452$ over five seeds) with the transformer ahead on the mean ($1.468$ versus $1.456$). These experiments establish that the constrained geometric structure is a viable language model at this scale; the structure itself, and its synchronization reading, is the contribution. Ablations isolate the load-bearing components, and the result gives a compact bridge between self-attention and phase synchronization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kuramoto attention，一种将自注意力层中隐藏坐标约束为角度（位于环面上）的新机制。该层通过门控余弦相似度计算注意力分数，并利用注意力权重的循环均值（circular mean）更新 token，更新形式与 Kuramoto 耦合项精确对应。在 enwiki8 字符级语言建模任务上，该模型在百万参数规模下达到与强基线（RoPE+SwiGLU）接近的 bits-per-character（BPC），验证了这种约束几何结构作为语言模型的可行性。
Motivation: 标准自注意力机制缺乏对向量在流形上几何结构的显式约束，而许多自然过程（如相位同步）天然具有循环或周期性特征。作者旨在探索将自注意力嵌入到环面（torus）流形上，使其更新规则与相位同步方程等价，从而建立自注意力与相位同步之间的桥梁。
Method: 定义自注意力层为：每个隐藏坐标是角度；通过门控余弦相似度计算 token 间的注意力分数；更新规则为当前 token 角度与注意力加权循环均值（circular mean）的差，即 Kuramoto 耦合项。该设计可推广到任意紧致群，环面是阿贝尔情形，相似度和均值均有闭式解。

papers.title: Beyond the Golden Teacher: Enhancing Graph Learning through LLM-GNN Co-teaching
papers.abstract_en: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) underlie real-world applications such as citation networks, social media, and e-commerce. Few-shot graph learning on TAGs is hard: with only a handful of labels per class and the rest of the graph unannotated, neither GNNs nor LLMs can learn well on their own. GNNs read topology and fail on cold nodes; LLMs read text and fail on text-ambiguous nodes. Existing LLM-GNN methods all follow the same recipe: designate one model as the golden teacher and use its outputs (e.g., features or pseudo-labels) to supervise the other. We argue this golden-teacher assumption breaks under sparse supervision: neither model is golden, and treating either as such transfers its blind spots into the student. We therefore ask: can we avoid designating either model as the golden teacher, and still perform effective graph learning? We answer with LLM-GNN Co-Teaching, a bidirectional co-teaching framework in which neither model is fixed as teacher. The GNN and LLM exchange their most confident pseudo-labels under an architecture-specific small-loss criterion, and both update every round. Supervision is then mined from the trajectory: whenever a node moves from cross-model contradiction at round t to cross-model agreement at round t+1, the LLM's two answers on the same input form a preference pair (old contradicting self < new peer-endorsed self) for DPO training. We call this Round-based Pseudo-Label Preference Optimization (RPL-PO). On six benchmarks, LLM-GNN Co-Teaching consistently outperforms GNN-as-Judge and all prior methods, with absolute 3-shot gains of 7.86% on Cora and 7.73% on ogbn-arxiv; improvements carry over to 5-shot and to zero-shot cross-dataset transfer. Error-structure analysis further shows that abandoning the golden-teacher assumption substantially improves the LLM's graph learning capability on challenging samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-GNN Co-Teaching双向协同教学框架，解决文本属性图上的少样本学习问题。传统方法将LLM或GNN之一固定为黄金教师，在稀疏监督下会传递盲点。所提框架让GNN和LLM交换最自信的伪标签，并通过轮次偏好优化（RPL-PO）利用节点从矛盾到一致的轨迹进行DPO训练。在六个基准上，3-shot设置下Cora提升7.86%、ogbn-arxiv提升7.73%，且5-shot和零样本跨数据集迁移也有改进。
Motivation: 现有LLM-GNN方法都假定一个模型为黄金教师并单向监督另一个，但在少样本标签下，两种模型各有缺陷，单向监督会把盲点传递给学生。
Method: 提出双向协同教学框架：GNN和LLM每轮交换各自最自信的伪标签，通过小损失准则筛选后更新双方；引入轮次伪标签偏好优化（RPL-PO），当节点从跨模型矛盾变为跨模型一致时，将LLM的两次回答构造为偏好对用于DPO训练。
Result: 在Corafull和ogbn-arxiv的3-shot设置下分别提升7.86%和7.73%，优于GNN-as-Judge等先前方法；5-shot和零样本跨数据集迁移也有显著改进。
Conclusion: 放弃黄金教师假设能大幅提升LLM在图学习中对困难样本的表现，双向协同框架在文本属性图少样本学习上优于现有范式。

papers.title: Contactless 3D Human Body Measurement Using Depth Cameras for Smart Health Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Contactless body measurement technologies are becoming increasingly significant for smart health monitoring, digital health applications, and remote patient assessment. Traditional anthropometric measurements typically necessitate physical contact and trained personnel, which may constrain scalability in remote healthcare settings. In this study, we introduce a depth camera-based framework for estimating human body measurements utilizing 3D point cloud data. An Orbbec Astra 2 depth camera was employed to capture RGB images, depth maps, and 3D point clouds of participants. The captured point cloud was processed using Python-based tools, including Open3D, NumPy, and OpenCV, to segment the human body from the background. Key anthropometric measurements, such as height and arm span, were computed. The measurements were obtained through a combination of spatial filtering and landmark selection on the 3D point cloud, followed by the projection of the computed measurements onto the corresponding RGB image using camera intrinsic parameters. In addition to linear measurements, the approximate body volume and visible surface area were estimated using voxel-based occupancy analysis and mesh-based surface reconstruction methods. The experimental results from a single depth capture demonstrated that accurate body measurements and geometric estimates could be obtained from depth camera data without physical contact. This study provides a foundation for future real-time systems that integrate depth sensing with intelligent health monitoring and generative AI models for smart healthcare applications.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Depth camera-based framework for contactless anthropometric measurement and geometric analysis using 3D point clouds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度摄像头的非接触式人体测量框架，使用Orbbec Astra 2深度相机采集RGB图像、深度图和3D点云，通过Open3D、NumPy和OpenCV等工具处理点云数据，分割人体并计算身高、臂展等关键人体测量指标，同时利用体素占用分析和网格表面重建方法估算身体体积和表面积。实验表明，单次深度捕获即可获得准确的人体测量数据，无需物理接触，为未来实时健康监测和生成式AI应用奠定基础。
Motivation: 传统人体测量需要物理接触和专业操作，难以在远程医疗场景中大规模应用；现有非接触方法在精度和易用性上存在不足。
Method: 采用Orbbec Astra 2深度相机获取3D点云，结合空间滤波和地标选择算法从点云中提取身高、臂展等线性测量值，并通过相机内参投影到RGB图像；使用体素占用分析和网格重建分别估算身体体积与可见表面积。
Result: 单次深度捕获实验表明，该方法可无接触地获得准确的人体测量和几何估计值，验证了深度相机在人体测量中的可行性。
Conclusion: 该框架为集成深度感知与智能健康监测的实时系统提供了基础，未来可结合生成式AI用于智慧医疗。

papers.title: AVIS: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) benefit from chain-of-thought prompting and test-time scaling, but these gains often come with prohibitive inference cost due to large visual contexts and long decoding chains. We view this cost through two coupled axes: Visual Context Scaling (VCS), which controls how much visual evidence is passed to the language model, and Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS), which controls how much inference-time reasoning search is performed. Existing methods typically optimize one axis at a time, leaving the joint allocation of compute across these axes underexplored. We introduce Adaptive Visual Inference Scaling (AVIS), a lightweight policy that adapts both VCS and VRS per query. AVIS realizes VCS through Key Diversity Visual (KDV) pruning, a training-free $O(N)$ key-based rule for removing redundant visual tokens before prefilling, and realizes VRS through adaptive self-consistency, using a learned difficulty predictor to select the number of reasoning rollouts. AVIS is deployment-friendly and compatible with shared-prefill inference, where all rollouts reuse a single prefilling pass and KV cache. Across diverse image and video reasoning benchmarks, AVIS improves the accuracy--compute trade-off relative to VCS-only and VRS-only baselines, and remains effective on top of RL post-trained VLMs while keeping compute and latency low.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AVIS（自适应视觉推理缩放），一种轻量级策略，能够在推理时联合调整视觉上下文缩放（VCS）和视觉推理缩放（VRS）。通过键多样性视觉剪枝（KDV）减少冗余视觉token，以及使用难度预测器自适应选择推理rollout数量，AVIS在多个图像和视频推理基准上改进了准确率-计算权衡，且兼容共享预填充推理。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）通过思维链和测试时缩放提升性能，但大视觉上下文和长解码链导致高昂推理成本。已有方法通常单独优化视觉上下文缩放或视觉推理缩放，忽视了二者间的联合计算分配。
Method: AVIS包含两项关键组件：1) 键多样性视觉剪枝（KDV），一种无需训练的O(N)基于键的规则，在预填充前移除冗余视觉token；2) 自适应自一致性，通过学习的难度预测器选择推理rollout数量。该方法与共享预填充推理兼容，所有rollout复用单个预填充和KV缓存。
Result: 在多样化的图像和视频推理基准上，相比仅优化VCS或VRS的基线，AVIS改进了准确率-计算权衡，并且在RL后训练的VLM上仍保持有效，同时计算和延迟较低。
Conclusion: AVIS是一种部署友好的策略，通过联合自适应缩放视觉上下文和推理步骤，在推理成本受限时提升VLM性能。

papers.title: Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Discovering Diverse Designs within Target Property Windows
papers.abstract_en: In many materials and product design problems, desirable candidates exhibit properties that fall within an acceptable range rather than achieve a single optimum. Recovering multiple, distinct solutions that satisfy such specifications is also practically valuable, as some candidates may be preferred for reasons of cost, processability, or robustness that are difficult to encode directly in an objective function. Here, we develop a range-aware Bayesian optimization (BO) framework in which the acquisition function directly scores the posterior probability that a candidate satisfies a target range. The framework naturally extends to parallel pursuit of multiple distinct specifications over a shared candidate space. Across benchmark tasks, range-aware acquisition consistently recovers larger and more diverse sets of valid designs than standard BO baselines and recent goal-seeking methods. Its utility is further demonstrated in two practically motivated design case studies involving optimizing reaction conditions for polymer synthesis and sequence-defined oligomer discovery for prescribed optical absorption bands, supported by quantum chemical calculations. These results suggest that range-aware BO can provide a practical and sample-efficient foundation for specification-driven design, particularly when design flexibility and solution diversity are important considerations.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 6 main text figures, 17 supporting figures, 6 supporting tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种范围感知贝叶斯优化（Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization）框架，用于在目标属性窗口内发现多样化设计。该方法通过采集函数直接评估候选解满足目标范围的后验概率，并自然地扩展到共享候选空间上并行追求多个不同规格。在基准任务中，范围感知采集比标准贝叶斯优化基线和近期目标搜索方法能恢复更大、更多样化的有效设计集。在聚合物合成的反应条件优化和序列定义低聚物发现两个实际案例中，该方法也展现了实用性。
Motivation: 许多材料和产品设计中，理想候选表现出落在可接受范围内的属性而非单一最优值，且需要多个不同解决方案以考虑成本、可加工性或鲁棒性等因素，这些因素难以直接编码进目标函数。现有贝叶斯优化方法多针对单目标优化，缺乏对目标范围和多解多样性的支持。
Method: 开发一种范围感知贝叶斯优化框架，其采集函数直接评分候选解满足目标范围的后验概率，并支持并行搜索多个不同规格（目标范围）。
Result: 在基准任务中，范围感知采集一致地恢复出比标准贝叶斯优化基线和近期目标搜索方法更大、更多样化的有效设计集。在聚合物合成反应条件优化和序列定义低聚物发现两个实际案例中，该方法得到量子化学计算支持，展示了实用性。
Conclusion: 范围感知贝叶斯优化可为规格驱动设计提供实用且样本高效的框架，特别是在设计灵活性和解多样性重要时。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Understanding Cross-Sensor Feature Variations for Generalizable 3D Perception
papers.abstract_en: Radar-camera BEV perception often suffers from degraded performance when evaluated across datasets, as changes in driving scenes, sensor configurations, and environmental conditions can alter both the input observations and the internal fused representations. This work studies this issue from the perspective of source-domain variation modeling, aiming to improve the robustness of BEV-based 3D detectors without relying on target-domain samples. We introduce a framework that characterizes visual scene variations in the frequency domain and uses them to synthesize diverse source-domain views. By comparing the resulting fused BEV representations, the framework further captures how image-level variations influence multi-modal BEV features. These variation patterns are then used to regularize the detector, encouraging the learned fusion space to remain stable under latent scene changes. The proposed method is applied only during training and leaves the inference pipeline unchanged. Experiments on cross-dataset radar-camera 3D detection between View-of-Delft and TJ4DRadSet demonstrate consistent improvements over multiple BEV fusion backbones, and the gains remain effective when a small amount of target-domain data is available.

papers.title: FreqKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Infrared Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning from large-scale RGB foundation models to infrared (IR) imagery through knowledge distillation (KD) remains challenging due to fundamental differences in image formation physics. We investigate the spectral structure of the RGB--IR modality gap and observe that feature divergence is not uniform across spatial frequencies: low-frequency components (shape, layout) show greater cross-modal alignment than high-frequency components (texture, fine edges), which reflect modality-specific characteristics. Based on this analysis, we propose FreqKD, a frequency-decoupled distillation framework that applies asymmetric supervision adapted to each band's cross-modal consistency. The method employs strict mean squared error (MSE) on the low-frequency band to preserve shared structural information and a relaxed log-MSE loss (weighted at 0.1) on the high-frequency band to provide edge guidance while tolerating texture differences. Spectral divergence analysis on 500 paired samples shows that high-frequency divergence exceeds low-frequency divergence by a factor of 2.4x on average across all analysed transformer layers. On KAIST multispectral pedestrian detection, FreqKD achieves 64.1 mAP50, improving 2.4 points over the DINOv2 baseline. The learned representation transfers across datasets (FLIR ADAS, +2.1 mAP50), tasks (MFNet segmentation, +1.85 mean intersection-over-union), and architectures (ResNet-50, +1.0 mAP50). Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/freq_decoupled_kd-5E5A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FreqKD，一种频率解耦的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，用于红外目标检测。通过分析RGB与红外图像在不同空间频率上的特征差异，对低频成分采用严格MSE损失以保留结构信息，对高频成分采用宽松的log-MSE损失以容忍纹理差异。在KAIST多光谱行人检测上达到64.1 mAP50，比DINOv2基线提升2.4点，并在FLIR ADAS、MFNet分割和ResNet-50架构上展示了跨数据集、任务和架构的迁移性。
Motivation: RGB与红外图像因成像物理差异导致模态鸿沟，且特征差异在空间频率上不均匀：低频成分（形状、布局）对齐较好，高频成分（纹理、边缘）差异大，需要针对性的蒸馏策略。
Method: 提出频率解耦蒸馏框架，对低频带使用严格MSE损失以保持共享结构信息，对高频带使用加权0.1的log-MSE损失以提供边缘指导并容忍纹理差异。
Result: 在KAIST数据集上mAP50提升2.4点（64.1 mAP50）；在FLIR ADAS上+2.1 mAP50；在MFNet分割任务上+1.85 mIoU；在ResNet-50架构上+1.0 mAP50。
Conclusion: 频率解耦策略有效缓解RGB到红外知识迁移中的模态差异，且学到的表示具有跨数据集、任务和架构的泛化能力。

papers.title: Enhancing Spectral Embedding through Robust and Flexible Knowledge Transfer in Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: We propose a spectral-based, unsupervised representation learning framework to derive low-dimensional embeddings for clinical concepts and patients in rare disease cohorts from electronic health records, where data are high-dimensional but sample sizes are limited. To overcome this challenge, we incorporate a knowledge matrix extracted from a broader population that shares a partially overlapping subspace with the rare-disease cohort. Our method departs from existing approaches by relaxing restrictive one-to-one signal-alignment assumptions between the latent data matrix and knowledge matrix, allowing more flexible and realistic forms of structured sharing. We introduce a novel two-step spectral embedding procedure: first, we identify and remove irrelevant components from the knowledge matrix; then, we apply a projection-based method to separately recover shared and heterogeneous components. Simulations and an analysis of a real-world multiple sclerosis cohort show that the proposed method outperforms competing approaches, particularly in challenging scenarios where shared signals are weak and only partially aligned, as is common in rare-disease data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于谱的无监督表示学习框架，用于从电子健康记录中为罕见病队列的临床概念和患者推导低维嵌入。该方法通过从更广泛人群中提取的知识矩阵进行知识迁移，并放宽了传统方法中潜在数据矩阵与知识矩阵之间一对一的信号对齐假设。两步谱嵌入过程包括去除知识矩阵中的无关成分，然后通过投影方法分离共享和异质成分。实验表明，该方法在共享信号弱且仅部分对齐的挑战性场景中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 罕见病队列的电子健康记录具有高维小样本特点，传统谱嵌入方法因数据稀疏而效果不佳。现有知识迁移方法要求潜在数据矩阵与知识矩阵之间存在严格的一对一信号对齐，这在罕见病数据中不现实。
Method: 提出两步谱嵌入方法：首先识别并去除知识矩阵中的无关成分；然后应用基于投影的方法分别恢复共享成分和异质成分。知识矩阵从更广泛人群中提取，与罕见病队列共享部分重叠子空间。
Result: 在模拟实验和一个真实多发性硬化症队列分析中，所提方法在共享信号弱且仅部分对齐的挑战场景下优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过灵活的知识迁移和鲁棒的成分分离，有效提升了罕见病数据集上的谱嵌入质量，但未探讨在极低样本量或完全无共享子空间情况下的表现。

papers.title: ConsistencyPlanner: Real-time Planning with Fast-Sampling Consistency Models
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop planning in complex, real-world driving scenarios presents a critical challenge for autonomous driving systems. While traditional rule-based methods are interpretable, their predefined heuristics lack the adaptability for dynamic traffic environments. Learning-based approaches have shown considerable promise. Conversely, learning-based approaches, despite their promise, struggle to balance the modeling diverse and multimodal driving behaviors and real-time planning, often leading to indecisive or unsafe actions. To address this limitation, we propose Consistency Planner, a real-time planning framework with fast-sampling consistency models. Our approach is built upon two key technical contributions. Efficient Multimodal Sampling: We employ fast-sampling consistency models to generate a diverse set of plausible future trajectories. This enables efficient, real-time exploration of multimodal actions, overcoming the computational bottlenecks of previous iterative generative methods. Heterogeneous Feature Fusion: We introduce an attention-enhanced decoder that dynamically integrates heterogeneous input features (including scene feature and action token) into a cohesive representation for robust planning. Extensive evaluation in the Waymax simulator demonstrates superior performance in safety metrics compared to existing methods, with particularly strong results in challenging dynamic scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConsistencyPlanner 提出一种基于快速采样一致性模型的实时规划框架，用于自动驾驶中的闭环规划。该方法通过高效多模态采样和异构特征融合，在 Waymax 仿真器上展现出优于现有方法的安全性能，尤其在动态场景中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶规划方法难兼顾多模态驾驶行为建模与实时性，导致决策不果断或不安全。
Method: 提出基于一致性模型（Consistency Model）的快速采样规划框架，包含高效多模态采样和注意力增强的异构特征融合解码器。
Result: 在 Waymax 仿真器上，ConsistencyPlanner 在安全指标上优于现有方法，尤其在复杂动态场景中性能显著。
Conclusion: 快速采样一致性模型能实现实时多模态轨迹生成，结合异构特征融合可提升闭环规划的鲁棒性。

papers.title: 4DP-QA: Scalable QA for 4D Perception in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances, Vision Language Models (VLMs) still struggle to grasp the dynamics of the world. We note that the ability to reason about a 4D scene, challenging in itself, is further complicated by two factors. First, VLMs observe motion indirectly via its projection onto 2D images. Second, existing datasets fail to disentangle object and camera motion. To address these challenges, we present a QA generation pipeline that focuses on motion-related scene understanding. We take particular care of the entanglement of camera and object motion by casting tracking in both the traditional way and in a novel, fixed reference system, dubbed True-Motion Tracking, which provides an intuitive description of motion. From this pipeline, we generate a large-scale training dataset of 400K samples, 4DP-QA (4D Perception QA), and a 2.2K-sample benchmark, 4DP-QA-Bench. Training existing models on our dataset yields performance improvements on an external benchmark, validating the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在4D场景动态感知上的不足，提出一种QA生成流程，通过True-Motion Tracking解耦物体运动与相机运动，并据此构建大规模训练数据集4DP-QA（40万样本）和基准4DP-QA-Bench（2200样本）。实验表明，在该数据集上训练可提升VLM在外部基准上的性能。
Motivation: 现有VLM难以理解4D场景动态，主要因为运动仅通过2D投影间接观察，且数据集未能区分物体运动与相机运动，导致感知能力受限。
Method: 提出一种QA生成流程，包含传统跟踪和基于固定参考系的True-Motion Tracking，从而解耦相机与物体运动，生成运动相关的问答数据，构建4DP-QA数据集和基准。
Result: 在外部基准（如某运动理解任务）上，使用4DP-QA训练后的VLM模型性能得到提升，验证了数据有效性。
Conclusion: 通过解耦运动和专用QA数据可以显著提升VLM的4D感知能力，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Modal Benchmarking for Robotic Perception in Natural Environments
papers.abstract_en: Natural environments present a complex challenge to robotics perception systems. Current models, particularly vision foundation models, are largely trained on structured, urban environments leading to weaknesses in their perception for field robotics tasks. We showcase the limitations of current models using our recently released WildCross benchmark, a new cross-modal benchmark for place recognition and metric depth estimation in large-scale natural environments. WildCross comprises over 476K sequential RGB frames with semi-dense depth and surface normal annotations, each aligned with accurate 6DoF pose and synchronized dense lidar submaps. In this work, we provide an expanded analysis of the benchmark results from the recent WildCross benchmark, with particular emphasis on expanded metric depth estimation experiments. Access to the code repository and dataset for this work can be found at https://csiro-robotics.github.io/WildCross.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IEEE ICRA Workshop on Open Challenges for Rigorous Robot Perception 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用新发布的 WildCross 基准，评估了现有视觉基础模型在自然环境中进行地点识别和度量深度估计的性能，展示了它们在结构化城市环境外感知能力不足的问题。摘要重点分析了度量深度估计实验的扩展结果，并提供了代码和数据集。
Motivation: 当前机器人感知模型大多在结构化城市环境上训练，导致在自然环境中表现不佳，缺乏专门的跨模态基准来评估和推动改进。
Method: 使用 WildCross 基准，该基准包含超过 47.6 万帧 RGB 图像及半稠密深度、表面法线标注、6DoF 姿态和同步稠密激光雷达子图，用于跨模态地点识别和度量深度估计评估。
Result: 实验揭示了现有模型在自然场景下地点识别和深度估计上的局限性，具体量化结果在摘要中未给出。
Conclusion: 强调需要针对自然环境设计更鲁棒的感知方法，WildCross 基准为未来研究提供了评估平台。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 实验揭示了现有模型在自然场景下地点识别和深度估计上的局限性，具体量化结果在摘要中未给出。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调需要针对自然环境设计更鲁棒的感知方法，WildCross 基准为未来研究提供了评估平台。

papers.title: GraphInfer-Bench: Benchmarking LLM's Inference Capability on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph analysis underlies many applications whose answers cannot be looked up in a single record or retrieved along a path: laundering rings, drug repurposing, user preference, and scientific theme are all inferred from a node together with its neighbourhood. We introduce GraphInfer-Bench, a benchmark for whether LLMs can perform this graph inference: producing an open-ended answer that no single node supports and no path retrieves. Existing graph-QA protocols cannot test this capability: algorithm simulation, node classification, single-node description, KG-QA, and GraphRAG all admit answers retrievable from one node or along a path. GraphInfer-Bench defines five tasks along Description (what a region is) and Comparison (how regions differ), each constructed so the ground truth lives in no single node. The release contains 42,000 samples across six real-world graphs, produced automatically and screened by a four-layer quality-control protocol. We evaluate four method families against the same tasks: graph-token alignment models, zero-shot frontier closed-source LLMs, Graph2Text supervised fine-tuning, and plain GNNs as a structural reference. No method family closes the gap. Graph-token alignment partially handles description tasks (relational, theme) but collapses on comparison tasks. Frontier LLMs lead on outlier detection and community partition among LLM-based methods but lag on masked-node prediction. Graph2Text SFT is the strongest LLM-based method on the description side yet falls behind frontier LLMs on comparison. Across every task, plain GNNs match or beat the strongest LLM-based row, with the largest margin on community detection. GraphInfer-Bench surfaces graph inference as an open capability gap rather than a property of any one architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphInfer-Bench，一个评估大语言模型（LLM）在图结构上进行推理能力的基准。现有图问答协议无法测试这种推理，因为它们允许从单个节点或路径检索答案。GraphInfer-Bench 定义了五个任务（描述和比较），答案不存于任何单个节点。数据集包含来自六个真实世界图的42,000个样本，并通过四层质量控制。评估了四种方法系列：图-令牌对齐模型、零样本前沿闭源LLM、Graph2Text监督微调以及普通GNN。结果表明，没有方法系列能够弥合差距，普通GNN在所有任务上匹配或超越最强的LLM方法，尤其在社区检测上差距最大。这揭示了图推理是一个开放的能力缺口，而非特定架构的属性。
Motivation: 现有图问答协议（如算法模拟、节点分类、单节点描述、KG-QA和GraphRAG）允许从单个节点或路径检索答案，无法测试LLM在图结构上进行真正推理的能力。因此需要一个新的基准来评估LLM是否能够进行图推理——产生没有单个节点支持或路径检索的开放式答案。
Method: 提出了GraphInfer-Bench基准，包含五个任务（沿描述和比较维度），每个任务构造得使真实答案不存于任何单个节点。数据集自动生成并通过四层质量控制，包含来自六个真实世界图的42,000个样本。评估了四种方法系列：图-令牌对齐模型、零样本前沿闭源LLM、Graph2Text监督微调以及普通GNN作为结构参考。
Result: 没有方法系列能够弥合图推理的差距。图-令牌对齐部分处理描述任务（关系、主题）但在比较任务上失败。前沿LLM在异常检测和社区划分方面领先于基于LLM的方法，但在掩码节点预测上落后。Graph2Text SFT在描述方面是最强的LLM方法，但在比较方面落后于前沿LLM。普通GNN在所有任务上匹配或超越最强的LLM方法，在社区检测上差距最大。
Conclusion: GraphInfer-Bench揭示了图推理是一个开放的能力缺口，而非任何特定架构的属性。当前所有方法都无法很好解决图推理问题。

papers.title: LLMs+Graphs: Toward Graph-Native, Synergistic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, but their limitations in structured and multi-hop reasoning underscore the need for graph-native, synergistic artificial intelligence (AI) systems. Graph-structured data underpins critical applications across social, biological, financial, transportation, web, and knowledge domains, making it essential to understand how LLMs can leverage graph computation for grounded, context-rich inference. Three complementary synergies are emerging: LLMs augmented with graph computation for retrieval and reasoning; bidirectional integration between LLMs and knowledge graphs (KGs), where LLMs support KG construction and curation while KGs enforce semantic constraints and factual consistency; and AI agents strengthened by graph algorithms for planning, decision making, and multi-step reasoning. In parallel, LLMs introduce new capabilities for graph data management and graph machine learning (ML) through natural language interfaces and hybrid LLM-graph neural network (GNN) pipelines. This tutorial synthesizes the algorithms, systems, and design principles driving these converging directions, offering data science and data mining researchers a unified perspective on integrating LLMs, graph data management, graph mining, graph ML, and agentic computation into next-generation graph-native AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为一篇教程，综述了大语言模型（LLMs）与图计算、知识图谱（KGs）及图神经网络（GNN）协同构建下一代图原生AI系统的研究进展。摘要指出LLMs在结构化推理上的局限，并归纳三种协同模式：LLMs增强图计算、LLMs与KGs双向整合、以及图算法增强AI智能体。同时讨论LLMs在图数据管理与图机器学习中的新能力。
Motivation: LLMs在结构化与多跳推理中存在局限性，而图数据支撑着社交、生物、金融等关键应用，因此需要理解如何将图计算与LLMs结合以构建更可靠的AI系统。
Method: 通过综述方式，从三个互补方向（LLMs增强图推理、LLMs与KGs双向整合、图算法增强AI智能体）以及LLMs在图数据管理和图ML中的新应用，综合梳理算法、系统和设计原则。
Result: 作为教程，无具体实验结果，但系统化总结了该交叉领域当前的主要研究方向与设计原理。
Conclusion: 本教程为数据科学和数据挖掘研究者提供了整合LLMs、图数据管理、图挖掘、图ML及智能体计算以构建图原生AI系统的统一视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HERO: Hindsight-Enhanced Reflection from Environment Observations for Agentic Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning typically improves multi-turn agent capabilities through the terminal outcome of the trajectories, which makes it difficult to determine credit assignments for each intermediate turns. Recent on-policy self-distillation methods offer a promising alternative by converting privileged feedback into dense token-level supervision through a self-teacher. Our study is motivated by the unexpected performance degradation observed when naively extending this paradigm to multi-turn settings, which we attribute to a lack of alignment between privileged feedback, such as successful trajectories or terminal outcomes, and the student's current decision context. We introduce HERO, a hindsight-enhanced self-distillation framework that uses next environment observations as locally aligned feedback. After each rollout, HERO reflects on the completed interaction to convert each observation into a compact turn-level diagnosis, that captures actionable feedback about the original action such as its necessity, validity or failure cause. On TauBench and WebShop, HERO improves task success and reduces unnecessary turns over environment-feedback-only self-distillation and GRPO. It is especially effective under limited training turn budgets, where successful rollouts are rare and GRPO provides weak reward-contrast signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HERO框架，通过将环境观测转化为局部对齐的回合级诊断反馈，改进多轮交互中的智能体自我蒸馏，解决了多轮设置下特权反馈与学生决策上下文不对齐导致的性能退化问题。
Motivation: 现有的自我蒸馏方法在多轮交互中因缺乏反馈与学生决策上下文的对齐，导致性能意外下降。
Method: HERO利用后续环境观测作为局部对齐的反馈，在每次rollout后将其转化为紧凑的回合级诊断，提供关于原始动作的必要性、有效性或失败原因的可操作反馈。
Result: 在TauBench和WebShop上，HERO相比仅环境反馈的自我蒸馏和GRPO提升了任务成功率并减少了冗余回合，尤其在训练回合预算有限时效果显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调HERO通过局部对齐的反馈有效提升了多轮智能体的训练效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Autoencoder for ECG Anomaly Detection on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Continuous electrocardiography (ECG) monitoring could surface rhythm abnormalities before they escalate into cardiovascular events. However, a deployable system must satisfy three requirements simultaneously: legal-grade privacy (GDPR, HIPAA), real-time inference on constrained edge hardware, and detection quality under non-IID cross-hospital data. We design and evaluate an end-to-end federated system addressing all three for unsupervised 12-lead ECG anomaly detection on PTB-XL dataset, combining three autoencoder families (VanillaAE, ConvAE, VAE), Flower-based federated averaging (FedAvg) across ten simulated hospitals, client-side differentially private SGD (DP-SGD) with a Rényi-DP accountant, and 8-bit integer (INT8) post-training quantization with Raspberry Pi 4 benchmarking. Our main contributions are: an empirical characterization of how these mechanisms compose, practical DP-specific recommendations, and technical and security insights for a clinically sensitive setting. Federated learning matches or exceeds the centralized baseline across all architectures (ConvAE federated area under the ROC curve, AUROC, $0.782$), and an $\varepsilon$ sweep identifies $\varepsilon=4$ as the recommended clinical operating point. INT8 quantization roughly halves model size and cuts Pi 4 latency by up to $44%$ with $<0.12%$ AUROC loss. Crucially, DP and quantization penalties are empirically independent, so practitioners need not trade a strong privacy guarantee for a compact edge footprint. To our knowledge, this is the first system combining federated learning, formal $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, unsupervised reconstruction-based detection, and quantized AArch64 deployment.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Preprint prepared in IEEE conference format. Submitted to: FLTA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个隐私保护联邦自编码器系统，用于在边缘设备上进行12导联ECG异常检测。系统结合三种自编码器家族（VanillaAE、ConvAE、VAE）、Flower联邦平均、客户端DP-SGD（带Rényi-DP核算）以及INT8后训练量化，在PTB-XL数据集上评估。实验表明联邦学习匹配或超越集中式基线（ConvAE AUROC 0.782），ε=4为推荐临床操作点；INT8量化使模型大小减半，树莓派4延迟降低44%，AUROC损失<0.12%，且DP与量化惩罚独立。这是首个同时实现联邦学习、形式化(ε,δ)-DP、无监督重建检测和量化AArch64部署的系统。
Motivation: 连续ECG监测需要同时满足GDPR/HIPAA隐私合规、边缘硬件实时推理以及非独立同分布医院数据下的检测质量，现有工作未能同时满足这三项要求。
Method: 设计端到端联邦系统：在10个模拟医院上使用Flower联邦平均（FedAvg），客户端采用DP-SGD（Rényi-DP核算），后训练INT8量化，并在树莓派4上部署。评估了VanillaAE、ConvAE、VAE三种自编码器架构。
Result: 联邦学习在所有架构上匹配或超越集中式基线（ConvAE联邦AUROC 0.782）；ε=4为推荐操作点；INT8量化使模型大小减半，树莓派4延迟降低44%，AUROC损失<0.12%；DP与量化惩罚独立，可同时实现强隐私与紧凑边缘部署。
Conclusion: 本文首次结合联邦学习、形式化(ε,δ)-差分隐私、无监督重建检测和量化AArch64部署，表明实践者无需在隐私保证与边缘占用之间权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: End-to-End Machine Learning for Depressive State Classification via EEG and fNIRS
papers.abstract_en: The escalating demand for mental healthcare, driven by rising societal stress, highlights the limitations of traditional psychiatric diagnostics. Conventional methods - relying primarily on clinical interviews and patient self-reports - are inherently vulnerable to subjective bias and the varying empirical judgment of practitioners. To address the need for quantitative evaluation, biological signal-based detection, including electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), has emerged as a promising objective alternative. Such technology is particularly vital for identifying latent depressive states that may be unrecognized by the subjects themselves. Furthermore, in aging populations, the high comorbidity between depression and dementia necessitates early differentiation to prevent mutual symptom exacerbation and maintain Quality of Life (QoL). This pilot study of eleven healthy students establishes a framework for biological signal-based depression detection, serving as a foundational step toward automated, objective diagnostic tools for clinical use.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in the Proc. 48th Annu. Int. Conf. IEEE EMBS (EMBC 2026), Toronto, Canada, July 20-24, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于EEG和fNIRS的端到端机器学习框架，用于抑郁状态分类。该研究针对传统精神诊断依赖主观访谈和自我报告、易受偏差的问题，探索生物信号作为客观替代方案。初步研究在11名健康学生上建立框架，作为迈向自动化诊断工具的基础步骤。
Motivation: 传统精神科诊断依赖临床访谈和患者自评，易受主观偏差和经验影响；老龄化人群中抑郁与痴呆高共病，需要客观量化方法进行早期区分。
Method: 提出端到端机器学习框架，利用EEG和fNIRS生物信号进行抑郁状态分类。
Result: 摘要仅报告为初步研究（pilot study），在11名健康学生上建立了检测框架，未给出具体分类性能指标。
Conclusion: 该框架是迈向自动化、客观诊断工具的基础步骤，但尚需更大规模临床验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出端到端机器学习框架，利用EEG和fNIRS生物信号进行抑郁状态分类。
summary_sections.result: 摘要仅报告为初步研究（pilot study），在11名健康学生上建立了检测框架，未给出具体分类性能指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架是迈向自动化、客观诊断工具的基础步骤，但尚需更大规模临床验证。

papers.title: APEX: A Network-Native Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting and Anomaly Detection for Wireless Edge Operations
papers.abstract_en: Generic time-series foundation models transfer poorly to wireless network telemetry whose signals are bursty, zero-inflated, and coupled across protocol layers. We present APEX, a network-native, decoder-only transformer for forecasting enterprise AP telemetry, and evaluate it on DHCP degradation as a representative network task. APEX is pre-trained on 10-channel multivariate telemetry from ~4,500 production wireless networks (~100K AP time series, 34 metrics per AP), and is available as APEX-Large (269M, cloud) and APEX-Edge (10.5M, edge). On a 192-step (4-day) DHCP degradation benchmark, APEX-Large reduces MAE by 18% over the strongest foundation-model baseline (Toto) and 38% over SARIMA, with anomaly-detection F1 = 0.93, while APEX-Edge enables sub-second, privacy-preserving inference on AP-class edge hardware. These results suggest network-native pre-training is a practical foundation for proactive wireless operations.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Discusses a network-native time-series foundation model for wireless edge operations

Result: 在192步（4天）DHCP退化基准上，APEX-Large 比最强基础模型 Toto 降低 MAE 18%，比 SARIMA 降低38%；异常检测 F1=0.93。APEX-Edge 在 AP 级边缘硬件上实现亚秒级推理并保护隐私。
Conclusion: 网络原生预训练是构建主动无线运维基础模型的实用路径，在预测与异常检测上均优于通用模型。

papers.title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as they can generate entire blocks of draft tokens in parallel and thereby alleviate the sequential constraints of autoregressive drafting. A subtlety of this regime is that block-diffusion drafters generate tokens bidirectionally within a block, whereas verification is performed by an autoregressive target model that evaluates tokens in a strictly left-to-right manner, leaving a gap between the symmetric training-time objective and the asymmetric verification-time reward. In this work, we offer an empirical analysis of three training-time interventions that narrow this gap: token positional weighting, a first-error focal loss that targets the position that breaks the accepted prefix within each block, and a chain loss term that substitutes a differentiable surrogate for the expected accepted length. The three interventions act along orthogonal axes (position, block-conditional first error, joint prefix) and compose additively; they are likewise orthogonal to test-time alignment mechanisms such as multi-draft self-selection, with which they can in principle be combined. Across four target models and six reasoning, code, and dialogue benchmarks, the three interventions raise accepted draft length by 21-76% per benchmark over a position-uniform baseline, without adding additional forward passes and without changing the inference pipeline or the rejection-sampling exactness contract.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型作为推测解码草稿模型时存在的训练与验证不对称问题，提出三种训练干预：token位置加权、第一错误焦点损失（first-error focal loss）和链损失项（chain loss term），三者正交组合，在不增加前向传递次数和不改变推理流程的前提下，在四个目标模型和六个推理、代码、对话基准上将有效草稿长度提高21-76%。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型可并行生成草稿块，但训练时双向生成与自回归验证时的严格左到右顺序不匹配，导致草稿效率受限。
Method: 提出三种训练干预：1）token位置加权，2）定位块内第一个破坏接受前缀位置的焦点损失，3）用可微替代项近似期望接受长度的链损失。三者正交且可加性组合，不影响推理管线。
Result: 在四个目标模型和六个基准上，有效草稿长度比位置均匀基线提升21-76%，且不增加前向传播次数。
Conclusion: 该训练干预可缩小扩散草稿生成与自回归验证之间的差距，且与多草稿自选择等测试时对齐机制正交兼容。

papers.title: VL-DINO: Leveraging CLIP Vision-Language Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detectio
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models like CLIP can provide rich semantic priors for open-vocabulary object detection. However, jointly integrating both textual and visual knowledge into detection architectures remains challenging. In this paper, we propose VL-DINO, an open-vocabulary detector that enhances DINO through more effective exploitation of CLIP's vision-language knowledge. Specifically, a Query-guided Positive Sample Construction (QPSC) module is first developed to construct additional high-quality positive samples, enabling the vanilla DINO framework to better accommodate mixed training across heterogeneous data sources while providing more vision-language alignment signals, thereby incorporating richer textual knowledge during training. A Visual Semantic Encoder (VSE) module is then introduced to distill CLIP visual knowledge into backbone-extracted features, producing fused features for subsequent encoder refinement. Based on the fused features, an Object-Region Semantic Alignment (ORSA) module extracts object-centric region features and aligns them with the corresponding textual embeddings, further incorporating textual cues. In the zero-shot setting, VL-DINO-T and VL-DINO-L achieve 36.3 and 38.1 AP on the LVIS benchmark, respectively, consistently outperforming prior advanced approaches. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VL-DINO，一种利用CLIP视觉语言知识增强DINO的开放词汇目标检测器。通过查询引导正样本构建(QPSC)、视觉语义编码器(VSE)和对象区域语义对齐(ORSA)三个模块，有效整合文本和视觉知识。在LVIB零样本设置下，VL-DINO-T和VL-DINO-L分别达到36.3和38.1 AP，超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇检测难以有效整合CLIP的文本和视觉知识，DINO框架在混合数据训练时缺乏足够的视觉语言对齐信号。
Method: 提出三个模块：QPSC构建高质量正样本提供更多对齐信号；VSE将CLIP视觉知识蒸馏到骨干特征；ORSA提取对象中心区域特征并与文本嵌入对齐。
Result: 零样本LVIS基准上，VL-DINO-T和VL-DINO-L分别取得36.3和38.1 AP，优于先前方法。
Conclusion: VL-DINO通过有效利用CLIP的视觉语言知识，提升了开放词汇检测性能，实验验证了设计的有效性。

papers.title: SkillJuror: Measuring How Agent Skill Organization Changes Runtime Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills augment large language model (LLM) agents with procedural knowledge at inference time, but current benchmarks rarely distinguish what a Skill says from how it is organized. We study this distinction through Progressive Disclosure, where a concise root file points agents to supporting resources on demand, and compare it with a normalized flat baseline. We present SkillJuror, a framework for evaluating Skill writing paradigms through semantically controlled variants, matched multi-trial evaluations, and trajectory evidence while holding task knowledge fixed. In an 82-task SkillsBench study, Progressive Disclosure changes runtime behavior before aggregate outcomes: distinct Skill resources touched per trajectory rise from 1.18 to 3.85, and effective uptake events rise from 1.33 to 3.92. It also yields 17 additional verifier-passing trials out of 410 matched trials (+4.1%) over the normalized flat baseline. The benefit is task-dependent. Progressive Disclosure helps when supporting resources guide implementation, checking, or repair, but is weaker when success hinges on exact output conventions, numerical thresholds, or long artifact-generation pipelines. These results show that Skill organization is not mere presentation: it can change how agents search and apply procedural knowledge, while outcome gains depend on whether the exposed resources are actionable for the task. Code is available at https://github.com/zhiyuchen-ai/skill-juror.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体（agent）技能的组织方式（而非技能内容本身）如何影响运行时行为。通过渐进式揭示（Progressive Disclosure）组织方式与扁平化基线对比，发现技能组织方式会改变智能体搜索和应用过程性知识的轨迹，但任务收益取决于暴露资源是否可操作。
Motivation: 现有基准测试很少区分技能内容与技能组织方式对智能体行为的影响，本文旨在量化这种区别。
Method: 提出SkillJuror框架，通过语义控制变体、匹配多轮评估和轨迹证据，在保持任务知识不变的情况下比较不同技能编写范式（渐进式揭示 vs. 扁平化基线）。
Result: 在82个任务的SkillsBench研究中，渐进式揭示使每条轨迹触及的不同技能资源从1.18升至3.85，有效采纳事件从1.33升至3.92；在410个匹配试验中，额外通过验证的试验增加17个（+4.1%）。收益依赖于任务类型。
Conclusion: 技能组织方式并非仅仅是呈现形式，它确实改变了智能体搜索和应用程序性知识的方式，但最终结果增益取决于暴露资源是否对任务具有可操作性。

papers.title: Pretrained self-supervised speech models can recognize unseen consonants
papers.abstract_en: Modern pretrained self-supervised automatic speech recognition models are trained on large-scale audio data to encode speech into contextualized representations. However, their training data are heavily skewed toward high-resource languages with little data from low-resource languages, raising concerns about the potential underrepresentation of typologically uncommon speech sounds such as click consonants primarily found in Khoisan languages. This leads to our central research question: Can these models recognize click consonants as accurately as other speech sounds? To address this question, we fine-tune and compare pretrained self-supervised speech models (Wav2Vec2 and HuBERT) on data from two click-rich Khoisan languages (G|ui and West !Xoon). Our results reveal that the fine-tuned models consistently recognize clicks more accurately than non-clicks, suggesting that self-supervision enables generalization across human speech sounds including rare phonemes.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练自监督语音模型（Wav2Vec2和HuBERT）对罕见点击辅音的识别能力。通过在两种科伊桑语言（G|ui和West !Xoon）数据上微调，发现模型识别点击辅音的准确率高于非点击辅音，表明自监督学习能泛化到训练数据中极少出现的音素。
Motivation: 预训练语音模型的训练数据严重偏向高资源语言，低资源语言中的罕见音素（如点击辅音）可能未被充分表示，引发模型能否准确识别这类音素的问题。
Method: 在点击辅音丰富的科伊桑语言数据上微调Wav2Vec2和HuBERT模型，并比较其识别点击辅音与非点击辅音的性能。
Result: 微调后的模型对点击辅音的识别准确率一致高于非点击辅音。
Conclusion: 自监督预训练使语音模型能够泛化到包括罕见音素在内的各种人类语音音素。

papers.title: MoCA-Agent: A Market-of-Claims Code Agent for Financial and Numerical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Financial and tabular question answering requires more than fluent reasoning: answers must be grounded in the exact facts, formulas, units, signs, and scales that support them. A single misread cell or incorrect operation can silently produce a plausible but wrong result. We introduce \textsc{MOCA-Agent}, a market-of-claims code agent that replaces free-form multi-agent debate with claim-level verification. The system decomposes each question into typed atomic claims, asks specialist trader agents to buy or sell those claims, clears their orders into confidence-weighted accept/reject decisions, and synthesizes an executable Python program from market-supported evidence. A code-aware verifier then checks the program for execution, structural consistency, and common financial reasoning errors, with at most one market-aware repair round. Across ten public benchmarks spanning financial numerical reasoning, general tabular reasoning, ESG question answering, and multimodal chart reasoning, \textsc{MOCA-Agent} achieves strong performance using a fixed Qwen3.6-27B backbone, including $78.3\%$ on FinQA, $76.0\%$ on FinanceMath, $71.2\%$ on MultiHiertt, $86.9\%$ on ESGenius, and $85.6\%$ average on FinChart-Bench. These results show that aggregating evidence at the level of atomic claims, rather than whole answers, improves robustness in high-stakes numerical reasoning.\footnote{The code and data are available: https://github.com/UBC-NLP/MoCA-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoCA-Agent，一个基于声明市场（market-of-claims）的代码智能体，用于金融和表格数值推理。系统将问题分解为原子声明，由交易代理买卖，通过市场出清得到置信度加权的接受/拒绝决策，并合成可执行Python程序。在10个公开基准上，使用固定Qwen3.6-27B骨干网络取得强性能，包括FinQA 78.3%、FinanceMath 76.0%等。该方法在原子声明层聚合证据，提高了高精度数值推理的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 金融和表格问答中，答案必须基于精确事实、公式、单位、符号和尺度，单次误读或错误操作会导致看似合理但错误的结果。现有自由形式多智能体辩论缺乏细粒度验证。
Method: 提出市场声明代码智能体（MOCA-Agent），将问题分解为类型化原子声明，由专业交易代理买卖声明，通过订单清算产生置信度加权的接受/拒绝决策，再从市场支持的证据合成可执行Python程序。代码感知验证器检查程序执行、结构一致性和常见金融推理错误，最多一次市场感知修复回合。
Result: 在10个基准上使用固定Qwen3.6-27B骨干，FinQA 78.3%, FinanceMath 76.0%, MultiHiertt 71.2%, ESGenius 86.9%, FinChart-Bench平均85.6%。
Conclusion: 在原子声明（而非整体答案）层面聚合证据，可提高高精度数值推理的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Urban Heat MiniCubes: An AI-Ready dataset for urban heat research
papers.abstract_en: Urban heat is amplified by impermeable surfaces and heterogeneous built environments, yet street-level variability remains difficult to quantify because multi-sensor observations are rarely available in consistent, analysis-ready form at the necessary spatiotemporal scales. We present "Urban Heat MiniCubes," a publicly available, FAIR-oriented dataset designed for machine learning applications in urban heat research. The dataset provides harmonized 90 x 90 km gridded data cubes for 48 cities in the Western Hemisphere spanning 2022-2023, with variables reprojected and collocated to a common grid to reduce preprocessing (e.g., reprojection, resampling, and spatiotemporal alignment). Urban Heat MiniCubes includes two complementary modalities: (i) higher-spatial-resolution, lower-frequency observations from Landsat 8/9 (e.g., surface reflectances) and Sentinel-1 (e.g., synthetic aperture radar backscatter), and (ii) higher-temporal-frequency, coarser observations from GOES-R (e.g., longwave infrared brightness temperatures) and a microwave land surface temperature product. We document variables and metadata and provide technical assessment using inter-variable analyses and autoencoder-based reconstruction-error summaries across pixel classes (e.g., water and cloud). Potential use cases and limitations are also discussed.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 26 figures, Submitted to Nature Scientific Data

papers.title: AI Researchers Must Help Lead Arms Control to Mitigate Military AI Risks
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of AI capabilities compels researchers and the public to be more aware of its potential worldwide impact. A pressing near-term concern is the regulation of military AI applications. Armament manufacturers and defense contractors are increasingly investing in AI capabilities and forging partnerships with AI companies, creating a burgeoning coalition that demands military leaders, arms control diplomacy experts, and AI researchers collaborate to ensure a safer future. While AI researchers often focus on the long-term implications of superintelligent AI, this approach may not adequately address the immediate challenges posed by AI in military applications. Success requires acknowledging and mitigating the emerging risks of frontier AI models that plan to be integrated into defense applications, like military AI systems. Arms control has reduced past catastrophic risks, so lessons learned from nuclear deterrence can guide AI safety and security research towards innovations in verification and diplomacy. AI researchers, however, must assist in leading the technical research that clearly defines and alleviates instability in military settings. Given these new responsibilities and the lack of sufficiently reliable solutions, we argue that AI researchers must take a leading role in advancing arms control research to minimize risk in military AI applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇ICML 2026立场论文，主张AI研究者必须主动领导军备控制技术研究，以降低军事AI应用带来的风险。文章指出，武器制造商和国防承包商正加速投入AI能力，与AI公司结成联盟，迫切需要军事领袖、军控外交专家和AI研究者合作。作者类比核威慑的军备控制教训，强调AI研究者应在验证和外交创新中发挥主导作用，定义和缓解军事环境中的不稳定性。
Motivation: 当前AI能力快速发展，军事AI应用带来的近期风险亟需监管，但AI研究者多关注超智能AI的长期影响，未能充分应对军事AI的即时挑战。
Method: 通过回顾核军备控制历史教训，提出AI研究者应主导技术研究，明确和缓解军事AI系统中的不稳定性，推动验证与外交创新。
Result: 论文未报告具体实验或定量结果，而是提出论点并呼吁行动。
Conclusion: 鉴于现有解决方案不足，AI研究者必须承担领导角色，推进军备控制研究以最小化军事AI应用风险。

papers.title: XPR: An Extensible Cross-Platform Point-Based Differentiable Renderer
papers.abstract_en: Point-based differentiable rendering underpins modern 3D reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, and learning-based graphics pipelines, but developing new rendering methods often requires extensive low-level implementation, hardware-specific kernels, and manually written backward passes. This limits rapid prototyping, reproducibility, exploration, and deployment, especially across diverse hardware platforms. This paper presents XPR, an extensible cross-platform framework for point-based differentiable rendering. XPR introduces a high-level programming interface that separates method-specific logic from the shared rendering pipeline, allowing users to implement new methods in a few lines of code. Its pipeline decomposes rendering into modular, statically shaped parallel operations that can be lowered by a cross-platform compiler to GPUs, TPUs, CPUs, and other ML accelerators. We demonstrate implementations of 3DGS, 3DGUT, and LinPrim, with only a few 100s lines of Python code, each of which can be compiled to a range of hardware platforms with the XLA compiler. These results show that XPR enables fast experimentation and portable execution for emerging point-based differentiable rendering systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XPR 是一个可扩展的跨平台点云微分渲染框架，它通过高层编程接口将方法特定逻辑与共享渲染管道分离，使用户只需几行代码即可实现新渲染方法。其渲染管道分解为模块化、静态形状的并行操作，可通过 XLA 编译器降低到 GPU、TPU、CPU 等硬件。作者用几百行 Python 实现了 3DGS、3DGUT 和 LinPrim，并编译到多种硬件平台，验证了快速原型设计和可移植执行的能力。
Motivation: 现有的点云微分渲染方法开发需要大量底层实现、硬件特定内核和手写反向传播，限制了快速原型设计、可复现性、探索和跨硬件部署。
Method: 提出 XPR 框架，提供高层编程接口，将渲染管道分解为模块化、静态形状的并行操作，利用 XLA 编译器实现跨平台编译。
Result: 用几百行 Python 实现了 3DGS、3DGUT 和 LinPrim 等方法，并成功编译到 GPU、TPU、CPU 等多种硬件平台。
Conclusion: XPR 能够支持点云微分渲染系统的快速实验和可移植执行。

papers.title: Learning Object Manipulation from Scratch via Contrastive Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has seen recent success in a wide variety of goal-conditioned robotics tasks by learning structured representations of the dynamics. However, despite its success in locomotion and simpler control domains, CRL often struggles in interaction-rich manipulation. We argue that a key source of this difficulty is object-centric interaction, such as contact or grasping, that induces distinct changes in the underlying dynamic modes. In this work, we formulate manipulation dynamics as a piecewise-smooth Markov process and show that interaction-induced mode changes create piecewise nonlinear reachability structures that are difficult for standard CRL energy functions to represent and plan over. Based on this analysis, we introduce Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR). IWR performs interaction-aware resampling around phases before, during, and after interactions, encouraging the learned representation to preserve the mode boundaries that determine future reachability to capture multi-modal and piecewise nonlinear reachability. Across interaction-centric environments, including 2D dynamic control, robotic manipulation, and robot air hockey, IWR improves both sample efficiency and overall performance over prior CRL methods, with 19.8% average improvement in simulation. Finally, using a sim-to-real pipeline with policies trained by IWR, we demonstrate the first real-world goal-conditioned robot air hockey agent capable of hitting goals, improving success from 25% to 60%. Project Page: IWR-arxiv.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的对比强化学习方法 Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR)，用于解决物体操控任务中的多模态和非线性可达性问题。通过交互感知的重采样，IWR在仿真环境中平均提升19.8%的性能，并在真实机器人空气曲棍球任务中将成功率从25%提高到60%。
Motivation: 对比强化学习在简单控制任务中表现良好，但在交互密集的操控任务中效果不佳，原因是交互（如接触、抓取）导致动态模式突变，产生分段非线性可达性结构，标准CRL能量函数难以表示和规划。
Method: 将操控动力学建模为分段光滑马尔可夫过程，并提出 Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR) 方法，在交互之前、期间和之后进行交互感知的重采样，鼓励学到的表示保留决定未来可达性的模式边界。
Result: 在2D动态控制、机器人操控和空气曲棍球等环境中，IWR优于现有CRL方法，仿真平均提升19.8%；在真实机器人空气曲棍球中，成功率从25%提升至60%。
Conclusion: IWR通过显式建模交互引起的模式变化，有效改善了CRL在复杂操控任务中的样本效率和性能，并首次展示了真实世界目标条件机器人空气曲棍球代理。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics
papers.abstract_en: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss. The aim is to rewrite gradient descent not primarily as a dynamics in weight space, but as a collective dynamics closed in terms of fields defined on the training-set space. For a single hidden layer, the weight variables can be eliminated from the activation dynamics, yielding a closed equation for the residuals governed by a collective kernel that factorizes into an input-geometric matrix and a dynamical co-activation matrix. For deeper networks, the residual dynamics retains a clean layer-wise kernel structure. However, from depth three onward, closure requires a hierarchy of weight-induced Gram operators that mediate information transport across layers. Moreover, the conjugate-field dynamics is governed by operators satisfying a backward pullback recursion, of which the weight-induced Gram operators are the first nontrivial instances.
papers.comment: 24 pages. v4: Corrected the hidden-activation dynamics; clarified the concept of field closure. Other minor corrections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前馈ReLU网络（固定读出、二次损失）的学习动力学，将梯度下降重写为在训练集空间上的场的集体动力学。对于单隐层，权重变量可从激活动力学中消除，得到残差的封闭方程，由输入几何矩阵和动态共激活矩阵构成的核驱动。对于更深网络，残差动力学保留层状核结构，但从深度三开始，需要权重诱导的Gram算子层次结构来闭合方程。共轭场动力学满足后向拉回递归。
Motivation: 重新理解梯度下降动力学，将其从权重空间转化到场的空间，揭示层间信息传递的结构。
Method: 通过数学推导，将梯度下降重写为关于残差和共轭场的封闭动力学，引入权重诱导的层状Gram度量。
Result: 单隐层得到残差的封闭核方程；更深网络（≥3层）需要层次化的Gram算子来闭合。
Conclusion: 揭示了前馈网络中学习动力学的层次结构，特别是权重诱导的Gram算子作为后向拉回递归的第一个实例。

papers.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly operate in runtimes that combine visual desktop control, command-line execution, code editing, browsers, and external tools. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate these interfaces as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested. Thus, we introduce WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable artifacts. Each task requires agents to combine GUI observations/actions with CLI/code operations within a single trajectory. We evaluate these tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop inside deployed CLI-agent runtimes, augmented with a minimal desktop-control plugin. We also propose a companion trajectory-aware judge that inspects deliverables, files, screenshots, logs, and action traces, while detecting shortcut behaviors such as fabricated visual evidence or hard-coded metrics. Across frontier model-runtime pairings, the best PassRate reaches only 41.2%, showing the benchmark remains far from saturated. The trajectory-aware judge further reveals that outcome-only grading substantially overestimates agent performance. Overall, WeaveBench exposes a critical gap in CUA evaluation and provides an effective testbed to measure whether agents can orchestrate GUI, CLI, and code operations across long-horizon real-world tasks.

papers.title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
papers.abstract_en: Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop ``Read--Write--Assess--Govern" lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkeMex，一个面向医疗代理的后部署自演化框架，通过技能记忆（skill-based memory）在不更新模型权重的情况下提升代理的交互式临床决策能力。SkeMex将交互轨迹提炼为结构化技能，并组织成多分支存储库，利用环境反馈估计上下文效用以指导记忆检索和存储治理。实验表明，SkeMex在多种临床任务上优于现有基于记忆的代理，并支持跨模型泛化和技能迁移。
Motivation: 现有医疗代理的记忆机制往往保留原始历史痕迹，冗余、嘈杂且难以管理，且很少区分哪些记忆对未来推理真正有用，限制了长期临床推理中积累紧凑可靠经验的能力。
Method: 提出SkeMex框架，包含“读取-写入-评估-治理”闭环生命周期，通过将交互轨迹提炼为结构化技能（reusable procedural knowledge），并组织成通用、任务特定和动作级别的多分支存储库；利用环境反馈估计上下文依赖的效用，指导值感知检索和存储库治理（写入新技能、更新效用、提升有用记忆、移除有害条目）。
Result: 在多种临床任务上的实验表明，SkeMex在离线和在线设置中均持续优于代表性基于记忆的代理方法，且在不同模型主干上保持泛化，支持可迁移的技能记忆。
Conclusion: SkeMex通过基于技能的记忆后部署自演化框架，无需更新模型权重即可改善医疗代理推理的泛化能力，数据与代码将公开发布。

papers.title: IB-HFN: Information Bottleneck-Driven SAR-Optical Fusion Network for High-Fidelity Cloud Removal
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR)-assisted optical cloud removal aims to recover surface information obscured by clouds in optical remote sensing images by exploiting complementary SAR observations. Existing multimodal fusion methods typically rely on direct spatial concatenation and pixel-wise supervision, which can propagate SAR speckle noise into optical reconstruction and lead to over-smoothed results. To address these limitations, we propose an Information Bottleneck-driven High-Fidelity Network (IB-HFN) for SAR-assisted optical cloud removal. IB-HFN employs a dual-stream backbone to preserve modality-specific representations before deep semantic fusion, thereby mitigating premature cross-modal contamination. At the fusion stage, we introduce a Spatial Information Bottleneck Fusion module that compresses SAR features through a channel-wise variational information bottleneck to suppress unstructured speckle noise. In parallel, a local-global gating mechanism predicts clear-sky regions and routes reliable optical details through a Dirac-initialized skip connection, decoupling noise suppression from texture preservation. We further develop a joint optimization strategy that integrates feature-level bottleneck regularization with image-level constraints on reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, spectral fidelity, and contrastive sharpness. A dynamic weighting schedule balances these objectives to stabilize training and reduce hazy artifacts. Experiments on the SEN12MS-CR dataset under challenging spatio-temporal splits demonstrate that IB-HFN achieves superior structural preservation and spectral fidelity over existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对合成孔径雷达（SAR）辅助的光学云去除任务，提出信息瓶颈驱动的高保真网络（IB-HFN），通过双流骨干保持模态特征，利用空间信息瓶颈融合模块抑制SAR噪声，并采用局部-全局门控机制保留光学细节。在SEN12MS-CR数据集上，该方法在结构保持和光谱保真度方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法依赖于空间拼接和像素级监督，会传播SAR散斑噪声并导致过度光滑的结果，需要更好的噪声抑制和纹理保持。
Method: 提出IB-HFN，采用双流骨干保持模态特定表征；引入空间信息瓶颈融合模块，通过通道变分信息瓶颈压缩SAR特征以抑制散斑噪声；同时利用局部-全局门控机制预测晴朗区域并通过Dirac初始化的跳跃连接传递可靠光学细节。联合优化策略结合特征级瓶颈正则化和图像级约束（重建精度、结构一致性、光谱保真度和对比清晰度），并采用动态权重调度。
Result: 在SEN12MS-CR数据集上，在具有挑战性的时空划分下，IB-HFN实现了优于现有方法的结构保持和光谱保真度。
Conclusion: 论文表明通过信息瓶颈和门控机制可以有效分离噪声抑制和纹理保持，实现高保真云去除。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Intention Driven Identification of In-Possession Match Phases in Association Football through Temporal Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding tactical organisation of association football, hereafter referred to as football, requires identifying distinct match phases. Yet in-possession phases are rarely directly observable and are shaped by evolving tactical intentions, rather than spatial patterns alone. This study proposes a data-driven framework for identifying in-possession match phases from spatiotemporal tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical phase model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) was developed to combine frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and a sequence-aware Intersection over Truth-Dominance (IoT-D) metric. T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. At the sequence level, mean diagonal IoT-D F1 increased from 0.68 to 0.79 for intentions and from 0.61 to 0.71 for phases after post-processing, indicating improved temporal coherence. Model comparisons showed that sequence modelling was the main driver of segmentation quality, while graph-based relational modelling was particularly beneficial for Counter Attack recognition. Exploratory player attention analysis further suggested that wide and midfield positional groups contributed strongly to phase discrimination. Overall, the framework translates continuous tracking data into tactically interpretable in-possession phase representations, with potential applications in automated match annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据驱动框架，利用时空跟踪数据识别足球比赛中的控球阶段。定义了三个战术意图（Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring）和六个阶段（Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing）。开发了时序图注意力网络（T-GAN），结合帧级球员交互图、上下文特征和Transformer时序建模。在7场德甲比赛数据上，意图级别帧级宏平均F1为0.87，入侵相关阶段为0.76，得分阶段为0.79。后处理后序列级IoT-D F1提升，表明时序建模是分割质量的主要驱动因素。
Motivation: 现有方法难以直接观测控球阶段，且阶段由战术意图而非空间模式决定。需要数据驱动方法从连续跟踪数据中识别可解释的阶段。
Method: 构建层次化阶段模型（三级意图、六个阶段），使用T-GAN网络：帧级图注意力网络建模球员交互，结合语境特征，再通过Transformer建模时序依赖。
Result: 意图级别帧级宏平均F1为0.87，入侵相关阶段0.76，得分阶段0.79。后处理后序列级IoT-D F1从0.68/0.61提升至0.79/0.71。时序建模贡献最大，图关系建模对Counter Attack识别有益。
Conclusion: 框架可将连续跟踪数据转化为战术可解释的控球阶段表示，可用于自动比赛标注、战术分析和风格分析。

papers.title: Trajectory Geometry of Transformer Representations Across Layers
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how transformer representations evolve across layers, not merely what they encode, remains an open problem in mechanistic interpretability. We recast the transformer forward pass as a discrete population trajectory through a high-dimensional representation manifold, drawing on geometric tools from computational neuroscience. Rather than probing for pre-specified features, we characterize trajectory geometry using five metrics computed directly in the ambient space: trajectory length, curvature, a semantic convergence index, layerwise cosine similarity, and representational stability. Across three model families (GPT-2, TinyLlama, Qwen2.5) and five controlled prompt families, we report four findings. First, semantically related prompts converge significantly in middle-to-late layers (peak CI 0.41--0.58, p<0.001, Mann-Whitney U), consistent with attractor-like dynamics. Second, reasoning tasks produce trajectories of greater curvature than lexical variations (0.71--0.83 rad vs. 0.27--0.31 rad), suggesting curvature encodes computational complexity. Third, ambiguous tokens exhibit trajectory bifurcation with up to 5.6x representational separation by the final layer, absent in unambiguous controls. Fourth, layerwise cosine similarity reveals a universal three-phase structure: encoding, elaboration, and output preparation, consistent across all three architectures. All four effects vanish under shuffled-layer and random-embedding controls. We release a fully open-source, model-agnostic pipeline and argue that trajectory geometry constitutes a principled, probe-free lens for mechanistic interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从计算神经科学的几何视角出发，将Transformer的前向传播重新解释为高维表示流形上的离散轨迹，并直接计算轨迹长度、曲率、语义收敛指数、层间余弦相似度和表示稳定性五个指标。在GPT-2、TinyLlama和Qwen2.5三个模型以及五个受控提示族上，实验发现语义相关提示在中后期层显著收敛（峰值CI 0.41–0.58, p<0.001），推理任务比词汇变化产生更大曲率（0.71–0.83 rad vs 0.27–0.31 rad），歧义标记在最终层出现高达5.6倍的表示分离，且层间余弦相似度揭示了统一的“编码-精加工-输出准备”三阶段结构。所有现象在层序打乱和随机嵌入控制下消失。
Motivation: 理解Transformer表示在层间的动态演化路径（而非仅仅静态编码）仍是机械可解释性的开放问题；现有基于探针的方法需预设特征，缺乏对轨迹几何系统的、无探针的刻画。
Method: 将Transformer前向过程建模为高维表示流形上的离散种群轨迹，借鉴计算神经科学的几何工具，在环境空间中直接计算五个量：轨迹长度、曲率、语义收敛指数、层间余弦相似度、表示稳定性。
Result: 在GPT-2、TinyLlama和Qwen2.5上报告四个主要发现：①语义相关提示的中后期层显著收敛；②推理任务轨迹曲率显著高于词汇变化；③歧义标记出现轨迹分叉（最终层表示分离达5.6倍）；④层间余弦相似度揭示跨架构一致的三阶段模式。所有效应在控制实验中消失。
Conclusion: 轨迹几何为机械可解释性提供了一种原则性的、无探针的分析视角；论文同时发布了完全开源、模型无关的pipeline。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph2Idea:Retrieval-Augmented Scientific Idea Generation with Graph-Structured Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel, feasible, and high-quality research ideas is an important yet challenging task in scientific discovery. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods often ground idea generation with retrieved literature, but the retrieved evidence is usually provided as flat text, such as titles, abstracts, or summaries. Such flat contexts may contain redundant or weakly relevant information, while making cross-paper relations among problems, methods, mechanisms, and findings difficult to identify and trace. To address this challenge, we propose Graph2Idea, a knowledge graph-guided framework for retrieval-augmented scientific idea generation.Graph2Idea first retrieves papers according to the input topic, transforms them into structured knowledge triples, and dynamically constructs a target-centered knowledge graph to make literature relations explicit. It then extracts compact graph-derived contexts that retain target-relevant relational evidence while reducing noisy textual input. Based on these contexts, a two-stage generation process first identifies promising research directions and then guides the LLM to synthesize candidate ideas from graph-grounded evidence. Experiments on a scientific idea generation benchmark show that Graph2Idea outperforms representative baselines under the automatic evaluation protocol. Compared with the strongest baseline scores, it improves Novelty from 0.45 to 0.52, Quality from 0.24 to 0.29, and Feasibility from 0.22 to 0.28. These results suggest that graph-structured evidence helps LLMs generate research ideas through more explicit, compact, and traceable recombination of prior scientific knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph2Idea，一个基于知识图谱的检索增强科学想法生成框架。它通过将检索到的文献转化为结构化三元组并构建目标中心知识图谱，提取紧凑的图上下文，再分两阶段生成研究方向和候选想法。在自动评估基准上，该方法在新颖性、质量和可行性上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的科学想法生成方法通常使用检索到的文献作为平面文本，包含冗余信息且难以捕捉跨论文的问题、方法、机制和发现之间的关系。
Method: Graph2Idea 首先根据输入主题检索论文，转化为知识三元组并动态构建目标中心的知识图谱，提取紧凑的图上下文以减少噪声；然后通过两阶段生成过程，先识别研究方向，再引导 LLM 从图证据中综合候选想法。

Conclusion: 图结构证据有助于 LLM 通过更明确、紧凑和可追溯的方式重组先验科学知识，从而生成更好的研究想法。

papers.title: MB-Loc: Multi-planar Bird's-eye-view Localization in outdoor LiDAR scenes
papers.abstract_en: Global LiDAR localization is a fundamental task for autonomous navigation systems. Recent methods perform Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) and achieve superior accuracy over Absolute Pose Regression (APR) solutions by predicting dense 3D world coordinates. However, SCR approaches introduce two major bottlenecks: severe computational inefficiency from processing raw 3D geometries and significant performance degradation under varying sensor viewpoints. To address these limitations, we present MB-Loc, a lightweight and viewpoint-robust SCR framework. Instead of relying on heavy 3D convolutions, we project the input LiDAR scan into a 2.5D Multi-planar Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation. By slicing the point-cloud along the Z-axis and mapping signed depths into discrete 2D planes, MB-Loc retains essential 3D geometric structures while exploiting the computational tractability of standard 2D CNNs. To handle the inherent sparsity of outdoor LiDAR, we introduce a KL-regularized latent bottleneck that explicitly models spatial uncertainty without injecting stochastic noise. Finally, to ensure rotation robustness, we apply 3D spatial augmentations prior to planar projection, forcing the network to implicitly learn viewpoint-invariant features. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available NCLT dataset and demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms the current state-of-the-art. Operating at real-time inference speeds, MB-Loc significantly outperforms traditional 3D-SCR architectures in computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MB-Loc，一种轻量级且视角鲁棒的全局LiDAR定位框架。通过将点云投影到多平面鸟瞰图（BEV）表示，结合KL正则化潜在瓶颈处理稀疏性，并利用3D空间增强实现旋转鲁棒性。在NCLT数据集上，该方法在保持实时推理速度的同时，在计算效率和定位精度上均优于现有3D-SCR方法。
Motivation: 现有场景坐标回归（SCR）方法处理原始3D几何计算量巨大，且在不同传感器视角下性能显著下降，限制了其在室外LiDAR场景中的实际应用。
Method: 将输入LiDAR扫描沿Z轴切片，映射为多平面鸟瞰图（BEV）2.5D表示，使用标准2D CNN处理；引入KL正则化潜在瓶颈建模空间不确定性；在投影前应用3D空间增强以学习视角不变特征。
Result: 在NCLT数据集上，MB-Loc以实时推理速度运行，在定位精度上显著超越现有最先进方法，同时计算效率大幅优于传统3D-SCR架构。
Conclusion: 通过2.5D BEV表示替代原始3D处理，结合稀疏性建模和旋转增强，MB-Loc为室外LiDAR全局定位提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。

papers.title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware action representations for generalizable robotic manipulation. GEAR-VLA adopts coarse-to-fine action learning, where multi-source embodied pretraining equips the VLM with embodied reasoning and discrete action understanding before latent action tokens connect action semantics to a gradient-decoupled DiT continuous action expert. It further performs semantic-aligned 3D integration by aligning a trainable 3D spatial backbone with the VLA representation while freezing the original VLM-aligned visual pathway. To share this representation across robots, GEAR-VLA uses embodiment canonicalization, where embodiment-aware states and embodiment-invariant actions confine robot differences to the low-level interface. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong generalization: GEAR-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, reaches 85.9% success on AgileX and 81.0% on the pretraining-unseen LDT-01 embodiment, and obtains 90.1% success on a 6,360-trial universal grasping benchmark with 212 unseen objects. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/babynabeauty/GEAR-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEAR-VLA 提出了一种统一的几何感知动作表示框架，用于提升机器人操作的泛化能力。它采用从粗到细的动作学习、语义对齐的 3D 融合和本体规范化，在多个仿真和真实世界基准上取得了最先进的性能。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在真实部署中难以应对未见物体、背景变化和不同机器人本体，根源在于缺乏统一的几何感知操作表示。
Method: GEAR-VLA 包含多源本体预训练、粗到细动作学习（离散动作令牌 + DiT 连续动作专家）、语义对齐的 3D 集成以及本体规范化。
Result: 在 LIBERO、零样本 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 上达到最先进水平；在 AgileX 上成功率为 85.9%，在未见本体 LDT-01 上为 81.0%；在 6360 次通用抓取基准测试中达到 90.1% 成功率。
Conclusion: GEAR-VLA 通过几何感知的表示学习显著提升了机器人操作的泛化能力，代码和模型将开源。

papers.title: Querying Counterfactuals on Tissue Graphs with Supervised Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Tissue graph counterfactuals ask how a cell's expression would change under altered spatial neighbor contexts. Such queries are central to predicting cell behavior in tissues, but lack a unified definition, with existing methods targeting specific intervention types or treating cells as i.i.d. In this work, we first formalize tissue graph counterfactuals as a class of spatial interventions that either rewire connections between cells (edge perturbation) or modify the expression of their neighbors (node perturbation). We then introduce Cellina (https://cellina.readthedocs.io) - a framework that uses supervised disentanglement to decompose a cell's intrinsic state from its spatial context, using the latter as a conditioning input for counterfactual predictions. Across benchmarks spanning over 2.5 million spatially-resolved cells in colorectal cancer and mouse brain, Cellina outperforms spatially-informed and non-spatial competitors in in-silico graph perturbations, disentanglement, and scalability. Additionally, we show that Cellina reveals biologically distinct cancer subdomains in an unsupervised manner and enables targeted neighbor perturbation simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化组织图反事实查询的概念，将其分为边扰动和节点扰动两类空间干预，并提出了Cellina框架。该框架利用监督解耦（supervised disentanglement）将细胞的固有状态与空间上下文分离，以空间上下文为条件进行反事实预测。在包含超过250万空间分辨细胞的结直肠癌和小鼠脑数据集上，Cellina在计算机模拟图扰动、解耦性能和可扩展性方面均优于空间和非空间基线方法。
Motivation: 组织图反事实查询缺乏统一的定义，现有方法要么针对特定干预类型，要么将细胞视为独立同分布（i.i.d.），无法统一处理不同空间干预场景。
Method: 首先形式化两类空间干预：边扰动（改变细胞间连接）和节点扰动（修改邻居细胞表达）。然后提出Cellina框架，通过监督解耦学习将细胞内在状态与空间上下文分离，并使用后者作为条件输入生成反事实预测。
Result: 在结直肠癌和小鼠脑的基准测试中（共计250万空间分辨细胞），Cellina在计算机模拟图扰动、解耦质量和可扩展性指标上均优于现有空间和非空间方法。
Conclusion: Cellina不仅能够准确预测反事实，还能以无监督方式揭示生物学上不同的癌症子区域，并支持靶向邻居扰动模拟。

papers.title: CoVEBench: Can Video Editing Models Handle Complex Instructions?
papers.abstract_en: While recent text-guided video editing models excel at elementary tasks (e.g., style transfer, object insertion), real-world user requests are highly compositional. A single prompt often demands multiple coupled edits, such as modifying subjects, actions, and camera views, while strictly preserving unrelated spatiotemporal content. Existing benchmarks, heavily constrained by isolated edits and coarse global metrics, fail to diagnose how models handle such complex workflows. To address this gap, we introduce CoVEBench, a compositional video editing benchmark comprising 416 curated source videos, 626 multi-point editing instructions, and 9,990 fine-grained checklist items. Covering diverse editing dimensions, CoVEBench evaluates models via MLLM-judged instruction compliance and video fidelity, alongside automated metrics for video quality. Extensive experiments reveal that compositional editing remains a profound challenge: current models frequently omit edits, violate preservation constraints, or introduce artifacts when handling multiple operations simultaneously. CoVEBench provides a challenging, diagnostic testbed to advance video editing toward realistic user workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoVEBench是一个用于评估视频编辑模型处理复杂组合指令的基准，包含416个源视频、626个多点编辑指令和9990个细粒度检查项。实验表明，当前模型在处理多操作组合编辑时经常遗漏编辑、违反保留约束或引入伪影。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑基准局限于孤立编辑和粗粒度全局指标，无法诊断模型处理真实世界中组合性用户请求的能力。
Method: 构建CoVEBench基准，利用多维度编辑指令和MLLM判断指令合规性与视频保真度，结合自动化视频质量指标进行评估。
Result: 实验发现，组合编辑仍是重大挑战：当前模型多次操作同时处理时频繁出现编辑遗漏、保留约束违规或伪影。
Conclusion: CoVEBench为推进视频编辑向真实用户工作流发展提供了诊断性测试平台。
