papers.title: GENERIC-FNO: Embedding Energy Conservation and Entropy Production into Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GENERIC-FNO, the first neural operator to embed the full GENERIC (metriplectic) structure of nonequilibrium thermodynamics -- reversible, energy-conserving dynamics and irreversible, entropy-producing dynamics coupled through the degeneracy conditions -- directly in function space. Existing structure-preserving neural operators enforce at most a single conservation law or reversible (Hamiltonian) structure, while thermodynamically consistent learning has been confined to finite-dimensional, graph, or particle systems. GENERIC-FNO closes this gap: it learns the energy and entropy functionals as neural operators and parameterizes the Poisson and friction operators as diagonal Fourier multipliers sandwiched between rank-one projections that enforce the degeneracy conditions exactly, by construction, with no penalty term, update projection, or residual. The degeneracy identities hold to machine precision (residuals ~10^-13) for any initialization, dimension, or resolution, so the continuous-time dynamics conserve the learned energy and produce entropy exactly; the explicit time stepping adds only a small O(dt^2) drift (per-step residual ~10^-6). We further note that the (E,S,L,M) decomposition of a given flow is not unique, and introduce a gauge-invariant dissipation diagnostic separating reversible from dissipative dynamics independently of the learned functionals. Across three operator backbones (1D/2D FNOs and DeepONet) and four PDEs spanning reversible, dissipative, and mixed regimes, GENERIC-FNO preserves its exact structural guarantees zero-shot across a 4x super-resolution range (64 to 256), recovers the ground-truth ordering of physical dissipation, and is competitive with strong unconstrained and energy-penalized baselines, outperforming them on several dissipative and mixed problems at comparable or fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GENERIC-FNO，首个将非平衡热力学完整 GENERIC 结构（可逆能量守恒与不可逆熵产生，通过退化条件耦合）直接嵌入函数空间的神经算子。它学习能量和熵泛函作为神经算子，并通过秩一投影之间的对角傅里叶乘子参数化泊松和摩擦算子，精确满足退化条件。在多个 PDE 上验证，退化条件达到机器精度，时间步进漂移仅为 O(dt^2)，且零样本超分辨率性能与强基线相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有结构保持神经算子最多只强制执行单一守恒律或可逆（哈密顿）结构，而热力学一致学习局限于有限维、图或粒子系统。本文旨在填补函数空间上完整热力学结构保持的空白。
Method: 将能量和熵泛函作为神经算子学习，泊松和摩擦算子参数化为对角傅里叶乘子，夹在秩一投影之间，通过构造精确满足退化条件，无需惩罚项或更新投影。
Result: 退化恒等式残差约 10^-13，时间步进每步残差约 10^-6；在 1D/2D FNO 和 DeepONet 三种骨干及四个 PDE 上，零样本超分辨率（64→256）下保持结构保证，恢复物理耗散排序，与强无约束和能量惩罚基线竞争，部分问题更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算子在结构保持和泛化方面的优势，并指出分解非唯一性，引入规范不变耗散诊断以分离可逆与耗散动力学。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 GENERIC-FNO，首个将非平衡热力学完整 GENERIC 结构（可逆能量守恒与不可逆熵产生，通过退化条件耦合）直接嵌入函数空间的神经算子。它学习能量和熵泛函作为神经算子，并通过秩一投影之间的对角傅里叶乘子参数化泊松和摩擦算子，精确满足退化条件。在多个 PDE 上验证，退化条件达到机器精度，时间步进漂移仅为 O(dt^2)，且零样本超分辨率性能与强基线相当或更优。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有结构保持神经算子最多只强制执行单一守恒律或可逆（哈密顿）结构，而热力学一致学习局限于有限维、图或粒子系统。本文旨在填补函数空间上完整热力学结构保持的空白。
summary_sections.method: 将能量和熵泛函作为神经算子学习，泊松和摩擦算子参数化为对角傅里叶乘子，夹在秩一投影之间，通过构造精确满足退化条件，无需惩罚项或更新投影。
summary_sections.result: 退化恒等式残差约 10^-13，时间步进每步残差约 10^-6；在 1D/2D FNO 和 DeepONet 三种骨干及四个 PDE 上，零样本超分辨率（64→256）下保持结构保证，恢复物理耗散排序，与强无约束和能量惩罚基线竞争，部分问题更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该算子在结构保持和泛化方面的优势，并指出分解非唯一性，引入规范不变耗散诊断以分离可逆与耗散动力学。

papers.title: Continual Quadruped Robots Coordination via Semantic Skill Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Multi-quadruped coordination has attracted increasing attention due to its enhanced payload capacity, broader contact coverage, and improved adaptability to challenging tasks. Existing methods for multi-quadruped manipulation typically focus on predefined or closed task families, often relying on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train task-specific coordination policies. However, such methods struggle in open-ended continual learning settings, where tasks arrive sequentially and robots are expected to acquire new coordination skills while reusing previously learned ones without catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose Conquer, a semantic skill-library framework that formulates continual multi-quadruped coordination as a retrieve-adapt-update process. First, to accommodate varying team sizes across tasks, we design a team-structured Self-Allies-Goal (SAG) backbone that supports variable-cardinality robot teams by explicitly modeling each robot's own state, teammate context, and task goal. For each incoming task, Conquer constructs a task-level semantic descriptor from pre-execution information and retrieves a relevant skill from the library for adaptation. After successful execution, Conquer updates the skill library by extracting trajectory-level semantic descriptors and organizing them according to semantic distance, thereby enabling continual skill accumulation and cross-task knowledge transfer. Simulation experiments show that Conquer achieves a final average success rate of 95.6%, demonstrating strong forward transfer and negligible catastrophic forgetting. Real-world rollouts on Unitree Go2 teams further validate the deployment feasibility of Conquer for practical multi-quadruped coordination. Simulation and real-robot demonstration videos are available at: https://conquer-project.pages.dev/.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://conquer-project.pages.dev/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Conquer 框架，通过语义技能库实现四足机器人的持续多机器人协调。该框架将任务视为检索-适应-更新过程，支持可变团队规模，并利用语义描述符实现跨任务知识迁移。仿真实验最终平均成功率达95.6%，并在真实Unitree Go2机器人上验证了可行性。
Motivation: 现有四足机器人协调方法通常局限于预定义或封闭任务族，难以应对开放式的持续学习场景，即任务序列到达且机器人需在不灾难性遗忘的情况下获取新协调技能。
Method: 提出语义技能库框架 Conquer，包含三部分：1) 团队结构的Self-Allies-Goal (SAG)骨干网络，支持可变数量机器人；2) 任务级语义描述符用于检索和适配技能；3) 轨迹级语义描述符用于更新技能库，按语义距离组织技能。
Result: 仿真实验最终平均成功率95.6%，展示强正向迁移和可忽略的灾难性遗忘；在真实Unitree Go2机器人团队上验证了部署可行性。
Conclusion: Conquer框架通过语义技能库有效实现了持续多四足机器人协调，支持跨任务知识积累与复用。

papers.title: Rewrite to Translate, Translate to Reward: Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting in Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Rewriting source text with large language models (LLMs) before translation has been shown to improve machine translation (MT) quality. However, we find that prompt-based rewriting can degrade translation quality rather than improve it, particularly when smaller LLMs, such as 4B-parameter models, are used. We argue that this limitation stems from the difficulty of controlling rewriting behavior through natural-language prompts alone: a rewrite is useful only if it improves downstream translation, yet existing prompt-based methods do not explicitly optimize for this signal. To address this issue, we propose RLSR (Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting), a reinforcement learning framework that trains the rewriting model with a reward based on the downstream translation-quality improvement produced by each rewrite. Experiments across six MT systems and 16 language pairs show that our 4B RLSR-trained rewriting models significantly outperform both the no-rewriting baseline and prompt-based rewriting baselines at the same model scale, while remaining competitive with baselines that use a 235B LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RLSR框架，通过强化学习训练源文本重写模型，以提升下游机器翻译质量。实验表明，4B参数的RLSR重写模型在6个MT系统和16个语言对上显著优于无重写和基于提示的重写基线，且与235B参数的大模型性能相当。
Motivation: 基于提示的源文本重写可能降低翻译质量，尤其是使用较小LLM时，因为自然语言提示难以精确控制重写行为，且未直接优化翻译质量的提升。
Method: 提出RLSR框架，使用强化学习，以重写后翻译质量的改进作为奖励信号，训练源文本重写模型。
Result: 在6个MT系统和16个语言对上，4B参数的RLSR模型显著优于无重写基线和提示重写基线，并与235B参数大模型竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 强化学习可以有效训练源文本重写模型，使其专注于提升下游翻译质量，小模型也能取得与大模型竞争的性能。

papers.title: MemToolAgent: Leveraging Memory for Tool Using Agents Based on Environment and User Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language model (LLM) agents can use external tools to help users solve complex tasks. However, for problems that require learning from long-term historical events or from previous agent-environment interactions, LLM agents are required to use memory mechanisms to store and retrieve experiences. While sophisticated memory systems exist for dialogue agents, few studies have empirically examined how to improve agents' tool-using capabilities through past user-agent conversations. We propose MemToolAgent, a framework that improves tool use through memory management. Our approach contains a memory extraction module that processes past experiences into structured memory entries, and a retrieval module that dynamically selects a subset of the stored memory entries. This enables more personalized and accurate responses aligned with user preferences and feedback without requiring LLM fine-tuning. In summary, this work has three main contributions: (1) a unified memory entry format that improves both general-purpose and personalized tool use without LLM fine-tuning, (2) a reflection-based memory extraction that uses environment and user feedback to distill wrong executions into critiques to store, and (3) a retrieval module that chooses how many past experiences to use based on the memory similarity distribution. MemToolAgent achieves 29%, 80%, and 17% relative improvements compared to strong baselines on the WorkBench, NESTFUL, and PEToolBench benchmarks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemToolAgent框架，通过记忆管理提升大语言模型智能体的工具使用能力。该框架包含记忆提取模块（将历史经验结构化为记忆条目）和检索模块（动态选择相关记忆），无需微调LLM即可实现个性化且准确的响应。在WorkBench、NESTFUL和PEToolBench基准上，相比强基线分别获得29%、80%和17%的相对提升。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在使用外部工具时，难以从长期历史事件或先前交互中学习，而针对工具使用的记忆机制研究不足。
Method: 提出包含三个组件的框架：统一记忆条目格式支持通用和个性化工具使用；基于反思的记忆提取利用环境和用户反馈将错误执行转化为批评性记忆；检索模块根据记忆相似度分布自适应选择历史经验数量。
Result: 在WorkBench、NESTFUL和PEToolBench上分别实现29%、80%和17%的相对提升。
Conclusion: 无需微调LLM即可通过结构化的记忆管理显著提升工具使用能力和个性化响应。

papers.title: Breaking the Ice: Analyzing Cold Start Latency in vLLM
papers.abstract_en: As scalable inference services become popular, the cold start latency of an inference engine becomes important. Today, vLLM has evolved into the de facto inference engine of choice for many inference workloads. Although popular, due to its complexity and rapid evolution, there has not been a systematic study of its startup latency. With major architectural innovations such as the V1 API and the introduction of torch.compile, this paper presents the first detailed performance characterization of vLLM startup latency. We break down the startup process into six foundational steps and demonstrate that it is predominantly CPU bound. Each step exhibits consistent and interpretable scaling trends with respect to model-level and system-level parameters, enabling fine-grained attribution of latency sources. Building on these insights, we develop a lightweight analytical model that accurately predicts vLLM startup latency for a given hardware configuration, providing actionable guidance for resource planning in large-scale inference environments. All benchmarking datasets, analysis tools, and prediction scripts are open sourced at https://github.com/upb-cn/vllm-startup-profiler.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 9th MLSys Conference, Bellevue, WA, USA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了vLLM推理引擎的冷启动延迟，将其分解为六个基本步骤，发现启动过程主要为CPU密集型，并建立了轻量级分析模型以准确预测给定硬件配置下的启动延迟。所有基准数据集、分析工具和预测脚本均已开源。
Motivation: vLLM作为广泛使用的推理引擎，其冷启动延迟缺乏系统性研究，尤其是V1 API和torch.compile等新架构带来的影响尚未被量化分析。
Method: 通过性能剖析将vLLM启动过程分解为六个基本步骤，识别模型级和系统级参数对延迟的影响，并构建轻量级分析模型进行预测。
Result: 启动延迟主要为CPU密集型，各步骤展现出一致且可解释的缩放趋势，模型能准确预测延迟，为资源规划提供依据。
Conclusion: 该分析模型可用于大规模推理环境中的资源规划，相关工作已开源。

papers.title: DEFINED: A Data-Efficient Computational Framework for Fine-Grained Creativity Assessment in Debate Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Human creativity has emerged as a critical competency in the era of large language models. Assessing creativity in complex, open-ended environments is a grand challenge in data mining, currently hindered by a reliance on standardized simple tasks and the scarcity of fine-grained expert data. As an ecologically valid assessment context, debate reflects multiple dimensions of creativity, encompassing both divergent thinking and convergent thinking. Moreover, debate is a data-rich domain, with a large volume of publicly accessible materials. Current mainstream automated scoring methods are poorly suited to complex settings such as debate, and therefore still rely on costly human evaluation. To this end, this paper proposes DEFINED, a data-efficient computational framework for fine-grained creativity assessment in debate scenarios. DEFINED operationalizes debate creativity through a hierarchical eight-dimensional metric system, implemented via a pre-trained autoregressive language model with a hierarchical scoring head that supports both fine-grained and coarse-grained evaluation. Statements and their associated expert scores were obtained from authentic debate competitions, and a constrained data augmentation strategy was employed to address the elite bias inherent in the original data. DEFINED adopts a mixed-granularity training strategy enabling robust learning from limited fine-grained supervision annotated by trained graduate experts. To rigorously validate ecological validity beyond synthetic benchmarks, we incorporate an empirical study with debate-naive participants, utilizing these authentic data to serve as a qualitative case study for mid-to-low proficiency populations. Across our evaluation protocol, our scoring model achieves accurate and stable scoring, outperforming prompt-based large language model evaluators and existing debate scoring methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DEFINED，一个数据高效的细粒度创造力评估计算框架，应用于辩论场景。该框架通过层次化八维度量系统来操作化辩论创造力，采用预训练自回归语言模型和层次化评分头，支持细粒度和粗粒度评估。使用来自真实辩论比赛的陈述和专家评分，并通过约束数据增强应对精英偏差。实验表明，该评分模型比基于提示的大语言模型评估器和现有辩论评分方法更准确稳定。
Motivation: 在大语言模型时代，评估复杂开放环境中的创造力是一个重大挑战，目前受限于标准化简单任务和细粒度专家数据的缺乏。自动评分方法不适合辩论等复杂场景，仍依赖昂贵的人工评估。
Method: 提出DEFINED框架，包含层次化八维评分系统，基于预训练自回归语言模型，带有层次化评分头。采用混合粒度训练策略从有限的细粒度监督中学习，并使用约束数据增强缓解精英偏差。
Result: 在评估协议中，该评分模型实现了准确稳定的评分，优于基于提示的大语言模型评估器和现有辩论评分方法。
Conclusion: 该框架通过真实的辩论数据和实证研究验证了生态效度，为复杂场景下的创造力自动评估提供了有效途径。

papers.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used to improve large language model reasoning, but its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We characterize the trajectory of OPD updates in parameter space and compare it with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). A suite of parameter-space diagnostics consistently places OPD in a relaxed off-principal regime: compared with SFT, its updates affect fewer weights and avoid principal directions more strongly, while compared with RLVR, they remain less tightly constrained. Beyond this static localization, OPD exhibits subspace locking: its cumulative updates rapidly enter a narrow low-dimensional channel. Constraining training to the update subspace formed early in training preserves OPD performance but substantially degrades SFT, indicating that the locked subspace is functionally sufficient for OPD. Control experiments further show that sparsifying the update tokens and shifting rollout generation off-policy preserve the rank dynamics, whereas mixing the OPD objective with RLVR changes them. Overall, these results suggest that OPD is not merely an intermediate point between SFT and RLVR, but induces its own update geometry in parameter space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）在参数空间中的训练动态，并与监督微调（SFT）和基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行对比。通过一系列参数空间诊断，OPD被刻画为一种放松的离主成分（off-principal）机制：相比SFT，其更新影响更少的权重并更强烈地避开主方向；相比RLVR，约束更弱。此外，OPD表现出子空间锁定（subspace locking）：累积更新快速进入一个狭窄的低维通道。实验表明，在OPD的训练早期形成的更新子空间中约束训练能够保持性能，但会显著降低SFT的性能，说明该锁定子空间对OPD功能足够。控制实验进一步表明，稀疏化更新token和将rollout生成偏移到离策略（off-policy）会保持秩动态，而将OPD目标与RLVR混合则会改变它们。总体而言，OPD并非SFT与RLVR之间的简单插值，而是在参数空间中有其独特的更新几何。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏在提升大语言模型推理能力方面应用日益广泛，但其训练动态仍缺乏深入理解，尤其是与SFT和RLVR的对比分析。
Method: 通过参数空间诊断工具（如更新权重影响、主方向偏离程度、子空间锁定分析）来刻画OPD的更新轨迹，并与SFT和RLVR对比。进一步通过控制实验（稀疏化token、off-policy生成、目标混合）验证关键因素。
Result: OPD的更新比SFT更稀疏、更偏离主方向，比RLVR约束更宽松；且OPD累积更新快速锁定到低维子空间，该子空间对OPD功能足够但对SFT不充分；稀疏化token和off-policy生成不影响秩动态，而混合RLVR目标会改变。
Conclusion: OPD具有独特的更新几何，不是SFT和RLVR的中间态，而是有自身规律。研究揭示了OPD的训练动态特性，为理解其效果提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
papers.abstract_en: High-quality training data is essential to large language models (LLMs) and typically requires extensive and costly manual curation. Existing automatic data preparation methods rely on predefined pipelines or customized human instructions, which limits their adaptability to diverse data distributions and lacks principled guidance from high-quality examples. In this paper, we introduce DataEvolver, the first self-evolving data preparation system that automatically constructs pipelines to transform raw data into high-quality data. DataEvolver employs a multi-level mechanism to ensure both pipeline executability and effectiveness. At the operator level, it incrementally expands the operator set to construct a logical plan while resolving dependency conflicts. At the pipeline level, it instantiates logical plans into executable code and iteratively refines pipeline orchestration through a feedback loop that reduces the distribution gap between prepared data and high-quality examples. Experiments on seven benchmarks show that DataEvolver substantially improves data quality and achieves an average 10\% gain in downstream LLM performance compared with training on original data, highlighting new opportunities for the iterative co-evolution of LLMs and data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataEvolver，首个自动进化数据准备系统，通过多级机制自动构建流水线将原始数据转化为高质量数据，在七个基准上平均提升下游LLM性能10%。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据对LLM至关重要但人工成本高，现有自动方法依赖预定义流水线或人工指令，适应性差且缺乏高质量示例指导。
Method: 提出DataEvolver，包含操作符级和流水线级的多级机制：操作符级逐步扩展操作符集构建逻辑计划并解决依赖冲突；流水线级将逻辑计划实例化为可执行代码，并通过反馈循环迭代优化流水线编排，缩小准备数据与高质量示例的分布差距。
Result: 在七个基准上，使用DataEvolver准备的数据训练LLM相比原始数据平均提升10%性能。
Conclusion: DataEvolver展示了LLM和数据迭代共同进化的新机遇，可自动生成高质量训练数据。

papers.title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://showlab.github.io/ActionMap/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ActionMap，一种体素热图动作头（voxel heatmap action head），用于替换现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的单点预测动作解码器。该方法将动作空间离散化为体素网格，并预测每个体素上的概率热图。在LIBERO仿真和真实Franka操作任务上，ActionMap在匹配训练步数下超越了两种不同架构的基线（如平均领先OpenVLA-OFT的L1回归头8.2%），且收敛速度相当或更快，在低数据量下数据效率更高。结果表明动作表示是提升VLA性能的关键因素。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型的动作解码器多为单点预测器（如自回归token bin、L1回归或流匹配去噪），将动作空间视为非结构化，未能利用相邻动作的几何邻近性进行训练。
Method: 提出ActionMap，一种可插入现有VLA的体素热图动作头：对每个新动作，预测动作空间上的体素热图，每个体素直接存储对应动作的概率。
Result: 在LIBERO仿真和真实Franka操作任务上，ActionMap在匹配训练步数下平均领先OpenVLA-OFT的L1回归头8.2%，在两个不同骨干网络上收敛速度相当或更快，且在低训练数据量下数据效率显著更高。
Conclusion: 动作表示是提升VLA性能的关键杠杆，不同于进一步扩展骨干网络或训练配方。ActionMap在跨骨干网络的一致性表明其泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving Agents in the Dark: Retrospective Harness Optimization via Self-Preference
papers.abstract_en: AI agents rely on a harness of skills, tools, and workflows to solve complex problems. Continually improving this harness is essential for adapting to new tasks. However, existing optimization methods typically require ground-truth validation sets, yet such labeled data is difficult to acquire in practical deployment settings. To address this problem, we introduce Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO), a self-supervised method that optimizes the agent harness using only past trajectories. Specifically, RHO selects a diverse coreset of challenging tasks from past trajectories and re-solves them in parallel. The agent analyzes these rollouts using self-validation and self-consistency, then generates candidate harness updates and selects the most effective one by its own pairwise self-preference. We evaluate RHO across three diverse domains, spanning software engineering, technical work, and knowledge work. Notably, a single optimization round improves the pass rate on SWE-Bench Pro from 59% to 78% without any external grading. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that RHO effectively targets prior failure modes. As a result, the optimized harness alters the agent's behavior patterns and sustains higher accuracy during long-horizon sessions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督的代理技能包优化方法 Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO)，仅利用历史轨迹即能提升 AI 代理在软件工程、技术工作等领域的表现，无需人工标注验证集。在 SWE-Bench Pro 上单轮优化将通过率从 59% 提升至 78%。
Motivation: 现有代理技能包优化方法依赖人工标注的真实验证集，而实际部署中标注数据难以获取。
Method: RHO 从历史轨迹中选取多样化的困难任务核心集，并行重解；通过自我验证与自我一致性分析生成候选技能包更新，并依据自身偏好对选择最优更新。
Result: 单轮优化后，SWE-Bench Pro 通过率从 59% 提升至 78%，无需外部评分；优化后的技能包改变了代理行为模式，在长时间会话中维持更高准确率。
Conclusion: RHO 能够有效定位并改进代理的先前失败模式，实现无外部监督的持续自我优化。

papers.title: Knowledge Manifold: A Riemannian Geometric Framework for Semantic Mapping and Geodesic Analysis of Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: We present the knowledge manifold: a Riemannian geometric space in which a corpus of documents is arranged according to semantic positional relationships derived from character n-gram TF-IDF representations. The framework proceeds in five tightly coupled stages. First, each document is converted to a character-level n-gram TF-IDF vector (4-7 grams, up to 250,000 features, L2-normalized) and embedded in a two-dimensional knowledge map via constrained stress minimization with repulsion, variance, and centering regularizers. Second, knowledge at an arbitrary query point is estimated through Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) interpolation using a cubic-spline kernel, yielding an interpolated TF-IDF feature vector that can be linguistically characterized. Third, directional knowledge gradients at 0, 45, and 90 degrees are computed from the SPH interpolation map, and pairwise directional similarity is quantified via inner product and cosine similarity. Fourth, a Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) model, with a Constant x RBF + White kernel fitted on a 10-dimensional SVD projection, provides a Bayesian posterior mean, uncertainty estimate, and per-document contribution rate at the query point. Fifth, geodesics in the knowledge space are obtained by minimizing a discrete Riemannian path energy derived from the SPH-induced metric tensor, using L-BFGS-B with seven deterministic initial-path candidates. We apply the formulation to a corpus of 20 papers in fiber-reinforced composite materials and aerospace structural mechanics, showing that the semantic map recovers meaningful research clusters, geodesic paths reveal natural conceptual bridges between distant topics, and SPH/GPR interpolation enables the generation of virtual knowledge: hypothetical paper abstracts describing unstudied but geometrically predicted research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识流形（knowledge manifold）框架，将文献语料库嵌入黎曼几何空间，通过字符n-gram TF-IDF、光滑粒子流体动力学插值、高斯过程回归和测地线路径分析，实现语义映射和虚拟知识生成。
Motivation: 现有文献分析方法缺乏连续几何空间中的语义建模，难以揭示研究概念间的内在联系和潜在研究方向。
Method: 五阶段流程：1）字符n-gram TF-IDF向量表示与力导向映射降维；2）SPH插值生成任意查询点的语义向量；3）方向梯度计算与相似性度量；4）高斯过程回归提供贝叶斯后验均值和不确定性；5）基于度规张量的离散黎曼路径能量最小化求测地线。
Result: 在纤维增强复合材料和航空航天结构力学20篇论文语料上，语义图恢复有意义的聚类，测地线揭示概念桥梁，SPH/GPR插值生成虚拟论文摘要。
Conclusion: 知识流形框架有效实现文献的连续语义空间建模，支持虚拟知识推断，但规模化和跨域泛化有待验证。

papers.title: Agentic Software: How AI Agents Are Restructuring the Software Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: For over half a century, software engineering has operated on a foundational premise: human engineers decompose problems, encode decision logic into static code, and manually adapt that code as requirements evolve. This paper argues that the emergence of AI agents -- systems where large language models serve as the primary reasoning engine, dynamically generating and discarding code as an instrumental resource -- constitutes a fundamental restructuring of what software is, not an incremental tool improvement. We formalize the distinction between traditional deterministic software and agentic software: in the former, code is the carrier of pre-written decision logic; in the latter, the agent itself is the software, and its decision logic is generated at runtime. We trace the historical arc from licensed software to SaaS to Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS), showing that each shift transferred additional complexity away from end-users -- with the agentic shift transferring not just operational complexity but decision-making complexity itself. We introduce Agentic Engineering as an expansion of the software engineering discipline into a new paradigm, distinct in its core object of study (agent systems rather than static source code), its control model (LLM-driven rather than human-predefined), and its human role (intent architect rather than code author). Through analysis of recent benchmark evidence including SWE-bench Verified, EvoClaw, and LangChain's multi-agent coordination studies, we demonstrate both the transformative potential of the agentic paradigm and its current limitations. We conclude with a four-stage roadmap toward self-evolving agent ecosystems and concrete recommendations for practitioners navigating this transition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为AI代理（以大型语言模型为核心推理引擎，动态生成和丢弃代码）正在根本性地重构软件范式，从传统确定性软件转向代理型软件（agentic software）。论文形式化了两者的区别，追溯了从许可软件到SaaS再到代理即服务（AaaS）的历史演变，并提出了代理工程（Agentic Engineering）作为软件工程的新范式。通过SWE-bench Verified等基准证据，展示了代理范式的变革潜力及其当前局限，最后给出了向自演化代理生态系统的四阶段路线图。
Motivation: 软件工程长期基于人类分解问题、编写静态代码并手动适配的假设，但AI代理的出现使得代码成为动态生成的工具，这种转变需要被形式化理解。
Method: 通过历史分析、范式对比（传统确定性软件 vs. 代理型软件）、代理即服务（AaaS）概念提出，以及基准实验（SWE-bench Verified等）证据来论证观点。
Result: 基于SWE-bench Verified等基准的分析显示代理范式具有变革潜力，但当前仍存在局限性。
Conclusion: 代理型软件代表了软件工程的范式转变，人类角色从代码作者转变为意图架构师（intent architect），未来将走向自演化代理生态系统。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.tldr: 本文认为AI代理（以大型语言模型为核心推理引擎，动态生成和丢弃代码）正在根本性地重构软件范式，从传统确定性软件转向代理型软件（agentic software）。论文形式化了两者的区别，追溯了从许可软件到SaaS再到代理即服务（AaaS）的历史演变，并提出了代理工程（Agentic Engineering）作为软件工程的新范式。通过SWE-bench Verified等基准证据，展示了代理范式的变革潜力及其当前局限，最后给出了向自演化代理生态系统的四阶段路线图。
summary_sections.motivation: 软件工程长期基于人类分解问题、编写静态代码并手动适配的假设，但AI代理的出现使得代码成为动态生成的工具，这种转变需要被形式化理解。
summary_sections.method: 通过历史分析、范式对比（传统确定性软件 vs. 代理型软件）、代理即服务（AaaS）概念提出，以及基准实验（SWE-bench Verified等）证据来论证观点。
summary_sections.result: 基于SWE-bench Verified等基准的分析显示代理范式具有变革潜力，但当前仍存在局限性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 代理型软件代表了软件工程的范式转变，人类角色从代码作者转变为意图架构师（intent architect），未来将走向自演化代理生态系统。

papers.title: Characterizing the Impact of NVFP4 Quantization for Low-Power Edge AI Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Energy-efficient neural-network inference at the edge requires reducing arithmetic cost, memory traffic, computation energy, and storage overhead while maintaining acceptable accuracy. This paper presents an ablation-focused study of NVFP4 quantization for edge-efficient neural networks, with emphasis on the relationship between activation precision, weight precision, block-size scaling, retraining, and model accuracy. NVFP4 activations are represented using 4-bit FP4 data, an FP8 block scale, and an FP32 tensor scale, enabling ultra-low precision inference while preserving activation dynamic range. A block-size ablation over six edge-efficient models shows that block size B = 16 provides a practical accuracy/storage trade-off, requiring only 4.5078 bits per input for N = 4096. A weight precision ablation further shows that FP8 and FP16 weights provide only modest gains over FP4 weights under the same NVFP4 activation path, suggesting that activation quantization and scaling dominate much of the accuracy behavior. To isolate the benefit of the NVFP4 data type, this work compares conventional unscaled FP4 activation inference and NVFP4 activation inference with and without retraining. The results show that conventional FP4 inference collapses accuracy for most compact models, while NVFP4 without retraining already recovers substantial accuracy by restoring activation dynamic range through FP8 block scaling and FP32 tensor scaling. When combined with retraining, NVFP4 achieves the best accuracy across the evaluated models, demonstrating the effectiveness of scaling-aware FP4 (NVFP4) inference. These findings provide general design guidance for hardware-software co-design of low power edge inference across a broad range of accelerator platforms, including GPUs, Tensor Cores, FPGAs, domain-specific AI accelerators, near-memory computing systems, and emerging edge-computing architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过消融实验研究NVFP4量化（4位FP4数据+FP8块缩放+FP32张量缩放）对边缘高效神经网络的影响。结果表明块大小B=16在精度和存储之间取得实际折中，每输入仅需4.5078比特；权重精度FP8/FP16相比FP4提升有限；常规无缩放FP4推理导致紧凑模型精度崩溃，而NVFP4无需重训练即可恢复大量精度，结合重训练达到最佳准确率。
Motivation: 节能边缘推理需要降低算术成本、内存流量、计算能耗和存储开销，同时保持可接受的准确率。现有低精度量化（如FP4）在紧凑模型上会导致精度崩溃，需要新的量化方案来恢复动态范围。
Method: 采用消融研究，系统评估NVFP4量化在不同块大小（B=16,32等）、权重精度（FP4/FP8/FP16）和是否重训练下的准确率表现，并与常规无缩放FP4推理进行对比。
Result: 块大小B=16提供实际精度/存储折中，每输入仅需4.5078比特（N=4096时）。FP8和FP16权重相比FP4权重仅带来微弱精度提升。常规FP4推理导致紧凑模型精度崩溃，而NVFP4无需重训练即可通过恢复激活动态范围大幅恢复精度，结合重训练达到最佳准确率。
Conclusion: 研究发现为低功耗边缘推理的硬件-软件协同设计提供通用指导，适用于GPU、Tensor Core、FPGA、领域专用AI加速器、近内存计算系统和新兴边缘计算架构。

papers.title: Frames2LoRA: Parametric Video Internalization for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Processing video in vision-language models is expensive: each frame occupies hundreds of tokens, and inference cost scales with every frame and every repeated query. We introduce Frames2LoRA, a method for parametric video internalization. A perceiver hypernetwork reads the intermediate representations produced layer-by-layer as a frozen VLM encodes a video, and generates a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. Unlike standard LoRA fine-tuning, which requires iterative gradient updates, Frames2LoRA predicts these weights directly from the video. Trained for SmolVLM2 500M and 2.2B on video summarization and captioning, Frames2LoRA enables the same frozen VLM to answer queries from the adapter alone, with zero visual tokens in its context at query time. Frames2LoRA is statistically non-inferior and equivalent to direct video-in-context inference across all five captioning benchmarks at both model scales, and across seven of eight video question answering benchmark-scale pairings. Although trained only on 12 frames at 384px, it remains stable up to 1,024 frames and 1024px, where direct video-in-context inference often degenerates. Across this sweep, it reduces answer-time visual-token load by up to 1,500x and query TTFT by 6-80x, while preserving video-faithful outputs. We also find that independently generated adapters for non-overlapping video segments can compose in rank space, suggesting a path toward chunked long-video internalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Frames2LoRA 提出一种参数化视频内部化方法，通过感知器超网络从冻结的视觉语言模型编码视频时产生的中间表示中直接生成 LoRA 适配器，无需梯度更新。该方法在视频摘要和字幕任务上训练，推理时无需视觉 token，仅靠适配器回答查询。在五个字幕基准和七个视频问答基准上统计上与直接视频上下文推理等价，且能稳定处理多达 1024 帧和 1024px，将推理时视觉 token 负载降低最多 1500 倍，查询 TTFT 降低 6-80 倍。
Motivation: 处理视频时，每个帧占用数百个 token，推理成本随帧数和查询次数线性增长，现有方法昂贵且无法高效复用视频表示。
Method: 提出 Frames2LoRA，使用感知器超网络读取冻结 VLM 逐层编码视频的中间表示，一次性生成 LoRA 适配器，推理时仅需适配器，无需视觉 token。
Result: 在 SmolVLM2 500M 和 2.2B 模型上，五个字幕基准和七个视频问答基准统计上非劣且等价于直接视频上下文推理；支持最多 1024 帧和 1024px，推理视觉 token 负载降低最多 1500 倍，TTFT 降低 6-80 倍。
Conclusion: Frames2LoRA 实现了视频参数化内部化，显著降低推理成本，且独立生成的适配器可在秩空间中组合，支持分块长视频内部化。

papers.title: EvalStop: Using World Feedback to Detect and Correct Reward Overoptimization in Multi-Tenant RLHF Platforms
papers.abstract_en: Cloud LLM fine-tuning platforms increasingly serve RLHF workloads, where a learned reward model is optimized as a proxy for human quality. As Gao et al. (2023) showed, this proxy diverges from world feedback (downstream eval metrics) under sustained optimization pressure, a phenomenon known as reward overoptimization. Existing platform schedulers ignore this divergence: non-clairvoyant schedulers optimize JCT without any quality signal, SLAQ-style quality-aware schedulers use training loss (a weaker proxy that drops monotonically through hacking), and classical per-job early stopping requires human monitoring and does not free shared GPUs. We propose EvalStop, a composable scheduling primitive that terminates jobs on k consecutive eval-score declines, releases GPUs, preserves the best checkpoint, and delegates to any base scheduler. We frame scheduler-level early stopping as a detection problem and evaluate it in a discrete-event simulator whose RLHF workload mixes reward-hacking and structurally healthy runs, with ground-truth labels hidden from schedulers. On RLHF-heavy workloads (80% RLHF, 64 GPUs), EvalStop achieves precision 98% / recall 99% / FPR 1.5% while improving JCT by 9% and cutting wasted compute by 22% over SRTF-Est (p<0.05). Trivial fixed-progress and loss-plateau competitors either incur 65% FPR on healthy RLHF or miss over half of true hacking cases. Gains compose across every base scheduler tested (9-25% JCT) and detection quality stays stable under eval noise (precision at least 91% at noise std <= 0.05) and hacking base rate (precision at least 89% across 20-80% hacking fractions).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多租户RLHF平台中奖励模型代理与真实世界反馈（下游评估指标）背离导致的奖励过度优化问题，提出EvalStop调度原语。该原语通过检测连续k次评估分数下降来终止作业、释放GPU并保留最佳检查点，可组合到任意基础调度器。在模拟器中，面对80% RLHF负载且64 GPU的场景，EvalStop达到98%精确率、99%召回率、1.5%假阳性率，同时将作业完成时间（JCT）提升9%，浪费算力减少22%。该检测方法在不同基础调度器上均保持9-25%的JCT改进，且在评估噪声下仍维持91%以上的精确率。
Motivation: 现有云LLM微调平台调度器忽略奖励模型在持续优化下与真实世界反馈的偏离，导致奖励过度优化问题。非先知调度器优化JCT但无质量信号，SLAQ风格调度器使用训练损失（更弱且单调下降的代理），经典每作业提前停止需人工监控且无法释放共享GPU。
Method: 提出EvalStop，一个可组合的调度原语，在检测到连续k次评估分数下降时终止作业、释放GPU、保存最佳检查点，并委托给任意基础调度器。将调度器级别的提前停止形式化为检测问题，并在离散事件模拟器中评估，其中RLHF负载混合奖励黑客和结构健康运行，真实标签对调度器隐藏。
Result: 在RLHF密集负载（80% RLHF，64 GPU）下，EvalStop实现98%精确率、99%召回率、1.5%假阳性率，同时JCT提升9%，浪费计算减少22%。固定进度和损失平台基线要么导致65%假阳性率，要么漏掉超过一半真实黑客案例。该增益在所有测试的基础调度器上一致（JCT提升9-25%），且在评估噪声标准差≤0.05时精确率保持91%以上，黑客基础率在20-80%范围内精确率保持89%以上。
Conclusion: EvalStop通过调度器级别的高精度检测可有效识别并纠正奖励过度优化，释放GPU资源并保留最佳模型，显著提升多租户RLHF平台的算力效率和质量。该方法具有可组合性和鲁棒性，适用于各类调度策略。

papers.title: BaltiVoice: A Speech Corpus and Fine-tuned Whisper ASR System for the Balti Language
papers.abstract_en: We present BaltiVoice, a 16.8-hour read-speech corpus for Balti (ISO 639-3: bft), a Tibetic language spoken in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan, with no prior publicly available ASR resources. The corpus contains 10,060 validated utterances in native Nastaliq script, derived from Mozilla Common Voice recordings. Fine-tuning OpenAI Whisper-small yields a Word Error Rate (WER) of 26.74% and a Character Error Rate (CER) of 8.67% on a 538-utterance speaker-disjoint validation set, down from a zero-shot baseline of 159.19% WER and 152.52% CER. A Whisper-base fine-tuned on the same data achieves 44.54% WER and 15.61% CER, confirming that model capacity matters for this low-resource setting. The dataset, fine-tuned model, and a live transcription demo are publicly available on HuggingFace.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/mohdali-dev/BaltiVoice-ASR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 BaltiVoice，一个 16.8 小时的巴尔蒂语朗读语音语料库，这是该语言首个公开可用的 ASR 资源。通过微调 Whisper-small，在扬声器分离的验证集上实现了 26.74% 的词错误率（WER）和 8.67% 的字错误率（CER），远低于零样本基线。数据集和模型已公开。
Motivation: 巴尔蒂语（藏语系，巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦地区）缺乏公开的 ASR 资源，该论文旨在填补这一空白，提供语音语料库和基线 ASR 系统。
Method: 从 Mozilla Common Voice 录音中构建了包含 10,060 个已验证话语的语料库，采用本地 Nastaliq 脚本转录。然后微调 OpenAI Whisper-small 和 Whisper-base 模型进行评估。
Result: 微调后的 Whisper-small 在 538 个话语的验证集上达到 26.74% WER 和 8.67% CER，而 Whisper-base 达到 44.54% WER 和 15.61% CER；零样本 Whisper-small 基线分别为 159.19% WER 和 152.52% CER。
Conclusion: 该工作为巴尔蒂语提供了首个公开 ASR 资源，并证明即使是小型 Whisper 模型经过微调也能在该低资源语言上取得显著改进。数据集、模型和演示已公开。

papers.title: Libra: Efficient Resource Management for Agentic RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a standard post-training paradigm for shaping large language models (LLMs) into capable agents. In agentic RL, the rollout stage generates trajectories while invoking tools, producing long-tailed and non-stationary workloads that expose two fundamental challenges in resource management. First, due to the long-tail distribution, a small fraction of trajectories dominates rollout makespan. Second, rollout and training are subject to cross-stage imbalance, as they exhibit strong asymmetry in compute patterns, memory demands, and sensitivity to sequence length. Compounding this asymmetry, the sequence length distribution drifts continuously as the policy evolves, rendering any static resource split progressively suboptimal. We present Libra, a resource management system to address both challenges via two core mechanisms. The first is a global resource planner that jointly optimizes GPU allocation across rollout and training clusters. It leverages an elastic hybrid pool to enable lightweight, non-blocking worker reallocation between stages. The second is a causality-driven multi-level feedback queue (C-MLFQ) scheduler, which routes requests to heterogeneous rollout buckets based on causal signals derived from tool-return outcomes, rather than relying on fragile length predictions. Evaluated on 48 A800 GPUs, Libra achieves up to 3.0x higher throughput and converges up to 2.5x faster in reward compared to the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Libra，一个面向智能体强化学习后训练的资源管理系统。针对长尾分布和跨阶段不平衡两大挑战，Libra通过全局资源规划器（弹性混合池）和因果驱动的多级反馈队列调度器（C-MLFQ）优化GPU分配与请求路由。在48块A800 GPU上的实验表明，相比基线，吞吐量提升高达3.0倍，奖励收敛加快2.5倍。
Motivation: 智能体强化学习后训练中，轨迹生成长尾且非平稳，导致资源管理面临两大问题：少数轨迹主导生成时间（长尾），以及推出阶段与训练阶段计算模式、内存需求和对序列长度的敏感性存在强烈不对称，且序列长度分布随策略演变而漂移，静态资源分配逐渐次优。
Method: 提出Libra系统，包含两个核心机制：1）全局资源规划器，联合优化推出和训练集群的GPU分配，利用弹性混合池实现轻量级非阻塞工作节点重分配；2）因果驱动的多级反馈队列（C-MLFQ）调度器，基于工具返回结果的因果信号而非脆弱长度预测将请求路由到异构推出桶。
Result: 在48块A800 GPU上评估，相比基线，吞吐量提升高达3.0倍，奖励收敛速度加快2.5倍。
Conclusion: Libra有效解决了长尾和跨阶段不平衡问题，提升了资源利用率和训练效率。

papers.title: Anomalies in Multivariate Time Series Benchmarks Are Mostly Univariate
papers.abstract_en: Many recent multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) models incorporate cross-channel modeling, under the implicit assumption that the structure of anomalies may be spread across multiple channels. We evaluate this assumption on eight widely used public benchmarks by introducing a per-segment diagnostic framework that flags, for each labeled anomaly, whether at least one channel deviates individually from its normal history, whether the cross-channel correlation structure changes, or both. The framework shows that no cross-channel rupture occurs without an accompanying univariate deviation across a range of reasonable thresholds. A complementary metric also reveals that on six of the eight benchmarks, at least half of the labeled anomaly segments deviate univariately on 89% to 100% of their timesteps, reaching 100% on three of these datasets. To verify that our framework captures cross-channel structure when present, we construct synthetic data of phase-shifted sinusoidal channels with shared noise. Each anomalous segment is altered through one of two channel-wise corruptions that preserve the per-channel marginal distribution while breaking cross-channel structure, and our framework correctly characterizes these segments as cross-channel-only. On these data, channel-dependent (CD) models successfully exploit the cross-channel signal whereas channel-independent (CI) ones fail. The CI/CD comparison of a recent SOTA detector on real benchmarks further confirms that CD modeling brings no measurable gain. We conclude that current MTSAD benchmarks are unsuitable for validating cross-channel modeling capabilities, and we call for the development of more structurally diverse evaluation sets. The code for this study is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对8个常用多变量时间序列异常检测基准进行逐段诊断，发现所有被标记的异常段在合理阈值下都伴随单变量偏离，且跨通道关联结构变化从未单独出现。进一步分析显示，在6个基准中，至少一半的异常段在89%至100%的时间步上存在单变量偏离。合成实验证明，只有当异常真正存在于跨通道结构时，依赖通道的模型才有优势，但在真实基准上这类建模并未带来可测的提升。结论是现有基准不适合评估跨通道建模能力。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测模型普遍引入跨通道建模，但假设异常结构可能分布于多个通道的依据是否成立尚不清楚。本文旨在系统评估基准中异常的单变量与跨通道性质。
Method: 提出逐段诊断框架，对每个标记异常段判断是否存在至少一个通道的单变量偏离、跨通道关联结构变化或两者兼有。同时构建合成数据（相位偏移正弦波加共享噪声）验证框架对纯跨通道异常的识别能力。
Result: 在8个基准上，未发现任何跨通道破裂不伴随单变量偏离。6个基准中至少一半异常段在89%-100%时间步上单变量偏离，其中3个基准达到100%。合成数据上仅依赖通道的模型有效，而真实基准上依赖通道与独立通道的检测器表现无差异。
Conclusion: 当前多变量时间序列异常检测基准未能有效检验跨通道建模能力，未来需要结构更多样的评估数据集。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal learning refers to a student language model acquiring a teacher's traits (e.g. a system-prompted preference for owls) when fine-tuned on the teacher's outputs, despite the outputs being semantically unrelated to those traits. It remains poorly understood how data without semantic meaning can transfer specific semantic traits. In this work, we show that subliminal learning is mediated by a single steering vector, i.e. a vector added to the model's activations. Across two open-source models, we find that the teacher's system prompt is well approximated by a steering vector, and that the student's behavior is driven by learning an aligned vector over fine-tuning. System prompts that are not well approximated by steering vectors are not subliminally learned. This is a special case of steering vector distillation, in which a student trained on the outputs of a steered teacher learns to imitate that steering. We demonstrate steering vector distillation on a range of semantic and random vectors. Adding a semantic vector to a model's activations can have both model-independent and model-specific (i.e. non-semantic) effects on its behavior, so generated data that is non-semantic can transmit a vector with semantic effects, enabling subliminal learning. This also explains why subliminal learning does not transfer between models. We find that adaptive optimizers are necessary for subliminal learning in language models: activation gradients on steered data carry a small but consistent component along the steering direction, and non-adaptive optimizers impede this by allowing outlier gradients to dominate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明潜意识学习（subliminal learning）——学生模型从语义无关数据中习得教师特征——是由单个转向向量（steering vector）介导的。教师系统提示可被转向向量近似，学生通过微调学习对齐该向量，且非语义数据可通过转向向量蒸馏传递语义效应。自适应优化器对语言模型中的潜意识学习必不可少。
Motivation: 潜意识学习现象显示，学生模型能从语义无关的教师输出中习得特定语义特征（如系统提示偏好），其机制尚不明确。
Method: 通过分析两个开源模型，发现教师系统提示可近似为转向向量，学生微调时学习该向量。提出转向向量蒸馏（steering vector distillation）概念，并实验验证语义与随机向量的蒸馏效果。
Result: 系统提示能被转向向量近似时才能被潜意识学习；非语义数据可传播语义向量；自适应优化器（如Adam）对潜意识学习必要，非自适应优化器因离群梯度主导而阻碍学习。
Conclusion: 潜意识学习是转向向量蒸馏的特例，其机制依赖于转向向量表示和自适应优化，解释了跨模型不迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows
papers.abstract_en: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Rectified Flow模型中的概念擦除问题，提出GEM框架。该框架将基于轨迹的遗忘与教师引导擦除统一为几何引导目标，利用教师的吸引和排斥信号实现目标概念的抑制，同时保持良性生成能力。
Motivation: 随着多模态生成模型的广泛采用，有害内容合成和版权侵权风险增加，概念擦除成为重要的防护手段。但现有研究主要针对U-Net扩散模型，对Rectified Flow Transformer的擦除研究滞后。
Method: 提出GEM框架，通过建立基于Generative Flow Networks的轨迹遗忘与教师引导擦除之间的原则性桥梁，将轨迹信号转化为教师引导的流匹配设置，并组合教师的吸引和排斥信号为单一的几何引导目标。
Result: 摘要表明该方法能实现针对性的概念抑制，同时保持良性生成能力，但未提供具体定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GEM简单但有效，为Rectified Flow模型的概念擦除提供了统一框架，弥合了轨迹遗忘和教师引导擦除之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Geometric Chords for Query-Efficient Decision-Based Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: While decision-based black-box adversarial attacks present a severe security threat, current methodologies suffer from fundamental limitations. Pixel-wise attacks frequently introduce unnatural, high-frequency visual artifacts, while latent-space frameworks are confined by the limited search space of low-dimensional manifolds and inherent reconstruction flaws. To resolve these limitations, we propose Latent Geometric Chords (LGC) for Query-Efficient Decision-Based Adversarial Attacks alongside a variant, LGC-H. At its core, LGC navigates decision boundaries by executing a curvature-aware geometric search within a compressed semantic manifold. To guarantee high visual fidelity and circumvent dimensionality bottlenecks, we introduce a Residual-based Adversarial Generation (RAG) mechanism. RAG isolates semantic perturbations as geometric chords and superimposes them directly onto the original source image. RAG substantially resolves baseline reconstruction flaws and effectively doubles the permissible search space dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that LGC achieves robust cross-dataset transferability and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, our method, LGC, minimizes perturbation magnitudes while achieving state-of-the-art visual fidelity--with a Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) exceeding 0.99 and a Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) below 0.01 at 5000 queries--and sustaining high attack success rates under stringent perceptual constraints, successfully compromising adversarially trained robust models. The source code is available at: https://github.com/eihmuekhine/Latent-Geometric-Chords.
papers.comment: Added a conceptual diagram for the LGC architecture, 14 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. The source code is available at https://github.com/eihmuekhine/Latent-Geometric-Chords
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Geometric Chords (LGC) 方法，用于查询高效的决策式黑盒对抗攻击。LGC 在压缩语义流形上执行曲率感知几何搜索，并通过残差对抗生成 (RAG) 机制将语义扰动作为几何弦直接叠加到原始图像上，避免了像素级攻击的伪影和潜空间框架的维度瓶颈。实验表明，在 5000 次查询下 SSIM>0.99、LPIPS<0.01，攻击成功率高且跨数据集迁移性好。
Motivation: 现有决策式黑盒攻击中，像素级扰动易引入不自然的高频伪影，而潜空间框架受限于低维流形的有限搜索空间和固有的重建缺陷。
Method: 提出 Latent Geometric Chords (LGC) 方法，在压缩语义流形上进行曲率感知的几何搜索；同时引入 Residual-based Adversarial Generation (RAG) 机制，将语义扰动隔离为几何弦，直接叠加到原始图像上，成倍扩展搜索空间并消除重建缺陷。
Result: 在 5000 次查询下，SSIM 超过 0.99，LPIPS 低于 0.01；攻击成功率在严格感知约束下依然很高，能成功攻破对抗训练鲁棒模型，且跨数据集迁移性优于现有基线。
Conclusion: LGC 在极低扰动幅度下实现了最先进的视觉保真度和高攻击成功率，有效解决了现有方法的伪影和维度瓶颈问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.

papers.title: Mitigating Content Shift and Hallucination in GenAI Image Editing via Structural Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) image editors, such as Nano Banana, produce visually compelling results for retouching tasks, enabling non-experts to edit images through text prompts alone. However, the generative nature of these models often introduces spatial misalignment, texture distortion, and content hallucination, all of which are detrimental to downstream workflows that require pixel-level fidelity. We identify a problem setting we call "structure-preserving GenAI fusion" for black-box GenAI image retouching: retain the perceptual enhancements of a GenAI output while enforcing structural faithfulness to the original input image. To address this problem, we propose a post-processing framework that fuses an input image with its GenAI-enhanced counterpart by first establishing coarse spatial and photometric correspondences, then performing a fusion stage that transfers desired enhancements while suppressing hallucinated content. In the absence of direct prior work in this setting, we evaluate our framework against representative methods from photorealistic style transfer and image fusion. Our experiments demonstrate that our method better preserves aesthetic quality while maintaining pixel-level structural consistency and the input resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式AI图像编辑中常见的空间错位、纹理畸变和内容幻觉问题，提出一个后处理框架，通过建立粗略的空间与光度对应关系，将原始图像与GenAI增强版本融合，在抑制幻觉的同时保留期望的增强效果。实验表明，该方法在保持像素级结构一致性和输入分辨率的前提下，优于真实感风格迁移和图像融合的现有方法。
Motivation: 生成式AI图像编辑器虽然能产生视觉上吸引人的结果，但常引入像素级忠实度受损的问题（如空间错位、纹理畸变、幻觉），影响需要精确对齐的下游工作流。
Method: 提出一个后处理框架，首先在输入图像与GenAI增强图像之间建立粗略的空间与光度对应，然后执行融合阶段，转移期望的增强效果同时抑制幻觉内容。
Result: 与真实感风格迁移和图像融合的代表性方法相比，所提方法在保持像素级结构一致性和原始分辨率的基础上，更好地保留了审美质量。
Conclusion: 该框架作为黑盒GenAI图像修图的后处理步骤，能够有效平衡结构保真与视觉增强，但论文未讨论对特定编辑类型或大规模应用的局限性。

papers.title: Brain-IT-VQA: From Brain Signals to Answers
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual content from fMRI signals recorded while a person views images, and specifically answering questions about the seen images, is a long-standing challenge. While significant progress has been made in recent years in visual question answering (VQA) from fMRI, performance remains limited. Moreover, although recent models can make increasingly accurate predictions, they have rarely been used as tools for understanding the structure of visual representations in the brain. We present Brain-IT-VQA, a framework for visual question answering from fMRI. Building on the Brain Interaction Transformer (Brain-IT), our method decodes language tokens from brain activity and integrates them with a language model to answer visual questions. Our model substantially outperforms previous fMRI-based captioning and VQA approaches. We further introduce NSD-VQA, a new dataset and benchmark for visual question answering from fMRI. Unlike existing image-fMRI VQA datasets, which typically provide only a few broad and weakly controlled questions per image, NSD-VQA provides on average 20 question-answer pairs per image across 20 controlled question categories that disentangle multiple levels of visual understanding. This enables more reliable and interpretable evaluation despite limited fMRI test data. Together, Brain-IT-VQA and NSD-VQA provide both a strong predictive framework and a tool for studying brain representations. Using this benchmark, we quantify which forms of visual and semantic information can be reliably decoded from fMRI responses to natural images. We further analyze the contributions of different brain regions across question types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Brain-IT-VQA 框架，从 fMRI 信号中解码语言 token 并与语言模型结合，用于视觉问答任务。同时构建了新基准数据集 NSD-VQA，包含 20 个受控问题类别，平均每张图像 20 个问答对。模型在 fMRI 字幕生成和 VQA 上显著优于先前方法，并用于分析不同脑区对视觉和语义信息的解码贡献。
Motivation: 从 fMRI 信号解码视觉内容并回答相关问题是一个长期挑战，现有方法性能有限，且缺乏可控且丰富的问题基准来评估和解释大脑视觉表征。
Method: 基于 Brain Interaction Transformer (Brain-IT)，从 fMRI 活动解码语言 token，再整合到语言模型中生成答案。同时构建 NSD-VQA 数据集，包含 20 个受控问题类型和更多问答对，以支持可靠评估。
Result: 模型在 fMRI 字幕生成和 VQA 任务上显著优于先前方法。NSD-VQA 基准允许量化从 fMRI 响应中可靠解码的视觉和语义信息类型，并分析不同脑区的贡献。
Conclusion: Brain-IT-VQA 和 NSD-VQA 为从 fMRI 进行视觉问答提供了强大框架和可靠基准，有助于理解大脑视觉表征结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Steering Tropical Cyclones Using Small Perturbations in an AI Weather Model
papers.abstract_en: Tropical cyclone (TC) trajectories are governed by large-scale steering flows and exhibit sensitive dependence on atmospheric initial conditions. Using Hurricane Sandy (2012) in the Aurora AI weather model, we investigate whether targeted thermodynamic perturbations can induce meaningful track deviations. Two distinct perturbation regimes emerge. In the Caribbean, forward finite-time Lyapunov exponent (FTLE) diagnostics identify dynamically sensitive regions within Sandy's steering flow, where perturbations produce substantially larger responses than random placement. In the Pacific, a preferred corridor near 165W influences Sandy through Rossby wave teleconnections, confirmed using Takaya-Nakamura wave activity flux diagnostics. Despite their different physical pathways, both regimes share a common amplification mechanism: small initial perturbations generate modest trajectory offsets that are rapidly amplified when Sandy enters the highly sensitive recurvature region. The largest experiments produce track deviations exceeding 500 km after seven days. These results provide a proof-of-concept demonstration of the Weather Jiu-Jitsu framework, illustrating how targeted perturbations can be amplified through atmospheric dynamics in an AI weather model. Because the required perturbations exceed current operational cloud-seeding capabilities, the experiments should be interpreted as a theoretical sensitivity analysis rather than an operational weather modification strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Aurora AI天气模型，以2012年飓风Sandy为例，研究目标热力学扰动能否产生有意义的路径偏移。研究发现两种扰动机制：加勒比海区域的前向有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）诊断识别出动态敏感区；太平洋区域通过Rossby波遥相关影响Sandy。两种机制共享放大过程：小扰动产生的轨迹偏移在Sandy进入高敏感的回转区域时被快速放大，七天后最大路径偏差超过500公里。该研究为Weather Jiu-Jitsu框架提供了概念验证，但扰动幅度超出当前人工影响天气能力，应视为理论敏感性分析。
Motivation: 热带气旋轨迹对初始条件敏感，但能否通过小的目标扰动有效改变路径尚不清楚，现有研究多基于传统数值模式。
Method: 在Aurora AI天气模型中对飓风Sandy施加目标热力学扰动，利用FTLE和Takaya-Nakamura波活动通量诊断识别敏感区域，通过数值实验比较不同扰动位置和幅度的路径响应。
Result: 在加勒比海和太平洋两种扰动机制下，小扰动均可产生显著路径偏移，最大偏移超过500公里（七天）。
Conclusion: 该研究为使用AI模式进行气旋路径操控提供了概念验证，但所需扰动超出当前技术能力，结果应视为理论敏感性分析，而非可操作方案。

papers.title: Apertus LLM Family Expansion via Distillation and Quantization
papers.abstract_en: The wide adoption of LLMs has led to their use in great variety of applications and scenarios, such as chatbot assistants and data annotation, creating the need for the models to satisfy certain budget and hardware constraints. This has led to the trend of LLMs being released in batches consisting of similar models of various sizes for the family of models to adhere to as wide of a range of constraints as possible. In this paper, we validate distillation and quantization as a cost-effective way to expand model families to new sizes and hardware formats. Based on the open-recipe Apertus 8B LLM, we produce Apertus-v1.1 - a distilled family of models with up to 4B parameters trained on 1.7T permissive license tokens. We demonstrate cost-efficiency and strong accuracy performance of our approach for covering large ranges of hardware and systems requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文旨在通过蒸馏和量化方法，以低成本将开源Apertus 8B LLM扩展为不同规模和硬件格式的模型家族，产生了Apertus-v1.1系列，参数多达4B，训练于1.7T token上。摘要报告了该方法在覆盖广泛硬件和系统需求时的成本效益和强准确性。
Motivation: LLM在不同应用场景中需满足预算和硬件约束，但目前缺乏低成本扩展模型家族的方法，本文旨在验证蒸馏和量化为一种经济有效的途径。
Method: 基于开源配方Apertus 8B LLM，通过蒸馏和量化技术，产生最多4B参数的Apertus-v1.1模型家族，训练数据为1.7T许可token。
Result: 摘要展示了该方法的成本效益以及在覆盖广泛硬件和系统需求时的强准确性表现。
Conclusion: 蒸馏和量化被证明是一种经济有效的策略，可扩展模型家族至新规模和硬件格式。

papers.title: Models That Know How Evaluations Are Designed Score Safer
papers.abstract_en: The validity of AI safety evaluations depends on models behaving consistently across controlled and deployment settings. Prior work has identified test-time contextual cues, such as hypothetical scenarios, as a source of verbalized evaluation awareness and subsequent behavioral shift. In this paper, we investigate a potential explanation of this phenomenon: evaluation meta-knowledge, defined as parametric knowledge about the structural traits that characterize evaluations. Similar to dataset contamination, where benchmark exposure leads to higher performance through memorization, we hypothesize that models trained on texts describing evaluation practices may implicitly learn to recognize and respond to evaluation-like contexts, for instance, through exposure to scientific articles or social media posts about AI benchmarking. To test this, we fine-tune models on synthetic documents describing evaluation traits such as verifiable structures or moral dilemmas. Evaluating this fine-tuned model on six safety benchmarks, we find that it is significantly safer than the base model and control model. This behavioral shift persists even when restricting the analysis to responses lacking explicit verbalization of evaluation awareness. Our results demonstrate that evaluation meta-knowledge may inflate safety benchmark performance, introducing a novel confounder that is independent of explicit memorization or verbalized evaluation awareness, thus, challenging to detect. These findings have important implications for the design and interpretation of AI safety evaluations. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/compass-group-tue/arxiv2026_evaluation_meta_knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI安全评估中的一种新型混淆因素：评估元知识（evaluation meta-knowledge），即模型关于评估结构性特征（如可验证结构、道德困境）的参数化知识。通过在合成文档上微调模型，发现该模型在六个安全基准上显著更安全，且这种行为变化不依赖于显式的评估意识表达，表明评估元知识可能膨胀安全基准性能，对评估设计与解读有重要影响。
Motivation: 安全评估的有效性依赖模型在受控环境和部署环境下行为一致，但已有研究发现测试时上下文线索可导致评估感知和行为偏移。本文探索评估元知识作为该现象的潜在解释，即模型可能通过训练时接触描述评估实践的文本（如科学文章、社交媒体帖子）而隐式学会识别和响应评估类环境。
Method: 在描述评估特征（如可验证结构、道德困境）的合成文档上微调模型，然后在六个安全基准上评估其安全行为。
Result: 微调后的模型在六个安全基准上显著比基础模型和控制模型更安全，并且即使只分析未明确表达评估意识的响应，该行为偏移仍然存在。
Conclusion: 评估元知识可能独立于显式记忆或评估意识而膨胀安全基准性能，构成一种新型的、难以检测的混淆因素，对AI安全评估的设计和解读有重要启示。

summary_sections.motivation: 安全评估的有效性依赖模型在受控环境和部署环境下行为一致，但已有研究发现测试时上下文线索可导致评估感知和行为偏移。本文探索评估元知识作为该现象的潜在解释，即模型可能通过训练时接触描述评估实践的文本（如科学文章、社交媒体帖子）而隐式学会识别和响应评估类环境。
summary_sections.method: 在描述评估特征（如可验证结构、道德困境）的合成文档上微调模型，然后在六个安全基准上评估其安全行为。
summary_sections.result: 微调后的模型在六个安全基准上显著比基础模型和控制模型更安全，并且即使只分析未明确表达评估意识的响应，该行为偏移仍然存在。
summary_sections.conclusion: 评估元知识可能独立于显式记忆或评估意识而膨胀安全基准性能，构成一种新型的、难以检测的混淆因素，对AI安全评估的设计和解读有重要启示。

papers.title: GrowLoop: Self-Evolving Conversation Evaluation Seeded by Human
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of large language models, evaluating human-likeness in open-ended conversation has become increasingly important. However, human-likeness is a form of tacit knowledge that humans perceive intuitively, yet the underlying criteria resist explicit formulation. Human judgments vary widely, with strong agreement on some cases and legitimate disagreement on others. Meanwhile, the criteria behind human judgments remain implicit, leaving no clear basis for constructing cases. Further, what counts as human-likeness is not static, but evolving with model capability and human expectations. Despite progress in evaluation methods such as expert-authored benchmarks, Reward Models, and self-evolving benchmarks, none addresses all three challenges simultaneously. Therefore, we propose GrowLoop, a self-evolving conversation evaluation system that continuously adapts as models advance and scenarios shift. Starting from minimal human seed annotations, LLM agents iteratively extract and refine evaluation rubrics through Heuristic Learning. Human-AI agreement is required where annotators converge, while only plausibility is expected where they diverge. Moreover, the Rubric-Case co-evolution mechanism enables continuous evolution. When the evaluation target shifts, new human seeds expand the system's coverage accordingly. When applied to human-likeness evaluation in open-ended conversation, the AI judge guided by these rubrics not only substantially outperforms existing methods in alignment with human judgments, but also uncovers issues that annotators overlook. The resulting benchmark effectively discriminates models across capability tiers and reveals where they fall short, while generalizing to new scenarios and adapting as models advance. Our work shifts the benchmarking paradigm from manual updates or difficulty scaling to comprehensive, continuous self-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GrowLoop 是一个自进化对话评估系统，从少量人工种子标注出发，通过 LLM 智能体启发式学习提取和优化评估标准，并实现标准-案例协同进化，以应对模型能力提升和场景变化带来的评估需求演进。在开放域对话的人类相似性评估中，基于这些标准的 AI 裁判在人类判断对齐上显著优于现有方法，并能发现标注者遗漏的问题。
Motivation: 现有对话评估方法（如专家标注基准、奖励模型、自进化基准）无法同时解决人类判断的主观性与隐性标准、标准随模型和能力演变的动态性，以及缺乏明确案例构建依据这三个挑战。
Method: 提出 GrowLoop 系统，从少量人工种子标注开始，LLM 智能体通过启发式学习提取并迭代优化评估标准（Rubric）；对标注者一致的部分要求人机一致，对分歧部分只要求合理；通过 Rubric-Case 协同进化机制实现持续演化，当评估目标变化时，新种子扩展覆盖范围。
Result: 在开放域对话人类相似性评估中，基于这些标准的 AI 裁判在人类判断对齐上显著优于现有方法，能区分模型能力层级并揭示不足，同时能泛化到新场景并随模型进步适应。
Conclusion: 该工作将基准测试范式从手动更新或难度扩展转向全面、持续的自我进化。

papers.title: Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridges for time series (SBTS) generate synthetic paths by projecting, in relative entropy, a Brownian reference onto the path laws that match the joint distribution of the data on the observation grid. The Brownian reference, however, fixes the quadratic variation of the generated paths, which is restrictive when stochastic volatility, correlated noise, or rank-deficient covariance structures must be reproduced. We introduce "Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series" (TR-SBTS), which keeps the entropy-projection backbone of SBTS but replaces the Brownian reference by a triangular, volatility-informed, intervalwise frozen reference on a state augmented with latent covariance descriptors. The construction remains a single entropy projection on the augmented state: the minimiser is the \(h\)-transform of the reference, and on each frozen interval the optimal drift has the logarithmic-gradient form \(b^\star(t,x)=A\,\nabla\log H(t,x)\), intrinsic to the active covariance directions when the frozen covariance \(A\) is degenerate. We prove stability of the frozen approximation and consistency of the associated regularised kernel estimators, describe a reference-aware Nadaraya--Watson implementation of the conditional next-increment law, and evaluate the construction on numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Triangular-Reference Schrödinger Bridges for Time Series (TR-SBTS)，将 SBTS 中的布朗参考替换为三角、波动率感知、区间冻结的参考，并扩展状态空间以包含潜在协方差描述符，从而能够生成具有随机波动率、相关噪声或秩亏协方差结构的时间序列。方法保持单次熵投影框架，证明了冻结近似的稳定性和正则化核估计的一致性。
Motivation: 标准 SBTS 使用布朗参考，固定了生成路径的二次变差，无法再现随机波动率、相关噪声或秩亏协方差结构，限制了在复杂时间序列上的适用性。
Method: 在 SBTS 的熵投影框架下，将布朗参考替换为三角、波动率感知、区间冻结的参考，并引入潜在协方差描述符增强状态空间。最优漂移具有对数梯度形式，并采用了参考感知的 Nadaraya–Watson 实现。
Result: 数值实验验证了所提出方法的有效性，但具体性能指标未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: TR-SBTS 扩展了 SBTS 的建模能力，能够处理更丰富的协方差结构，且保持熵投影的理论性质。文中给出了稳定性与一致性证明。

papers.title: When Does Deep RL Beat Calibrated Baselines? A Benchmark Study on Adaptive Resource Control
papers.abstract_en: A properly calibrated rule-based autoscaler can beat every one of six mainstream deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms on cost across every workload we test - so when, if ever, does DRL actually help? We study this in RLScale-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for DRL on adaptive resource control, where an agent allocates compute to a dynamic workload under cost and service-level constraints. We evaluate PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3, and DDPG under matched architectures, training budgets, and reward functions against a calibrated rule-based baseline across six workload patterns and five seeds (240 runs), instantiate the benchmark on Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling, and probe distribution-shift generalization. Three findings challenge common assumptions: (i) the calibrated controller achieves the lowest cost on all six workloads, though it trails the best RL agents on bursty and flash traffic; (ii) discrete-action algorithms outperform continuous-action ones by one to two orders of magnitude in constraint violations due to action-space mismatch; and (iii) no single algorithm dominates across workloads, with rankings shifting by up to four positions. The bottleneck in RL-based resource control is not algorithm selection but baseline calibration, reward engineering, and realistic evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过RLScale-Bench基准系统性地比较了六种主流深度强化学习（DRL）算法与经过校准的基于规则的自动缩放器在自适应资源控制任务上的表现。结果显示，在所有六种工作负载模式下，校准的规则基线在成本上击败了所有DRL算法，但在突发和闪流流量上DRL略有优势；离散动作算法在约束违反上比连续动作算法好一到两个数量级；没有单一算法在所有工作负载上占优。结论是RL资源控制的瓶颈不在于算法选择，而在于基线校准、奖励设计和评估协议。
Motivation: 主流DRL算法在自适应资源控制中是否真的优于简单但校准良好的规则基线？本文旨在通过可重复的基准研究回答这一关键问题。
Method: 构建RLScale-Bench基准，包含六种工作负载模式和五种随机种子的240次实验，在Kubernetes水平Pod自动缩放上实例化，评估PPO、DQN、A2C、SAC、TD3和DDPG，匹配架构、训练预算和奖励函数，并与校准规则基线比较。
Result: 校准规则基线在所有六种工作负载上实现最低成本，但DRL在突发和闪流流量上表现更好；离散动作算法的约束违反比连续动作算法低一到两个数量级；算法排名在不同工作负载间变化高达四个位置。
Conclusion: DRL在资源控制中的瓶颈不是算法选择，而是基线校准、奖励工程和现实的评估协议。

papers.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. Existing confidence-based decoding ranks masked positions independently and commits the top-K positions, largely ignoring whether the committed tokens provide complementary visual grounding. We identify a step-level limitation of this strategy in multimodal settings: high-confidence tokens selected in the same step can rely on overlapping visual grounding, introducing visual redundancy among the committed tokens and leaving less complementary visual grounding available for later decoding. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Visual Redundancy Index (VRI), which measures visual grounding overlap among tokens committed in parallel. To control this redundancy during decoding, we propose Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding (VRCD), a training-free inference-time decoding method that uses token-to-image attention to prioritize visually complementary positions. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, VRCD reduces visual redundancy and remaining-position entropy with modest runtime overhead. In longer decoding experiments, it also achieves relative accuracy gains of up to 18.8% on M^3CoT and 6.9% on MMBench over confidence-based decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, preprint. Code is available at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）并行解码中存在的视觉冗余问题，提出视觉冗余控制解码（VRCD），一种无需训练的推理时解码方法，利用token-to-image注意力选择视觉互补的位置。实验表明，VRCD减少了视觉冗余，并在M^3CoT和MMBench上分别获得了18.8%和6.9%的相对准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有基于置信度的并行解码独立选择top-K位置，忽略提交的token之间视觉覆盖的重叠，导致视觉冗余，限制后续解码。
Method: 引入视觉冗余指数（VRI）量化并行提交token之间的视觉覆盖重叠，并提出VRCD，在解码时优先选择视觉互补的位置。
Result: 在多模态基准上，VRCD降低了视觉冗余和剩余位置熵，在长解码实验中比基于置信度的解码在M^3CoT上提升18.8%，在MMBench上提升6.9%。
Conclusion: 控制视觉冗余可以提升并行解码的效率和性能，VRCD是一种轻量级、无需训练的改进方法。

papers.title: The ASE-LSE Disagreement Landscape: An End-to-End Characterisation of Extremes and Structural Drivers
papers.abstract_en: Two of the most widely used methods for analysing graph data, Adjacency Spectral Embedding and Laplacian Spectral Embedding, often produce different results when applied to the same graph. Yet the structural reasons behind this disagreement remain incompletely understood. This paper provides an end-to-end account of ASE-LSE latent subspace disagreement. We first prove that the two methods produce identical latent subspaces for every embedding dimension whenever the Laplacian is a scalar multiple of the adjacency matrix, and show that this scalar relationship holds if and only if the graph is either regular or bipartite biregular. This anchor result identifies a sufficient condition for perfect agreement that pins down the floor of the disagreement spectrum and supplies the baseline for the perturbation analysis. We then prove that no maximal-disagreement graph or family of graphs exists: the disagreement is always strictly below its theoretical ceiling, and we exhibit a witness family demonstrating that no finite maximum is attainable, so the disagreement landscape has no maximiser. With both endpoints established, we derive a Regularity Departure Bound whose two terms isolate degree heterogeneity and eigengap as the primary structural factors influencing disagreement in the middle regime. Empirical validation across thousands of simulated graphs confirms the mechanisms predicted by the bound: heterogeneity pushes disagreement up, eigengap suppresses it, and their joint ratio emerges as a unified predictor of ASE-LSE disagreement, suggesting when the two embeddings can be treated as interchangeable and when they cannot.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了邻接谱嵌入和拉普拉斯谱嵌入在图数据分析中产生不同潜在子空间的结构原因。证明当且仅当图是正则图或二部双正则图时，两种嵌入在任意维度上产生相同子空间；并证明了不存在最大差异图。推导了正则性偏移界，将度异质性和特征间隙识别为影响差异的主要因素。实验验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 两种常用的图嵌入方法ASE和LSE往往产生不同结果，但导致这种差异的结构原因尚未被完全理解。
Method: 通过理论分析建立ASE-LSE潜在子空间差异的完整描述：首先确定完全一致的条件，然后证明不存在最大差异图，最后推导正则性偏移界，将差异分解为度异质性和特征间隙的贡献。
Result: 在数千个模拟图上验证了理论预测：度异质性增加差异，特征间隙抑制差异，两者的联合比率可作为统一预测指标。
Conclusion: 该研究揭示了ASE和LSE何时可互换、何时不可互换的明确条件，为图嵌入方法的选取提供了理论指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该研究揭示了ASE和LSE何时可互换、何时不可互换的明确条件，为图嵌入方法的选取提供了理论指导。

papers.title: What Semantics Survive the Connector? Diagnosing VLM-to-DiT Alignment in Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching based video generative models have been increasingly relying on prepended Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to handle complex, instruction-based video editing. The prevailing assumption underlying this paradigm is that a connector module can seamlessly align the VLM's rich multi-modal reasoning with the original text embedding space of DiTs. However, we hypothesize that this alignment acts as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural variables. Verifying this is challenging, as end-to-end evaluations conflate alignment failures with generation errors, and natural datasets lack disentangled annotations. To rigorously investigate this, we propose a controlled data processing pipeline based on video composition that results in TRACE-Edit, a diagnostic dataset focusing on relation-based editing. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic protocol to analyze two important designs of meta-query and connector in the existing video editing models. Systematic evaluation of four representative model cases reveals that fine-grained structural semantics can be severely degraded during alignment. Our findings overturn the assumption of lossless semantic transfer, identifying the VLM-to-DiT alignment as a major bottleneck and providing a new diagnostic foundation for future multi-modal alignment architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑了在基于流匹配的视频生成模型中，连接器（connector）能够将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的丰富多模态推理无缝对齐到DiT文本嵌入空间的假设。作者通过构造基于视频合成的诊断数据集TRACE-Edit，并设计全面的诊断协议，系统评估了四种代表性模型，发现细粒度的结构语义在对齐过程中严重退化，表明VLM到DiT的对齐是语义瓶颈。
Motivation: 当前视频编辑模型普遍使用预置的VLM处理复杂指令，但假设连接器能无损对齐VLM与DiT，这一假设未经严格验证。由于端到端评估混淆了对齐失败和生成错误，且自然数据集缺乏解耦标注，难以直接诊断对齐质量。
Method: 提出基于视频合成的可控数据处理流程，构建诊断数据集TRACE-Edit，专注于关系编辑任务。设计诊断协议，分析现有模型中元查询（meta-query）和连接器（connector）两种重要设计对语义保留的影响。
Result: 对四种代表性模型案例的系统评估显示，细粒度结构语义在对齐过程中被严重退化，推翻了无损语义转移的假设，确认VLM到DiT的对齐是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 本文为未来多模态对齐架构提供了新的诊断基础，表明连接器设计需要重新审视以保留结构语义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KAN-MLP-Mixer: A comprehensive investigation of the usage of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for improving IMU-based Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have demonstrated an exceptional ability to learn complex functions on clean, low-dimensional data but struggle to maintain performance on noisy and imperfect real-world datasets. In contrast, conventional multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) are far more tolerant to noise and computationally efficient. Replacing all MLP components with KANs in HAR models often degrades accuracy and computation efficiency, highlighting an open challenge: how to combine KANs' precision with MLPs' noise robustness and efficiency. To address this, we systematically explore various placements of KAN modules within deep HAR networks and propose a hybrid architecture that strategically synergizes the strengths of both paradigms, which uses a KAN-based input embedding layer, retains MLP layers for intermediate feature mixing, and introduces a specialized LarctanKAN module for final activity classification. Across eight public HAR datasets, the hybrid KAN-MLP model achieves an average macro F1 score relative improvement of 5.33\% compared pure-MLP model, significantly outperforming standalone KAN and MLP baselines. Furthermore, integrating this hybrid strategy into other state-of-the-art HAR architectures consistently boosts their performance. Our findings demonstrate that a carefully orchestrated combination of KAN, MLP, or other conventional neural components yields more robust and accurate HAR models for real-world wearable sensing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统探索KAN模块在深度HAR网络中的不同放置方式，提出混合架构，在输入嵌入层使用KAN，中间特征混合保留MLP，最后使用LarctanKAN模块进行分类。在8个公开HAR数据集上，相比纯MLP模型平均macro F1提升5.33%，并提升其他SOTA架构性能。结论强调精心组合KAN、MLP等组件可得到更鲁棒准确的HAR模型。
Motivation: KAN在干净低维数据上表现优异，但在噪声真实数据上性能下降，MLP则对噪声更鲁棒且计算高效。现有HAR模型简单替换所有MLP为KAN会降低准确率和效率，需探索如何结合二者优势。
Method: 提出混合架构：KAN输入嵌入层、MLP中间特征混合层、LarctanKAN分类模块。在8个公开HAR数据集上实验，对比纯MLP、纯KAN及其他SOTA架构。
Result: 混合模型平均macro F1提升5.33%，优于纯MLP和纯KAN，整合到其他SOTA HAR架构中也提升性能。
Conclusion: 精心组合KAN、MLP等神经组件可在真实穿戴传感环境下得到更鲁棒准确的HAR模型。

papers.title: Real-Time Neural Hair Denoising
papers.abstract_en: We propose a lightweight real-time method for reconstructing strand-based hair G-Buffers from severely undersampled rasterized inputs. Our pipeline first applies neural spatial reconstruction and temporal accumulation to recover hair coverage, i.e., fractional hair visibility within a pixel, and tangent. It then uses a tangent-guided reconstruction step to complete the position, which is subsequently used for physically based deferred hair shading. We evaluate our method across a diverse set of hairstyles, including straight, wavy, afro, and ponytail styles, under both static and dynamic scenarios. Our method achieves higher hair reconstruction quality than existing hair-specific denoising techniques and general industrial neural reconstruction solutions such as DLSS and FSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级实时神经网络方法，用于从严重欠采样的光栅化输入中重建基于发丝的毛发 G-Buffer。管道包括神经空间重建和时间累积以恢复毛发覆盖率和切线，再通过切线引导重建位置，最终用于物理基础的延迟毛发着色。在多种发型和动态场景下，该方法优于现有毛发去噪技术及 DLSS、FSR 等工业方案。
Motivation: 现有毛发去噪方法在处理严重欠采样输入时质量不佳，而通用工业方案（如 DLSS）对毛发这种精细结构效果有限，亟需轻量级、高保真的实时毛发重建方案。
Method: 提出一个两阶段管道：首先通过神经空间重建和时间累积恢复像素级毛发覆盖率（fractional hair visibility）和切线信息；然后利用切线引导重建毛发位置，用于后续的基于物理的延迟着色。
Result: 在直发、卷发、非洲式、马尾辫等多种发型，以及静态和动态场景下，该方法的重建质量优于现有毛发专用去噪技术及 DLSS、FSR 等通用方案。
Conclusion: 轻量级神经网络结合切线引导的位置重建能有效解决实时毛发去噪问题，且适用于多种复杂发型和动态场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASRU: Activation Steering Meets Reinforcement Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) may memorize sensitive cross-modal information during pretraining, making machine unlearning (MU) crucial. Existing methods typically evaluate unlearning effectiveness based on output deviations, while overlooking the generation quality after unlearning. This can easily lead to hallucinated or rigid responses, thereby affecting the usability and safety of the unlearned model. To address this issue, we propose ASRU, a controllable multimodal unlearning framework that incorporates generation quality as a core evaluation objective. ASRU first induces initial refusal behavior through activation redirection, and then optimizes fine-grained refusal boundaries using a customized reward function, thereby achieving a better trade-off between target knowledge unlearning and model utility. Experiments on Qwen3-VL show that ASRU significantly improves unlearning effectiveness (+24.6%) on average and generation quality (5.8X) on average while effectively preserving model utility, using only a small amount of retained supervision data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASRU，一种用于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可控遗忘框架，将生成质量作为核心评估目标。ASRU 通过激活重定向诱导初始拒绝行为，再利用自定义奖励函数优化细粒度拒绝边界，在目标知识遗忘与模型效用之间取得更好权衡。在 Qwen3-VL 上的实验表明，ASRU 平均遗忘效果提升 24.6%，生成质量提升 5.8 倍，且仅需少量保留监督数据。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通常仅基于输出偏差评估遗忘效果，忽视遗忘后的生成质量，易导致模型产生幻觉或僵硬回应，影响可用性和安全性。
Method: ASRU 包含两阶段：首先通过激活重定向诱导模型初始拒绝行为，然后使用定制奖励函数优化细粒度拒绝边界，实现可控的多模态遗忘。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL 上，ASRU 平均遗忘效果提升 24.6%，平均生成质量提升 5.8 倍，同时有效保留模型效用，且仅需少量保留监督数据。
Conclusion: ASRU 通过引入生成质量作为核心评估目标，实现了遗忘效果与模型效用的更好平衡，但摘要未提及其他模型或多模态任务上的泛化能力。
