papers.title: On the Stability of Growth in Structural Plasticity
papers.abstract_en: Standard deep-learning pipelines usually choose the network architecture before training and keep it fixed throughout optimization. In contrast, a model can also be adapted by editing its structure during training, for example by pruning existing hidden-neuron units or growing new ones. Although growth is appealing for adaptive and continual systems, we show that it is not simply the inverse of pruning. Pruning selects among units that have participated in training from the start, whereas growth inserts new units into an already specialized optimization trajectory. We isolate this insertion problem and show that newborn units are often forward-active but backward-starved: they participate in the forward computation, yet receive much weaker gradient signal than incumbent units. This disadvantage is minor in small MLP benchmarks, but becomes clear in harder image-classification settings with a convolutional trunk. In these settings, \textsc{Grow} can achieve high final accuracy during the structural-editing procedure, while \textsc{Prune} is stronger when performance is averaged over the training trajectory or when the final sparse network is retrained from scratch. Interventions targeting optimizer state, insertion, selection, and trainability show that improving the integration of newborn units can improve adaptive performance, but does not automatically produce better final subnetworks. In continual-learning benchmarks stressing plasticity loss, \textsc{Grow} becomes competitive mainly when new units have enough time to integrate. Together, these results suggest that \textsc{Grow} should be evaluated not only as an architecture-search operator, but as a time-sensitive optimization process whose success depends on insertion stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络结构生长（Growth）与剪枝（Pruning）的差异，揭示生长并非剪枝的逆过程。新插入单元在前向传播中活跃但反向传播梯度信号弱，导致“前向活跃-后向饥饿”问题。在卷积图像分类任务中，生长可获高最终精度，但剪枝在平均轨迹性能或重新训练时更强。持续学习场景下，生长仅在新单元有充足整合时间时才有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有结构自适应方法中，生长（添加新单元）常被视为剪枝的逆过程，但两者在优化轨迹上的根本差异未被充分认识，导致生长在复杂任务中表现不稳定。
Method: 通过实验隔离新单元插入问题，对比生长与剪枝在不同基准（小型MLP、卷积图像分类、持续学习）上的表现，并针对优化器状态、插入策略、选择机制和可训练性进行干预分析。
Result: 生长在结构编辑过程中可达到高最终准确率，但新单元接收的梯度信号显著弱于原有单元；剪枝在平均训练轨迹性能或从零重新训练时更强。改善新单元整合可提升自适应性能，但不自动改善最终子网络质量。
Conclusion: 生长不应仅被视为架构搜索操作，而是一个时间敏感的优化过程，其成功依赖于插入稳定性（即新单元有足够时间整合）。

papers.title: TAPIOCA: Why Task- Aware Pruning Improves OOD model Capability
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has promoted task-aware layer pruning as a way to improve model performance on particular tasks, as shown by TALE. In this paper, we investigate when such improvements occur and why. We show first that, across controlled polynomial regression tasks and large language models, such pruning yields no benefit on in-distribution (ID) data but consistently improves out-of-distribution (OOD) accuracy. We further show empirically that OOD inputs induce layerwise norm and pairwise-distance profiles that deviate from the corresponding ID profiles. This leads to a geometric explanation of task-aware pruning: each task induces a task-adapted geometry, characterized empirically by the representation profiles observed on ID inputs. OOD inputs can introduce a distorted version of the task-adapted geometry. Task-aware pruning identifies layers that create or amplify this distortion; by removing them, it shifts OOD representational norms and pairwise distances toward those observed on the adapted distribution. This realigns OOD inputs with the model's task-adapted geometry and improves performance. We provide causal evidence through controlled distribution shifts and residual-scaling interventions, and demonstrate consistent behavior across model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究任务感知层剪枝 (task-aware layer pruning) 何时以及为何提升模型性能。通过可控多项式回归和大语言模型实验，发现剪枝对分布内 (ID) 数据无益，但持续提升分布外 (OOD) 准确率。作者从几何角度解释：OOD 输入会扭曲任务适配的几何结构，剪枝移除产生或放大扭曲的层，从而将 OOD 表示向 ID 分布对齐。提供因果证据和跨模型规模的一致性表现。
Motivation: 虽然已有工作（如TALE）表明任务感知层剪枝能提升特定任务性能，但尚不清楚改进发生的条件和根本原因。本文旨在解析剪枝何时有效以及为何有效。
Method: 在可控多项式回归和大语言模型上进行实验；测量ID和OOD输入的逐层范数和成对距离分布；提出几何解释框架；通过控制分布偏移和残差缩放干预提供因果证据。
Result: 任务感知剪枝对ID数据无提升，但持续改善OOD准确率。OOD输入产生偏离ID的层表示几何，剪枝通过移除扭曲层使OOD表示重新对齐任务适配几何。
Conclusion: 任务感知剪枝的有益效果源于其校正OOD输入几何失配的能力，该现象在多个模型规模上一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Segmentation as Semantic-Based Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) trains dense pixel-level segmentation models from partial or coarse annotations such as bounding boxes, scribbles, or image-level tags. While recent work leverages foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to generate pseudo-labels, these approaches typically depend on heuristic prompt choices and offer limited ways to incorporate prior knowledge or heterogeneous labels. We address this gap by taking a neurosymbolic perspective: integrating differentiable fuzzy logic with deep segmentation models. Weak annotations and domain-specific priors are unified as continuous logical constraints that fine-tune SAM under weak supervision. The refined foundation model then produces improved pseudo-labels, from which we train a second-stage prompt-free segmentation model. Experiments on Pascal VOC 2012 and the REFUGE2 optic disc/cup segmentation dataset show that our logic-guided fine-tuning yields higher-quality pseudo-labels, leading to state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy that often exceeds densely supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从神经符号主义的角度出发，将可微模糊逻辑与深度分割模型结合，解决弱监督语义分割中伪标签质量差的问题。通过将弱标注和领域先验统一为连续逻辑约束，微调SAM（Segment Anything Model），再训练第二阶段的免提示分割模型。在Pascal VOC 2012和REFUGE2数据集上，该方法生成的伪标签质量更高，分割精度优于许多全监督基线。
Motivation: 现有弱监督语义分割方法依赖启发式提示选择，难以融入先验知识或异质标注，导致伪标签质量不高。
Method: 提出神经符号主义方法：将可微模糊逻辑约束作为正则项，连续地微调SAM，使其在弱监督下生成更优的伪标签；随后用这些伪标签训练一个无需提示的第二阶段分割模型。
Result: 在Pascal VOC 2012和REFUGE2数据集上，该方法达到的分割精度领先于现有弱监督方法，甚至超过部分全监督基线。
Conclusion: 逻辑引导的微调能有效提升伪标签质量，从而在弱监督设定下取得优异分割性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Instruction Compliance in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in real-world use cases may need to adapt to external natural language instructions that interrupt ongoing behavior and conflict with long-horizon objectives. However, conditioning rewards on instructions introduces a fundamental failure mode as Bellman updates couple value estimates across instruction contexts, leading to inconsistent values when instructions interrupt macro-actions. We propose Macro-Action Value Correction for Instruction Compliance (MAVIC), which corrects Bellman backups at instruction boundaries by correcting the incoming instruction objective and restoring the continuation value under the current objective. Unlike reward shaping, MAVIC modifies the bootstrapping target itself, enabling consistent value estimation under stochastic instruction switching within a unified policy. We provide theoretical analysis and an actor-critic implementation, and show that MAVIC achieves high instruction compliance while preserving base task performance in increasingly complex cooperative multi-agent environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAVIC方法，通过修正指令边界处的Bellman备份来解决多智能体强化学习中外部指令与长期目标冲突导致的值估计不一致问题。理论分析和实验表明MAVIC能在复杂合作环境中实现高指令遵循同时保持基础任务性能。
Motivation: 现有MARL在接收外部自然语言指令时，Bellman更新会跨指令上下文耦合值估计，导致值不一致，尤其在指令打断宏动作时。
Method: 提出Macro-Action Value Correction for Instruction Compliance (MAVIC)，在指令边界修正Bellman备份：校正传入指令目标并恢复当前目标下的连续值。
Result: 在日益复杂的合作多智能体环境中，MAVIC实现了高指令遵循同时保持基础任务性能。
Conclusion: MAVIC通过修改自举目标本身而非奖励塑造，实现在随机指令切换下的一致值估计，适用于统一策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TokenRatio: Principled Token-Level Preference Optimization via Ratio Matching
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used RL-free method for aligning language models from pairwise preferences, but it models preferences over full sequences even though generation is driven by per-token decisions. Existing token-level extensions typically decompose a sequence-level Bradley-Terry objective across timesteps, leaving per-prefix (state-wise) optimality implicit. We study how to recover token-level preference optimality using only standard sequence-level pairwise comparisons. We introduce Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization (TBPO), which posits a token-level Bradley-Terry preference model over next-token actions conditioned on the prefix, and derive a Bregman-divergence density-ratio matching objective that generalizes the logistic/DPO loss while preserving the optimal policy induced by the token-level model and maintaining DPO-like simplicity. We introduce two instantiations: TBPO-Q, which explicitly learns a lightweight state baseline, and TBPO-A, which removes the baseline through advantage normalization. Across instruction following, helpfulness/harmlessness, and summarization benchmarks, TBPO improves alignment quality and training stability and increases output diversity relative to strong sequence-level and token-level baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization (TBPO)，在 token 级别建模偏好，使用 Bregman 散度密度比匹配目标，推广了 DPO 损失。实验在指令遵循、有帮助性/无害性、摘要基准上，TBPO 改善了对齐质量和训练稳定性，并增加了输出多样性，优于强序列级和 token 级基线。
Motivation: 现有 DPO 是序列级别的，而生成是 token 级别的；现有 token 级扩展通常分解序列级目标，没有显式考虑前缀（state-wise）最优性。本文研究如何仅使用标准序列级成对比较来恢复 token 级偏好最优性。
Method: 提出 TBPO，假设 token 级别的 Bradley-Terry 偏好模型（next-token actions 条件于前缀），推导 Bregman 散度密度比匹配目标，推广 DPO 损失。两种实例：TBPO-Q（学习轻量级状态基线）和 TBPO-A（通过优势归一化去除基线）。
Result: 在指令遵循、有帮助性/无害性、摘要基准上，TBPO 改善了对齐质量和训练稳定性，并增加了输出多样性，优于强序列级和 token 级基线。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过密度比匹配可以从序列级偏好恢复 token 级最优性，并提出了简单有效的算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Sample Efficiency in Predictive Coding
papers.abstract_en: Predictive Coding (PC) is an influential account of cortical learning. Much of recent work has focused on comparing PC to Backpropagation (BP) to find whether PC offers any advantages. Small scale experiments show that PC enables learning that is more sample efficient and effective in many contexts, though a thorough theoretical understanding of the phenomena remains elusive. To address this, we quantify the efficiency of learning in BP and PC through a metric called ``target alignment'', which measures how closely the change in the output of the network is aligned to the output prediction error. We then derive and empirically validate analytical expressions for target alignment in Deep Linear Networks. We show that learning in PC is more efficient than BP, which is especially pronounced in deep, narrow and pre-trained networks. We also derive exact conditions for guaranteed optimal target alignment in PC and validate our findings through experiments. We study full training trajectories of linear and non-linear models, and find the predicted benefits of PC persist in practice even when some assumptions are violated. Overall, this work provides a mechanistic understanding of the higher learning efficiency observed for PC over BP in previous works, and can guide how PC should be parametrised to learn most effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了预测编码（PC）相对于反向传播（BP）在学习效率上的优势，通过引入“目标对齐”（target alignment）度量来量化学习效率。作者在深度线性网络中推导并验证了目标对齐的解析表达式，发现PC在深层、窄网络和预训练网络上效率更高，并给出了保证最优目标对齐的条件。实验表明PC的优势在实际中即使假设被违反时仍然存在。
Motivation: 以往工作显示PC在样本效率和有效性上优于BP，但缺乏理论理解。本文旨在量化并解释PC的学习效率优势。
Method: 提出目标对齐度量，衡量网络输出变化与输出预测误差的匹配程度。在深度线性网络中推导解析表达式，并通过理论分析和实验验证。
Result: PC的学习效率高于BP，尤其在深层、窄网络和预训练网络中更为显著；推导出保证最优目标对齐的精确条件，并通过实验验证。
Conclusion: 本文提供了PC相对于BP更高学习效率的机制性理解，并指导如何参数化PC以实现最有效的学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Engineering Robustness into Personal Agents with the AI Workflow Store
papers.abstract_en: The dominant paradigm for AI agents is an "on-the-fly" loop in which agents synthesize plans and execute actions within seconds or minutes in response to user prompts. We argue that this paradigm short-circuits disciplined software engineering (SE) processes -- iterative design, rigorous testing, adversarial evaluation, staged deployment, and more -- that have delivered the (relatively) reliable and secure systems we use today. By focusing on rapid, real-time synthesis, are AI agents effectively delivering users improvised prototypes rather than systems fit for high-stakes scenarios in which users may unwittingly apply them? This paper argues for the need to integrate rigorous SE processes into the agentic loop to produce production-grade, hardened, and deterministically-constrained agent *workflows* that substantially outperform the potentially brittle and vulnerable results of on-the-fly synthesis. Doing so may require extra compute and time, and if so, we must amortize the cost of rigor through reuse across a broad user community. We envision an *AI Workflow Store* that consists of hardened and reusable workflows that agents can invoke with far greater reliability and security than improvised tool chains. We outline the research challenges of this vision, which stem from a broader flexibility-robustness tension that we argue requires moving beyond the ``on-the-fly'' paradigm to navigate effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判当前AI代理的“即时合成”范式，认为其绕过了迭代设计、严格测试、对抗性评估等严谨的软件工程流程，导致生成的系统在高风险场景中可能脆弱且不可靠。作者提出“AI工作流商店”愿景，通过可复用的、经严格测试的工作流来替代即时工具链，以提升可靠性和安全性，并讨论了灵活性与健壮性之间的张力。
Motivation: 现有AI代理的实时合成范式缺乏软件工程纪律，难以保证生产级、强健和确定性的输出，尤其在高风险应用中可能给用户带来风险。
Method: 提出构建AI工作流商店，存储和复用经过严格工程处理的工作流，通过社区共享来摊销额外计算和时间的成本。
Result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，而是提出了一个研究愿景和挑战框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要超越即时合成范式，通过复用经工程验证的工作流来平衡灵活性与健壮性，并指出了相关研究挑战。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Resilient Solution for Sewer Overflow Monitoring across Cloud and Edge
papers.abstract_en: Aging combined sewer systems in many historical cities are increasingly stressed by extreme rainfall events, which can trigger combined sewer overflows (CSO) with significant environmental and public health impacts. Forecasting the filling dynamics of overflow basins is critical for anticipating capacity exceedance and enabling timely preventive actions for CSO. We present a web-based demonstrator that integrates Deep Learning forecasting methods in both cloud and edge settings into an interactive monitoring dashboard for overflow monitoring, resilient to network outages. A video showcase is available online (https://cloud.bht-berlin.de/index.php/s/b9xt4T3SdiLBiFZ).
papers.comment: 3 pages, 6 figures, accepted at 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), Demonstrations Track. URL: https://riwwer.demo.calgo-lab.de
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合云和边缘计算的深度学习预测方法，用于监测合流制下水道溢流（CSO）的填充动态，并构建了抗网络中断的交互式仪表盘演示系统。摘要指出该方法能够预测溢流池容量超限，从而支持及时预防措施。
Motivation: 老旧合流制下水道系统在极端降雨事件下容易发生溢流，造成环境和健康影响。现有监测方案在网络中断时缺乏韧性，需要一种能够在云和边缘侧协同工作的预测方法。
Method: 集成深度学习预测方法，支持云和边缘两种部署模式，并设计成抗网络中断的监测仪表盘。系统包括前端交互界面和后端预测模型，视频展示已在线提供。

Conclusion: 本文展示的基于云和边缘的监测方案可提高下水道溢流预报的韧性，减少环境与健康风险。

papers.title: Litespark Inference For CPUs: Ultra-Fast SIMD Framework for Ternary (1.58-bit) Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed artificial intelligence, but their computational requirements remain prohibitive for most users. Standard inference demands expensive datacenter GPUs or cloud API access, leaving over one billion personal computers underutilized for AI workloads. Ternary models offer a path forward: their weights are constrained to {-1, 0, +1}, theoretically eliminating the need for floating-point multiplication. However, existing frameworks fail to exploit this structure, treating ternary models as dense floating-point networks. We address this gap with custom SIMD kernels that replace matrix multiplication with simple addition and subtraction operations, targeting the integer dot product instructions available on modern CPUs. Our implementation, Litespark-Inference, is pip-installable and integrates directly with Hugging-Face, achieving 18.15x higher throughput, 7.15x faster time-to-first-token and 6.03x memory reduction compared to standard PyTorch inference on Apple Silicon, with comparable or higher throughput speedups up to 95.81x on Intel and AMD processors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Litespark-Inference，一个针对三元（1.58-bit）语言模型CPU推理的SIMD框架。通过自定义SIMD内核将矩阵乘法替换为整数加法与减法，利用现代CPU的整数点积指令，实现比标准PyTorch推理高18.15倍的吞吐量、7.15倍的首token延迟降低和6.03倍的内存缩减，在Intel和AMD处理器上吞吐量提升达95.81倍。
Motivation: 三元模型权重限制为{-1,0,+1}，理论上可省去浮点乘法，但现有框架仍将其视为稠密浮点网络，未利用其结构优势，导致CPU推理效率低下。
Method: 开发自定义SIMD内核，针对三元权重的特性，用整数加法和减法操作替代矩阵乘法，并直接调用现代CPU的整数点积指令，同时提供pip安装包并与HuggingFace集成。
Result: 在Apple Silicon上，相比PyTorch推理，吞吐量提升18.15倍，首token延迟降低7.15倍，内存减少6.03倍；在Intel和AMD处理器上吞吐量提升最高达95.81倍。

papers.title: CredibleDFGO: Differentiable Factor Graph Optimization with Credibility Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) positioning is widely used for urban navigation, but the covariance reported by the GNSS solver is often unreliable in urban canyons. Existing differentiable factor graph optimization (DFGO) methods learn measurement weighting through the solver, but they still use position-only objectives. As a result, the position estimate may improve while the reported covariance remains too small, too large, or incorrectly oriented. We propose CredibleDFGO (CDFGO), a differentiable GNSS factor graph framework that makes covariance credibility an explicit training target. A Weighting Generation Network (WGN) predicts per-satellite reliability weights, and a differentiable Gauss-Newton solver maps these weights to a position estimate and a Hessian-derived posterior covariance. We use proper scoring rules to supervise the East-North predictive distribution end to end. We study negative log-likelihood (NLL), the energy score (ES), and their combination. Results on three UrbanNav test scenes show consistent gains in covariance credibility. Positioning accuracy also improves on the medium-urban and harsh-urban scenes; on the deep-urban scene, both the mean horizontal error and the 95th-percentile error improve. On the harsh-urban Mong Kok (MK) scene, CDFGO-Combined reduces the mean horizontal error from 13.77 m to 11.68 m, reduces NLL from 40.63 to 6.59, and reduces ES from 12.31 to 9.05 relative to DFGO (MAE). Case studies link the MK improvement to better axis-wise consistency, more credible local covariance ellipses, and satellite-level reweighting.
papers.comment: Submitted to NAVIGATION: Journal of the Institute of Navigation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出CredibleDFGO (CDFGO) 框架，通过将协方差可信度作为显式训练目标，改进可微分因子图优化 (DFGO)。使用加权生成网络预测卫星权重，并通过可微分高斯-牛顿求解器输出位置估计和Hessian后验协方差，利用负对数似然和能量评分进行端到端监督。在城市导航数据集上，协方差可信度一致提升，定位精度在中度和严酷城市场景下也有改善。
Motivation: 现有DFGO方法仅使用位置目标，导致协方差报告不可靠（过小、过大或错误定向），尤其在城市峡谷中。
Method: 提出CDFGO框架，包含加权生成网络 (WGN) 预测卫星可靠性权重，可微分高斯-牛顿求解器计算位置和Hessian后验协方差，并使用 proper scoring rules（NLL和ES）端到端监督东-北预测分布。
Result: 在UrbanNav测试场景中，协方差可信度一致提升；在中度和严酷城市场景中定位精度提高；在深城市场景中平均水平误差和95百分位误差均改善。严酷城市MK场景下，CDFGO-Combined相比DFGO (MAE) 将平均水平误差从13.77m降至11.68m，NLL从40.63降至6.59，ES从12.31降至9.05。
Conclusion: CDFGO通过显式监督协方差可信度，不仅提升了协方差可靠性，还改善了定位精度，尤其在城市峡谷等困难场景中。

papers.title: Towards an Inferentialist Account of Information Through Proof-theoretic Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Information is one of the most widely-discussed concepts of the current era. However, a great deal of insightful work notwithstanding, it is yet to be given wholly convincing logical or mathematical foundations. Without them, we lack adequate reasoning tools for understanding the complex ecosystems of systems upon which the society depends. We seek to rectify this by taking a first step towards developing an inferentialist semantic theory of information. There are three key interacting components. First, conceptual analysis: the metaphysics of information. Dretske expressed the key concepts of information in terms of intentionality, truth, and transmissibility. We replace truth with inferability, and trace the consequences of this replacement. Second, logic: proof-theoretic semantics (P-tS) provides a mathematical-logical realization of inferentialist reasoning. Using P-tS, we develop the first steps towards a mathematical-logical theory of an inferentialist primitive unit of information, the 'inferon'. This proof-theoretic approach counterpoints the model-theoretic view of information articulated in situation theory. Furthermore, we argue that it facilitates addressing all three components of van Benthem and Martinez's categorization of the understandings of information, as range, as correlation, and as code. Our focus is on information-as-correlation. Third, systems: the P-tS tools we develop provide the basis for a mathematical account of distributed systems modelling -- a key tool from informatics for understanding the organization of information processing systems. This yields a reasoning-based theory of information flow in models of distributed systems. Overall, we seek to give a conceptually rigorous mathematical-logical account of information and its role within informatics, grounded in inference and reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于证明论语义学（proof-theoretic semantics）的推理主义信息理论，以'inferon'作为信息的基本原语，用可推导性替代经典德雷斯基（Dretske）信息论中的真实性条件。该框架通过概念分析、逻辑和系统三个组成部分，试图统一理解信息的三种范畴（范围、相关、代码），重点在于信息作为相关（information-as-correlation），并应用于分布式系统建模中的信息流分析。
Motivation: 当前信息概念缺乏令人满意的逻辑或数学基础，导致无法充分推理社会依赖的复杂系统生态中的信息流。
Method: 从概念分析出发，将信息的真实性条件替换为可推导性；利用证明论语义学定义推理主义信息原语'inferon'；并将该逻辑工具应用于分布式系统建模，形成基于推理的信息流理论。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的实验或量化结果，主要贡献是概念框架和逻辑基础的初步构建。
Conclusion: 本文旨在为信息及其在信息学中的作用提供一个概念严谨、基于推理的数理逻辑基础，认为证明论方法能自然处理信息的三种理解，且适用于分布式系统。

papers.title: Self-Attention as Transport: Limits of Symmetric Spectral Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: When a language model processes a hallucinated response, its attention routing tends to fail in one of two shapes: over-concentrating on a narrow set of positions, or spreading so diffusely that relevance is diluted, and the shape of the failure carries diagnostic signal. We study these shapes as a diagnostic characterization, computed from attention matrices under \emph{forced scoring} of benchmark-labeled responses rather than during live generation. A widely used family of spectral methods analyzes the symmetric component of the degree-normalized attention operator, which governs transport \emph{capacity}; we prove that every transpose-invariant spectral diagnostic of this operator is structurally \emph{orientation-blind} (it cannot distinguish an operator from its transpose, and therefore cannot detect information-flow direction), with a converse to the blindness theorem bounding any Lipschitz diagnostic's transpose sensitivity by the asymmetry coefficient $G$. Pairing this with a closed-form bipartite-Cheeger landscape for canonical causal architectures, we show that uniform causal attention satisfies an $n$-independent floor $φ\ge 1/5$, while window attention pierces the floor as $O(w/n)$; failure modes are shape-different, not just value-different. This floor is an idealized-architecture benchmark, not an empirical attractor: the fraction of real attention heads that pierce it is itself an architectural signature. The resulting two-axis diagnostic ($φ$ for capacity, $G$ for direction) yields a falsifiable polarity prediction: bottleneck- and diffuse-dominated benchmarks should exhibit opposite polarity. Under length-controlled evaluation, transport features retain interpretable signal (0.62-0.84 LC-AUROC) across the tested decoder-only, encoder-only, and encoder-decoder models, with polarity reversing as predicted between HaluEval and MedHallu.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables; 81-page online supplement (proofs, additional experiments, dataset statistics) as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在生成幻觉响应时注意力路由的两种失败模式——过度集中或过度分散，并提出一种基于传输理论的诊断方法。作者证明对称谱诊断对注意力算子的方向盲性（无法区分算子与其转置），并给出因果注意力架构的Cheeger下界（均匀注意力≥1/5，窗口注意力为O(w/n)）。基于容量（φ）和方向（G）的两轴诊断在长度受控评估下达到0.62-0.84 LC-AUROC，且极性在HaluEval与MedHallu上反转。
Motivation: 现有注意力诊断方法无法区分信息流的失败模式（集中或分散），且缺乏对方向敏感性的理论分析，限制了其作为幻觉检测工具的可解释性。
Method: 提出基于传输理论的谱诊断框架：利用对称化的度归一化注意力算子分析容量（Cheeger常数φ），并引入不对称系数G量化方向性。通过理论证明任何转置不变谱诊断都是方向盲的，并推导因果架构的Cheeger下界。
Result: 在长度受控评估下，传输特征在多个解码器、编码器及编码器-解码器模型上取得0.62-0.84 LC-AUROC；极性反转预测得到验证（HaluEval与MedHallu相反）。
Conclusion: 对称谱诊断因方向盲性有固有局限，但结合容量与方向的两轴方法可有效识别幻觉响应中的注意力失败形状，且适用于多种架构。

papers.title: Hybrid Iterative Neural Low-Regularity Integrator for Nonlinear Dispersive Equations
papers.abstract_en: We propose HIN-LRI, a hybrid framework that augments a classical numerical solver with a neural operator trained to correct the solver's structured truncation error. A base low-regularity integrator provides a consistent first-order approximation to nonlinear dispersive PDEs, while a lightweight neural network, operating on a low-dimensional latent manifold, learns the residual defect that analytical methods cannot close. An explicit time-step scaling on the neural correction ensures that its Lipschitz contribution remains $\mathcal{O}(τ)$, yielding a Gronwall stability factor bounded uniformly in the step size and independent of the spatial resolution. The network is trained end-to-end through a solver-in-the-loop objective that unrolls the full iteration and penalises trajectory error in a Bourgain-type norm, aligning learning with multi-step solver dynamics rather than isolated one-step targets. Under stated assumptions, the global error satisfies $C(\varepsilon_{net}+δ)\,τ^γ\ln(1/τ)$, where $\varepsilon_{net}$ measures the network approximation quality and $δ$ the training shortfall. Experiments on three dispersive benchmarks with rough data show that HIN-LRI improves accuracy over analytical integrators, splitting methods, and neural PDE surrogates, with stable spatial refinement, effective out-of-distribution transfer, and modest online overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIN-LRI，一种混合框架，将经典低正则性数值积分器与轻量神经网络结合，用于求解非线性色散偏微分方程。神经网络学习并修正积分器的截断误差，通过显式时间步缩放保证稳定性，在 Bourgain 范数下进行轨迹误差训练。在三个粗糙数据分散性基准上，HIN-LRI 相比分析积分器、分裂方法和神经 PDE 替代模型提高了精度，并展示了稳定的空间细化、有效的分布外迁移和适中的在线开销。
Motivation: 非线性色散方程的数值求解中，传统低正则性积分器存在截断误差，而纯神经网络代理在长期积分和稳定性方面有局限。需要一种方法结合两者优势，在保持理论收敛保证的同时提高精度。
Method: 以低正则性积分器为基座，附加一个在低维潜流形上操作的神经网络，学习并补偿积分器的截断误差。通过显式时间步缩放确保 Lipschitz 贡献为 O(τ)，从而获得与空间分辨率无关的 Gronwall 稳定因子。网络通过解算器在环（solver-in-the-loop）训练，在 Bourgain 范数下惩罚多步轨迹误差。
Result: 在三个粗糙数据分散性基准上，HIN-LRI 比分析积分器、分裂方法和神经 PDE 替代模型具有更高精度。全局误差满足 C(ε_net+δ)τ^γ ln(1/τ)，其中 ε_net 为网络近似质量，δ 为训练不足。方法展现了稳定的空间细化、有效的分布外迁移和适中的在线开销。

papers.title: Self-Prompting Small Language Models for Privacy-Sensitive Clinical Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Clinical named entity recognition from dental progress notes is challenging because documentation is highly unstructured, domain-specific, and often privacy-sensitive. We developed a locally deployable framework that enables small language models to self-generate, verify, refine, and evaluate entity-specific prompts for extracting multiple clinical entities from dental notes. Using 1,200 annotated notes, we evaluated candidate open-weight models with multi-prompt ensemble inference and further adapted selected models using QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Model performance varied substantially, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation rather than reliance on generic benchmarks. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct achieved the strongest baseline performance. After DPO, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct achieved micro/macro F1 scores of 0.864/0.837 and 0.806/0.797, respectively. These findings suggest that automated prompt optimization combined with lightweight preference-based post-training can support scalable clinical information extraction using locally deployed small language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种本地可部署的框架，利用小型语言模型自我生成、验证、精炼和评估实体特定的提示，用于从牙科病历中提取多种临床实体。在1200条标注笔记上评估了多个开源模型，使用多提示集成推理以及基于QLoRA的监督微调和直接偏好优化。Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct在DPO后达到微/宏F1分别为0.864/0.837。
Motivation: 牙科病历的非结构化、领域特定和隐私敏感性使得临床命名实体识别具有挑战性，现有通用基准无法准确评估任务性能。
Method: 开发了一个本地部署框架，让小型语言模型自动生成并优化实体特定提示，结合多提示集成推理，并采用QLoRA微调和直接偏好优化进行模型适应。
Result: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct获得最佳基准性能，DPO后微/宏F1达0.864/0.837；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct DPO后微/宏F1为0.806/0.797。
Conclusion: 自动提示优化与轻量级偏好后训练的结合可以使本地部署的小型语言模型支持可扩展的临床信息提取。

papers.title: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generative control policies (GCPs), such as diffusion- and flow-based control policies, have emerged as effective parameterizations for robot learning. This work introduces Off-policy Generative Policy Optimization (OGPO), a sample-efficient algorithm for finetuning GCPs that maintains off-policy critic networks to maximize data reuse and propagate policy gradients through the full generative process of the policy via a modified PPO objective, using critics as the terminal reward. OGPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on manipulation tasks spanning multi-task settings, high-precision insertion, and dexterous control. To our knowledge, it is also the only method that can fine-tune poorly-initialized behavior cloning policies to near full task-success with no expert data in the online replay buffer, and does so with few task-specific hyperparameter tuning. Through extensive empirical investigations, we demonstrate that OGPO drastically outperforms methods alternatives on policy steering and learning residual corrections, and identify the key mechanisms behind its performance. We further introduce practical stabilization tricks, including success-buffer regularization, two-sided conservative advantages, and Q-variance reduction, to mitigate critic over-exploitation across state- and pixel-based settings. Beyond proposing OGPO, we conduct a systematic empirical study of GCP finetuning, identifying the stabilizing mechanisms and failure modes that govern successful off-policy full-policy improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Off-policy Generative Policy Optimization (OGPO)，一种样本高效的生成式控制策略微调算法。OGPO 通过维护离线策略评论家网络、使用修改的 PPO 目标传播策略梯度，并在状态和像素设置中引入成功缓冲区正则化等稳定技巧，在多任务操作、高精度插入和灵巧控制任务上达到当前最优性能。实验表明，OGPO 是唯一能从不良初始行为克隆策略微调至接近完全任务成功且无需专家数据的方法。
Motivation: 生成式控制策略在机器人学习中表现优异，但现有微调方法样本效率低，且难以从不良初始策略出发实现成功微调。OGPO 旨在解决样本效率问题并提升微调效果。
Method: OGPO 是一种离线策略算法，利用评论家网络作为终端奖励，通过修改的 PPO 目标将策略梯度传播到完整生成过程，同时采用成功缓冲区正则化、双边保守优势、 Q 方差降低等技巧防止评论家过度利用。
Result: 在多任务操作、高精度插入和灵巧控制任务上达到 SOTA；能从不良初始行为克隆策略微调至接近完全任务成功，无需专家数据；超参数调优需求低，性能显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: OGPO 是首个能有效微调不良初始化生成式控制策略的离线策略方法，其稳定机制（如成功缓冲区正则化）对防止评论家过利用至关重要。

papers.title: Beyond Continuity: Simulation-free Reconstruction of Discrete Branching Dynamics from Single-cell Snapshots
papers.abstract_en: Inferring cellular trajectories from destructive snapshots is complicated by the challenges of stochasticity and non-conservative mass dynamics such as cell proliferation and apoptosis. Existing unbalanced Optimal Transport (OT) methods treat mass as a continuous fluid, performing inference at the population level. However, this macroscopic view often fails to capture the discrete, jump-like nature of birth-death events at single-cell resolution, which is essential for understanding lineage branching and fate decisions. We present Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridge (USB), a simulation-free framework for learning underlying dynamics that effectively integrates both stochastic and unbalanced effects which also models the discrete, jump-like birth-death dynamics at single-cell resolution. Theoretically, USB provides a tractable solution to the Branching Schrödinger Bridge (BSB) problem, offering a rigorous microscopic interpretation where individual cells undergo both Brownian motion and discrete birth-death jumps. Technically, the method implements an efficient solver by introducing a simulation-free training objective that effectively scales to high-dimensional omics data. Empirically, we demonstrate on both simulated and real-world datasets that USB not only achieves trajectory reconstruction performance better than or comparable to deterministic baselines but also uniquely enables realistic discrete simulation of birth-death dynamics at single-cell resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridge (USB)框架，用于从单细胞快照数据中重建考虑离散生灭过程的细胞轨迹。USB将细胞运动建模为布朗运动与离散生灭跳变的结合，提供了一种无模拟的训练目标，适用于高维组学数据。实验表明USB在轨迹重建性能上达到或超过确定性基线方法，并能实现单细胞分辨率的离散生灭动态模拟。
Motivation: 现有不平衡最优传输方法将细胞群体视为连续流体，无法捕捉单细胞分辨率的离散生灭事件（如增殖和凋亡），这限制了谱系分化和命运决策的理解。
Method: 提出USB框架，通过求解Branching Schrödinger Bridge问题，将细胞运动分解为布朗运动和离散生灭跳变，并引入无模拟的训练目标实现高效求解。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，USB的轨迹重建性能优于或可比于确定性基线方法，且能唯一实现单细胞分辨率的离散生灭动态模拟。
Conclusion: USB提供了一种可解的微观解释和可扩展的计算方法，适用于高维单细胞组学数据的轨迹推断。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Bayesian online learning in the one-pass regime: Frequentist validity and uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian online learning provides a coherent framework for sequential inference. However, its theoretical understanding remains limited, particularly in the one-pass setting. Existing theoretical guarantees typically require the mini-batch sample size to diverge, a condition that fails in the one-pass regime. In this paper, we propose a new Bayesian online learning algorithm tailored to the one-pass setting, which incorporates a warm-start phase to ensure stable sequential updates. For this algorithm, we show that the sequentially updated posterior attains the optimal convergence rate. Building on this, we establish an online analogue of the Bernstein-von Mises theorem, which guarantees valid uncertainty quantification without diverging mini-batch sample sizes. Our analysis is based on a novel theoretical framework that differs fundamentally from existing approaches in the online learning literature. Numerical experiments on generalized linear models show that the proposed method matches the performance of the batch estimator while outperforming existing online procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线学习中的单遍设置提出了一种新的贝叶斯在线学习算法，该算法包含预热启动阶段以确保顺序更新的稳定性。作者证明序贯更新的后验达到最优收敛速率，并建立了在线版本的伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯定理，保证在不需要小批量样本容量发散的条件下实现有效的不确定性量化。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯在线学习的理论保证通常要求小批量样本容量发散，这在单遍设置中不成立，因此缺乏适用于单遍场景的理论基础。
Method: 提出一种包含预热启动阶段的贝叶斯在线学习算法，通过一个新颖的理论框架建立收敛性和不确定性量化保证。
Result: 序贯后验达到最优收敛速率，在线伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯定理成立；在广义线性模型上的数值实验表明，该方法匹配批处理估计器的性能，优于现有在线方法。
Conclusion: 该算法在单遍设置下提供了频率学派有效性和不确定性量化保证，填补了贝叶斯在线学习的理论空白。

papers.title: Internet of Everything in the 6G Era: Paradigms, Enablers, Potentials and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: The Internet of Everything (IoE) represents an evolution of the Internet of Things (IoT) by integrating people, data, processes, and things into a unified intelligent ecosystem. IoE aims to enhance automation, decision-making, and service efficiency across multiple application domains such as smart cities, healthcare, industry, and next-generation wireless networks. This paper provides a structured overview of the IoE concept, its core components, architectural foundations, enabling technologies, and major research challenges. Finally, open research directions toward 6G-enabled intelligent IoE systems are discussed, with emphasis on scalability, security, privacy, and energy efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了万物互联（IoE）在6G时代的发展，包括其核心组件、架构、使能技术和主要研究挑战。摘要指出IoE通过集成人、数据、流程和事物来增强自动化、决策和服务效率，并讨论了面向6G智能IoE系统的可扩展性、安全性、隐私和能效等开放研究方向。
Motivation: IoE作为IoT的演进，需要整合人、数据、流程和事物，实现统一智能生态系统；本文旨在提供系统性概述，并指出6G时代的关键研究挑战。
Method: 采用结构化综述方法，梳理IoE的概念、核心组件、架构基础、使能技术和主要研究挑战。
Result: 本文总结了IoE的核心组件、使能技术，并指出了面向6G智能IoE系统的开放研究方向，包括可扩展性、安全性、隐私和能效。
Conclusion: 论文强调未来6G智能IoE系统需要在可扩展性、安全性、隐私和能效方面进行进一步研究。

papers.title: Information bottleneck for learning the phase space of dynamics from high-dimensional experimental data
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the dynamical state variables of a system from high-dimensional observations is a central problem across physical sciences. The challenge is that the state variables are not directly observable and must be inferred from raw high-dimensional data without supervision. Here we introduce DySIB (Dynamical Symmetric Information Bottleneck) as a method to learn low-dimensional representations of time-series data by maximizing predictive mutual information between past and future observation windows while penalizing representation complexity. This objective operates entirely in latent space and avoids reconstruction of the observations. We apply DySIB to an experimental video dataset of a physical pendulum, where the underlying state space is known. The method, with hyperparameters of the learning architecture set self-consistently by the data, recovers a two-dimensional representation that matches the dimensionality, topology, and geometry of the pendulum phase space, with the learned coordinates aligning smoothly with the canonical angle and angular velocity. These results demonstrate, on a well-characterized experimental system, that predictive information in latent space can be used to recover interpretable dynamical coordinates directly from high-dimensional data.

papers.title: TopoHR: Hierarchical Centerline Representation for Cyclic Topology Reasoning in Driving Scenes with Point-to-Instance Relations
papers.abstract_en: Topology reasoning is crucial for autonomous driving. Current methods primarily focus on instance-level learning for centerline detection, followed by a sequential module for topology reasoning that relies on simplified MLP layers. Moreover, they often neglect the importance of \textit{point-to-instance} (P2I) relationships in topology reasoning. To address these limitations, we present TopoHR (Topological Hierarchical Representation), a novel end-to-end framework that establishes cyclic interaction between centerline detection and topology reasoning, allowing them to iteratively enhance each other. Specifically, we introduce a hierarchical centerline representation including point queries, instance queries, and semantic representations. These multi-level features are seamlessly integrated and fused within a hierarchical centerline decoder. Furthermore, we design a hierarchical topology reasoning module that captures both fine-grained P2I relationships and global instance-to-instance (I2I) connections within a unified architecture. With these novel components, TopoHR ensures accurate and robust topology reasoning. On the OpenLane-V2 benchmark, TopoHR refreshes state-of-the-art performance with significant improvements. Notably, compared with previous best results, TopoHR achieves +3.8 in $\mathrm{DET}_{\text{l}}$, +5.4 in $\mathrm{TOP}_{\text{ll}}$ on $\text{subset_A}$ and +11.0 in $\mathrm{DET}_{\text{l}}$, +7.9 in $\mathrm{TOP}_{\text{ll}}$ on $\text{subset_B}$, validating the effectiveness of the proposed components. The code will be shared publicly at https://github.com/Yifeng-Bai/TopoHR.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TopoHR，一种端到端框架，用于驾驶场景中的循环拓扑推理。通过引入层次化的中心线表示（点查询、实例查询、语义表示）和层次化拓扑推理模块（捕获细粒度点对实例关系P2I和全局实例对实例关系I2I），实现中心线检测与拓扑推理的迭代增强。在OpenLane-V2基准上，该方法在subset_A和subset_B上分别将DET_l和TOP_ll指标提升+3.8/+5.4和+11.0/+7.9，刷新了最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常先独立进行实例级中心线检测，再通过简化MLP层进行拓扑推理，忽略了点对实例（P2I）关系的重要性，且检测与推理缺乏交互。
Method: 提出层次化中心线表示（点、实例、语义层级）和层次化拓扑推理模块，在统一解码器内融合多级特征，并设计P2I和I2I关系的联合捕获机制，实现中心线检测与拓扑推理的循环迭代增强。
Result: 在OpenLane-V2 subset_A上，DET_l提升3.8，TOP_ll提升5.4；在subset_B上，DET_l提升11.0，TOP_ll提升7.9，均优于先前最佳结果。
Conclusion: TopoHR通过层次化表示和循环交互机制，有效提升了驾驶场景中拓扑推理的准确性和鲁棒性，代码将开源。

papers.title: Deep Learning of Solver-Aware Turbulence Closures from Nudged LES Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: The differentiable physics paradigm may be leveraged as an a-posteriori approach for discovering turbulence closure models by embedding a neural network parameterization directly inside the solver and optimizing it given potentially sparse target data. This addresses a key limitation of a-priori learning where direct numerical simulation (DNS) data is used to approximate the subgrid stress with the assumption of a low-pass filter. Closures trained in this a-priori manner frequently lead to unstable deployments due to the mismatch between the assumed filter and the effect of numerical discretizations and coarse-graining. In comparison, while typically stable during deployment, a-posteriori learning incurs high computational costs due to the need to backpropagate through a large eddy simulation (LES) solver. Furthermore, a-posteriori methods are challenging to apply broadly since they require significant modification of existing solvers. Finally, both approaches are limited when generalization is desired across different numerical schemes with their implicit filtering characteristics. In this work, we present a deep-learning approach for turbulence closure modeling built on the continuous data assimilation framework. Our approach enables the a-priori training of closures using sparsely observed DNS data without modifying or differentiating through the LES solver, while preserving stability during deployment for the recovery of invariant statistics. We focus on the model's ability to adapt to different discretizations by explicitly conditioning it on the numerical scheme. We use two- and three-dimensional canonical cases to test our framework and show that the learned correction systematically tracks the discretization error of the coarse solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于连续数据同化框架的深度学习湍流封闭建模方法，在无需修改或微分粗网格求解器（LES）的情况下，利用稀疏观测的DNS数据以先验方式训练封闭模型，并在部署时保持稳定性。该方法通过显式条件化数值格式，适应不同离散化方案，在二维和三维规范案例中系统性地追踪粗求解器的离散误差。
Motivation: 传统先验学习因假设低通滤波器与数值离散不匹配导致部署不稳定；后验学习成本高且需大量修改求解器；两者在泛化至不同数值格式时受限。
Method: 将连续数据同化框架引入深度学习封闭建模，通过观测数据引导粗网格解逼近真实解，实现先验训练而不依赖求解器微分，并对数值格式进行显式条件化。
Result: 在二维和三维规范案例中，学习的修正项能系统性地追踪粗求解器的离散误差，并恢复不变统计量。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持部署稳定性的同时，降低了计算成本，并提高了对不同数值离散化方案的适应性。

papers.title: Bimanual Robot Manipulation via Multi-Agent In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful reasoning engines for embodied control. In particular, In-Context Learning (ICL) enables off-the-shelf, text-only LLMs to predict robot actions without any task-specific training while preserving their generalization capabilities. Applying ICL to bimanual manipulation remains challenging as the high-dimensional joint action space and tight inter-arm coordination constraints rapidly overwhelm standard context windows. To address this, we introduce BiCICLe (Bimanual Coordinated In-Context Learning), the first framework that enables standard LLMs to perform few-shot bimanual manipulation without fine-tuning. BiCICLe frames bimanual control as a multi-agent leader-follower problem, decoupling the action space into sequential, conditioned single-arm predictions. Evaluated on 13 tasks from the TWIN benchmark, BiCICLe achieves 70.5% average success rate, outperforming the best training-free baseline by 6.1 percentage points and surpassing most supervised methods. We also demonstrate superior real-world performance on 3 tasks without hardware-specific retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BiCICLe 框架，首个无需微调即可利用标准语言模型进行双臂机器人操作的方法。通过将双臂控制建模为多智能体领导者-跟随者问题，分解动作空间为顺序的条件化单臂预测，在 TWIN 基准的 13 个任务上达到 70.5% 的平均成功率，超过现有无训练基线 6.1 个百分点，并优于大多数监督方法。真实世界三个任务也展示了优异性能。
Motivation: 现有上下文学习（ICL）应用于双臂操作时，高维联合动作空间和紧密的臂间协调约束容易超出标准上下文窗口，导致直接应用困难。
Method: 将双臂控制建模为多智能体领导者-跟随者问题，通过顺序条件化单臂预测分解动作空间，利用预训练语言模型进行上下文学习，无需任务特定微调。
Result: 在 TWIN 基准 13 个任务上平均成功率 70.5%，比最佳无训练基线高 6.1 个百分点，超越大多数监督方法；真实世界 3 个任务无需硬件重新训练即表现良好。
Conclusion: BiCICLe 证明了无需微调的轻量级双臂操作可行性，但可能受限于语言模型的上下文窗口长度和任务复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClawEnvKit: Automatic Environment Generation for Claw-Like Agents
papers.abstract_en: Constructing environments for training and evaluating claw-like agents remains a manual, human-intensive process that does not scale. We argue that what is needed is not just a dataset, but an automated pipeline capable of generating diverse, verified environments on demand. To this end, we introduce ClawEnvKit, an autonomous generation pipeline that instantiates this formalism from natural language descriptions. The pipeline comprises three modules: (1) a parser that extracts structured generation parameters from natural language input; (2) a generator that produces the task specification, tool interface, and scoring configuration; and (3) a validator that enforces feasibility, diversity, structural validity, and internal consistency across the generated environments. Using ClawEnvKit, we construct Auto-ClawEval, the first large-scale benchmark for claw-like agents, comprising 1,040 environments across 24 categories. Empirically, Auto-ClawEval matches or exceeds human-curated environments on coherence and clarity at 13,800x lower cost. Evaluated across 4 model families and 8 agent harness frameworks, we find that harness engineering boosts performance by up to 15.7 percentage points over a bare ReAct baseline, completion remains the primary axis of variation with no model saturating the benchmark, and automated generation enables evaluation at a scale previously infeasible. Beyond static benchmarking, ClawEnvKit enables live evaluation: users describe a desired capability in natural language and obtain a verified environment on demand, turning evaluation into a continuous, user-driven process. The same mechanism serves as an on-demand training environment generator, producing task distributions that adapt to an agent's current weaknesses rather than being bounded by existing user logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ClawEnvKit，一个从自然语言描述自动生成类爪状智能体环境的管道，包含解析、生成和验证三个模块。基于该管道构建了包含1040个环境的Auto-ClawEval基准，其质量媲美人工环境但成本降低13800倍。实验发现框架工程可提升性能高达15.7个百分点，且现有模型均未饱和该基准。
Motivation: 为类爪状智能体手动构建训练和评估环境耗时费力且难以规模化，需要一种能按需生成多样化、可验证环境的自动化管道。
Method: ClawEnvKit包含三个模块：从自然语言提取结构化参数的解析器、生成任务规范/工具接口/评分配置的生成器、以及确保可行性、多样性、结构有效性和内部一致性的验证器。
Result: Auto-ClawEval基准在连贯性和清晰度上匹配或超越人工环境，成本降低13800倍。4个模型家族和8个智能体框架的评估显示，框架工程相比裸ReAct基线提升高达15.7个百分点，完成率是主要差异轴，且无模型饱和基准。
Conclusion: ClawEnvKit支持静态基准测试和按需环境生成，将评估转变为持续、用户驱动的过程，并可作为适应性训练环境生成器。

papers.title: Right Regions, Wrong Labels: Semantic Label Flips in Segmentation under Correlation Shift
papers.abstract_en: The robustness of machine learning models can be compromised by spurious correlations between non-causal features in the input data and target labels. A common way to test for such correlations is to train on data where the label is strongly tied to some non-causal cue, then evaluate on examples where that tie no longer holds. This idea is well established for classification tasks, but for semantic segmentation the specific failure modes are not well understood. We show that a model may achieve reasonable overlap while assigning the wrong semantic label, swapping one plausible foreground class for another, even when object boundaries are largely correct. We focus on this semantic label-flip behaviour and quantify it with a simple diagnostic (Flip) that counts how often ground truth foreground pixels are assigned the wrong foreground identity while remaining predicted as foreground. In a setting where category and scene are correlated during training, increasing the correlation consistently widens the gap between common and rare test conditions and increases these within-object label swaps on counterfactual groups. Overall, our results motivate assessing segmentation robustness under distribution shift beyond overlap by decomposing foreground errors into correct pixels, flipped-identity pixels, and missed-to-background pixels. We also propose an entropy-based, ground truth label-free `flip-risk' score, which is computed from foreground identity uncertainty, and show that it can flag flip-prone cases at inference time. Code is available at https://github.com/acharaakshit/label-flips.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语义分割模型在相关性偏移下的标签翻转问题，即模型正确分割前景区域但赋予错误的语义类别。作者提出一个简单的诊断指标Flip来量化这种行为，并基于主训练集类别-场景相关性增强时，模型在反事实测试组上标签翻转增加。还提出一个无监督的翻转风险分数，可在推理时识别易翻转的像素。
Motivation: 语义分割中相关性偏移导致的失败模式尚不明确，现有鲁棒性评估多关注分类任务，缺乏对分割中语义标签翻转的量化分析。
Method: 提出Flip指标：统计真实前景像素被预测为其他前景类别的比例。进一步将前景错误分解为正确、翻转和漏掉三类，并设计基于预测熵的无需真实标签的翻转风险分数。
Result: 实验发现，训练时场景与类别相关性增强会扩大常见与罕见测试组之间的性能差距，并显著增加标签翻转。翻转分数可有效标记高风险的预测像素。
Conclusion: 评估分割模型鲁棒性时应超越传统重叠度量，关注标签翻转行为。提出的翻转指标和风险分数有助于发现和缓解此类错误。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究语义分割模型在相关性偏移下的标签翻转问题，即模型正确分割前景区域但赋予错误的语义类别。作者提出一个简单的诊断指标Flip来量化这种行为，并基于主训练集类别-场景相关性增强时，模型在反事实测试组上标签翻转增加。还提出一个无监督的翻转风险分数，可在推理时识别易翻转的像素。
summary_sections.motivation: 语义分割中相关性偏移导致的失败模式尚不明确，现有鲁棒性评估多关注分类任务，缺乏对分割中语义标签翻转的量化分析。
summary_sections.method: 提出Flip指标：统计真实前景像素被预测为其他前景类别的比例。进一步将前景错误分解为正确、翻转和漏掉三类，并设计基于预测熵的无需真实标签的翻转风险分数。
summary_sections.result: 实验发现，训练时场景与类别相关性增强会扩大常见与罕见测试组之间的性能差距，并显著增加标签翻转。翻转分数可有效标记高风险的预测像素。
summary_sections.conclusion: 评估分割模型鲁棒性时应超越传统重叠度量，关注标签翻转行为。提出的翻转指标和风险分数有助于发现和缓解此类错误。

papers.title: MedVeriSeg: Teaching LISA-Like Medical Segmentation Models to Verify Query Validity Without Extra Training
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in text-prompt-based medical image segmentation, existing LISA-like MLLM-based methods typically generate masks regardless of whether the target specified in the query is present, leading to hallucinated segmentation. In this work, we propose MedVeriSeg, a training-free query verification framework that enables LISA-like medical segmentation models to reject false segmentation queries. MedVeriSeg first quantifies the response quality between the [SEG] token and image features through a Similarity Response Quality Scoring Module. To further improve robustness, it employs a Lightweight Routed Multi-Agent Verification Module, which fuses quantitative score evidence with qualitative agent evidence to comprehensively verify the validity of the query. To support systematic evaluation, we construct MedVeriSeg-Bench, a benchmark designed for query verification in medical image segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that MedVeriSeg effectively identifies false segmentation queries and reduces hallucinated segmentation, while maintaining a high acceptance rate for valid queries, thereby largely preserving the segmentation utility of LISA-like medical segmentation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedVeriSeg，一个无需额外训练的查询验证框架，用于 LISA-like 医学图像分割模型。它通过相似性响应质量评分模块和多智能体验证模块，识别虚假查询并减少幻觉分割。在 MedVeriSeg-Bench 上，该方法有效拒绝无效查询，同时保持对有效查询的高接受率。
Motivation: 现有的 LISA-like MLLM 模型在查询目标不存在时仍生成掩膜，导致幻觉分割，缺乏查询验证能力。
Method: 提出训练免费的框架，包含两个模块：相似性响应质量评分模块（量化 [SEG] token 与图像特征的响应质量）和轻量级路由多智能体验证模块（融合定量评分与定性证据）。
Result: 在 MedVeriSeg-Bench 上，该方法能有效识别虚假分割查询，降低幻觉分割，同时保持对有效查询的高接受率，从而保留原模型的分割能力。
Conclusion: MedVeriSeg 可提升 LISA-like 医学分割模型的可靠性，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: Auditing Demographic Bias in Facial Landmark Detection for Fair Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Fairness in human-robot interaction critically depends on the reliability of the perceptual models that enable robots to interpret human behavior. While demographic biases have been widely studied in high-level facial analysis tasks, their presence in facial landmark detection remains unexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic audit of demographic bias in this task, analyzing the age, gender, and race biases. To this end, we introduce a controlled statistical methodology to disentangle demographic effects from confounding visual factors. Our analysis demonstrates that visual confounders, particularly head pose and face resolution, heavily outweigh the impact of demographic attributes. Notably, after accounting for these confounders, performance disparities across gender and race vanish. However, we identify a statistically significant age-related bias, with higher localization errors for older individuals. This shows that fairness issues can emerge even in low-level vision components and can propagate through the HRI pipeline. We argue that auditing and correcting such biases is a necessary step toward trustworthy and equitable robot perception systems.
papers.journal_ref: 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统审计了面部关键点检测中的年龄、性别和种族偏差，提出一种控制统计方法来分离人口统计学效应与视觉混杂因素。结果表明，头部姿态和面部分辨率等视觉混杂因素影响远大于人口统计属性，校正后性别和种族的性能差异消失，但存在显著的年龄偏差，老年人定位误差更高。
Motivation: 公平的人机交互依赖于感知模型的可靠性，但面部关键点检测中的人口统计偏差尚未被探索，此类偏差可能传播至整个交互管道。
Method: 引入一种受控的统计方法，通过分离头部姿态、面部分辨率等视觉混杂因素，系统审计年龄、性别和种族对关键点定位误差的影响。
Result: 视觉混杂因素（尤其是头部姿态和分辨率）对性能的影响远超人口统计属性；校正后性别和种族的性能差异消失，但年龄偏差显著，老年人误差更高。
Conclusion: 低层视觉组件（如关键点检测）中存在公平性问题，需审计和修正以确保机器人感知系统的可信与公平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProGRank: Probe-Gradient Reranking to Defend Dense-Retriever RAG from Corpus Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves large language model applications by grounding generation in retrieved evidence, but also introduces corpus poisoning as a new attack surface. In this setting, an adversary injects or edits passages so that they enter the Top-$K$ results for target queries and influence downstream generation. Existing defences often rely on content filtering, auxiliary models, or generator-side reasoning, which complicates deployment. We propose ProGRank, a post hoc, training-free retriever-side defence for dense-retriever RAG. ProGRank stress-tests each query--passage pair under mild randomized perturbations, extracts probe gradients from a small fixed parameter subset, and derives two instability signals: representational consistency and dispersion risk. It then combines these signals with a score gate for reranking. ProGRank preserves the original passage content, requires no retraining, and supports a surrogate-based variant when the deployed retriever is unavailable. Experiments across datasets, retrievers, attacks, and retrieval-stage and end-to-end settings show that ProGRank improves robustness and maintains a favorable robustness--utility trade-off, including under adaptive evasive attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProGRank，一种面向密集检索器 RAG 的即插即用、无需训练的检索端防御方法，通过探针梯度提取表示一致性与离散风险信号，对查询-段落对进行重新排序，以抵御语料投毒攻击。实验表明该方法能在保持良好鲁棒性-效用权衡的同时提升防御效果。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统易受语料投毒攻击，而现有防御方法多依赖内容过滤、辅助模型或生成端推理，部署复杂且通用性不足。
Method: ProGRank 对每个查询-段落对施加轻微随机扰动，从固定小参数子集中提取探针梯度，计算表示一致性和离散风险两个不稳定信号，并结合得分门控进行重新排序。支持在检索器不可用时使用基于代理的变体。
Result: 在多个数据集、检索器、攻击类型以及检索阶段和端到端设置下，ProGRank 提升了鲁棒性，并保持了有利的鲁棒性-效用权衡，包括应对自适应规避攻击。
Conclusion: ProGRank 是一种有效、轻量且易于部署的检索端防御方案，不需要修改模型或重新训练，为 RAG 安全提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Instrument for Measuring Regional Human Mobility: The Distributed Human Data Engine (DHDE)
papers.abstract_en: Accurately estimating human mobility in peripheral regional economies presents a fundamental measurement challenge: physical ground-truth sensors are sparse, behavioral intent signals are heterogeneous, and environmental friction introduces systematic bias into demand inference. We introduce the Distributed Human Data Engine (DHDE), a multi-modal sensor fusion architecture that addresses this challenge by integrating physical instrumentation (Edge-AI cameras), digital intent signals (route search impression metrics), behavioral records (90,350 spending records, 97,719 standardized survey responses), and meteorological data across four geographically distributed nodes in Fukui, Japan. The primary measurement-science contribution is the design, deployment, and cross-node validation of the DHDE as a sparse-sensor compensation instrument: a heterogeneous sensor fusion architecture that anchors non-stationary digital intent signals to concurrent physical ground-truth counts, correcting for systematic bias introduced by meteorological planning friction. The instrument is implemented as an ensemble inference pipeline (Random Forest and Ordinary Least Squares with Newey-West robust inference), calibrated across 397 daily observations and validated by chronological holdout replication across four geographically distinct node types. The primary OLS specification achieved an in-sample explanatory power of R2 = 0.810 and a chronological out-of-sample predictive performance of R2 = 0.683. Results identify an Under-Vibrancy Paradox where macro-regional visitor satisfaction correlates positively with crowd density (Spearman rank correlation rs = +0.150, p = 0.002). We estimate an annual proxy gap of 865,917 intent-implied visits, corresponding to JPY 11.96 billion (USD 72.6 million) in foregone revenue.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Pre-print of a manuscript submitted for peer review (v2)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分布式人类数据引擎 (DHDE)，一种多模态传感器融合架构，整合物理传感器、数字意图信号、行为记录和气象数据，用于测量日本福井地区的人类流动性。通过随机森林和最小二乘回归在397天观测上校准，主OLS模型样本内R²=0.810，时间外R²=0.683。发现“欠繁荣悖论”：区域游客满意度与人群密度正相关。估计年度代理缺口为865,917次意图隐含访问，对应119.6亿日元收入损失。
Motivation: 偏远地区人类流动性测量面临物理传感器稀疏、行为信号异质、环境摩擦引入系统偏差的挑战，需要一种稀疏传感器补偿方法。
Method: 提出DHDE架构，集成边缘AI摄像头、路线搜索印象指标、90,350条消费记录、97,719份标准化调查和气象数据，采用随机森林和带Newey-West稳健推断的OLS进行集成推理，在4个地理节点上交叉验证。
Result: 主OLS模型样本内R²=0.810，时间外R²=0.683；发现欠繁荣悖论（rs=+0.150, p=0.002）；估计年度代理缺口865,917次访问，对应119.6亿日元。
Conclusion: DHDE作为稀疏传感器补偿工具有效锚定非平稳数字信号，但论文未讨论降水预报或同化技术，主要贡献在人类流动性测量。

papers.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that LLMs can sometimes detect when steering vectors are injected into their residual stream and identify the injected concept -- a phenomenon termed "introspective awareness." We investigate the mechanisms underlying this capability in open-weights models. First, we find that it is behaviorally robust: models detect injected steering vectors at moderate rates with 0% false positives across diverse prompts and dialogue formats. Notably, this capability emerges specifically from post-training; we show that preference optimization algorithms like DPO can elicit it, but standard supervised finetuning does not. We provide evidence that detection cannot be explained by simple linear association between certain steering vectors and directions promoting affirmative responses. We trace the detection mechanism to a two-stage circuit in which "evidence carrier" features in early post-injection layers detect perturbations monotonically along diverse directions, suppressing downstream "gate" features that implement a default negative response. This circuit is absent in base models and robust to refusal ablation. Identification of injected concepts relies on largely distinct later-layer mechanisms that only weakly overlap with those involved in detection. Finally, we show that introspective capability is substantially underelicited: ablating refusal directions improves detection by +53%, and a trained bias vector improves it by +75% on held-out concepts, both without meaningfully increasing false positives. Our results suggest that this introspective awareness of injected concepts is robust and mechanistically nontrivial, and could be substantially amplified in future models. Code: https://github.com/safety-research/introspection-mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）对内省意识（introspective awareness）的机制，即模型检测并识别残差流中注入的转向向量（steering vectors）的能力。实验发现该能力在行为上鲁棒，且仅出现在后训练阶段（如DPO）而非标准监督微调。机制上，检测由两阶段电路实现：早期“证据载体”（evidence carrier）特征检测扰动，抑制下游“门控”（gate）特征从而改变默认负响应。内省能力未充分激发：移除拒绝方向提升检测53%，训练偏置向量提升75%，且不增加误报。
Motivation: 现有工作已发现LLM能检测注入的转向向量（称为内省意识），但其底层机制尚不明确。理解这一机制对模型安全与可控性具有重要意义。
Method: 通过行为实验（零误报率检测、多样化prompt）和机制分析（电路追踪、消融实验）研究内省意识。使用DPO等偏好优化算法诱导该能力，并对比标准监督微调。通过干预证据载体和门控特征来验证两阶段电路假说。
Result: 模型检测注入转向向量的中等成功率，零误报；偏好优化（DPO）可诱发该能力，监督微调不能；检测机制为两阶段电路；移除拒绝方向使检测提升53%，训练偏置向量提升75%，且误报率未显著增加。
Conclusion: 内省意识是一种鲁棒且机制复杂的现象，在后训练中涌现；当前模型中该能力被严重低估，未来可通过针对性干预大幅增强。局限性：仅针对开放权重模型，概念识别机制与检测机制部分分离。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 内省意识是一种鲁棒且机制复杂的现象，在后训练中涌现；当前模型中该能力被严重低估，未来可通过针对性干预大幅增强。局限性：仅针对开放权重模型，概念识别机制与检测机制部分分离。

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Hypergradient Estimation for Decentralized Bi-Level Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many strategic decision-making problems, such as environment design for warehouse robots, can be naturally formulated as bi-level reinforcement learning (RL), where a leader agent optimizes its objective while a follower solves a Markov decision process (MDP) conditioned on the leader's decisions. In many situations, a fundamental challenge arises when the leader cannot intervene in the follower's optimization process; it can only observe the optimization outcome. We address this decentralized setting by deriving the hypergradient of the leader's objective, i.e., the gradient of the leader's strategy that accounts for changes in the follower's optimal policy. Unlike prior hypergradient-based methods that require extensive data for repeated state visits or rely on gradient estimators whose complexity can increase substantially with the high-dimensional leader's decision space, we leverage the Boltzmann covariance trick to derive an alternative hypergradient formulation. This enables efficient hypergradient estimation solely from interaction samples, even when the leader's decision space is high-dimensional. Additionally, to our knowledge, this is the first method that enables hypergradient-based optimization for 2-player Markov games in decentralized settings. Experiments highlight the impact of hypergradient updates and demonstrate our method's effectiveness in both discrete and continuous state tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对去中心化双层强化学习中的超梯度估计问题，提出利用Boltzmann协方差技巧推导替代的超梯度公式，使得仅从交互样本中即可高效估计超梯度，无需大量数据或高维决策空间下的复杂梯度估计器。实验表明该方法在离散和连续状态任务上有效。

papers.title: A theory of learning data statistics in diffusion models, from easy to hard
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion models have emerged as a powerful class of generative models, their learning dynamics remain poorly understood. We address this issue first by empirically showing that standard diffusion models trained on natural images exhibit a distributional simplicity bias, learning simple, pair-wise input statistics before specializing to higher-order correlations. We reproduce this behaviour in simple denoisers trained on a minimal data model, the mixed cumulant model, where we precisely control both pair-wise and higher-order correlations of the inputs. We identify a scalar invariant of the model that governs the sample complexity of learning pair-wise and higher-order correlations that we call the diffusion information exponent, in analogy to related invariants in different learning paradigms. Using this invariant, we prove that the denoiser learns simple, pair-wise statistics of the inputs at linear sample complexity, while more complex higher-order statistics, such as the fourth cumulant, require at least cubic sample complexity. We also prove that the sample complexity of learning the fourth cumulant is linear if pair-wise and higher-order statistics share a correlated latent structure. Our work describes a key mechanism for how diffusion models can learn distributions of increasing complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验和理论分析，揭示了标准扩散模型在自然图像上存在分布简单性偏差，即先学习简单的成对输入统计量，再学习高阶相关性。在混合累积模型（mixed cumulant model）中复现了该行为，并定义了扩散信息指数（diffusion information exponent），该标量不变量决定了学习不同阶统计量的样本复杂度。理论证明，去噪器学习成对统计量只需线性样本复杂度，而学习四阶累积量至少需要三次方复杂度；若成对与高阶统计量共享相关潜在结构，则四阶累积量的样本复杂度可降至线性。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为强大的生成模型，其学习动态仍缺乏深入理解，尤其是模型如何从简单到复杂地学习数据分布。
Method: 通过经验观察标准扩散模型在自然图像上的学习行为，并在受控的混合累积模型上训练简单去噪器，精确控制数据的成对与高阶相关性。识别扩散信息指数作为控制样本复杂度的关键不变量，并基于此进行理论证明。
Result: 证明成对统计量的样本复杂度为线性，而高阶累积量（如四阶）至少需要三次方样本；若存在相关潜在结构，则高阶累积量的样本复杂度可变为线性。
Conclusion: 该工作描述了扩散模型如何从学习简单统计量逐步到复杂统计量的关键机制，为理解其学习分布的内在过程提供了理论基础。

papers.title: The Latent Color Subspace: Emergent Order in High-Dimensional Chaos
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation models have advanced rapidly, yet achieving fine-grained control over generated images remains difficult, largely due to limited understanding of how semantic information is encoded. We develop an interpretation of the color representation in the Variational Autoencoder latent space of FLUX.1 [Dev], revealing a structure reflecting Hue, Saturation, and Lightness. We verify our Latent Color Subspace (LCS) interpretation by demonstrating that it can both predict and explicitly control color, introducing a fully training-free method in FLUX based solely on closed-form latent-space manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/LCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了 FLUX.1 [Dev] 的 VAE 潜空间中颜色表示的结构，发现其对应于色相、饱和度和明度。作者通过仅使用闭式潜空间操作实现无需训练的颜色预测与控制，验证了 Latent Color Subspace (LCS) 解释的有效性。
Motivation: 文本到图像生成模型虽进展迅速，但对语义信息编码的理解有限，导致细粒度控制困难。本文旨在理解颜色在潜空间中的表示机制。
Method: 提出 Latent Color Subspace (LCS) 解释，通过对 FLUX.1 [Dev] 的 VAE 潜空间进行闭式操作，实现无需训练的颜色预测与控制。
Result: LCS 解释能准确预测颜色，并通过潜空间操作实现显式颜色控制，整个方法无需额外训练。
Conclusion: 潜空间颜色表示具有结构化的有序性，LCS 提供了一种训练自由的颜色控制方法，有助于提升文本到图像生成的可解释性和可控性。

papers.title: Does the Question Really Matter? Training-Free Data Selection for Vision-Language SFT
papers.abstract_en: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for improving vision-language large models (VLLMs). However, many samples can be solved via linguistic patterns or common-sense shortcuts, without genuine cross-modal reasoning, limiting the effectiveness of multimodal learning. Prior data selection methods often rely on costly proxy model training and focus on difficulty or diversity, failing to capture a sample's true contribution to vision-language joint reasoning. In this paper, we propose CVS, a training-free data selection method based on the insight that, for high-quality multimodal samples, introducing the question should substantially alter the model's assessment of answer validity given an image. CVS leverages a frozen VLLM as an evaluator and measures the discrepancy in answer validity with and without conditioning on the question, enabling the identification of samples that require vision-language joint reasoning while filtering semantic-conflict noise. Experiments on Vision-Flan and The Cauldron show that CVS achieves solid performance across datasets. On Vision-Flan, CVS outperforms full-data training by 3.5% and 4.8% using only 10% and 15% of the data, respectively, and remains robust on the highly heterogeneous Cauldron dataset. Moreover, CVS reduces computational cost by 17.3% and 44.4% compared to COINCIDE and XMAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的数据选择方法CVS，用于视觉语言模型（VLLM）的指令微调。CVS通过比较有条件（给定问题）和无条件（仅图像）下模型对答案有效性的评估差异，来筛选需要跨模态推理的样本。实验表明，在Vision-Flan和The Cauldron数据集上，CVS使用10%或15%的数据即可超越全量训练，并降低计算成本。
Motivation: 现有视觉指令微调数据中存在大量可通过语言模式或常识捷径解决的样本，无需真正的跨模态推理；现有数据选择方法依赖昂贵的代理模型训练，且难以捕捉样本对视觉-语言联合推理的真实贡献。
Method: 提出训练免费的数据选择方法CVS，利用冻结的VLLM作为评估器，测量引入问题前后模型对答案有效性的评估差异，以此识别需要视觉-语言联合推理的样本，并过滤语义冲突噪声。
Result: 在Vision-Flan数据集上，CVS仅使用10%和15%的数据分别超越全量训练3.5%和4.8%；在高度异质的Cauldron数据集上保持鲁棒；相比COINCIDE和XMAS，计算成本降低17.3%和44.4%。
Conclusion: CVS提供了一种无需额外训练、高效的数据选择方案，能提升视觉指令微调中跨模态推理的有效性。

papers.title: On Regret Bounds of Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study a widely used Bayesian optimization method, Gaussian process Thompson sampling (GP-TS), under the assumption that the objective function is a sample path from a GP. Compared with the GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) with established high-probability and expected regret bounds, most analyses of GP-TS have been limited to expected regret. Moreover, whether the recent analyses of GP-UCB for the lenient regret and the improved cumulative regret upper bound can be applied to GP-TS remains unclear. To fill these gaps, this paper shows several regret bounds: (i) a regret lower bound for GP-TS, which implies that GP-TS suffers from a polynomial dependence on $1/δ$ with probability $δ$, (ii) an upper bound of the second moment of cumulative regret, which directly suggests an improved regret upper bound on $δ$, (iii) expected lenient regret upper bounds, and (iv) an improved cumulative regret upper bound on the time horizon $T$. Along the way, we provide several useful lemmas, including a relaxation of the necessary condition from recent analysis to obtain improved regret upper bounds on $T$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程汤普森采样（GP-TS）在贝叶斯优化中的后悔界进行理论分析，填补了概率界和期望界方面的空白。摘要展示了多个后悔界结果：GP-TS的后悔下界（依赖于1/δ的多项式），累积后悔二阶矩上界，期望宽松后悔上界，以及关于时间T的改进累积后悔上界，并提供了放松必要条件的引理。
Motivation: 现有GP-TS分析多限于期望后悔，缺乏高概率和宽松后悔界，且GP-UCB的改进界能否应用于GP-TS不清楚。本文旨在填补这些理论空白。
Method: 本文通过理论推导，证明了GP-TS的多个后悔界，包括下界和上界，并提供了若干引理，包括放松近期分析中的必要条件以获得改进的上界。
Result: 摘要给出四个主要结果：(i) GP-TS下界显示以概率δ存在多项式依赖1/δ；(ii) 累积后悔二阶矩上界；(iii) 期望宽松后悔上界；(iv) 关于时间T的改进累积后悔上界。
Conclusion: 本文严格丰富了GP-TS的理论后悔界，为贝叶斯优化中的算法选择提供了新的理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Impact of Connectivity on Laplacian Representations in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning compact state representations in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) has proven crucial for addressing the curse of dimensionality in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) problems. Existing principled approaches leverage structural priors on the MDP by constructing state representations as linear combinations of the state-graph Laplacian eigenvectors. When the transition graph is unknown or the state space is prohibitively large, the graph spectral features can be estimated directly via sample trajectories. In this work, we prove an upper bound on the approximation error of linear value function approximation under the learned spectral features. We show how this error scales with the algebraic connectivity of the state-graph, grounding the approximation quality in the topological structure of the MDP. We further bound the error introduced by the eigenvector estimation itself, leading to an end-to-end error decomposition across the representation learning pipeline. Additionally, our expression of the Laplacian operator for the RL setting, although equivalent to existing ones, prevents some common misunderstandings, of which we show some examples from the literature. Our results hold for general (non-uniform) policies without any assumptions on the symmetry of the induced transition kernel. We validate our theoretical findings with numerical simulations on gridworld environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中基于拉普拉斯特征向量的状态表示学习，证明了在基于样本轨迹估计谱特征时，线性值函数逼近的误差上界，并揭示了该误差如何与状态图代数连通性（algebraic connectivity）相关，同时考虑了特征向量估计自身的误差，形成了端到端的误差分解。作者还澄清了拉普拉斯算子在强化学习中的常见误解，并在网格世界环境中用数值模拟验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有基于图拉普拉斯特征的表示学习方法在理论上缺乏对逼近误差与图拓扑结构关系的严谨刻画，且对非均匀策略下的估计误差认识不足。
Method: 从理论上推导线性值函数逼近误差的上界，该上界依赖于状态图的代数连通性，并进一步对特征向量估计误差进行边界分析，得到整个表示学习管道的端到端误差分解。
Result: 摘要报告了逼近误差与代数连通性的定量关系，并给出了特征向量估计误差的边界，数值模拟验证了理论结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调状态图的连接性直接影响拉普拉斯表示学习的质量，且所提出的误差分解框架适用于一般（非均匀）策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReMoT: Reinforcement Learning with Motion Contrast Triplets
papers.abstract_en: We present ReMoT, a unified training paradigm to systematically address the fundamental shortcomings of VLMs in spatio-temporal consistency -- a critical failure point in navigation, robotics, and autonomous driving. ReMoT integrates two core components: (1) A rule-based automatic framework that generates ReMoT-16K, a large-scale (16.5K triplets) motion-contrast dataset derived from video meta-annotations, surpassing costly manual or model-based generation. (2) Group Relative Policy Optimization, which we empirically validate yields optimal performance and data efficiency for learning this contrastive reasoning, far exceeding standard Supervised Fine-Tuning. We also construct the first benchmark for fine-grained motion contrast triplets to measure a VLM's discrimination of subtle motion attributes (e.g., opposing directions). The resulting model achieves state-of-the-art performance on our new benchmark and multiple standard VLM benchmarks, culminating in a remarkable 25.1% performance leap on spatio-temporal reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMoT，一种统一的训练范式，通过运动对比三元组解决视觉语言模型（VLM）在时空一致性上的根本缺陷。该方法包括自动生成大规模运动对比数据集 ReMoT-16K（16.5K 三元组）和使用群体相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）进行对比推理学习。作者在运动对比三元组新基准和多个标准 VLM 基准上取得了最先进性能，时空推理任务提升高达 25.1%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在导航、机器人和自动驾驶等任务中缺乏时空一致性，而现有数据集生成成本高或需人工标注。
Method: 提出基于规则的运动对比三元组自动生成框架（ReMoT-16K），并结合群体相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化学习训练，超越标准的有监督微调。
Result: 在运动对比三元组新基准和多个标准 VLM 基准上取得最先进性能，时空推理任务性能提升 25.1%。
Conclusion: ReMoT 通过自动生成数据集和强化学习有效提升了 VLM 的时空一致性，但仍依赖于视频元标注的质量。

papers.title: Neural ensemble Kalman filter: Data assimilation for compressible flows with shocks
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) for compressible flows with shocks is challenging because many classical DA methods generate spurious oscillations and nonphysical features near uncertain shocks. We focus here on the ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF). We show that the poor performance of the EnKF may be attributed to the bimodal forecast distribution that can arise in the vicinity of an uncertain shock location; this violates the assumptions underpinning the EnKF, which assume a forecast which is close to Gaussian. To address this issue we introduce the new neural EnKF. The basic idea is to systematically embed neural function approximations within ensemble DA by mapping the forecast ensemble of shocked flows to the parameter space (weights and biases) of a deep neural network (NN) and to subsequently perform DA in that space. The nonlinear mapping encodes sharp and smooth flow features in an ensemble of NN parameters. Neural EnKF updates are therefore well-behaved only if the NN parameters vary smoothly within the neural representation of the forecast ensemble. We show that such a smooth variation of network parameters can be enforced via physics-informed transfer learning, and demonstrate that in so-doing the neural EnKF avoids the spurious oscillations and nonphysical features that plague the EnKF. The applicability of the neural EnKF is demonstrated through a series of systematic numerical experiments with the inviscid Burgers' equation, the Sod shock tube, and a two-dimensional blast wave.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可压缩流激波附近数据同化中经典EnKF产生虚假振荡的问题，提出神经集成卡尔曼滤波方法（neural EnKF）。该方法将含激波的流场预报集合通过物理信息迁移学习映射到深度神经网络参数空间，在该参数空间执行同化更新，从而避免非物理特征。数值实验在无黏Burgers方程、Sod激波管和二维爆炸波上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 经典EnKF在不确定激波位置附近产生双峰预报分布，违反高斯假设，导致同化结果出现虚假振荡和非物理特征。
Method: 将预报集合中的激波流场映射到深度神经网络的参数空间（权重和偏置），通过物理信息迁移学习确保网络参数在预报集合中平滑变化，然后在参数空间中应用EnKF更新。
Result: 在无黏Burgers方程、Sod激波管和二维爆炸波实例中，neural EnKF避免了经典EnKF产生的虚假振荡和非物理特征，同化效果显著改善。
Conclusion: neural EnKF通过神经网络参数空间的同化有效处理了激波附近的双峰分布问题，但对其他复杂流动的适用性及计算成本仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Scaling Laws of Global Weather Models
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven models are revolutionizing weather forecasting. To optimize training efficiency and model performance, this paper analyzes empirical scaling laws within this domain. We investigate the relationship between model performance (validation loss) and three key factors: model size ($N$), dataset size ($D$), and compute budget ($C$). Across a range of models, we find that Aurora exhibits the strongest data-scaling behavior: increasing the training dataset by 10x reduces validation loss by up to 3.2x. GraphCast demonstrates the highest parameter efficiency, yet suffers from limited hardware utilization. Our compute-optimal analysis indicates that, under fixed compute budgets, allocating resources to more total training data yields greater performance gains than increasing model size. Furthermore, we analyze model shape and uncover scaling behaviors that differ fundamentally from those observed in language models: weather forecasting models consistently favor increased width over depth. These findings suggest that future weather models should prioritize wider architectures and larger effective training datasets to maximize predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了数据驱动全球天气模型中的缩放定律，分析了模型性能（验证损失）与模型规模（N）、数据集规模（D）和计算预算（C）之间的关系。实验发现Aurora模型的数据缩放行为最强，数据集扩大10倍可使验证损失降低3.2倍；GraphCast参数效率最高但硬件利用率有限。计算最优分析表明，固定计算预算下增加训练数据比增加模型规模更有效。模型形状分析揭示天气模型偏好宽度增加而非深度增加，与语言模型缩放行为根本不同。
Motivation: 数据驱动天气模型在预报中表现优异，但如何高效分配计算资源以优化训练和性能尚不明确，缺乏针对天气领域的系统缩放定律研究。
Method: 通过大量实验拟合验证损失与模型大小、数据集大小、计算预算之间的幂律关系，并分析模型宽度与深度对性能的影响。
Result: Aurora模型数据缩放最强（10倍数据使损失降3.2倍）；GraphCast参数效率最高但硬件利用率低；计算最优策略是增加数据而非扩大模型；天气模型更偏好宽度增加而非深度增加。
Conclusion: 未来天气模型应优先采用更宽的架构和更大的有效训练数据集以提升预测性能。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: MobilityBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Route-Planning Agents in Real-World Mobility Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Route-planning agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for supporting everyday human mobility through natural language interaction and tool-mediated decision making. However, systematic evaluation in real-world mobility settings is hindered by diverse routing demands, non-deterministic mapping services, and limited reproducibility. In this study, we introduce MobilityBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM-based route-planning agents in real-world mobility scenarios. MobilityBench is constructed from large-scale, anonymized real user queries collected from Amap and covers a broad spectrum of route-planning intents across multiple cities worldwide. To enable reproducible, end-to-end evaluation, we design a deterministic API-replay sandbox that eliminates environmental variance from live services. We further propose a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol centered on outcome validity, complemented by assessments of instruction understanding, planning, tool use, and efficiency. Using MobilityBench, we evaluate multiple LLM-based route-planning agents across diverse real-world mobility scenarios and provide an in-depth analysis of their behaviors and performance. Our findings reveal that current models perform competently on Basic information retrieval and Route Planning tasks, yet struggle considerably with Preference-Constrained Route Planning, underscoring significant room for improvement in personalized mobility applications. We publicly release the benchmark data, evaluation toolkit, and documentation at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/MobilityBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobilityBench是一个基于高德地图大规模匿名用户查询构建的基准，用于评估基于大语言模型（LLM）的路线规划智能体。它覆盖全球多城市的多样化路线规划意图，并设计了确定性API回放沙箱以消除环境差异，实现可复现的端到端评估。实验表明，当前模型在基本信息检索和路线规划任务上表现良好，但在偏好约束路线规划上表现较差，揭示了个性化移动应用中的改进空间。
Motivation: 现有评估在真实移动场景中受限于多样化的路由需求、非确定性地图服务和有限的可复现性，亟需系统化的基准。
Method: 从高德地图大规模、匿名化的真实用户查询构建MobilityBench；设计确定性API回放沙箱消除实时服务环境差异；提出基于结果有效性的多维度评估协议，涵盖指令理解、规划、工具使用和效率。
Result: 多个LLM路线规划智能体在MobilityBench上的评估显示，当前模型在基本信息检索和路线规划任务上表现良好，但在偏好约束路线规划任务上困难较大。
Conclusion: 当前模型在个性化路线规划方面仍有显著不足，公开的基准数据和评估工具可促进该领域研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EKF-Based Depth Camera and Deep Learning Fusion for UAV-Person Distance Estimation and Following in SAR Operations
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) frameworks aid human search tasks by detecting and recognizing specific individuals, then tracking and following them while maintaining a safe distance. A key safety requirement for UAV following is the accurate estimation of the distance between camera and target object under real-world conditions, achieved by fusing multiple image modalities. As part of the system for automatic people detection and face recognition using deep learning, in this paper we present the fusion of depth camera measurements and monocular camera-to-body distance estimation for robust tracking and following. Deep learning based filtering of depth camera data and estimation of camera-to-body distance from a monocular camera are achieved with YOLO-pose, enabling real-time fusion of depth information using the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) algorithm. The proposed subsystem, designed for use in drones, estimates and measures the distance between the depth camera and the human body keypoints, to maintain the safe distance between the drone and the human target. Our system provides an accurate estimated distance, which has been validated against motion capture ground truth data. The system has been tested in real time indoors, where it reduces the average errors, RMSE and standard deviations of distance estimation up to 15,3% in three tested scenarios. Based on the test results, the EKF fusion-based approach increases the depth detection range by reducing the errors outside the optimal depth camera working range. It also shows improved robustness and precision in challenging conditions, such as reflections and poor visibility, making it suitable for SAR.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的深度相机与深度学习融合方法，用于无人机在搜索救援任务中估计与目标人的距离。系统使用YOLO-pose对深度相机数据滤波和单目相机的人体关键点距离估计，通过EKF融合实现实时鲁棒的距离估计。在室内实验中，该方法将距离估计的平均误差、RMSE和标准差最多降低15.3%，并扩展了有效探测范围，在反射和低能见度条件下表现更鲁棒。
Motivation: 无人机跟随目标人时，准确估计距离是关键安全需求。深度相机在反射、能见度差等条件下误差大，单目相机估计精度有限，需要融合多种模态提高鲁棒性。
Method: 使用YOLO-pose从单目相机估计人体关键点到相机的距离，同时从深度相机获取深度数据，通过深度学习滤波后的深度信息与单目距离估计，利用扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行实时融合。
Result: 在三个室内场景中，该方法将距离估计的平均误差、RMSE和标准差最多降低15.3%。在深度相机最佳工作范围外，误差减少，有效距离增加；在反射和低能见度条件下表现更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 基于EKF的融合方法提高了深度探测范围和精度，适用于搜索救援等需要鲁棒距离估计的场景。
