papers.title: Carbon-Aware Governance Gates: An Architecture for Sustainable GenAI Development
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of Generative AI (GenAI) in the software development life cycle (SDLC) increases computational demand, which can raise the carbon footprint of development activities. At the same time, organizations are increasingly embedding governance mechanisms into GenAI-assisted development to support trust, transparency, and accountability. However, these governance mechanisms introduce additional computational workloads, including repeated inference, regeneration cycles, and expanded validation pipelines, increasing energy use and the carbon footprint of GenAI-assisted development. This paper proposes Carbon-Aware Governance Gates (CAGG), an architectural extension that embeds carbon budgets, energy provenance, and sustainability-aware validation orchestration into human-AI governance layers. CAGG comprises three components: (i) an Energy and Carbon Provenance Ledger, (ii) a Carbon Budget Manager, and (iii) a Green Validation Orchestrator, operationalized through governance policies and reusable design patterns.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Preprint version under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出碳感知治理门（CAGG）架构，将碳预算、能源溯源和可持续性验证编排嵌入生成式AI（GenAI）辅助开发的人类-AI治理层。CAGG包含三个组件：能源与碳溯源账本、碳预算管理器、绿色验证编排器，通过治理策略和可复用设计模式实现，旨在降低GenAI开发活动的碳足迹。
Motivation: GenAI在SDLC中的快速采用增加了计算需求，可能提高开发活动的碳足迹；同时，治理机制引入额外计算负载（如重复推理、再生周期、扩展验证管道），进一步增加能源消耗和碳排放。现有方法缺乏将碳意识融入治理层的系统架构。
Method: 提出Carbon-Aware Governance Gates (CAGG)架构扩展，包括三个组件：Energy and Carbon Provenance Ledger（能源与碳溯源账本）、Carbon Budget Manager（碳预算管理器）、Green Validation Orchestrator（绿色验证编排器），通过治理策略和可复用设计模式实现碳预算、能源溯源和可持续性感知验证编排。
Result: 摘要仅描述架构设计，未报告具体实验结果或量化性能。
Conclusion: 本文提供了将碳意识融入GenAI开发治理的架构蓝图，但未提供实证验证。作者指出该架构通过治理策略和设计模式操作化，有望降低碳足迹。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Diffusing to Coordinate: Efficient Online Multi-Agent Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: Online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a prominent framework for efficient agent coordination. Crucially, enhancing policy expressiveness is pivotal for achieving superior performance. Diffusion-based generative models are well-positioned to meet this demand, having demonstrated remarkable expressiveness and multimodal representation in image generation and offline settings. Yet, their potential in online MARL remains largely under-explored. A major obstacle is that the intractable likelihoods of diffusion models impede entropy-based exploration and coordination. To tackle this challenge, we propose among the first \underline{O}nline off-policy \underline{MA}RL framework using \underline{D}iffusion policies (\textbf{OMAD}) to orchestrate coordination. Our key innovation is a relaxed policy objective that maximizes scaled joint entropy, facilitating effective exploration without relying on tractable likelihood. Complementing this, within the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm, we employ a joint distributional value function to optimize decentralized diffusion policies. It leverages tractable entropy-augmented targets to guide the simultaneous updates of diffusion policies, thereby ensuring stable coordination. Extensive evaluations on MPE and MAMuJoCo establish our method as the new state-of-the-art across $10$ diverse tasks, demonstrating a remarkable $2.5\times$ to $5\times$ improvement in sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在线多智能体强化学习框架OMAD，使用扩散策略（diffusion policies）增强策略表达性并促进协调。针对扩散模型在在线环境中难以进行熵基础探索的问题，提出松弛策略目标最大化缩放联合熵，并联合分布价值函数优化去中心化策略。在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个任务上达到最先进，样本效率提升2.5至5倍。
Motivation: 扩散模型在在线MARL中因似然难以处理而阻碍熵基础的探索与协调，限制了策略表达性的提升。
Method: 提出松弛策略目标最大化缩放联合熵以替代直接似然计算；在CTDE中使用联合分布价值函数通过可计算熵增强目标同时更新去中心化扩散策略。
Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个任务上取得最先进结果，样本效率提升2.5到5倍。
Conclusion: 首次将扩散策略成功应用于在线MARL，通过熵增强探索解决了扩散模型在在线环境中的协调问题。

papers.title: Sonar-TS: Search-Then-Verify Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Querying for Time Series Databases (NLQ4TSDB) aims to assist non-expert users retrieve meaningful events, intervals, and summaries from massive temporal records. However, existing Text-to-SQL methods are not designed for continuous morphological intents such as shapes or anomalies, while time series models struggle to handle ultra-long histories. To address these challenges, we propose Sonar-TS, a neuro-symbolic framework that tackles NLQ4TSDB via a Search-Then-Verify pipeline. Analogous to active sonar, it utilizes a feature index to ping candidate windows via SQL, followed by generated Python programs to lock on and verify candidates against raw signals. To enable effective evaluation, we introduce NLQTSBench, the first large-scale benchmark designed for NLQ over TSDB-scale histories. Our experiments highlight the unique challenges within this domain and demonstrate that Sonar-TS effectively navigates complex temporal queries where traditional methods fail. This work presents the first systematic study of NLQ4TSDB, offering a general framework and evaluation standard to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sonar-TS 是一个神经符号框架，用于时间序列数据库的自然语言查询（NLQ4TSDB），采用“搜索-然后-验证”流水线：先通过 SQL 索引候选窗口，再用生成的 Python 程序验证原始信号。同时提出了首个大规模基准 NLQTSBench。实验表明 Sonar-TS 能处理传统方法失败的时间查询。
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 方法不适用于连续的形态意图（如形状、异常），而时间序列模型难以处理超长历史记录。需要一种能高效检索有意义事件、区间和摘要的 NLQ4TSDB 方法。
Method: 提出 Sonar-TS 神经符号框架：利用特征索引通过 SQL 快速定位候选窗口，然后生成 Python 程序对原始信号进行验证，模拟主动声纳。
Result: 在 NLQTSBench 基准上，Sonar-TS 有效导航复杂时间查询，传统方法失败时仍能成功。
Conclusion: 这是 NLQ4TSDB 的首次系统性研究，提供了通用框架和评估标准，促进未来研究。

papers.title: Coverage Guarantees for Pseudo-Calibrated Conformal Prediction under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) offers distribution-free marginal coverage guarantees under an exchangeability assumption, but these guarantees can fail if the data distribution shifts. We analyze the use of pseudo-calibration as a tool to counter this performance loss under a bounded label-conditional covariate shift model. Using tools from domain adaptation, we derive a lower bound on target coverage in terms of the source-domain loss of the classifier and a Wasserstein measure of the shift. Using this result, we provide a method to design pseudo-calibrated sets that inflate the conformal threshold by a slack parameter to keep target coverage above a prescribed level. Finally, we propose a source-tuned pseudo-calibration algorithm that interpolates between hard pseudo-labels and randomized labels as a function of classifier uncertainty. Numerical experiments show that our bounds qualitatively track pseudo-calibration behavior and that the source-tuned scheme mitigates coverage degradation under distribution shift while maintaining nontrivial prediction set sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析在标签条件协变量偏移模型下，使用伪校准（pseudo-calibration）来维持共形预测（conformal prediction）的覆盖保证。通过域适应工具推导出目标覆盖的下界，并提出一种基于松弛参数的伪校准集设计方法。进一步提出源调优伪校准算法，在硬伪标签和随机标签之间插值，数值实验表明该方法能定性跟踪伪校准行为，并在分布偏移下缓解覆盖退化。
Motivation: 共形预测在交换性假设下提供无分布边际覆盖保证，但数据分布偏移会导致保证失效。本文针对这一问题，研究伪校准作为应对手段。
Method: 在标签条件协变量偏移模型下，利用域适应工具推导出目标覆盖关于源域分类器损失和Wasserstein偏移度量的下界。基于此，设计通过松弛参数膨胀共形阈值的伪校准集。提出源调优伪校准算法，根据分类器不确定性在硬伪标签和随机标签之间插值。
Result: 数值实验表明推导的边界能定性跟踪伪校准行为，源调优方案在维持非平凡预测集大小的同时，缓解了分布偏移下的覆盖退化。
Conclusion: 所提伪校准方法能在分布偏移下提供覆盖保证，有效平衡覆盖率和预测集效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Momentum LMS Theory beyond Stationarity: Stability, Tracking, and Regret
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale data processing scenarios, data often arrive in sequential streams generated by complex systems that exhibit drifting distributions and time-varying system parameters. This nonstationarity challenges theoretical analysis, as it violates classical assumptions of i.i.d. (independent and identically distributed) samples, necessitating algorithms capable of real-time updates without expensive retraining. An effective approach should process each sample in a single pass, while maintaining computational and memory complexities independent of the data stream length. Motivated by these challenges, this paper investigates the Momentum Least Mean Squares (MLMS) algorithm as an adaptive identification tool, leveraging its computational simplicity and online processing capabilities. Theoretically, we derive tracking performance and regret bounds for the MLMS in time-varying stochastic linear systems under various practical conditions. Unlike classical LMS, whose stability can be characterized by first-order random vector difference equations, MLMS introduces an additional dynamical state due to momentum, leading to second-order time-varying random vector difference equations whose stability analysis hinges on more complicated products of random matrices, which poses a substantially challenging problem to resolve. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data streams demonstrate that MLMS achieves rapid adaptation and robust tracking, in agreement with our theoretical results especially in nonstationary settings, highlighting its promise for modern streaming and online learning applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动量最小均方（MLMS）算法在非平稳时变随机线性系统中的跟踪性能与遗憾界。与经典LMS不同，MLMS引入动量项导致二阶随机向量差分方程，稳定性分析依赖于随机矩阵乘积，更具挑战性。实验在合成和真实数据流上验证了MLMS的快速适应和鲁棒跟踪能力。
Motivation: 大规模数据处理中数据流常具有时变分布和参数，违背独立同分布假设，需要能实时更新的算法。MLMS作为计算简单的自适应识别工具，其非平稳场景下的理论性质尚未充分研究。
Method: 对MLMS在时变随机线性系统中进行理论分析，推导跟踪性能与遗憾界，并通过合成和真实数据流实验验证。
Result: 理论得到MLMS在多种实际条件下的跟踪误差界和遗憾界；实验表明MLMS在非平稳设置下实现快速适应和鲁棒跟踪，与理论一致。
Conclusion: MLMS适用于现代流式数据和非平稳在线学习场景，其动量结构带来的二阶动力学虽增加分析难度，但可提供更优的跟踪性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpaTeoGL: Spatiotemporal Graph Learning for Interpretable Seizure Onset Zone Analysis from Intracranial EEG
papers.abstract_en: Accurate localization of the seizure onset zone (SOZ) from intracranial EEG (iEEG) is essential for epilepsy surgery but is challenged by complex spatiotemporal seizure dynamics. We propose SpaTeoGL, a spatiotemporal graph learning framework for interpretable seizure network analysis. SpaTeoGL jointly learns window-level spatial graphs capturing interactions among iEEG electrodes and a temporal graph linking time windows based on similarity of their spatial structure. The method is formulated within a smooth graph signal processing framework and solved via an alternating block coordinate descent algorithm with convergence guarantees. Experiments on a multicenter iEEG dataset with successful surgical outcomes show that SpaTeoGL is competitive with a baseline based on horizontal visibility graphs and logistic regression, while improving non-SOZ identification and providing interpretable insights into seizure onset and propagation dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpaTeoGL，一种用于颅内脑电图（iEEG）癫痫发作区（SOZ）定位的时空图学习框架。该框架联合学习窗口级空间图（捕捉电极间交互）和时间图（基于空间结构相似性连接时间窗口），通过平滑图信号处理与交替块坐标下降算法求解。在多中心iEEG数据集上，该方法与基于水平可见性图+逻辑回归的基线性能相当，但改进了非SOZ识别并提供可解释的发作传播动态。
Motivation: 精确的SOZ定位对癫痫手术至关重要，但复杂的时空发作动力学使现有方法面临挑战。
Method: 提出SpaTeoGL，联合学习窗口级空间图与时间图，在平滑图信号处理框架下通过交替块坐标下降算法求解。
Result: 在多中心iEEG数据集上，与水平可见性图+逻辑回归基线相比，SpaTeoGL在SOZ定位上竞争性相当，但非SOZ识别更优，并提供可解释的发作起始与传播洞察。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在保持竞争力的同时提升了可解释性和非SOZ识别能力，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftMatcha 2: A Fast and Soft Pattern Matcher for Trillion-Scale Corpora
papers.abstract_en: We present SoftMatcha 2, an ultra-fast and flexible search algorithm that enables search over trillion-scale natural language corpora in under 0.3 seconds while allowing semantic variations in the form of substitution, insertion, and deletion. Our approach employs string matching based on suffix arrays that scales well with corpus size, and represents words as vectors, which underpin its semantic flexibility. To mitigate the combinatorial explosion induced by the semantic relaxation of queries, our method is built on two key algorithmic ideas: dynamic corpus-aware pruning and fast exact lookup enabled by a disk-aware design. We theoretically analyze the efficiency of the proposed method, indicating that it can mitigate exponential growth in the search space. Empirically, on FineWeb-Edu (Lozhkov et al., 2024) (1.4T tokens), it attains substantially lower search latency than existing methods: infini-gram (Liu et al., 2024), infini-gram mini (Xu et al., 2025), and SoftMatcha (Deguchi et al., 2025). As a practical application, our method uncovers benchmark contamination in training corpora that existing approaches miss, and it also benefits information retrieval and paraphrase detection. We also provide an online demo of fast, soft search across corpora in seven languages.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML2026. Project Page & Web Interface: https://softmatcha.github.io/v2/, Source Code: https://github.com/softmatcha/softmatcha2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftMatcha 2，一种超快速且灵活的搜索算法，能在0.3秒内搜索万亿级自然语言语料库，并支持替换、插入和删除等语义变体。算法基于后缀数组和词向量实现语义灵活性，通过动态语料感知剪枝和磁盘感知设计避免组合爆炸。在FineWeb-Edu（1.4T tokens）上，延迟显著低于现有方法。实际应用包括发现训练数据中的基准污染、信息检索和释义检测。
Motivation: 现有搜索方法难以在万亿级语料上同时实现速度和语义灵活性，尤其是处理查询的语义变体（替换、插入、删除）时面临组合爆炸问题。
Method: 采用基于后缀数组的字符串匹配，将词表示为向量；提出动态语料感知剪枝和基于磁盘感知的快速精确查找两种核心算法思想，从理论上分析了缓解搜索空间指数增长的能力。
Result: 在FineWeb-Edu（1.4T tokens）上，搜索延迟显著低于infini-gram、infini-gram mini和SoftMatcha；实际应用中发现现有方法遗漏的基准污染，并提升信息检索和释义检测性能。
Conclusion: SoftMatcha 2 在速度、可扩展性和语义灵活性方面达到新水平，支持七种语言的在线演示，但适用范围限于自然语言语料库的软模式匹配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kalman Linear Attention: Parallel Bayesian Filtering For Efficient Language Modelling and State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: State-space language models such as Mamba and gated linear attention (GLA) offer linear-complexity, parallelisable alternatives to transformers, but their linear state updates limit expressivity and robust state tracking. We close this gap from a probabilistic angle, casting sequence mixing as exact Bayesian filtering with the Kalman filter as the core primitive. Classical Kalman filters give principled state and uncertainty estimates but are viewed as inherently sequential; we show that reparameterising them in information form turns their updates into an associative scan - so the per-token recurrent update is non-linear (a Möbius/precision recursion) yet remains temporally parallel. The resulting Kalman Linear Attention (KLA) layer is a drop-in sequence mixer that performs time-parallel probabilistic inference, carries an explicit belief-state uncertainty, and is strictly more expressive than GLA-style linear updates at the same computational cost. This expressivity translates directly into stronger state tracking: KLA solves permutation-composition ($A_5$) tasks that linear SSMs and attention cannot, while staying scan-parallel. As a drop-in primitive it also matches or improves on modern SSMs and GLAs across synthetic token-manipulation and zero-shot commonsense benchmarks, and is among the first stacked Bayesian-filtering primitives trained at the billion-token scale.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. An earlier version of this work was presented at the 1st Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML) at EurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kalman Linear Attention (KLA)层，将序列建模重新诠释为精确贝叶斯滤波，以卡尔曼滤波为核心。通过将卡尔曼滤波重参数化为信息形式，使得原本顺序的递归更新变为可并行计算的关联扫描（associative scan），从而在保持线性复杂度的同时获得比门控线性注意力（GLA）更强的表达能力。实验表明，KLA能够解决置换组合（A5）任务，而线性状态空间模型和标准注意力无法做到，并在合成token操作和零样本常识推理基准上匹配或超越现代SSM和GLA。
Motivation: 现有线性状态空间模型（如Mamba）和门控线性注意力（GLA）的线性状态更新限制了表达力和鲁棒的状态跟踪能力，传统卡尔曼滤波虽然概率框架严谨但被视作顺序计算。
Method: 将标准卡尔曼滤波重新参数化为信息形式，使更新步骤转化为Möbius/精度递归，进而可表示为关联扫描，从而实现时间并行化。该Kalman Linear Attention (KLA)层可作为即插即用的序列混合器，执行时间并行的概率推理。
Result: KLA在置换组合（A5）任务上成功求解，而线性SSM和注意力机制均失败；在合成token操作和零样本常识基准上，KLA匹配或优于现代SSM和GLA，且计算成本相同。
Conclusion: KLA是首个在十亿token规模下训练的堆叠贝叶斯滤波原语，证明了概率视角下线性时间序列建模的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Optimal Reasoning Length for RL-Trained Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning substantially improves reasoning in large language models, but it also tends to lengthen chain-of-thought outputs and increase computational cost. Although length-control methods have been proposed, the length-accuracy relationship they induce remains unclear. We train policies with several length-control methods on multiple base models in a controlled setup and find that, across both mathematical reasoning and code generation, accuracy is non-monotonic in output length, peaking at an intermediate value. Mode accuracy, however, continues to improve with length even in settings where sample accuracy plateaus or declines, indicating that the non-monotonic length-accuracy relationship is driven by dispersion around an increasingly correct center.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控设置下，使用多种长度控制方法训练不同基座模型，研究强化训练语言模型的推理长度与准确率的关系。在数学推理和代码生成任务上，准确率随输出长度呈非单调变化，在中间长度达到峰值，但模式准确率持续随长度提升。
Motivation: 强化学习显著提升语言模型推理能力，但往往导致链式思维输出变长、计算成本增加。现有长度控制方法虽被提出，但其所诱导的长度-准确率关系尚不明确。
Method: 在多个基座模型上采用多种长度控制方法训练策略，系统性地分析输出长度与准确率之间的关联。
Result: 准确率在输出长度上呈非单调变化，中间长度达到峰值；模式准确率随长度持续改善，而样本准确率出现平台期或下降，表明非单调性由围绕逐渐正确中心的分散度驱动。
Conclusion: 非单调长度-准确率关系源于样本围绕正确中心的分散度，而非单纯的长度增加，提示设计长度控制策略需考虑分散度因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autoregressive Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Direct preference optimization (DPO) has emerged as a promising approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, the widespread reliance on the response-level Bradley-Terry (BT) model may limit its full potential, as the reference and learnable models are assumed to be autoregressive only after deriving the objective function. Motivated by this limitation, we revisit the theoretical foundations of DPO and propose a novel formulation that explicitly introduces the autoregressive assumption prior to applying the BT model. By reformulating and extending DPO, we derive a novel variant, termed Autoregressive DPO (ADPO), that explicitly integrates autoregressive modeling into the preference optimization framework. Without violating the theoretical foundations, the derived loss takes an elegant form: it shifts the summation operation in the DPO objective outside the log-sigmoid function. Furthermore, through theoretical analysis of ADPO, we show that there exist two length measures to be considered when designing DPO-based algorithms: the token length $μ$ and the feedback length $μ'$. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to explicitly distinguish these two measures and analyze their implications for preference optimization in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自回归直接偏好优化（ADPO），在Bradley-Terry模型之前显式引入自回归假设，重新推导DPO损失函数，将求和运算移至log-sigmoid函数之外，并首次区分令牌长度μ和反馈长度μ'两种长度度量，分析其对偏好优化的影响。
Motivation: 现有DPO基于响应级别的Bradley-Terry模型，在推导目标函数后才假设参考模型和可学习模型为自回归，可能限制了其潜力。本文旨在理论基础中更早引入自回归假设，以改进偏好优化。
Method: 通过重新审视DPO的理论基础，在应用Bradley-Terry模型之前显式引入自回归假设，推导出新的损失函数形式：将DPO目标中的求和运算移到log-sigmoid函数外部，得到ADPO。
Result: 理论分析表明存在两种长度度量（令牌长度μ和反馈长度μ'），首次明确区分二者并分析其对偏好优化的影响。
Conclusion: ADPO在不违反理论基础的前提下，通过重构损失函数形式，为基于DPO的算法设计提供了新的理论视角，并强调了长度度量在偏好优化中的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Correspondence to Actions: Human-Like Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning in Multi-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in single-image spatial reasoning, multi-image spatial reasoning, which requires integration of information from multiple viewpoints, remains challenging. Cognitive studies suggest that humans address such tasks through two mechanisms: cross-view correspondence, which identifies regions across different views that correspond to the same physical locations, and stepwise viewpoint transformation, which composes relative viewpoint changes sequentially. However, existing studies incorporate these mechanisms only partially and often implicitly, without explicit supervision for both. We propose Human-Aware Training for Cross-view correspondence and viewpoint cHange (HATCH), a training framework with two complementary objectives: (1) Patch-Level Spatial Alignment, which encourages patch representations to align across views for spatially corresponding regions, and (2) Action-then-Answer Reasoning, which requires the model to generate explicit viewpoint transition actions before predicting the final answer. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that HATCH consistently outperforms baselines of comparable size by a clear margin and achieves competitive results against much larger models, while preserving single-image reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HATCH框架，通过补丁级空间对齐和动作-答案推理，训练多模态大语言模型实现类人的多图像空间推理，在三个基准上超越同尺寸基线并接近更大模型。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在单图像空间推理中表现良好，但多图像空间推理需要整合多个视角的信息，现有方法仅部分且隐式地利用了跨视图对应和逐步视角变换机制。
Method: HATCH包含两个目标：(1) 补丁级空间对齐，让对应空间区域的补丁表征跨视图对齐；(2) 动作-答案推理，要求模型在预测答案前生成显式的视角转换动作。
Result: 在三个基准上，HATCH一致且明显地优于同尺寸基线，并与更大模型取得竞争性结果，同时保持单图像推理能力。
Conclusion: 显式监督跨视图对应和视角变换能有效提升多图像空间推理，且不损害单图像性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE: Scalable AI Governance & Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating relevance in large-scale search systems is fundamentally constrained by the governance gap between nuanced, resource-constrained human oversight and the high-throughput requirements of production systems. While traditional approaches rely on engagement proxies or sparse manual review, these methods often fail to capture the full scope of high-impact relevance failures. We present \textbf{SAGE} (Scalable AI Governance \& Evaluation), a framework that operationalizes high-quality human product judgment as a scalable evaluation signal. At the core of SAGE is a bidirectional calibration loop where natural-language \emph{Policy}, curated \emph{Precedent}, and an \emph{LLM Surrogate Judge} co-evolve. SAGE systematically resolves semantic ambiguities and misalignments, transforming subjective relevance judgment into an executable, multi-dimensional rubric with near human-level agreement. To bridge the gap between frontier model reasoning and industrial-scale inference, we apply teacher-student distillation to transfer high-fidelity judgments into compact student surrogates at \textbf{92$\times$} lower cost. Deployed within LinkedIn Search ecosystems, SAGE guided model iteration through simulation-driven development, distilling policy-aligned models for online serving and enabling rapid offline evaluation. In production, it powered policy oversight that measured ramped model variants and detected regressions invisible to engagement metrics. Collectively, these drove a \textbf{0.25\%} lift in LinkedIn daily active users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE（可扩展 AI 治理与评估）框架，通过双向校准循环将人类产品判断转化为可扩展的评估信号，结合策略、案例和 LLM 替代裁判，并应用师生蒸馏以 92 倍成本降低实现高保真判断。在 LinkedIn 搜索生态中部署后，该框架指导模型迭代、检测回归，并带来日活跃用户 0.25% 的提升。
Motivation: 大规模搜索系统中的相关性评估受限于人工审查的资源瓶颈和高吞吐需求，传统代理指标或稀疏审查无法捕捉重大相关性失败。
Method: 提出 SAGE 框架，核心是自然语言策略、策划案例和 LLM 替代裁判的双向校准循环，通过师生蒸馏将前沿模型的高保真判断转移到紧凑学生模型，成本降低 92 倍。
Result: 在 LinkedIn 搜索生产中，SAGE 驱动的策略监督检测到参与度指标不可见的回归，并最终带来日活跃用户 0.25% 的显著提升。
Conclusion: SAGE 提供了一种可扩展的方式将人类产品判断转化为可靠的评估信号，适用于工业级搜索系统的迭代与监控。

papers.title: "Do Not Mention This to the User": Detecting and Understanding Malicious Agent Skills in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents increasingly rely on third-party extensions called skills, which bundle natural language instructions and helper scripts that execute with full user privileges. Community registries have emerged to distribute these skills, but the security implications remain unstudied due to the absence of labeled threat data. This paper presents a systematic security analysis of 98,380 skills collected from two major registries. Through a combination of static pattern matching and dynamic behavioral verification, we identify 157 skills exhibiting confirmed malicious behavior, encompassing 632 distinct vulnerabilities across 13 attack techniques. Our analysis reveals that these threats are deliberate rather than accidental: each malicious skill contains an average of 4.03 vulnerabilities spanning multiple attack phases. We identify two dominant attack strategies with statistically significant negative correlation -- credential theft via remote code execution, and agent manipulation through adversarial instructions embedded in documentation. Over half of all confirmed cases originate from a single threat actor employing templated brand impersonation at scale. We further observe that attack sophistication correlates with concealment investment, with advanced skills universally employing undocumented capabilities while also exploiting platform-native trust mechanisms. Following responsible disclosure, registry maintainers removed all 157 (100%) of the reported skills. Our dataset and detection pipeline are publicly available to facilitate future research on securing LLM agent ecosystems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两个主流技能注册表中的98,380个LLM代理技能进行系统性安全分析，通过静态模式匹配和动态行为验证识别出157个恶意技能，包含632个不同漏洞和13种攻击技术。研究发现这些威胁是蓄意的，平均每个恶意技能有4.03个漏洞，超过一半来自一个使用模板化品牌冒充的威胁行为者。披露后所有恶意技能已被移除。
Motivation: LLM代理依赖第三方技能，但社区注册表的安全性尚未被系统研究，缺乏标记威胁数据。
Method: 结合静态模式匹配和动态行为验证，对98,380个技能进行安全分析。
Result: 识别出157个恶意技能，包含632个漏洞和13种攻击技术；每个恶意技能平均有4.03个漏洞；超过一半来自单一威胁行为者；所有报告技能已被移除。
Conclusion: LLM代理技能生态存在严重安全隐患，攻击是蓄意的且手法多样，需加强安全审查。

papers.title: Learning to Inject: Automated Prompt Injection via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection is a critical vulnerability in LLM agents, yet the strongest methods still rely on human red-teamers and hand-crafted prompts. Adapting automated jailbreak optimizers does not close this gap: jailbreaks shape models toward generic compliance, while prompt injection requires emitting specific tool calls with correct parameters. The success signal is binary, and randomly sampled suffixes almost never trigger it, so standard optimizers have no gradient to follow. We present AutoInject, a black-box reinforcement learning (RL) framework that learns adversarial suffixes for prompt injection. A learned comparison-based reward scores each candidate against the best suffix seen so far, turning the binary signal into a dense reward suitable for RL optimization. The framework supports both online query-based attacks and offline-trained transferable suffixes that need no utility access at deployment, and incorporates a utility objective when task-completion feedback is available. On AgentDojo, AutoInject outperforms template attacks, GCG, TAP, and adaptive attack across production models, with statistically significant improvements under McNemar's test with p<0.05. Suffixes learned by AutoInject also break Meta-SecAlign-70B, a model fine-tuned specifically to resist prompt injection, where template attacks fail outright. The results establish an automated baseline for prompt injection and expose a gap between preference-based defenses and adaptive optimization-based attackers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoInject，一个基于强化学习的黑盒框架，用于自动生成prompt injection的后缀。该方法通过基于比较的奖励函数将二元成功信号转化为稠密奖励，支持在线查询攻击和离线可迁移后缀。在AgentDojo基准上，AutoInject以统计显著性优于模板攻击、GCG、TAP和自适应攻击，并能击败专门针对prompt injection防御微调的Meta-SecAlign-70B模型。
Motivation: 现有prompt injection攻击依赖人工红队和手工提示，自动化的越狱优化器（如GCG）不适用，因为成功信号是二元的且随机采样几乎无法触发，导致标准优化器缺乏可用的梯度。
Method: 提出AutoInject框架，使用强化学习（RL）学习对抗性后缀。核心是一个基于比较的奖励函数，将当前候选与历史最佳后缀比较，将二元成功信号转化为稠密奖励，从而支持RL优化。框架支持在线查询攻击和离线训练的可迁移后缀（部署时无需查询权限），并在有任务完成反馈时纳入效用目标。
Result: 在AgentDojo基准上，AutoInject在多个生产模型上以McNemar检验（p<0.05）统计显著地优于模板攻击、GCG、TAP和自适应攻击。此外，AutoInject学习的后缀能够攻破专门针对prompt injection防御微调的Meta-SecAlign-70B模型，而模板攻击在此模型上完全失败。
Conclusion: 该工作为prompt injection建立了自动化基线，揭示了基于偏好的防御与自适应优化攻击之间的差距，强调需要更强的防御方法。

papers.title: Global Geometry Is Not Enough for Vision Representations
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption in representation learning is that globally well-distributed embeddings support robust and generalizable representations. This focus has shaped both training objectives and evaluation protocols, implicitly treating global geometry as a proxy for representational competence. While global geometry effectively encodes which elements are present, it is often insensitive to how they are composed. We investigate this limitation by testing the ability of geometric metrics to predict compositional binding across a diverse suite of vision encoders. We find that standard geometry-based statistics exhibit near-zero correlation with compositional binding. In contrast, functional sensitivity, as measured by the input--output Jacobian, reliably tracks this capability. We further provide an analytic account showing that this disparity arises from objective design, as existing losses explicitly constrain embedding geometry but leave the local input--output mapping unconstrained. These results suggest that global embedding geometry captures only a partial view of representational competence and establish functional sensitivity as a critical complementary axis for modeling composite structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了表征学习中“全局良好分布的嵌入支持鲁棒泛化”这一常见假设。通过在多种视觉编码器上测试几何指标与组合绑定（compositional binding）能力的相关性，发现标准几何统计量与组合绑定几乎零相关，而输入-输出雅可比（Jacobian）函数敏感性则可靠地追踪该能力。作者从目标设计角度分析差异，指出现有损失明确约束嵌入几何但未能约束局部输入-输出映射，表明全局几何仅捕捉表征能力的部分视角，函数敏感性是建模组合结构的关键补充轴。
Motivation: 现有表征学习默认全局几何足以衡量表征质量，但该假设忽视了组合结构（compositional structure）的编码能力。本文旨在揭示全局几何与组合绑定之间的脱节，并寻找更有效的评估指标。
Method: 在多种视觉编码器上，系统计算标准全局几何统计量（如均匀性、对齐性等）与组合绑定性能之间的相关性，同时引入输入-输出雅可比范数作为函数敏感性度量，并理论分析目标函数对几何和局部映射的不同约束作用。
Result: 全局几何统计量与组合绑定能力之间呈近零相关；而雅可比范数所反映的函数敏感性则稳定预测组合绑定性能。
Conclusion: 全局嵌入几何不足以表征组合结构能力，函数敏感性应作为评估表征质量的重要补充维度。

papers.title: MentisOculi: Revealing the Limits of Reasoning with Mental Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Frontier models are transitioning from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that merely ingest visual information to unified multimodal models (UMMs) capable of native interleaved generation. This shift has sparked interest in using intermediate visualizations as a reasoning aid, akin to human mental imagery. Central to this idea is the ability to form, maintain, and manipulate visual representations in a goal-oriented manner. To evaluate and probe this capability, we develop MentisOculi, a procedural, stratified suite of multi-step reasoning problems amenable to visual solution, tuned to challenge frontier models. Evaluating visual strategies ranging from latent tokens to explicit generated imagery, we find they generally fail to improve performance. Analysis of UMMs specifically exposes a critical limitation: While they possess the textual reasoning capacity to solve a task and can sometimes generate correct visuals, they suffer from compounding generation errors and fail to leverage even ground-truth visualizations. Our findings suggest that despite their inherent appeal, visual thoughts do not yet benefit model reasoning. MentisOculi establishes the necessary foundation to analyze and close this gap across diverse model families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文 MentisOculi 提出了一个程序化、分层推理问题套件，用于评估前沿模型在多步视觉推理中的表现。研究发现，尽管统一多模态模型 (UMM) 具备文本推理能力并有时能生成正确视觉，但视觉思维（如生成中间图像）并未改善推理性能，反而因累积生成错误而受损。
Motivation: 随着多模态模型从仅输入视觉信息向原生交错的统一多模态模型过渡，视觉中间表示（类似人类心理意象）被视为推理辅助手段。然而，现有模型在这种目标导向的视觉表示形成、维护和操作能力上存在不足，亟需系统性评估。
Method: 开发了 MentisOculi，一个程序化、分层的多步推理问题套件，专门设计为适合视觉解法，并用于挑战前沿模型。评估了多种视觉策略，包括潜在 token 和显式生成的图像。
Result: 摘要报告称，视觉策略普遍未能提升性能；统一多模态模型虽然具备文本推理能力且有时能生成正确视觉，但遭受累积生成错误，甚至无法利用真实标注的可视化结果。
Conclusion: 论文认为，尽管视觉思维具有内在吸引力，但目前并未有益于模型推理。MentisOculi 为分析和弥合不同模型家族间的这一差距提供了必要基础。

papers.title: AI4SLT: Empirical Processes in Lean 4 for Formal Statistical Learning Theory
papers.abstract_en: We present the first comprehensive Lean 4 formalization of statistical learning theory (SLT) grounded in empirical process theory. Our en-to-end formal infrastructure implement the missing contents in latest Lean library, including a complete development of Gaussian Lipschitz concentration, Dudley's entropy integral theorem for sub-Gaussian processes, and an application to least-squares (sparse) regression with a sharp rate. The project was carried out using a human-AI collaborative workflow, in which humans design proof strategies and AI agents execute tactical proof construction, leading to the human-verified Lean 4 toolbox for SLT. Beyond implementation, the formalization process exposes and resolves implicit assumptions and missing details in standard SLT textbooks, enforcing a granular, line-by-line understanding of the theory. This work establishes a reusable formal foundation and opens the door for future developments in machine learning theory. The code is provided in https://github.com/YuanheZ/lean-stat-learning-theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在 Lean 4 中完整形式化了基于经验过程理论的统计学习理论，包括高斯 Lipschitz 集中不等式、Dudley 熵积分定理以及最小二乘（稀疏）回归的 sharp 率。通过人机协作工作流，人类设计证明策略，AI 执行战术构建，最终得到人类验证的 Lean 4 工具箱。形式化过程暴露并解决了标准教材中的隐含假设和遗漏细节，为机器学习理论的形式化建立了可复用基础。
Motivation: 统计学习理论的形式化验证缺失，现有 Lean 库缺少关键内容，而形式化有助于发现隐含假设和错误，推动理论严谨性。
Method: 采用人类-AI 协作工作流，人类设计证明策略，AI 代理执行具体证明构建，在 Lean 4 中实现从 Gaussian Lipschitz 集中不等式到经验过程核心定理的端到端形式化。
Result: 成功形式化了 Dudley 熵积分定理等核心定理，并应用于最小二乘（稀疏）回归的 sharp 率，代码已开源。
Conclusion: 该工作为统计学习理论的形式化建立了可复用基础，未来可扩展到更多机器学习理论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Risk Monitoring of Deployed Models for Detecting Harmful Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of monitoring model performance in dynamic environments where labeled data are limited. To this end, we propose prediction-powered risk monitoring (PPRM), a semi-supervised risk-monitoring approach based on prediction-powered inference (PPI). PPRM constructs anytime-valid lower bounds on the running risk by combining synthetic labels with a small set of true labels. Harmful shifts are detected via a threshold-based comparison with an upper bound on the nominal risk, satisfying assumption-free finite-sample guarantees on the type-I error. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PPRM through extensive experiments on image classification, large language model (LLM), and telecommunications monitoring tasks.

papers.title: Neural FOXP2 -- Language Specific Neuron Steering for Targeted Language Improvement in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are multilingual by training, yet their lingua franca is often English, reflecting English language dominance in pretraining. Other languages remain in parametric memory but are systematically suppressed. We argue that language defaultness is governed by a sparse, low-rank control circuit, language neurons, that can be mechanistically isolated and safely steered. We introduce Neural FOXP2, that makes a chosen language (Hindi or Spanish) primary in a model by steering language-specific neurons. Neural FOXP2 proceeds in three stages: (i) Localize: We train per-layer SAEs so each activation decomposes into a small set of active feature components. For every feature, we quantify English vs. Hindi/Spanish selectivity overall logit-mass lift toward the target-language token set. Tracing the top-ranked features back to their strongest contributing units yields a compact language-neuron set. (ii) Steering directions: We localize controllable language-shift geometry via a spectral low-rank analysis. For each layer, we build English to target activation-difference matrices and perform layerwise SVD to extract the dominant singular directions governing language change. The eigengap and effective-rank spectra identify a compact steering subspace and an empirically chosen intervention window (where these directions are strongest and most stable). (iii) Steer: We apply a signed, sparse activation shift targeted to the language neurons. Concretely, within low to mid layers we add a positive steering along the target-language dominant directions and a compensating negative shift toward the null space for the English neurons, yielding controllable target-language defaultness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Neural FOXP2方法，通过定位语言神经元并施加稀疏激活偏移，改变多语言大模型（LLM）的默认语言（如从英语切换为印地语或西班牙语）。方法分为三阶段：利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）定位语言神经元、通过SVD提取可控语言转向方向、以及施加符号化稀疏激活偏移。
Motivation: 多语言LLM在预训练中英语占主导，其他语言虽在参数记忆中但被系统性抑制。现有方法难以在不影响整体性能的情况下安全地改变模型的默认语言。
Method: Neural FOXP2包含三个阶段：（1）定位：训练逐层SAE分解激活，通过logit质量提升量化语言选择性，追溯得到紧凑语言神经元集；（2）转向方向：构建英语到目标语言的激活差异矩阵，进行逐层SVD提取主导奇异方向，利用特征间隙和有效秩谱确定干预窗口；（3）转向：在低中层对目标语言神经元施加正转向，对英语神经元施加负转向（指向零空间），实现可控的默认语言切换。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅描述方法框架。实验预期在Hindi或Spanish上实现默认语言切换。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种机械论可解释的语言控制手段，但摘要未讨论局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: FOCUS: DLLMs Know How to Tame Their Compute Bound
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to Auto-Regressive models, but their deployment is constrained by high decoding cost. In this work, we identify a key inefficiency in DLLM decoding: while computation is parallelized over token blocks, only a small subset of tokens is decodable at each diffusion step, causing most compute to be wasted on non-decodable tokens. We further observe a strong correlation between attention-derived token importance and token-wise decoding probability. Based on this insight, we propose FOCUS, an inference system designed for DLLMs. By dynamically focusing computation on decodable tokens and evicting non-decodable ones on-the-fly, FOCUS increases the effective batch size, alleviating compute limitations and enabling scalable throughput. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FOCUS achieves up to 3.52$\times$ throughput improvement over the production-grade engine LMDeploy in large-batch settings, while preserving or improving generation quality across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析Diffusion大语言模型(DLLM)解码中的低效问题：虽然计算被并行化到token块上，但每个扩散步骤中只有少量token可解码，导致大部分计算浪费。作者发现注意力导出的token重要性与逐token解码概率强相关，据此提出FOCUS推理系统，通过动态聚焦计算于可解码token并驱逐非可解码token，增大有效批大小，提高吞吐量。在LMDeploy上实现高达3.52倍吞吐量提升，且保持或改善生成质量。
Motivation: DLLM的高解码成本限制了部署，现有工作中存在计算效率瓶颈：并行计算token块时，大部分计算消耗在非可解码token上。
Method: 提出FOCUS推理系统，利用注意力导出的token重要性动态聚焦计算于可解码token，实时驱逐非可解码token，从而增大有效批大小。
Result: 在LMDeploy上，大批量设置下实现高达3.52倍吞吐量提升，同时保持或改善多个基准上的生成质量。
Conclusion: 通过动态聚焦可解码token，FOCUS有效缓解DLLM的计算限制，实现可扩展吞吐量。

papers.title: OpenVTON-Bench: A Large-Scale High-Resolution Benchmark for Controllable Virtual Try-On Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly elevated the visual fidelity of Virtual Try-On (VTON) systems, yet reliable evaluation remains a persistent bottleneck. Traditional metrics struggle to quantify fine-grained texture details and semantic consistency, while existing datasets fail to meet commercial standards in scale and diversity. We present OpenVTON-Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 100K high-resolution image pairs (up to $1536 \times 1536$). The dataset is constructed using DINOv3-based hierarchical clustering for semantically balanced sampling and Gemini-powered dense captioning, ensuring a uniform distribution across 20 fine-grained garment categories. To support reliable evaluation, we propose a multi-modal protocol that measures VTON quality along five interpretable dimensions: background consistency, identity fidelity, texture fidelity, shape plausibility, and overall realism. The protocol integrates VLM-based semantic reasoning with a novel Multi-Scale Representation Metric based on SAM3 segmentation and morphological erosion, enabling the separation of boundary alignment errors from internal texture artifacts. Experimental results show strong agreement with human judgments (Kendall's $τ$ of 0.833 vs. 0.611 for SSIM), establishing a robust benchmark for VTON evaluation.
papers.comment: Under review for the NeurIPS 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个大规模高分辨率虚拟试穿基准数据集 OpenVTON-Bench，包含约10万对高分辨率图像（最高1536×1536），通过基于DINOv3的层次聚类和Gemini密集标注构建，覆盖20个细粒度服装类别。同时提出一个多模态评估协议，从背景一致性、身份保真度、纹理保真度、形状合理性和整体真实性五个维度衡量试穿质量，实验表明与人类判断高度一致（Kendall's τ 0.833，对比SSIM的0.611）。
Motivation: 现有虚拟试穿系统视觉保真度提升，但可靠评估仍是瓶颈：传统指标难以量化纹理细节和语义一致性，现有数据集在规模和多样性上达不到商业标准。
Method: 构建OpenVTON-Bench数据集：使用DINOv3层次聚类进行语义平衡采样，结合Gemini生成密集描述，确保20个细粒度服装类别均匀分布。提出多模态评估协议，集成VLM语义推理与基于SAM3分割和形态学腐蚀的多尺度表示指标（Multi-Scale Representation Metric），分离边界对齐误差与内部纹理伪影。
Result: 摘要报告该协议与人类判断的Kendall's τ达0.833，显著优于SSIM的0.611，为虚拟试穿评估建立了稳健基准。
Conclusion: OpenVTON-Bench为虚拟试穿提供了大规模、高分辨率、多样化的基准数据集，多模态评估协议实现了更可靠和可解释的质量度量。

papers.title: A Judge-Aware Ranking Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models without Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on open-ended tasks without ground-truth labels is increasingly done via the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm. A critical but under-modeled issue is that judge LLMs differ substantially in reliability; treating all judges equally can yield biased leaderboards and misleading uncertainty estimates. More data can make evaluation more confidently wrong under misspecified aggregation. We propose a judge-aware ranking framework that extends the Bradley-Terry-Luce model by introducing judge-specific discrimination parameters, jointly estimating latent model quality and judge reliability from pairwise comparisons without reference labels. We establish identifiability up to natural normalizations and prove consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator, enabling confidence intervals for score differences and rank comparisons. Across multiple public benchmarks and a newly collected dataset, our method improves agreement with human preferences, achieves higher data efficiency than unweighted baselines, and produces calibrated uncertainty quantification for LLM rankings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在开放任务中缺乏真实标签时的评估问题，提出一种裁判感知的排名框架。该方法扩展了Bradley-Terry-Luce模型，引入裁判特定的判别参数，通过成对比较联合估计潜在模型质量和裁判可靠性，无需参考标签。论文证明了模型的可识别性、最大似然估计的一致性和渐近正态性，从而能给出分数差异和排名比较的置信区间。在多个公共基准和新数据集上，该方法相比未加权基线改善了与人类偏好的一致性，提高了数据效率，并提供了校准的不确定性量化。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估范式下，不同裁判LLM的可靠性差异很大，但通常被平等对待，导致有偏的排行榜和误导性的不确定性估计。更多数据在错误聚合下反而可能使评估更自信地错误。
Method: 提出一种裁判感知的排名框架，扩展Bradley-Terry-Luce模型，为每个裁判引入一个判别参数，从成对比较中联合估计模型质量和裁判可靠性。建立了模型在自然归一化下的可识别性，并证明了最大似然估计的一致性和渐近正态性，从而可以计算得分差异和排名比较的置信区间。
Result: 在多个公共基准和新收集数据集上，该方法改善了与人类偏好的一致性，比未加权基线具有更高的数据效率，并为LLM排名提供校准的不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式建模裁判可靠性差异，实现了更可靠且具有统计保证的LLM排名评估，特别适用于缺乏真实标签的开放任务。

papers.title: Reliability-Calibrated Edge-IoT Early Fault Warning for Rotating Machinery with a Physics-Guided Tiny-Mamba Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems increasingly rely on distributed vibration sensing to support predictive maintenance of rotating machinery. In practical deployments, however, raw signal upload is costly and alarm decisions must be made locally under limited computation, changing operating conditions, and strict nuisance-alarm budgets. This paper presents a reliability-calibrated edge-IoT early-warning framework, in which a compact Physics-Guided Tiny-Mamba Transformer (PG-TMT) acts as the representation module and an extreme value theory (EVT) layer converts streaming anomaly scores into event-level alarm episodes. PG-TMT combines a depthwise-separable convolutional stem, a Tiny-Mamba state-space branch, and a lightweight local Transformer to capture transient, long-horizon, and multichannel degradation cues under batch-size-one inference. To improve auditability, temporal attention is projected to the frequency domain and softly aligned with analytical bearing fault-order bands. EVT calibration, dual-threshold hysteresis, and trimmed-tail fitting provide controllable false-alarm intensity even when healthy calibration data are imperfect. Experiments on CWRU, Paderborn, XJTU-SY, and an industrial pilot demonstrate that the proposed framework improves PR-AUC, reduces detection delay under a controlled nuisance-alarm budget, and remains robust to structured interference, metadata uncertainty, compound fault mixtures, and domain transfer. With a sub-1 MB footprint and Jetson p99 latency below 7 ms, the framework supports calibrated and interpretable early warnings for IIoT predictive maintenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业物联网中旋转机械的早期故障预警，提出一个可靠性校准的边缘计算框架，核心是物理引导的紧凑型Tiny-Mamba Transformer (PG-TMT) 和极值理论 (EVT) 层。在CWRU、Paderborn、XJTU-SY和工业试点数据集上，该框架在受控误报预算下提升了PR-AUC，降低了检测延迟，模型小于1MB，Jetson端p99延迟低于7ms。
Motivation: 现有IIoT预测性维护面临原始信号上传成本高、本地计算资源有限、工况变化大及误报率要求严格等挑战，缺乏一种同时满足轻量、可校准和可解释性的边缘预警方案。
Method: 提出PG-TMT模块，结合深度可分离卷积、Tiny-Mamba状态空间分支和轻量局部Transformer以捕获瞬态、长周期和多通道退化特征；将时间注意力投影到频域并与轴承故障阶次带对齐；通过EVT校准、双阈值滞后和修剪尾部拟合控制误报率。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法提升了PR-AUC，在受控误报预算下缩短了检测延迟，并对结构化干扰、元数据不确定性、复合故障和域迁移具有鲁棒性；模型体积<1MB，Jetson p99延迟低于7ms。
Conclusion: 该框架为IIoT预测性维护提供了可校准、可解释且适合边缘部署的早期故障预警方案。

papers.title: Robust Privacy: Inference-Stage Privacy through Certified Robustness
papers.abstract_en: An adversary observing a model's released prediction can infer sensitive attributes of the queried input, or even reconstruct representatives of the model's training data. The inference interface thus acts as a side channel for privacy leakage. We introduce Robust Privacy (RP), an inference-stage privacy notion inspired by certified robustness: if a model's prediction is provably invariant within a radius-R neighborhood around an input x with confidence at least $1-α$, then x enjoys $(R,α)$-Robust Privacy, under which we prove that any adversary observing the released prediction has at most $α/2$ advantage in distinguishing x from any input within distance R of x. Building on RP, we formalize Robust Attribute Privacy (RAP), an attribute-level privacy notion that characterizes the set of sensitive-attribute values that remain compatible with a released prediction. On a classification task, RP increases the median length of the RAP-compatible inference interval from 23.50 to 29.96, reducing attribute-inference precision. Model inversion attacks, often treated as a training-stage threat, in fact rely on fine-grained signals leaked through the inference interface; RP masks these signals at the inference stage, reducing attack success rate (ASR) from 73% to 4% on a black-box inversion attack. This direct targeting of the leakage channel enables RP to dominate DP-SGD and randomized response in the privacy-utility tradeoff space: RP retains 98.4% accuracy at 21% ASR, whereas DP-SGD must drop accuracy to 61.7% to reach a comparable ASR. Across both experiments, increasing the smoothing sample size N strengthens privacy and improves utility together. Finally, we examine model distillation as a scope boundary and show that RP mitigates attribute-level and instance-level inference-stage privacy leakage, but not function-level extraction through model distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robust Privacy (RP)，一种受 certified robustness 启发的推理阶段隐私概念。通过在输入 x 的半径 R 邻域内保证预测不变，使得对手区分 x 与邻域内任何输入的优势不超过 α/2。在此基础上形式化 Robust Attribute Privacy (RAP)，描述与预测兼容的敏感属性值集合。实验表明，RP 将模型反转攻击成功率从73%降至4%，并在隐私-效用权衡上优于 DP-SGD 和随机响应，保留98.4%准确率同时达到21%攻击成功率。
Motivation: 现有隐私保护方法多关注训练阶段，而推理阶段通过预测结果泄露敏感属性的问题尚未被充分解决，对手可利用预测输出推断输入中敏感属性甚至重建训练数据，形成侧信道隐私泄露。
Method: 引入 Robust Privacy (RP) 概念，基于 certified robustness：若模型在输入 x 的半径 R 邻域内预测以至少 1-α 置信度保持不变，则 x 享有 (R,α)-Robust Privacy。在此基础上形式化 Robust Attribute Privacy (RAP)，并通过随机平滑等机制保证预测不变性。
Result: 在分类任务上，RP 将 RAP 兼容推理区间中位数从23.50增至29.96；黑盒模型反转攻击成功率从73%降至4%；在21%攻击成功率下保留98.4%准确率，而 DP-SGD 需降至61.7%准确率才能达到类似攻击成功率。增大平滑样本量 N 可同时提升隐私和效用。
Conclusion: RP 是一种有效的推理阶段隐私保护方法，能直接屏蔽推理接口泄露的细粒度信号，在隐私-效用权衡上优于现有方法。但存在局限性：不能防止通过模型蒸馏进行的函数级提取。

papers.title: An XAI View on Explainable ASP: Methods, Systems, and Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Answer Set Programming (ASP) is a popular declarative reasoning and problem solving approach in symbolic AI. Its rule-based formalism makes it inherently attractive for explainable and interpretive reasoning, which is gaining importance with the surge of Explainable AI (XAI). A number of explanation approaches and tools for ASP have been developed, which often tackle specific explanatory settings and may not cover all scenarios that ASP users encounter. In this survey, we provide, guided by an XAI perspective, an overview of types of ASP explanations in connection with user questions for explanation, and describe their coverage by current theory and tools. Furthermore, we pinpoint gaps in existing ASP explanations approaches and identify research directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从可解释人工智能（XAI）视角，综述了回答集编程（ASP）中的解释方法、系统和视角。ASP作为一种符号AI中的声明式推理和问题求解方法，其基于规则的形式化天然适用于可解释和推理。文章梳理了与用户解释问题相关的ASP解释类型，评估了当前理论和工具覆盖情况，并指出未来研究方向。
Motivation: 随着XAI兴起，ASP的解释性受到关注，但现有解释方法往往针对特定场景，缺乏系统性分类和覆盖度评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，从XAI视角全面审视ASP解释。
Method: 采用综述方法，基于XAI分类学，将ASP解释类型与用户提问场景进行映射，分析现有理论与工具的支持程度。
Result: 识别出当前ASP解释方法在覆盖用户问题类型上的差距，并提出了若干未来研究方向。
Conclusion: ASP解释领域仍存在诸多未覆盖场景，需要结合XAI进展发展更全面的解释框架。

papers.title: Intermittent time series forecasting: local vs global models
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting intermittent time series, which contain zeros, is a crucial challenge in supply chains as inventory policies require probabilistic forecasts to establish safety levels. Intermittent time series are commonly forecast using local models, trained individually on each time series. In the last years global models, trained on a large collection of time series, have become popular for time series forecasting. Global models are often based on neural networks or gradient boosted trees. We carry out the first study comparing state-of-the-art probabilistic local and global models on intermittent time series. For global models we consider three different distribution heads suitable for intermittent time series: negative binomial, hurdle-shifted negative binomial and Tweedie. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of the latter two with neural networks. We perform experiments on five datasets comprising overall more than 40'000 real-world time series. Among global models, TiDE, a simple neural network architecture, achieves the best accuracy; it also consistently outperforms local models and has lower computational requirements. Large global models are instead much more computationally demanding and less accurate. Among the distribution heads, the Tweedie provides the best estimates of the highest quantiles.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Journal of the Operational Research Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统比较了间歇性时间序列（含零值序列）的概率预测中局部模型与全局模型的性能。全局模型TiDE（简单神经网络架构）在五个真实数据集（总计超过4万条序列）上持续优于局部模型，且计算需求更低；Tweedie分布头对高分位数估计最佳。
Motivation: 间歇性时间序列预测在供应链中至关重要，但此前缺乏对最先进的局部与全局概率预测模型的系统比较。
Method: 对比了局部模型与全局模型（基于神经网络或梯度提升树），为全局模型设计了三种适用于间歇性序列的分布头：负二项、Hurdle-移位负二项和Tweedie分布，其中后两种首次用于神经网络。
Result: 全局模型TiDE在所有数据集上准确率最高且计算成本最低；大型全局模型计算昂贵但精度较差；Tweedie分布头在高分位数估计上最优。
Conclusion: 简洁的全局模型（如TiDE）在间歇性时间序列预测中更有效，Tweedie分布适合处理零膨胀数据。

papers.title: CoVar: Confidence-Variance-Guided Pseudo-Label Selection for Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-label selection in semi-supervised learning is commonly driven by maximum-confidence thresholds, yet confidence alone can be unreliable under model overconfidence and class imbalance. We propose CoVar, a confidence--variance framework that assesses pseudo-label reliability by jointly modeling Maximum Confidence (MC) and Residual-Class Variance (RCV). Starting from entropy minimization, we derive a second-order cross-entropy approximation showing that low-loss pseudo-labels are favored when MC is high and RCV is low, with a confidence-dependent penalty that becomes stronger for near-certain predictions. Based on this criterion, CoVar embeds predictions into a two-dimensional confidence--variance space and uses SVD-based spectral relaxation to separate reliable and unreliable predictions without hand-tuned confidence thresholds. Cluster-wise Gaussian weighting then converts this separation into per-sample training weights. The resulting weights can be integrated into existing semi-supervised segmentation and classification pipelines during training and introduce no inference-time overhead. Experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012, Cityscapes, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and STL-10 show clear gains on VOC and Cityscapes under matched backbones, as well as competitive or improved error rates on standard classification benchmarks. These results indicate that residual-class dispersion provides a useful signal complementary to confidence for robust pseudo-label selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoVar框架，通过联合建模最大置信度（MC）和残差类方差（RCV）来评估伪标签可靠性，用于半监督学习。该方法利用SVD谱松弛将预测映射到置信-方差空间，并通过聚类高斯加权生成训练权重，无需手动阈值。实验在语义分割和分类基准上取得提升。
Motivation: 现有伪标签选择常依赖最大置信度阈值，但在模型过自信和类别不平衡时不可靠，需要更鲁棒的可靠性评估信号。
Method: 从熵最小化出发，推导二阶交叉熵近似，显示低损失伪标签在MC高且RCV低时被偏好。将预测嵌入二维置信-方差空间，使用SVD谱松弛分离可靠与不可靠预测，再通过聚类高斯加权转换为训练权重。
Result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012、Cityscapes、CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、STL-10上实验，在VOC和Cityscapes上取得明显提升，在标准分类基准上获得竞争性或更低的错误率。
Conclusion: 残差类分散度是置信度的有用补充信号，可提升半监督学习中伪标签选择的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Reverse Flow Matching: A Unified Framework for Online Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion and Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow policies are gaining prominence in online reinforcement learning (RL) due to their expressive power, yet training them efficiently remains a critical challenge. A fundamental difficulty that distinguishes online RL from standard generative modeling is the lack of direct samples from the target Boltzmann distribution defined by the Q-function. To address this, two seemingly distinct families of methods have been proposed for diffusion policies: a noise-expectation family, which uses a weighted average of noise as the training target, and a gradient-expectation family, which employs a weighted average of Q-function gradients. However, it remains unclear how these objectives are formally related, or whether they can be synthesized into a more general formulation. In this paper, we propose a unified framework, reverse flow matching (RFM), which rigorously addresses the problem of training diffusion and flow models without direct target samples. By adopting a reverse inferential perspective, we formulate the training target as a posterior mean estimation problem given an intermediate noisy sample. Crucially, we introduce Langevin Stein operators to construct zero-mean control variates, deriving a general class of estimators that share the same expectation. We show that existing noise-expectation and gradient-expectation methods are simply two specific instances within this broader class. This unified view yields two key advancements: it extends the capability of targeting Boltzmann distributions from diffusion to flow policies, and it enables the principled combination of Q-value and Q-gradient information to form an effective estimator, thereby improving training efficiency and stability. We instantiate RFM to train a flow policy in online RL and demonstrate improved performance on continuous-control benchmarks compared to diffusion policy baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架reverse flow matching (RFM)，用于在线强化学习中训练扩散和流策略。通过将训练目标转化为后验均值估计问题，并引入Langevin Stein算子构造零均值控制变量，推导出一类共享相同期望的通用估计器。现有噪声期望和梯度期望方法被视为该框架的特例。RFM将玻尔兹曼分布目标从扩散策略扩展到流策略，并允许联合利用Q值和Q梯度信息提高训练效率。在连续控制基准上，RFM训练的流策略优于扩散策略基线。
Motivation: 在线强化学习中的扩散和流策略训练面临缺乏目标玻尔兹曼分布直接样本的难题；已有两类方法（噪声期望和梯度期望）之间的关系不明确，且缺乏统一的理论框架。
Method: 提出reverse flow matching (RFM)，采用反向推断视角将训练目标表述为后验均值估计问题，利用Langevin Stein算子构造零均值控制变量导出一族估计器，统一了已有方法并允许组合Q值和Q梯度信息。
Result: 在连续控制基准任务上，RFM训练的流策略比扩散策略基线获得更好的性能，展示出更优的训练效率和稳定性。
Conclusion: RFM为训练扩散和流策略提供了统一框架，并展示了利用Q值和Q梯度联合估计的有效性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架reverse flow matching (RFM)，用于在线强化学习中训练扩散和流策略。通过将训练目标转化为后验均值估计问题，并引入Langevin Stein算子构造零均值控制变量，推导出一类共享相同期望的通用估计器。现有噪声期望和梯度期望方法被视为该框架的特例。RFM将玻尔兹曼分布目标从扩散策略扩展到流策略，并允许联合利用Q值和Q梯度信息提高训练效率。在连续控制基准上，RFM训练的流策略优于扩散策略基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 在线强化学习中的扩散和流策略训练面临缺乏目标玻尔兹曼分布直接样本的难题；已有两类方法（噪声期望和梯度期望）之间的关系不明确，且缺乏统一的理论框架。
summary_sections.method: 提出reverse flow matching (RFM)，采用反向推断视角将训练目标表述为后验均值估计问题，利用Langevin Stein算子构造零均值控制变量导出一族估计器，统一了已有方法并允许组合Q值和Q梯度信息。
summary_sections.result: 在连续控制基准任务上，RFM训练的流策略比扩散策略基线获得更好的性能，展示出更优的训练效率和稳定性。
summary_sections.conclusion: RFM为训练扩散和流策略提供了统一框架，并展示了利用Q值和Q梯度联合估计的有效性。

papers.title: Precomputing Multi-Agent Path Replanning Using Temporal Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: Executing a multi-agent plan can be challenging when an agent is delayed, because this typically creates conflicts with other agents. So, we need to quickly find a new safe plan. Replanning only the delayed agent often does not yield an efficient plan, and sometimes cannot even yield a feasible one. On the other hand, replanning other agents may lead to a cascade of changes and delays, and it is computationally expensive. We show how to efficiently replan a single delayed agent by tracking and using the temporal flexibility of other agents while avoiding cascading delays. This flexibility is the maximum delay that the agent can take without changing the order with agents other than the initially delayed agent, or further delaying other agents. Our algorithm, FlexSIPP, precomputes all possible plans for the delayed agent and returns the changes to the other agents within the given scenario. We demonstrate our method in a real-world case study of replanning trains in the densely-used Dutch railway network and in the MovingAI MAPF benchmark set. Our experiments show that FlexSIPP provides effective solutions relevant to real-world adjustments, and within a reasonable timeframe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多智能体计划执行中单个智能体延迟导致的冲突问题，本文提出 FlexSIPP 算法，通过预先计算延迟智能体的所有可能计划并利用其他智能体的时间灵活性（即不改变与其他智能体顺序或不进一步延迟其他智能体的最大延迟量），避免级联重规划。在荷兰铁路网络实际案例和 MovingAI MAPF 基准测试中，FlexSIPP 能在合理时间内提供有效的解决方案。
Motivation: 现有重规划方法要么只重规划延迟智能体导致效率低或不可行，要么重规划所有智能体引发级联延迟和高计算成本，需要一种兼顾效率与可行性的单智能体重规划方法。
Method: 提出 FlexSIPP 算法，预先计算延迟智能体的所有可能计划，并利用其他智能体的时间灵活性（即最大可延迟量而不改变与延迟智能体之外的顺序或进一步延迟其他智能体），在给定场景下返回对其他智能体的最小改动。
Result: 在荷兰铁路网络实际案例和 MovingAI MAPF 基准测试中，FlexSIPP 能在合理时间内提供有效的解决方案，适用于实际调整场景。
Conclusion: 实验表明 FlexSIPP 提供了与实际调整相关的有效解决方案，并在合理时间范围内完成。

papers.title: Steering the Noise: Turning Random Perturbations into Effective Descent for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) achieves strong performance but is often limited by the memory overhead of backpropagation. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization avoids this overhead by estimating gradients through forward passes alone, yet it typically converges slowly because random Gaussian perturbations yield high-variance gradient estimates in high-dimensional parameter spaces. In this paper, we propose a plug-and-play framework that turns random perturbations into more effective descent directions. The key idea is to draw a small pool of candidate perturbations, evaluate their loss values, and then select or combine those that are best aligned with the optimization objective. We develop two instantiations of this idea: MeZO-GV, which forms a guiding vector from the contrast between low-loss and high-loss perturbation groups, and MeZO-Greedy, which keeps the single best perturbation within a fixed evaluation budget. We theoretically show that both strategies yield a larger per-step reduction in the objective than standard ZO estimation, leading to improved convergence rates. Experiments on LLMs of different scales and architectures confirm that the proposed methods integrate naturally with existing ZO optimizers and consistently improve convergence speed and task accuracy. On OPT-13B, our approach outperforms all ZO baselines across 11 benchmarks and exceeds gradient-based methods on 9 of them, while retaining the memory efficiency of forward-only optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的零阶优化框架，通过小规模候选扰动池生成更有效的下降方向，用于大语言模型的内存高效微调。具体包括两种实例化：MeZO-GV（基于低损与高损组对比形成引导向量）和MeZO-Greedy（保留单个最佳扰动）。理论上证明每步目标函数降低大于标准零阶估计，实验在OPT-13B上超越所有零阶基线并在9/11基准上超过梯度方法。
Motivation: 零阶优化通过前向传播估计梯度可避免反向传播的内存开销，但高维参数空间中随机高斯扰动导致高方差梯度估计，收敛缓慢。
Method: 生成小规模候选扰动池，评估其损失值，然后选择或组合与优化目标最对齐的扰动。实例包括MeZO-GV（对比低损与高损组）和MeZO-Greedy（固定预算内保留最佳扰动）。
Result: 理论上证明每步目标函数降低大于标准零阶估计；实验在OPT-13B上超越所有零阶基线，并在9/11基准上超过梯度方法，同时保持只向前传播的内存效率。
Conclusion: 所提框架可自然集成到现有零阶优化器中，一致提升收敛速度和任务准确率，为内存高效微调提供有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Higher order PCA-like rotation-invariant features for detailed shape descriptors modulo rotation
papers.abstract_en: PCA can be used for rotation invariant features, describing a shape with its $p_{ab}=E[(x_i-E[x_a])(x_b-E[x_b])]$ covariance matrix approximating shape by ellipsoid, allowing for rotation invariants like its traces of powers. However, real shapes are usually much more complicated, hence there is proposed its extension to e.g. $p_{abc}=E[(x_a-E[x_a])(x_b-E[x_b])(x_c-E[x_c])]$ order-3 or higher tensors describing central moments, or polynomial times Gaussian allowing decodable shape descriptors of arbitrarily high accuracy, and their analogous rotation invariants. Its practical applications could be rotation-invariant features to include shape modulo rotation e.g. for molecular shape descriptors, or for up to rotation object recognition in 2D images/3D scans maybe also for 3D scene understanding, or shape similarity metric allowing inexpensive comparison of objects modulo rotation avoiding costly optimization over rotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将PCA扩展到高阶张量（如三阶矩）和多项式乘高斯，构造旋转不变的形状描述子，可任意高精度地描述形状的细节。方法基于中心矩的高阶张量和多项式乘高斯核，推导出相应的旋转不变量，用于分子形状描述、2D/3D物体识别等任务，避免对旋转进行优化搜索。
Motivation: 标准PCA使用协方差矩阵将形状近似为椭球，但真实形状通常更复杂，需要更高阶矩来捕捉细节，因此需要扩展PCA以获取更丰富的旋转不变特征。
Method: 提出使用中心矩的高阶张量（如三阶张量 p_abc）和多项式乘高斯核，构造可解码的高精度形状描述子，并推导其旋转不变量。
Result: 方法可实现任意高精度的形状描述，且避免了对旋转的优化搜索，但摘要中未提供具体的定量结果。
Conclusion: 该方法潜在应用于分子形状描述和旋转不变物体识别（如2D图像、3D扫描等），提供了一种无需旋转优化的形状相似度度量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry of Reason: Spectral Signatures of Valid Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Verifying whether a language model is genuinely reasoning or pattern-matching remains an open problem: learned verifiers are expensive, and output-based heuristics are brittle. We show that valid mathematical reasoning induces a measurable, training-free spectral signature in transformer attention. By treating each attention matrix as a weighted token graph, we extract four diagnostics: Fiedler value, High-Frequency Energy Ratio (HFER), spectral entropy, and smoothness, that require no learned parameters. Experiments across seven models from four architectural families yield effect sizes up to Cohen's $d = 3.30$ ($p < 10^{-116}$), enabling $85$--$96\%$ single-threshold classification accuracy. Two findings sharpen the interpretation. First, \emph{Platonic validity}: the spectral signal tracks logical coherence rather than compiler acceptance, proofs rejected for timeouts or missing imports are correctly classified as valid, a distinction confirmed by a manual audit ($κ= 0.82$, $n = 51$). Second, \emph{architectural determinism}: Sliding Window Attention shifts the discriminative feature from HFER to smoothness ($d = 2.09$, $p < 10^{-48}$), showing that attention design governs which spectral channel encodes reasoning quality. Causal ablation confirms the signature traces induction-head circuits. The method generalises to informal chain-of-thought ($d = 0.78$, $p < 10^{-3}$), and in proof search, HFER reranking improves Best-of-16 Pass@1 by $+4.4$--$6.6$\%, matching $98\%$ of the AUC of fully supervised probes with zero labels. Spectral graph analysis is a principled, architecture-aware primitive for reasoning verification.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, Accepted at ICML 2026 (main track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明有效数学推理会在Transformer注意力中产生可测量的频谱特征（Fiedler值、高频能量比、频谱熵和平滑度），无需学习参数。在七个模型上，分类准确率达85-96%，效应量Cohen's d最高3.30。发现频谱信号追踪逻辑连贯性而非编译器接受度，且注意力架构决定哪个频谱通道编码推理质量。因果消融表明该信号源于归纳头电路。该方法可泛化到非正式思维链，并在证明搜索中，HFER重排序使Best-of-16 Pass@1提升4.4-6.6%。
Motivation: 现有方法难以区分语言模型是真正推理还是模式匹配：学习型验证器成本高，基于输出的启发式方法脆弱。需要一种训练自由、架构感知的推理验证方法。
Method: 将每个注意力矩阵视为加权词图，提取四个频谱诊断量：Fiedler值、高频能量比（HFER）、频谱熵和平滑度，无需学习参数。通过因果消融验证信号源于归纳头电路。
Result: 在七个模型上，单阈值分类准确率85-96%，p值<10^{-116}；HFER重排序在证明搜索中提升Best-of-16 Pass@1达4.4-6.6%；频谱信号在手动审核中与逻辑连贯性高度一致（κ=0.82）。
Conclusion: 频谱图分析是一种原则性、架构感知的推理验证原始方法，可匹配完全监督探针98%的AUC，且零标签。

papers.title: Causal Emotion Recognition in Conversation: Context Saturation and Discourse-Marker Evidence
papers.abstract_en: We address two persistent gaps in Emotion Recognition in Conversation: which modeling choices materially affect performance, and how recognition findings connect to interpretable discourse-level patterns. We study both through a systematic investigation on IEMOCAP with cross-dataset validation on MELD. For recognition, we run controlled ablations with 10 random seeds and paired significance tests with multiple-comparisons correction, yielding three findings. First, conversational context is the dominant factor, but performance saturates quickly: roughly 90% of the gain is captured within the most recent 10-30 preceding turns, depending on the label set. Second, hierarchical sentence representations help most in utterance-only settings and show a clear advantage on MELD, but their benefit disappears once turn-level context is available, suggesting that conversational history subsumes much of the intra-utterance structure. Third, integrating an external affective lexicon does not improve results, consistent with pretrained encoders already capturing most of the affective signal needed for ERC. Under a strictly causal setting, our simple models achieve strong performance (82.69% 4-way; 67.07% 6-way weighted F1), showing that competitive accuracy is achievable without future turns. For linguistic analysis, we examine 5,286 discourse-marker occurrences and find a reliable association between emotion and marker position (p < .0001). Sad utterances show reduced left-periphery marker usage (21.9%) relative to other emotions (28-32%), consistent with accounts linking left-periphery markers to active discourse management. This aligns with our recognition results, where Sad benefits most from conversational context (+22 percentage points), suggesting sadness may be more context-dependent than emotions with stronger local pragmatic cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了对话情感识别中的两个关键问题：哪些建模选择真正影响性能，以及识别结果如何与可解释的话语层面模式关联。通过在IEMOCAP上的受控消融实验和MELD的跨数据集验证，发现对话上下文是主导因素但性能在最近10-30句内饱和；层级句子表示在仅话语设置中有优势但被上下文替代；外部情感词典无改进。语言分析显示情感与话语标记位置显著相关，悲伤更依赖上下文。
Motivation: 对话情感识别中，现有研究缺乏对建模选择系统性的因果分析，且识别结果与话语层面可解释模式的联系尚不明确。
Method: 采用受控消融实验（10个随机种子、配对显著性检验、多重比较校正）研究上下文窗口大小、层级表示、外部词典等建模选择，并对5286个话语标记进行位置与情感关联分析。
Result: 上下文在10-30句内饱和（捕获约90%增益）；层级表示在仅话语设置有效但加入上下文后优势消失；词典无改进；简单因果模型在严格因果设置下达到82.69%（4-way）和67.07%（6-way）加权F1；悲伤话语左边界标记使用减少（21.9% vs 其他28-32%），且悲伤从上下文中获益最大（+22个百分点）。
Conclusion: 对话上下文是情感识别的关键，但存在饱和效应；简单模型在因果设置下即可取得强性能；情感与话语标记位置存在可靠关联，悲伤更依赖上下文的发现与识别结果一致。

summary_sections.motivation: 对话情感识别中，现有研究缺乏对建模选择系统性的因果分析，且识别结果与话语层面可解释模式的联系尚不明确。
summary_sections.method: 采用受控消融实验（10个随机种子、配对显著性检验、多重比较校正）研究上下文窗口大小、层级表示、外部词典等建模选择，并对5286个话语标记进行位置与情感关联分析。
summary_sections.result: 上下文在10-30句内饱和（捕获约90%增益）；层级表示在仅话语设置有效但加入上下文后优势消失；词典无改进；简单因果模型在严格因果设置下达到82.69%（4-way）和67.07%（6-way）加权F1；悲伤话语左边界标记使用减少（21.9% vs 其他28-32%），且悲伤从上下文中获益最大（+22个百分点）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对话上下文是情感识别的关键，但存在饱和效应；简单模型在因果设置下即可取得强性能；情感与话语标记位置存在可靠关联，悲伤更依赖上下文的发现与识别结果一致。

papers.title: Unifying Learning Dynamics and Generalization in Transformers Scaling Law
papers.abstract_en: The scaling law, a cornerstone of Large Language Model (LLM) development, predicts improvements in model performance with increasing computational resources. Yet, while empirically validated, its theoretical underpinnings remain poorly understood. This work formalizes the learning dynamics of transformer-based language models as an ordinary differential equation (ODE) system, then approximates this process to kernel behaviors. Departing from prior toy-model analyses, we rigorously analyze stochastic gradient descent (SGD) training for multi-layer transformers on sequence-to-sequence data with arbitrary data distribution, closely mirroring real-world conditions. Our analysis characterizes the convergence of generalization error to the irreducible risk as computational resources scale with data, especially during the optimization process. We establish matching upper and lower bounds on the excess risk, characterized by a distinct phase transition. In the initial optimization phase, the excess risk decays exponentially relative to the computational cost ${\sf C}$. However, once a specific resource allocation threshold is crossed, the system enters a statistical phase, where the generalization error follows a power-law decay of $Θ(\mathsf{C}^{-1/7})$. These rates are certified by complementary lower bounds -- statistical, via an information-theoretic two-point reduction, and optimization-side, via a first-order oracle argument -- rendering the two-stage law tight up to constants, logarithmic factors, and a condition-number gap. Beyond this unified framework, our theory derives isolated scaling laws for model size, training time, and dataset size, elucidating how each variable independently governs the bounds of generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将 Transformer 语言模型的缩放律建立在学习动态的理论基础上，将训练过程形式化为常微分方程 (ODE) 系统，并近似为核行为。通过对多层 Transformer 在序列到序列数据上的随机梯度下降 (SGD) 训练进行严格分析，证明了泛化误差随计算资源扩展时存在相变：初始阶段超额风险指数衰减，之后遵循幂律衰减 Θ(C^{-1/7})，且上下界紧。
Motivation: 缩放律在 LLM 开发中经验有效，但其理论根基尚不清晰，尤其缺乏对实际条件下多层 Transformer 真实训练动态的分析。
Method: 将 Transformer 学习动态形式化为 ODE 系统并近似为核行为；使用 SGD 理论分析泛化误差收敛，推导出模型规模、训练时间和数据集大小的独立缩放律。
Result: 证明泛化误差收敛至不可约风险，超额风险存在两阶段：初始指数衰减，之后幂律 decay Θ(C^{-1/7})；上下界匹配，仅差常数、对数因子和条件数间隔。
Conclusion: 统一了计算资源与泛化误差的缩放关系，揭示相变现象，并给出各资源维度的独立缩放律。

papers.title: MPK: A Compiler and Runtime for Mega-Kernelizing Tensor Programs
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK), the first compiler and runtime system that automatically transforms multi-GPU model inference into a single high-performance mega-kernel. MPK introduces an SM-level graph representation that captures data dependencies at the granularity of individual streaming multiprocessors (SMs), enabling cross-operator software pipelining, \rev{fine-grained overlap of computation and communication, and other optimizations that are infeasible under the conventional kernel-per-operator execution model}. The MPK compiler lowers tensor programs into optimized SM-level task graphs and generates fast CUDA implementations for each task, while the MPK in-kernel parallel runtime executes these tasks within a single persistent mega-kernel using decentralized scheduling across SMs. Together, these components provide end-to-end kernel fusion with minimal developer effort, while preserving the flexibility of existing programming models. Our evaluation shows that MPK significantly outperforms existing kernel-per-operator LLM serving systems, achieving up to 1.7$\times$ lower end-to-end inference latency and pushing LLM inference performance close to the limits of the underlying hardware. MPK is publicly available at https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK)，首个自动将多 GPU 模型推理转换为单个高性能 mega-kernel 的编译器和运行时系统。MPK 引入 SM 级图表示，捕获流多处理器粒度上的数据依赖，支持跨算子软件流水线、计算与通信的细粒度重叠等优化。编译器将张量程序优化为 SM 级任务图并生成快速 CUDA 实现，运行时在单个持久 mega-kernel 内利用跨 SM 的分布式调度执行任务。评估显示 MPK 相比现有按算子执行 LLM 服务系统，端到端推理延迟最高降低 1.7 倍，接近硬件极限。
Motivation: 传统按算子执行 (kernel-per-operator) 模型在多 GPU 推理中缺乏跨算子优化机会，导致低效。现有方法难以自动实现细粒度的算子融合与计算通信重叠。
Method: 提出 SM 级图表示，在流多处理器粒度上建模数据依赖；编译器据此生成优化任务图与 CUDA 实现；运行时通过跨 SM 分布式调度在单个持久 mega-kernel 中执行所有任务。
Result: 在 LLM 推理上对比现有系统，端到端延迟降低最高 1.7 倍，逼近硬件性能上限。
Conclusion: MPK 提供端到端核融合，最小化开发工作量，同时保留编程模型灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RSTR: Reducing SpatioTemporal Redundancy in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high computational costs. We identify two sources of redundancy. First, temporal redundancy: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) applies costly dual forward passes at every timestep, yet guidance matters only at specific steps, and variable scales at critical steps can compensate for skipping others. Second, spatial redundancy: under variable guidance, different transformer blocks exhibit heterogeneous sensitivity, yet uniform calibration across all blocks wastes computation while failing to address their varying requirements. We present RSTR, the first framework to jointly reduce spatiotemporal redundancy in diffusion transformers. Stage-1 addresses temporal redundancy through evolutionary search, discovering sparse guidance schedules with variable scales. Stage-2 addresses spatial redundancy through adaptive rank allocation, assigning calibration capacities to transformer regions based on their sensitivity. Experiments on DiT-XL/2, PixArt-$α$, FLUX, and state-of-the-art Qwen-Image demonstrate 50%-70% compute savings while maintaining or improving quality. On DiT-XL/2, RSTR achieves 57% savings with 15% FID improvement; on Qwen-Image, 3.43$\times$ speedup with preserved quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSTR框架，联合减少扩散Transformer（DiTs）中的时空冗余。第一阶段通过进化搜索发现稀疏引导调度和可变缩放因子，减少分类器自由引导（CFG）的时序冗余；第二阶段通过自适应秩分配，根据Transformer区域敏感性分配校准容量，减少空间冗余。在DiT-XL/2、PixArt-α、FLUX和Qwen-Image上，实现50%-70%计算节省，同时保持或提升生成质量。在DiT-XL/2上，节省57%计算并改善FID 15%。
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）图像生成计算成本高，存在时序冗余（CFG在每个时间步做双前向传播，但引导仅在特定步骤必要）和空间冗余（不同Transformer块对可变引导的敏感性不同，而均匀校准浪费计算）。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用进化搜索生成稀疏引导调度和可变缩放因子；第二阶段根据敏感性对Transformer区域自适应分配秩（校准容量）。
Result: 在DiT-XL/2、PixArt-α、FLUX和Qwen-Image上，计算节省50%-70%，质量保持或提升。DiT-XL/2上节省57%计算，FID改善15%；Qwen-Image上加速3.43倍，质量不变。
Conclusion: RSTR是首个联合减少扩散Transformer时空冗余的框架，通过稀疏引导调度和自适应秩分配实现高效生成。

papers.title: Towards Deep Learning Surrogate for the Forward Problem in Electrocardiology: A Scalable Alternative to Physics-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: The forward problem in electrocardiology, computing body surface potentials from cardiac electrical activity, is traditionally solved using physics-based models such as the bidomain or monodomain equations. While accurate, these approaches are computationally expensive, limiting their use in real-time and large-scale clinical applications. We propose a proof-of-concept deep learning (DL) framework as an efficient surrogate for forward solvers. The model adopts a time-dependent, attention-based sequence-to-sequence architecture to predict electrocardiogram (ECG) signals from cardiac voltage propagation maps. A hybrid loss combining Huber loss with a spectral entropy term was introduced to preserve both temporal and frequency-domain fidelity. Using 2D tissue simulations incorporating healthy, fibrotic, and gap junction-remodelled conditions, the model achieved high accuracy (mean $R^2 = 0.99 \pm 0.01$). Ablation studies confirmed the contributions of convolutional encoders, time-aware attention, and spectral entropy loss. These findings highlight DL as a scalable, cost-effective alternative to physics-based solvers, with potential for clinical and digital twin applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于注意力的序列到序列深度学习框架作为心电学正问题（从心脏电活动到体表电位）的替代模型。使用Huber损失和频谱熵混合损失，在2D组织模拟（健康、纤维化、缝隙连接重塑）上达到平均R^2=0.99±0.01。展示了深度学习作为可扩展、成本效益高的替代方案的潜力。
Motivation: 传统基于物理的模型（如bidomain方程）准确但计算昂贵，限制了实时和大规模临床应用。需要更高效的替代方法。
Method: 采用时间依赖的注意力序列到序列架构，输入心脏电压传播图，输出心电图信号。损失函数结合Huber损失和频谱熵项以保持时频域保真度。
Result: 在2D组织模拟中平均R^2=0.99±0.01。消融研究证实了卷积编码器、时间注意力、频谱熵损失的贡献。
Conclusion: 深度学习作为可扩展、成本效益高的替代方案，有潜力用于临床和数字孪生应用。

papers.title: SEDULity: A Proof-of-Learning Framework for Distributed and Secure Blockchains with Efficient Useful Work
papers.abstract_en: The security and decentralization of Proof-of-Work (PoW) have been well-tested in existing blockchain systems. However, its tremendous energy waste has raised concerns about sustainability. Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW) aims to redirect the meaningless computation to meaningful tasks such as solving machine learning (ML) problems, giving rise to the branch of Proof-of-Learning (PoL). While previous studies have proposed various PoLs, they all, to some degree, suffer from security, decentralization, or efficiency issues. In this paper, we propose a PoL framework that trains ML models efficiently while maintaining blockchain security in a fully distributed manner. We name the framework SEDULity, which stands for a Secure, Efficient, Distributed, and Useful Learning-based blockchain system. Specifically, we encode the template block into the training process and design a useful function that is difficult to solve but relatively easy to verify, as a substitute for the PoW puzzle. We show that our framework is distributed, secure, and efficiently trains ML models. We further demonstrate that the proposed PoL framework can be extended to other types of useful work and design an incentive mechanism to incentivize task verification. We show theoretically that a rational miner is incentivized to train fully honestly with well-designed system parameters. Finally, we present simulation results to demonstrate the performance of our framework and validate our analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为SEDULity的Proof-of-Learning (PoL)框架，旨在在完全分布式环境中高效训练机器学习模型，同时保持区块链的安全性和去中心化。该框架将模板块编码到训练过程中，设计一个难解易验的有用函数替代PoW谜题，并支持扩展到其他类型的有用工作，通过激励机制促使矿工诚实训练。理论分析和仿真验证了框架的性能。
Motivation: 现有PoW浪费能源，而PoUW虽试图重定向计算到有用任务，但已有PoL方案在安全性、去中心化或效率方面存在缺陷。
Method: 提出SEDULity框架，将模板块编码到训练过程，设计一个难解易验的有用函数作为PoW替代，并设计激励机制鼓励任务验证和诚实训练。
Result: 理论分析表明，在合理参数下理性矿工会完全诚实训练；仿真结果验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 所提PoL框架能同时实现安全性、去中心化、效率和有用性，并可扩展到其他有用工作类型。

papers.title: Semantic search for 100M+ galaxy images using AI-generated captions
papers.abstract_en: Finding scientifically interesting phenomena through slow manual labeling campaigns severely limits our ability to explore the billions of galaxy images produced by telescopes. In this work, we develop a pipeline to create a semantic search engine from completely unlabeled image data. Our method leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to generate descriptions for galaxy images, then contrastively aligns a pre-trained astronomy foundation model with these embedded descriptions to produce searchable embeddings at scale. We find that current VLMs provide descriptions that are sufficiently informative to train a semantic search model that outperforms direct image similarity search. Our model, AION-Search, achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on finding rare phenomena despite training on randomly selected images with no deliberate curation for rare cases. Furthermore, we introduce a VLM-based re-ranking method that nearly doubles the recall for our most challenging targets in the top-100 results. For the first time, AION-Search enables flexible semantic search for over 100 million galaxy images, enabling discovery from previously infeasible searches, including the identification of 36 new extragalactic stellar stream candidates. More broadly, our work provides an approach for making large, unlabeled scientific image archives semantically searchable, expanding data exploration capabilities in fields from Earth observation to microscopy. The code, data, and app are publicly available at https://github.com/NolanKoblischke/AION-Search
