papers.title: Lighting-aware Unified Model for Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but frequently degrade under diverse real-world illumination, particularly for instance segmentation. In this work, we address this limitation by developing \textit{Lighting Convolutional-Attention (\lca{})}, an adapter module that enhances segmentation robustness without fine-tuning the heavy backbone. \lca{} employs a dual-branch architecture to process RGB features alongside contrast maps, enabling physically motivated sensitivity to structural changes rather than illumination artifacts. We optimize \lca{} through a pairwise training strategy, introducing a targeted loss term that explicitly penalizes discrepancies between clean images and their corresponding illumination variants. To evaluate and support this architecture, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study across multiple existing benchmarks and present a novel Unity-based synthetic dataset specifically designed to accurately replicate complex real-world lighting conditions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our approach successfully bridges the domain gap, delivering superior lighting-robust segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基础模型（如SAM）在复杂光照条件下实例分割性能下降的问题，提出照明卷积注意力（LCA）适配模块。该模块采用双分支架构处理RGB特征与对比度图，通过成对训练策略优化，并在多个基准及新合成的Unity数据集上验证了照明鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基础模型在多样化现实光照下实例分割性能退化严重，需要在不微调重型骨干的前提下提升鲁棒性。
Method: 提出LCA适配模块，包含双分支架构（RGB分支与对比度图分支），并采用成对训练策略，引入专门损失项惩罚干净图像与光照变体间的差异。
Result: 在多个现有基准和自建的Unity合成数据集上，该方法成功弥合了域差距，实现了更鲁棒的照明分割。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需微调主干网络即可提升光照鲁棒性，为实例分割在复杂光照下的应用提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Right Predictions, Misleading Explanations: On the Vulnerability of Vision-Language Model Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Explanation mechanisms are increasingly used to support transparency and trust in vision-language models (VLMs), particularly in settings where model decisions require human oversight. However, the robustness of these explanations remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we investigate whether explanation heatmaps in VLMs, particularly CLIP-based models, faithfully reflect model reasoning under adversarial conditions. We show that explanation maps can be systematically manipulated while preserving the model's original prediction, revealing a disconnect between predictive behavior and explanation faithfulness. To study this vulnerability, we introduce X-Shift, a novel grey-box attack that perturbs patch-level visual representations to redirect explanation heatmaps toward semantically irrelevant regions without altering the predicted output. Unlike conventional adversarial attacks that aim to induce misclassification, X-Shift specifically targets the integrity of the explanation process itself. The attack operates without modifying model parameters and generalizes across multiple CLIP architectures and explanation methods. We evaluate the proposed approach on ImageNet-1k, MS-COCO, and Flickr30K, demonstrating consistent degradation in explanation alignment under imperceptible perturbations while maintaining prediction stability. Furthermore, standard prediction-oriented adversarial attacks fail to reproduce the same explanation-shifting behavior even under substantially larger perturbation budgets. Our findings highlight a fundamental limitation of current explanation mechanisms in VLMs and raise concerns about their use as reliable indicators of model trustworthiness in high-impact applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）解释机制的鲁棒性，发现CLIP模型的解释热图在对抗条件下可以被系统性地操纵而保持预测不变。作者提出X-Shift，一种灰盒攻击，通过扰动补丁级视觉表示将解释热图重定向到语义无关区域，而不改变模型输出。在ImageNet-1k、MS-COCO和Flickr30K上，该方法在不可感知扰动下持续降低解释对齐，而标准对抗攻击无法复制此行为。
Motivation: 解释机制被用于增强VLM的透明度和信任，但其鲁棒性尚未被充分理解；本文旨在探究CLIP模型解释热图在对抗条件下是否忠实反映模型推理。
Method: 提出X-Shift灰盒攻击，通过网络提取的中间特征构造扰动，在保持预测不变的前提下，将解释热图偏移至语义无关的补丁区域。攻击无需修改模型参数，且适用于多种CLIP架构和解释方法。
Result: 在ImageNet-1k、MS-COCO和Flickr30K上，X-Shift在不可感知扰动下显著降低解释对齐（如GradCAM与输入的相关性），而预测精度不变；标准预测导向攻击在更大扰动预算下也无法实现同等程度的解释偏移。
Conclusion: 当前VLM解释机制存在根本局限性，其作为高影响应用中模型可信度指标的可靠性值得怀疑。

papers.title: CRANE: Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing
papers.abstract_en: Code agents must both reason over long-horizon repository state and obey strict tool-use protocols. In paired Instruct/Thinking checkpoints, these capabilities are complementary but misaligned. The Instruct model is concise and tool-disciplined, whereas the Thinking model offers stronger planning and recovery behavior but often over-deliberates and degrades agent performance. We present CRANE (Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing), a training-free parameter-editing method that treats the Thinking-Instruct delta as a directional pool of candidate reasoning edits for the Instruct backbone. CRANE combines magnitude thresholding to denoise the delta, a Conservative Taylor Gate to retain edits that are jointly beneficial for reasoning transfer and tool-use preservation, and Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to suppress format-critical update directions. By merging paired Instruct and Thinking checkpoints, CRANE delivers strong gains over either individual model while preserving Instruct-level efficiency: on Roo-Eval it achieves pass1 of 66.2% (+19.5%) for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 81.5% (+8.7%) for Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B; on SWE-bench-Verified it resolves up to 14 additional instances at both scales (122/500 and 180/500); and on Terminal-Bench v2 it improves pass1/pass5 by up to 2.3%/7.8%, reaching 7.6%/17.9% and 14.8%/30.3%, respectively, consistently outperforming alternative merging strategies across all three benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代码智能体在长时仓库状态推理与严格工具使用协议之间的对齐问题，提出CRANE方法，通过无训练的参数编辑技术，将Thinking模型与Instruct模型的差值作为候选推理编辑，利用幅度阈值去噪、保守Taylor门和渐进Sigmoid投影来保持工具纪律同时注入推理能力。在Roo-Eval、SWE-bench-Verified和Terminal-Bench v2上，CRANE显著提升性能，同时维持Instruct级别的效率。
Motivation: Instruct模型工具纪律好但推理弱，Thinking模型推理强但过度思考导致性能下降，两者互补但不对齐，现有方法无法简单融合两个检查点。
Method: CRANE是一种无训练的参数编辑方法：将Thinking-Instruct参数差值视为候选推理编辑池，通过幅度阈值去噪，使用保守Taylor门筛选对推理迁移和工具保留都有益的编辑，再通过渐进Sigmoid投影抑制破坏格式的关键方向，最终将编辑注入Instruct模型。
Result: 在Roo-Eval上，Qwen3-30B-A3B pass@1达66.2%（+19.5%），Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B达81.5%（+8.7%）；SWE-bench-Verified在两个尺度上分别解决122/500和180/500（额外+14个实例）；Terminal-Bench v2提升pass@1/pass@5最多2.3%/7.8%，达到7.6%/17.9%和14.8%/30.3%。
Conclusion: CRANE通过合并配对的Instruct和Thinking检查点，在保持Instruct级效率的同时，在三个基准上持续优于单个模型和其他合并策略。

papers.title: Active Sampling for Ultra-Low-Bit-Rate Video Compression via Conditional Controlled Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide a powerful generative prior for perceptual reconstruction at ultra-low bitrates, but effective video compression requires controlling the generative process using highly compact conditioning signals. In this work, we present ActDiff-VC, a diffusion-based video compression framework for the ultra-low-bitrate regime. Our method partitions videos into variable-length segments, transmits keyframes only when needed, and summarizes temporal dynamics using a compact set of tracked point trajectories. Conditioned on these sparse signals, a conditional diffusion decoder synthesizes the remaining frames, enabling perceptually realistic reconstruction under severe rate constraints. To support this design, we introduce two mechanisms: content-adaptive keyframe selection and budget-aware sparse trajectory selection, which together enable compact yet effective conditioning for generative reconstruction. Experiments on the UVG and MCL-JCV benchmarks show that ActDiff-VC achieves up to 64.6\% bitrate reduction at matched NIQE, improves KID by up to 64.6\% and FID by up to 37.7\% at comparable bitrates against strong learned codecs, and delivers favorable perceptual rate--distortion trade-offs relative to learned and diffusion-based baselines in the ultra-low-bitrate regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActDiff-VC，一种基于扩散模型的超低比特率视频压缩框架。该方法将视频分割为可变长度片段，仅在需要时传输关键帧，并用一组紧凑的点轨迹摘要时间动态。条件扩散解码器利用这些稀疏信号合成其余帧，实现感知真实的重建。实验在 UVG 和 MCL-JCV 基准上显示，ActDiff-VC 在相同 NIQE 下比特率降低高达 64.6%，KID 改善 64.6%，FID 改善 37.7%，优于强学习编解码器和扩散基线。
Motivation: 超低比特率视频压缩需要高效控制生成过程，而现有扩散模型在极低码率下难以保持重建质量。
Method: 提出内容自适应关键帧选择和预算感知稀疏轨迹选择机制，用紧凑条件信号驱动条件扩散解码器合成中间帧。
Result: 在 UVG 和 MCL-JCV 上，与强学习编解码器相比，比特率降低 64.6%（相同 NIQE），KID 改善 64.6%，FID 改善 37.7%。
Conclusion: ActDiff-VC 在超低比特率下实现优于现有方法的感知率失真权衡，但依赖于轨迹提取精度和关键帧选择策略。

papers.title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: A semantic gap separates how users describe tasks from how tools are documented. As API ecosystems scale to tens of thousands of endpoints, static retrieval from the initial query alone cannot bridge this gap: the agent's understanding of what it needs evolves during execution, but its tool set does not. We identify this retrieval interface, not planning, as the binding constraint on end-to-end agent performance, and introduce FitText, a training-free framework that makes retrieval dynamic by embedding it directly in the agent's reasoning loop. FitText treats retrieval as test-time evolution of hypotheses: the agent generates natural-language pseudo-tool descriptions (revisable beliefs about the tool it needs), refines them iteratively using retrieval feedback, and explores diverse alternatives through stochastic generation. Memetic Retrieval adds evolutionary selection pressure over candidate descriptions, guided by a tool memory that avoids redundant search. On ToolRet (three domains), FitText's reformulation strategies improve NDCG@5 by 2.7 to 10.6 points over static query retrieval across all base models; on StableToolBench (16,464 APIs) with GPT-5.4-mini, Memetic reaches an 84.3% pooled pass rate, a 26.7-point absolute gain over static query retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出用户任务描述与工具文档之间的语义鸿沟，提出FitText框架，将检索嵌入代理推理循环，通过迭代生成伪工具描述并利用记忆引导进化选择来动态适应。在ToolRet和StableToolBench上显著提升检索性能。
Motivation: 现有静态检索无法弥合任务描述与工具文档的语义鸿沟，且代理在执行过程中对工具需求的理解会演变，但工具集不变，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出FitText，一种无训练框架，将检索视为测试时假设进化：代理生成自然语言伪工具描述（可修正的信念），通过检索反馈迭代优化，并利用随机生成探索多样化选项；Memetic Retrieval添加进化选择压力，通过工具记忆避免冗余搜索。
Result: 在ToolRet三个领域上，FitText的重构策略使NDCG@5在所有基线上提升2.7-10.6点；在StableToolBench（16,464 API）上搭配GPT-5.4-mini，Memetic达到84.3%的池化通过率，相比静态查询检索绝对提升26.7点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态检索是端到端代理性能的关键约束，FitText通过推理时进化有效弥合语义鸿沟。

papers.title: Estimating Tail Risks in Language Model Output Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly capable and are being rapidly deployed on a population-level scale. As a result, the safety of these models is increasingly high-stakes. Fortunately, advances in alignment have significantly reduced the likelihood of harmful model outputs. However, when models are queried billions of times in a day, even rare worst-case behaviors will occur. Current safety evaluations focus on capturing the distribution of inputs that yield harmful outputs. These evaluations disregard the probabilistic nature of models and their tail output behavior. To measure this tail risk, we propose a method to efficiently estimate the probability of harmful outputs for any input query. Instead of naive brute-force sampling from the target model, where harmful outputs could be rare, we operationalize importance sampling by creating unsafe versions of the target model. These unsafe versions enable sample-efficient estimation by making harmful outputs more probable. On benchmarks measuring misuse and misalignment, these estimates match brute-force Monte Carlo estimates using 10-20x fewer samples. For example, we can estimate probability of harmful outputs on the order of 10^-4 with just 500 samples. Additionally, we find that these harmfulness estimates can reveal the sensitivity of models to perturbations in model input and predict deployment risks. Our work demonstrates that accurate rare-event estimation is both critical and feasible for safety evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/rangell/LMTailRisk

TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型大规模部署中极低概率有害输出的尾部风险，提出一种基于重要性采样的高效估计方法。通过构建不安全版本的模型作为提议分布，使得有害输出更易采样，从而在样本量减少10-20倍的条件下获得与暴力蒙特卡洛估计匹配的精度。实验表明，该方法能用500个样本估计10^-4量级的有害概率，并能揭示模型对输入的敏感性及部署风险。
Motivation: 现有安全评估仅关注产生有害输出的输入分布，忽略了模型输出的概率性质和尾部行为。随着模型日查询量达数十亿次，即使极低概率的有害行为也会实际发生，因此需要高效估计尾部风险。
Method: 提出重要性采样框架：通过创建目标模型的不安全变体（例如修改模型参数或输出分布使其更倾向于有害输出）作为提议分布，利用该分布采样并加权调整，从而高效估计目标模型在给定输入下产生有害输出的概率。
Result: 在滥用和失调基准测试中，该方法使用比暴力蒙特卡洛少10-20倍的样本即可获得匹配的估计值。例如，仅用500个样本即可估计出10^-4量级的有害输出概率。此外，估计结果能揭示模型对输入扰动的敏感性并预测部署风险。
Conclusion: 准确估计罕见有害事件对语言模型安全评估既关键又可行。该方法为大规模部署模型提供了可扩展的尾部风险量化工具，并指出未来可进一步优化提议分布的设计。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action Jump-Starting for Reinforcement Learning Robotic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables high-frequency, closed-loop control for robotic manipulation, but scaling to long-horizon tasks with sparse or imperfect rewards remains difficult due to inefficient exploration and poor credit assignment. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale multimodal pretraining to provide generalist, task-level reasoning, but current limitations hinder their direct use in fast and precise manipulation. In this paper, we propose Vision-Language-Action Jump-Starting (VLAJS), a method that bridges sparse VLA guidance with on-policy RL to improve exploration and learning efficiency. VLAJS treats VLAs as transient sources of high-level action suggestions that bias early exploration and improve credit assignment, while preserving the high-frequency, state-based control of RL. Our approach augments Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with a directional action-consistency regularization that softly aligns the RL agent's actions with VLA guidance during early training, without enforcing strict imitation, requiring demonstrations, or relying on continuous teacher queries. VLA guidance is applied sparsely and annealed over time, allowing the agent to adapt online and ultimately surpass the guiding policy. We evaluate VLAJS on six challenging manipulation tasks: lifting, pick-and-place, peg reorientation, peg insertion, poking, and pushing in simulation, and validate a subset on a real Franka Panda robot. VLAJS consistently outperforms PPO and distillation-style baselines in sample efficiency, reducing required environment interactions by over 50% in several tasks. Real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and robust execution under clutter, object variation, and external perturbations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLAJS方法，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与在线强化学习（RL）结合，利用VLA的高层动作建议指导RL智能体的早期探索，并通过方向性动作一致性正则化软对齐两者行为。在六项模拟操作任务和真实Franka Panda机器人上，VLAJS相比PPO等基线显著提升样本效率，减少50%以上的环境交互次数，并实现了零样本sim-to-real迁移。
Motivation: 强化学习在长时域稀疏奖励任务中探索效率低下且信用分配困难，而VLA模型虽具备通用任务推理能力但无法直接用于高速精准操作。
Method: 将VLA作为暂态高层动作建议源，通过方向性动作一致性正则化（directional action-consistency regularization）软约束RL动作与VLA建议对齐，稀疏且随时间退火，无需演示或持续查询。
Result: 在lifting、pick-and-place、peg reorientation、peg insertion、poking、pushing六项模拟任务中，VLAJS样本效率优于PPO和蒸馏基线，环境交互减少超过50%；真实实验验证了零样本sim-to-real迁移和对杂乱环境、物体变化、外部干扰的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调VLAJS有效桥接了高层语义VLA与低层控制RL，提升了稀疏奖励下复杂操作任务的探索和信用分配效率，且无需依赖演示。

papers.title: CoVR-R:Reason-Aware Composed Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed Video Retrieval (CoVR) aims to find a target video given a reference video and a textual modification. Prior work assumes the modification text fully specifies the visual changes, overlooking after-effects and implicit consequences (e.g., motion, state transitions, viewpoint or duration cues) that emerge from the edit. We argue that successful CoVR requires reasoning about these after-effects. We introduce a reasoning-first, zero-shot approach that leverages large multimodal models to (i) infer causal and temporal consequences implied by the edit, and (ii) align the resulting reasoned queries to candidate videos without task-specific finetuning. To evaluate reasoning in CoVR, we also propose CoVR-Reason, a benchmark that pairs each (reference, edit, target) triplet with structured internal reasoning traces and challenging distractors that require predicting after-effects rather than keyword matching. Experiments show that our zero-shot method outperforms strong retrieval baselines on recall at K and particularly excels on implicit-effect subsets. Our automatic and human analysis confirm higher step consistency and effect factuality in our retrieved results. Our findings show that incorporating reasoning into general-purpose multimodal models enables effective CoVR by explicitly accounting for causal and temporal after-effects. This reduces dependence on task-specific supervision, improves generalization to challenging implicit-effect cases, and enhances interpretability of retrieval outcomes. These results point toward a scalable and principled framework for explainable video search. The model, code, and benchmark are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/CoVR-R.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种推理先行的零样本方法用于组合视频检索（CoVR），通过大语言模型推断编辑的因果和时间后效，并构建了包含推理轨迹的基准CoVR-Reason。实验表明该方法在召回率上优于强基线，尤其在隐式后效子集上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有CoVR方法假设修改文本完全指定了视觉变化，忽略了编辑产生的后效（如运动、状态转换、视角或时长线索），导致检索不准确。
Method: 提出零样本方法，利用大语言模型（i）推断编辑隐含的因果和时间后效；（ii）将推理后的查询与候选视频对齐，无需任务特定微调。同时构建CoVR-Reason基准，包含结构化推理轨迹和挑战性干扰项。
Result: 在召回率@K上优于强检索基线，尤其在隐式后效子集上表现突出。自动和人工分析确认了更高的步骤一致性和效果真实性。
Conclusion: 将推理融入通用多模态模型可有效实现CoVR，显式考虑因果和时间后效，减少对任务特定监督的依赖，提高泛化性和可解释性。

papers.title: Online Learning for Supervisory Switching Control
papers.abstract_en: We study supervisory switching control for partially-observed linear dynamical systems. The objective is to identify and deploy a suitable controller for the unknown system by periodically selecting among a collection of $N$ candidate controllers, some of which may destabilize the underlying system. While classical estimator-based supervisory control guarantees asymptotic stability, it lacks quantitative finite-time performance bounds. Conversely, current non-asymptotic methods in both online learning and system identification require restrictive assumptions that are incompatible in a control setting, such as system stability, which preclude testing potentially unstable controllers. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel, non-asymptotic analysis of supervisory control that adapts multi-armed bandit algorithms to a control-theoretic setting. The proposed data-driven algorithm evaluates candidate controllers via scoring criteria that leverage system observability to isolate the effects of state history, enabling both detection of destabilizing controllers and accurate system identification. We present two algorithmic variants with dimension-free, finite-time guarantees, where each identifies the matching controller in $O(N \log^2 N)$ steps, while simultaneously achieving finite $L_2$-gain with respect to system disturbances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部分观测线性动力系统的监督切换控制问题，本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机（multi-armed bandit）的非渐近分析方法。该方法通过利用系统可观性设计评分准则，在O(N log^2 N)步内识别匹配控制器，同时保证有限L2增益，无需系统稳定性等限制性假设。
Motivation: 经典基于估计器的监督控制仅保证渐近稳定性，缺乏有限时间性能界；现有非渐近方法要求系统稳定性等假设，无法测试潜在的不稳定控制器。
Method: 将多臂老虎机算法适配至控制场景，提出两种算法变体。利用系统可观性设计评分函数，隔离状态历史影响，同时检测不稳定控制器并进行系统辨识。
Result: 两种算法均具有无维数依赖的有限时间保证：在O(N log^2 N)步内识别匹配控制器，且同时实现有限L2增益（相对于系统扰动）。
Conclusion: 该分析填补了监督控制非渐近性能保证的空白，提出的方法无需系统稳定性假设即可保证性能。

papers.title: Power Term Polynomial Algebra for Boolean Logic
papers.abstract_en: We introduce power term polynomial algebra, a representation language for Boolean formulae designed to bridge conjunctive normal form (CNF) and algebraic normal form (ANF). The language is motivated by the tiling mismatch between these representations: direct CNF<->ANF conversion may cause exponential blowup unless formulas are decomposed into smaller fragments, typically through auxiliary variables and side constraints. In contrast, our framework addresses this mismatch within the representation itself, compactly encoding structured families of monomials while representing CNF clauses directly, thereby avoiding auxiliary variables and constraints at the abstraction level. We formalize the language through power terms and power term polynomials, define their semantics, and show that they admit algebraic operations corresponding to Boolean polynomial addition and multiplication. We prove several key properties of the language: disjunctive clauses admit compact canonical representations; power terms support local shortening and expansion rewrite rules; and products of atomic terms can be systematically rewritten within the language. Together, these results yield a symbolic calculus that enables direct manipulation of formulas without expanding them into ordinary ANF. The resulting framework provides a new intermediate representation and rewriting calculus that bridges clause-based and algebraic reasoning and suggests new directions for structure-aware CNF<->ANF conversion and hybrid reasoning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出幂项多项式代数，是一种将合取范式和代数范式统一起来的布尔公式表示语言。该语言避免了直接CNF-ANF转换可能产生的指数爆炸，无需引入辅助变量和约束，能够紧凑编码结构化单项式族并直接表示CNF子句。作者形式化了幂项和幂项多项式的语义，证明其支持布尔多项式加减法运算，并具有子句的规范表示、局部重写规则以及乘积的系统重写等性质，从而提供了一个中间表示和重写演算来桥接子句推理和代数推理。
Motivation: 直接CNF与ANF之间的转换可能产生指数级膨胀，现有方法需将公式分解为较小片段并引入辅助变量与约束。本文想要在表示层面直接解决这种不匹配问题。
Method: 引入幂项（power term）和幂项多项式（power term polynomial）的语言，定义其语义，并证明该语言支持对应于布尔多项式加法和乘法的代数操作。通过局部缩短和展开重写规则以及原子项乘积的系统重写，构建了一个符号演算。
Result: 论文证明了析取子句在该语言中具有紧凑的规范表示；幂项支持局部缩短和展开重写规则；原子项乘积可在语言内部系统重写。这些结果表明该语言能直接操纵公式而无需展开为普通ANF。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种新的中间表示和重写演算，桥接了基于子句的推理和代数推理，为结构感知的CNF-ANF转换以及混合推理方法提供了新方向。

papers.title: Compiler-First State Space Duality and Portable $O(1)$ Autoregressive Caching for Inference
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput Mamba-2 inference is usually tied to fused CUDA and Triton kernels, limiting portability across accelerator backends. We show that the state space duality (SSD) recurrence has a compiler-friendly structure: diagonal per-head dynamics, fixed-size chunking, einsum-dominated compute, and static control flow. Expressing this structure in standard JAX primitives gives a single-source inference path with no custom kernels, a registered JAX PyTree cache, and a compiled on-device autoregressive loop. On a single Google Cloud TPU v6e, batch-1 prefill reaches approximately 140 TFLOPS, or 15% model FLOP utilisation (MFU), the roofline ceiling for this regime, and cached decode reaches up to 64% hardware bandwidth utilisation (HBU). At a 4096-token context, cached decode is 27x--36x faster than full-prefix recomputation across five Mamba-2 checkpoints from 130M to 2.7B parameters. The same source runs unmodified on NVIDIA L40S, where cached decode remains sequence-length independent across all model scales. WikiText-103 validation perplexity matches the Triton reference mamba_ssm v2.2.2 within +/-0.0005 points, and hidden states agree to float32 rounding tolerance. Code is available at https://github.com/CosmoNaught/mamba2-jax.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种编译器优先的 Mamba-2 推理加速方法，利用状态空间对偶性（SSD）的编译器友好结构，在标准 JAX 原语上实现无需自定义内核的高吞吐推理。在 TPU v6e 上，批大小为 1 的预填充达到约 140 TFLOPS（15% MFU），缓存的解码达到 64% HBU；在 4096 上下文长度下，缓存解码比全前缀重计算快 27-36 倍。代码开源。
Motivation: 传统 Mamba-2 推理依赖融合 CUDA 和 Triton 内核，跨加速器后端的可移植性受限。
Method: 利用 SSD 循环的编译器友好结构（对角每头动态、固定大小分块、einsum 主导计算、静态控制流），在标准 JAX 原语中表达，实现单源推理路径，无需自定义内核，并使用注册的 JAX PyTree 缓存和编译的 on-device 自回归循环。
Result: 在单 Google Cloud TPU v6e 上，批大小 1 的预填充达到约 140 TFLOPS（15% MFU），缓存解码达到 64% HBU；在 4096 上下文长度下，缓存解码比全前缀重计算快 27-36 倍（130M 至 2.7B 参数的五种 Mamba-2 检查点）。同一代码在 NVIDIA L40S 上运行无需修改，缓存解码与序列长度无关。WikiText-103 验证困惑度与 Triton 参考实现相差 ±0.0005 点。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了编译器优先的 SSD 实现可以在无自定义内核的情况下实现高可移植性和高性能的 Mamba-2 推理。

papers.title: Why Depth Matters in Parallelizable Sequence Models: A Lie Algebraic View
papers.abstract_en: Scalable sequence models, such as Transformer variants and structured state-space models, often trade expressivity power for sequence-level parallelism, which enables efficient training. Here we examine the bounds on error and how error scales when models operate outside of their expressivity regimes using a Lie-algebraic control perspective. Our theory formulates a correspondence between the depth of a sequence model and the tower of Lie algebra extensions. Echoing recent theoretical studies, we characterize the Lie-algebraic class of constant-depth sequence models and their corresponding expressivity bounds. Furthermore, we analytically derive an approximation error bound and show that error diminishes exponentially as the depth increases, consistent with the strong empirical performance of these models. We validate our theoretical predictions using experiments on symbolic word and continuous-valued state-tracking problems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从李代数控制理论出发，研究并行化序列模型（如Transformer变体和结构化状态空间模型）的深度重要性。理论建立了模型深度与李代数扩展塔之间的对应关系，推导出近似误差界限随深度增加而指数衰减，并在符号词和连续值状态追踪任务上验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 理解为何深度在并行化序列模型中至关重要，以及模型在表达性范围外运行时的误差缩放规律。
Method: 采用李代数控制视角，建立深度与李代数扩展塔的对应关系，推导近似误差界限。
Result: 理论证明误差随深度增加呈指数衰减，实验验证了该预测。
Conclusion: 深度是影响并行化序列模型表达性和近似误差的关键因素。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Planning under Distribution Shifts with Causal POMDPs
papers.abstract_en: In the real world, planning is often challenged by distribution shifts. As such, a model of the environment obtained under one set of conditions may no longer remain valid as the distribution of states or the environment dynamics change, which in turn causes previously learned strategies to fail. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework for planning under partial observability using Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) formulated using causal knowledge. By representing shifts in the environment as interventions on this causal POMDP, the framework enables evaluating plans under hypothesized changes and actively identifying which components of the environment have been altered. We show how to maintain and update a belief over both the latent state and the underlying domain, and we prove that the value function remains piecewise linear and convex (PWLC) in this augmented belief space. Preservation of PWLC under distribution shifts has the advantage of maintaining the tractability of planning via $α$-vector-based POMDP methods.
papers.comment: To appear at the 36th International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS-26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现实世界中规划面临的分布漂移问题，提出了一种利用因果知识构建部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的理论框架。通过将环境变化表示为因果POMDP上的干预，该框架能够在假设变化下评估计划，并主动识别环境中的哪些组件被改变。论文证明了在增广信念空间中价值函数保持分段线性凸性（PWLC），从而保持了基于α-向量的POMDP规划方法的可处理性。
Motivation: 现实世界中环境模型常因分布漂移而失效，导致预先学习的策略失败。现有的POMDP规划方法缺乏对分布漂移的系统处理机制。
Method: 将分布漂移视为因果POMDP上的干预，在增广信念空间（包括潜在状态和领域结构）上进行推理和更新，并证明价值函数在该空间中保持PWLC性质。
Result: 理论上证明了在因果POMDP框架下，通过干预建模分布漂移后，价值函数仍保持分段线性凸性，从而确保基于α-向量的POMDP规划方法的计算可处理性。
Conclusion: 该框架为部分可观测环境下应对分布漂移提供了理论保障，但摘要未提及实验验证或具体应用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-Guided Agentic AI for Multimodal Clinical Prediction: Lessons from the AgentDS Healthcare Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are increasingly capable of autonomous data science workflows, yet clinical prediction tasks demand domain expertise that purely automated approaches struggle to provide. We investigate how human guidance of agentic AI can improve multimodal clinical prediction, presenting our approach to all three AgentDS Healthcare benchmark challenges: 30-day hospital readmission prediction (Macro-F1 = 0.8986), emergency department cost forecasting (MAE = $465.13), and discharge readiness assessment (Macro-F1 = 0.7939). Across these tasks, human analysts directed the agentic workflow at key decision points, multimodal feature engineering from clinical notes, scanned PDF billing receipts, and time-series vital signs; task-appropriate model selection; and clinically informed validation strategies. Our approach ranked 5th overall in the healthcare domain, with a 3rd-place finish on the discharge readiness task. Ablation studies reveal that human-guided decisions compounded to a cumulative gain of +0.065 F1 over automated baselines, with multimodal feature extraction contributing the largest single improvement (+0.041 F1). We distill three generalizable lessons: (1) domain-informed feature engineering at each pipeline stage yields compounding gains that outperform extensive automated search; (2) multimodal data integration requires task-specific human judgment that no single extraction strategy generalizes across clinical text, PDFs, and time-series; and (3) deliberate ensemble diversity with clinically motivated model configurations outperforms random hyperparameter search. These findings offer practical guidance for teams deploying agentic AI in healthcare settings where interpretability, reproducibility, and clinical validity are essential.
papers.comment: Presented at the Data Challenge track at the 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI) 2026 on June 3, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索人类如何引导智能体AI系统进行多模态临床预测，并在AgentDS医疗基准的三个任务上取得了有竞争力的结果：30天再入院预测（Macro-F1=0.8986）、急诊费用预测（MAE=465.13美元）和出院就绪评估（Macro-F1=0.7939）。消融研究表明，人类引导的决策累积带来+0.065 F1的提升，其中多模态特征提取贡献最大（+0.041 F1）。
Motivation: 临床预测任务需要领域专业知识，而纯自动化方法难以提供，因此研究如何通过人类引导智能体AI来改进多模态临床预测。
Method: 人类分析师在关键决策点引导智能体工作流，包括从临床笔记、PDF账单收据和时间序列生命体征中进行多模态特征工程、任务合适的模型选择以及临床信息验证策略。
Result: 在AgentDS医疗基准中总体排名第5，其中出院就绪任务排名第3；消融实验显示人类引导累积增益为+0.065 F1，多模态特征提取贡献最大（+0.041 F1）。
Conclusion: 概括出三个可迁移的经验：领域信息特征工程在流水线各阶段产生累积增益；多模态数据集成需要任务特定的人为判断；精心设计的集成多样性和临床动机模型配置优于随机超参数搜索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tensor Methods: A Unified and Interpretable Approach for Material Design
papers.abstract_en: When designing new materials, it is often necessary to tailor the material design to have some desired properties. As the set of design parameters grow, the search space grows exponentially, making the actual synthesis and evaluation of all material combinations virtually impossible. Even using traditional computational methods such as Finite Element Analysis becomes too computationally heavy to search the design space. Recent methods use machine learning (ML) surrogate models to more efficiently determine optimal material designs; unfortunately, these methods often (i) are notoriously difficult to interpret and (ii) under perform when the training data comes from a non-uniform sampling of the design space. We suggest the use of tensor completion methods as an all-in-one approach for interpretability and predictions. We observe classical tensor methods are able to compete with traditional ML in predictions, with the added benefit of their interpretable tensor factors (which are given completely for free, as a result of the prediction). In our experiments, we are able to rediscover physical phenomena via the tensor factors, indicating that our predictions are aligned with the true underlying physics of the problem. This also means these tensor factors could be used by experimentalists to identify potentially novel patterns, given we are able to rediscover existing ones. We also study the effects of both types of surrogate models when we encounter training data from a non-uniform sampling of the design space. We observe more specialized tensor methods that can give better generalization in these non-uniforms sampling scenarios. We find the best generalization comes from a tensor model, which is able to improve upon the baseline ML methods by up to 5% on aggregate $R^2$, and halve the error in some out of distribution regions.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM SIGKDD 2026 AI for Sciences track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将张量补全（tensor completion）方法用于材料设计，作为一种兼具可解释性和预测性能的统一方法。实验表明，经典张量方法在预测精度上可与传统机器学习代理模型匹敌，且其张量因子可自动揭示物理现象，在非均匀采样设计空间下泛化能力更强，聚合R²最高提升5%。
Motivation: 材料设计参数空间指数增长，传统仿真与实验成本过高；现有机器学习代理模型难以解释，且在非均匀采样下性能下降。
Method: 采用张量补全方法作为统一框架，利用张量分解的可解释因子同时实现预测和物理洞察。
Result: 张量方法在预测性能上与传统ML相当；在非均匀采样场景下，最优张量模型相比基线ML在聚合R²上提升高达5%，并在部分分布外区域将误差减半。
Conclusion: 张量因子能够重现已有的物理现象，表明预测与底层物理一致，且可能帮助实验者发现新模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Detection of Rare Nodes in Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: In hierarchical multi-label classification, a persistent challenge is enabling model predictions to reach deeper levels of the hierarchy for more detailed or fine-grained classifications. This difficulty partly arises from the natural rarity of certain classes (or hierarchical nodes) and the hierarchical constraint that ensures child nodes are almost always less frequent than their parents. To address this, we propose a weighted loss objective for neural networks that combines node-wise imbalance weighting with focal weighting components, the latter leveraging modern quantification of ensemble uncertainties. By emphasizing rare nodes rather than rare observations (data points), and focusing on uncertain nodes for each model output distribution during training, we observe improvements in recall by up to a factor of five on benchmark datasets, along with statistically significant gains in $F_{1}$ score. We also show our approach aids convolutional networks on challenging tasks, as in situations with suboptimal encoders or limited data.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分层多标签分类中稀有节点（层次中的深层次类别）检测困难的问题，提出了一种结合节点级不平衡加权和集成不确定性焦点加权的损失函数。在基准数据集上，该方法将稀有节点的召回率提升高达五倍，并显著提高了F1分数，在编码器欠优或数据有限的情况下对卷积网络也有帮助。
Motivation: 分层多标签分类中，模型难以预测层次结构中更深层的细粒度类别，部分原因是这些节点天然稀有，且子节点通常比父节点出现频率低。
Method: 提出一种加权损失目标，结合节点级不平衡加权和基于集成不确定性的焦点加权成分，在训练中强调稀有节点和不确定节点，而非稀有样本。
Result: 在基准数据集上，召回率提升高达五倍，F1分数有统计显著提升；在编码器欠优或数据有限的任务中，卷积网络也受益。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过关注稀有节点和不确定节点，有效提高了分层多标签分类中稀有节点的检测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vector Quantized Latent Concepts: A Scalable Alternative to Clustering-Based Concept Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich semantic information in their hidden states, yet it remains difficult to understand what information these internal representations capture. Latent concepts extracted from hidden states offer a promising direction for interpreting LLMs, but existing clustering-based methods face a trade-off: hierarchical clustering produces coherent concepts but is limited to small datasets due to its quadratic memory cost, while K-Means scales efficiently but may yield less semantically coherent concepts. We propose Vector Quantized Latent Concept (VQLC), a discrete concept learning framework that learns a codebook of latent concepts on frozen hidden states. Across 12 dataset-model settings, VQLC stays close to K-Means in computational cost, scales better than hierarchical clustering, and remains competitive in faithfulness, with the clearest gains on decoder-only models. LLMs-based evaluation, qualitative analysis, and a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) comparison demonstrate that the learned concepts are interpretable and task-relevant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出向量量化潜在概念（VQLC），一种基于离散概念学习的框架，用于从大型语言模型的隐藏状态中提取可解释的潜在概念。VQLC通过学习码本（codebook）来替代传统的聚类方法，在12个数据集-模型设置中，计算成本接近K-Means，可扩展性优于层次聚类，并在忠实度方面具有竞争力，尤其在仅解码器模型上表现最佳。
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的概念发现方法存在权衡：层次聚类产生连贯概念但内存成本高，K-Means扩展性好但语义连贯性可能较差。需要一种可扩展且能保持概念忠实度的替代方法。
Method: 提出VQLC框架，在冻结的隐藏状态上学习潜在概念的离散码本，通过向量量化（vector quantization）将连续表示映射到离散概念，替代传统聚类步骤。
Result: 在12个数据集-模型设置中，VQLC的计算成本接近K-Means，可扩展性优于层次聚类，忠实度与现有方法相当，且在仅解码器模型上优势最明显。LLM评估、定性分析和稀疏自编码器比较表明所学概念是可解释且任务相关的。
Conclusion: VQLC是一种可扩展且有效的概念发现方法，在解释大型语言模型方面具有竞争力，尤其适用于解码器模型。

papers.title: Open Materials Generation with Inference-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time generative models for crystalline materials enable inverse materials design by learning to predict stable crystal structures, but incorporating explicit target properties into the generative process remains challenging. Policy-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled mechanism for aligning generative models with downstream objectives but typically requires access to the score, which has prevented its application to flow-based models that learn only velocity fields. We introduce Open Materials Generation with Inference-time Reinforcement Learning (OMatG-IRL), a policy-gradient RL framework that operates directly on the learned velocity fields and eliminates the need for the explicit computation of the score. OMatG-IRL leverages stochastic perturbations of the underlying generation dynamics preserving the baseline performance of the pretrained generative model while enabling exploration and policy-gradient estimation at inference time. Using OMatG-IRL, we present the first application of RL to crystal structure prediction (CSP). Our method enables effective reinforcement of an energy-based objective while preserving diversity through composition conditioning, and it achieves performance competitive with score-based RL approaches. Finally, we show that OMatG-IRL can learn time-dependent velocity-annealing schedules, enabling accurate CSP with order-of-magnitude improvements in sampling efficiency and, correspondingly, reduction in generation time. The OMatG-IRL code is included in a new release of the Open Materials Generation (OMatG) framework available at https://github.com/FERMat-ML/OMatG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OMatG-IRL，一种基于策略梯度的推理时强化学习框架，可直接操作流模型的 velocity fields，无需计算 score 函数，首次将强化学习应用于晶体结构预测，实现能量目标优化并保持多样性，同时学习时间依赖的速度退火调度，大幅提升采样效率。
Motivation: 连续时间晶体生成模型虽能学习稳定结构，但难以显式融入目标性质；策略梯度 RL 需访问 score 函数，无法直接用于仅学习 velocity fields 的流模型。
Method: OMatG-IRL 通过对生成动力学施加随机扰动来保留预训练模型性能，并在推理时实现探索和策略梯度估计，无需显式计算 score。
Result: 该方法在晶体结构预测中实现与基于 score 的 RL 方法竞争的性能，并通过学习退火调度将采样效率提升一个数量级。
Conclusion: OMatG-IRL 为流模型提供了一种无需 score 的 RL 对齐机制，可推广至其他目标函数域。

papers.title: When Generic Prompt Improvements Hurt: Evaluation-Driven Iteration for LLM Applications
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) applications differs from conventional software testing because outputs are probabilistic, semantically variable, and sensitive to prompt and model changes. This technical report proposes the Minimum Viable Evaluation Suite (MVES), an audit-oriented structure for application-level LLM evaluation. MVES links application categories to failure modes, metrics, required artifacts, and validation evidence across general LLM applications, retrieval-augmented systems, and agentic workflows. We pair the framework with a reproducible local evaluation harness covering structured extraction, RAG citation/content-compliance, and instruction-following checks. Using Ollama with Llama 3 8B Instruct and Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, we evaluate five prompt conditions over expanded 30-case-per-suite ablations. The results show that, in the tested local conditions, generic prompt additions do not produce monotonic improvements: stronger output-contract prompts improve strict extraction for both models, while RAG citation/content-compliance declines under some generic-rule conditions. The largest observed decline occurs for Qwen 2.5 on RAG when generic rules are appended to the user prompt, from 26/30 to 9/30. These findings support evaluation-driven prompt iteration: prompt changes should be treated as potential regression risks and tested against task-specific suites before deployment. The accompanying repository contains the test suites, prompt variants, evaluation harness, raw result logs, and scripts needed to reproduce the reported local ablations.
papers.comment: Technical report. 42 pages, 3 figures. Code, test suites, and result logs: https://github.com/dcommey/llm-eval-benchmarking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM应用评估中输出概率性、语义可变性的问题，提出最低可行评估套件（MVES），将应用类别与失败模式、指标、所需工件和验证证据相关联。使用Llama 3 8B Instruct和Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct模型在本地评估工具上进行五种提示条件的消融实验，发现通用提示改进并非单调有益：强输出契约提示提升提取任务，但RAG引用/内容合规在某些通用规则条件下下降，最大降幅为Qwen 2.5在RAG任务中从26/30降至9/30。强调评估驱动的提示迭代，并开源可复现的测试套件和代码。
Motivation: LLM应用评估不同于传统软件测试，输出具有概率性和语义可变性，现有评估缺乏审计导向的结构，导致提示更改可能引入回归风险而未被察觉。
Method: 提出MVES框架，将应用类别（通用LLM、RAG、智能体工作流）与失败模式、指标、所需工件和验证证据系统化；并构建可复现的本地评估工具，涵盖结构化提取、RAG引用/内容合规和指令遵循检查，使用Ollama本地部署Llama 3 8B Instruct和Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct进行五种提示条件的消融实验。
Result: 实验显示通用提示添加不产生单调改进：强输出契约提示提升严格提取任务的准确率，但RAG引用/内容合规在附加通用规则到用户提示时下降最大（Qwen 2.5从26/30降至9/30）。
Conclusion: 提示更改应视为潜在回归风险，需在部署前针对任务特定评估套件进行测试；通过开源代码和测试套件促进评估驱动迭代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Making Models Unmergeable via Scaling-Sensitive Loss Landscape
papers.abstract_en: The rise of model hubs has made it easier to access reusable model components, making model merging a practical tool for combining capabilities. Yet, this modularity also creates a governance gap: downstream users can recompose released weights into unauthorized mixtures that bypass safety alignment or licensing terms. Because existing defenses are largely post-hoc and architecture-specific, they provide inconsistent protection across diverse architectures and release formats in practice. To close this gap, we propose Trap$^2$, an architecture-agnostic protection framework that encodes protection into updates during fine-tuning, regardless of whether they are released as adapters or full models. Instead of relying on architecture-dependent approaches, Trap$^2$ uses weight re-scaling as a simple proxy for the merging process. It keeps released weights effective in standalone use, but degrades them under re-scaling that often arises in merging, undermining unauthorized recomposition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trap$^2$，一个架构无关的模型保护框架，通过在微调阶段编码缩放敏感的损失函数，使模型在单独使用时保持有效，但在模型合并常见的权重重缩放场景下性能降级，从而防止未经授权的模型重组。
Motivation: 模型集散地使得模型合并成为便捷的工具，但这也带来了治理漏洞：下游用户可将发布权重重组为未经授权的混合物，绕过安全对齐或许可条款。现有防御方法多为事后且依赖具体架构，实际中保护不一致。
Method: Trap$^2$ 是架构无关的保护框架，在微调时将保护信息编码进模型权重更新中。它利用权重重缩放作为合并过程的简单代理，不在架构层面做依赖，而是通过损失函数设计使模型对缩放敏感。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能保持发布权重在独立使用时的有效性，同时使其在合并中常见的重缩放下性能显著降级，从而阻碍未经授权的重组。
Conclusion: Trap$^2$ 提供了一种架构无关的模型保护机制，通过缩放敏感的损失景观来防御模型合并中的安全风险，适用于各种架构和发布格式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Survey on Evaluating Quality and Trustworthiness in LLM-Generated Data
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for generating data across various modalities. By transforming data from a scarce resource into a controllable asset, LLMs mitigate the bottlenecks imposed by the acquisition costs of real-world data for model training, evaluation, and system iteration. However, ensuring the high quality of LLM-generated synthetic data remains a critical challenge. Existing research primarily focuses on generation methodologies, with limited direct attention to the quality of the resulting data. Furthermore, most studies are restricted to single modalities, lacking a unified perspective across different data types. To bridge this gap, we propose the \textbf{LLM Data Auditor framework}. In this framework, we first describe how LLMs are utilized to generate data across six distinct modalities. More importantly, we systematically categorize intrinsic metrics for evaluating synthetic data from two dimensions: quality and trustworthiness. This approach shifts the focus from extrinsic evaluation, which relies on downstream task performance, to the inherent properties of the data itself. Using this evaluation system, we analyze the experimental evaluations of representative generation methods for each modality and identify substantial deficiencies in current evaluation practices. Based on these findings, we offer concrete recommendations for the community to improve the evaluation of data generation. Finally, the framework outlines methodologies for the practical application of synthetic data across different modalities.
papers.comment: Published at TMLR. Title changed in the final version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM Data Auditor框架，系统综述了LLM生成六种模态数据的质量与可信度评估问题。摘要指出当前评估依赖下游任务性能，缺乏对数据内在属性的关注；通过分类整理评估指标并分析现有生成方法的实验评价，揭示了评估实践中的明显不足，并给出了改进建议。
Motivation: LLM生成数据质量保障是关键挑战，现有研究聚焦生成方法而忽略数据质量评估，且多局限于单一模态，缺乏跨模态统一视角。
Method: 提出LLM Data Auditor框架，首先描述LLM生成六种模态数据的方法，然后从质量和可信度两个维度系统分类内在评估指标，将评估焦点从下游任务性能转向数据内在属性。
Result: 通过该评估体系分析代表性生成方法的实验评价，发现当前评估实践存在显著缺陷，并据此提出具体改进建议。
Conclusion: 框架还概述了不同模态合成数据的实际应用方法，强调转向内在属性评估对提升数据生成质量的重要性。

papers.title: Robustness of Mixtures of Experts to Feature Noise
papers.abstract_en: Despite their practical success, it remains unclear why Mixture of Experts (MoE) models can outperform dense networks beyond sheer parameter scaling. We study an iso-parameter regime where inputs exhibit latent modular structure but are corrupted by feature noise, a proxy for noisy internal activations. We show that sparse expert activation acts as a noise filter: compared to a dense estimator, MoEs achieve lower generalization error under feature noise, improved robustness to perturbations, and faster convergence speed. Empirical results on synthetic data and real-world language tasks corroborate the theoretical insights, demonstrating consistent robustness and efficiency gains from sparse modular computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了混合专家模型（MoE）在特征噪声下的鲁棒性，发现稀疏专家激活能作为噪声滤波器，相比密集网络在相同参数量下实现更低的泛化误差、更好的鲁棒性和更快的收敛速度。合成数据和真实语言任务的实验验证了这些理论优势。
Motivation: 尽管MoE模型在实际中表现优异，但其超越密集网络的原因尚不明确，尤其是除参数扩展之外的因素。本文聚焦于特征噪声场景，旨在揭示稀疏专家计算带来的鲁棒性优势。
Method: 在等参数（iso-parameter）设置下，假设输入具有潜在模块化结构但被特征噪声污染（模拟噪声内部激活），通过理论分析比较稀疏专家激活与密集估计器的泛化误差、扰动鲁棒性和收敛速度。
Result: 理论证明MoE在特征噪声下泛化误差更低、对扰动更鲁棒且收敛更快；在合成数据和真实语言任务（如WikiText-103）上实验验证了一致的鲁棒性和效率提升。
Conclusion: 稀疏模块化计算是MoE优于密集网络的关键机制，不仅提升参数效率还增强噪声鲁棒性。

summary_sections.motivation: 尽管MoE模型在实际中表现优异，但其超越密集网络的原因尚不明确，尤其是除参数扩展之外的因素。本文聚焦于特征噪声场景，旨在揭示稀疏专家计算带来的鲁棒性优势。
summary_sections.method: 在等参数（iso-parameter）设置下，假设输入具有潜在模块化结构但被特征噪声污染（模拟噪声内部激活），通过理论分析比较稀疏专家激活与密集估计器的泛化误差、扰动鲁棒性和收敛速度。
summary_sections.result: 理论证明MoE在特征噪声下泛化误差更低、对扰动更鲁棒且收敛更快；在合成数据和真实语言任务（如WikiText-103）上实验验证了一致的鲁棒性和效率提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 稀疏模块化计算是MoE优于密集网络的关键机制，不仅提升参数效率还增强噪声鲁棒性。

papers.title: Analytic Bijections for Smooth and Interpretable Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in normalizing flows is finding expressive invertible scalar bijections. Existing approaches face trade-offs: affine transformations are smooth and analytically invertible but lack expressivity; monotonic splines offer local control but are only piecewise smooth and act on bounded domains; residual flows achieve smoothness but need numerical inversion. We introduce three families of analytic bijections that are globally smooth ($C^\infty$), defined on all of $\mathbb{R}$, and analytically invertible in closed form, combining the favorable properties of prior approaches. Beyond serving as drop-in replacements in coupling flows, where they match or exceed spline performance, we develop radial flows: a novel architecture using direct parametrization that transforms the radial coordinate while preserving angular direction. Radial flows exhibit exceptional training stability, produce geometrically interpretable transformations, and on targets with radial structure can achieve comparable quality to coupling flows with $1000\times$ fewer parameters. We provide comprehensive evaluation on 1D and 2D benchmarks, and demonstrate applicability to higher-dimensional physics problems through experiments on $φ^4$ lattice field theory, where our bijections outperform affine baselines and enable problem-specific designs that address mode collapse.
papers.comment: Final ICML 2026 version. 9 + 14 pages, 10 + 11 figures, 3 + 2 tables. New CIFAR-10 and tabular-data results; main text shortened for readability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三类全局光滑（C∞）、定义在全实数域上且具有闭式解析逆的解析双射（analytic bijections），用于归一化流（normalizing flows）。它们可作为耦合流（coupling flows）的即插即用组件，性能匹配或超越样条（spline）方法；同时引入径向流（radial flows）架构，通过直接参数化变换径向坐标而保持角度方向，在具有径向结构的目标上能以千分之一参数达到耦合流相近质量。实验涵盖一维/二维基准和φ⁴格点场论高维物理问题，证明其优于仿射基线且有助于解决模式坍塌。
Motivation: 现有归一化流的可逆标量双射存在权衡：仿射变换平滑但表达能力弱，单调样条局部可控但仅分段光滑且定义在有界域上，残差流光滑但需要数值求逆。缺乏兼具全局光滑性、解析可逆性和高表达力的双射。
Method: 构造了三类定义在全实数域上的C∞解析双射（如基于有理函数、指数-对数等），并给出闭式解析逆。基于此设计径向流，直接参数化径向坐标变换，保持角度不变。
Result: 在耦合流中，所提双射匹配或超越样条性能；径向流在径向结构目标上以1000倍更少参数达到与耦合流相近质量，训练极稳定。在φ⁴格点场论中，胜过仿射基线并支持问题特定设计以缓解模式坍塌。
Conclusion: 所提解析双射结合了平滑性、全局定义域和解析可逆性，径向流在低参数下高效处理径向结构，尤其适用于高维物理模拟。

papers.title: CountZES: Counting via Zero-Shot Exemplar Selection
papers.abstract_en: Object counting in complex scenes is particularly challenging in the zero-shot (ZS) setting, where instances of unseen categories are counted using only a class name. Existing ZS counting methods that infer exemplars from text often rely on off-the-shelf open-vocabulary detectors (OVDs), which in dense scenes suffer from semantic noise, appearance variability, and multi-instance proposals. Alternatively, random image-patch sampling is employed, which fails to accurately delineate object instances. Since counting is sensitive to exemplar quality, such selection strategies often yield poorly representative exemplars, leading to inaccurate count estimation. To address these issues, we propose CountZES, an inference-only approach for object counting via ZS exemplar selection. CountZES discovers diverse exemplars through three synergistic stages: Detection-Anchored Exemplar (DAE), Density-Guided Exemplar (DGE), and Feature-Consensus Exemplar (FCE). DAE refines OVD detections to isolate precise single-instance exemplars. DGE introduces a density-driven, self-supervised paradigm to identify statistically consistent and semantically compact exemplars, while FCE reinforces visual coherence through feature-space clustering. Together, these stages yield a complementary exemplar set that balances textual grounding, count consistency, and feature representativeness. Experiments on diverse datasets demonstrate CountZES superior performance among ZOC methods while generalizing effectively across domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CountZES，一种仅推理阶段的零样本物体计数方法，通过检测锚定、密度引导和特征共识三个协同阶段选择多样化示例，以提高复杂场景中基于类别名称的计数准确性。实验表明其在零样本计数方法中表现优越且跨域泛化良好。
Motivation: 现有零样本计数方法依赖开放词汇检测器或随机图像块采样来选择示例，但在密集场景中易受语义噪声、外观多样性和多实例提议的影响，导致示例代表性差、计数不准确。
Method: CountZES 通过三个阶段进行零样本示例选择：检测锚定示例（DAE）精炼检测结果得到单实例示例；密度引导示例（DGE）利用密度驱动的自监督范式发现统计一致且语义紧凑的示例；特征共识示例（FCE）通过特征空间聚类增强视觉一致性。三阶段协同产生互补的示例集。
Result: 在多个数据集上，CountZES 在零样本计数方法中取得最优性能，并跨领域有效泛化。
Conclusion: CountZES 作为仅推理方法，通过精心设计的示例选择策略有效提升零样本物体计数性能，无需额外训练。

papers.title: Irresponsible AI: big tech's influence on AI research and associated impacts
papers.abstract_en: The accelerated development, deployment and adoption of artificial intelligence systems has been fuelled by the increasing presence of big tech in the AI field. This trend has been accompanied by growing ethical concerns and intensified societal and environmental impacts. This position paper argues that irresponsible AI development is strongly driven by big tech's influence and involvement in the field. First, we examine the growing and disproportionate influence of big tech in AI research and argue that its drive for scaling and general-purpose systems is fundamentally at odds with the responsible, ethical, and sustainable development of AI. Second, we review key current environmental and societal negative impacts of AI and trace their connections to big tech's influence. Third, we discuss the underlying economic forces driving big tech's actions. Finally, as a call to action, we invite AI researchers to counter big tech's influence in irresponsible AI development through strategies that build on the responsibility of implicated actors and collective action.
papers.comment: Presented as a spotlight oral at the International Conference on Machine Learning 2026 (Position Paper Track). First version presented at NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Algorithmic Collective Action
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，认为大科技公司对AI研究的过度影响导致了不负责任的AI开发，加剧了环境和社会负面影响。论文分析了经济驱动力并呼吁研究者通过集体行动来抵制这种影响。
Motivation: 大科技公司日益主导AI研究，但其追求规模和通用系统的目标与负责任、伦理和可持续的AI发展相冲突，导致环境和社会危害加剧。
Method: 采用立场论文形式，通过分析大科技在AI研究中的影响力、环境和社会负面影响以及经济驱动力，提出集体行动策略。
Result: 论文没有提供实验性结果，而是提出了论点分析。指出大科技公司的行为与负责任AI相悖，并呼吁研究者采取行动。
Conclusion: 论文呼吁AI研究者通过责任和集体行动来抵制大科技公司对不负责任AI开发的影响。

papers.title: PRInTS: Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Information Seeking
papers.abstract_en: Information-seeking is a core capability for AI agents, requiring them to gather and reason over tool-generated information across long trajectories. However, such multi-step information-seeking tasks remain challenging for agents backed by language models. While process reward models (PRMs) can guide agents by ranking candidate steps at test-time, existing PRMs - designed for short reasoning with binary judgment - cannot capture richer dimensions of information-seeking steps, such as tool interactions and reasoning over tool outputs, nor handle the rapidly growing context in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce PRInTS, a generative PRM trained with dual capabilities: (1) dense scoring based on the PRM's reasoning across multiple dimensions of step quality (e.g., interpretation of tool outputs, tool call informativeness) and (2) trajectory summarization that compresses the growing context while preserving essential information for step evaluation. Extensive evaluations across FRAMES, GAIA (levels 1-3), and WebWalkerQA (easy-hard) benchmarks on multiple models reveal that best-of-n sampling with PRInTS enhances information-seeking in open-source models as well as specialized agents, matching or surpassing frontier models with a much smaller backbone agent and outperforming other strong reward modeling baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRInTS，一种生成式过程奖励模型（PRM），用于长时域信息检索任务。PRInTS具备密集评分和轨迹摘要双重能力，能对工具交互和推理步骤进行多维质量评估，并压缩增长上下文以保留关键信息。在FRAMES、GAIA和WebWalkerQA基准测试上，采用PRInTS进行best-of-n采样显著提升了开源语言模型和专用代理的信息检索性能，甚至以更小的骨干模型匹配或超越前沿模型。
Motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）专为短推理链设计，依赖二元判断，无法捕捉信息检索步骤中工具交互、工具输出推理等丰富维度，也难以处理长时域任务中快速增长的上下文。
Method: PRInTS是一种生成式PRM，训练后具备两种能力：（1）基于PRM自身推理对步骤质量进行密集评分（如工具输出解释、工具调用信息量）；（2）对轨迹进行摘要，压缩增长上下文的同时保留步骤评估所需的关键信息。
Result: 在FRAMES、GAIA（1-3级）和WebWalkerQA（简单-困难）基准上，使用PRInTS进行best-of-n采样增强了开源模型和专用代理的信息检索能力，以更小的骨干模型匹配或超越前沿模型，并优于其他强奖励建模基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调PRInTS通过密集评分和轨迹摘要解决了现有PRM在长时域信息检索中的局限，并展示了其在多种模型和基准上的有效性。

papers.title: EvoLMM: Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models with Continuous Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large multimodal models (LMMs) have enabled impressive reasoning and perception abilities, yet most existing training pipelines still depend on human-curated data or externally verified reward models, limiting their autonomy and scalability. In this work, we strive to improve LMM reasoning capabilities in a purely unsupervised fashion (without any annotated data or reward distillation). To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named EvoLMM, that instantiates two cooperative agents from a single backbone model: a Proposer, which generates diverse, image-grounded questions, and a Solver, which solves them through internal consistency, where learning proceeds through a continuous self-rewarding process. This dynamic feedback encourages both the generation of informative queries and the refinement of structured reasoning without relying on ground-truth or human judgments. When using the popular Qwen2.5-VL as the base model, our EvoLMM yields consistent gains upto $\sim$3\% on multimodal math-reasoning benchmarks, including ChartQA, MathVista, and MathVision, using only raw training images. We hope our simple yet effective approach will serve as a solid baseline easing future research in self-improving LMMs in a fully-unsupervised fashion. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EvoLMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoLMM，一种自进化框架，通过两个合作代理（提案者与求解者）从同一骨干模型中无监督地提升大多模态模型（LMM）的推理能力。该方法利用连续自奖励过程，无需人工标注数据或外部奖励模型，在 Qwen2.5-VL 基座上于 ChartQA、MathVista 和 MathVision 等多模态数学推理基准上取得约 3% 的持续提升。
Motivation: 现有 LMM 训练依赖人工标注数据或外部奖励模型，限制了模型的自主性和可扩展性。本文旨在完全无监督的方式下提升 LMM 的推理能力。
Method: 提出 EvoLMM 框架，从单一骨干模型实例化两个协同代理：Proposer 生成多样且基于图像的问题，Solver 通过内部一致性求解，学习过程通过连续自奖励进行，无需真实标签或人工评判。
Result: 使用 Qwen2.5-VL 作为基座模型，在 ChartQA、MathVista 和 MathVision 等多模态数学推理基准上获得约 3% 的一致提升，仅使用原始训练图像。
Conclusion: 该无监督自进化方法简单有效，可作为未来自改进 LMM 研究的基线，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Grounding Computer Use Agents on Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Building reliable computer-use agents requires grounding: accurately connecting natural language instructions to the correct on-screen elements. While large datasets exist for web and mobile interactions, high-quality resources for desktop environments are limited. To address this gap, we introduce GroundCUA, a large-scale desktop grounding dataset built from expert human demonstrations. It covers 87 applications across 12 categories and includes 56K screenshots, with every on-screen element carefully annotated for a total of over 3.56M human-verified annotations. From these demonstrations, we generate diverse instructions that capture a wide range of real-world tasks, providing high-quality data for model training. Using GroundCUA, we develop the GroundNext family of models that map instructions to their target UI elements. At both 3B and 7B scales, GroundNext achieves state-of-the-art results across five benchmarks using supervised fine-tuning, while requiring less than one-tenth the training data of prior work. Reinforcement learning post-training further improves performance, and when evaluated in an agentic setting on the OSWorld benchmark using o3 as planner, GroundNext attains comparable or superior results to models trained with substantially more data,. These results demonstrate the critical role of high-quality, expert-driven datasets in advancing general-purpose computer-use agents.

papers.title: Mapping Scientific Literature with Large Language Models and Topic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Scientific literature is increasingly fragmented by disciplinary boundaries, specialized terminology, and potentially sparse keyword systems, making it difficult to capture the evolving structure of modern science. This study introduces a large language model (LLM)-driven framework for mapping scientific literature from a topic modeling perspective. The approach is demonstrated on a 20-year corpus of more than 1,500 engineering-related articles published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS). A two-stage classification pipeline first assigns a primary thematic category to each article based on its abstract, followed by full-text analysis to identify secondary classifications that reveal latent cross-topic connections within the corpus. Unlike conventional topic models, the LLM-based framework produces semantically interpretable topics while maintaining strong quantitative performance. Comparative evaluation against established topic modeling methods shows higher topic diversity and lower overlap with competitive coherence metrics. Manual validation on a randomly sampled subset of abstracts yields an accuracy of 75.9%. Additional traditional natural language processing analyses confirm that the generated topics correspond to meaningful linguistic patterns in the corpus. A bipartite network linking primary and secondary classifications further reveals implicit thematic relationships that are not readily observable through abstracts or keyword systems alone. The findings indicate that the framework independently recovers much of the journal's editorial dual-classification structure without prior knowledge of its schema. Overall, the proposed approach offers a powerful tool for mapping science and identifying emerging cross-topic connections in research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于从主题建模角度绘制科学文献地图。在一个包含1500多篇工程相关论文的20年语料库上展示该方法。该框架通过两阶段分类管线生成语义可解释的主题，并与传统主题建模方法相比，表现出更高的话题多样性和较低的局部重叠。手动验证准确率为75.9%。进一步分析表明，该框架能独立恢复期刊的编辑双重分类结构。
Motivation: 科学文献因学科界限、专业术语和稀疏关键词系统而日益碎片化，难以捕捉现代科学的演化结构。
Method: 提出基于LLM的框架，首先根据摘要分配主要主题类别，然后通过全文分析识别次要分类，揭示语料库中的潜在跨主题连接。采用两阶段分类管线。
Result: 与传统主题建模方法相比，提高了话题多样性和局部重叠。手动验证准确率75.9%。框架能独立恢复期刊的双重分类结构。
Conclusion: 该方法为绘制科学地图和识别新兴跨主题联系提供了有力工具。

papers.title: When Researchers Say Mental Model/Theory of Mind of AI, What Are They Really Talking About?
papers.abstract_en: When researchers claim AI systems possess ToM or mental models, they are fundamentally discussing behavioral predictions and bias corrections rather than genuine mental states. This position paper argues that the current discourse conflates sophisticated pattern matching with authentic cognition, missing a crucial distinction between simulation and experience. While recent studies show LLMs achieving human-level performance on ToM laboratory tasks, these results are based only on behavioral mimicry. More importantly, the entire testing paradigm may be flawed in applying individual human cognitive tests to AI systems, but assessing human cognition directly in the moment of human-AI interaction. I suggest shifting focus toward mutual ToM frameworks that acknowledge the simultaneous contributions of human cognition and AI algorithms, emphasizing the interaction dynamics, instead of testing AI in isolation.
papers.comment: This work have been accepted in CogInterp @ NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本立场论文指出，研究者声称AI系统具有心智模型（Theory of Mind, ToM）时，实际讨论的是行为预测和偏差纠正，而非真正的心理状态。论文批评当前话语混淆了模式匹配与真实认知，认为AI在ToM测试中的表现仅基于行为模仿，且测试范式本身存在缺陷——将个体人类认知测试应用于AI，而忽视了人机交互中的人类认知。作者建议转向关注交互动态的互惠ToM框架。
Motivation: 现有关于AI心智模型的研究存在概念混淆，将行为模仿误认为真实认知，且孤立测试AI的方式忽略了人类认知在交互中的作用。
Method: 作为立场论文，主要通过理论分析和批判现有文献来论证观点，提出转向互惠ToM框架的建议。
Result: 未给出具体实验数据，但指出LLMs在ToM测试中达到人类水平仅反映行为模仿，且当前测试范式有根本缺陷。
Conclusion: 研究应关注人机交互中双方认知的协同作用，而非孤立评估AI的心智能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy Use of AI Inference, Efficiency Pathways, and Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: As AI inference scales to billions of queries, estimates of per-query energy use are increasingly important for capacity planning, efficiency interventions, and policy. Yet many public estimates assume non-production settings, leading to systematic overestimation. We introduce a bottom-up framework estimating inference energy from token throughput, node power, and overhead under large-scale deployment assumptions. For frontier-scale models (>200B parameters) on H100 nodes, we estimate a median energy of 0.31 Wh/query (IQR 0.16-0.60), indicating widely cited estimates are overstated by 4-20x. In test-time scaling scenarios 15x longer than typical queries, the median energy rises 13x to 3.91 Wh (IQR 2.15-7.05). Across models, serving systems, and hardware, we estimate 8-20x line-of-sight energy reductions. At datacenter scale, serving 1 billion queries/day requires 0.7 GWh; if 10% are long queries, demand rises to 1.7 GWh/day. With efficiency interventions, it falls to 0.8 GWh/day, mitigating the energy impact of test-time scaling.
papers.comment: A preprint version with DOI is available at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17188770
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自底向上的框架，用于估计大规模部署下AI推理的每查询能耗。针对H100节点上超过200B参数的前沿模型，估计中位能耗为0.31 Wh/查询（IQR 0.16-0.60），表明广泛引用的估计值被高估了4-20倍。在测试时扩展场景下，中位能耗上升13倍至3.91 Wh。文章还分析了数据中心的能耗和效率干预措施的影响。
Motivation: 随着AI推理扩展至数十亿查询，准确的每查询能耗估计对于容量规划、效率干预和政策制定至关重要。现有公开估计多基于非生产环境，导致系统性高估。
Method: 提出一个自底向上的框架，从令牌吞吐量、节点功耗和开销出发，在大规模部署假设下估计推理能耗。
Result: 对于H100节点上的>200B参数模型，中位能耗为0.31 Wh/查询（IQR 0.16-0.60），比广泛引用的估计低4-20倍。测试时扩展15倍时，中位能耗升至3.91 Wh。数据中心层面，每天10亿查询需0.7 GWh，若10%为长查询则升至1.7 GWh，通过效率干预可降至0.8 GWh。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过效率干预（如硬件、系统优化）可以实现8-20倍的能耗降低，从而缓解测试时扩展带来的能源影响。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: OCSVM-Guided Representation Learning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to detect anomalies without labeled data, a necessity in many machine learning applications where anomalous samples are rare or not available. Most state-of-the-art methods fall into two categories: reconstruction-based approaches, which often reconstruct anomalies too well, and decoupled representation learning with density estimators, which can suffer from suboptimal feature spaces. While some recent methods attempt to couple feature learning and anomaly detection, they often rely on surrogate objectives, restrict kernel choices, or introduce approximations that limit their expressiveness and robustness. To address this challenge, we propose a novel method that couples representation learning with an analytically solvable One-Class SVM (OCSVM), through a custom loss formulation that directly aligns latent features with the OCSVM decision boundary. The model is evaluated on two tasks: a \deleted{new} benchmark based on MNIST-C, and a challenging brain MRI \deleted{subtle} lesion detection task. Unlike most methods that focus on large, hyperintense lesions at the image level, our approach succeeds to target small, non-hyperintense lesions, while we evaluate voxel-wise metrics, addressing a more clinically relevant scenario. Both experiments evaluate a form of robustness to domain shifts, including corruption types in MNIST-C and texture or population age variations in MRI. Results demonstrate performance and robustness of our proposed model, highlighting its potential for general UAD and real-world medical imaging applications. The source code is available at https://github.com/Nicolas-Pinon/uad_ocsvm_guided_repr_learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无监督异常检测方法，通过自定义损失函数将表示学习与可解析求解的One-Class SVM（OCSVM）耦合，直接对齐潜在特征与OCSVM决策边界。在MNIST-C和脑MRI病变检测任务上，该方法能有效检测小、非高信号病变，并在像素级指标上展示了对领域偏移的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法存在重建缺陷、特征空间次优或耦合方式受限的问题，需要一种无需替代目标或近似即可直接优化异常检测边界的框架。
Method: 提出一种耦合表示学习与OCSVM的方法，通过定制损失函数使潜在特征直接与OCSVM决策边界对齐，避免了对异常检测边界的间接优化。
Result: 在MNIST-C基准和脑MRI病变检测任务上，该方法成功检测到小、非高信号病变，并在像素级评估中优于专注于大高信号病变的方法，展现了对图像损坏和年龄/纹理变化等域偏移的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 所提方法在通用无监督异常检测和临床相关医学成像（如小病变检测）中具有潜力，代码已开源。

papers.title: Composing Linear Layers from Irreducibles
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary large models often exhibit behaviors suggesting the presence of low-level primitives that compose into modules with richer functionality, but these fundamental building blocks remain poorly understood. We investigate this compositional structure in linear layers by asking: can we identify/synthesize linear transformations from a minimal set of geometric primitives? Using Clifford algebra, we show that linear layers can be expressed as compositions of bivectors -- geometric objects encoding oriented planes -- and introduce a differentiable algorithm that decomposes them into products of rotors. This construction uses only O(log^2 d) parameters, versus O(d^2) required by dense matrices. Applied to the key, query, and value projections in LLM attention layers, our rotor-based layers match the performance of strong baselines such as block-Hadamard and low-rank approximations. Our findings provide an algebraic perspective on how these geometric primitives can compose into higher-level functions within deep models.
papers.comment: 35 Pages, 11 Tables, 6 Figures, Appearing in NeurIPS 2025
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用克利福德代数（Clifford algebra）将线性层分解为双向量（bivectors）的复合，并提出了一个可微算法将线性变换表示为转子（rotors）的乘积。该表示仅需 O(log^2 d) 个参数，远少于稠密矩阵的 O(d^2)。在LLM注意力层的K、Q、V投影上，基于转子的层性能与块Hadamard和低秩近似等强基线相当。
Motivation: 大型模型的行为暗示存在低层原语组合成功能模块，但这些基础构建块尚未被理解。作者试图从几何基元的最小集合中识别/合成线性变换。
Method: 利用克利福德代数，将线性层表示为双向量（编码有向平面的几何对象）的复合，并设计可微算法将线性变换分解为转子乘积。
Result: 该方法在LLM注意力投影上匹配块Hadamard和低秩近似等强基线的性能，且参数效率极高（O(log^2 d) vs O(d^2)）。
Conclusion: 提供了几何原语如何组合成深度模型中高层功能的代数视角。

summary_sections.result: 该方法在LLM注意力投影上匹配块Hadamard和低秩近似等强基线的性能，且参数效率极高（O(log^2 d) vs O(d^2)）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提供了几何原语如何组合成深度模型中高层功能的代数视角。

papers.title: Cross-Layer Discrete Concept Discovery for Interpreting Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting language models remains challenging due to the existence of residual stream, which linearly mixes and duplicates features across adjacent layers, causing single-layer analyses to miss this cross-layer structure. Cross-layer sparse autoencoders (SAEs) address layer mixing but operate in continuous space, where concepts split across many neurons without clear boundaries. We introduce Cross-Layer Vector Quantized-Variational Autoencoder (CLVQ-VAE), a novel framework which maps representations from a lower layer to a higher layer through a discrete vector-quantization bottleneck, collapsing duplicated residual-stream features into compact, interpretable concept vectors. Our approach combines top-k temperature-based sampling with exponential moving average (EMA) codebook updates, providing controlled exploration of the discrete latent space while maintaining codebook diversity. Across both encoder- and decoder-based models on ERASER-Movie, Jigsaw, and AGNews, CLVQ-VAE outperforms clustering, single-layer vector quantized-variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE), and sparse autoencoder (SAE) baselines across three evaluation axes: removing identified concepts drops model accuracy by up to 93%, LLM judges rank our concepts first in 66.7% of comparisons, and human annotators recover model predictions from our visualizations with 78% accuracy versus 54% for clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨层向量量化变分自编码器（CLVQ-VAE），用于从语言模型残差流中发现离散概念。该方法将低层表征通过离散向量量化瓶颈映射到高层，压缩重复特征为可解释概念向量，结合top-k温度采样和EMA码本更新。在多个文本分类数据集上，CLVQ-VAE在概念移除、LLM评判和人类可解释性方面显著优于聚类、单层VQ-VAE和稀疏自编码器基线。
Motivation: 语言模型残差流跨层混合和复制特征，导致单层分析遗漏跨层结构；现有跨层稀疏自编码器在连续空间中概念分散，缺乏清晰边界。
Method: 提出CLVQ-VAE框架，通过离散向量量化瓶颈将低层表示映射到高层，压缩重复特征为紧凑概念向量；采用top-k温度采样和指数移动平均码本更新以保持码本多样性。
Result: 在ERASER-Movie、Jigsaw和AGNews上，移除识别概念使模型准确率下降高达93%；LLM评判在66.7%比较中首选本文概念；人类注释者从可视化恢复模型预测准确率78%，远超聚类方法的54%。
Conclusion: CLVQ-VAE通过离散化跨层表示有效发现可解释概念，显著优于现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: \texttt{Range-Arithmetic}: Verifiable Deep Learning Inference on an Untrusted Party
papers.abstract_en: Verifiable computing (VC) has gained prominence in decentralized machine learning systems, where resource-intensive tasks like deep neural network (DNN) inference are offloaded to external participants due to blockchain limitations. This creates a need to verify the correctness of outsourced computations without re-execution. We propose \texttt{Range-Arithmetic}, a novel framework for efficient and verifiable DNN inference that transforms non-arithmetic operations, such as rounding after fixed-point matrix multiplication and ReLU, into arithmetic steps verifiable using sum-check protocols and concatenated range proofs. Our approach avoids the complexity of Boolean encoding, high-degree polynomials, and large lookup tables while remaining compatible with finite-field-based proof systems. Experimental results show that our method not only matches the performance of existing approaches, but also reduces the computational cost of verifying the results, the computational effort required from the untrusted party performing the DNN inference, and the communication overhead between the two sides.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Range-Arithmetic 框架，用于在不可信方上实现可验证的深度神经网络推理。该框架将非算术操作（如定点矩阵乘法后的舍入和 ReLU）转换为可使用求和校验协议和级联范围证明验证的算术步骤，避免了布尔编码、高次多项式和大型查找表的复杂性，同时保持与有限域证明系统的兼容性。实验表明，该方法在匹配现有方法性能的同时，降低了验证计算成本、不可信方的计算负担以及通信开销。
Motivation: 去中心化机器学习系统中，深度神经网络推理等资源密集型任务常外包给外部参与者，需要在不重新执行的情况下验证外包计算的正确性。现有方法存在布尔编码复杂、多项式次数高、查找表大等问题。
Method: 提出 Range-Arithmetic 框架，将非算术操作（如定点矩阵乘法后的舍入和 ReLU）转换为算术步骤，利用求和校验协议和级联范围证明进行验证，避免布尔编码和高次多项式。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在匹配现有方法性能的同时，降低了验证计算成本、不可信方的计算负担以及通信开销。
Conclusion: Range-Arithmetic 为可验证深度学习推理提供了一种高效框架，适用于区块链等去中心化环境。

papers.title: A Physics-Inspired Optimizer: Velocity Regularized Adam
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Velocity-Regularized Adam (VRAdam), a physics-inspired optimizer for training deep neural networks that draws on ideas from quartic terms for kinetic energy with its stabilizing effects on various system dynamics. Previous algorithms, including the ubiquitous Adam, operate at the so-called adaptive edge of stability regime during training, leading to rapid oscillations and slowed convergence of loss. However, VRAdam adds a higher order penalty on the learning rate based on the velocity such that the algorithm automatically slows down whenever weight updates become large. In practice, we observe that the effective dynamic learning rate shrinks in high-velocity regimes, and damping oscillations. By combining this velocity-based regularizer for global damping with per-parameter scaling of Adam, we create a powerful hybrid optimizer. For this optimizer, we provide rigorous theoretical analysis of operation at the edge of stability from a physical and control perspective for the momentum. Furthermore, we derive convergence bounds with the rate $\mathcal{O}(\ln(N)/\sqrt{N})$ for a stochastic non convex objective under mild assumptions. We demonstrate that VRAdam exceeds the performance against standard optimizers including AdamW. We benchmark various tasks such as image classification, language modeling, and generative modeling using diverse architectures and training methodologies including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Transformers, and GFlowNets.
papers.comment: L. Schorling and P. Vaidhyanathan contributed equally to this work. 20 pages, 10 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受物理启发的优化器 Velocity-Regularized Adam (VRAdam)，通过在 Adam 中加入基于速度的高阶学习率惩罚项，在权重更新较大时自动降低学习率以抑制振荡。理论分析从物理和控制角度论证了动量在边缘稳定性（edge of stability）上的行为，并给出了在非凸随机目标下的收敛界 O(ln(N)/√N)。实验在图像分类、语言建模和生成建模任务上超越 AdamW 等标准优化器。
Motivation: 现有 Adam 类优化器在训练时处于自适应边缘稳定阶段，容易导致快速振荡和损失收敛变慢。
Method: 在 Adam 的每参数缩放基础上，引入基于速度的高阶正则项，使得在高速度区域有效动态学习率缩小，从而全局阻尼振荡。
Result: 在图像分类、语言建模和生成建模任务（使用 CNN、Transformer 和 GFlowNet）上，VRAdam 性能优于包括 AdamW 在内的标准优化器。
Conclusion: VRAdam 结合了速度正则化的全局阻尼和 Adam 的每参数自适应，提供了一种在边缘稳定区域内更稳定的训练方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weighted Random Dot Product Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Modeling of intricate relational patterns has become a cornerstone of contemporary statistical research and related data science fields. Networks, represented as graphs, offer a natural framework for this analysis. This paper extends the Random Dot Product Graph (RDPG) model to accommodate weighted graphs, markedly broadening the model's scope to scenarios where edges exhibit heterogeneous weight distributions. We propose a nonparametric weighted (W)RDPG model that assigns a sequence of latent positions to each node. Inner products of these nodal vectors specify the moments of their incident edge weights' distribution via moment-generating functions. In this way, and unlike prior art, the WRDPG can discriminate between weight distributions that share the same mean but differ in other higher-order moments. We derive statistical guarantees for an estimator of the nodal's latent positions adapted from the workhorse adjacency spectral embedding, establishing its consistency and asymptotic normality. We also contribute a generative framework that enables sampling of graphs that adhere to a (prescribed or data-fitted) WRDPG, facilitating, e.g., the analysis and testing of observed graph metrics using judicious reference distributions. The paper is organized to formalize the model's definition, the estimation (or nodal embedding) process and its guarantees, as well as the methodologies for generating weighted graphs, all complemented by illustrative and reproducible examples showcasing the WRDPG's effectiveness in various network analytic applications.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 12 figures, code to generate Figures 3 to 12 available at https://github.com/bmarenco/wrdpg. Updated to match the published version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了随机点积图（RDPG）模型以处理加权图，提出非参数加权RDPG（WRDPG）模型。该模型为每个节点分配一系列潜在位置，通过内积和矩生成函数指定边权重分布的矩，从而区分具有相同均值但高阶矩不同的分布。作者给出了基于邻接谱嵌入的估计量的统计保证，证明其一致性和渐近正态性，并提供了生成符合WRDPG的图的框架。
Motivation: 现有RDPG模型仅适用于无权图，无法处理边权重分布异质的情况，且无法区分具有相同均值但高阶矩不同的权重分布，限制了网络建模的适用范围。
Method: 提出WRDPG模型：每个节点分配一个潜在位置序列，节点间的内积通过矩生成函数决定边权重分布的矩。估计方法基于邻接谱嵌入的变体，并推导了其渐近性质。同时构建了生成框架，允许从指定或数据拟合的WRDPG中采样图。
Result: 推导了潜在位置估计量的一致性和渐近正态性；提供了生成加权图的方法，并通过可复现示例展示了WRDPG在各种网络分析应用中的有效性（摘要未报告具体数值）。
Conclusion: WRDPG模型显著拓宽了RDPG框架的应用范围，支持加权图且能捕捉高阶矩信息，为网络分析提供了更灵活的建模工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Stop Anthropomorphizing Intermediate Tokens as Reasoning/Thinking Traces!
papers.abstract_en: Intermediate token generation (ITG), where a model produces output before the solution, has become a standard method to improve the performance of language models on reasoning tasks. These intermediate tokens have been called \say{reasoning traces} or even \say{thinking traces} -- implicitly anthropomorphizing the traces, and implying that these traces resemble steps a human might take when solving a challenging problem, and as such can provide an interpretable window into the operation of the model's thinking process to the end user. In this position paper, we present evidence that this anthropomorphization isn't a harmless metaphor, and instead is quite dangerous -- it confuses the nature of these models and how to use them effectively, and leads to questionable research. We call on the community to avoid such anthropomorphization of intermediate tokens.
papers.comment: Appears in ICML 2026. [This is a fork of v1. This fork, while overlapping with v1 in background section, differs both in the overall focus as well as the specific argument against anthropomorphization of reasoning traces]
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，反对将语言模型生成推理任务时的中间令牌（intermediate tokens）拟人化为“推理轨迹”或“思考轨迹”。作者认为这种拟人化不仅是无害的比喻，反而会混淆模型的本质和有效使用方法，并导致有问题的研究。文章呼吁社区避免对中间令牌进行拟人化描述。
Motivation: 当前研究普遍将语言模型在推理任务中产生的中间令牌称为“推理轨迹”或“思考轨迹”，隐含地将其拟人化为类似人类解题步骤，并提供可解释的窗口。作者认为这种拟人化具有误导性，需要纠正。
Method: 作为立场论文（position paper），作者通过已有的证据和论证来支持其论点，未提出新的技术方法。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区避免对中间令牌进行拟人化，以避免混淆模型本质和使用方式，并防止误导性研究。

papers.title: STEAM: Squeeze and Transform Enhanced Attention Module
papers.abstract_en: Channel and spatial attention mechanisms introduced in earlier work enhance the representational capabilities of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) but often increase parameter and computational costs. While recent approaches focus solely on efficient feature context modeling for channel attention, we aim to model both channel and spatial attention comprehensively with minimal parameters and reduced computation. Leveraging the principles of relational modeling in graphs, we introduce a constant-parameter module, \textit{STEAM: Squeeze and Transform Enhanced Attention Module}, which integrates channel and spatial attention to enhance the representation power of CNNs. To our knowledge, we are the first to propose a graph-based approach for modeling both channel and spatial attention, utilizing concepts from multi-head graph transformers. Additionally, we introduce \textit{Output Guided Pooling} (OGP), which efficiently captures spatial context to further enhance spatial attention. We extensively evaluate STEAM for large-scale image classification, object detection and instance segmentation on standard benchmark datasets. STEAM achieves a \(2\%\) increase in accuracy over the standard ResNet-50 model with only a meager increase in GFLOPs. Furthermore, STEAM outperforms the leading modules, ECA and GCT, in terms of accuracy while achieving a threefold reduction in GFLOPs. The code will be made available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 STEAM 的常量参数注意力模块，基于图多头部变换器原理同时建模通道和空间注意力，并引入输出引导池化（OGP）高效捕获空间上下文。在 ImageNet 等基准上，STEAM 使 ResNet-50 准确率提升 2%，GFLOPs 仅微增，且相比 ECA 和 GCT 模块，在保持更高准确率的同时将 GFLOPs 降低三倍。
Motivation: 现有通道和空间注意力机制常增加参数和计算成本，而近期方法仅关注高效通道注意力，缺乏对两者综合且轻量的建模。
Method: 基于图关系建模思想，设计 STEAM 模块，利用多头图变换器架构整合通道和空间注意力；同时提出输出引导池化（OGP）高效提取空间上下文以增强空间注意力。
Result: 在 ImageNet 分类任务上，STEAM 使 ResNet-50 准确率提升 2%，GFLOPs 增加极少；相比 ECA 和 GCT 模块，STEAM 准确率更高且 GFLOPs 降低约三倍。在目标检测和实例分割上亦有提升。
